kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kthaw kurim u Moses , na ka jait Ken , ki la leit ryngkat bad u paid Judah na Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai , sha ka ri shrah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Arad ha Judah . Ki shongduh hangta hapdeng ki Amalek .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kenite , u kpa tymmen u Moses u la leit sha ka ri khlaw Judah kaba don shaphang shathie jong ka Arad ; bad ki la leit sah hapdeng ki briew .

en: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they laughed us to scorn , and despised us , and said , What is this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?
kha: Haba u Sanballat , u Tobiah , bad u nong Arab uba kyrteng u Geshem ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ngi la thmu ban leh , ki rkhie ïa ngi bad ong ,  Kaei kaba phi tharai phin leh ? Hato phin ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Sanballat u Horonite bad u Tobiah u shakri, u Ammonite bad u Geshem u Arab ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la rkhie bein ia ngi bad ki la leh bein ia ngi bad ki la ong, Kaei kane kaei kaba phi leh ? phin leh pyrshah ia u syiem ?

en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , and took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he took all : he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
kha: U syiem Shishak u wan sha Jerusalem bad u shim ïa ki jingkynshew na ka Templ bad na ka ïingsyiem . U shim lut ïa kiei kiei , kaba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kaba u syiem Solomon u la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Syiem Ijipt u la wan hiar thma ia ka Jerusalem bad u la shim noh ia ki spah jong ka iing U Trai bad ki spah jong ka iing syiem baroh: u la rah noh ruh ia ki jingda ksiar kiba u Solomon u la shna .

en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field , and thou hast increased and waxen great , and thou art come to excellent ornaments : thy breasts are fashioned , and thine hair is grown , whereas thou wast naked and bare .
kha: Nga la pynlong ïa pha ban san kum u jingthung baplung . Pha la nang khlaiñ bad jrong bad pha la long ka kynthei samla . Ka shadem jong pha ka la wandur itynnat , bad u shñiuh jong pha u la san , hynrei pha long kaba lyngkhuit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynlong ia me ban nangroi kum u bniat jong ka lyngkha, bad me la nangroi bad nangroi shibun: ki bniat jong me ki la kylla dur, bad ki shniuh jong me ki la san, katba me la lyngkhuid bad lyngkhuid .

en: Behold , I will command , saith the  Lord  , and cause them to return to this city  ; and they shall fight against it , and take it , and burn it with fire : and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant .
kha: Ngan ai ka hukum , bad kin wan biang sha kane ka nongbah . Kin tur ïaleh ïa ka , kin kurup ïa ka , bad thang duh ïa ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ki shnong ka Judah ba kin long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan hukum , ong U Trai , bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban leit phai sha kane ka nongbah bad kin ialeh pyrshah ia ka bad kin shim ia ka bad thang ia ka da ka ding: bad ngan pynlong ia ki nongbah Judah ka jingjot khlem u nongshong shnong .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  that created the heavens  ; God himself that formed the earth and made it  ; he hath established it , he created it not in vain , he formed it to be inhabited : I am the  Lord   ; and there is none else .
kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki bneng — U long tang ma u hi U Blei ! U pynlong bad thaw ïa ka pyrthei — U thaw ïa ka kaba skhem bad kaba neh . Um shym la thaw ïa ka ban iehnoh suda , hynrei ka jaka ba ki briew kin shong kin sah . U long ma u , uba ong ,  Nga long U  Trai  , ym don uwei pat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai uba la thaw ia ki bneng ; U Blei hi uba la thaw ia ka bad u la pynlong ia ka u la pynskhem ia ka, um shym la thaw ia ka khlem da pynlut por: Nga long U Trai ; bad ym don shuh .

en: And Jonathan said unto David , O  Lord  God of Israel , when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time , or the third day , and , behold , if there be good toward David , and I then send not unto thee , and shew it thee  ;
kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  To ai ba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel un long u Sakhi hapdeng jong ngi ! Ha kum kane ka por lashai bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngan kylli jingkylli ïa i pa . Lada ka jingthmu jong i ïa phi ka bha , ngan sa phah ktien ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la ong ha u Dabid , Ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel haba nga la pynsawa ia u kpa jong nga ha ka por kaba lai, bad, ha khmih, lada don ka jingbha ia u Dabid, bad te ngam phah ia ka ha me;

en: And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki shynrang , ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingshongkurim bad ki kynthei kat kum ba dei ka rukom bad ki la ïa ing da ka jingkwah brai para ma ki hi . Ki shynrang ki leh kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki , bad ka jingmih ka long ba ki wallam halor lade hi ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ki don hok ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingleh bym dei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh ki shynrang, ki iehnoh ia ka jingpyndonkam ba kynja met jong ka kynthei, ki la thang ha ka jingkwah brai jong ki iwei ia iwei pat bad ki shynrang kiba trei ia kata kaba ym lah ban leh, bad ki pdiang ha lade ia kata ka jingsiew kylliang jong ka jingbakla jong ki kaba la iakynduh .

en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their hosts with them , about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east : for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword .
kha: U Sebah bad u Salmunna ki don ha Karkor lem bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki . Na ka kynhun shipai baroh jong ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , tang kumba khatsan hajar ngut ki dang sah ; shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ki la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Sebah bad u Zalmunna ki la don ha Karkor bad ki shipai jong ki, kumba shiphew hajar ngut ki briew baroh kiba sah na ki shipai baroh: namar ki la hap shispah arphew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la sei ia ka waitlam .

en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah  ; they shall feed thereupon : in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening : for the  Lord  their God shall visit them , and turn away their captivity .
kha: Ki paid ka Judah kiba lait im kin buhai ha ka ri jong phi . Kin pynbamphlang ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki hangta bad thiah hapoh ki ïing ka Ashkelon . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki un long lem bad ki bad un pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw kan long na ka bynta kiba sah jong ka iing Judah; ha ki iing Ashkelon kin thiah noh ha ka por janmiet: namar U Trai U Blei jong ki un leit jngoh ia ki, bad un pynphai noh ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki .

en: David said moreover , The  Lord  that delivered me out of the paw of the lion , and out of the paw of the bear , he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine . And Saul said unto David , Go , and the  Lord  be with thee .
kha: U  Trai  uba la pyllait im ïa nga na ki sing bad na ki dngiem ; un pyllait im ïa nga na une u Philistia .   To kata ,  u Saul u jubab .  Khie leit , bad U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong shuh shuh , U Trai uba la pyllait im ia nga na ka tyrpeng jong u sing bad na ka tyrpeng jong u bear , un pyllait im ia nga na ka kti jong une u Philistia . U Saul u la ong ha u Dabid , To leit bad U Trai un long ryngkat bad me .

en: And Joshua said unto them , Pass over before the ark of the  Lord  your God into the midst of Jordan , and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder , according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel :
kha: bad u ong ha ki ,  Khie leit sha ka Jordan ha shuwa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un bah ïa u maw ha la ka tyrpeng jong phi , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki: To iaid sha khmat ka synduk U Trai U Blei jong phi haduh pdeng ka Jordan , bad phi shim ia uwei pa uwei u maw ha ka tyrpeng jong u , kat kum ka jingbun ki jait Israel:

en: And it came to pass on the fourth day , when they arose early in the morning , that he rose up to depart : and the damsel s father said unto his son in law , Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread , and afterward go your way .
kha: Ha ka step jong ka sngi kaba saw ki khie dang step bad ki khreh ban ïaleit noh . Hynrei u kpa jong ka kynthei u ong ha u Lebi ,  Da bam da dih shuwa . Kan bha ïa phi . Phi lah ban sa leit hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw, haba ki la khie dang step, ba u la ieng ban leit noh: bad u kpa jong u u la ong ha u khun jong u: To sngewbha ia ka dohnud jong me da ka jingbam ba la shet bad hadien kata to leit noh .

en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch , and of the houses thereof , and of the treasuries thereof , and of the upper chambers thereof , and of the inner parlours thereof , and of the place of the mercy seat ,
kha: U Dabid u ai ha u Solomon ïa ka dur pynkhreh jong ka jingtei baroh jong ka Templ , bad ïa ki kamra buh tiar jong ka bad ïa kiwei pat ki kamra bad ïa ka jaka kaba kyntang tam , ha kaba la map ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ai ha u Solomon ia ka dur jong ka phyllaw bad ki iing jong ka bad ki kamra ba shalor jong ka bad ki kamra ba shapoh jong ka .

en: And when thou prayest , thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
kha: Haba phi duwai , wat long kum ki riewarsap ! Ki ieit ban ïeng bad duwai ha ki synagog bad ha ki kyndong surok , khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba me duwai, wat long kumba ki nongleh arsap ki long: namar ki sngewtynnad ban duwai ha ki synagog bad ha ki thliew lynti ba kin iohi da ki briew . Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ki don ka bainong jong ki .

en: But if the  Lord  make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them , and they go down quick into the pit  ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei lada U  Trai  u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ym pat ju ïohsngew , bad ba ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa ki bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don , ba kumta ki hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , te phin sa tip ba kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada U Trai u pynlong ia kaei kaei kaba thymmai, bad ka khyndew ka plie ia ka shyntur jong ka, bad ka rong noh ia ki, bad baroh kiba iadei bad ki, bad ki hiar stet shapoh ka thliew ; te phin sngewthuh ba kine ki briew ki la pynkhih ia U Trai .

en: And all that Samuel the seer , and Saul the son of Kish , and Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah , had dedicated  ; and whosoever had dedicated any thing , it was under the hand of Shelomith , and of his brethren .
kha: U Shelomith bad ka longïing jong u , ki dei peit ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba la pynkyntang ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ , kynthup ruh ïa ki jingai sngewbha kiba la wanlam da u Samuel , u nongïathuhlypa , da u syiem Saul , da u Abner u khun jong u Ner , bad da u Joab u khun jong ka Seruïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kata u Samuel u nongiohi, bad u Saul u khun u Ner, bad u Joab u khun u Seruiah, ki la aiti lut; bad uno uno uba la aiti lut, u la long hapoh ka kti u Shelomith bad ki hynmen jong u .

en: And now , behold , the hand of the Lord is upon thee , and thou shalt be blind , not seeing the sun for a season . And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness  ; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand .
kha: Ka kti U Trai kan sa wan ha me mynta ; men sa matlah bad men ym ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi shipor .  Mar kumta hi u Elumas u la sngew ba u lyoh khyndew uba ïong u la tap ïa ki khmat jong u , bad u la ïaid kylleng da kaba pyrshang ban wad ïano ïano ban ïalam ïa u na ka kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, ka kti U Trai ka don halor jong me, bad me phin sa matlah, khlem da iohi ia ka sngi na ka bynta kawei ka aiom . Bad mar kumta hi ka la hap ha u ka lyer bad ka jingdum ; bad u la leit kylleng kylleng ban ialam ia u da ka kti .

en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .
kha: Mynta , ïa kane ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha nga , ym namar ba nga kham stad ban ïa uno uno uwei pat , hynrei khnang ba u Syiem Kynrad u lah ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi bad shemphang ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba la wan ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia nga , ia kane ka jingmaham ym shym la pynpaw ha nga na ka bynta kano kano ka jingstad kaba nga don kham palat ban ia uno uno uba im , hynrei na ka bynta jong ki kiba pynpaw ia ka jingbatai ha u syiem , bad ba me lah ban tip ia ki jingmut jong ka dohnud jong me .

en: And when the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians : wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim , which is beyond Jordan .
kha: Haba ki Kanaan kiba shong ha kata ka ri ki ïohi ïa kita ki briew kiba ïambriew ha Atad , ki ïa-ong ,  Kane ka rukom ïambriew ki nong Ijipt kaba da sngew lung mynsiem shisha !  Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka Abel Misraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri, ki nong Kanaan, ki la iohi ia ka jingsngewsih ha ka mala jong u Atad, ki la ong: Kane ka long ka jingsngewsih kaba sngewsih ia ki nong Ijipt: namar kata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Abelmizraim kaba don sha lyndet ka Jordan .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan buh pat ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri jong ki bad ngan isynei ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Ha khmih , ngan wanrah biang ia ka jingshah set jong u Jakob, bad ngan isynei ia ki jaka sah jong u ; bad ka nongbah kan long kaba la tei halor la ka jong ka kynhun, bad ka iing kan sah katkum ka rukom jong ka .

en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them , they determined that Paul and Barnabas , and certain other of them , should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question .
kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la poi sha ka jingïasaid nia kaba jur bad ki shaphang kane , kumta la ïakut ba u Paul bad u Barnabas bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ha Antiokh ki dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad ïakynduh ïa ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang shaphang kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Paul bad u Barnabas kim don ka jingïapher bad ka jingïapher kaba rit bad ki , ki la rai ba u Paul bad u Barnabas bad katto katne ngut ki dei ban leit sha Jerusalem sha ki apostol bad ki rangbah shaphang kane ka jingkylli .

en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth , according to the effectual working in the measure of every part , maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love .
kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u , baroh ki dkhot kiba ïapher jong ka met ki ïabiang lang sbiak , bad ïa ka met baroh kawei la bat lang da kawei pa kawei ka jingïapyndait ïa kaba ka la pynbiang . Kumta haba kawei pa kawei ka bynta kaba ïapher ka ïatrei kam kumba ka dei ban trei , ka met baroh kawei ka san bad ka tei ïa lade da ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Na uba ka met baroh kawei ka iasoh bad ka la shah pynkhih ha kata kaba kawei pa kawei ka shyieng ka pyndap , kat kum ka jingtreikam kaba treikam ha ka jingthew jong kawei pa kawei ka bynta , ka pynlong ia ka met ban nang kiew ha ka jingieit .

en: Also the sons of the stranger , that join themselves to the  Lord  , to serve him , and to love the name of the  Lord  , to be his servants , every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and taketh hold of my covenant  ;
kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ha kito ki nongwei kiba la pynïasoh bad ki briew jong u , kiba ieit ïa u bad kiba shakri ïa u , kiba sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad kiba batskhem ïa ka jutang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki khun shynrang jong u nongwei kiba iasoh bad U Trai, ban shakri ia u bad ban ieit ia ka kyrteng U Trai, ban long ki shakri jong u, uwei pa uwei uba sumar ia ka Sabha na kaba pynjakhlia ia ka, bad u bat ia ka jutang jong nga;

en: It came even to pass on the third day , that , behold , a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent , and earth upon his head : and so it was , when he came to David , that he fell to the earth , and did obeisance .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei u samla u la wan poi na ka jaka sher dara jong u Saul . Ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad sleh ïa la ka khlieh da ka khyndew . U leit sha u Dabid bad u dem ngon da kaba burom haduh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba lai, ba, ha khmih, uwei u briew u la mih na ka shnong u la tyrkhong ia ki jain jong u, bad ka khyndew ha ka khlieh jong u: bad kumta ka la long haba u la poi ha u Dabid, ba u la hap ha ka khyndew bad u la dem khrup .

en: Then he said to Gehazi , Gird up thy loins , and take my staff in thine hand , and go thy way : if thou meet any man , salute him not  ; and if any salute thee , answer him not again : and lay my staff upon the face of the child .
kha: U Elisha u phai sha u Gehasi bad u ong ,  Pynkloi ! Shim ïa u diengduh jong nga bad khie leit . Wat sangeh ban khublei ïano ïano ba me ïakynduh , bad lada uno uno u khublei ïa me , wat shim por ban jubab . Leit beit sha ka ïing bad buh ïa u diengduh jong nga halor jong u khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha u Gehasi, To rah ia ki tyrpeng jong me, bad to shim ia u diengduh jong nga ha ka kti jong me, bad to leit noh: lada me iakynduh ia uno uno u briew, wat ai khublei ia u; bad lada uno uno u ai khublei ia me, wat jubab shuh ia u: bad to buh ia u diengduh jong nga ha ka khmat jong u khynnah .

en: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .
kha: Ngan lumlang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta ngan bishar ïa ki na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ki la pynsakma ïa ki Israel sha ki ri nongwei bad ki la phiah ïa ka Israel , ka ri jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan lum lang ruh ia ki jaitbynriew baroh, bad ngan wanrah ia ki sha ka them Jehoshaphat, bad ngan kyrpad ia ki hangta na ka bynta ki briew jong nga bad na ka bynta ka pateng jong nga ki Israel kiba ki la pynpra hapdeng ki jaitbynriew jong nga .

en: Behold , therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee , and have diminished thine ordinary food , and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee , the daughters of the Philistines , which are ashamed of thy lewd way .
kha: Mynta nga la rah ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa pha bad ban shim noh ïa ka bhah jong pha na ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Nga lah aiti ïa pha ha ki Philistia , kiba isih ïa pha bad kiba sngewjli ïa ki jingleh khlem akor jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor jong me , bad nga la pynduna ia ka jingbam ba rit jong me , bad nga la aiti ia me ha ka mon jong kita kiba shun ia me , ki khun kynthei jong ki Philistia kiba sngewlehrain ia ka lynti kaba sniew jong me .

en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem , saying , There is a king in Judah : and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words . Come now therefore , and let us take counsel together .
kha: bad ba phi la pynbeit ba katto katne ki nongïathuhlypa kin pynbna ha Jerusalem ba phi long u syiem ka Judah . U syiem , khlem pep , un ïohsngew shaphang kane , kumta nga ai jingmut ba ma phi bad nga ngin ïakynduh ban ïakren halor kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la thung ruh ia ki nongiathuhlypa ha Jerusalem, da kaba ong: Don u syiem ha Judah: bad mynta yn sa iathuh ha u syiem kat kum kine ki ktien . To wan mynta , bad to ngin ia iamir jingmut lang .

en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall , and , behold , it be not in sight deeper than the skin , and that there is no black hair in it  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days :
kha: Lada , haba u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa u , u shem ba kata ka prum kam shym long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , hynrei ym pat shym don shñiuh ïong hangta , yn pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u lyngdoh u peit ia ka khlam jong ka sniehdoh bad, ha khmih, kam kham jylliew ban ia ka sniehdoh bad ba ym don shniuh uba lieh ha ka ; te u lyngdoh un khang ia uta uba don ia ka khlam jong ka sniehdoh hynriew sngi:

en: Therefore they sent the ark of God to Ekron . And it came to pass , as the ark of God came to Ekron , that the Ekronites cried out , saying , They have brought about the ark of the God of Israel to us , to slay us and our people .
kha: Kumta ki phah noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha Ekron kawei pat ka nongbah jong ki Philistia , hynrei haba ka poi hangta , ki briew ki la lynñiar jam ,  Ki la wallam shane ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei ki Israel , khnang ban pynïap ïa ngi baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la phah ia ka synduk U Blei sha Ekron . Bad ka la jia, katba ka synduk U Blei ka la poi ha Ekron , ba ki Ekron ki la pyrta , ki la wanrah ia ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel ha ngi , ban pyniap ia ngi bad ia ki briew jong ngi .

en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
kha: U Jisu u la bitar katba u la peit sawdong ïa ki , hynrei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih na ka bynta jong ki , namar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh bymdei . Te u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Rah ïa la ka kti .  U la rah ïa ka , bad ka la khiah bha pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la peit sawdong ia ki da ka jingbitar, u la sngewsih namar ka jingkhlain jong ki dohnud jong ki, u ong ha uta u briew, Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me . Bad u la pynkhih ia ka: bad ka kti jong u ka la kylla long kaba pura kum kawei pat .

en: But when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised them up a deliverer , Ehud the son of Gera , a Benjamite , a man lefthanded : and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab .
kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la kyang jam ha U  Trai  , bad u la phah ïa uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . Une u dei u Ehud , u briew uba trei da kadiang , u khun jong u Gera na ka jait Benjamin . Ki paid Israel ki phah ïa u Ehud ban leit ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon u syiem Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki khun Israel ki la pyrta ha U Trai, U Trai u la pynmih ia ki da u nongpyllait im, u khun u Gera, u Benjaminite: bad da u ki khun Israel ki la phah ia ka jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon u syiem u Moab .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , This is the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , saying , I will give it unto thy seed : I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes , but thou shalt not go over thither .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Kane ka long kata ka ri ba nga la kular ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki . Nga la shah ïa me ban ïohi ïa ka , hynrei ngan ym shah ba men leit shata .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u: Kane ka dei ka ri kaba nga la smai ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob, da kaba ong: Ngan ai ia ka ha u symbai jong me: nga la pynlong ia me ban iohi ia ka da ki khmat jong me, hynrei me ym leit sha kata ka jaka .

en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction , and shall smite the waves in the sea , and all the deeps of the river shall dry up : and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down , and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away .
kha: Haba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ka jingjynjar jong ki , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan shoh ïa ki jingat phyllung , bad ki jingjylliew jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong . Ïa ka Assyria kaba sarong yn pynpoh , bad ka Ijipt bakhlaiñbor kan duh noh ïa ka bor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un iaid lyngba ka duriaw da ka jingjynjar, bad un pynkhih ia ki um ha duriaw, bad ki jingjylliew jong ka wah baroh kin sa tyrkhong: bad ka jingsarong jong ka Assyria kan sa hiar noh , bad ka sniehdoh jong ka ri Ijipt kan sa jah noh .

en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , ka syiem jong ka Sheba kan ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ka la wan na la ka ri bajngai ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong U Syiem Solomon ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mahadei jong ka ri Sepngi kan kiew ha ka jingbishar bad kane ka pateng: namar ka la wan na ki bynta ba kut jong ka khyndew ban iohsngew ia ka jingstad u Solomon ; bad, ha khmih, ka kham khraw ban ia u Solomon ka don hangne .

en: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel , because it was desolate , so will I do unto thee : thou shalt be desolate , O mount Seir , and all Edom , even all of it : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: kumba me shadkmen ha ka jingpynjot ïa ka Israel , ka nongkynti jong nga . Ki lumbah ka Seir , ho-oid , baroh ka ri Edom kin sah kynjah . Te baroh kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba me la sngewbha ia ka pateng jong ka iing Israel, namar ba ka la jah rngai noh, kumta ngan leh ia me: me la jah rngai noh, ko u lum Seir, bad u Edom baroh: bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt  ; which my covenant they brake , although I was an husband unto them , saith the  Lord  :
kha: Kan ym long kum ka jutang barim kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la shim ïa ki da la ka kti bad ïalam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Wat la nga la long kum u tnga ïa ki , kim shym la bat ïa kata ka jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym kat kum ka jutang kaba nga la leh bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha ka sngi ba nga la shim ia ki da ka kti ban pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt ; kaba ki pynsangeh ia ka jutang jong nga, wat la nga long u tnga ha ki , ong U Trai:

en: And it came to pass , as the angels were gone away from them into heaven , the shepherds said one to another , Let us now go even unto Bethlehem , and see this thing which is come to pass , which the Lord hath made known unto us .
kha: Haba ki angel ki la leit noh pat na ki sha bneng , ki nongaplangbrot ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha Bethlehem bad ban ïohi ïa kane kaei kaei kaba la lah jia , kaba U Trai u la ïathuh ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki angel ki la leit noh na ki sha bneng , ki nongaplangbrot ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: To ngin leit mynta wat sha Bethlehem bad ngin ia peit ia kane kaei kaba la jia ha ngi .

en: Moab hath been at ease from his youth , and he hath settled on his lees , and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel , neither hath he gone into captivity : therefore his taste remained in him , and his scent is not changed .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka Moab ka la ju long kaba shongshngain bad ym pat ju ïalam mraw ïa ka . Ka Moab ka long kum ka waiñ kaba la shu ieh kumta khlem pynkhih bad ka bym ju phylliew na uwei u klong sha uwei pat . Ïa ka jingsuhsieng jong ka ym pat shu pynsniew , bad ka jingmad jong ka , ka long kaba bang kumba ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moab u la shongthait na ka jinglong samla jong u, bad um shym la shah pynthylli na ka lieng sha ka lieng, bad um shym la leit sha ka jingshah set: namarkata ka jingsma jong u ka la sah ha u, bad ka jingsma jong u kam shym la kylla .

en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it , and remember all the commandments of the  Lord  , and do them  ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :
kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin long kum ki jingpynkynmaw , bad man ka por ba phi ïohi ïa ki , phin kynmaw ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad kohnguh ïa ki ; te kumta phin ym phai noh na nga bad bud ïa ki jingkwah mon bad ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha phi na ka bynta ka jingeh, ba phin peit ia ka, bad kynmaw ia ki hukum U Trai baroh, bad leh ia ki ; bad ba phin ym wad ia la ka jong ka dohnud bad ki khmat jong phi hi, hadien kata phi ju leit sha ka jaka khaii:

en: Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;
kha: Kylli ïa kine kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip aïu ka pharshi ka mut . Ïathuh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan sha Jerusalem bad rah ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u lem bad u sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong mynta ha ka iing kaba leh pyrshah , Phim tip ia kine kiei kiei ? iathuh ia ki , Ha khmih u syiem Babilon u la wan sha Jerusalem bad u la shim ia u syiem jong ka bad ki rangbah jong ka bad u la ialam ia ki bad u sha Babilon;

en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .
kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u kiew artet ïa ka sharing lum kaba shatei na Jerikho bad u suh sha sepngi lyngba ka ri lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud jong ki shaphang shathie u long na Jordan ; bad u pud u sam u la kiew sha ka liang ka Jerikos shaphang shathie, bad u la kiew lyngba ki lum shaphang shathie ; bad ki jingleit shabar jong ka ki long ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Bethaven .

en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word  ; Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Every bottle shall be filled with wine : and they shall say unto thee , Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine ?
kha: U  Trai  U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ . Kin jubab ba ki tip ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban kren ia ki ia kane ka ktien; Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u ong: Kawei pa kawei ka bilor kan dap da ka wain: bad kin ong ha me: Hato ngim tip shisha ba kawei pa kawei ka bilor kan dap da ka wain ?

en: ( For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man . For oftentimes it had caught him : and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters  ; and he brake the bands , and was driven of the devil into the wilderness . )
kha: U la ong ïa kane namar U Jisu u la lah hukum ïa u mynsiem bymman ban mihnoh na u . Bunsien u la lympat ïa u , wat haba la set khop ïa u , ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u la teh da ki kynjri , u ju pyndkut ïa ki kynjri bad shah ïalam ha u ksuid sha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar u la hukum ia u mynsiem bymkhuid ban mih na uta u briew . Namar bunsien ka la kem ia u: bad la teh ia u da ki kynjri bad ha ki kynjri ; bad u la pynkhih ia ki kynjri; bad u la beh noh ia u ksuid sha ka ri khlaw . )

en: As for you , O house of Israel , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Go ye , serve ye every one his idols , and hereafter also , if ye will not hearken unto me : but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts , and with your idols .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Bad mynta , ma phi ki Israel baroh , to pynsngewbha ïa lade ! To khie bad to shakri ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ! Hynrei nga maham ïa phi ba hadien kane , phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad sangeh ban pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga da kaba ai ki jingai sngewbha ha ki bleithaw jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia phi, ko iing Israel, kumta ong U Trai Blei; To leit sha ki bleithaw jong u, bad hadien kata ruh lada phin ym sngap ia nga: hynrei phim pynjakhlia shuh ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da ki jingai jong phi bad da ki bleithaw jong phi .

en: Yet they obeyed not , nor inclined their ear , but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart : therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant , which I commanded them to do  ; but they did them not .
kha: Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor lane kohnguh . Pynban , uwei uwei baroh u ïai bteng ban long uba mutlop bad uba sniew kumba u ju long . Nga la hukum ïa ki ban bat ïa ka jutang , hynrei ki la kyntait . Kumta nga la wallam halor jong ki baroh ïa ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh, lymne kim shym la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong ki, hynrei ki iaid ha ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud kaba sniew jong ki: namarkata ngan wanrah ha ki ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka jutang kaba nga la hukum ia ki ban leh; hynrei kim shym la leh ia ki .

en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters : but God shall rebuke them , and they shall flee far off , and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind , and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki ïaid shaphrang kum ki jingat phyllung kiba wan stet , hynrei U Blei u sneng ïa ki bad ki kynran , la beh noh ïa ki kum u pui pui ha ki sharing lum , kum u phlangïap ha ka  erlangthari .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin mareh kum ka jingtuid jong ki um kiba bun: hynrei U Blei un pynrem ia ki , bad kin phet noh sha jngai , bad kin shah beh kum ki lum ha khmat ka Iyer , bad kum ka jingkylla ha khmat ka Iyer .

en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good  ; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil : for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh .
kha: U briew uba bha u wallam ïa kaba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba bha kiba ha ka dohnud jong u ; u briew uba sniew u wallam ïa kaba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew . Naba ka shyntur ka kren ïa kaei kaba dap ha ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bha na ka spah babha jong ka dohnud jong u u pynmih ia kata kaba bha bad u briew uba sniew na ka spah kaba sniew jong ka dohnud jong u u pynmih ia kata kaba sniew: namar na ka jingbun jong ka dohnud jong u u kren .

en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes , part of potters  clay , and part of iron , the kingdom shall be divided  ; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron , forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay .
kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ki kjat bad ki shympriah kjat ki long shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha bad shi bynta da ka nar . Kane ka mut ba kan long ka hima kaba la pynïakhlad . Kan don kaei kaei kaba eh kum ka nar , namar la don ka nar kaba la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba me dang iohi ia ki kjat bad ki tyrpeng, ka bynta jong ki khiew bad ka bynta jong ka nar, ka hima kan sa phiah ; hynrei kan don ha ka ka jingkhlain jong ka nar, kumba me la iohi ia ka nar ba la khleh lang bad ka dewbilat kaba jyrngam .

en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge : because thou hast rejected knowledge , I will also reject thee , that thou shalt be no priest to me : seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God , I will also forget thy children .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki shu jot ei namar kim pdiang ïa nga . Phi ki lyngdoh phim suidñiew ban pdiang ïa nga bad phi la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa phi bad ngan ym pdiang ïa ki khun jong phi kum ki lyngdoh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong nga ki shah pynjot namar ka jingbym tip: namar ba me la kyntait ia ka jingtip: nga ruh ngan kyntait ia me: ba me la klet ia ka hukum U Blei jong me: namar ba me la klet ia ka hukum U Blei jong me ruh ngan klet ia ki khun jong me .

en: And it came to pass , when all that knew him beforetime saw that , behold , he prophesied among the prophets , then the people said one to another , What is this that is come unto the son of Kish ? Is Saul also among the prophets ?
kha: Ki briew kiba ithuh ïa u mynshuwa haba ki ïohi ïa u ba u leh ïa kane ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei kane kaba la wan jia ïa u khun jong u Kish ? Hato , u Saul ruh u la long nongïathuhlypa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba baroh kiba ithuh ia u ki la iohi ia kata, ha khmih, u la iathuhlypa hapdeng ki nongiathuhlypa, te ki briew ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: Kaei kata kaba wan ha u khun u Kish ? Hato u Saul ruh u long napdeng ki nongiathuhlypa ?

en: And I fell at his feet to worship him . And he said unto me , See thou do it not : I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus : worship God : for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .
kha: Nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u ban mane ïa u , hynrei u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u para shakri bad me bad kita ki parabangeit jong me , kito baroh kiba bat ïa ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw . To mane ïa U Blei !  Naba ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw ka long kata kaba pyrsad mynsiem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la dem ha ki kjat jong u ban mane ia u . Bad u la ong ha nga: Peit me: Nga long u para bangeit jong me: bad na ki hynmen jong me kiba don ka jingphla U Jisu: mane ia U Blei: namar ka jingphla U Jisu ka long ka mynsiem jong ka jingiathuhlypa .

en: If thou hast run with the footmen , and they have wearied thee , then how canst thou contend with horses ? and if in the land of peace , wherein thou trustedst , they wearied thee , then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Jeremaïah , lada me la thait ban ïamareh pyrshah ïa ki rangbah , kumno me lah ban ïamareh pyrshah ïa ki kulai ? Lada mem lah wat ban ïeng ha ka jaka bym don jingkah , kumno men leh ha ka khlaw harud jong ka Jordan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me la mareh bad ki nongleit jingleit bad ki la pynsngewsih ia me, te kumno me lah ban ialeh bad ki kulai ? bad lada ha ka ri jong ka jingsuk ha kaba me shaniah, ki la pynsngewsih ia me, te kumno me leh ha ka jingsma jong ka Jordan ?

en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with a consumption , and with a fever , and with an inflammation , and with an extreme burning , and with the sword , and with blasting , and with mildew  ; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish .
kha: U  Trai  un shoh ïa phi da ka jingkhrew , da ka khieshoh , da ka jingat thung , bad da ka jingshit kyr-ang ; un phah ruh ïa ka jingryngkhiang , ki lyer khluit , ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Kine ki jingpynjot kin ïailong bad phi haduh ba phin da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un shoh ia me da ka jingbam, bad da ka jingshit, bad da ka jingsma kaba jur, bad da ka waitlam, bad da ka waitlam, bad da ka waitlam, bad da ka waitlam; bad kin bud ia me haduh ba me da jah noh .

en: And the  Lord  hath performed his word that he spake , and I am risen up in the room of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the  Lord  promised , and have built an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u la pyndep ïa ka kular jong u . Nga la kiew ïa ka khet u kpa jong nga , u syiem ki Israel bad nga la tei ïa ka Templ ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la leh ia ka ktien jong u kaba u la kren, bad nga la ieng ha ka kamra u Dabid u kpa jong nga, bad nga shong ha ka khet Israel kumba U Trai u la kular, bad nga la tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: And the  Lord  shall cause his glorious voice to be heard , and shall shew the lighting down of his arm , with the indignation of his anger , and with the flame of a devouring fire , with scattering , and tempest , and hailstones .
kha: U  Trai  un shah ïa baroh ban ïohsngew ïa ka sur bamaïan jong u bad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar jong u . Kin don ki thylliej ding , ki jingjur eh u slap , ki phria bad u slap khlem sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynlong ia ka sur ba donburom jong u ban iohsngew, bad un pyni ia ka jingshai jong ka kti jong u, da ka jingbitar jong u, bad da ka ding kaba bam ia ka ding, da ka jingsma bad ka eriong bad ki mawlyngnai .

en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ? yet among many nations was there no king like him , who was beloved of his God , and God made him king over all Israel : nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin .
kha: Nga la ong ,  Ka dei na ka daw ki kynthei nongwei ba u syiem Solomon u la leh pop . U la long u briew uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno na ki syiem jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew . U Blei u la ieit ïa u bad pynlong syiem ïa u halor ki Israel , bad pynban u hap ha kane ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u syiem Israel um shym la leh pop da kine kiei kiei ? hynrei hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba bun ym don syiem kum ma u , uba la ieit ia u U Blei jong u: wat la katta ruh u la leh ia ki kynthei kiba la shah pynlong ban leh pop .

en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .
kha: Hynrei nga la jubab ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pyntngit ïa lade . Naduh dang khynnah ngam pat ju bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw . Ngam pat ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ba la kheiñ ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong, Ah Trai Blei ! ha khmih, ka mynsiem jong nga kam shym la shah pynjakhlia: namar naduh ka por samla jong nga haduh mynta ngam shym la bam ia kata kaba iap hi, ne la tyrkhong ha ki bynta; lymne ka la wan sha ka shyntur jong nga .

en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , See , thou sayest unto me , Bring up this people : and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me . Yet thou hast said , I know thee by name , and thou hast also found grace in my sight .
kha: U Moses u la ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ka long kaba shisha ba me la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa kine ki briew sha kata ka ri ; hynrei mem pat shym ïathuh ha nga ïano men phah ryngkat bad nga . Me la ong ba me tip bha shaphang jong nga , bad me sngewbha eh ruh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Trai , Peit, me ong ha nga, To wanrah ia une u briew : bad me khlem pyntip ia nga mano ba me phah ryngkat bad nga . Hynrei me la ong , Nga tip ia me da ka kyrteng, bad me ruh me la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong nga .

en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper , or hath a running issue  ; he shall not eat of the holy things , until he be clean . And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead , or a man whose seed goeth from him  ;
kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , uba ngat ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh lane ka jingpang mih jor , ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba un da long uba khuid . Lada uta u ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid da kaba pyndei bad ka metïap , lane lada u ïoh ka jingpang mih jor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno u briew uba long u nongpang niangthohlieh, ne uba don ka jingmih kaba tuid um un ym bam ia kiei kiei kiba kyntang, haduh ba un da khuid . Bad uno uno uba ktah ia kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid da kiba iap , ne u briew uba u symbai jong u u leit na u ; .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to enquire of me  ; Behold , Pharaoh s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land .
kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka don ha ka lynti ban ïarap ïa me , hynrei kan leit phai noh sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel; Kumta phin ong ha u syiem Judah, uba la phah ia phi sha nga ban kylli ia nga; Ha khmih, u Pharaoh u la wan ban iarap ia phi, un leit phai noh sha Ijipt sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: On the seventh day , when the heart of the king was merry with wine , he commanded Mehuman , Biztha , Harbona , Bigtha , and Abagtha , Zethar , and Carcas , the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jong ka jingkhawai jong u , u syiem u dang dih bad sngewkmen , kumta u khot ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki ïunukh kiba long ki shakri ba ju shakri ha syndah jong u , ïa u Mehuman , u Bistha , u Harbona , u Bigtha , u Abagtha , u Sethar bad u Karkas .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , haba ka dohnud u syiem ka la sngewbha da ka wain , u la hukum ia u Mehuman , u Biztha , u Habona , u Bigtha , bad u Abachi , u Zesar bad u Karkas , ki hynriew tylli ki kamra kiba la shakri ha khmat u Ahasuerus u syiem .

en: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him , What hast thou done unto us ? and what have I offended thee , that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .
kha: Nangta u Abimelekh u khot ïa u Abraham , bad u ong ,  Kaei kane kaba me la leh ïa ngi ? Nga la leh sniew aïu ïa me ban pynlong ïa me ban pynngat ïa kane ka jynjar ha nga bad ha ka hima jong nga ? Ym don uwei ruh u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abimelech u la khot ia u Abraham bad u la ong ha u, Me la leh aiu ia ngi ? bad nga la pynsngewsih ia me ba me la wanrah ia nga bad ha ka hima jong nga ka pop kaba khraw ? me la leh ia ki kam ha nga ki bym dei ban leh .

en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .
kha: To ai hukum , te , ba yn da ap phira biang biang ïa ka jingtep jong u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , khnang ba ki synran jong u kin ym lah ban leit ban tuh ïa ka met , bad nangta ban ïathuh ha ki briew ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap . Kane ka jinglamler kaba khatduh kan long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit namarkata ba ka jingtep kan long kaba skhem haduh ka sngi kaba lai , ioh ki synran jong u kin wan miet , bad kin tuh noh ia u , bad kin ong ha ki briew , U la mihpat na kiba iap: kumta ka jingbakla kaba khatduh kan kham sniew ban ia kaba nyngkong .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers , of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods : write thou every man s name upon his rod .
kha: Ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wan ai ha me khat-ar tylli ki diengduh , uwei uwei u diengduh na u nongïalam jong kawei kawei ka jait . Thoh ïa ka kyrteng uta u briew ha u diengduh jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel , bad shim na uwei pa uwei u dieng kat kum ka iing ki kpa jong ki , na ki rangbah jong ki baroh kat kum ka iing ki kpa jong ki: thoh ia uwei pa uwei u dieng jong u .

en: And David arose , and came to the place where Saul had pitched : and David beheld the place where Saul lay , and Abner the son of Ner , the captain of his host : and Saul lay in the trench , and the people pitched round about him .
kha: U leit mar mar ban tip thik ïa ka jaka ha kaba u Saul bad u Abner , u khun jong u Ner , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul ki thiah . U Saul u thiah hapdeng ka jaka sher dara , bad sawdong jong u ki briew jong u ki shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ieng bad u la poi ha ka jaka ba u Saul u la ialehkai: bad u Dabid u la iohi ia kata ka jaka ba u Saul u la thiah: bad u Dabid u la thiah sawdong jong u .

en: For the vile person will speak villany , and his heart will work iniquity , to practise hypocrisy , and to utter error against the  Lord  , to make empty the soul of the hungry , and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail .
kha: Uba bieit u kren bieit bad u pyrkhat ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Kaei kaba u leh bad kaei kaba u ong ka long ka jingibeiñ ïa U  Trai  , bad um ju bsa ïa kiba thngan lane um ju ai ka jingdih ïa kiba sliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u briew uba sniew un kren bein, bad ka dohnud jong u kan trei ia ka jingbymhok, ban leh ia ka jingleh arsap bad ban pynlong ia ka jingbakla kaba jur pyrshah ia U Trai , ban pynlong thylli ia ka mynsiem jong kiba thngan , bad un pynlong ia ka jingdih jong kiba sliang ban jah noh .

en: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in , and sat in the middle gate , even Nergal–sharezer , Samgar–nebo , Sarsechim , Rab–saris , Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon .
kha: ( Haba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem , baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wan bad ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Khyrdop Pdeng , kaba kynthup ïa ka Nergal Sareser , ka Samgar Nebo , ka Sarsekhim , bad kawei pat ka Nergal Sareser . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem baroh jong u syiem Babilon ki la wan rung, bad ki la shong ha ka khyrdop pdeng, wat ha ka por ba sah jong ki syiem Babilon .

en: The land of Egypt is before thee  ; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell  ; in the land of Goshen let them dwell : and if thou knowest any men of activity among them , then make them rulers over my cattle .
kha: Ieh kin ïashong ïasah ha Goshen , ka jaka kaba bha tam ha ka ri . Bad lada don napdeng jong ki , ki briew kiba tbit , buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki jingri jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri Ijipt ka don ha khmat jong me; ha ka ri kaba bha tam jong me bad ki hynmen jong me ban shong ha ka ri Goshen to ai ba kin shong: bad lada me tip ia uno uno u briew uba trei kam hapdeng jong ki, te to pynlong ia ki ki ki nongsynshar halor ki masi jong nga .

en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead , and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall . And there was great indignation against Israel : and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .
kha: Kumta u shim ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , uba dei ban long syiem hadien jong u , bad u la tyrwa ïa u halor ka kynroh shnong kum ka jingkñia sha u blei Moab . Ki Israel ki la sngewshyrkhei bad kumta ki la kynran na ka nongbah bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shim ia u khun rangbah jong u uba la dei ban synshar ha ka jaka jong u, bad u la tyrwa ia u ban thang ia ka jingknia halor ka jingkhang . Bad ka la don ka jingbitar kaba khraw pyrshah ia ki Israel: bad ki la leit noh na u, bad ki la leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place , and shall not be quenched .
kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai ïa ki jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da baroh kaba ki leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka khie pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kan ym duh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la iehnoh ia nga bad ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih sha kiwei pat ki blei , ba kin pynkhih ia nga da ki kam baroh jong ki kti jong ki ; namarkata ka jingbitar jong nga kan sa bthei pyrshah ia kane ka jaka , bad kan ym shah pynlip .

en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and wash himself in water , that he may be clean : and after that he shall come into the camp , and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days .
kha: Uta u briew pat un sait ïa la ki jaiñ , un khi lut ïa la u shñiuh , bad un sum un sleh ; te un sa long uba khuid . U lah ban wan rung sha ka jaka shong dara , hynrei u dei ban shong shabar ka ïingjaiñ jong u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba dei ban pynkhuid un sait ia ki jain jong u baroh bad un sait ia lade ha ka um, khnang ba un long uba khuid: bad hadien kata un wan shapoh ka jaka shong jaka sah jong u hynriew sngi .

en: If one man sin against another , the judge shall judge him : but if a man sin against the  Lord  , who shall entreat for him ? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father , because the  Lord  would slay them .
kha: Lada u briew u leh pop pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , U Blei u lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei mano ba lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta u briew uba leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ?  Hynrei kim shym sngap ïa la u kpa , naba U  Trai  u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uwei u briew u leh pop pyrshah ia uwei pat, u nongbishar un bishar ia u: hynrei lada u briew u leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai , mano ba un kyrpad ia u ? Wat la katta ruh kim shym la sngap ia ka sur jong u kpa jong ki , namar U Trai un pyniap ia ki .

en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the  Lord  , if the thing follow not , nor come to pass , that is the thing which the  Lord  hath not spoken , but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously : thou shalt not be afraid of him .
kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u kren ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad kata kaba u kren kam shym urlong , kata kam dei ka khubor U  Trai . Uta u nongïathuhlypa u la kren na lade hi , bad phim dei ban sheptieng ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u nongiathuhlypa u kren ha ka kyrteng U Trai , lada kata kam bud , lane ka jia , kata ka long kaei kaei kaba U Trai um shym la kren , hynrei u nongiathuhlypa u la kren ia kata da kaba sngewthuh bakla: me dei ban tieng ia u .

en: And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .
kha: Uno uno uba nud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u nongbishar lane ïa u lyngdoh uba shakri ha kata ka por ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynkhuid ïa kata ka jingbymman na Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u briew uba leh khlem akor bad u bym sngap ia u lyngdoh uba ieng hangta ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me, ne ha u nongbishar, wat uta u briew un iap: bad me dei ban weng noh ia kaba sniew na Israel .

en: And the pillars of the court round about , and their sockets , and their pins , and their cords , with all their instruments , and with all their service : and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden .
kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long hynriew hajar arspah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki maw jong ka iingbishar sawdong, bad ki socket jong ki, bad ki pin jong ki, bad ki nar jong ki baroh, bad bad ka jingshakri jong ki baroh: bad da ka kyrteng phin khein ia ki tiar jong ka jingkit jong ki .

en: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans : and thou shalt not escape out of their hand , but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon : and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire .
kha: Te nga la ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa baroh ki kynthei bad ki khun jong phi , yn rah noh sha ki nong Babilonia , bad ma phi ruh ïa lade phin ym lait na ki . Yn sa ïalam ïa phi kum u koidi da u syiem ka Babilonia , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn sa thang lut khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kin pynmih ia ki tnga jong me baroh bad ki khun jong me sha ki Khaldi: bad me ym lait na ka kti jong ki: hynrei men shah shim da ka kti jong u syiem Babilon: bad me dei ban thang ia kane ka shnong da ka ding .

en: And they gave the money , being told , into the hands of them that did the work , that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders , that wrought upon the house of the  Lord  ,
kha: Hadien ba la buh jingkheiñ katno ka dei , ki aiti ïa ka rupa ha ki rangbah kiba dei peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , bad kine ki siew bainong ïa ki misteri , ki nongtei jingtei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia ka pisa, haba la iathuh ha ki kti jong kito kiba leh ia ka kam: bad ki la buh ia ka ha ki nongshna dieng bad ki nongtei kiba la trei ia ka iing U Trai .

en: And when the day began to wear away , then came the twelve , and said unto him , Send the multitude away , that they may go into the towns and country round about , and lodge , and get victuals : for we are here in a desert place .
kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sdang ban sep , ki khat-ar ngut ki synran ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  To phah noh ïa ki paidbah khnang ba ki lah ban leit sha ki nongrit bad sha ki jaka ri jingri kiba don sawdong hangne ban ïoh jingbam bad jaka sahmiet , namar kane ka dei ka jaka kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sngi ka la sdang ban jah noh, nangta ki shiphew ngut ki la wan sha u, bad ki la ong ha u, Pynpoi ia u paidbah sha ki shnong bad ki ri sawdong, bad ki la leit sha ki jaka ri jingri: namar ngi don hangne ha ka jaka ri khlaw .

en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time , even Terah , the father of Abraham , and the father of Nahor : and they served other gods .
kha: U Joshua u ong ha uta u paidbah baroh ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u don ban ong : ‘ Mynhyndai , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki shong ki sah sha shiliang jong ka wah Ïuphratis , bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Uwei na kito ki kpa tymmen u dei u Terah , u kpa jong u Abraham bad u Nahor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki briew baroh , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la shong ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka jingshlei um ha ka por barim , wat u Terah u kpa u Abraham bad u kpa u Nahor: bad ki la shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei .

en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow , as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him : and we , or ever he come near , are ready to kill him .
kha: Mynta te , ma phi bad ka Dorbar to phah ktien sha u rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom ban wallam ïa u Paul sha phi , da kaba leh mynleh ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba thikna shaphang jong u . Hynrei ngin long kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa u ha shuwa ba un poi hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta phi bad ka dorbar phi pynpaw ha u rangbah shipai ba u wanrah ia u shapoh jong phi lashai ka sngi, kumba phi kwah ban kylli ia kaei kaei kaba kham janai shaphang jong u: bad ngi, ne haba u wan hajan, ngi long kiba kloi ban pyniap ia u .

en: And , behold , all the men of Israel came to the king , and said unto the king , Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away , and have brought the king , and his household , and all David s men with him , over Jordan ?
kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong ha u ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong ngi , ki rangbah ka Judah , ki pyrkhat ba ki don ka hok ban rah noh ïa phi bad synran ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi , bad ïa ki rangbah jong phi sha shiliang ka Jordan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, baroh ki briew Israel ki la wan sha u syiem, bad ki la ong ha u syiem, Balei ki hynmen jong ngi ki la tuh noh ia me, bad ki la wanrah ia u syiem bad ka iing jong u, bad ki briew jong u baroh, halor ka Jordan ?

en: The  Lord  do so and much more to Jonathan : but if it please my father to do thee evil , then I will shew it thee , and send thee away , that thou mayest go in peace : and the  Lord  be with thee , as he hath been with my father .
kha: Lada i thmu ban pynsniew ïa phi , to U  Trai  un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pyntip ïa phi ïa kata bad ba phin ïohlait na ka jingma . To U  Trai  un long lem bad phi kumba u la long bad i pa jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u leh kumta bad kham bun ia u Jonathan: hynrei lada u kpa jong nga un leh ia me kaba sniew, te ngan pyni ia me, bad ngan phah noh ia me, ba me lah ban leit suk: bad U Trai un long bad me kumba u la long bad u kpa jong nga .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house , and I will take thy wives before thine eyes , and give them unto thy neighbour , and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun .
kha: Nga smai ha me ba ngan pynlong ïa uwei na ka longïing jong me hi ban wallam jingjynjar halor jong me . Men ïohi ïa ka haba nga shim na me ïa ki tnga jong me bad ai ïa ki ha uwei pat u briew ; bad un ïathiah shongkha bad ki haba dang shai ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan pynmih ia ka jingsniew pyrshah ia me na ka iing jong me hi , bad ngan shim ia ki tnga jong me ha khmat jong me , bad ngan ai ia ki ha u paramarjan jong me , bad un thiah bad ki tnga jong me ha khmat kane ka sngi .

en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods , and all the women that stood by , a great multitude , even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt , in Pathros , answered Jeremiah , saying ,
kha: Nangta ki rangbah baroh kiba tip ba ki tnga jong ki , ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ïeng hangta , kaba kynthup ïa ki Israel kiba shong ha ki bynta bashathie ka Ijipt — u paidbah babun baroh — ki ong ha nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta baroh ki shynrang kiba tip ba ki tnga jong ki ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih sha kiwei pat ki blei bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ieng hajan, wat ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka ri Ijipt, ha Pathro, ki la jubab ia u Jeremaiah da kaba ong:

en: After this I looked , and , behold , a door was opened in heaven : and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me  ; which said , Come up hither , and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter .
kha: Ha kane ka por , nga don kawei pat ka jingïohipaw bad nga la ïohi ïa ka jingkhang ba plie ha bneng . Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba sawa kum ka turoi kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba kren ha nga kumba mynshuwa , kaba ong ,  Wan kiew shane shalor , bad ngan pyn-i ïa me kaei kaba dei ban jia hadien kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane nga la peit, bad, ha khmih, ka jingkhang ka la plie ha bneng: bad ka sur kaba nyngkong kaba nga la iohsngew ka long kumba ka long ka turoi kaba kren bad nga ; kaba la ong: To wan shaneng hangne , bad ngan pyni ia me ia kiei kiei kiba dei ban long hadien .

en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come , and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother , which slew them  ; and upon the men of Shechem , which aided him in the killing of his brethren .
kha: Kane ka la jia kumta khnang ba u Abimelekh bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem , kiba la pynshlur ïa u ban pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon , kin siew na ka bynta ka kam sniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingleh be-ijot kaba la leh ia ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jerubaal kan wan, bad ka snam jong ki kan sa theh ha u Abimelech u hynmen jong ki, uba la pyniap ia ki ; bad ha ki briew jong u Shechem , kiba la iarap ia u ha kaba pyniap ia ki hynmen jong u .

en: And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba nga la ïathuh ha phi mynba nga dang don lem bad phi : Kaei kaei baroh kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Ki Salm ka dei ban urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kine ki long ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi katba nga dang don bad phi, ba kiei kiei baroh kin long kiba la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses bad ha ki nongiathuhlypa bad ha ki Salm shaphang jong nga .

en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment , and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh , and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar , and he shall put them beside the altar .
kha: Nangta u lyngdoh , uba kup ïa ka jaiñkup linen bad uba phong ïa ka patlun linen kaba lyngkot , un weng noh ïa u dpei khleiñ ba sah ha ka duwan bad un buh ïa u harud jong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un phong ia ki jain lin jong u, bad u la buh ia ki jain lin jong u ha ka doh jong u, bad un shim ia ka dewbilat kaba ka ding ka la bam da ka jingknia thang ha ka jaka thang niang .

en: Say unto them , As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked  ; but that the wicked turn from his way and live : turn ye , turn ye from your evil ways  ; for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
kha: Ïathuh ha ki , ba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , Nga long U Blei uba im , ngam sngewbha ban ïohi ba u nongpop u ïap . Ngan jin da la ïohi ïa u ba u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u im . Ko Israel , sangeh noh ka bymman ba pha leh . Balei pha kwah ban ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ha ki , Kumba nga im , ong U Trai Blei , ngam don jingsngewbha ha ka jingiap jong u bymman ; hynrei ba u bymman u phai noh na ka lynti jong u bad u im: phi phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong phi ; namar balei phin iap noh ko iing Israel ?

en: In the first month , that is , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Serksis , ha u Nisan , u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la hukum ban kynting sbai ( la khot ïa ki ,  purim  ) ban shem ïa ka sngi bad u bnai babiang ban pyntreikam ïa kata ka jingsylla jong u . La rai ban pyntreikam ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u bnai ba nyngkong, kata, ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Ahasaerus, ki bret ia u Pur, kata, ka lot, ha khmat u Haman naduh ka sngi haduh ka sngi, bad naduh u bnai haduh u bnai uba shiphew, kata, u bnai Adar .

en: And they shall not come near unto me , to do the office of a priest unto me , nor to come near to any of my holy things , in the most holy place : but they shall bear their shame , and their abominations which they have committed .
kha: Kim dei ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh lane leit hajan kano kano kaba khuid ïa nga lane ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam . Kane ka dei ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym wan hajan jong nga, ban leh ia ka kam lyngdoh jong nga, lane ban wan hajan jong nga, ha ka jaka bakhuid tam: hynrei kin kit ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki bad ki jinglehrain jong ki kiba ki la leh .

en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him , saying , Behold , the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent  ; let thy word therefore , I pray thee , be like one of theirs , and speak thou good .
kha: Ha kata ka por , u rangbah synshar uba la leit ban wallam ïa u Mikaïah u ong ha u ,  Baroh kiwei pat ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingjop na ka bynta u syiem , ka bha ba phi ruh phin leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor uba la leit khot ia u Maiah u la kren ha u, u la ong, Ha khmih, ki ktien ki nongiathuhlypa ki pynbna bha ia u syiem da kawei ka jingmynjur ; to ai ba ka ktien jong me kan long kum kawei na ki, bad me kren bha .

en: Speak not evil one of another , brethren . He that speaketh evil of his brother , and judgeth his brother , speaketh evil of the law , and judgeth the law : but if thou judge the law , thou art not a doer of the law , but a judge .
kha: Wat ïa-wohnia para ma phi , ko parabangeit jong nga . Uno uno uba wohnia ïa u parabangeit ne bishar ïa u , u wohnia ïa ka Hukum bad u bishar ïa ka . Lada phi bishar ïa ka Hukum , te phim long shuh uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , hynrei uwei uba bishar ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kren bein iwei ia iwei pat, ko para bangeit . Uta uba kren bein ia u hynmen jong u, bad uba bishar ia u hynmen jong u, u kren ia ka ain bad u bishar ia ka ain: hynrei lada me bishar ia ka ain , me long u nongleh kam sniew jong ka ain .

en: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim , Azariah the son of Johanan , Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth , and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum , and Amasa the son of Hadlai , stood up against them that came from the war ,
kha: Saw ngut na ki rangbah ba kham pawkhmat jong ka Hima Bashatei , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Berekhaïah u khun jong u Meshillemoth , u Jehiskaïah u khun jong u Shallum , bad u Amasa u khun jong u Hadlai ruh ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki jingleh ka kynhun shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta katto katne na ki khlieh jong ki khun Ephraim, u Azariah u khun u Johanan, u Beriah u khun u Meshillemot bad u Jehiah u khun u Shallum bad u Amasa u khun u Hadlai ki la ieng pyrshah ia ki kiba wan na ka thma .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Uno uno uba shong ha ka nongbah un ïap ha ka thma lane ka jingïapthngan lane ka jingpang . Hynrei uno uno uba mihnoh bad uba pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , yn ym pynïap ; la kumno kumno un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Uta uba sah ha kane ka shnong un iap da ka waitlam, da ka jingkyrduh bad da ka jingpang khlam: hynrei uta uba leit sha ki Khlieh un im; namar un ioh ia ka jingim jong u na ka bynta ka jingbam , bad un im .

en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .
kha: Naba da kumno ki briew kin tip ba me sngewbha ïa une u paidlang bad ïa nga lada me men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi ? Ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ngi kan pyn-i ba ngi long kiba pher na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong nga yn sa tip hangne ba nga bad ki briew jong me ngi la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me ? em ha kata ba me leit bad ngi ? kumta ngin sa shah pyniakhlad noh , ma nga bad ki briew jong me na ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew .

en: And all the spoil of these cities , and the cattle , the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves  ; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword , until they had destroyed them , neither left they any to breathe .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la shim ïa ki markordor baroh bad ïa ki jingri jingdup na kine ki nongbah bad ki la buh ïa ki na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ; ym don uwei ruh uba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jinglute baroh jong kine ki shnong bad ki masi , ki khun Israel ki la shim ia ka jingbam ha lade ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u la sdang da ka waitlam haduh ba kin da pynjot ia ki , ym shym la iehnoh ia ki ban ring mynsiem .

en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war , even four hundred thousand chosen men : Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men , being mighty men of valour .
kha: U Abijah u pynkhreh ka kynhun shipai kaba don saw lakh ngut , bad u Jeroboam u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u da ka kynhun shipai kaba don phra lakh ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Abijah u la buh ia ka thma ha ka kynhun shipai kaba don shiphew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied: U Jeroboam ruh u la buh ia ka thma ha ka kynhun shipai kaba la jied da ki san spah hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied da ki shiphew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied da ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew hajar ngut ki shiphew ha ki shiphew ha ki shiphew ha ki shiphew ha ki shiphew ha ki shi

en: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof , and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it : for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee .
kha: Katba nang bun snem , ka dor kan kham heh ; bad katba nang khyndiat ki snem , ka dor kan kham rit , namar la pynshongdor ïa ka khyndew ha ka jinglah ban pynmih bun ki soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka jingbun ki snem me dei ban pynkiew ia ka dor jong ka , bad kat kum ka jingbun ki snem me dei ban pynduna ia ka dor jong ka: namar kat kum ka jingbun ki snem jong ki soh u die ha me .

en: And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .
kha: Ïa uta u briew la thung syiem bad u la wan phai pat . Mar kumta hi , u la hukum ïa ki shakri ban wan mih ha khmat jong u , khnang ban shem haduh katno ki la kamai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u la wan phai noh, u la hukum ia kine ki shakri ban shah khot ha u, ha kiba u la ai ia ka pisa , ba un tip katno uwei pa uwei u la ioh da kaba khaii .

en: Is it such a fast that I have chosen ? a day for a man to afflict his soul ? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush , and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him ? wilt thou call this a fast , and an acceptable day to the  Lord  ?
kha: Haba phi shahjingit , phi pynshitom ei ïa lade ; phi pyndem ngon ïa la ka khlieh kum u phlang , bad phriang ïa ki jaiñ khain bad u dpei ban thiah hangta . Hato ka dei kata kaba phi khot ka jingshah jingit ? Phi tharai ba ngan sngewbha ïa kata ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka long kaba stet kum kata kaba nga la jied ? ka sngi na ka bynta u briew ban pynshitom ia ka mynsiem jong u ? hato ka dei ban dem khrup bad ban pynphriang ia ka sniehdoh hapoh jong u ? hato phin khot ia kane ka jingstet bad ka sngi kaba pdiang sngewbha ia U Trai ?

en: But if thou return to the city , and say unto Absalom , I will be thy servant , O king  ; as I have been thy father s servant hitherto , so will I now also be thy servant : then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel .
kha: hynrei phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga da kaba leit phai sha ka nongbah bad ong ïa u Absalom ba mynta phin shakri hok ïa u kumba phi la shakri ïa u kpa jong u . Bad leh ïa baroh kaba phi lah ban leh pyrshah ïa kano kano ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me leit phai sha ka shnong bad ong ha u Absalom, ngan long u shakri jong me, ko syiem; kumba nga la long u shakri jong u kpa jong me haduh mynta: te me ruh mynta ngan long u shakri jong me: te me lah ban jop ia ka jingmut jong u Ahitoh .

en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight , and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations .
kha: te ngan weng noh ïa phi na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan iehnoh ïa kane ka Templ ba nga la pynkyntang kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga . Ki briew kylleng kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan sa kheit noh ia ki da ki tynrai jong nga kiba nga la ai ha ki bad ia kane ka iing kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, ngan bret noh ia ka na ka khmat jong nga, bad ngan pynlong ia ka ban long ka nuksa bad ka ktien lyngkot hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: So I took the chief of your tribes , wise men , and known , and made them heads over you , captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , and captains over fifties , and captains over tens , and officers among your tribes .
kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki nongïalam kiba stad bad kiba khraw jingmut ïa kiba phi hi phi la jied na ki jait jong phi , bad nga la buh ïa ki ban peit halor ïa phi . Don na ki , kiba peit ïa ki shihajar ngut , don kiba peit ïa ki shispah ngut , don kiba peit ïa ki sanphew ngut , bad don ruh kiba peit ïa ki shiphew ngut . Nalor kitei , nga la thung ruh ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la shim ia u rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew jong phi, ki riewstad bad kiba la tip, bad nga la pynlong ia ki ban khlieh ia phi, ki rangbah shipai kiba palat ia ki hajar ngut, bad ki rangbah shipai kiba palat ia ki spah ngut, bad ki rangbah shiphew ngut, bad ki rangbah shiphew ngut ki rangbah jong phi .

en: And Saul said , Thus shall ye say to David , The king desireth not any dowry , but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines , to be avenged of the king s enemies . But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines .
kha: bad u Saul u hukum ïa ki ban ong ïa u Dabid ,  Baroh kaba u syiem u kwah na phi kum ka dor jong ka nongleitkurim ka long shispah tylli ki doh otsher jong ki Philistia , kum ka jingpynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong u .  ( Kane ka long kumno u Saul u thmu khnang ba yn ïoh pynïap ïa u Dabid da ki Philistia . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong , Kumta phin ong ha u Dabid , U syiem um kwah ia ka jinglehrain hynrei shispah ngut ki nongshun jong u syiem . Hynrei u Saul u la pyrkhat ban pynlong ia u Dabid ban hap da ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .
kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong nga da baroh kaba ki la leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la khie buk , bad ngan ym pynjah kumto .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la iehnoh ia nga bad ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih sha kiwei pat ki blei , ba kin pynkhih ia nga da ki kam baroh jong ki kti jong ki ; namarkata ka jingbitar jong nga kan sa tuid ha kane ka jaka , bad kan ym shah pynlip .

en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod , and in the palaces in the land of Egypt , and say , Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria , and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof , and the oppressed in the midst thereof .
kha: To pynbna ha kito kiba shong ha ki ïingsyiem ha Ijipt bad Ashdod :  Ïalumlang ha ki lum sawdong ka Samaria , bad peit ïa ka jingkhynwin kaba khraw bad ka jingbymman ba la leh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ha ki iing ha Ashdod bad ha ki iing ha ka ri Ijipt bad ong: To ia lum lang ia lade ha ki lum Samaria bad ha khmih ia ki jingsawa kiba khraw hapdeng jong ka bad kiba shah pynshitom hapdeng jong ka .
