en: Wherefore the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Amaziah , and he sent unto him a prophet , which said unto him , Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people , which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand ?
kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban bitar , kumta u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa sha u Amasaïah . U nongïathuhlypa u la dawa ,  Balei ba phi mane ïa ki blei nongwei ki bym lah wat ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei ha u Amasaiah bad u la phah ha u ia u nongiathuhlypa uba la ong ha u: Balei me la wad ia ki blei ki briew ki bym lah ban pyllait ia la ki jong ki briew na ka kti jong me ?

en: And Jehu went , and Jehonadab the son of Rechab , into the house of Baal , and said unto the worshippers of Baal , Search , and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the  Lord  , but the worshippers of Baal only .
kha: Hadien kata , u Jehu da lade u leit rung shapoh ka templ ryngkat bad u Jonadab u khun jong u Rekhab , bad u ong ha kita ki briew hangta ,  Pynthikna ba tang ki nongmane ïa u Baal ki don bad ym don uno uno u nongmane ïa U  Trai  uba la wan shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la leit sha ka iing u Baal bad u la ong ha ki nongmane Baal: To wad bniah bad peit ba ym don hangne bad phi uwei ruh na ki shakri U Trai .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah  ; They shall not lament for him , saying , Ah my brother ! or , Ah sister ! they shall not lament for him , saying , Ah lord ! or , Ah his glory !
kha: Kumta te , U  Trai  u ong kumne shaphang u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah , u syiem ka Judah ,  Yn ym don ba ïambriew ha ka jingïap jong u lane ba ong , ‘ A katno kaba shyrkhei , ko paralok jong nga , A katno kaba shyrkhei !’ Yn ym don mano mano ba ïam sngewsih ïa u lane uba kyang , ‘ A ko Kynrad jong nga !’ ‘ A ko syiem jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai shaphang u Jehosiah u khun u Josiah u Judah; Kin ym iam na ka bynta jong u, ki ong: Ah hynmen jong nga ! kin ym iam na ka bynta jong u, ki ong: Ah kynrad jong u ! lane , Ah ka burom jong u !

en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for God will deliver it into the king s hand .
kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot shapoh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab .  U Blei un ai jingjop ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u syiem Israel u la ialum lang saw spah ngut ki nongiathuhlypa bad u la ong ha ki: Hato ngin leit sha Ramotgilead ban ialeh thma ? Ki la ong: To leit shaneng; namar U Blei un aiti ia ka ha ka kti u syiem .

en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about , every man with his weapons in his hand  ; and whosoever else cometh into the house , he shall be put to death : but be ye with the king when he cometh in , and when he goeth out .
kha: Ki Lebi ki dei ban ïeng ïada sawdong ïa u syiem , lem bad ki waitlam jong ki , kiba ki la sei , bad ki dei ban don ryngkat bad u syiem kat shaba u leit . Uno uno uba pyrshang ban rung shapoh ka Templ u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Lebi kin ker sawdong ia u syiem baroh sawdong, uwei pa uwei u don ki tiar ialeh jong u ha ka kti jong u bad uno uno uba wan shapoh iing, un shah pyniap: hynrei phi long bad u syiem haba u wan rung bad haba u mih noh .

en: Is it not wheat harvest to day ? I will call unto the  Lord  , and he shall send thunder and rain  ; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great , which ye have done in the sight of the  Lord  , in asking you a king .
kha: Mynta ka dei ka aïom rang ryngkhiang , ym dei ? Hynrei ngan duwai , bad U  Trai  un phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap . Haba kane ka wan jia , phin sa sngewthuh haduh katno phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynba phi pan syiem na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kam dei ka jingot kew ha ka sngi ? Ngan khot ia U Trai , bad un phah ia u slap bad u slap ; ba phin sngewthuh bad iohi ba ka jingsniew jong phi ka long kaba khraw , kaba phi la leh ha khmat U Trai , ha kaba kylli ia phi ia u syiem .

en: And he brought up Hadassah , that is , Esther , his uncle s daughter : for she had neither father nor mother , and the maid was fair and beautiful  ; whom Mordecai , when her father and mother were dead , took for his own daughter .
kha: U don ka bakha , ka Esther , kaba ka kyrteng Hebru jong ka , ka long ka Hadassah ; ka long ka samla ba-bhabriew , bad ka don ka rynïeng ryñiot ba-itynnat . Ha ka jingïap noh ki kmie ki kpa jong ka , u Mordekai u la ri bad pynheh pynsan ïa ka kum la ka jong ka khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynsan ia u Hadassah, kata ka Esther, ka khun jong u: namar kam don kpa ne kmie, bad ka nongtrei ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba itynnad ; ia kaba u Mordecai, haba u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka ki la iap, ki la shim ia la ka jong ka khun kynthei .

en: And it came to pass , as they departed from him , Peter said unto Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias : not knowing what he said .
kha: Katba kita ki rangbah ki dang leit noh na U Jisu , u Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .  ( Um tip da shisha ïa kaei kaba u kren . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba ki dang leit noh na u, u Petros u la ong ha U Jisu, Ko Nonghikai, ka long kaba bha ia ngi ban don hangne : bad to ngin ia leh lai tylli ki Tabernak uwei na ka bynta jong me, bad uwei na ka bynta u Moses, bad uwei na ka bynta u Elias: khlem da tip ia kaei kaba u la ong .

en: These men are peaceable with us  ; therefore let them dwell in the land , and trade therein  ; for the land , behold , it is large enough for them  ; let us take their daughters to us for wives , and let us give them our daughters .
kha: Kine ki briew ki long kum ki paralok ; ai ba kin shong kin sah bad ngi ha kane ka ri , bad kin leit kin wan laitluid . Ka ri ka long kaba kylluid bad kan biang ïa ki ruh . To ngin ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ngin ai ruh ïa la ki jong ba kin ïashongkurim bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki briew ki long kiba suk bad ngi namarkata to ai ba kin shong ha ka ri, bad kin khaii hangta ; na ka bynta ka ri, ha khmih, ka long kaba heh bha na ka bynta jong ki ; to ngin shim ia ki khun kynthei jong ki ha ngi na ka bynta ki tnga jong ngi.

en: As touching the Gentiles which believe , we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing , save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols , and from blood , and from strangled , and from fornication .
kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Jentil kiba la long kiba ngeit , ngi la phah ka shithi sha ki da kaba ïathuh ïa ki ba ngi la rai ba kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ïa kaba la kñia ha ki bleithaw , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam , lane ïa kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , bad ba ki dei ban sumar ïa lade na ka jingawria .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ngi dang ktah ia ki Jutang kiba ngeit , ngi la thoh bad pynkut ba kim ju iohi ia kata kaei kaei, lait noh tang ba ki iada ia lade na kiei kiei kiba la tyrwa sha ki bleithaw , bad na ka snam , bad na ka jingleh be-ijot .

en: And Azariah the chief priest , and all the priests , looked upon him , and , behold , he was leprous in his forehead , and they thrust him out from thence  ; yea , himself hasted also to go out , because the  Lord  had smitten him .
kha: U Asaraïah bad kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , ki peit sah ïa ka shyllangmat jong u syiem da ka jingsheptieng , bad mar mar ki tan jubor ïa u shabar ban mihnoh na ka Templ . U pynkloi ban mih shabar , namar U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asariah u rangbah lyngdoh bad ki lyngdoh baroh ki la peit ia u, bad, ha khmih, u la tyrkhong ha ka khlieh jong u, bad ki la beh noh ia u naduh kata ka por;

en: O Zion , that bringest good tidings , get thee up into the high mountain  ; O Jerusalem , that bringest good tidings , lift up thy voice with strength  ; lift it up , be not afraid  ; say unto the cities of Judah , Behold your God !
kha: Ko Jerusalem , leit kiew sha u lumbah bajrong bad to pynbna ïa ka khubor babha ! To kyang da ka sur bajam , ko Seïon ; to pynbna ka khubor babha ! To kren bad wat sheptieng . Ïathuh ïa ki shnong ka Judah ba U Blei jong ki u la wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Seion, uba wanrah ia ka khubor babha, to kiew sha u lum uba jrong ; ko Jerusalem , uba wanrah ia ka khubor babha, to pynkiew ia ka sur jong me da ka bor ; rah ia ka; wat tieng; to ong ha ki shnong Judah: Ha khmih U Blei jong phi !

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs , or a piece of an ear  ; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed , and in Damascus in a couch .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kumba u nongaplangbrot u shem pat sa tang ar tylli ki kjat , ne ka shkor jong ka langbrot ba u sing u la bam , kumta ruh yn pyllait im tang khyndiat ïa ki briew ka Samaria , kiba mynta ki shong shaniah ha ki jingthiah baremdor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Kumba u nongaplangbrot u shim na ka shyntur jong u sing ar tylli ki kjat, ne ka bynta jong ka shkor ; kumta ki khun Israel kin shah shim noh kiba shong ha Samaria ha ka kut jong ka jingthiah, bad ha Damascus ha ka shuki shong .

en: And Samuel said , What hast thou done ? And Saul said , Because I saw that the people were scattered from me , and that thou camest not within the days appointed , and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash  ;
kha: hynrei u Samuel u ong ,  Phi la leh aïu kumne ?  U Saul u jubab ,  Ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga , bad phim pat shym wan poi haba phi la ong ba phin wan ; nalor kata , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ha Mikhmash ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong: Me la leh aiu ? U Saul u la ong: Namar nga la iohi ba ki briew ki la jah noh na nga bad ba me ym wan hapoh ki sngi ba la buh bad ba ki Philistia ki la ialum lang ha Michmash;

en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning , that there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud upon the mount , and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud  ; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled .
kha: Ha ka step jong ka sngi kaba lai , la don u pyrthat bad ka leilieh , u lyoh uba rben u la paw halor u lum , bad la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi kaba sawa jam . Baroh ki briew kiba don ha ka jaka sher dara ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai mynstep, ba ki la don ki jingsawa bad ki jingshai, bad u lyoh uba jylliew halor u lum, bad ka sur jong ka turoi kaba la khih palat; kumta ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka shnong ki la khih .

en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne , clothed in their robes , and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
kha: Baroh ar ngut ki syiem , ba la riam ha ki jingphong syiem , ki shong halor ki khet jong ki ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba don shabar ka khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel bad u syiem Judah u la shong ha ka khet jong u, u la phong da ki jainkup jong ki, bad ki la shong ha ka jaka kaba thylli ha ka jingrung jong ka khyrdop Samaria ; bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh ki la iathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .

en: And it was told Solomon , saying , Behold , Adonijah feareth king Solomon : for , lo , he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar , saying , Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword .
kha: La ïathuh ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Adonijah u la sheptieng ïa u , bad ba u bat sah ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , u da ong ,  Nyngkong eh , nga kwah ba u Syiem Solomon un smai ha nga ba un ym phah pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u Solomon, da kaba ong, Ha khmih, u la bat ia ki bniat jong ka altar, da kaba ong, To ai ba u syiem Solomon un smai ha nga ha ka sngi ba un ym pyniap ia u shakri jong u da ka waitlam .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If thou wilt walk in my ways , and if thou wilt keep my charge , then thou shalt also judge my house , and shalt also keep my courts , and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong :  Lada me kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh ïa ki kamram kiba nga la shaniah ha me , te men ïailong uba khmih ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ïa ki phyllaw jong ka , bad ngan shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me , kumba nga shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki angel kiba don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid Lada me iaid ha ki lynti jong nga, bad lada me bat ia ka jingbthah jong nga, te me ruh men bishar ia ka iing jong nga, bad men sumar ruh ia ki iingbishar jong nga, bad ngan ai jaka ia me ban iaid hapdeng kine kiba ieng hajan .

en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said , Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? is not he the son of Jerubbaal ? and Zebul his officer ? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem : for why should we serve him ?
kha: U Gaal u ong ,  Ki rangbah kiba kumno ngi long ha Shekhem ? Balei ba ngi shakri ïa u Abimelekh ? U dei uei uta ? U khun jong u Gideon ! Bad u Sebul u la ïoh hukum na u , hynrei balei ngi dei ban shakri ïa u ? To ïaineh ha u Hamor , u kpa tymmen jong phi , uba la seng ïa ka kur jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Baal u khun u Ebed u la ong, Uei u Abimelech bad u Shechem ba ngin shakri ia u ?

en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .
kha: Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïalam ïa phi baroh shi lynter lynti lyngba ka ri shyiap ha kine ki sawphew snem kiba la dep ba un pyndem ïa phi , u da tynjuh ïa phi ba un ïoh tip aïu phi thmu ban leh , bad la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kynmaw ia ka lynti baroh kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ialam ia me ha ka ri khlaw, ban pynrit ia me bad ban pynshisha ia me, ban tip ia kaei kaba don ha ka dohnud jong me, la me sumar ia ki hukum jong u ne em .

en: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the  Lord  , and they shall fish them  ; and after will I send for many hunters , and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga phah khot ïa shibun ki nongtong dohkha ban wan bad kem ïa kine ki briew . Nangta ngan phah khot ïa shibun ki nongbeh mrad ban thwet pynïap ïa ki halor uwei pa uwei u lumbah bad u lumrit bad hapoh ki krem hapdeng ki mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan phah bun ki nongtong dohkha , U Trai , bad kin ri dohkha ia ki bad hadien ngan phah bun ki nongleit khwai , bad kin leit khwai ia ki na u lum baroh;

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Stand in the court of the  Lord s  house , and speak unto all the cities of Judah , which come to worship in the  Lord s  house , all the words that I command thee to speak unto them  ; diminish not a word :
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To ïeng ha ka ïingbishar jong ka Templ bad to pynbna ïa baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa me ban ong ha ki briew kiba wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah ban mane hangta . Wat ym iehnoh ei ei ruh em .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai ; To ieng ha ka iing jong U Trai, bad kren ha ki shnong Judah baroh kiba wan ban mane ha ka iing U Trai, ki ktien baroh kiba nga hukum ia me ban kren ha ki; wat pynduna ia ka ktien:

en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever shall call on the name of the  Lord  shall be delivered : for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance , as the  Lord  hath said , and in the remnant whom the  Lord  shall call .
kha: Hynrei baroh uba kyrpad ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , yn pynim . Kumba U  Trai  U la ong , ‘ Katto katne ha Jerusalem , kin lait im ; kito ïa kiba nga jied , kin im .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba uno uno uba khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai un shah pyllait im: namar ha u lum Seion bad ha Jerusalem kan long ka jingpyllait im kumba U Trai u la ong , bad ha kiba sah kiba U Trai un khot .

en: And they come unto thee as the people cometh , and they sit before thee as my people , and they hear thy words , but they will not do them : for with their mouth they shew much love , but their heart goeth after their covetousness .
kha: Kumta ki briew jong nga ki ïawan paidbah ban sngap aïu me don ban ong , hynrei kim leh satia ïa kaei kaba me ong ïa ki ba kin leh . Ki ktien ieit ki long ha ki rymmiang shyntur jong ki , hynrei ki ïai bteng ha ki rukom khwan myntoi jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki wan sha me katba ki briew ki wan, bad ki shong ha khmat jong me kum ki briew jong nga, bad kin iohsngew ia ki ktien jong me, hynrei kin ym leh ia ki: namar da ka shyntur jong ki ki pyni ia ka jingieit kaba khraw, hynrei ka dohnud jong ki ka iaid bud ia ka jingkwah brai jong ki .

en: His body also was like the beryl , and his face as the appearance of lightning , and his eyes as lamps of fire , and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass , and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude .
kha: Ka met jong u ka tyngshaiñ kum u mawlynnai . Ka durkhmat jong u ka thaba kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh , bad ki khmat jong u ki la meh kum ka ding . Ki kti bad ki kjat jong u ki tyngshaiñ kum ka rnong ba la shut phyrnai , bad ka sur jong u ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh u paidbah bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka met jong u ruh ka long kum ka rong saw, bad ka khmat jong u kum ka dur jong ka jingshai, bad ki khmat jong u kum ki sharak ding, bad ki kti bad ki kjat jong u kum ki rong saw kiba la rong saw, bad ka sur jong ki ktien jong u kum ka sur jong u paidbah .

en: And of the Hebronites , Hashabiah and his brethren , men of valour , a thousand and seven hundred , were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the  Lord  , and in the service of the king .
kha: Napdeng ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , u Hashabaïah bad shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki ba-ha-ïing jong u , baroh ki briew kiba tbit , la buh ban peit ïa ka kam synshar ha baroh ki kam niam bad ki kam hima sima ha Israel kaba shaphang sepngi jong ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki Hebronite , u Hashabiah bad ki hynmen jong u, ki shihajar hynriew spah ngut ki la long ki ophisar hapdeng jong ki Israel ha kane ka liang Jordan shaphang shathie ha ka kam jong U Trai baroh .

en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law , Remain a widow at thy father s house , till Shelah my son be grown : for he said , Lest peradventure he die also , as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father s house .
kha: Nangta u Judah u ong ha ka Tamar ka pyrsa kurim jong u ,  Khie leit phai noh sha ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad to ïaisah riewkynthei tad haduh ba u Shelah u khun jong nga un da rangbah .  U ong kumta naba u sheptieng ïoh ba u Shelah un shah pynïap kum ki hynmen jong u . Kumta ka Tamar ka la leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Judah u la ong ha u Tamar u khun jong u, To sah ha iing u kpa jong me, haduh ba u Shela u khun jong nga un san: namar u la ong: Wat la u ruh un iap noh kumba ki hynmen jong u ki la leh . Bad ka Tamar ka la leit sah ha iing u kpa jong ka .

en: Now I beseech you , brethren , by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye all speak the same thing , and that there be no divisions among you ; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment .
kha: Da ka bor jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi nga kyrpad ïa phi baroh , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin ïamynjur lang ïa kaei kaba phi ong , khnang ba yn ym don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong phi . To phin ïalong kawei , tang ha kawei ka jingpyrkhat bad kawei ka jingthmu .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit, da ka kyrteng U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist, ba phi baroh phi kren kumjuh, bad ba ym don jingpher hapdeng jong phi ; hynrei ba phin iasoh pura ha kajuh ka jingmut bad ha kajuh ka jingbishar .

en: Yet it pleased the  Lord  to bruise him  ; he hath put him to grief : when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin , he shall see his seed , he shall prolong his days , and the pleasure of the  Lord  shall prosper in his hand .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka dei ka mon jong nga ba un shah pynshitom ; ka jingïap jong u ka long ka jingkñia ban wanrah ïa ka jingmap-ei . Bad kumta un ïohi ïa la ki khun ki ksiew ; un ïoh ïa ka jingim kaba jlan , bad lyngba jong u ïa ka jingthmu jong nga yn pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la pynsngewbha ia U Trai ban pynmong ia u ; u la buh ia u ha ka jingsngewsih: haba me pynlong ia ka mynsiem jong u ka jingknia na ka bynta ka pop , un iohi ia u symbai jong u , un pynjlan ia ki sngi jong u , bad ka jingsngewbha U Trai kan roi ha ka kti jong u .

en: For our rejoicing is this , the testimony of our conscience , that in simplicity and godly sincerity , not with fleshly wisdom , but by the grace of God , we have had our conversation in the world , and more abundantly to you-ward .
kha: Ngi sngewsarong ba ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynskhem ïa ngi ba ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei , bad khamtam eh ba ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi , la pynïaid da kata ka jingkhuid bad ka jingsngur kaba na U Blei , da ka bor ka jingaiei U Blei bad ym da ka jingstad briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingkmen jong ngi ka long kane, ka jingphla jong ka jingsngew jong ngi, ba ha ka jinglong kaba suk bad kaba riewblei, ym da ka jingstad ba kynja doh, hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ngi la ioh ia ka jingiakren jong ngi ha ka pyrthei , bad kham bunsien ia phi .

en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day  ; then he establisheth all her vows , or all her bonds , which are upon her : he confirmeth them , because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them .
kha: Hynrei lada ha ka sngi ba u ïohsngew ïa ka jingkular , um shym pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah , ka dei ban pyndep lut ïa kaba ka la kular . U la pynskhem ïa ka jingkular da kaba um pyrshah ei ei ha kata ka sngi ba u ïohsngew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u bat pura ia ka naduh ka sngi shuh shuh: te u pynskhem ia ki jingkular jong ka baroh: u pynskhem ia ki: namar u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u ha ka sngi ba u la iohsngew ia ki .

en: So he came to the king . And the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall we forbear ? And he answered him , Go , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
kha: Haba u wan mih ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Khie tur ïaleh !  u Mikaïah u jubab .  Da shisha phin jop . U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la wan sha u syiem . Bad u syiem u la ong ha u, U Mikaiah, hato ngin leit sha ka thma Ramotgilead sha ka thma ? Bad u la jubab ia u, To leit, bad to roi: namar U Trai un aiti ia ka ha ka kti u syiem .

en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves : and their horsemen shall spread themselves , and their horsemen shall come from far  ; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat .
kha: Ki kulai jong ki , ki kham stet ban ïa ki  labasa , kham shyrkhei ban ïa ki suri bathngan . Ki nongshong kulai jong ki , ki wan tur na ki jaka ba sha jngai ; ki kulai jong ki , ki trud ïa ka khyndew . Ki wan suh wia kum ki pukni kiba tur ha ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kulai jong ki ruh ki kham stet ban ia ki blang , bad ki kham shyrkhei ban ia ki blang janmiet: bad ki kulai jong ki kin saphriang ia lade , bad ki kulai jong ki kin wan na jngai; kin her kum u blang uba kyrkieh ban bam .

en: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies , but turned their backs before their enemies , because they were accursed : neither will I be with you any more , except ye destroy the accursed from among you .
kha: Dei namar kane ba ki Israel kim lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Ki kynran dien na ki namar ki hi ki la shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot ! Ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad phi lymda phi pynjot thiaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la hukum ïa phi ban ym shim !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki khun Israel kim lah ban ieng ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki , hynrei ki phai noh sha khmat ki nongshun jong ki: lymne ngan ym don shuh bad phi , lymda phi pynjot ia kiba la shah kyntait na pdeng jong phi .

en: Behold , he is hid now in some pit , or in some other place : and it will come to pass , when some of them be overthrown at the first , that whosoever heareth it will say , There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom .
kha: Wat mynta hi u dang rieh ha kawei na ki krem lane ha kawei pat ka jaka . Hamar ba u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong phi , kat uba ïohsngew ïa kata un ong ba ki rangbah jong phi ki la shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u la buhrieh mynta ha kano kano ka thliew , ne ha kawei pat ka jaka: bad kan sa jia , haba don napdeng jong ki ha kaba nyngkong , ba uno uno uba iohsngew un ong , Ka don ka jingpyniap briew hapdeng ki briew kiba bud ia u Absalom .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  against all mine evil neighbours , that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit  ; Behold , I will pluck them out of their land , and pluck out the house of Judah from among them .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga don ei ei ban ong shaphang ki paramarjan jong ka Israel kiba la pynjot ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan shim noh ïa kito ki briew bymman na ki ri jong ki kum ïa u jingthung ba la rat , bad ngan pyllait im ïa ka Judah na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai pyrshah ia ki para marjan kiba sniew jong nga baroh, kiba ktah ia ka pateng kaba nga la pynlong ia ki briew jong nga ban hiar pateng ; Ha khmih ngan kheit noh ia ki na ka ri jong ki, bad ngan kheit noh ia ka iing u Judah na pdeng jong ki .

en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .
kha: Wat lada kito ki bym dei hok ban shah pynshitom ki dei ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ma phi phin lait noh khlem shah pynshitom ? Em , phi dei ban dih na kane ka khuri !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai ; Ha khmih , kita kiba ka jingbishar jong ki kam shym la dih ia ka khuri ki la dih kyiad shuh shuh; bad me uta uba leit khlem da shah pynshitom ? me dei ban leit khlem da shah pynshitom , hynrei me dei ban dih shisha na ka .

en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin , after their journeys , according to the commandment of the  Lord  , and pitched in Rephidim : and there was no water for the people to drink .
kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na ka ri shyiap Sin , da kaba ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ka jaka kat kum ka hukum U  Trai . Ki la sher dara ha Rephidim , hynrei ym don umdih hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiaseng baroh jong ki khun Israel ka la iaid na ka ri khlaw jong ka pop, hadien ki jingleit jong ki, kat kum ka hukum U Trai: bad ym don um ia ki briew ban dih .

en: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw , and there came water thereout  ; and when he had drunk , his spirit came again , and he revived : wherefore he called the name thereof En–hakkore , which is in Lehi unto this day .
kha: Kumta U Blei u pynpdang ïa ka khyndew hangta ha Lehi , bad ka mih ka um na ka . U Samson u dih ïa ka bad u sdang ban kham ïohbor . Kumta ïa kata ka umpohliew la khot Hakkore ; ka dang don hi hangta ha Lehi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wanrah ia ka jaka kaba jylliew kaba don ha ka shyntur, bad ka la mih ka um nangta bad ynda u la dih, ka mynsiem jong u ka la wan biang: namar kata u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Enhakhala, kaba don ha ka por mynta .

en: And the  Lord  was gracious unto them , and had compassion on them , and had respect unto them , because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them , neither cast he them from his presence as yet .
kha: hynrei U  Trai  u long uba bha bad leh-isynei ïa ki . Um shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki , hynrei u ïarap ïa ki , namar ka jutang jong u bad u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Um pat ju klet ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la sngewsynei ia ki, bad u la sngewsynei ia ki, bad u la burom ia ki, namar ka jutang jong u bad u Abraham, u Isaak bad u Jakob, bad un ym pynjot ia ki, lymne un ym bret ia ki na ka jingdon jong u haduh mynta .

en: And in the valley , Beth–haram , and Beth–nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .
kha: Ha ka Them Jordan ka kynthup ïa ka Beth Haram , ka Bethnimrah , ka Sukkoth , bad ka Saphon , kaba sah na ka hima u Sihon u syiem Heshbon . Ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ki ka dei ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka phang bashatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka them, u Bethharam, bad u Bethnimrah, bad u Sucoth, bad u Spahon, kiwei pat ki hima u Syiem Heshbon, u Jordan bad u pud jong u, haduh ka tduh jong ka duriaw Chinnereth shaphang mihngi .

en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .
kha: U Ahas u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :  Nga long u shakri baïaineh jong phi . To wan bad pyllait im ïa nga na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel , kiba wan tur ïaleh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Ahasa u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u syiem jong ka ri Asyria, u da ong, Nga long u shakri jong me bad u khun jong me: to wan shaneng, bad pyllait im ia nga na ka kti u syiem Syria bad na ka kti u syiem Israel uba kiew pyrshah ia nga .

en: And I will bring a sword upon you , that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant : and when ye are gathered together within your cities , I will send the pestilence among you  ; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy .
kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingpynkheiñ jutang jong phi , bad lada phi wad jingïada da kaba ïalumlang ha la ki shnong , ngan phah ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah hapdeng jong phi bad phin hap pyndem ha ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia ka waitlam halor jong phi, kaba pynkhih ia ka jingialeh jong nga: bad ynda la lum lang ia phi hapoh ki nongbah jong phi , ngan phah ia ka jingpang hapdeng jong phi ; bad phin sa shah aiti ha ka kti jong u nongshun .

en: And they cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and wailing , saying , Alas , alas , that great city , wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness ! for in one hour is she made desolate .
kha: Ki la kynting pui pui halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la lynñiar bad ki la ïambriew , da kaba ong ,  Katno kaba shyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka long ka nongbah ha kaba baroh kiba don ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha ki duriaw ki la kylla riewspah ha ka spah jong ka ! Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kiei kiei baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bret ia ka dewmet ha ki khlieh jong ki, bad ki la pyrta, ki iam bad ki iam, ki ong, Ah, kata ka nongbah kaba khraw, ha kaba la pynlong ia ki lieng baroh ha duriaw namar ka jinglut jingsep jong ka ! namar ha ka shi kynta la pynlong ia ka ban jah rngai noh .

en: And it came to pass , when the sun did arise , that God prepared a vehement east wind  ; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah , that he fainted , and wished in himself to die , and said , It is better for me to die than to live .
kha: Hadien ba ka sngi ka la mih , U Blei u la phah ïa ka lyer mihngi kaba shit , bad u Jonah u la jan ïapler na ka jingshit jong ka sngi kaba shoh halor ka khlieh jong u . Kumta u la kwah ban ïap noh .  Ka kham bha ïa nga ban ïap noh ban ïa kaba im ,  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ka sngi ka la mih, ba U Blei u la pynkhreh ia ka Iyer kaba jur bha shaphang mihngi bad ka sngi ka la beh ia ka khlieh jong u Jonah, ba u la lyngngoh bad u la kwah ha lade ban iap, bad u la ong: Ka kham bha ia nga ban iap ban ia kaba im .

en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the  Lord .
kha: Shisien shisnem , u Aaron un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da kaba buh ha ki reng jong ka baroh saw tylli ïa ka snam jong ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Dei ban leh ïa kane man ka snem ha ki por baroh ki ban wan . Kane ka duwan ka dei ban long kaba khuid , kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Aaron un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid ia ki bniat jong ka shisien ha ka shisnem da ka snam jong ka jingknia pop: shisien ha ka shisnem un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid ia ka ha ki pateng jong phi baroh: ka long kaba khuid tam ha U Trai .

en: For they vex you with their wiles , wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor , and in the matter of Cozbi , the daughter of a prince of Midian , their sister , which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor s sake .
kha: namar ka kam bymman ba ki la leh ïa phi haba ki la shukor ïa phi ha Peor , bad namar ka Kosbi kaba la shah pynïap ha ka por jong ka jingïapthem ha Peor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki pynsngewsih ia phi da ki khnai jong ki, ha kaba ki la pynsngewsih ia phi ha ka kam jong u Peor , bad ha ka kam jong u Kozbi , ka khun jong u syiem u Midian , ka para jong ki kaba la shah pyniap ha ka sngi jong ka khlam na ka bynta u Peor .

en: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , thou that killest the prophets , and stonest them which are sent unto thee , how often would I have gathered thy children together , even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings , and ye would not !
kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah ha pha ! Katno sien nga la kwah ban kdup ha ki ksang ti jong nga ïa ki briew jong pha baroh , kumba ka syiar ka lumlang ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , hynrei pham shym la shah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Jerusalem, Jerusalem, me uba pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa bad uba pyniap ia kita kiba la phah sha me, katno sien nga la lum lang ia ki khun jong me, kumba ka syiar ka lum ia ki syiar jong ka hapoh ki bniat jong ka , bad phim shym la lum ia ki khun jong ka hapoh ki bniat jong ka !

en: And thou , Pashur , and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity : and thou shalt come to Babylon , and there thou shalt die , and shalt be buried there , thou , and all thy friends , to whom thou hast prophesied lies .
kha: Na ka bynta jong me , ko Pashhur , ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me baroh yn kem ruh bad rah sha Babilonia . Hangta men ïap bad yn tep , lem bad ki paralok jong me baroh ïa kiba me la lah ïathuh bun ki jinglamler .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, Pashur, bad baroh kiba shong ha ka iing jong me kin leit sha ka jinglong mraw: bad me wan sha Babilon, bad hangta me iap, bad me shah tep hangta, me bad ki paralok jong me baroh, ha kiba me la iathuhlypa .

en: And she said , I will surely go with thee : notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour  ; for the  Lord  shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman . And Deborah arose , and went with Barak to Kedesh .
kha: Ka jubab ,  Ñiuma , ngan leit ryngkat bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh burom ei ei ïa ka jingjop , namar U  Trai  un aiti ïa u Sisera ha ka kynthei .  Kumta ka Deborah ka leit bad u Barak sha Kedesh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , Ngan leit ryngkat bad me: wat la ka jingleit kaba me shim kan ym long na ka bynta ka burom jong me; namar U Trai un die ia u Sisera ha ka kti jong ka kynthei . U Deborah u la ieng bad u Barak sha Kadesh .

en: And it shall come to pass , that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court , they shall be clothed with linen garments  ; and no wool shall come upon them , whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court , and within .
kha: Haba ki rung ïa ka khyrdop sha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka Templ , kin phong ïa ki sopti jaiñ linen . Kim dei ban phong kano kano ba la thain na u  saiwul haba ki don ha ka kam ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh lane hapoh ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan jia ba haba ki rung ha ki khyrdop jong ka phyllaw ba shapoh , kin sa phong da ki jain lyngkhuid ; bad ym don snieh langbrot ha ki , ha kaba ki shakri ha ki khyrdop jong ka phyllaw ba shapoh .

en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul s bolster  ; and they gat them away , and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked : for they were all asleep  ; because a deep sleep from the  Lord  was fallen upon them .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u shim ïa uta u sum bad ïa uta u khiew um najan ka khlieh u Saul , bad ma u bad u Abishai ki mihnoh . Ym don mano mano uba la ïohi lane tip ïa kata ; ym don ruh mano mano uba la kyndit — baroh ki dang ïohthiah lyngngai , namar ba U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba jur ha ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la shim ia ka khnam bad ka um kaba jylliew na u Saul u la leit noh ia ki, bad ym don ba iohi ia ka, lymne tip ia ka: namar baroh ki la iohthiah lyngngai na U Trai .

en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not , I put my life in my hands , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  delivered them into my hand : wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day , to fight against me ?
kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba phim shym wan ïarap ïa nga , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim bad nga jam ïa u pud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ; bad U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka jingjop halor jong ki . Te balei pat phi wan ban ïaleh ïa nga mynta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la iohi ba phim shym la pyllait im ia nga, nga la buh ia ka jingim jong nga ha ki kti jong nga, bad nga la iaid lait noh ia ki khun Ammon, bad U Trai u la pyllait ia ki ha ka kti jong nga: namar kata te phi wan shaneng ha nga ha kane ka sngi ban ialeh pyrshah ia nga ?

en: And it shall come to pass , when all these things are come upon thee , the blessing and the curse , which I have set before thee , and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath driven thee ,
kha: Mynta nga la ai ba phin jied napdeng ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim . Ynda kine kiei kiei baroh ki la wan jia ha phi , bad phi shong hapdeng ki jaitbynriew sha kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynsakma ïa phi , phin sa kynmaw ïa ka jingjied ba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, haba kine kiei kiei baroh ki wan ha me, ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim kaba nga la buh ha khmat jong me, bad me dei ban khot ia ki ha ka jingmut jong ki jaitbynriew baroh, ha kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la beh noh ia me .

en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests , and they builded the sheep gate  ; they sanctified it , and set up the doors of it  ; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it , unto the tower of Hananeel .
kha: Kane ka long kumno ba la tei pat ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u ki la tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Langbrot , ki pynkyntang ïa ka , bad pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop . Ki la pynkyntang ïa ka kynroh haduh u Mot ki Shispah bad u Mot Hananel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eliashib u rangbah lyngdoh u la ieng bad ki hynmen jong u ki lyngdoh , bad ki la tei ia ka khyrdop langbrot ; ki la pynkyntang ia ka , bad ki la buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka ; haduh ka tower jong ka Meh ki la pynkyntang ia ka, haduh ka tower jong u Hanel .

en: And it came to pass , when their hearts were merry , that they said , Call for Samson , that he may make us sport . And they called for Samson out of the prison house  ; and he made them sport : and they set him between the pillars .
kha: Ki ïalehkmen para ma ki , kumta ki ong  Khot ïa u Samson , bad ngin phah ïa u ban pynbyrngia ïa ngi !  Haba ki la wallam ïa u Samson na ka byndi , ki phah ba un pynbyrngia ïa ki bad ki pynïeng ïa u hapdeng ki rishot . Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa u , ki rwai ïaroh sha u blei jong ki :  U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor u nongshun jong ngi , uba la pynjot ïa ka ri jong ngi bad uba la pynïap shibun na ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki dohnud jong ki ki la sngewbha, ba ki la ong, Khot ia u Samson, ba un pynlong ia ngi ban ialehkai . Bad ki la khot ia u Samson na ka iing set phatok ; bad u la pynlong ia ki ban ialehkai: bad ki la buh ia u hapdeng ki lum .

en: The sons of Amram  ; Aaron and Moses : and Aaron was separated , that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons for ever , to burn incense before the  Lord  , to minister unto him , and to bless in his name for ever .
kha: U Amram , u khun nyngkong jong u , u dei u kpa jong u Aaron bad u Moses . ( Ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u la pynkyrpang ban sumar junom ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba khuid , ban thang jingiwbih ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , ban shakri ïa u , bad ban kyrkhu ïa ki briew ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Amram ; Aaron bad u Moses: bad u Aaron u la shah pyniakhlad noh , ba un pynkyntang ia kiei kiei kiba khuid tam , ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u junom , ban thang ia ka jingiwbih ha khmat U Trai , ban shakri ia u bad ban kyrkhu ia ka kyrteng jong u junom .

en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said ,  I have compassion on the multitude , because they continue with me now three days , and have nothing to eat : and I will not send them away fasting , lest they faint in the way .
kha: U Jisu u la khot ïa la ki synran sha lade bad u la ong ,  Nga isynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la ïadon bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei ban bam . Ngam kwah ban phah noh ïa ki khlem da bsa ïa ki , naba ki lah ban ïapler ha ka lynti jong ki sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ia ki synran jong u ha u bad u la ong, Nga sngewsynei ia u paidbah, namar ki iai bteng bad nga mynta lai sngi, bad kim don ei ei ban bam: bad ngan ym phah noh ia ki da kaba shah jingit, ioh kin sa lyngngoh ha lynti .

en: Because they have committed villany in Israel , and have committed adultery with their neighbours  wives , and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them  ; even I know , and am a witness , saith the  Lord .
kha: Kane kan long ka kupar jong ki namar ki la shah rem na ki pop bashyrkhei — ki la leh awria bad ki la ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai . Kane ka long pyrshah ïa ka mon ka jong U  Trai  ; u tip ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , bad u long u sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la leh ia ka kam runar ha Israel , bad ki la leh ia ka kam runar bad ki tnga jong ki para marjan jong ki , bad ki la kren ia ki ktien thok ha ka kyrteng jong nga , kiba ngam shym la hukum ia ki ; wat nga ruh nga tip , bad nga long u sakhi , ong U Trai .

en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .
kha: Tei ïa nga kawei ka duwan da ka khyndew , bad kñia ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi jong phi halor jong ka kum ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha man la ka jaka ba nga pynkyrpang ba phin mane ïa nga , ngan wan bad kyrkhu ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaka bam jong ka khyndew me dei ban leh ha nga, bad ha kata ka por jong me, bad ki jingknia jingsuk jong me, ki langbrot jong me bad ki masi jong me: ha ki jaka baroh ha kaba nga thoh ia ka kyrteng jong nga ngan wan sha me bad ngan kyrkhu ia me .

en: And he brought me to the porch of the house , and measured each post of the porch , five cubits on this side , and five cubits on that side : and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side , and three cubits on that side .
kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka kamra rung jong ka templ . U la thew ïa ka tyngkong : ka la long ar mitar shiteng ka jingjylliew bad hynñiew mitar ka pyngkiang , lem bad ki kynroh kiba rben shi mitar shiteng ha baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga sha ka phyllaw jong ka iing, bad u la thew ia kawei pa kawei ka post, san phut na kane ka liang: bad ka jingjylliew jong ka khyrdop ka long lai phut na kane ka liang .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear not , neither be thou dismayed : take all the people of war with thee , and arise , go up to Ai : see , I have given into thy hand the king of Ai , and his people , and his city , and his land :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ïalam lang bad me ïa ki shipai baroh bad leit kiew sha Ai . Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop ïa u syiem ka Ai ; ki briew jong u , ka nongbah jong u , bad ka ri kan long ka jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Joshua, Wat tieng, lymne wat sngewsih: shim ia ki briew kiba ialeh thma bad me, bad to khie, leit sha Ai: peit, nga la aiti ha ka kti jong me ia u syiem Ai, bad ki briew jong u, bad ka shnong jong u:

en: Then Uzziah was wroth , and had a censer in his hand to burn incense : and while he was wroth with the priests , the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the  Lord  , from beside the incense altar .
kha: U Ussaïah u ïeng hangta hapoh ka Templ harud ka duwan thang jingiwbih , bad u bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih . U la bitar ïa kita ki lyngdoh , bad mar kumta ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka mih ha ka shyllangmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Uzziah u la bitar , bad u don ka umphniang ha ka kti jong u ban thang ia ka jingiwbih: bad katba u dang bitar bad ki lyngdoh , u la kiew wat ha ka khlieh jong u ha khmat ki lyngdoh ha ka iing U Trai , najan ka jaka thang jingiwbih .

en: The  Lord  hath sworn by his right hand , and by the arm of his strength , Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies  ; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine , for the which thou hast laboured :
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang bad da ka bor jong u , un pynlongkam ïa ka :  U kew jong pha un ym long shuh ka jingbam ïa ki nongshun jong pha , bad ki nongwei kin ym ïoh shuh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la smai da ka kti kadiang jong u bad da ka kti jong ka bor jong u: Hooid ngan ym ai shuh ia u kew jong me ban long ka doh na ka bynta ki nongshun jong me ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u nongwei kin ym dih ia ka wain jong me:

en: And when he had consulted with the people , he appointed singers unto the  Lord  , and that should praise the beauty of holiness , as they went out before the army , and to say , Praise the  Lord   ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Hadien ba u la ïakren bad u paidbah , u syiem u hukum ïa katto katne ki nongtem nongput ban phong ïa ki jingriam kiba ki ju phong ha ki por bakyntang bad ban ïaid na khmat ka kynhun shipai , da kaba rwai :  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iamir jingmut bad ki briew , u la thung ia ki nongrwai ha U Trai , bad kata ka dei ban iaroh ia ka jingitynnad jong ka jingkhuid , katba ki dang mih shabar ha khmat ki shipai , bad ban ong , Iaroh ia U Trai ; namar ka jingisynei jong u ka long junom .

en: As also in all his epistles , speaking in them of these things  ; in which are some things hard to be understood , which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest , as they do also the other scriptures , unto their own destruction .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ki shithi jong u baroh haba u thoh halor kane ka phang . Don katto katne kiei kiei kiba eh ha ki shithi jong u ha kiba ki bym da shemphang bad ki briew ki bymneh jingmut ki batai bakla , kumba ki leh ïa kiwei pat ki bynta ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid . Kumta ki wanrah hi ïa la ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba long ruh ha ki shithi jong u baroh, da kaba kren ha ki ia kine kiei kiei baroh ha kaba don katto katne kiei kiei kiba eh ban sngewthuh, kiba ki long ki bym nang la stad bad ki bym skhem, kumba ki leh ruh ia kiwei pat ki jingthoh, haduh ka jingpynjot jong ki hi .

en: The book Holocaust Politics , published in 2001 , says : “If more people practiced versions of what the Jehovah’s Witnesses preach and practice , the Holocaust could have been prevented and genocide would scourge the world no more .”
kha: Ka kot Holocaust Politics , ia kaba la pynmih ha u snem 2001 , ka ong , “lada khambun naki briew ki pynmlien banleh ia kaba ki nongsakhi u Jehoba ki ialap bad leh , ia ka jingpynjot ia ka jingim yn jin dala lah ban iada bad kan nym don shuh ka jingpynduh jait ka ban pynshitom ha ka pyrthei .”
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kot Holokaust Politics , kaba la pynmih ha u snem 2001 , ka ong: Lada ki briew kiba kham bun ki leh ia kaei kaba ki Nongsakhi Jehobah ki ialap bad leh , lah ban khanglad ia ka Holokaust bad ka jingpyniap pathar kan ym pynkhih shuh ia ka pyrthei .

en: For before these days rose up Theudas , boasting himself to be somebody  ; to whom a number of men , about four hundred , joined themselves : who was slain  ; and all , as many as obeyed him , were scattered , and brought to nought .
kha: Phi kynmaw ba u Theudas u la mih katto katne por mynshuwa , u da kam ba u long uta uba khraw , bad kumba sawspah ngut ki briew ki la ïasoh bad u . Hynrei la pynïap ïa u , bad ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsakma , bad ka kynhun jong u ka la kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shuwa kine ki sngi u Theudas u la mih u Theudas, u la sngew sarong ia lade ba u long u briew uba la shah pyniap: uba la shah pyniap ; bad baroh, kumba ki la kohnguh ia u, ki la shah pynpra noh .

en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills , and of the south , and of the vale , and of the springs , and all their kings : he left none remaining , but utterly destroyed all that breathed , as the  Lord  God of Israel commanded .
kha: Kumta u Joshua u la jop thiaw ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei . U la jop ïa ki syiem jong ka ri lum , kiba ha ki sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi , bad kiba ha trai ki lum ha ka phang sepngi , bad ïa kito ki jong ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Um shym la pynsah ïano ïano , u pynïap lut khoit ïa ki baroh . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la pynkhih ia ka ri baroh kawei jong ki lum, bad jong ki lum bad ki tyllong um jong ki: um shym la iehnoh ia ki syiem jong ki baroh: hynrei u la pynjot lut ia kita baroh kiba ring mynsiem, kumba U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la hukum .

en: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee , and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee , and give them compassion before them who carried them captive , that they may have compassion on them :
kha: Map ïa ki pop jong ki baroh bad ïa ki jingleh pyrshah jong ki ïa me , bad pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban iehnoh ïa ki ha ka jingsbun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad map ia ki briew jong me kiba la leh pop pyrshah ia me, bad ki jingpynkhein jong ki baroh ha kaba ki la iaid lait ia me, bad to ai jingsngewrit ia ki ha khmat jong ki kiba la rah ia ki mraw, ba kin sngewsynei ia ki:

en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock , and the third part of an hin unto a ram , and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb : this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year .
kha: Ka jingainguh waiñ kaba biang ka long ar litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , shi litar shiteng ka waiñ lem bad u langbrot , bad shi litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . Kane ka long ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka jingainguh thang na ka bynta ka sngi nyngkong kaba man la u bnai baroh shisnem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingainguh dih jong ki kin long shiteng na ka shi bnai sha u masi , bad ka bynta kaba lai na ka shi bynta sha u langbrot: kane ka long ka jingainguh thang man la u bnai ha baroh ki bnai jong u snem .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey  ; and it shall be the wages for his army .
kha: Te mynta kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga ai ïa ka ri ki nong Ijipt sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar . Un lute bad pynjot lut bad rong noh ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Ijipt kum ka bainong ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih, ngan ai ia ka ri Ijipt ha u Neuchastrozzar syiem Babilon ; bad un shim ia ka jingbun briew jong ka, bad un shim ia ka jingjot jong ka ; bad kan long ka bainong na ka bynta ka kynhun shipai jong u .

en: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .
kha: Kan leit beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka , hynrei kan ym lap ïa ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong ,  Ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga uba nyngkong jong nga — nga kham bit kham biang myn ha kata ban ïa kaba nga long mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan bud ia ki nongieit jong ka, hynrei kan ym jop ia ki ; bad kan wad ia ki , hynrei kan ym shem ia ki: nangta kan ong: ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga ba nyngkong jong nga ; namar ha kata ka por ka la kham bha bad nga ban ia mynta .

en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .
kha: U la ai jingkheiñ ha u Dabid ïa ka jingdon baroh lang jong ki rangbah kiba bit ïa ka kam shipai : Khatwei lakh ngut ha Israel , bad saw lakh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ai ia ka jingkhein jong ki briew ha u Dabid . Bad baroh ki Israel ki long shi hajar shispah hajar ngut ki briew kiba la sei waitlam: bad u Judah u long saw spah sanphew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la sei waitlam .

en: And David took the crown of their king from off his head , and found it to weigh a talent of gold , and there were precious stones in it  ; and it was set upon David s head : and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city .
kha: U Molekh , u bleithaw jong ki Ammon u don ka pansngiat ksiar kaba khia kumba laiphew saw kilo . Ha ka don u mawlynnai , ïa uba u Dabid u shim bad buh ha la ka jong ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ka jinglute na ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim ia ka khlieh jong u syiem jong ki na ka khlieh jong u, bad u la shem ia ka ban khia ia ka ksiar, bad ki don ki maw kiba kordor ha ka ; bad la buh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u Dabid bad u la wanrah ruh ia ka jingbam kaba palat na ka nongbah .

en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men , that went out to war by bands , according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler , under the hand of Hananiah , one of the king s captains .
kha: U don ruh ka kynhun shipai kaba heh kaba la kloi na ka bynta ka thma . Ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka la sumar da u Jeiel u bad u Maaseïah , ki sekretari jong u hapoh ka jingpeit u Hananaïah , u dkhot jong ki nongtrei jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Uzziah u don shibun ki shipai kiba ialeh thma, kiba la leit sha ka thma da ki band, kat kum ka jingkhein jong ki da ka kti jong u nongthoh bad u Maaseiah u nongsynshar, hapoh ka kti jong u Hananiah, uwei na ki rangbah syiem .

en: Israel hath sinned , and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them : for they have even taken of the accursed thing , and have also stolen , and dissembled also , and they have put it even among their own stuff .
kha: Ki Israel ki la leh pop ! Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingkular bad nga kaba nga la hukum ïa ki ban bat . Ki la shim katto katne kiei kiei kiba dei ban pynjot . Ki la tuh ïa ki , ki la len shaphang kata , bad buh lang ïa ki bad la ki jong ki tiar ki tar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la leh pop ruh bad ki la pynkhein ia ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la hukum ia ki: namar ki la shim wat ia kaei kaei kaba la shah kynnoh , bad ki la tuh ruh , bad ki la pynjah burom ruh ia ka wat hapdeng ki tiar jong ki hi .

en: And it came to pass after this , that David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah ? And the  Lord  said unto him , Go up . And David said , Whither shall I go up ? And he said , Unto Hebron .
kha: Hadien kane , u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan leit bad shimti noh ïa kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Judah ?   Ho-oid ,  U  Trai  u jubab .  Ïa kano ?  U Dabid u kylli .  Ka Hebron  U  Trai  u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien kane, ba u Dabid u la kylli ia U Trai, u da ong, Hato ngan leit sha kano kano ka shnong Judah ? U Trai u la ong ha u, To leit shaneng. U Dabid u la ong, Nga leit shaneng ? Bad u la ong, Ha u Hebron .

en: Therefore shall evil come upon thee  ; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth : and mischief shall fall upon thee  ; thou shalt not be able to put it off : and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly , which thou shalt not know .
kha: Ka jingjot kan wan ha pha , bad yn ym don na ki kam myntor jong pha ki ban lah ban pynsangeh ïa ka . Ka jingpynjot kynsan kynsan kan wan halor jong pha , ka jingpynjot kaba pham pat ju phohsniew !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingsniew kan wan ha me ; men ym tip naei ka mih: bad ka jingsniew kan hap halor jong me ; men ym lah ban pynsangeh noh ia ka: bad ka jingpynjot kan wan ha me kynsan kynsan , kaba me ym tip .

en: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes , both we and our land ? buy us and our land for bread , and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh : and give us seed , that we may live , and not die , that the land be not desolate .
kha: Wat ai ba ngin ïap , To leh ei ei ! Wat ai ba ki lyngkha jong ngi kin shu sah shrah . Thied noh ïa ngi , bad ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap jong ngi , ban ïa-bujli bad ka bam . Ngin mat long noh ki mraw u syiem , bad u pat un long trai ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap jong ngi . Ai kew ïa ngi ba ngin dup im , bad ai symbai ba ngin ïoh bet ha la ki lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ngin iap ha khmat jong me, ngi bad ka ri jong ngi? thied ia ngi bad ka ri jong ngi na ka bynta u kpu, bad ngi bad ka ri jong ngi ngin long ki shakri ha u Pharaoh: bad ngin ai symbai ia ngi, ba ngin im, bad ym iap, ba ka ri kan ym jah rngai noh .

en: Be glad then , ye children of Zion , and rejoice in the  Lord  your God : for he hath given you the former rain moderately , and he will cause to come down for you the rain , the former rain , and the latter rain in the first month .
kha: To lehkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , to shadkmen ha kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa phi . U la ai ïa phi ïa u slap synrai uba biang ; u la theh ïa u slap tlang na ka bynta jong phi bad ïa u slap pyrem kumba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha te, ko khun jong u Seion, bad to sngewbha ha U Trai U Blei jong phi: namar u la ai ia phi ia u slap uba nyngkong ha ka por ba nyngkong , bad un pynlong ia u slap uba nyngkong ha u bnai uba nyngkong .

en: And for the majesty that he gave him , all people , nations , and languages , trembled and feared before him : whom he would he slew  ; and whom he would he kept alive  ; and whom he would he set up  ; and whom he would he put down .
kha: U la long uba khraw katta katta ba ki briew jong ki hima baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ki la sheptieng ïa u bad khynñiuh . Lada u la kwah ban pynïap ïano ïano u leh kumta ; lada u kwah ban ri pynim ïano ïano , u leh kumta . U pyndonburom lane pynjahburom ïa uno uno , uba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka jingkhraw kaba u la ai ha u, ki briew baroh, ki jaitbynriew bad ki ktien, ki la khih bad ki la tieng ha khmat jong u: ia uba u la pyniap ; bad ia uba u la pynim ; bad ia uba u la buh ; bad ia uba u la buh; bad ia uba u la buh .

en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates :
kha: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga . Ha kata ka sngi phim bit ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam — ma phi , ne ki khun jong phi , ne ki mraw jong phi , ne ki jingri jong phi , ne ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka sngi kaba hynriew ka long ka Sabha jong U Trai U Blei jong me: ha ka wat leh ei ei, ma me, ne u khun jong me, ne ka khun jong me, ne u shakri jong me, ne u shakri jong me, ne ki masi jong me, ne u nongwei jong me uba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong me:

en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .
kha: Ka wan phai pat sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka kti , bad u rah ïa ka shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka paro kam shym la shem ia ka kjat jong ka, bad ka la wan phai biang sha u shapoh ka lieng: namar ki um ki la don ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew baroh kawei: nangta u la kner ia la ka kti bad u la shim ia ka bad u la tan ia ka shapoh jong u shapoh ka lieng .

en: The  Lord  hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion : he hath stretched out a line , he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying : therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament  ; they languished together .
kha: Ka burom jong ka , ka la leit noh ; ka la lyngkhuit bad ka la don ha ka jingshah ñiewbeiñ . Ka ud bad ka buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat ha ka jinglehrain . Ka Jerusalem ka la pynjakhlia ïa lade da ka pop kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la thmu ban pynjot ia ka kynroh jong ka khun jong u Seion: u la pynjrong ia u lain , um shym la weng noh ia la ka kti na kaba pynjot: namarkata u la pynlong ia ka kynroh bad ka kynroh ban iam; ki la ia tyngkhuh lang .

en: And it came to pass that night , that the angel of the  Lord  went out , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
kha: Ha kata ka miet u angel jong U  Trai  u leit sha ka jaka sher dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , hangta ki la thiah lyngktar , baroh kiba la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kata ka miet , ba u angel U Trai u la mih noh, bad u la leit sha ka jaka sah jong ki nong Assyria shispah san hajar: bad haba ki la khie dang step , ha khmih baroh ki la iap .

en: And the children of Israel arose , and went up to the house of God , and asked counsel of God , and said , Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin ? And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up first .
kha: Ki Israel ki leit sha ka jaka mane ha Bethel , bad hangta ki kylli na U Blei ,  Ka jait jongno ka ban leit ïaleh nyngkong ïa ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ka jait Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ieng bad ki la leit sha ka iing U Blei bad ki la kylli ia ka jingai jingmut jong U Blei bad ki la ong: Mano na ngi ban leit sha ka thma pyrshah ia ki khun shynrang jong u Benjamin ? Bad U Trai u la ong , U Judah un leit sha jrong nyngkong .

en: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it , and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .
kha: Nga shim ïa kata kaei kaei kaba long hi ka pop — kata ka dur khun masi keiñ kaba phi la thaw bad nga bret ïa ka ha ka ding . Nangta nga pynpait pharia ïa ka , nga tylliat ni ïa ka haduh ba kan da long kum u pui pui , bad nga bret ïa kata ha ka wah kaba tuid na uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ia ka pop jong phi, ia u khun masi jong phi, bad nga la thang ia ka da ka ding, bad nga la pynkhih ia ka, bad nga la pynkhih ia ka haduh ba ka la rit bha kum ka dewbilat: bad nga la bret ia ka dewbilat jong ka shapoh ka wah kaba la hiar na u lum .

en: I also will do this unto you  ; I will even appoint over you terror , consumption , and the burning ague , that shall consume the eyes , and cause sorrow of heart : and ye shall sow your seed in vain , for your enemies shall eat it .
kha: Ngan pynngat ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar — ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah , bad ki jingpang shit ki ban pynmatlah ïa phi bad ban pynlong ïa ka jingim jong phi ban sep-ei . Phin bet ïa u symbai , hynrei um myntoi ïa phi , naba ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi bad kin bam ïa kaba phi la thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh ngan leh ia kane ha phi; ngan buh wat ia phi ia ka jingtieng, ka jingbam bad ka jingthang ia ki khmat bad ka pynmih ia ka jingsngewsih: bad phin bet ia u symbai jong phi khlem da don ei ei: bad phin bet ia u symbai jong phi khlem da don ei ei:

en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt , and that the  Lord  thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm : therefore the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day .
kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt , bad ba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga la pyllait im ïa phi da ka borbah jong nga . Dei namar kata ba nga hukum ïa phi ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kynmaw ba me la long u shakri ha ka ri Ijipt, bad ba U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynmih ia me nangta lyngba ka kti kaba khlain bad da ka kti kaba la pynjrong: namarkata U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me ban sumar ia ka sngi Sabha .

en: But Rab–shakeh said unto them , Hath my master sent me to thy master , and to thee , to speak these words ? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall , that they may eat their own dung , and drink their own piss with you ?
kha: U jubab ,  Hato me pyrkhat ba dei tang ma me bad u syiem kiba u nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ong ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Em , nga kren ruh ha ki briew kiba shong halor ka kynroh , ki ban hap bam ïa ka jakhlia bad ban dih ïa ka um pynjhieh , kumba me men hap leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Rabshakeh u la ong ha ki, Hato u kynrad jong nga u la phah ia nga sha u kynrad jong me bad ha me ban kren ia kine ki ktien ? hato um shym la phah ia nga sha ki briew kiba shong ha ka kynroh ba kin bam ia la ka jong ka sboh bad dih ia la ka jong ka sboh bad phi ?

en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing , whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast , or a carcase of unclean cattle , or the carcase of unclean creeping things , and if it be hidden from him  ; he also shall be unclean , and guilty .
kha: Lada uno uno u kum ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba la ñiew bymkhuid , kum ïa ka mrad ba la ïap , u long u bymkhuid bad ba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada ka mynsiem ka ktah ia kano kano ka jingbam kaba khlem khuid, la ka long ka met jong u mrad bymkhuid, ne ka met jong ki masi bymkhuid , ne ka met jong ki jingbam bymkhuid bad lada la buhrieh na u; u ruh un long u bymkhuid bad uba don pop .

en: As also the high priest doth bear me witness , and all the estate of the elders : from whom also I received letters unto the brethren , and went to Damascus , to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem , for to be punished .
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar hi baroh kawei ki lah ban pynshisha ba nga kren ïa ka jingshisha . Nga la ïohpdiang na ki ïa ki shithi kiba la thoh sha ki para Jiw kiba ha Damaskos , kumta nga la leit shata ban kem ïa kine ki briew bad wan ïalam pat ïa ki , kiba la khum ha ki kynjri sha Jerusalem ba yn pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba long ruh u rangbah lyngdoh u sakhi ia nga, bad ia ka jaka jong ki rangbah baroh: na kiba ruh nga la ioh ia ki shithi sha ki para bangeit bad nga la leit sha ka nongbah Damekhos ban wanrah ia kita kiba la shah teh ha Jerusalem .

en: And the woman came unto Saul , and saw that he was sore troubled , and said unto him , Behold , thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me .
kha: Kata ka kynthei ka leit sha u , bad haba ka ïohi ba u la sheptieng , kumta ka ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kynrad , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim da kaba leh ïa kaei ba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la wan sha u Saul bad ka la iohi ba u la sngewsih shibun, bad ka la ong ha u: Ha khmih ka kti jong me ka la kohnguh ia ka sur jong me bad nga la buh ia ka jingim jong nga ha ka kti jong nga bad nga la sngap ia ki ktien jong me kiba me kren ha nga .

en: I also will choose their delusions , and will bring their fears upon them  ; because when I called , none did answer  ; when I spake , they did not hear : but they did evil before mine eyes , and chose that in which I delighted not .
kha: Kumta ngan wallam jingjot halor jong ki — Ïa kita kiei kiei kiba ki sheptieng — namar ym don uwei ruh uba jubab haba nga khot lane shahshkor haba nga kren . Ki jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh ngan jied ia ki jingsngewsih jong ki, bad ngan wanrah ia ki jingtieng jong ki ha ki ; namar haba nga khot, ym don ba jubab ; haba nga kren: hynrei ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat jong nga, bad ki la jied ia kata ha kaba ngam shym la sngewbha .

en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass , and took the five loaves , and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed , and brake , and gave the loaves to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
kha: U la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong halor u phlang ; nangta u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran , bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hukum ia u paidbah ban shong ha u phlang bad u la shim ia ki san tylli ki kpu bad ki ar tylli ki dohkha bad u la peit sha bneng , u la kyrkhu bad u la bthei bad u la ai ia ki kpu ha ki synran jong u bad ki synran jong u ha u paidbah .

en: And Joram said , Make ready . And his chariot was made ready . And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out , each in his chariot , and they went out against Jehu , and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite .
kha: U syiem Joram u hukum ,  Pynkhreh ka kali ïapom jong nga .  Ynda la pynkhreh , ma u bad u syiem Ahasaïah ki mih mar la ka kali ïapom ban leit ïakynduh ïa u Jehu . Ki ïakynduh ïa u ha ka lyngkha kaba la ju long ka jong u Naboth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joram u la ong, To pynkhreh . Bad ka kali jong u ka la long kaba la pynkhreh . U Joram u syiem Israel bad u Ahasaiah u syiem Judah ki la mih noh uwei pa uwei ha ka kali jong u, bad ki la leit shabar pyrshah ia u Jehu bad ki la iakynduh ia u ha ka bynta jong u Nabot u Jesreel .

en: And the  Lord  shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships , by the way whereof I spake unto thee , Thou shalt see it no more again : and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen , and no man shall buy you .
kha: U  Trai  un phah biang ïa phi da ka lieng sha Ijipt , wat la nga la ong ba phim dei ban leit shuh shata lano lano ; bad hangta phin sa tyrwa die mraw ïa lade ha ki nongshun jong phi , hynrei yn ym don ba thied ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un wanrah biang ia me sha Ijipt da ki lieng, da ka lynti kaba nga kren ha me: bad hangta phin ym iohi shuh ia ka: bad hangta phin sa die noh ha ki nongshun jong phi na ka bynta ki mraw bad ki mraw jong phi .

en: And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .
kha: U Kornelios , u rangbah shipai u la phah ïa ngi ,  ki la jubab .  U long u briew uba bha uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba la ñiewburom shikatdei da ki Jiw baroh . U angel jong U Blei u la ïathuh ïa u ban khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: U Kornelius u rangbah shipai uba hok bad uba sheptieng ia U Blei bad uba iathuh khubor babha hapdeng ka jaitbynriew Jiw baroh .

en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten  ; he shall even pour out the blood thereof , and cover it with dust .
kha: Lada uno uno u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u ïoh pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka sim kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , u dei ban da pjiar ïa ka snam bad tap ïa ka da ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u briew uba don na ki khun Israel ne na ki nongwei kiba sah hapdeng jong phi, uba leit khwai bad uba kem ia uno uno u mrad ne u khnai uba lah ban bam; un theh wat ia ka snam jong u, bad un tap ia ka da ka dewbilat .

en: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .
kha: Nangta u mihnoh bad u wan ïalam sa hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem wat kiba kham sniew ban ïa u , bad ki wan shongsah hangta . Kumta haba baroh ka la kut , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang . Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew kiba sniew jong kane ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u leit noh bad u shim ia ki hynriew tylli kiwei pat ki mynsiem kiba kham sniew ban ia lade, bad ki rung bad ki shong hangta : bad ka jinglong kaba khatduh jong uta u briew ka kham sniew ban ia kaba nyngkong . Wat la katta ruh kan long ha kane ka pateng kaba sniew .

en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph : and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses , and for the flocks , and for the cattle of the herds , and for the asses : and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year .
kha: Kumta ki wallam ïa la ki jingri sha u Joseph ; u pat u ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad ki kulai , ki langbrot , ki blang , ki jingri jingdup , bad ki kada . Ha kata ka snem u pyndap ïa ki da kaba shu ïapli bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ki masi jong ki sha u Joseph: bad u Joseph u la ai kpu ia ki ha ka jingsiew ia ki kulai bad na ka bynta ki kynhun masi bad na ka bynta ki masi bad na ka bynta ki kada: bad u la ai bam ia ki da u kpu na ka bynta ki masi jong ki baroh na ka bynta kata ka snem .

en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel  ; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth–el , and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin : and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent .
kha: u jied lai hajar ngut ki rangbah ; u bat ar hajar ngut na ki bad u ha Mikhmash bad ha ka ri lum jong ka Bethel bad u phah shihajar ngut bad u Jonathan u khun jong u sha Gibeah , ha ka thain Benjamin . Ïa kiba sah pat u phah noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la jied ia u lai hajar ngut ki briew Israel; na ki ar hajar ngut ki don bad u Saul ha Michmash bad ha u lum Bethel, bad shi hajar ngut ki don bad u Jonathan ha Gibeah u Benjamin: bad kiwei pat ki briew ki la phah ia u sha ka ïingjahthait jong u .

en: So I stood upon him , and slew him , because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen : and I took the crown that was upon his head , and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them hither unto my lord .
kha: Kumta nga leit sha u bad nga pynïap ïa u , namar nga tip ba un sa ïap hi la kumno kumno un tang shu kyllon . Nangta nga shim ïa ka pansngiat na ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka jingdeng na ka ksang ti jong u , bad nga la wallam ïa ki sha phi , ko kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la ieng halor jong u, bad nga la pyniap ia u, namar nga la thikna ba um lah ban im hadien ba u la hap: bad nga la shim ia ka khlieh kaba don halor ka khlieh jong u, bad ka ryntieh kaba don ha ka kti jong u, bad nga la wanrah ia ki hangne sha u kynrad jong nga .

en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come , when it shall come for my hire before thy face : every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and brown among the sheep , that shall be counted stolen with me .
kha: Hadien habud phin sa shem da kaba suk lada nga lah lehhok . Haba phin wan ban khmih ïa ka bainong jong nga , lada nga don ki blang ki bym thohbria bad ki bym thohbroin , lane kino kino ki khunlangbrot ki bym ïong , phin tip ba nga la tuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka hok jong nga kan jubab na ka bynta jong nga ha ka por ban wan, haba kan wan na ka bynta ka bainong jong nga ha khmat jong me: uwei pa uwei u bym shym la tyrkhong bad ba la iohi hapdeng ki blang bad u la tyrkhong hapdeng ki langbrot , ia kiba la khein bad nga .

en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law , and if thou turn unto the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
kha: hynrei phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai jong u . Phi dei ban phai sha u da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me sngap ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me, ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u bad ki ain jong u kiba la thoh ha kane ka Kitab ka hukum , bad lada me phai sha U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh .

en: And all the people went to Gilgal  ; and there they made Saul king before the  Lord  in Gilgal  ; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the  Lord   ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly .
kha: Kumta ki ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad hangta ha ka jaka kyntang ki pynbna ba u Saul u long u syiem . Ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad u Saul bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalehkmen ha kane ka jingjia .
