translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la leit sha Gilgal ; bad hangta ki la pynlong ia u Saul syiem ha khmat U Trai ha Gilgal bad hangta ki la knia ia ki jingknia jingsuk ha khmat U Trai ; bad hangta u Saul bad ki Israel baroh ki la ia kmen shibun .

en: For I fear , lest , when I come , I shall not find you such as I would , and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not : lest there be debates , envyings , wraths , strifes , backbitings , whisperings , swellings , tumults :
kha: Nga sheptieng ba haba nga poi hangto ngan shem ïa phi kiba pher na kaei kaba nga kwah ïa phi ba phin long bad ba phin shem ïa nga ba nga pher na kaei kaba phi kwah ïa nga ban long . Nga sheptieng ba ïoh ngan shem ïa ka jingïania bad jingbishni , ki jingïabitar bad jingkhwan myntoi , ki jingkrenbeiñ bad jinglorni , ka jingsarong bad jingkynrum kynram .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tieng , ioh , haba nga wan , ngan ym shem ia phi kumba nga kwah , bad ba ngan shem ha phi kumba phim kwah: ioh ba kin don ki jingiatai, ki jingsngewsih, ki jingsngewsih, ki jingsngewsih, ki jingsngewsih, ki jingsngewsih, ki jingsngewsih, ki jingsngewsih:

en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , did they bring them out by their means .
kha: Ki pynbiang kulai bad kali ïapom ïa ki syiem Hit bad Syria , da kaba die ïa ki kali ïapom hynriewspah ki sbai rupa kawei bad ïa ki kulai shispah sanphew uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u kali u la wan kiew bad u la mih na Ijipt na ka bynta hynriew spah Shekel rupa, bad u kulai na ka bynta shispah sanphew: bad kumta na ka bynta ki syiem Hiti baroh bad na ka bynta ki syiem Syria , ki la pynmih ia ki da ka jingdon jong ki .

en: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .
kha: Ko syiem , phi dei ban tip ba ngi la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judah bad shem ba ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bakhraw la dang shna biang da ki maw baheh bad da ki bim dieng ba la pyndait ha ka kynroh . Ïa ka kam la pyntrei ha ka rukom kaba biang bha bad ka dang ïaid shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ha u syiem ba ngi la leit sha ka ri Judah, sha ka iing U Blei uba khraw, kaba la tei da ki maw kiba heh bad la buh dieng ha ki kynroh bad kane ka kam ka iaid stet bad ka roi ha ki kti jong ki .

en: And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men , to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks , to shoot arrows and great stones withal . And his name spread far abroad  ; for he was marvellously helped , till he was strong .
kha: Ha Jerusalem , ki nongshna tiar jong u ki shna ïa ki tiar ki tar ban siat ïa ki khnam bad kawang ïa ki maw kiba heh na ki kut bad ki kyndong jong ka kynroh ka nongbah . Ka nam jong u ka la phriang kylleng sawdong , bad u la long uba khlaiñbor katta katta namar ka jingïarap ba u ïohpdiang na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ha Jerusalem ia ki engine, ba la thaw da ki briew kiba stad, ban don ha ki tower bad ha ki thliew , ban siat ia ki nar bad ki maw kiba heh . Bad ka kyrteng jong u ka la saphriang shabar ri; namar u la iarap shibun eh, haduh ba u la khlain .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .
kha: U Manoah um shym tip ba u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , kumta u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha wat nym pat leit . Ai ba ngin ïoh shet uwei u khunblang na ka bynta jong phi .  Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Lada nga dei ban ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ban pynkhreh ïa ka , thang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha u Manoah , Wat la me bat ia nga hynrei ngan ym bam ia u kpu jong me: bad lada me ai ia ka jingknia thang ia ka ha U Trai . Namar u Manoah um tip ba u long u angel jong U Trai .

en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem , to appoint captains , to open the mouth in the slaughter , to lift up the voice with shouting , to appoint battering rams against the gates , to cast a mount , and to build a fort .
kha: Mynta ! Ka kti kamon jong u ka bat ïa ka jingkdew ba la thoh ‘ Jerusalem’ ! Ka ïathuh ïa u ban leit bad buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh , ban pyrta ïa ka jingkyang thma , ban buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh pyrshah ïa ki khyrdop , ban bret shajrong ïa ka khyndew ba la tih , bad ban tih ïa ki kharai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka kti kadiang jong u ka la long ka jingkhein ia ka Jerusalem , ban thung ia ki nongialam , ban plie ia ka shyntur ha ka jingpyniap , ban pynkiew ia ka sur da kaba pyrta , ban thung ia ki langbrot kiba iaid pyrshah ia ki khyrdop , ban buh ia ka lum bad ban tei ia ka kut .

en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him ,  One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .
kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha u da ka jingieit bad u la ong ,  Me donkam tang kawei kaei kaei . Khie leit bad die ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men ïoh ïa ka spah ha bneng ; nangta sa wan bad bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu haba u la iohi ia u u la ieit ia u, bad u la ong ha u, Kawei kaba phi duna tam: leit noh ia ka lynti jong me, die ia kaei kaei kaba me don, bad to ai ha kiba duk, bad me don ka spah ha bneng: bad to wan, shim ia ka diengphna bad bud ia nga .

en: For the eyes of the  Lord  run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him . Herein thou hast done foolishly : therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars .
kha: U  Trai  u khmih bha ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ban ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa kito kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki ïaineh ha u . Me la leh bieit , bad kumta naduh mynta men don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki khmat U Trai ki iaid sha kylleng ka khyndew baroh kawei, ban pyni ia lade uba skhem na ka bynta jong ki kiba ka dohnud jong u ka long kaba janai ha u . Hangne me la leh bieit: namarkata naduh mynta me la leh ia ki thma .

en: And the woman said unto him , Behold , thou knowest what Saul hath done , how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land : wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life , to cause me to die ?
kha: Kata ka kynthei ka jubab ,  Da shisha , phi tip aïu u syiem Saul u la leh , kumno u la beh ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong na Israel . Te balei phi riam ïa nga bad ba ngan shah pynïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka kynthei ka la ong ha u: Ha me, me tip ia kaei kaba u Saul u la leh, kumno u la ot noh ia kita kiba la tip bha bad ki nongleh jadu: namar kata me buh ia ka jingma ia ka jingim jong nga, ban pynlong ia nga ban iap ?

en: And if he be poor , and cannot get so much  ; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved , to make an atonement for him , and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering , and a log of oil  ;
kha: Lada uta u briew u long uba duk bad um kotbor haduh katta , un wallam na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid tang uwei u khunlangbrot kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat , kaba long ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai  na ka bynta u lyngdoh . Un wanrah ruh tang shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh bam bad sa kumba shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u long uba duk kumta u dei ban shim ia uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba la pynkhih na ka bynta jong u, ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u, bad kawei ka shi bynta na ka shi bynta na ka shi bynta na ka shi bynta na ka bynta ka umphniang doh;

en: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt , an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee , when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes . I the  Lord  have spoken it .
kha: Haba nga la bitar shla ïa pha bad pynshitom ïa pha , baroh ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong pha kin sngewshyrkhei . Kin peit ïa pha da jingisih bad kin rkhiebeiñ ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kan long ka jingkren bein bad ka jingkren bein, ka jinghikai bad ka jinglyngngoh ia ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong me, haba ngan pyndep ia ki jingbishar ha me ha ka jingbitar bad ha ka jingbitar bad ha ka jingbitar . Nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata .

en: And Joshua said , Alas , O Lord  God  , wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites , to destroy us ? would to God we had been content , and dwelt on the other side Jordan !
kha: Bad u Joshua u ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Balei me wan ïalam ïa ngi sha shiliang ka Jordan ? Hato ban aiti noh ïa ngi ha ki nong Amor ? Hato ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Balei ngim shu shongsah sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan !
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong, Ah Trai Blei, namar kata me la wanrah ia une u briew halor ka Jordan, ban aiti ia ngi ha ka kti jong ki Amorites, ban pynjot ia ngi ? hato ha U Blei ngi la sngewhun, bad ngi la shong ha kawei pat ka liang ka Jordan !

en: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the  Lord   ; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it , to the name of the  Lord  , to Jerusalem : neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka Jerusalem yn khot , ‘ Ka Khet ka jong U  Trai  ,’ bad baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang hangta ban mane ïa nga . Kin ym leh shuh ïa kaei ba ka dohnud ba-mutlop bad basniew jong ki ka ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por kin khot ia ka Jerusalem ia ka khet U Trai ; bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ialum lang ha ka kyrteng U Trai: lymne kin iaid shuh kat kum ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud bymman jong ki .

en: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob , and David my servant , so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob : for I will cause their captivity to return , and have mercy on them .
kha: Bad kumba , shisha , nga la leh ïa kane , kumta ngan pynneh ïa la ka jutang bad ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob bad u shakri jong nga u Dabid . Ngan jied ïa uwei na ki nonghiarpateng u Dabid ban synshar halor ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Ngan isynei ïa ki briew jong nga bad pynlong ïa ki ban roi kyrhai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan bret noh ia u symbai u Jakob bad u Dabid u shakri jong nga, khnang ba ngan ym shim ia uno uno na u symbai jong u ban long ki nongsynshar halor u symbai u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob: namar ngan pynlong ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki ban wan phai biang bad ngan isynei ia ki .

en: And David commanded his young men , and they slew them , and cut off their hands and their feet , and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron . But they took the head of Ish–bosheth , and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron .
kha: U Dabid u ai hukum , bad ki shipai jong u ki la pynïap ïa u Rekhab bad ïa u Baanah bad ki la ot ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki , ïa kiba ki la sdien hajan ka pung ha Hebron . Ki la shim ïa ka khlieh jong u Ishbosheth bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u Abner hangta ha Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la hukum ia ki samla jong u, bad ki la pyniap ia ki, bad ki la ot ia ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki, bad ki la pyndait ia ki halor ka pung ha Hebron . Hynrei ki la shim ia ka khlieh jong u Ishbosheth bad ki la tep ia ka ha ka jingtep jong u Abner ha Hebron .

en: Remember , and forget not , how thou provokedst the  Lord  thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord .
kha: Wat ju klet kumno phi la pynbitar lep ïa U  Trai  ha ka ri shyiap . Naduh ka sngi ba phi mih na Ijipt haduh ba phi poi hangne , phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw bad wat klet ia U Trai U Blei jong me ban bitar ha ka ri khlaw: naduh ka sngi ba me mih noh na ka ri Ijipt haduh ba phin da poi sha kane ka jaka , phi la leh pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: In the mountains , and in the valleys , and in the plains , and in the springs , and in the wilderness , and in the south country  ; the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Canaanites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites :
kha: Kane ka bynta ka kynthup ïa ka ri lum , ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi , ka Them Jordan bad ki kjat lum jong ka , ka sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi bad ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka ri ka la ju long ka ïing jong ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki lum bad ha ki them bad ha ki madan bad ha ki tyllong um bad ha ka ri khlaw bad ha ka ri Sepngi ki Hit , ki Amorit bad ki Kanaan , ki Perizi , ki Hivit bad ki Jebus:

en: And send them to the king of Edom , and to the king of Moab , and to the king of the Ammonites , and to the king of Tyre , and to the king of Zidon , by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah  ;
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban phah ka khubor sha ki syiem jong ka Edom , ka Moab , ka Ammon , ka Tyros , bad ka Sidon lyngba ki nongkit  tiensyiem jong ki , kiba lah wan sha Jerusalem ban jngoh ïa u syiem Sedekaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phah ia ki sha u syiem ka Edom bad sha u syiem ka ri Amobab bad sha u syiem ka ri Amobab bad sha u syiem ka ri Amobab bad sha u syiem ka ri Amobab .

en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the  Lord  , when thou numberest them  ; that there be no plague among them , when thou numberest them .
kha: Haba me shim jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon ki paid Israel , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban siew ïa nga ïa ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , khnang ba kano kano kaba sniew kan ym wan ha u katba dang shim jingkheiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me shim ia ka jingkhein jong ki khun Israel katkum ka jingkhein jong ki, te kin ai ia uwei pa uwei ia ka jingsiew bai lutksan na ka bynta ka mynsiem jong u ha U Trai, haba me khein ia ki ; ba ym don ka khlam hapdeng jong ki, haba me khein ia ki .

en: That ye shall say , It is the sacrifice of the  Lord s  passover , who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt , when he smote the Egyptians , and delivered our houses . And the people bowed the head and worshipped .
kha: Phin jubab , ‘ Ka long ka jingkñia jong ka Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , naba u la ïaid lait ïa ki ïing jong ki Israel ha ka ri Ijipt . U la pynïap ïa ki nong Ijipt , hynrei u la pyllait im ïa ngi .’   Ki Israel ki la dem khohsiew bad ki la mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin ong , Ka long ka jingknia jong U Trai ka jingleit jingwan jong ki Israel ha Ijipt , haba u la shoh ia ki nong Ijipt bad u la pynpoi ia ki iing jong ngi . Ki briew ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .

en: So then if , while her husband liveth , she be married to another man , she shall be called an adulteress : but if her husband be dead , she is free from that law ; so that she is no adulteress , though she be married to another man .
kha: Kumta te , lada ka ïashong bad uwei pat u briew katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; yn khot ïa ka , ka briew kaba klim ; hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la ïap , kat kum ka aiñ ka long ka briew ba la laitluid bad kam leh ïa ka jingklim haba ka shongkurim ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta lada ka dang im bad uwei pat u briew, yn khot ia ka ka jingkha khun: hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la iap , ka lait na kata ka hukum ; kumta kam long kaba sniew , wat la ka la shongkurim bad uwei pat u briew .

en: And Saul s son had two men that were captains of bands : the name of the one was Baanah , and the name of the other Rechab , the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite , of the children of Benjamin : ( for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin :
kha: U Ishbosheth u don ar ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba long ki nongïalam ïa ki kynhun lute , u Baanah bad u Rekhab , ki khun shynrang jong u Rimmon , uba na Beeroth , hapoh ka jait Benjamin . ( Ïa ka Beeroth la ñiew kum ka bynta jong ki Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun shynrang u Saul u don arngut ki rangbah: ka kyrteng jong uwei pat u long u Baah , bad ka kyrteng jong uwei pat u Rehab , ki khun shynrang jong u Rimmon u Beerot , na ki khun shynrang jong u Benjamin: (na u Beerot ruh u la khein ia u Benjamin:

en: And now they sin more and more , and have made them molten images of their silver , and idols according to their own understanding , all of it the work of the craftsmen : they say of them , Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves .
kha: Kin nang ïai leh pop shuh shuh da kaba saiñ ïa ki durblei ban mane — ki bleithaw kiba da ka rupa , kiba la saiñdur da ka jingpyrkhat briew , ba la shna da ki kti briew . Bad nangta ki ong ,  Ai ki jingkñia sha ki !  Kumno ki briew kin doh ïa kito ki bleithaw — ki bleithaw ha ka dur ki masi kyrtong !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ki nang kham pop shuh shuh, bad ki la pynlong ia ki dur rupa jong ki, bad ki bleithaw kat kum ka jingsngewthuh jong ki hi: ki ong shaphang jong ki: Ai ba ki briew kiba knia kin kdup ia ki khun masi .

en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . So Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
kha: U ong ha u samla nongrah atiar jong u ,  Sei ïa ka waitlam jong me bad dung ïap ïa nga , ban ym shah ba kine ki Philistia ki bym don blei kin ïuhbeiñ halor jong nga .  Hynrei uta u samla u la khynñiuh tyngeh ban leh ïa ka . Kumta u Saul u sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la ong ha u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u, To ring ia ka waitlam jong me, bad pynkhih ia nga lyngba kata ka waitlam ba kine ki bym pat shah ot kin wan bad lehbein ia nga . Hynrei u nongrah tiar jong u un ym lehbein ia nga . Kumta u Saul u la shim ia ka waitlam, bad u la hap halor jong ka .

en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation , and condemn them : for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar , ka syiem jong ka Sheba kan ïeng bad mudui ïa ki briew kiba mynta , namar ka la wan jngai na la ka jong ka ri ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong u syiem Solomon ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mahadei jong ka ri Sepngi kan kiew ha ka jingbishar bad ki briew jong kane ka pateng: namar ka la wan na ki bynta ba kut jong ka khyndew ban iohsngew ia ka jingstad u Solomon ; bad, ha khmih, uba kham khraw ban ia u Solomon u don hangne .

en: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone  ; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai : wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , even the people of Mordecai .
kha: bad haba u tip ba u Mordekai u dei u Jiw , u la rai ban pynshitom ym tang ïa u Mordekai marwei . U la don ka jingthmu ban pynïap ïa baroh ki Jiw ha ka hima Persia baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrkhat ban buh kti ia u Mordecai marwei: namar ki la pyni ia u ia ki briew jong u Mordecai: namar kata u Haman u la wad ban pynjot ia ki Jiw baroh kiba don ha ka hima Ahasueros baroh kawei .

en: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .
kha: Bad shano shano ba U Jisu u leit , sha ki nongrit , ki shnong , ki lyngkha , ki paidbah ki rah ïa kito kiba pang sha ki jaka ïew bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ïa ki la kumno kumno ban ktah ïa ka rmiang jaiñkup jong u ; bad baroh kiba ktah ïa ka , ki ïohkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangno hangno ba u rung, ha ki shnong ne ki nongbah ne ki ri, ki la buh ia kiba pang ha ki lynti , bad ki la kyrpad ia u ba kin ktah lada ka long tang u pud jong ka jain jong u: bad katba lah ban ktah ia u la pynlong pura .

en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the  Lord  had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them , to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .
kha: Hynñiew sngi ki rakhe da ka jingkmen ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki la dap da ka jingkmen namar U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria ban lehsbun ïa ki , ba u kyrshan ïa ki ha ka jingtrei jong ki ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ jong U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bat ia ka jingkhawai jong u kpu khlem thied hynriew sngi da ka jingkmen: namar U Trai u la pynkmen ia ki, bad u la pynphai ia ka dohnud jong u syiem Assyria sha ki, ban pynskhem ia ki kti jong ki ha ka kam jong ka iing U Blei , U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father , and said unto him , Let not the king sin against his servant , against David  ; because he hath not sinned against thee , and because his works have been to thee-ward very good :
kha: U Jonathan u ïaroh ïa u Dabid ha u Saul bad u ong ,  Pa kynrad , wat leh bymdei ïa u shakri jong phi u Dabid . Um pat ju leh palat ïa phi ; ha kawei ka liang , kat kaba u la leh ka la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la kren bha ia u Dabid ha u kpa jong u, bad u la ong ha u, Wat leh ia u syiem ba u la leh pop ia u shakri jong u, pyrshah ia u Dabid; namar ba um shym la leh pop ia me, bad namar ba ki kam jong u ki la long kiba bha shibun:

en: Now the name of the man was Nabal  ; and the name of his wife Abigail : and she was a woman of good understanding , and of a beautiful countenance : but the man was churlish and evil in his doings  ; and he was of the house of Caleb .
kha: La don u briew na ka kur u Kaleb uba kyrteng u Nabal , uba na ka nongrit Maon , bad uba don jaka hajan ka nongrit Karmel . U long u briew uba riewspah , u trai jong ki lai hajar tylli ki langbrot bad shihajar tylli ki blang . Ka tnga jong u ka Abigail ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba shemphang , hynrei u pat u long uba byrtia , bad u briew uba khong khong . U Nabal u dang ot shñiuh ïa ki langbrot jong u ha Karmel
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka kyrteng jong uta u briew ka long u Nabal bad ka kyrteng jong ka tnga jong u Abigail: bad ka la long ka kynthei kaba stad bad kaba itynnad: hynrei uta u briew u la tyrkhong bad uba sniew ha ki kam jong u ; bad u la long na ka iing u Caleb .

en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain , Take up , and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite : for remember how that , when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father , the  Lord  laid this burden upon him  ;
kha: bad u Jehu u ong ha u Bidkar , u nongbud jong u ,  Shim bret ïa ka met jong u ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth . Phi kynmaw ba mynba ma phi bad ma nga ngi dang ïabud ha la ki kulai nadien u Ahab , u kpa jong u syiem Joram , U  Trai  u la kren ïa kine ki ktien pyrshah ïa u Ahab :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jehu u la ong ha u rangbah jong u, To shim ia u, bad bret ia u ha ka bynta jong ka lyngkha u Naboth u Jeselete: namar to kynmaw kumno kata, haba ma nga bad me ngi la shong lang hadien u kpa jong u, U Trai u la buh ia kane ka jingkit halor jong u;

en: And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u la ong ,  U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Wat sheptieng ïa katai ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ! Ngan ai jingjop ïa me halor jong ka mynta ka sngi , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U  Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u la wan u nongiathuhlypa ha u syiem Israel, u da ong: Kumta u ong u Trai: Me la iohi ia une u paidbah uba bun ? ha khmih , ngan aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong me ha kane ka sngi; bad me phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people that were with him , rose up early , and pitched beside the well of Harod : so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Gideon bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki la sher dara harud ka Umpohliew Harod . Ki Midian pat ki sher dara shaphang shatei na ki , ha ka them kaba harud u Lum Moreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jerubbaal uba long u Gideon bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la ieng dang step bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ka pung jong u Had: kumta ka kynhun ki nong Midian ka la don shaphang shathie jong ki, hajan u lum Mrekh, ha ka them .

en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .
kha: Kumta u Ahab u jubab ha ki nonglamktien jong u Benhadad ,  Ïathuh ha u syiem u kynrad jong nga , ba nga mynjur ïa ka jingdawa kaba nyngkong jong u , hynrei ngam lah ban mynjur ïa kaba ar .  Ki nonglamktien ki leit noh bad nangta ki wan biang da kawei pat ka khubor na u Benhadad ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ong ha ki nonglam khubor jong u Benhadad, To iathuh ia u kynrad jong nga u syiem, Baroh kaba me la phah sha u shakri jong me ha kaba nyngkong ngan leh: hynrei ia kane ka kam ngam lah ban leh . Ki nonglam khubor ki la leit noh bad ki la wanrah biang ia u .

en: And David said unto his men , Gird ye on every man his sword . And they girded on every man his sword  ; and David also girded on his sword : and there went up after David about four hundred men  ; and two hundred abode by the stuff .
kha: Pyndait ïa la ki waitlam !  u la hukum , bad ki la leh kumta . U Dabid ruh u la pyndait ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mih lem bad kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah jong u , da kaba iehnoh shadien ïa ki arspah ngut lem bad ki jingkit jingbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha ki briew jong u, To buh ia ka waitlam jong u. Ki la teh ia ka waitlam jong u baroh ar spah ngut bad u Dabid ruh u la teh ia ka waitlam jong u: bad u la leit shaneng hadien u Dabid kumba saw spah ngut ki briew baroh ar spah ngut ki la sah ha ki tiar .

en: And it was so , that , after they had carried it about , the hand of the  Lord  was against the city with a very great destruction : and he smote the men of the city , both small and great , and they had emerods in their secret parts .
kha: Hynrei ynda ka la poi hangta , U  Trai  u pynshitom sa ïa kata ka nongbah ruh bad u pynkhih kulmar ïa ka . U pynshitom ïa ki da ki jingpang thung kiba mih ha baroh ki briew jong ka nongbah , ki samla bad tymmen kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, ba hadien ba ki la kit ia ka, ka kti U Trai ka la long pyrshah ia ka nongbah da ka jingpynjot kaba khraw shibun: bad u la shoh ia ki briew jong ka nongbah, kiba rit bad kiba khraw, bad ki la don ki jingmih ha ki bynta ba rieh jong ki .

en: But the tithes of the children of Israel , which they offer as an heave offering unto the  Lord  , I have given to the Levites to inherit : therefore I have said unto them , Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance .
kha: Ki Lebi kin ym don ka jingdon jingem baneh ha Israel , namar nga la ai ha ki kum ka bynta jong ki ïa ka kaba shiphew ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang . Dei namar kata ba nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba kin ym don ka jingdon jingem baneh ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka shiphew jong ki khun Israel kaba ki ai kum ka jingainguh kaba khraw ha U Trai , nga la ai ha ki Lebi ban hiar pateng: namarkata nga la ong ha ki: Napdeng ki khun Israel kin ym don pateng .

en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whom the  Lord  put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the  Lord  had commanded .
kha: U Besalel , u Oholiab , bad kiwei pat ki nongtrei ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ka jingtbit bad ka jingshemphang , kiba tip ban trei ïa ka kam baroh kaba ïadei bad ka jingtrei ïa ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang , ki dei ban shna ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leh ia u Bezaleel bad u Ahliab bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba stad, ha uba U Trai u la buh ia ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh ban tip kumno ban trei ia ki kam baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka jaka kyntang , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum .

en: Then God turned , and gave them up to worship the host of heaven  ; as it is written in the book of the prophets , O ye house of Israel , have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness ?
kha: Kumta U Blei u la phai noh na ki , bad u la iehnoh ïa ki ban mane ïa ki khlur ka sahit bneng , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab ki nongïathuhlypa :   ‘ Ko ki paid Israel ! Ym dei sha nga ba phi la pynïap bad kñia ïa ki jingri haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Blei u la phai bad u la aiti noh ia ki ban mane ia ka kynhun ki bneng kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ki nongiathuhlypa , ko iing Israel , phi la tyrwa ha nga ia ki mrad bad ki jingknia ba la pyniap da ka jaka kaba sawphew snem ha ka ri khlaw ?

en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they shall bear their iniquity : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations , that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance .
kha: Naduh mynta dei tang ki Lebi ki ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad kin kitkhlieh nadong shadong ïa ka . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ïaineh bad kaba teh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Lebi kin leh ia ka jingshakri jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi baroh kawei .

en: And he brought out the people that were in it , and cut them with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes . Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon . And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .
kha: U rah ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah bad pyntrei ïa ki ha ki jaka ot dieng , jaka shna mohkhiew bad sdie . U leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei ki shnong ka ri Ammon . Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki wan phai sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynmih ia ki briew kiba don ha ka, bad u la ot ia ki da ki nar bad da ki nar . Wat la katta ruh u Dabid u la leh ia ki shnong jong ki khun Ammon baroh . U Dabid bad ki briew baroh ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .

en: For , said Hushai , thou knowest thy father and his men , that they be mighty men , and they be chafed in their minds , as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field : and thy father is a man of war , and will not lodge with the people .
kha: Phi tip ba u Dabid , u kpa jong phi bad ki rangbah jong u ki long ki nongïaleh kiba satar , bad ba ki long kiba shyrkhei kum ka dngiem kmie kaba la shah knieh ïa ki khun jong ka . U kpa jong phi u dei u shipai uba la mlien bha bad um ju sah bad la ki rangbah mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, la ong u Hushai, me tip ia u kpa jong me bad ki briew jong u, ba ki long ki briew kiba khlain bor, bad ki la shah rong noh ha ka jingmut jong ki, kum u bear ba la lute ia ki khun jong ka ha lyngkha: bad u kpa jong me u long u briew uba ialeh thma, bad un ym sah bad ki briew .

en: And he went unto his father s house at Ophrah , and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal , being threescore and ten persons , upon one stone : notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left  ; for he hid himself .
kha: U leit sha ïing u kpa jong u ha Ophrah , bad hangta ha khlieh jong uwei u maw u la pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon . Hynrei u Jotham , u khun khatduh jong u Gideon , u la rieh bad um shym la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha ka iing u kpa jong u ha Ophra, bad u la pyniap ia ki hynmen jong u ki khun shynrang jong u Jerubaal, ki long hynriewphew ngut ki briew, halor uwei u maw: wat la u Jotham u khun uba rit tam jong u Jerubaal u la sah ha ka jaka ba u la buhrieh ia lade .

en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee : and yet thou hast not been as my servant David , who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do that only which was right in mine eyes  ;
kha: Nga la shim noh ïa ka hima na kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid bad nga la ai ïa ka ha me . Hynrei mem shym long kum u Dabid u shakri jong nga , uba bud tylli ïa nga , uba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , bad uba leh ïa kaba dei ha khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to weng noh ia ka hima na ka iing u Dabid, bad me la ai ia ka ha me: bad wat la katta ruh, me la long kum u Dabid jong nga, uba la sumar ia ki hukum jong nga, bad uba la bud ia nga da ka dohnud baroh, ban leh tang ia kata kaba dei ha ki khmat jong nga;

en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem  ; and Jesus went before them : and they were amazed  ; and as they followed , they were afraid . And he took again the twelve , and began to tell them what things should happen unto him ,
kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la don mynta ha ka jingïaid lynti ban leit kiew sha Jerusalem . U Jisu u la nang leit ha shuwa ki synran , kiba la dap da ka jingsngewtieng ; ki briew kiba la bud nadien ki la sheptieng . Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la shim ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran sharud bad u la kren ïa kiei kiei ki ban sa jia ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid sha Jerusalem ; bad U Jisu u la leit sha khmat jong ki: bad ki la lyngngoh ; bad katba ki dang bud . U la shim biang ia ki shiphew ngut bad u la sdang ban iathuh ia ki ia kiei kiei kiba dei ban jia ia u .

en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .
kha: Ki nongïalam ki long kum ki sing kiba kyrhuh halor ki mrad kiba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew , ki shim ïa ka pisa baroh bad ki jingdon jingem kat kaba ki lah ban ïoh , bad da kaba pynïap briew ki pynsah riewkynthei ïa kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingthmu jong ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka hapdeng jong ka, kum u sing uba rkhie bein ia u mrad ba la bam da ki briew; ki la shim ia ka spah bad kiei kiei kiba kordor; ki la pynlong ia ki riewkynthei jong ka kiba bun ha pdeng jong ka .

en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
kha: Ki shynrang baroh na ka jait Lebi kiba la dap shi bnai bad kham heh ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ñiew shi kur shi kur da ka hukum U  Trai  ki long arphew ar hajar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiba la khein ia ki longiing jong ki Kohati , baroh kiba lah ban shakri ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la khein kat kum ka hukum U Trai da ka kti u Moses .

en: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom , Go in unto thy father s concubines , which he hath left to keep the house  ; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father : then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong .
kha: U Ahithophel u jubab ,  Khie leit ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnga kliar u kpa jong phi , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shadien ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem . Te uwei pa uwei ha Israel un tip ba u kpa jong phi u kheiñ ïa phi kum u nongshun jong u , bad ïa ki nongbud jong phi yn pynshlur shibun eh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahitophel u la ong ha u Absalom: To leit sha u kpa jong me, uba u la iehnoh ban sumar ia ka iing ; bad ki Israel baroh kin iohsngew ba me la sngewsih ia u kpa jong me: nangta ki kti jong baroh kiba don bad me kin long kiba khlain .

en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it  ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the  Lord  shall forgive her .
kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U  Trai  un map ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la kyntait ia ka ha ka sngi ba u la iohsngew ia ka ; te un leh ia ka jingkular jong ka kaba ka la kular, bad kata kaba ka la kren da ki rmiang shyntur jong ka, da kaba ka la teh ia ka mynsiem jong ka, khlem jingktah ei ei: bad U Trai un map ia ka .

en: And it came to pass , when they were come into Samaria , that Elisha said ,  Lord  , open the eyes of these men , that they may see . And the  Lord  opened their eyes , and they saw  ; and , behold , they were in the midst of Samaria .
kha: Tang mar ïarung ha ka nongbah , u Elisha u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ki bad ai ba kin ïohi .  U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , u pynïoh pat ïa ka jingimat jong ki , bad ki la ïohi ba ki lah da don hapoh Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki la poi ha Samaria, ba u Elisha u la ong, ko Trai, to plie ia ki khmat jong kine ki briew, ba kin iohi . U Trai u la plie ia ki khmat jong ki, bad ki la iohi; bad, ha khmih, ki la don hapdeng ka Samaria .

en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet , and wept as he went up , and had his head covered , and he went barefoot : and all the people that was with him covered every man his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .
kha: Haba u Dabid u leit shalor u Lum ki Olib da kaba ïam ; u ïaid da ka kjat suda bad u tap ïa la ka khlieh kum ka dak ka jingsngewsih . Baroh kiba bud ïa u ki la tap ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la ïam ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kiew da ka jingkiew jong u lum Olivet, bad u la iam katba u dang kiew, bad u la tap ia ka khlieh jong u: bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la tap ia ka khlieh jong u baroh uwei u briew, bad ki la kiew shaneng, ki da iam katba ki nang kiew shaneng .

en: For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .
kha: Ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba im bad kaba donbor , kaba kham nep ban ïa kano kano ka waitlam arliang syrti . Ka pei lyngba shaduh kaba ka jingim bad ka mynsiem ki ïakynduh , shaduh kaba ki mat bad ki khleiñ shyieng ki ïakynduh lang . Ka bishar ïa ki jingkwah bad ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba stet, bad kaba donbor, bad kaba kham jem ban ia kano kano ka waitlam kaba arliang, kaba pynkhih wat haduh ka jingphiah ia ka mynsiem bad ka mynsiem, bad ki shyieng bad ki shyieng, bad ka long kaba pher ia ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingthmu jong ka dohnud .

en: Ye mountains of Gilboa , let there be no dew , neither let there be rain , upon you , nor fields of offerings : for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away , the shield of Saul , as though he had not been anointed with oil .
kha: Wat ai ban hap u slap ne ka umjer halor ki lum Gilboa ; Ai ba ki lyngkha jong ka kin ïailong shrah ! Naba ki stieh jong kiba shlur ki don hangta ha ka jingjahburom ; ïa ka stieh u Saul ym shym la shut phyrnai shuh da ka umphniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki lum Gilboa , wat ai ba un slap, lymne u slap, ne ki lyngkha jong ki jingknia: namar hangta ka jingda jong u ba khlain ka la jah noh da kaba sniew, ka jingda jong u Saul, kumba um shym la shah pynsleh da ka umphniang .

en: In the midst of the street of it , and on either side of the river , was there the tree of life , which bare twelve manner of fruits , and yielded her fruit every month : and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations .
kha: bad ka tuid sha ka pdeng jong ka lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka wah la don u dieng ka jingim , uba pynmih soh khat-ar sien shisnem , shisien ha uwei uwei u bnai , bad ki sla jong u ki long na ka bynta ban ai jingkhiah ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hapdeng ka lynti jong ka, bad ha kawei ka liang jong ka wah, la don hangta u dieng ka jingim, uba la kha shiphew jait ki soh , bad u la ai soh ia u soh jong ka man la u bnai: bad ki sla jong u dieng ki long na ka bynta ka jingpynkhiah ia ki jaitbynriew .

en: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard  ; publish , and conceal not : say , Babylon is taken , Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces  ; her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ka khubor sha ki jaitbynriew ! Pynbna ïa ka ! Ai ka dak bad pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Wat buhrieh ïa ka ! Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! U Marduk u blei jong ka u la khynñiuh ! Ïa ki bleithaw jong Babilon la buh ha ka jinglehrain , ïa ki dur ba-ijli jong ka la pynlwet !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad pynmih , bad buh ia ka kot lyngkdop kaba thikna, bad ym ban buhrieh: ong: Ka Babilon ka la shah pynjah burom, ka Bel ka la shah pynjah burom, ka Merodach ka la shah pynpra ha ki bynta; ki bleithaw jong ka ki la shah pynjah burom .

en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition , queen Esther ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? and it shall be performed , even to the half of the kingdom .
kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli biang ïa ka ,  Mynta , ko Esther , ko mahadei , kaei kaba pha kwah ? Ïathuh ïa nga bad phan ïoh ïa kata . Ngan ai ha pha wat shiteng na ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong biang ha ka sngi kaba ar ha ka jingkhawai wain, Kaei ka jingkyrpad jong me, ko mahadei ? bad yn ai ia me: bad kaei ka jingkyrpad jong me ? bad yn pyndep ia ka, wat haduh shiteng jong ka hima .

en: He removed the high places , and brake the images , and cut down the groves , and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made : for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it : and he called it Nehushtan .
kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki païa maw , bad u pyndkut ïa ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah . U pynpra ruh lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bseiñ rnong ïa uba u Moses u la shna , ïa uba la khot Nehushtan . Haduh kata ka por ki paid Israel ki la thang jingiwbih na ka bynta ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la weng noh ia ki jaka ba jrong, bad u la pynkhih ia ki dur, bad u la pynkhih ia u bsein uba la shna da u Moses: namar haduh kita ki sngi ki khun Israel ki la thang ia ka: bad u la khot ia ka Nehustan .

en: And said unto the children of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought up Israel out of Egypt , and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all kingdoms , and of them that oppressed you :
kha: bad u ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt bad nga la pyllait ïa phi na ki nong Ijipt bad na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynshitom beiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki khun Israel , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, nga la wanrah ia ki Israel na Ijipt bad nga la pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong ki nong Ijipt bad na ka kti jong ki hima baroh:

en: I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice  ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey  ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends  ; drink , yea , drink abundantly , O beloved .
kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ! Katno ki khmat jong phi hapoh ka jingtap khmat ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit . U shñiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba hiar sha trai ki lum Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga wan shapoh ka kper jong nga, ko para jong nga, ko lok jong nga: Nga la lum ia ka umsoh jong nga bad ka jingsma jong nga ; nga la bam ia ka umsoh jong nga bad ka umsoh jong nga ; nga la dih ia ka wain jong nga bad ka dud jong nga: bam, ko paralok; dih, hooid, dih bun, ko baieit .

en: Yet ,  Lord  , thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me : forgive not their iniquity , neither blot out their sin from thy sight , but let them be overthrown before thee  ; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger .
kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me tip ïa baroh ki jingthmu sniew jong ki ban pynïap ïa nga . Wat ym map ïa ka jingsniew jong ki lane map ïa ka pop jong ki . Bret ïa ki sha tbian ha ka jingshahjop bad leh ïa ki katba me dang bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ko Trai, me tip ia ka jingthmu jong ki baroh ban pyniap ia nga: wat map ia ka jingbymhok jong ki, wat nym pynmih ia ka pop jong ki na ka khmat jong me, hynrei to ai ba kin shah pynhap noh ha khmat jong me; leh kumta bad ki ha ka por jong ka jingbitar jong me .

en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath : wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand , and dipped it in an honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth  ; and his eyes were enlightened .
kha: Hynrei u Jonathan um shym la ïohsngew ba u kpa jong u , u la maham jur ïa ki rangbah da ka jingtim ; kumta u la kner da u dieng ba u rah , u pynngam ïa u ha ka rewngap , bad u bam khyndiat ka ngap . Hangta hi u la sngew ïohbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jonathan um shym la iohsngew haba u kpa jong u u la pynkyntang ia ki briew da ka jingsmai: namar kata u la buh ia ka tduh jong u diengsoh uba don ha ka kti jong u, bad u la buh ia ka kti jong u ha ka shyntur jong u; bad ki khmat jong u ki la shai .

en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and saddled his ass , and took two of his young men with him , and Isaac his son , and clave the wood for the burnt offering , and rose up , and went unto the place of which God had told him .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Abraham u thlieh ki dieng na ka bynta ka jingkñia , u la pynkit halor ka kada , bad u la ïalam ïa u Isaak lem bad ar ngut ki shakri . Ki la ïamihnoh ban leit sha ka jaka ba U Blei u la ïathuh ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la khie dang step, bad u la sngap jar ia la ka tdong bad u la shim arngut ki samla jong u bad u Isaak u khun jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia u dieng na ka bynta ka jingknia thang, bad u la khie, bad u la leit sha ka jaka kaba U Blei u la iathuh ia u .

en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the  Lord  , and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you . And this shall come to pass , if ye will diligently obey the voice of the  Lord  your God .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba sah sha jngai bah kin wan bad ïarap ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai . Bad haba la tei pat ïa ka , phin tip ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga sha phi . Kane baroh kan jia lada phi kohnguh lut ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba jngai kin wan bad tei ha ka tempi U Trai , bad phin sa tip ba U Trai jong ki paid u la phah ia nga sha phi . Bad kane kan sa jia lada phi kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai jong phi .

en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem , and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha nga ka khubor na ka bynta u Shemaïah jong ka Nehelam , uba la phah ka shithi ha ka kyrteng jong u hi sha baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad sha u Sephanaïah , u lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah bad sha baroh kiwei pat ki lyngdoh . Ha kane ka shithi , u Shemaïah u la thoh sha u Sephanaïah :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel, u ong: Namar me la phah shithi ha ka kyrteng jong me sha ki briew baroh kiba don ha Jerusalem bad ha u Sephaniah u khun u Maaseiah u lyngdoh bad ha ki lyngdoh baroh .

en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation , and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you  ; no manner of work shall be done in them , save that which every man must eat , that only may be done of you .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong bad kumjuh ruh ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , phi dei ban ïakynduh lang ban mane Blei . Phim bit ban trei ei ei ha kita ki sngi , hynrei phi lah ban pynkhreh jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong kan don ka jingiaseng kaba khuid bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew kan ym long ka jingiaseng kaba khuid ha phi; ym dei ban leh ei ei ha ki, lait noh tang ia kaba uwei pa uwei u dei ban bam, ba tang ia phi .

en: And will make an offering by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , or a sacrifice in performing a vow , or in a freewill offering , or in your solemn feasts , to make a sweet savour unto the  Lord  , of the herd , or of the flock :
kha: Ïa u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot lane ka blang lah ban wanrah ha U  Trai  kum ka jingainguh thang lane kum ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa ka jingsmai lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha lane kum ka jingainguh ha ki Jingkhawai Niam kiba man ka por ; ka jingiw jong kine ki jingainguh bam ka pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ka jingainguh da ka ding ha U Trai, ka jingainguh thang ne ka jingknia ha kaba leh ia ka jingkular ne ha ka jingainguh kaba laitluid ne ha ki jingkhawai ba bang jong phi, ban pynlong ia ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai, na ka kynhun ne na ka kynhun:

en: Also Jeshua , and Bani , and Sherebiah , Jamin , Akkub , Shabbethai , Hodijah , Maaseiah , Kelita , Azariah , Jozabad , Hanan , Pelaiah , and the Levites , caused the people to understand the law : and the people stood in their place .
kha: Nangta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka , bad kine ki Lebi ki batai ïa ka Hukum ha ki : u Jeshua , u Bani , u Sherebaïah , u Jamin , u Akkub , u Shabbethai , u Hodaïah , u Maaseïah , u Kelita , u Asaraïah , u Josabad , u Hanan , bad u Pelaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u Jeshua , bad u Bani , bad u Jamin, u Akkub, u Shabbethai, u Hodijah, u Maaseiah, u Kelita, u Azariah, u Jozabad, u Hanan, u Pelaiah bad ki Lebi, ki la pynlong ia ki briew ban sngewthuh ia ka ain: bad ki briew ki la ieng ha ka jaka jong ki .

en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself  ; and the second year that which springeth of the same : and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruit thereof .
kha: Te u Isaïah u la ong ha u syiem Hesekaïah ,  Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban jia . Kane ka snem bad hadien men ïoh tang u symboh kew khlaw ba men bam , hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud me lah ban bet ïa u kew jong me bad ban ot ïa u , bad men thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka dak ha me , Phin bam ia u soh jong u hi bad ha ka snem kaba ar kaba mih na kajuh ka por: bad ha ka snem kaba lai phi bet, bad ot, bad thung ia ki kper sohjew jong ka .

en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem , ( but he himself laid siege against Lachish , and all his power with him , ) unto Hezekiah king of Judah , and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem , saying ,
kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba u Sennakherib bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang don ha Lakhish , u phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Hesekaïah bad sha ki paid Judah kiba dang don bad u ha Jerusalem :
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane u Sennakherib u syiem Assyria u la phah ia ki shakri jong u sha Jerusalem (hynrei ma u hi u la leit sha u Laksh bad ka bor jong u baroh ryngkat bad u) ha u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah bad ha Judah baroh kiba don ha Jerusalem .

en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy  ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :
kha: Lada uno uno u briew u mih prum , lane u mih tohjaw , lane u tyrha ka sniehdoh , bad kata ka lah ban kylla sha ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , dei ban leit ïalam ïa u ha lyngdoh uba na ka longïing jong u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew u don ha ka sniehdoh jong u ka sniehdoh kaba kiew, ne kaba shai, bad ka don ha ka sniehdoh jong u kum ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh ; nangta un wanrah ha u Aaron u lyngdoh ne ha uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u:

en: They shall come with weeping , and with supplications will I lead them : I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way , wherein they shall not stumble : for I am a father to Israel , and Ephraim is my firstborn .
kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan phai da kaba ïam , da kaba duwai katba nga ïalam ban wan phai pat . Ngan ïalam ïa ki sha ki wahduid , ha ka lynti kaba beit ha kaba kin ym jynthut . Nga long kum u kpa ïa ki Israel , bad u Ephraim u long u khun banyngkong eh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin wan da kaba iam, bad da ki jingkyrpad ngan ialam ia ki: Ngan pynlong ia ki ban iaid lyngba ki wah um ha ka lynti kaba beit: namar nga long u kpa ia ki Israel , bad u Ephram u long u khun nyngkong jong nga .

en: And Baalath , and all the store cities that Solomon had , and all the chariot cities , and the cities of the horsemen , and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and throughout all the land of his dominion .
kha: ka nongbah Baalath , baroh ki nongbah ha kiba u kynshew jingbam , bad ki nongbah ha kiba u buh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong u . U pyndep ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong u ban tei ha Jerusalem , ha Lebanon , bad ha kylleng ka jaka kaba u synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Baalath bad ki nongbah dukan baroh kiba u Solomon u don, bad ki nongbah kit mar baroh bad ki nongbah jong ki kulai bad baroh kiba u Solomon u kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem bad ha Lebanon bad ha ka ri baroh kawei jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

en: And the sons of Bela  ; Ezbon , and Uzzi , and Uzziel , and Jerimoth , and Iri , five  ; heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour  ; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four .
kha: U Bela u don san ngut ki khun shynrang : u Esbon , u Ussi , u Ussiel , u Jerimoth , bad u Iri . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki dei baroh ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki kynthup ïa ki arphew ar hajar laiphew saw ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Bela Ezbon, bad u Uziel, bad u Jerimoth, bad u Iri, san tylli ki khlieh jong ki kpa jong ki, ki rangbah kiba donbor .

en: And these things , brethren , I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes ; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written , that no one of you be puffed up for one against another .
kha: Na ka bynta jong phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , nga la pynshisha ïa kane baroh ha u Apollos bad ha nga , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ngi baroh ar ngut kum ka nuksa , khnang ba phi lah ban tip kaei ka jingmut jong ka jingong ,  Kohnguh ïa ki kyndon kiba dei .  Uno uno na phi um dei ban ñiewkor ïa uwei u briew bad ibeiñ ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine kiei kiei, ko para bangeit, nga don ha ka dur kaba la pynkylla ha nga bad ha u Apollos na ka bynta jong phi ; ba phin nang ha ngi ban ym pyrkhat ia ki briew kiba palat ia kaba la thoh, ba ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la shah pynkhih na ka bynta iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand : that the  Lord  may turn from the fierceness of his anger , and shew thee mercy , and have compassion upon thee , and multiply thee , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers  ;
kha: Wat shim sha lade ïa kaei kaei kaba la mang ban pynjot , te U  Trai  un phai na ka jingbitar shla jong u bad un isynei ïa phi . Un leh-isynei ïa phi bad un pynroi ïa phi , kumba u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym don ei ei na kaei kaba la tim ha ka kti jong me: ba U Trai un phai noh na ka jingbitar jong u, bad un pyni ia me ia ka jingsngewrit ia me, bad un pynbun ia me, kumba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me;

en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .
kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha Seïon , sha u lum bakyntang jong nga , ngan ai ha phi ka jingkmen ha ka ïing jingduwai jong nga ; bad pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi ai ha ka duwan jong nga . Ïa ka ïing jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai na ka bynta ki briew jong ki ri baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia ki ruh ngan wanrah ha u lum bakhuid jong nga, bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban sngewbha ha ka iing duwai jong nga: ia ki jingknia thang jong ki bad ki jingknia jong ki yn pdiang ha ka jaka bam jong nga; namar ia ka iing jong nga yn khot ka iing duwai na ka bynta ki briew baroh .

en: And Adoni–bezek said , Threescore and ten kings , having their thumbs and their great toes cut off , gathered their meat under my table : as I have done , so God hath requited me . And they brought him to Jerusalem , and there he died .
kha: U Adonibesek u ong ,  Hynñiewphew ngut ki syiem ba la shah ot ki  tikmie bad ki  jatkmie ki hap ban tam jingbam na khrum miej jong nga . U Blei u la leh mynta ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ki .  La ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem , ha kaba u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Adonibeek u la ong, Ki shiphew ngut ki syiem, ki la ot ia ki kti bad ki tyrpeng kiba heh jong ki: kumba nga la leh, kumta U Blei u la pynshitom ia nga . Ki la wanrah ia u sha Jerusalem bad hangta u la iap .

en: Take thee a roll of a book , and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations , from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .
kha: Shim ïa ka kot kli bad thoh ha ka ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me shaphang ka Israel bad ka Judah bad baroh ki jaitbynriew . Thoh lut ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me naduh ka por ba nga la kren nyngkong ha me , mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia me ia ka kot , bad thoh ha kata ki ktien baroh kiba nga la kren ha me pyrshah ia ki Israel bad pyrshah ia ki jaitbynriew baroh , naduh ka sngi ba nga kren ha me, naduh ki sngi u Josiah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: But the women , and the little ones , and the cattle , and all that is in the city , even all the spoil thereof , shalt thou take unto thyself  ; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
kha: Hynrei phi lah ban shim sha lade ïa ki kynthei , ki khun rit , ki jingri jingdup , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha kata ka shnong . Phi lah ban rah ïa kata baroh kaba dei ka jong ki nongshun jong phi . U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki kynthei bad ki khynnah rit bad ki masi bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka shnong, wat ia ka jingjot jong ka baroh kawei, to shim ha lade; bad me dei ban bam ia ka jingjot jong ki nongshun jong me, ia kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ai ha me .

en: And the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them , and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth–maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward  ; and they smote them , until they left them none remaining .
kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki ; ki Israel ki tur ïaleh bad ki bad ki beh kthong ïa ki shaphang shatei haduh Misrephoth Maim bad Sidon , bad shaphang mihngi haduh ka them Mispah . Ka jingïaleh ka neh haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh u nongshun uba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki Israel, kiba la pynkhih ia ki, bad u la beh ia ki haduh u Sidon uba khraw, bad haduh ka them Mispeh shaphang mihngi; bad ki la pynkhih ia ki haduh ba kim shym la iehnoh ia ki.

en: Then said he unto me , The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great , and the land is full of blood , and the city full of perverseness : for they say , The  Lord  hath forsaken the earth , and the  Lord  seeth not .
kha: U Blei u la jubab ,  Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki la rem na ki pop kiba shyrkhei . Ki la pynïap briew ha ka ri baroh kawei bad ki pyndap ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kam runar . Ki ong ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ngam ïohi ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga , Ka jingbymhok jong ka iing Israel bad Judah ka long kaba palat ia ka snam bad ka shnong kaba dap da ka jingbym don: namar ki ong: U Trai u la iehnoh ia ka khyndew bad U Trai um iohi .

en: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah , southward of the river : these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh : the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river , and the outgoings of it were at the sea :
kha: Nangta u pud u hiar arsut sha ka wahduid Kanah . Ki nongbah kiba shathie jong ka wahduid ki dei jong ki jait Ephraim , wat la ki hap hapoh ka ri Manasseh . U pud ka Manasseh u suh ter ter na ka phud bashatei jong ka wahduid bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw ka la hiar sha ka wah Kanah, shaphang shathie jong ka wah: kine ki shnong Ephraim ki long napdeng ki shnong Manasseh: ka rud duriaw Manasseh ruh ka la don shaphang shathie jong ka wah:

en: And now will I shew thee the truth . Behold , there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia  ; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all : and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia .
kha: Bad kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ïa me ka long kaba shisha .  U angel u la ong ,  Sa lai ngut ki syiem kin synshar halor ka Persia , yn bud sa uba saw , u ban kham riewspah ban ïa baroh kiwei pat . Haba u la khlaiñbor bha bad riewspah eh un kob ïa ka hima Gris .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ngan pyni ia me ia ka jingshisha . Ha khmih, kin ieng sa lai ngut ki syiem ha Persia ; bad kaba saw kan kham riewspah shibun ban ia ki baroh: bad da ka bor jong u lyngba ki spah jong u un pynkhih lut ia ka hima Greece .

en: Then said he also to him that bade him ,  When thou makest a dinner or a supper , call not thy friends , nor thy brethren , neither thy kinsmen , nor thy rich neighbours  ; lest they also bid thee again , and a recompence be made thee .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u nongpdiang ïa u ,  Haba me ai ïa ka bam step ne ka bam miet , wat khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong me lane ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me lane ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong me lane ki paramarjan kiba riewspah jong me — naba kin khot sngewbha kylliang ïa me , bad ha kane ka rukom yn sa siew ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ruh ia uta uba la bthah ia u, Haba me pynlong ia ka jingbam janmiet ne ka jingbam janmiet, wat khot ia ki paralok jong me, ne ia ki hynmen jong me, ne ia ki para marjan jong me;

en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea , until we were come over the brook Zered , was thirty and eight years  ; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host , as the  Lord  sware unto them .
kha: Kane ka long laiphew phra snem hadien ba ngi la mih na Kadesh Barnea . Ki rangïapom baroh jong kata ka pateng ki la ïap lut , kumba U  Trai  u la kren lypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jaka ha kaba ngi la wan na Kadeshbarnea, haduh ba ngi la poi sha ka wah Zered, ka la long laiphew san snem shuh shuh haduh ba ka pateng baroh kawei ka la jah noh na pdeng ki shipai, katba U Trai u la sngap jar ia ki .

en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things , as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle : for , See , saith he , that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount .
kha: Ka kam kaba ki leh kum ki lyngdoh ka long shisha tang kum ka dur bad ka syrngiew ïa kaei kaba don ha bneng . Ka la long kajuh kumba ka la long bad u Moses . Haba u la dei ban thaw ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang , U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Pynthikna ban thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kum kata ka nongmuna ïa kaba la pyn-i ha me halor uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba shakri ia ka nuksa bad ka jingdum jong kiei kiei kiba ha bneng, kumba u Moses u la shah pynrem ha U Blei haba u la thmu ban shna ia ka ïingjahthait: namar , Peit , u ong ba me leh ia kiei kiei baroh kat kum ka rukom ba la pyni ha me ha u lum .

en: ( Acts 11 :27-30 ) Similarly , when we learn that our brothers in some part of the world are facing hardship , we send donations through our local congregation to supply material aid to those in critical need . —2 Corinthians 8 :13-15 .
kha: ( Kam 11 :27-30 ) Kumjuh ruh haba ngi tip ba ki para bangeit jong ngi ha kano kano ka bynta jong ka pyrthei ki shem jingeh , ngi phah ïa ki jingnoh synñiang lyngba ka balang la jong ban ai jingïarap sha kito kiba donkam bha . —2 Korinth 8 :13-15 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Ki Kam 11 :27-30 ) Kumjuh ruh haba ngi tip ba ki para jong ngi ha kawei ka bynta jong ka pyrthei ki iakynduh jingeh, ngi phah ia ki jingai sngewbha lyngba ka balang jong ngi ban pynbiang ia ka jingiarap ha ka liang ka met sha kito kiba donkam eh . 2 Korinth 8 :13-15 .

en: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places , and see where thou hast not been lien with . In the ways hast thou sat for them , as the Arabian in the wilderness  ; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness .
kha: Khmih shatei halor ki kliar lum . Hato don kano kano ka jaka ha kaba pham shym la leh kum ka nuti ? Pha la ap ïa ki nongleh-ieit shi lynter ka rud surok , kumba u Arab u apthap ha ka ri shyiap . Pha la pyntngit ïa ka ri da ka jingleh nuti jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia ki khmat jong me sha ki jaka ba jrong, bad peit shano me la leit noh bad ki . Ha ki lynti me la shong na ka bynta jong ki, kumba u Arab ha ka ri khlaw ; bad me la pynjakhlia ia ka ri da ki jingkhaii met jong me bad da ka jingsniew jong me .

en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God  ; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities : and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people  ; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation .
kha: Da la ki bleithaw ïa nga ki pynbitar , ïa ki blei jong ki , ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ngam lah shah . Kumta ngan pyndonkam da kito ki bym dei ka jaitbynriew ban pynbitar ïa ki , ngan kynshoit ruh ïa ki da ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit katba kin ym lah shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia nga ban sngewsih ia kata kaba ym long U Blei; ki la pynlong ia nga ban bitar ia ki jinglong ba sniew jong ki: bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban sngewsih ia kito ki bym dei ki briew ; ngan pynkhih ia ki ban bitar ia ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit .

en: As they gather silver , and brass , and iron , and lead , and tin , into the midst of the furnace , to blow the fire upon it , to melt it  ; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury , and I will leave you there , and melt you .
kha: ha kajuh ka rukom ba ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ka rupa , ka tama , ka nar , ka sisa , bad ka tin la buh ha ka ding ban saiñ ïa ki . Ka jingbitar bad jingbitar shla jong nga kin pynum ïa ki kumba ka lawar ding ka pynum ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki lum ia ka rupa, bad ka nar, bad ka nar, bad ka lead, bad ka tin, hapdeng ka ding, ban pynbthei ia ka ding halor jong ka, ban pynkhluit ia ka ; kumta ngan lum ia phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga bad ha ka jingbitar jong nga, bad ngan iehnoh ia phi hangta, bad ngan pynkhluit ia phi .

en: And when they cried unto the  Lord  , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians , and brought the sea upon them , and covered them  ; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt : and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season .
kha: Hynrei haba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki poi ha Duriaw Basaw , ki la kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap , bad nga la buh ïa ka jingdum hapdeng jong ki bad ki nong Ijipt . Nga la pynlong ïa ka duriaw ba kan tyllep halor ki nong Ijipt bad pynïap jyllop ïa ki . Phi tip kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Ijipt .   ‘ Phi la im slem bha ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pyrta ha U Trai , u la buh ia ka jingdum hapdeng jong phi bad ki nong Ijipt , bad u la wanrah ia ka duriaw halor jong ki , bad u la tap ia ki bad ki khmat jong phi ki la iohi ia kaei kaba nga la leh ha Ijipt: bad phi la shong ha ka ri khlaw kaba jrong .

en: And thou , even thyself , shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee  ; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not : for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger , which shall burn for ever .
kha: Phin hap ban iehnoh ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan pynlong ïa phi ban shakri ïa ki nongshun jong phi ha ka ri kaba phim tip ei ei , namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long kum ka ding , bad kan pluh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me hi, to sangeh noh na ka pateng jong me kaba nga la ai ha me; bad ngan pynlong ia me ban shakri ia ki nongshun jong me ha ka ri kaba me tip: namar phi la pynmeh ding ha ka jingbitar jong nga, kaba ngan thang junom .

en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the  Lord  of hosts in the land of Egypt : for they shall cry unto the  Lord  because of the oppressors , and he shall send them a saviour , and a great one , and he shall deliver them .
kha: Kin long ka dak jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Ijipt . Haba ïa ki briew hangta la banbeiñ bad ki la kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , un phah ïa uno uno ban pyllait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ka dak bad ka sakhi ia U Trai jong ki paid ha ka ri Ijipt: namar kin pyrta ia U Trai namar ki nongpynshitom bein , bad un phah ia ki ia u nongpynim bad uba khraw , bad un pyllait im ia ki .

en: Then spake Joshua to the  Lord  in the day when the  Lord  delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon  ; and thou , Moon , in the valley of Aijalon .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa ki Israel halor ki Amor , u Joshua u kren ha U  Trai . Ha khmat ki Israel u ong ,  Ko Sngi , to ïeng thik halor ka Gibeon , Ko Bnai , to sangeh ha ka Them Aijalon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joshua u la kren ha U Trai ha ka sngi ba U Trai u la aiti ia ki Amorit ha khmat ki Israel , bad u la ong ha khmat ki Israel , Sngi , me ieng dang ha Gibeon ; bad me , u Bnai , ha ka them Aijalon .

en: And David said to Abishai , and to all his servants , Behold , my son , which came forth of my bowels , seeketh my life : how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone , and let him curse  ; for the  Lord  hath bidden him .
kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ha u Abishai bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ,  U khun jong nga hi u pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga , te balei phin lyngngoh ïa une u nong Benjamin ? U  Trai  u la ong ïa u ban tim ; kumta wat pynwit ïa u , ai un leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abisai bad ha ki shakri jong u baroh, Ha khmih, ko khun jong nga, uba la mih na ka kpoh jong nga, u wad ia ka jingim jong nga: katno mynta une u Benjamin u lah ban leh ia kata ? to ai ba un long marwei, bad to ai ba un tim ia u; namar U Trai u la buh ia u.

en: And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem  ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria , except the apostles .
kha: Bad u Saul u la mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Stephan . Ha kata hi ka sngi , ka balang ha Jerusalem ka la sdang ban mad ïa ka jingpynshitom beiñ kaba shyrkhei . Baroh ki riewngeit , lait noh ki apostol , ki la sakma sha kylleng jong ki thain ka Judia bad ka Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la mynjur ia ka jingiap jong u . Bad ha kata ka por ka la don ka jingshah pynshitom bein kaba khraw pyrshah ia ka balang kaba don ha Jerusalem ; bad baroh ki la saphriang kylleng ki thain jong ka Judaea bad ka Samaria .

en: And if a man purchase of the Levites , then the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , shall go out in the year of jubilee : for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .
kha: Lada ïa ka ïing ha kawei na kine ki shnong la die da kiba na ka jait Lebi bad ym shym thied pat ïa ka , dei ban pynphai pat ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat , namar ki ïing jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi kiba don ha kita ki shnong jong ki , ki dei ki jingïohkynti jong ki hapdeng ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u thied ia ki Lebi, te ka iing kaba la die bad ka shnong jong u kan leit noh ha ka snem jubile: namar ki iing jong ki shnong ki Lebi ki long ki jong ki hapdeng ki khun Israel .

en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh , Speak , I pray thee , unto thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and speak not to us in the Jews  language , in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la ong ha u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ngi da ka ktien Aramaik . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïa-shahskhor .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eliakim bad u Shebna bad u Joah ha u Rabsakeh, To kren, nga kyrpad ia me, ha ki shakri jong me ha ka ktien Syria ; namar ngi sngewthuh ia ka: bad wat kren ia ngi ha ka ktien jong ki Jiw, ha ki shkor jong ki briew kiba don ha ka kynroh .

en: And it came to pass , as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god , that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword : and they escaped into the land of Armenia . And Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u dang mane ha ka templ jong u blei jong u , u Nisrokh , ar ngut na ki khun jong u , u Adrammelekh bad u Shareser , ki pynïap ïa u da ki waitlam , bad nangta ki phet ïap sha ka ri Ararat . Uwei pat na ki khun shynrang jong u , u Esarhaddon , u long u patsha ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u dang mane ha iing u blei jong u, ba u Adrammech bad u Sharezer ki khun jong u ki la shoh ia u da ka waitlam: bad ki la lait sha ka ri Armenia . Bad u Esarmad u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And she put her widow s garments off from her , and covered her with a veil , and wrapped herself , and sat in an open place , which is by the way to Timnah  ; for she saw that Shelah was grown , and she was not given unto him to wife .
kha: Kumta ka la kylliang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei ba ka phong , ka la tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jingkah khmat , bad ka la leit shong ha ka khyrdop ban rung sha Enaim , ka shnong kaba don ha ka lynti sha Timnah . Kumba ka la tip bha ba u Shelah u khun khatduh jong u Judah , u la rangbah mynta , pynban ym pat shym la ai ïa ka ha u ban shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la weng noh ia ki jain jong ka da ka jingtap , bad ka la tap ia ka da ka jingtap , bad ka la shong ha ka jaka kaba plie , kaba don ha ka lynti sha Timnah ; namar ka la iohi ba ka Shelah ka la san bad ym shym la ai ia ka ha u ha ka tnga .

en: He that walketh righteously , and speaketh uprightly  ; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions , that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes , that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood , and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil  ;
kha: Phi lah ban lait im lada phi ong bad phi leh ïa kaba dei . Wat pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi ban shukor ïa kiba duk bad wat pdiang ïa ka pisa bashukor . Wat ïasnohkti bad kito kiba thmu ban pynïap briew lane ban leh ïa kiwei ki kam sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaid hok, bad uba kren beit ia ka jingmyntoi jong ki jingshah lehbein, uba pynkhih ia ki kti jong u na kaba bat ia ki pisa , uba pynsangeh ia ki shkor jong u na kaba iohsngew ia ka snam , bad u khang ia ki khmat jong u na kaba iohi ia kaba sniew;

en: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold , although they were yet alive : for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof , which shall not return  ; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life .
kha: Yn ym don nongkhaïi ki ban im haduh ban ïoh biang ïa kaei kaba ki la duh , namar ka jingbitar U Blei ka long halor baroh . Kito kiba bymman kin ym lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u nongdie un ym wan phai sha kata kaba la die, wat la ki dang im: namar ka jingphohsniew ka ktah ia ka jingbun briew baroh kawei, kaba ym wan phai shuh shuh.

en: Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
kha: Sumar ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad pynkyntang ïa lade ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem . Lymda kumta , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh . Kan pluh , bad yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhluit ia lade ha U Trai, bad weng noh ia ki bniat jong ka dohnud jong phi, phi ki briew jong ka Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem: ioh ba ka jingbitar jong nga kan mih kum ka ding , bad thang ia ka ba ym don ba lah ban pynlip ia ka , namar ka jingsniew jong phi .

en: Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Solomon , bad u la ong ha u ,  Namar ba me la leh khnang ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba me la ïateh bad nga bad ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , nga kular ban shim noh ïa ka hima na me bad ngan ai ha uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata U Trai u la ong ha u Solomon , Kumba la leh ia kane na me , bad me khlem da sumar ia ka jutang jong nga bad ki ain jong nga kiba nga la hukum ia me , ngan sa pynkylla ia ka hima na me bad ngan ai ia ka ha u shakri jong me .

en: The son of Geber , in Ramoth–gilead  ; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh , which are in Gilead  ; to him also pertained the region of Argob , which is in Bashan , threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars :
kha: U Bengeber : ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead , bad ki shnong ha Gilead kiba dei jong ki kur u Jair , uba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , bad ka thain Argob ha Bashan , baroh hynriewphew tylli ki shnong kiba heh , kiba la ker da ki kynroh bad ki nar rnong ha ki khyrdop
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u Geber , ha Ramothgilead ; u la ioh ia ki shnong u Jair u khun u Manasseh, kiba don ha Gilead ; ha u ruh ki la ioh ia ka thain Argob kaba don ha Basan, ki lai tylli ki nongbah kiba heh bad ki nar kiba heh:
