en: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof  ; and the border about it shall be half a cubit  ; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about  ; and his stairs shall look toward the east .
kha: Ka bynta ba hapdeng ruh ka long sawdong , hynñiew mitar ka jingjrong ha kawei pa kawei ka liang , bad ka rmiang ha ka tduh bashabar kaba long arphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong . ( Ka nur ka long sanphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang . ) Ki kyrdon ban kiew shalor ka duwan ki don ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaka shong jaka sah kan long shiphew cubit ka jingjrong bad shiphew cubit ka jingjrong ha ki saw tylli ki jaka ba sawdong jong ka.

en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah  ; none was exempted : and they took away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha had builded  ; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .
kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u la phah ïa ka hukum kylleng ka ri Judah kaba dawa ïa uwei pa uwei , khlem lait ïano ïano , ban ïarap kit noh na Ramah ïa ki maw bad ki dieng ïa kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ban pynskhem ïa ka . Da kine ki tiar ki tar u Asa u tei pynskhem ïa ka Mispah bad ïa ka Geba , ka nongbah kaba don ha ka ri Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u la pynlong ia ka jingpynbna ha baroh kawei ka Judah: bad ki la weng noh ia ki maw jong ka Ramah bad ki dieng jong ka, ha kaba u Baasha u la tei; bad u syiem Asa u la tei bad ki ia u Gba u Benjamin bad u Mizpah .

en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with part of the vessels of the house of God : which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god  ; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .
kha: U Trai u la shah ïa u ban kem ïa u Syiem Jehoïakim bad kurup katto katne ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . U la shim pat katto katne ngut ki koidi lem bad u sha ka templ jong ki blei jong u ha Babilon , bad u la buh ïa ka jingkynshew ba la ïoh kurup ha ki jaka kynshew ka templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ai ha ka kti jong u syiem Judah ha ka kti jong u: kaba u la rah sha ka ri Shinar sha ka iing u blei jong u ; bad u la wanrah ia ki tiar sha ka iing jong u blei jong u .

en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee , that they may be joined unto thee , and minister unto thee : but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .
kha: Wan ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , kiba na ka jait Lebi , ban ïatreilang bad ïarap ïa me katba me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phi dang ïashakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki hynmen jong me ruh na ka jait Lebi, ka jait jong u kpa jong me, kin wanrah ia me bad me, ba kin iasoh bad me, bad kin shakri ia me: hynrei ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me kin shakri ha khmat ka iing jong me .

en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day : if the plague be spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in a skin , or in any work that is made of skin  ; the plague is a fretting leprosy  ; it is unclean .
kha: Un khmih bha pat ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la pur , kata ka long ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un peit ia ka khlam ha ka sngi kaba hynriew: lada ka khlam ka saphriang ha ka jain , la ka long ha ka sniehdoh , ne ha ka sniehdoh , ne ha kano kano ka kam kaba la shna da ka sniehdoh; ka khlam ka long kaba sniew; ka long kaba khlem khuid .

en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death . And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Hesekaïah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka bynta ba-halor jong ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ki ai ka burom kaba khraw ha ka jingïap jong u . U Manasseh u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ia u ha ka jaka tep jong ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid: bad u Judah baroh bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ki la burom ia u ha ka jingiap jong u . Bad u Manasseh u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them , after that they be destroyed from before thee  ; and that thou enquire not after their gods , saying , How did these nations serve their gods ? even so will I do likewise .
kha: Ynda U  Trai  u la pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew , da lei lei wat bud ïa ki rukom lehniam jong ki , namar ka long kaba ma . Wat pyrshang ban tip kumno ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , ïoh ba phi mane Blei kumba leh ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade ba men ym shah pynngop da kaba bud ia ki, hadien ba ki la shah pynjot na khmat jong me ; bad ba me ym kylli hadien ki blei jong ki, da kaba ong: Kumno kine ki jaitbynriew ki shakri ia ki blei jong ki ? wat la katta ruh ngan leh kumjuh .

en: Thou therefore , son of man , prophesy , and smite thine hands together , and let the sword be doubled the third time , the sword of the slain : it is the sword of the great men that are slain , which entereth into their privy chambers .
kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Thab ïa la ki kti , bad ka waitlam kan mait bad ïai mait . Ka dei ka waitlam kaba pynïap , ka waitlam ba pynshyrkhei bad ba mait .
translated_en_to_kha: Me, ko khun u briew, to iathuhlypa bad to pynkhih ia ki kti jong me, bad to ai ba ka waitlam kan long ar shah: ka long ka waitlam jong ki rangbah kiba la shah pyniap, kaba rung ha ki kamra ba rieh jong ki .

en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness , and shall uncover her nakedness  ; he hath discovered her fountain , and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood : and both of them shall be cut off from among their people .
kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , dei ban tait noh ïa ki baroh ar ngut na la ki parabriew , namar ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingbymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u shynrang un thiah bad ka kynthei kaba don ia ka jingpang jong ka, bad un pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka; u la lap ia ka pung jong ka snam jong ka: bad baroh arngut kin shah ot noh na ki briew jong ki .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la hukum ïa phi ban shim ïa kine ki dulir thied jaka baroh ar tylli , ka dulir thied jaka ba la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khnang ba kin neh ha ki snem ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel; Shim ia kine ki sakhi, kane ka sakhi jong ka jingthied, baroh ar kaba la khang, bad kane ka sakhi kaba plie; bad buh ia ki ha ka umphniang khyndew, ba kin iai bteng bun sngi .

en: For , lo , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah , saith the  Lord  : and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers , and they shall possess it .
kha: namar ka por ka wan haba ngan pynneh pat ïa ki briew jong nga , ki Israel bad Judah . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kin shim kynti biang ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki briew jong nga bad u Judah, ong U Trai: bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban leit phai noh sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , ye , and your fathers , your kings , and your princes , and the people of the land , did not the  Lord  remember them , and came it not into his mind ?
kha: Na ka bynta ki jingkñia kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ki syiem jong phi bad ki nongïalam jong phi , bad ki briew jong ka ri ki ai ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem — hato phi pyrkhat ba U  Trai  um tip shaphang jong ki lane ba u la klet ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiwbih kaba phi la thang ha ki shnong Judah bad ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad ki syiem jong phi bad ki nongsynshar jong phi , hato U Trai um shym la kynmaw ia ki bad kam shym la wan ha ka jingmut jong u ?

en: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh : for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity ; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness .
kha: (Nga pyndonkam ka ktien kaba ïakren man ka sngi namar ka jingtlot jong ka jingim tynrai jong phi .) Mynshuwa phi la pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman na ka bynta ki jingthmu bymman . Ha kajuh ka rukom mynta phi dei ban pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw jong ka hok na ka bynta ki jingthmu bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kren katkum ka rukom jong ki briew namar ka jingbym lah jong ka doh jong phi: namar kumba phi la aiti ia ki dkhot jong phi ha ka jingbymkhuid bad ha ka jingbymhok; wat la katta ruh mynta to aiti ia ki dkhot jong phi ha ka jinglong hok .

en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi , who receive the office of the priesthood , have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law , that is , of their brethren , though they come out of the loins of Abraham :
kha: Bad ïa kito kiba hiarpateng na u Lebi kiba long ki lyngdoh la ai ïa ki da ka Hukum ba kin lum kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na ki paid Israel , kata ka long , na la ki briew , wat haba ki briew jong ki ruh ki hiarpateng na u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shisha kita kiba long na ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi, kiba ioh ia ka kam lyngdoh, ki don ka hukum ban shim ia ka shiphew na ki briew kat kum ka hukum , kata na ki hynmen jong ki, wat la ki mih na ki tyrpeng u Abraham:

en: And saith unto him , If thou be the Son of God , cast thyself down : for it is written , He shall give his angels charge concerning thee : and in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
kha: bad u la ong ha U ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , pynnoh ïa lade sha tbian ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :   ‘ U Blei un ai hukum ïa la ki angel shaphang jong me ; kin bat ïa me hajrong da ki kti jong ki , khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me ruh kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u: Lada me long U Khun U Blei, to bret noh ia lade: namar la thoh: Un ai ia ki angel jong u: bad ha ki kti jong ki kin rah ia me shaneng: ioh ha kano kano ka por ba me pynkhih ia ka kjat jong me ha u maw .

en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough , and followed Abimelech , and put them to the hold , and set the hold on fire upon them  ; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .
kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u pom mar kawei ka tnat dieng , nangta ki la bud ïa u Abimelekh bad ki kynton shajrong ïa ki dieng pyrshah ïa ka kut baskhem . Ki wiang ding ïa ka , lem bad ïa ki briew hapoh jong ka , bad baroh ki briew jong kata ka kut ki la ïap — kumba shihajar ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh kumjuh ki la ot ia u tnat jong u, bad ki la bud ia ki ha ka jaka ri jingri, bad ki la thang ia ka ding ha ki ; haduh ba ki shynrang baroh jong ka tower Shechem ruh ki la iap, kumba shi hajar ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei .

en: And said unto me , What seest thou ? And I said , I have looked , and behold a candlestick all of gold , with a bowl upon the top of it , and his seven lamps thereon , and seven pipes to the seven lamps , which are upon the top thereof :
kha: Kaei me ïohi ?  U la kylli .  U diengpynïeng sharak ba la shna da ka ksiar ,  nga la jubab . Ha ka kliar ka don ka pliang na ka bynta ka umphniang .  Halor u diengpynïeng sharak don hynñiew tylli ki sharak , kawei kawei bad ki jaka na ka bynta ki hynñiew tylli ki ksai sharak .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, Kaei kaba me iohi ? Bad nga la ong, bad nga la iohi ia ka sharak baroh kawei, bad ka khiew halor jong ka, bad ki hynriew tylli ki sharak jong u ha ka tduh jong ka:

en: But there were false prophets also among the people , even as there shall be false teachers among you , who privily shall bring in damnable heresies , even denying the Lord that bought them , and bring upon themselves swift destruction .
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa balamler ki la ju mih ha ki por ba la leit noh hapdeng ki briew , bad ha kajuh ka rukom , ki nonghikai balamler kin mih hapdeng jong phi . Kin wallam ïa ki jinghikai bapynjot bad bymshisha ïa ki jinghikai shongtynrai bad kin len ïa U Kynrad uba la siewspah ïa ki , bad kumta kin wallam ha lade ïa ka jingpynjot kaba kynsan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki don ki nongiathuhlypa lamler ruh hapdeng ki briew, kumba kin don ki nonghikai lamler hapdeng jong phi, kiba shimet kin wanrah ia ki jingkren bein kiba lah ban shah pynrem, wat ban kyntait ia U Trai uba la thied ia ki, bad ban wanrah ia ka jingpynjot kaba stet ia lade .

en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh  ; and they shall be drunken with their own blood , as with sweet wine : and all flesh shall know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa kiba banbeiñ ïa pha ban ïa-pynïap para ma ki ; kin shu buaid ha kaba pynïap briew bad ha ka jingbitar . Nangta u bynriew baroh un tip ba nga long U  Trai  , uta uba pynim ïa pha bad uba pyllaitluid ïa pha . Kin tip ba nga long U Blei bakhlaiñbor jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai bam ia ki kiba pynshitom bein ia me da ka doh jong ki hi bad kin sa dih ia ka snam jong ki hi kumba da ka wain kaba thiang: bad ka doh baroh kan tip ba nga U Trai nga long U Nongpynim jong me bad U Nongsiewspah jong me, U Bakhraw jong u Jakob .

en: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged  ; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin  ; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder , the groves and images shall not stand up .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki pop jong ki Israel yn map tang haba ïa ki maw jong ki duwan ki blei thala la pynlwet jin kum u shok , bad ba ym don shuh ki duwan thang iwbih lane ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kiba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane ka jingbymhok jong u Jakob kan long kaba khuid bad kane ka long baroh ki soh ban weng noh ia ka pop jong u ; haba u pynlong ia ki maw jong ka almari baroh kiba la shah shoh ha ka sniehdoh , ki khlaw bad ki dur kin ym ieng .

en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bare unto Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth  ; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul , whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite :
kha: Pynban , u la shim ïa u Armoni bad ïa u Mephibosheth , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Rispah , ka khun u Aïah , ba ka la ïoh na u Saul ; u shim ruh ïa ki san ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Merab , ka khun jong u Saul , ba ka la ïoh na u Adriel u khun jong u Barsillai uba na Meholah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem u la shim ia ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Aiah, kiba ka la kha ha u Saul, u Armoni bad u Mephishet ; bad ki san ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Saul, kiba ka la pynsan pynrangbah na ka bynta u Adriel u khun shynrang jong u Barzillai u Melashet:

en: But he that knew not , and did commit things worthy of stripes , shall be beaten with few stripes . For unto whomsoever much is given , of him shall be much required : and to whom men have committed much , of him they will ask the more .
kha: Hynrei u shakri u bymtip aïu u kynrad jong u , u kwah ; bad pynban , u leh ïa kaei re kaei ïa kaba u dei hok ban ïoh ka jingsympat , un shah pynshitom da ka jingsympat kaba sting . Shibun la dawa na u briew ha uba la ai kham bun ; kham bun shuh shuh la dawa na u briew ha uba la ai kham bun shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta u bym tip, bad uba la leh ia kiei kiei kiba dei ban shah shoh, un shah shoh tang khyndiat eh . Namar ha uno uno uba la ai shibun, na u yn sa pan shibun: bad ha uba ki briew ki la leh shibun, na u kin sa pan kham bun .

en: Therefore , thou son of man , prepare thee stuff for removing , and remove by day in their sight  ; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight : it may be they will consider , though they be a rebellious house .
kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , to teh ïa ka song kumba u nongphetwir u leh bad mihnoh ha shuwa ban wan ka miet . Ai ba uwei uwei baroh un ïohi ba me mihnoh bad leit sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah kin ïohi ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko khun u briew, to pynkhreh ia me ban weng noh, bad weng noh ha ka sngi ha khmat jong ki ; bad me dei ban weng noh na ka jaka jong me sha kawei pat ka jaka ha khmat jong ki: ka lah ban long ba kin pyrkhat, wat la ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah .

en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about , and in the man s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth : so he measured the breadth of the building , one reed  ; and the height , one reed .
kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi ka long ka Templ , bad la don ka kynroh sawdong jong ka . U briew u la shim ïa u diengthew jong u , uba jrong lai mitar bad u la thew ïa kata ka kynroh . Ka long lai mitar ka kynjang , bad lai mitar ka jingrben .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha khmih ka jingkhang shabar jong ka iing sawdong, bad ha ka kti jong u briew ka long kaba jrong hynriew phut bad ka kti ka la jrong: kumta u la thew ia ka jingjylliew jong ka jingtei, uwei u la thoh; bad ka jingjrong .

en: And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .
kha: Kam shym pat biang ïa u ban leh pop kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u leit kham jngai shuh shuh bad u shongkurim ïa ka Jesebel , ka khun jong u Ethbaal u syiem ka Sidon , bad u la mane ïa u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia kumba ka la long kaba jem ia u ban iaid ha ki pop jong u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat , ba u la shim ia ka tnga jong u Jezebel ka khun jong u Ehlbaal u syiem u Sidonian bad u la leit shakri ia u Baal bad u la mane ia u .

en: My lord the king , these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet , whom they have cast into the dungeon  ; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is : for there is no more bread in the city .
kha: Ko Syiem , kaei kaba kine ki briew ki la leh ka long ka bym dei . Ki la thep ïa u Jeremaïah ha ka pung , ha kaba , da shisha , un sa ïap ha ka jingïapthngan , namar ym don jingbam shuh ha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong nga u syiem , kine ki briew ki la leh sniew ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa , ia uba ki la bret ha ka thliew ; bad u long kumba u iap thngan ha ka jaka ba u don: namar ym don kpu shuh ha ka nongbah .

en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people , that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree  ; let it be done with speed .
kha: To U Blei uba la jied ïa ka Jerusalem kum ka jaka ba yn mane ïa u , un pynjot noh ïa uno uno u syiem lane ka hima kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka hukum bad uba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka Templ hangta . Ma nga , u Darius , nga la ai ïa kane ka hukum . Dei ban kohnguh lut ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei uba la pynlong ia ka kyrteng jong u ban shong hangta u pynjot ia ki syiem bad ki briew baroh, kiba la buh ha ka kti jong ki ban pynkylla bad ban pynjot ia kane ka iing U Blei kaba don ha Jerusalem . Nga Darius nga la leh ia ka hukum; to ai ba kan long kaba stet .

en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament , that by means of death , for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament , they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance .
kha: Namar kane ka daw , U Khrist u long uta uba buh ryntih ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , khnang ba kito ïa kiba la khot da U Blei ki lah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkyrkhu bymjukut kiba U Blei u la kular . Ïa kane lah ban leh namar ka don ka jingïap kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew na ki jingbakla kaba ki la leh katba ka jutang kaba nyngkong ka dang treikam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta kane ka daw u long u nongpyniasuk ia ka jutang kaba thymmai, ba da ka jingiap , na ka bynta ka jingpynim ia ki jingpynkhein kiba la don hapoh ka jutang kaba nyngkong , kito kiba la khot ki lah ban ioh ia ka jingkular jong ka pateng bymjukut .

en: And I did so as I was commanded : I brought forth my stuff by day , as stuff for captivity , and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand  ; I brought it forth in the twilight , and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight .
kha: Nga la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leh . Ha kata ka sngi nga la teh ïa ka song kumba u nongphetwir u leh bad ha kata ka premmiet katba ka dang khreh dum nga la tih ka thliew ha ka kynroh da ki kti jong nga bad nga la mih shabar . Katba uwei uwei baroh u dang khmih , nga la tawah ïa ka song halor ka tyrpeng jong nga bad nga la mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la leh kumta kumba la bthah ia nga: Nga la wanrah ia ki tiar jong nga ha ka por mynstep, kum ki tiar na ka bynta ka jingshah set phatok, bad ha ka por mynstep nga la leit shabar da ka kti jong nga; nga la wanrah ia ka ha ka por mynstep, bad nga la rah ia ka ha ka tyrpeng jong nga ha ka por mynstep jong ki.

en: Therefore now thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls , to cut off from you man and woman , child and suckling , out of Judah , to leave you none to remain  ;
kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , mynta nga kylli ba balei phi leh kum kata ka kam kaba sniew ïa lade . Hato phi kwah ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha ki rangbah bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , khnang ba yn ym don na ki briew jong phi ban dang sah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta u ong kumta u Trai , U Blei jong ki paidbah , U Blei jong ki Israel; Namar kata phi leh ia kane ka jingsniew kaba khraw pyrshah ia ki mynsiem jong phi, ban ot noh na phi u shynrang bad kynthei, khun bad u khun bad u khun, na Judah, ban iehnoh ia phi ban sah;

en: Even the prophet Jeremiah said , Amen : the  Lord  do so : the  Lord  perform thy words which thou hast prophesied , to bring again the vessels of the  Lord s  house , and all that is carried away captive , from Babylon into this place .
kha: Kaba phylla ! Nga kyrmen U  Trai  un leh ïa kane ! Nga da kyrmen shisha un pynlong ïa ka jingïathuhlypa jong phi ban urlong shisha bad un wallam pat na Babilonia ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ka Templ bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba la shah ïalam noh kum ki koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat u nongiathuhlypa Jeremaiah ruh u la ong: Amen: U Trai u leh kumta: u Trai u leh ia ki ktien jong me kiba me la iathuhlypa, ban wanrah biang ia ki tiar jong ka iing U Trai, bad ia baroh kaba la rah noh na Babilon sha kane ka jaka .

en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house , being a leper  ; for he was cut off from the house of the  Lord  : and Jotham his son was over the king s house , judging the people of the land .
kha: Ha ka jingim ba dang sah jong u syiem Ussaïah , u la long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ka jingpang jong u . Namar ba um lah shuh ban rung sha ka Templ u shong u sah ha la ka ïing , khlem da leh shuh ïa la ki kamram , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u synshar ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Usiah u syiem u la long u nongpang niangthohlieh haduh ka sngi ba u la iap, bad u la shong ha kawei ka iing, u la long u nongpang niangthohlieh ; namar u la shah ot noh na ka iing U Trai: bad u Jotham u khun jong u u la long halor ka iing syiem .

en: And it came to pass , as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god , that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword  ; and they escaped into the land of Armenia : and Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u dang mane ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong u , u Nisrokh ; ar ngut na ki khun shynrang jong u , u Adrammelekh bad u Shareser , ki la pynïap ïa u da ki waitlam bad nangta ki la phet ban lait im sha ka ri Ararat . Uwei pat na ki khun shynrang jong u , u Esarhaddon u la long u patsha hadien jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u dang mane ha iing u blei jong u, ba u Adrammech bad u Sharezer ki khun jong u ki la shoh ia u da ka waitlam ; bad ki la lait sha ka ri Armenia : bad u Esarmaddon u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Likewise when the  Lord  sent you from Kadesh–barnea , saying , Go up and possess the land which I have given you  ; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God , and ye believed him not , nor hearkened to his voice .
kha: Bad haba u hukum ïa phi na Kadesh Barnea ban leit kam kynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la ai ha phi , phi ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa u ; phim shym shaniah bad kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh haba U Trai u la phah ia phi na Kadeshbarnea, da kaba ong: To leit shaneng bad to long trai ia ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi ; te phi la leh pyrshah ia ka hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad phim shym la ngeit ia u, lymne sngap ia ka sur jong u .

en: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and the Arabians , and the Ammonites , and the Ashdodites , heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up , and that the breaches began to be stopped , then they were very wroth ,
kha: U Sanballat , u Tobiah bad ki briew ka Arabia , ka Ammon bad ka Ashdod ki la ïohsngew ba ngi ïaid shaphrang ha kaba tei pat ïa ka kynroh Jerusalem , bad ba ïa ki thliew jong ka kynroh la set , bad ki la ïabitar haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia ba haba u Sanballat bad u Tobiah bad ki nong Ammon bad ki nong Ashdod ki la iohsngew ba la pynlong ia ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem bad ba ki jingtwa ki la sdang ban sangeh noh , nangta ki la bitar shibun .

en: And when there arose a great dissension , the chief captain , fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them , commanded the soldiers to go down , and to take him by force from among them , and to bring him into the castle .
kha: Ka jingïakajia ka la shit haduh katta katta ba u rangbah ai hukum u la sheptieng ïoh ba kin tar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Paul . Kumta u hukum ïa ki shipai jong u ban leit sha ka kynhun , ban shim noh ïa u Paul na ki , bad ïalam ïa u shapoh ka kut shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la mih ka jingïapher kaba khraw, u rangbah shipai, u la tieng ba u Paul un shah tan ha ki bynta jong ki, u la hukum ïa ki shipai ban hiar shapoh bad ban shim da ka bor na ki , bad ban wanrah ïa u shapoh ka ïing syiem .

en: I have trodden the winepress alone  ; and of the people there was none with me : for I will tread them in mine anger , and trample them in my fury  ; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments , and I will stain all my raiment .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Nga la ïuh ïa ki jaitbynriew kum ki sohwaiñ , bad ym don uwei ruh u ba la wan ban ïarap ïa nga . Nga la ïuh ïa ki ha ka jingbitar , bad ka snam jong ki ka la bit lut ha ki jaiñphong jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iaid ia ka jaka dih wain marwei bad na ki briew ym don bad nga: namar ngan iaid ia ki ha ka jingbitar jong nga, bad ngan iaid lyngba ia ki ha ka jingbitar jong nga; bad ka snam jong ki kan sa tuid ha ki jain jong nga baroh .

en: Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .
kha: Ïa ka ïingsyiem la pynitynnat da ki pyrda bajngum bad balieh , ba la teh da ki tyllai linen sawjngum bani ha ki syrwiang rupa bad pyndait ha ki rishot maw marbl . Ïa ki jaka shong shaniah ha ka ïingsyiem , la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , bad ïa ka madan la siang da u maw marbl balieh , maw marbl basaw , u mawkordor baphyrnai , bad u mawkordor bajngum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ki long kiba lieh, kiba saw bad kiba rong saw, kiba la pyndait da ki nar kiba rit bad kiba lieh bad kiba lieh ha ki rong rupa: ki jingthiah ki long ki ksiar bad rupa, halor ka lynti kaba saw, bad rong saw, bad rong saw, bad rong saw .

en: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court , which was at the side of the north gate  ; and their prospect was toward the south : one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north .
kha: Te u la wallam ïa nga sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . La don ar tylli ki kamra ha ka phyllaw bashapoh , kawei kaba phai shaphang shathie harud ka khyrdop bashatei bad kawei kaba phai shatei harud ka khyrdop bashathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad khlem ka khyrdop ba shapoh ki don ki kamra jong ki nongrwai ha ka phyllaw ba shapoh , kaba don ha ka liang ka khyrdop ; bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka long shaphang shathie: kawei ha ka liang mihngi ka don ka jingkyrmen shaphang shathie .

en: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts  ; even one thing befalleth them : as the one dieth , so dieth the other  ; yea , they have all one breath  ; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast : for all is vanity .
kha: Nalor baroh , kajuh ka kupar ka ap ïa ki briew bad ïa ki mrad kumjuh . Uwei u ïap kum uwei pat . Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw . U briew um long uba kham bha ban ïa ka mrad , namar ka jingim kam don jingmut ïa ki baroh ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kata kaba jia ia ki khun shynrang ki shah pyniap: kumba uwei u iap: kumta uwei pat u iap: kumta u iap: kumta baroh ki don kawei ka jingpynhiar mynsiem; kumta u briew um don shuh ka jinglong halor u mrad: namar baroh ki long kiba sniew .

en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of your words , when ye spake unto me  ; and the  Lord  said unto me , I have heard the voice of the words of this people , which they have spoken unto thee : they have well said all that they have spoken .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u ong ha nga , ‘ Nga la ïohsngew kine ki briew ki ong aïu ; ki la kren ïa kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki ktien jong phi haba phi la kren ha nga; bad U Trai u la ong ha nga: Nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong kine ki briew kiba ki la kren ha me: ki la kren bha ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la kren .

en: And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it : he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he , and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .
kha: Hynrei u kpa jong u , u kyrngah , bad u ong ,  Nga tip , khun ; nga tip . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Manasseh ruh kin sa kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Hynrei u para jong u un kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin kylla long ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong u u la kyntait bad u la ong, nga tip ia kata, ko khun jong nga, nga tip ia kata: ma u ruh un long u briew, bad ma u ruh un long uba khraw: hynrei shisha u hynmen barit jong u un kham khraw ban ia u, bad u symbai jong u un long u jaitbynriew kiba bun .

en: And the kingdom and dominion , and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven , shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High , whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and all dominions shall serve and obey him .
kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhraw jong baroh ki hima ha ka pyrthei yn ai ha ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka bor ba kynja syiem jong ki kan ym kut shuh bad ki nongsynshar baroh ha ka pyrthei kin shakri bad kohnguh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka hima bad ka jingsynshar, bad ka jingkhraw jong ka hima hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei, yn ai ha ki briew jong ki riewkhuid jong Uba ha khlieh duh tam, uba ka hima jong u ka long ka hima bymjukut, bad ki jingsynshar baroh kin shakri bad kohnguh ia u .

en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw , even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city : and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar  ; and I fell upon my face .
kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw ka la long kum kaba nga la ïohi mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kum kaba nga la ïohi harud ka wah Khebar . Nangta nga la dem pyllup ïa lade ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kat kum ka dur jong ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la iohi, wat kat kum ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la iohi haba nga wan ban pynjot ia ka nongbah: bad ki jingphohsniew ki long kum ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la iohi da ka wah Chebar ; bad nga la hap ha ka khmat jong nga .

en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night  ; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat , the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up .
kha: Hynrei ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh . Ha kata ka Sngi , ki bneng kin jah noh lem bad ka jingsawa kaba jam , ki metbneng kin ing duh bad yn pynjot , bad ka pyrthei lem bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka kin jah rngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka sngi U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh ha ka por miet ; ha kaba ki bneng kin jah noh da ka jingsawa kaba jur , bad ki bniat kin sa rkhiang da ka jingshit kaba jur , ka khyndew ruh bad ki kam kiba don ha ka kin shah thang .

en: Son of man , prophesy against the shepherds of Israel , prophesy , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto the shepherds  ; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves ! should not the shepherds feed the flocks ?
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ki nongsynshar ka Israel . Ïathuhlypa ha ki , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ki : Phi long ki bym don jingkyrmen shuh , a phi ki nongsharai ka Israel ! Phi sumar bha tang ïa lade , hynrei phim ju bsa bha ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u briew , u iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ki nongaplangbrot jong ki Israel , u iathuhlypa bad u ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei u ong ha ki nongaplangbrot ; Ka long ha ki nongaplangbrot jong ki Israel kiba ai bam ia lade ! hato ki nongaplangbrot kim dei ban ai bam ia ki langbrot ?

en: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the  Lord  shall send against thee , in hunger , and in thirst , and in nakedness , and in want of all things : and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck , until he have destroyed thee .
kha: Kumta keiñ , phin hap ban shakri ïa ki nongshun ba U  Trai  un phah pyrshah ïa phi . Phin thngan , phin sliang , bad phin lyngkhuit — phin da kyrduh shisha khait . U  Trai  un pynshitom jur ïa phi haduh ba phin da jot thiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to shakri ia ki nongshun jong me kiba U Trai un phah pyrshah ia me, ha ka jingkyrduh bad ha ka jingthngan bad ha ka jingkyrduh bad ha ka jingduna jong kiei kiei baroh: bad un buh ia ka lyngkhot nar ha ka ryndang jong me, haduh ba un da pynjot ia me .

en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .
kha: Baroh ki dieng kin tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga khet ïa ki dieng bajrong bad nga pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ban san jrong . Nga pynïap stai ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad pynlong ïa ki dieng ba-tyrkhong ban kylla jyrngam . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki dieng baroh jong ka lyngkha kin tip ba nga U Trai nga la pynhiar ia u dieng uba jrong, nga la pynkiew ia u dieng uba rit , nga la pynkhriat ia u dieng uba jyrngam ban phuh: Nga U Trai nga la kren bad nga la leh ia kata .

en: Son of man , when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously , then will I stretch out mine hand upon it , and will break the staff of the bread thereof , and will send famine upon it , and will cut off man and beast from it :
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  lada ka ri ka leh pop bad kam ïaineh ha nga , ngan kner ïa ka kti jong nga bad pynduh ïa ka jingpyndap jingbam jong ka . Ngan phah ïa ka  nemsniew bad pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , haba ka ri ka leh pop pyrshah ia nga da kaba pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor jong ka , te ngan pynkhih ia u diengduh jong u kpu jong ka , bad ngan phah ia ka jingkyrduh halor jong ka , bad ngan ot noh ia u briew bad u mrad na ka:

en: If men strive , and hurt a woman with child , so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow : he shall be surely punished , according as the woman s husband will lay upon him  ; and he shall pay as the judges determine .
kha: Lada ki rangbah kiba ïashoh ki pynmynsaw ïa ka kynthei kaba punkhun , bad kata ka briew ka hap khun , hynrei kam shym mong shym mynsaw da kumwei pat , uta uba pynmynsaw ïa ka un shah shaiñ kuna kat kumba u tnga jong kata ka briew u dawa , bad u dei ban siew kumba la buh dor ki nongbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki shynrang ki ialeh pyrshah ia ka kynthei kaba don khun, khnang ba u soh jong ka un mih noh na ka, bad wat la katta ruh: un shah pynshitom shisha , kumba u tnga jong ka kynthei un thiah halor jong u; bad un siew katba ki nongbishar ki la rai .

en: And the men arose , and went away : and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land , saying , Go and walk through the land , and describe it , and come again to me , that I may here cast lots for you before the  Lord  in Shiloh .
kha: Ki rangbah ki la leit ban jurip ïa ka ri hadien ba u Joshua u la ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah :  Khie ïaid ïa ka ri baroh kawei bad jurip ïa ka , bad wan phai pat sha nga . Nangta , hangne ha Shiloh ngan ïakren bad U  Trai  na ka bynta jong phi da kaba kynting sbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ieng bad ki la leit noh: bad u Joshua u la kynnoh ia ki kiba la leit ban batai ia ka ri, u da ong: To leit iaid lyngba ka ri, bad batai ia ka, bad to wan biang sha nga, ba ngan thep vote na ka bynta jong phi ha khmat U Trai ha Shiloh .

en: And it came to pass in those days , that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . And Achish said unto David , Know thou assuredly , that thou shalt go out with me to battle , thou and thy men .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ïa la u paidïapom ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel bad U Akhish u ong ha u Dabid ,  Da shisha phi tip ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi ki dei ban ïaleh ha ka liang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kita ki sngi, ba ki Philistia ki la lum lang ia ki shipai jong ki, ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel . U Akhis u la ong ha u Dabid , To tip shisha ba me leit shabar bad nga ban ialeh thma, ma me bad ki briew jong me .

en: For it was of the  Lord  to harden their hearts , that they should come against Israel in battle , that he might destroy them utterly , and that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki ban kut jingmut ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel , ba kumta kin shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot thiaw bad ba baroh kin shah pynïap khlem ka jingisynei . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la long na U Trai ban pynkhlain ia ki dohnud jong ki, ba kin wan pyrshah ia ki Israel ha ka thma, ba un pynjot lut ia ki, bad ba kin ym don jingsngewbha shuh, hynrei ba un pynjot ia ki kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there , and the owls shall dwell therein : and it shall be no more inhabited for ever  ; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation .
kha: Bad kumta ka Babilon kan long kaba shongksuid bad ba don ki mynsiem bymman , bad ki sim bymkhuid . Ki briew kin ym shong shuh hangta lano lano ruh , lymne ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki mrad khlaw jong ka ri khlaw bad ki mrad khlaw kin shong hangta , bad ki blang kin shong hangta: bad kan ym shong shuh shuh shuh shuh ha ka por; bad kan ym shong ha ka pateng haduh ka pateng .

en: And I beheld , and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven , saying with a loud voice , Woe , woe , woe , to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels , which are yet to sound !
kha: Nangta nga la khmih , nga la ïohsngew ïa u pukni uba her shajrong eh jong ka suiñ ba u pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Kaba kordit ! Kaba kordit ! Katno kaba kordit kan long ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei haba ka jingsawa ka mih na ki turoi ïa kaba kita kiwei pat ki lai ngut ki angel kin put .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi bad nga la iohsngew ia u angel uba her lyngba pdeng ka bneng, u da ong da ka sur kaba jam: Hooid, ko khun ki kti ha kiwei pat ki sur jong ka turoi jong ki lai tylli ki angel kiba dang sawa !

en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks  ; for they also are turned back , and are fled away together : they did not stand , because the day of their calamity was come upon them , and the time of their visitation .
kha: Wat ki shipai ba shu wai jong ka ki long khlem bor kum ki khun masi . Kim shym ïeng ban ïaleh ; baroh na ki , ki phai bad phet noh . Ka sngi jong ka jingshahjop ka la poi , ka por jong ka jingpynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki briew ba la thung jong ka ki don hapdeng jong ka kum ki masi ba la tyrkhong ; namar ki ruh ki kylla shadien , bad ki phet noh lang: kim shym la ieng , namar ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar jong ki ka la wan ha ki , bad ka por jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki .

en: Now it came to pass , after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites , that he brought the gods of the children of Seir , and set them up to be his gods , and bowed down himself before them , and burned incense unto them .
kha: Haba u Amasaïah u la wan phai na ka jingjop ïa ki Edom , u wanrah ïa ki bleithaw jong ki lem bad u , u pynïeng ïa ki , u la mane ïa ki , bad u thang jingiwbih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia hadien ba u Amasaiah u la wan na ka jingpyniap ia ki nong Edome, ba u la wanrah ia ki blei jong ki khun u Seir bad u la buh ia ki ban long ki blei jong u, bad u la dem khrup ha khmat jong ki bad u la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki .

en: And , behold , as Barak pursued Sisera , Jael came out to meet him , and said unto him , Come , and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest . And when he came into her tent , behold , Sisera lay dead , and the nail was in his temples .
kha: Haba u Barak u wan wad ïa u Sisera , ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u , bad ka ong ha u ,  Ale hangne ! Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba phi wad .  Kumta u la leit shapoh bad ka , bad hangta ha madan don u Sisera , uba la ïap , bad u snar pynskhem dara lyngba ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, katba u Barak u dang bud ia u Sisera, u Jael u la mih ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la ong ha u, To wan, bad ngan pyni ia me ia uta u briew uba me wad. Bad haba u la wan shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong ka, ha khmih, u Sisera u la thiah iap, bad u nail u la don ha ki tempi jong u .

en: The Chaldeans answered before the king , and said , There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king s matter : therefore there is no king , lord , nor ruler , that asked such things at any magician , or astrologer , or Chaldean .
kha: Ki nongai jingmut ki la jubab ,  Ym don mano mano ha sla pyrthei kiba lah ban ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban tip . Ym don u syiem , ym don wat uba khraw tam bad uba donbor tam , uba la pynlong kum kane ka jingdawa na ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor bad ki nongleh byrtong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Khaldes ki la jubab ha khmat u syiem bad ki la ong: Ym don briew ha ka khyndew uba lah ban pyni ia ka kam syiem: namarkata ym don syiem, kynrad ne nongsynshar , uba la kylli ia kum kine kiei kiei ha uno uno u nongleh jadu ne u nongleh jadu ne u nongleh jadu .

en: And when he came to the den , he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel : and the king spake and said to Daniel , O Daniel , servant of the living God , is thy God , whom thou servest continually , able to deliver thee from the lions ?
kha: Haba u la poi hangta , u la khot jam da ka jingkhmih lynti ,  Ko Daniel , u shakri jong U Blei uba im ! Hato U Blei uba me shakri hok katta katta u la lah mo ban pyllait im ïa me na ki sing ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la poi ha ka thliew , u la pyrta da ka sur kaba sngewsih ia u Daniel: bad u syiem u la kren bad u la ong ha u Daniel , ko Daniel , ko Daniel , ko Daniel , ko Daniel jong U Blei uba im , hato U Blei jong me uba me shakri beit u lah ban pyllait im ia me na ki sing ?

en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it  ; it shall not be put out : and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning , and lay the burnt offering in order upon it  ; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings .
kha: Ïa ka ding halor ka duwan dei ban ïai pynmeh bad ym dei ban shah ba kan lip noh . Man la ka step u lyngdoh un buh diengïap ha ka , un pynbeit ïa ka jingainguh thang halor jong ka , bad un thang ruh ïa ka khleiñ jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ding halor ka almari kan thang ha ka ; ym dei ban pynmih: bad u lyngdoh un thang dieng ha ka man ka step , bad un buh ia ka jingainguh thang khnang ba un thang ia ka ; bad un thang ia ka shini jong ki jingainguh jingsuk .

en: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen , and said , Go in between the wheels , even under the cherub , and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims , and scatter them over the city . And he went in in my sight .
kha: U Blei u la ong ha u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ,  To leit hapdeng ki shalyntem hapoh ki kherub bad pyndap ïa ki kti jong phi da ki rnga ding barhem . Nangta bret ïa ki rnga halor ka nongbah .  Nga la peit ïa u ba u leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren ha uta u briew uba la phong da ka jain lin, bad u la ong, To leit shapoh ki tyrpeng, wat hapoh u cherub, bad pyndap ia ka kti jong me da ki dewiong ding na pdeng ki cherub, bad pynphriang ia ki halor ka nongbah . Bad u la leit shapoh ka jingpeit jong nga .

en: Thus saith God the  Lord  , he that created the heavens , and stretched them out  ; he that spread forth the earth , and that which cometh out of it  ; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it , and spirit to them that walk therein :
kha: U Blei u thaw ïa ki bneng bad u pynpyiar ïa ki ; u pynwandur ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ; u ai jingim bad u pyrsad mynsiem ïa la ki briew baroh . Bad mynta U  Trai  U Blei u ong ha la u shakri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Blei U Trai , uta uba la thaw ia ki bneng , bad u la pynjrong ia ki shuh shuh uba pynphriang ia ka khyndew , bad kata kaba mih na ka shuh shuh uba ai mynsiem ia ki briew ha ka shuh shuh:

en: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria , which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the  Lord  to anger , Josiah took away , and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth–el .
kha: Ha man ka nongbah jong ka Israel , u syiem Josaïah u la pyntwa ïa baroh ki jaka mane thala kiba la tei da ki syiem Israel , kiba la pynkhih bitar ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa baroh kito ki duwan kumba u la leh ha Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki iing baroh ruh jong ki jaka ba jrong kiba don ha ki shnong Samaria , kiba ki syiem Israel ki la pynlong ia U Trai ban bitar , u Josiah u la shim noh ia ki kat kum ki kam baroh kiba u la leh ha Betel .

en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold , and said , It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you : but seeing ye put it from you , and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life , lo , we turn to the Gentiles .
kha: Hynrei u Paul bad u Barnabas ki la nang kham kren shlur :  Ka long kaba donkam ba ïa ka ktien jong U Blei dei ban kren nyngkong ha phi . Hynrei namar ba phi kyntait ïa ka bad ba phim ñiew ïa lade kiba bit ïa ka jingim bymjukut , ngin iehnoh ïa phi bad leit sha ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul bad u Barnabas ki la iaid shakhmat bad ki la ong, Ka la long kaba donkam ba ka ktien U Blei kan long kaba la kren nyngkong eh ha phi: hynrei haba phi iohi ia ka na phi , bad bishar ia lade ba phim lah ban ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut , ha khmih ngi phai sha ki Jutang .

en: And when there had been much disputing , Peter rose up , and said unto them , Men and brethren , ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us , that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel , and believe .
kha: Hadien ka jingïatainia kaba slem u Petros u la ïeng bad u la ong ,  Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , phi tip ba la kham slem mynshuwa U Blei u la jied ïa nga napdeng jong phi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki Jentil , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohsngew bad ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la don ka jingiakren kaba jur, u Petros u la ieng bad u la ong ha ki, ko para bangeit, phi tip kumno ba shipor mynshuwa U Blei u la jied hapdeng jong ngi, ba ki Jutang da ka shyntur jong nga kin iohsngew ia ka ktien jong ka gospel bad kin ngeit .

en: And Solomon awoke  ; and , behold , it was a dream . And he came to Jerusalem , and stood before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and offered up burnt offerings , and offered peace offerings , and made a feast to all his servants .
kha: U Solomon u la kyndit thiah bad u sngewthuh ba dei U Blei uba la kren ïa u ha ka jingphohsniew . Nangta u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la ïeng ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ka jong U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U  Trai . Hadien kata u la ai ka jingkhawai ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la kyndit bad, ha khmih, ka la long ka jingphohsniew . U la wan sha Jerusalem bad u la ieng ha khmat ka synduk ka jutang U Trai , bad u la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad u la ainguh ia ki jingknia jingsuk ia ki shakri jong u baroh .

en: And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .
kha: Haba uta u rangbah u ïathuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong kaba harud khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad sngaid bad kata ka jinghap ka la pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong u , bad u la ïap . U la long u nongïalam ha Israel sawphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la kdew ia ka synduk U Blei, ba u la hap na ka jaka shong shadien ha ka liang jong ka khyrdop, bad ka ryndang jong u ka la tyrkhong: namar u la tymmen bad u la khia . Bad u la bishar ia ki Israel sawphew snem .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ha ki thma jong ki ban pynïoh bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein jong ki khun Ammon , bad na ka bynta saw ngut , ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar ki la knieh ia ki kynthei kiba don khun Gilead , ba kin pynheh ia u pud jong ki:

en: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire : and them that had gotten the victory over the beast , and over his image , and over his mark , and over the number of his name , stand on the sea of glass , having the harps of God .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw kaba la khleh lang bad ka ding . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa kito kiba la jop ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad ïa uta uba ka kyrteng jong u la mihkhmat da u dak jingkheiñ . Ki la ïeng hajan ka ïit bakhraw , ki da bat ïa ki duitara kiba U Blei u la ai ha ki
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi kumba ka long ka duriaw rnong kaba la khleh lang bad ka ding: bad kita kiba la ioh ia ka jingjop halor u mrad bad halor ka dur jong u bad halor ka dak jong u bad halor ka jingbun jong ka kyrteng jong u, ki ieng ha ka duriaw rnong jong U Blei .

en: O my God , incline thine ear , and hear  ; open thine eyes , and behold our desolations , and the city which is called by thy name : for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses , but for thy great mercies .
kha: To shahshkor ïa ngi , A Blei ; to khmih sha ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjynjar kaba ngi don bad ïa ka jingshah shitom jong ka nongbah kaba kit ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Ngi duwai ha me namar ba me long uba dap da ka jingisynei , ym namar ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Blei jong nga, to pynkhih ia ka shkor jong me, bad to iohsngew ia ki khmat jong me, bad ha khmih ia ki jingpynjot jong ngi, bad ka nongbah kaba la khot da ka kyrteng jong me: namar ngim pyni ia ki jingkyrpad jong ngi ha khmat jong me na ka bynta ki hok jong ngi, hynrei na ka bynta ki jingisynei kiba khraw jong me .

en: And ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God , ye , and your sons , and your daughters , and your menservants , and your maidservants , and the Levite that is within your gates  ; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you .
kha: Shadkmen ha khmat jong u hangta , lem bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi ; to kynmaw ba ki Lebi kim don bri don khyndew la ka jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ia kmen ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi, ma phi, bad ki khun shynrang jong phi, bad ki mraw jong phi, bad ki mraw jong phi, bad u Lebi uba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong phi;

en: And he brought Aaron s sons , and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear , and upon the thumbs of their right hands , and upon the great toes of their right feet : and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
kha: Nangta u wanlam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shkor kamon jong ki , ha ki  tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ki  jatkmie ba sha kamon jong ki . Nangta u Moses u theh ïa ka snam kaba sah ha baroh sawdong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron, bad u Moses u la buh ia ka snam ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong ki, bad ha ki kti kadiang jong ki, bad ha ki tyrpeng kiba heh jong ki kjat kadiang jong ki: bad u Moses u la theh ia ka snam ha ka almari sawdong .

en: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches , and make a prey of thy merchandise : and they shall break down thy walls , and destroy thy pleasant houses : and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water .
kha: Ki nongshun jong pha kin shim ha lade ïa ka spah bad ki mar khaïi jong pha . Kin pynpra ïa ki kynroh jong pha bad kin pynkhynñiuh ïa ki ïing baremdor jong pha . Kin shim ïa ki maw bad ïa ki dieng bad ïa baroh kaba sah , bad kin pynngam ïa ki ha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynlong ia ka jinglute jong me, bad kin pynlong ia ki jingbam jong me: bad kin pynpra ia ki kynroh jong me: bad kin buh ia ki maw bad ki dieng jong me bad ka dewbilat jong me hapdeng ka um .

en: And let them judge the people at all seasons : and it shall be , that every great matter they shall bring unto thee , but every small matter they shall judge : so shall it be easier for thyself , and they shall bear the burden with thee .
kha: Ai kin shakri kum ki nongbishar ha ki por baroh . Ki lah ban wallam sha phi ïa baroh ki kam kiba eh ; hynrei ki hi ki lah ban rai ïa ki jingïakajia kiba rit . Kata kan pynsuk shibun ïa phi , namar kin ïakit lang ïa ka jingkit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kin bishar ia ki briew ha ki aiom baroh: bad kan long, ba baroh ki kam kiba khraw kin wanrah ha me, hynrei baroh ki kam kiba rit kin bishar: kumta kan kham suk ia me hi, bad kin kit ia ka jingkit bad me .

en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .
kha: Ha kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakajia para ma ki .  U syiem Dabid u la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ,  ki ïa-ong uwei ïa uwei pat .  U la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia ; hynrei mynta pat u la phet krad na u Absalom bad u la iehnoh ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la ialeh pyrshah ha ki jait Israel baroh kawei, ki da ong: U syiem u la pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti ki nongshun jong ngi , bad u la pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti jong ki Philistia ; bad mynta u la phet noh na ka ri na ka bynta u Absalom .

en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  for his sin which he hath sinned , a female from the flock , a lamb or a kid of the goats , for a sin offering  ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin .
kha: bad kum ka bainong namar ka pop jong u , u dei ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kynthei kum ka jingainguh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong u ha U Trai na ka bynta ka pop jong u kaba u la leh pop, ka kynthei na ka kynhun langbrot ne u khun blang , namar ka jingknia pop; bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u .

en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree , but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day  ; ( for he that is hanged is accursed of God  ; ) that thy land be not defiled , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
kha: ym dei ban ieh ïa ka metïap hangta baroh shi miet . Tep ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi , namar ka metïap kaba sdien ha u dieng ka long ka jingtim U Blei , khnang ba phin ym pyntngit ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka met jong u kan ym sah baroh shi miet halor u dieng, hynrei men tep ia u ha kata ka sngi ; (namar uta uba la shah pynngop u la shah tim ha U Blei ; ) ba ka ri jong me kan ym shah pynjakhlia, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me U Blei jong me U Blei jong me U Blei jong me U Blei jong me U Blei jong me U Blei jong me U Blei jong me.

en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus : and Pilate gave him leave . He came therefore , and took the body of Jesus .
kha: Hadien kane , u Joseph , uba na ka shnong Arimathaïa , u la pan na u Pilat lada un shah ban rah ïa ka met U Jisu . ( U Joseph u la long u nongbud jong U Jisu , hynrei ym ha kaba paw , namar ba u la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . ) U Pilat u la ong ïa u ba u lah ban rah ïa ka met , kumta u Joseph u la leit bad rah noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kane u Joseph na Arimathaea, u long u synran U Jisu, hynrei da kaba rieh na ka bynta ka jingtieng ia ki Jiw, u la kyrpad ia u Pilat ba un shim noh ia ka met U Jisu: bad u Pilat u la ailad ia u . U la wan namarkata, bad u la shim ia ka met U Jisu .

en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company , saying , Even to morrow the  Lord  will shew who are his , and who is holy  ; and will cause him to come near unto him : even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha u Korah bad ki nongbud jong u ,  Lashai mynstep U  Trai  un pyn-i ha ngi ïa uta uba long u jong u ; un sa shah ïa uta uba long u jong u , kata , uta keiñ ïa uba u la jied , ban leit sha u ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha u Korah bad ha ka kynhun jong u baroh kawei, u da ong: Wat la ka sngi U Trai un pyni ia kiba long ki jong u, bad uba khuid beg bad un pynlong ia u ban wan hajan jong u: wat ia uta uba u la jied un pynlong ban wan hajan jong u .

en: Make bright the arrows  ; gather the shields : the  Lord  hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes : for his device is against Babylon , to destroy it  ; because it is the vengeance of the  Lord  , the vengeance of his temple .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhih ïa ki syiem jong ka Media , namar u thmu ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia . Dei da kumta un siew kylliang namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka Templ jong u . Ki rangbah ai hukum ban tur ïaleh , ki hukum ,  Pynnep ïa ki khnam jong phi ! Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid ia ki khnam ; lum ia ki jingda: U Trai u la pynmih ia ka mynsiem jong ki syiem Media: namar ka jingthmu jong u ka long pyrshah ia ka Babilon , ban pynjot ia ka ; namar ka long ka jingpynshitom bein jong U Trai .

en: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .
kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim dei ki blei — ki long tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong ki kim dei kita kiba don ka bor bapalat liam . Haba U  Trai  u trei , ka hima bakhlaiñbor kan khyllem , bad ka hima batlot bor kaba ka ïarap kan kyllon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki nong Ijipt ki long ki briew, ym U Blei; bad ki kulai jong ki, bad ym ka mynsiem jong ki. Haba U Trai un pynkhih ia la ka kti , baroh arngut uta uba iarap un hap , bad uta uba la shah rem un hap noh , bad baroh kin sa jah noh lang .

en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men , such as fear God , men of truth , hating covetousness  ; and place such over them , to be rulers of thousands , and rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens :
kha: Hynrei nalor kata , phi dei ban jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit , bad thung ïa ki kum ki nongïalam jong u paidbah : ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ïa ki spah , ïa ki sanphew , bad ïa ki phew . Ki dei ban long ki briew kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei , kiba lah ban shaniah , bad kiba ym lah ban pynbam sap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me dei ban pynbiang na ki briew kiba lah ban leh, kum ki briew kiba tieng ia U Blei, kiba shun ia ka jingkwah brai ; bad buh ia kiba kum kita halor jong ki, ban long ki nongsynshar da ki hajar ngut, bad ki nongsynshar da ki spah ngut, ki nongsynshar da ki phew ngut:

en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :
kha: Mynta , kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga ha ki jingmut jong ki , bad ngan thoh ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long u paidlang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka jutang kaba ngan leh bad ka iing Israel hadien kita ki sngi , ong U Trai ; ngan buh ia ki ain jong nga ha ka jingmut jong ki , bad ngan thoh ia ki ha ki dohnud jong ki: bad ngan long ha ki U Blei , bad kin long ha nga ki briew:

en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north , and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the  Lord   ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you : for I am merciful , saith the  Lord  , and I will not keep anger for ever .
kha: U la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ong ha ka Israel ,  Ko Israel bymïaineh , to wan pat sha nga . Nga long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad ngan ym bitar ; ngan ym bitar ïa pha shi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad pynbna ia kine ki ktien shaphang shathie, bad ong, To wan phai noh, me kaba pynkylla ia ki Israel, ong U Trai ; bad ngan ym pynlong ia ka jingbitar jong nga ban hap halor jong phi: namar nga long uba isynei , ong U Trai , bad ngan ym bat ia ka jingbitar junom .

en: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day , the loss of children , and widowhood : they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries , and for the great abundance of thine enchantments .
kha: Hynrei ha ka shikhyllipmat , tang ha kawei ka sngi , kine baroh ar tylli kiei kiei ki wan jia . Wat hapdeng ki kam myntor baroh ba pha pyndonkam , phan duh noh ïa la u tnga bad ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kine ar tylli kiei kiei kin wan ha me ha ka khyllipmat ha kawei ka sngi: kin wan ha me ha ka jinglong janai jong me na ka bynta ka jingbun ki jingleh jadu jong me .

en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah , and said unto him , Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria , and not relied on the  Lord  thy God , therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand .
kha: Ha kata ka por u Hanani lyngdoh u leit sha u syiem Asa bad ong ,  Namar ba me la shaniah ha u syiem Syria ban ïa kaba shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong me , ka kynhun shipai u syiem Israel ka la lait phet na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u Hanani u nongiohi u la wan sha u syiem Judah bad u la ong ha u: Namar ba me la shaniah ha u syiem Syria bad ngam shym la shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong me, namarkata ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem Syria ka la lait na ka kti jong me .

en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan : the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones  ; for they are come , and have devoured the land , and all that is in it  ; the city , and those that dwell therein .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la da don hapoh ka nongbah Dan ; ngi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa pynhiar mynsiem jong ki kulai jong ki . Ka ri baroh kawei ka khynñiuh haba ki kulai jong ki , ki pah . Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la wan ban pynjot ïa ka ri jong ngi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha ka , ka nongbah jong ngi bad baroh ki briew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: La iohsngew ia ka jingsma jong ki kulai jong u na Dan: ka ri baroh kawei ka la khih ha ka jingsawa jong ki nongshong shnong jong u namar ki la wan , bad ki la bam ia ka ri , bad baroh kaba don ha ka;

en: Then he said unto them , Go your way , eat the fat , and drink the sweet , and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared : for this day is holy unto our Lord : neither be ye sorry  ; for the joy of the  Lord  is your strength .
kha: Mynta leit noh sha la ïing bad bam bad dih sngewbha . Ïasam ïa ka jingbam bad ka waiñ bad kito ki bym dap bym biang . Mynta ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U  Trai  jong ngi , kumta wat sngewsih . Ka jingkmen kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi kan pynlong khlaiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki, To leit noh ia ka jingbam kaba thiang bad dih ia kaba thiang bad phah ia ki ha ki kiba ym shym la pynkhreh ei ei: namar kane ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U Trai jong ngi: lymne to sngewsih ia ka jingkmen U Trai ka long ka bor jong phi .

en: And thou , Ezra , after the wisdom of thy God , that is in thine hand , set magistrates and judges , which may judge all the people that are beyond the river , all such as know the laws of thy God  ; and teach ye them that know them not .
kha: Ma me , ko Esra , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei jong me u la ai ha me , men thung ki nongsynshar bad ki nongbishar ki ban synshar ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi kiba im da ka Hukum jong U Blei jong me . Me dei ban hikai ïa kato ka Hukum ha uno uno u bymtip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, ko Esra, hadien ka jingstad U Blei jong me, kaba don ha ka kti jong me, to buh ia ki nongbishar bad ki nongbishar, kiba lah ban bishar ia ki briew baroh kiba don sha shiliang wah, baroh kiba tip ia ki ain U Blei jong me; bad hikai ia ki ki ki bym tip ia ki .

en: Send therefore now , and gather thy cattle , and all that thou hast in the field  ; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field , and shall not be brought home , the hail shall come down upon them , and they shall die .
kha: Mynta ai hukum ban pynrieh ïa ki jingri jong me bad ïa kiwei kiwei pat baroh kiba me don ha lum . U phria un hap ha ki briew bad ki mrad kiba don habar khlem jingda , bad baroh kin ïap lut .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phah mynta , bad lum ia ki masi jong me bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba me don ha lyngkha namar ha uwei pa uwei u briew bad u mrad ba la shem ha lyngkha , bad ym dei ban wanrah sha iing , u hail un hiar ha ki bad kin iap .

en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and the right shoulder  ; for it is a ram of consecration :
kha: Ot noh ïa ka khleiñ jong uta u langbrot , ïa u tdong jong u , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki  nierlang , ïa ka sbiar kaba haneng u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka lbong kamon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh me dei ban shim na u langbrot ia ka shini bad ka tyrpeng, bad ka shini kaba tap ia ka sniehdoh, bad ka caul halor ka sniehdoh, bad ki ar tylli ki snier, bad ka shini kaba don halor jong ki, bad ka tyrpeng kaba sha kadiang; namar ka long ka ram kaba la pynkyntang:

en: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land , that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians : so we dwell at Jerusalem .
kha: Hynrei mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hiarthma ïa ka ri , ngi la rai ban wan sha Jerusalem ban lait na ki kynhun shipai ka Babilonia bad ka Syria . Dei na kane ka daw balei ba ngi ïashong ïasah ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia haba u Nebuchassar u la wan sha ka ri, ba ngi la ong: To wan, bad to ngin leit sha Jerusalem namar ka jingtieng ia ka kynhun shipai jong ki Khaldes bad namar ka jingtieng ia ka kynhun shipai jong ki Syria: kumta ngi shong ha Jerusalem .

en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice  ; and many shouted aloud for joy :
kha: Bun na ki lyngdoh ba la kham tymmen , ki Lebi , bad ki rangbah kur , ki la ïohi ïa ka Templ banyngkong , bad ki peit ïa ka nongrim jong kane ka Templ katba dang tei , ki ïam pangnud . Hynrei kiwei pat kiba don hangta ki pyrta da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bun na ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad ki rangbah jong ki kpa tymmen kiba la iohi ia ka iing kaba nyngkong , haba la buh ia ka nongrim jong kane ka iing ha khmat jong ki , ki iam da ka sur kaba jam; bad bun ki la pyrta jam:

en: And a clean person shall take hyssop , and dip it in the water , and sprinkle it upon the tent , and upon all the vessels , and upon the persons that were there , and upon him that touched a bone , or one slain , or one dead , or a grave :
kha: Ha ka bynta kaba nyngkong u briew uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un shim ïa u tnat Hissop , un wieh ïa u ha kata ka um , bad un synreit ha kata ka ïingjaiñ , ha ki jingbuh jingsat baroh , bad ha ki briew kiba don hangta . Ha ka bynta kaba ar , uta uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa kata ka um ha kita kiba la ktah ïa ka shyieng briew , lane ïa ka metïap , lane ïa ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u briew uba khuid un shim ia ka um, bad un theh ia ka ha ka um, bad ha ki tiar baroh bad ha ki briew kiba don hangta, bad ha uta uba ktah ia ka shyieng, ne uwei uba la shah pyniap, ne uwei uba la iap:

en: And they shall amerce him in an hundred shekels of silver , and give them unto the father of the damsel , because he hath brought up an evil name upon a virgin of Israel : and she shall be his wife  ; he may not put her away all his days .
kha: Kin daiñ kuna ïa u shispah tylli ki sbai rupa bad ai ïa kata ka kuna ha u kpa jong kata ka samla , namar uta u briew u la pynjahburom ïa ka theisotti Israel . Nalorkata , ma ka , kan ïailong ka tnga jong u , bad un ym lah ban pyllait ïa ka katba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynkhih ia u da ki shispah tylli ki takel rupa, bad kin ai ia ki ha u kpa jong ka damel: namar u la wanrah ia ka kyrteng kaba sniew ha ka khun masi jong u Israel: bad kan long ka tnga jong u; um lah ban pynduh noh ia ka ha ki sngi jong u baroh .

en: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the  Lord  , to repair the breaches of the house ,
kha: Ong ïa u ban ai ïa ka pisa ha ki rangbah kiba dei khmih ïa ka jingshna pynbha ïa k Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kin aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong ki nongtrei jong ka kam: bad to ai ba kin ai ia ka ha ki nongtrei jong ka kam kaba don ha ka iing U Trai , ban pynbha ia ki jingpynkhein ia ka iing .

en: And it shall come to pass , that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink  ; and instead of a girdle a rent  ; and instead of well set hair baldness  ; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth  ; and burning instead of beauty .
kha: Ha ka jaka ba kin sleh jingiwbih kin sma iwkhong ; ha ka jaka ki panpoh ba-itynnat kin teh da ki tyllai barew ; ha ka jaka ban don u shñiuh ba-itynnat kin long kiba lyndum ; ha ka jaka ki jaiñ ba-itynnat kin phong ki jaiñjot ; ka jingbhabriew jong ki kan kylla sha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia , ba ha ka jaka jong ka jingsma kaba thiang kan long kaba jem bad ha ka jaka jong ka rong stem bad ha ka jaka jong ka rong stem kaba la buh bha; bad ha ka jaka jong u nonglehkai ka long kaba jem bad kaba thang ha ka jaka jong ka jingitynnad .

en: And she shall put the raiment of her captivity from off her , and shall remain in thine house , and bewail her father and her mother a full month : and after that thou shalt go in unto her , and be her husband , and she shall be thy wife .
kha: bad pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Ka dei ban sah ha ïing jong phi , bad ïam sngewsih shi bnai ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie . Hadien kata , phi lah ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan weng noh ia ka jain jong ka na ka, bad kan sah ha ka iing jong me, bad kan iam ia u kpa jong ka bad ka kmie jong ka shibnai: bad hadien kata men leit sha ka, bad kan long ka tnga jong me .

en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you , and the stranger that shall come from a far land , shall say , when they see the plagues of that land , and the sicknesses which the  Lord  hath laid upon it  ;
kha: Ha ki pateng ki ban wan , ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ki nongwei na ki ri kiba jngai kin ïohi ïa ki jingpynjot bad ki jingshah shitom ba U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka pateng ban wan na ki khun jong phi ki ban kiew hadien jong phi, bad u nongwei uba wan na ka ri kaba jngai , un ong haba ki iohi ia ki khniang jong kata ka ri bad ki jingpang kiba U Trai u la buh halor jong ka;

en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper  ; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn . This is the heritage of the servants of the  Lord  , and their righteousness is of me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei yn ym don ka tiar thma ka ban lah ban pynmynsaw ïa pha ; phan don ka jubab ïa kito baroh kiba mudui ïa pha . Ngan kyrshan ïa ki shakri jong nga bad ngan ai jingjop ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka atiar kaba la thaw pyrshah ia me kan roi bad kawei pa kawei ka shyntur kaba kiew pyrshah ia me ha ka jingbishar men pynrem . Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki shakri U Trai , bad ka hok jong ki ka long jong nga , ong U Trai .

en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .
kha: To map ïa ka pop jong u syiem bad jong ki paid Israel . Hikai ïa ki ban leh ïa kaba dei . Nangta , A  Trai  to phah ïa u slap ha kane ka ri jong me , ïa kaba me la ai ha la ki jong ki briew kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngap ha bneng bad map ia ka pop jong ki shakri jong me bad ki briew jong me ki Israel, ba me hikai ia ki ia ka lynti kaba bha ha kaba ki dei ban iaid, bad ai slap ia ka ri jong me kaba me la ai ha ki briew jong me kum ka pateng .

en: I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .
kha: Ngan wad ïa kito kiba la jah , ngan wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ngan sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba la mong , bad ngan pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , hynrei ïa kito kiba sngaid bad kiba khlaiñ ngan sa pynjot , namar nga long u nongaplangbrot uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wad ia kata kaba la jah noh , bad ngan wanrah biang ia kata kaba la shah beh noh , bad ngan teh ia kata kaba la tyrkhong , bad ngan pynskhem ia kata kaba la pang: hynrei ngan pynjot ia ka shini bad kaba khlain; ngan ai bam ia ki da ka jingbishar .

en: ( And the children of Israel went up and wept before the  Lord  until even , and asked counsel of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? And the  Lord  said , Go up against him . )
kha: Te ki khun Israel ki leit kiew sha jaka mane Blei bad ki ïamkthang ha khmat U  Trai  haduh janmiet . Ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki para jait jong ngi ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ho-oid .  Kumta ki paidïapom ki Israel ki la ïoh mynsiem , bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep .
translated_en_to_kha: (Bad ki khun Israel ki la kiew bad ki iam ha khmat U Trai haduh ban da janmiet, bad ki la kylli jingmut na U Trai, ki da ong: Hato ngan leit thma biang ia ki khun u Benjamin jong nga ? Bad U Trai u la ong: To leit sha u . )

en: And he said , Hearken ye , all Judah , and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem , and thou king Jehoshaphat , Thus saith the  Lord  unto you , Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude  ; for the battle is not yours , but God s .
kha: U Jahasiel u ong ,  Ko syiem bad baroh ma phi u paid Judah bad Jerusalem , U  Trai  u ong ba phim dei ban rit mynsiem ne sheptieng ban ïeng pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai ba bun paid . Ka thma ka shong ha U Blei , ym ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To sngap ia phi baroh Judah, bad phi ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem, bad me u syiem Jehoshaphat , Kumta u ong U Trai ha phi: Wat tieng ne sngewsih namar kane ka kynhun kaba khraw ; namar ka thma kam dei ka jong phi, hynrei U Blei u long .
