en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .
kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong nga na ki lynti kiba kim pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkylla ïa ka jingdum jong ki sha ka jingshai bad pynlong ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki jingkular jong nga , bad ngan batskhem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan wanrah ia kiba matlah da ka rukom kaba kim tip ; ngan ialam ia ki ha ki lynti kiba kim tip: Ngan pynlong ia ka jingdum kaba jem ha khmat jong ki , bad ngan pynlong ia kiei kiei kiba la tyrkhong beit beit . Kine kiei kiei ngan leh ia ki , bad ngan ym iehnoh ia ki .

en: In journeyings often , in perils of waters , in perils of robbers , in perils by mine own countrymen , in perils by the heathen , in perils in the city , in perils in the wilderness , in perils in the sea , in perils among false brethren ;
kha: Ha ki jingleit jong nga kiba bun nga la don ha ka jingma na ki jingshlei um bad na ki nonglute , ha ka jingma na ki para Jiw bad na ki Jentil ; ki la don ki jingma ha ki nongbah , ki jingma ha ki ri khlaw , ki jingma ha ki duriaw-bah , bad ki jingma na ki paralok kiba shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jingleit jingwan bunsien, ha ki jingma jong ki um, ha ki jingma jong ki nongtuh, ha ki jingma jong ki nongshong shnong jong nga hi, ha ki jingma jong ki nongwei, ha ki jingma ha ka nongbah, ha ki jingma ha ka ri khlaw, ha ki jingma ha duriaw, ha ki jingma hapdeng ki para lamler ; .

en: And I will also give thee into their hand , and they shall throw down thine eminent place , and shall break down thy high places : they shall strip thee also of thy clothes , and shall take thy fair jewels , and leave thee naked and bare .
kha: Ngan buh ïa pha ha ka bor jong ki , bad kin pynkhyllem ïa ki jaka ha kiba pha ïaleh nuti bad mane bleithaw . Kin shim noh ïa ki jaiñ bad ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit khoit ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ruh ia me ha ka kti jong ki, bad kin pynhap ia ka jaka ba pawnam jong me, bad kin pynpra ia me ruh na ki jain jong me, bad kin shim ia ki mawkordor ba itynnad jong me, bad kin iehnoh ia me lyngkhuid bad lyngkhuid .

en: But the  Lord  is with me as a mighty terrible one : therefore my persecutors shall stumble , and they shall not prevail : they shall be greatly ashamed  ; for they shall not prosper : their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten .
kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long ha ka liang jong nga , uba khlaiñ bad bakhrawbor , bad kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga kin ym jop , kin shah pynlehrain junom , namar kim lah ban jop . Ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki yn ym klet noh da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u don bad nga kum uba shyrkhei uba khraw: namarkata ki nongpynshitom bein jong nga kin ym jop: kin sa sngewlehrain shibun; namar kin ym roi: ka jingkulmar bymjukut jong ki kan ym klet satia .

en: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him , saying , Take away the filthy garments from him . And unto him he said , Behold , I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee , and I will clothe thee with change of raiment .
kha: U angel u la ong ha la ki shakri ba kynja bneng ,  Shim noh ïa ki jaiñ bajakhlia kiba une u briew u phong .  Nangta u ong ha u Joshua ,  Nga la shim noh ïa ka pop jong me bad ngan ai ha me ki jaiñ bathymmai ban phong .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la kren ha kito kiba ieng ha khmat jong u, u da ong: Pynduh noh ia ki jain kiba jakhlia na u . Bad ha u u la ong: Ha khmih nga la pynlong ia ka jingbymhok jong me ban iaid noh na me bad ngan phong ia me da ka jainkup .

en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered unto the  Lord  , two and twenty thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the  Lord .
kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . Bad kumta u syiem bad ki paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la tyrwa ia ka jingknia jingsuk kaba arphew hajar tylli ki masi bad shispah arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot . Kumta u syiem bad ki khun Israel baroh ki la aiti ia ka iing U Trai .

en: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee , and to seek thy soul : but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the  Lord  thy God  ; and the souls of thine enemies , them shall he sling out , as out of the middle of a sling .
kha: Lada uno uno un ktah kti ïa phi bad pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ri sumar ïa phi , kumba uno uno u ap phira ïa ka jingkynshew kaba kordor . Katba ïa ki nongshun jong phi , un bret ïa ki sharud , kumba uno uno u kawang maw da ka jingshat maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u briew u la kiew ban bud ia me, bad ban wad ia ka mynsiem jong me: hynrei ka mynsiem jong u kynrad jong nga kan shah teh ha ka kynhun jong ka jingim bad U Trai U Blei jong me; bad ki mynsiem jong ki nongshun jong me, kin sa sdang noh ia ki, kumba na pdeng jong ka sniehdoh .

en: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday , before the men and the women , and those that could understand  ; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law .
kha: Hangta ha ka jaka basawdong hajan ka khyrdop u pule ïa ka Hukum ha ki naduh dang step phyrngab haduh shiteng sngi , bad baroh ki ïasngap bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pule hangta ha khmat ka lynti kaba don ha khmat ka khyrdop um naduh mynstep haduh shiteng sngi , ha khmat ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , bad kito kiba lah ban sngewthuh ; bad ki shkor jong ki briew baroh ki la pyrkhat ia ka kot jong ka hukum .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it , because they have hardened their necks , that they might not hear my words .
kha: ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , u la lah ong ,  Ngan wallam ha kane ka nongbah bad ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ba-marjan ïa ka jingpynshitom baroh kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh , namar phi long kiba mutlop bad phim shym shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih ngan wanrah ia kane ka shnong bad ha ki shnong jong ka baroh kiba nga la pynpaw pyrshah ia ka , namar ki la pynkhlain ia ki ryndang jong ki , ba kin ym iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga .

en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream , and the interpretation thereof , that he worshipped , and returned into the host of Israel , and said , Arise  ; for the  Lord  hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian .
kha: Haba u Gideon u ïohsngew shaphang ka jingphohsniew jong uta u briew bad ba ka mut kumno , u dem khohsiew khrup bad u mane ïa U  Trai . Nangta u leit phai pat sha ka jaka sher dara ki Israel , bad u ong ,  Khie joit ! U  Trai  u ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ka kynhun shipai jong ki Midian !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, haba u Gideon u la iohsngew ia ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingbatai jong ka, ba u la mane, bad u la leit phai noh sha ka kynhun Israel, bad u la ong: To khie; namar U Trai u la aiti ha ka kti jong phi ia ka kynhun jong ki nong Ijian .

en: And he said , All is well . My master hath sent me , saying , Behold , even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets : give them , I pray thee , a talent of silver , and two changes of garments .
kha: Em ,  u Gehasi u jubab .  Hynrei u kynrad jong nga u la phah ïa nga ba dang myntan ar ngut na ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka ri lum Ephraim ki la wan poi , bad u kwah ïa phi ban ai ha ki lai hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa bad ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Baroh ki long kiba bha . U kynrad jong nga u la phah ia nga, u la ong, Ha khmih, wat mynta ruh ki wan sha nga na u lum Ephraim arngut ki samla na ki khun ki kti ki nongiathuhlypa: to ai ia ki, nga kyrpad ia me, ka talent rupa bad ar tylli ki jain .

en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field , neither cut down any out of the forests  ; for they shall burn the weapons with fire : and they shall spoil those that spoiled them , and rob those that robbed them , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Kin ym hap shuh ban khar diengïap sha lum sha wah ne thoh dieng na khlaw , namar ki don ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh , ban thang ding . Kin kurup bad lute ïa kito kiba la kurup bad lute ïa ki ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba kin ym shim dieng na lyngkha, lymne ban ot ia ki khlaw namar kin thang ia ki tiar da ka ding: bad kin pynsniew ia kito kiba la pynsniew ia ki, bad kin lute ia kito kiba la lute ia ki, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Sing , O ye heavens  ; for the  Lord  hath done it : shout , ye lower parts of the earth : break forth into singing , ye mountains , O forest , and every tree therein : for the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and glorified himself in Israel .
kha: To risa da ka jingkmen , phi ki bneng ! To risa , ko ki jaka bajylliew jong ka pyrthei ! To risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki lumbah , bad man la u dieng jong ka khlaw ! U  Trai  u la pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba u pynim ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai, ko bneng na ka bynta U Trai u la leh ia kata: pyrta, phi ki bynta kiba kham poh jong ka khyndew: to rwai sha ka jingrwai: phi ki lum, ko khlaw, bad uwei pa uwei u dieng ha ka: namar U Trai u la siewspah ia u Jakob, bad u la pyndonburom ia lade ha Israel .

en: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth :
kha: Hynrei to ieh ïa ka dyngkhong jong u ha khyndew lem bad ka syrwiang nar bad rnong sawdong jong u . Iehnoh ïa u hangta ha pyntha bad u phlang .   ‘ Mynta ai ba ka umjer kan hap halor une u briew , bad shah ïa u ban im bad ki mrad bad ki jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh to iehnoh ia ka tynrai jong u ha ka khyndew, wat da ka kynhun nar bad ka nar, ha ki phlang kiba jem jong ka lyngkha ; bad ai ba kan sngem da ka dewbilat jong ka bneng , bad ai ba ka bynta jong u kan long bad ki mrad ha ki phlang jong ka khyndew:

en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Wat long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi . La slem bah ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kaba ïathuh ha ki ban ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim bapop . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi, ha kiba ki nongiathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa ki la pyrta, ki ong: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid Pynkylla mynta na ki lynti bymman jong phi, bad na ki kam bymman jong phi: hynrei kim shym la iohsngew ne sngap ia nga, ong U Trai .

en: And every daughter , that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel , shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father , that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers .
kha: Man ka kynthei kaba ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew ha kano kano ka jait Israel ka dei ban ïashongkurim bad u briew uba na kata ka jait . Ha kane ka rukom ki Israel baroh kin ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kpa tymmen jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pa kawei ka khun kynthei kaba don ka pateng ha kano kano ka jait Israel kan long ka tnga ha kawei ka longiing jong u kpa jong ka, ba ki khun Israel kin ioh ia ka pateng jong ki kpa jong u .

en: And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not ?
kha: Ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , ngi tip ba me kren ïa ka jingshisha , khlem da khuslai ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat . Mem ñiew ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynrei me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew . To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban siew ki khajna sha u Patsha ka Rom ? Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban siew ne ban ym siew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la wan , ki la ong ha u: Ko Nonghikai, ngi tip ba me long uba shisha, bad wat sumar ia uno uno u briew: namar me khlem pyrkhat ia ka dur jong ki briew, hynrei me hikai ia ka lynti U Blei ha ka jingshisha: Hato ka long kaba dei ban ai khajna ia u Kaisar ne em ?

en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised : it may be that the  Lord  will work for us : for there is no restraint to the  Lord  to save by many or by few .
kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u samla ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara jong kito ki Philistia ba mane blei thala . Lehse U  Trai  un ïarap ïa ngi ; lada u ïarap , ym don ei ei kaba lah ban khang ïa u ban ai ha ngi ka jingjop , kam pher la ngi don tang khyndiat ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la ong ha uta u samla uba phong ia ki tiar ialeh jong u, To wan, bad to ngin leit sha ka kynhun jong kine ki bym pat shah ot: ka lah ban long ba U Trai un trei na ka bynta jong ngi: namar ym don jingteh ia U Trai ban pynim da kiba bun ne tang khyndiat .

en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , that eateth any manner of blood  ; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood , and will cut him off from among his people .
kha: Lada uno uno u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , U  Trai  un phai pyrshah ïa u bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u briew uba don na ka iing Israel ne na ki nongwei kiba sah hapdeng jong phi, uba bam ia kano kano ka snam ; ngan buh wat ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia kata ka mynsiem kaba bam snam , bad ngan ot noh ia u na ki briew jong u .

en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof , and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush : let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph , and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren .
kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap kyrhai da kaba bha baroh , Ba la kyrkhu da ka jingbha U  Trai  , Uba kren na ka  lawlynnong kaba mehding . To kine ki jingkyrkhu kin wan ha ka jait u Joseph , Namar u la long u nongïalam ïa la ki hynmen bad para .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba kordor jong ka khyndew bad ka jingdap jong ka: to ai ba ka jingkyrkhu kan wan ha ka khlieh jong u Joseph bad ha ka tduh jong u ba la pyniakhlad na ki hynmen jong u .

en: And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .
kha: U Phestos u la ong ,  Ko syiem Agrippa bad baroh kiba don hangne bad ngi : Phi ïohi ïa une u briew ïa uba ki Jiw baroh , kiba hangne bad ha Jerusalem , ki la wallam ki jingujor sha nga . Ki pyrta ba um dei shuh ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Festo u la ong, ko Syiem Agrippa bad ki briew baroh kiba don hangne bad ngi, phi iohi ia une u briew, shaphang jong u, shaphang jong u, u la leh ia nga, ha Jerusalem bad hangne ruh, da kaba iam ba um dei ban im shuh .

en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will even do according to thine anger , and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them  ; and I will make myself known among them , when I have judged thee .
kha: Kumta te , da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan sa siew kylliang na ka bynta ka jingbitar jong me , ka jingbishni jong me bad ka jingisih jong me ïa ki briew jong nga . Kin sa tip ba nga pynshitom ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, kumba nga im, ong U Trai Blei, ngan leh wat kat kum ka jingbitar jong me, bad kat kum ka jingsngewsih jong me kaba me la pyndonkam na ka jingshun jong me ia ki ; bad ngan pynpaw ia lade hapdeng jong ki, haba nga la bishar ia me .

en: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
kha: U Jakob , u Petros , bad u Ïoannis , kiba i ba ki long ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam bakyrpang ; kumta ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u Barnabas lem bad ïa nga de , kum ka dak ba ngi ïalong baroh ki nongïatrei lang . Ngi la ïamynjur ba u Barnabas bad nga , ngin ïatrei hapdeng ki Jentil , bad ki pat hapdeng ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Jakob , u Kephas bad u Ioannis kiba la long kumba ki maw ki la sngewthuh ia ka jingaiei kaba la ai ha nga , ki la ai ha nga bad u Barnabas ia ki kti kiba dei jong ka jingiasyllok ; ba ngi dei ban leit sha ki nongwei bad ki sha ka jingkren bein .

en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help  ; and stay on horses , and trust in chariots , because they are many  ; and in horsemen , because they are very strong  ; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel , neither seek the  Lord  !
kha: Kito kiba leit sha Ijipt ban ïoh jingïarap kin jot ! Ki shaniah ha ka bor shipai bakhraw jong ka Ijipt — ki kulai , ki kali ïapom , bad ki shipai . Hynrei kim tip ban shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel , lane pan na u ïa ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: To ia kito kiba leit sha Ijipt ban ioh jingiarap ; bad ki shong ha ki kulai , namar ki long kiba bun ; bad ha ki kulai , namar ki long kiba khlain bha ; hynrei kim peit sha U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , lymne ki wad ia U Trai !

en: Behold , thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth  ; and from thy face shall I be hid  ; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth  ; and it shall come to pass , that every one that findeth me shall slay me .
kha: Me la beh noh ïa nga na ka khyndew bad na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong me . Ngan long u nongphetwir ha ka pyrthei , bad uno uno uba lap ïa nga un pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih me la beh noh ia nga mynta ka sngi na ka khyndew ; bad na ka khmat jong me ngan buhrieh ; bad ngan long u nongleh bymman bad u nongleh bymman ha ka khyndew ; bad kan sa jia ba uno uno uba shem ia nga un pyniap ia nga .

en: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast , which was diverse from all the others , exceeding dreadful , whose teeth were of iron , and his nails of brass  ; which devoured , brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with his feet  ;
kha: Nangta nga la kwah ban tip kham bun shaphang jong u mradkhlaw uba saw , u bym long kum kiwei pat — u mradkhlaw bakynsha uba khñiot pynlwet ïa kiba u la ïoh da ki tnaw rnong bad da ki bniat nar bad nangta u kyrdem halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan sa tip ia ka jingshisha jong u mrad uba saw, uba la long uba pher na kiwei pat baroh, uba shyrkhei palat, uba ki bniat jong u ki long ki nar, bad ki bniat nar jong u; kiba la bam, ki la tyrkhong ha ki bynta ba saw, bad ki la tyrkhong ia ka jingsahkut bad ki kjat jong u ; .

en: Thine , O  Lord  , is the greatness , and the power , and the glory , and the victory , and the majesty : for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine  ; thine is the kingdom , O  Lord  , and thou art exalted as head above all .
kha: Me long uba khraw bad uba donbor , uba donburom , uba itynnat bad uba iphieng . Kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ki dei ki jong me ; me dei u syiem , u nongsynshar bahakhlieh duh halor baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me, ko Trai, me long ka jingkhraw, bad ka burom, bad ka jingjop, bad ka jingkhraw: namar baroh kaba don ha bneng bad ha ka khyndew ka long ka jong me; me long ka hima, ko Trai, bad me la pynkhraw ia me kum ka khlieh halor jong baroh .

en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u ai katto katne ka jingbam bad ka pla snieh ba-dap um ha ka Hagar . U pynbah ïa u khun ha ka met jong ka bad u la phah noh ïa ka . Ka la mihnoh bad ka ïaid sakma ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Beersheba .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la khie dang step, bad u la shim ia u kpu bad ka bilor um, bad u la ai ia ka ha ka tyrpeng jong ka, bad u khun, bad u la phah noh ia ka: bad ka la leit noh ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Beersheba .

en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth  ; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth  ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hid from mine eyes .
kha: Te uno uno uba ha ka ri uba pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu , un pan ban ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei uba ïaineh . Uno uno uba shim smai un smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei uba ïaineh ; Ki jingjynjar kiba mynshuwa kin leit noh bad yn klet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba uta uba kyrkhu ia lade ha ka khyndew un kyrkhu ia lade ha U Blei ka jingshisha ; bad uta uba smai ha ka khyndew un smai da U Blei ka jingshisha ; namar ba ki jingeh kiba mynshuwa ki la klet noh , bad namar ba ki la buhrieh na ki khmat jong nga .

en: Yea , I will make many people amazed at thee , and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee , when I shall brandish my sword before them  ; and they shall tremble at every moment , every man for his own life , in the day of thy fall .
kha: Kaei ba ngan leh ïa me ka pynkyndit ïa shibun ki jaitbynriew . Haba nga talain ïa ka waitlam jong nga , ki syiem kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ha ka sngi ba me kyllon , baroh na ki kin khynñiuh ha ka jingsheptieng na ka bynta ki jingim jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ngan pynlong ia kiba bun ki briew kiba lyngngoh ia me , bad ki syiem jong ki kin tieng shibun ia me , haba ngan pynkhih ia ka waitlam jong nga ha khmat jong ki ; bad kin khih ha man la ka khyllipmat , uwei pa uwei na ka bynta la ka jong ka jingim , ha ka sngi ba u hap .

en: And Saul said unto him , Why have ye conspired against me , thou and the son of Jesse , in that thou hast given him bread , and a sword , and hast enquired of God for him , that he should rise against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u ,  Balei ma me bad u Dabid me ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha u katto katne ka jingbam bad ka waitlam , bad ba me kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u ? Mynta u la phai pyrshah ïa nga bad u da ap ïa ka kabu ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u, "Balei phi la thmu pyrshah ia nga, ma me bad u khun u Jesse, namar ba me la ai ia u kpu bad ka waitlam bad me la kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u, ba un ieng pyrshah ia nga, ban thiah ha ka jaka sah kum ha kane ka sngi ?

en: And Lot lifted up his eyes , and beheld all the plain of Jordan , that it was well watered every where , before the  Lord  destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah , even as the garden of the  Lord  , like the land of Egypt , as thou comest unto Zoar .
kha: U Lot u la khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ba ka them Jordan baroh kawei haduh Soar , ka don kyrhai ka um , kum ka Kper jong U  Trai  lane kum ka ri Ijipt . ( Kane ka long ha shuwa ba U  Trai  un pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Lot u la rah ia ki khmat jong u, bad u la iohi ia ka madan Jordan baroh kawei, ba ka la tuid um bha ha man la ki jaka, shuwa ba U Trai un pynjot ia ka Sood bad ka Gomorrah, wat kum ka kper U Trai, kum ka ri Ijipt, katba me wan sha u Soar .

en: Go and speak to Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring my words upon this city for evil , and not for good  ; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee .
kha: ban ïathuh ïa u Ebedmelekh u nong Sudan ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Kumba nga la ong ba ngan leh , ngan wallam ka jingjot ha kane ka nongbah bad ym ïa ka jingmanbha . Bad haba kane kan jia , men don hangta ban ïohi ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad kren ia u Ebedmeech u nong Ithiopia, da kaba ong , Kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ki ktien jong nga halor kane ka nongbah na ka bynta ka jingsniew, bad ym na ka bynta ka jingsniew ; bad kin sa pyndep ha kata ka sngi ha khmat jong me .

en: For the  Lord  of hosts , that planted thee , hath pronounced evil against thee , for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah , which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la thung ïa ka Israel bad ka Judah ; hynrei mynta nga byrngem ïa ki da ka jingpynjot . Ki la wallam ïa kane halor jong ki hi namar ba ki la leh bakla ; ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai jong ki paid uba la thung ia me, u la pynbna pyrshah ia me, namar ka jingsniew jong ka iing Israel bad ka iing Judah, kaba ki la leh pyrshah ia lade ban pynkhih ia nga ban bitar ha kaba ai jingiwbih ia u Baal .

en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak , and say , For mischief did he bring them out , to slay them in the mountains , and to consume them from the face of the earth ? Turn from thy fierce wrath , and repent of this evil against thy people .
kha: Balei ba ki nong Ijipt kin ïoh ong ba me la ïalam ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , da kaba me thmu ban pynïap ïa ki ha ki lum , bad ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki ? Sangeh ban bitar ; pynkylla noh ïa ka jingmut jong me , bad wat ai ba kane ka jingpynjot kan ngat ha ki briew jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki nong Ijipt ki dei ban kren bad ki ong: Namar ka jingbym don pop u la pynmih ia ki shabar , ban pyniap ia ki ha ki lum bad ban bam ia ki na ka khmat ka khyndew ? Pynkylla na ka jingbitar kaba jur jong me bad kylla bamut na kane ka jingsniew jong me .

en: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever , who created heaven , and the things that therein are , and the earth , and the things that therein are , and the sea , and the things which are therein , that there should be time no longer :
kha: bad u la smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei , uba im junom la junom , uba la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , bad ïa kata ka duriaw , bad baroh kiba don ha ki . Uta u angel u la ong ,  Yn ym don jingpynslem shuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sngap jar da uta uba im junom, uba la thaw ia ka bneng bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka, bad ka khyndew bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka, bad ka duriaw bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka, ba kan ym don por shuh:

en: And Elisha prayed , and said ,  Lord  , I pray thee , open his eyes , that he may see . And the  Lord  opened the eyes of the young man  ; and he saw : and , behold , the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha .
kha: Nangta u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong u bad ai un ïohi .  U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad u shakri jong u Elisha haba u peit shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa ka sharing lum ba la dap da ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom kiba da ka ding baroh sawdong jong u Elisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la duwai bad u la ong, ko Trai, nga kyrpad ia me, to plie ia ki khmat jong u, ba un iohi . U Trai u la plie ia ki khmat jong uta u samla ; bad u la iohi: bad, ha khmih, u lum u la dap da ki kulai bad ki kali thang ding sawdong u Elisha .

en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen , and although I have scattered them among the countries , yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come .
kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki para ba shah ringmraw ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Nga long uta uba la phah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri kiba jngai bad pynsakma ïa ki ha kiwei de ki ri . Pynban , ïa mynta shipor ngan don bad ki ha ki jaka sha kaba ki la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Wat la nga la bret noh ia ki sha jngai hapdeng ki nongwei , bad wat la nga la pynphriang ia ki hapdeng ki ri , hynrei ngan long ha ki kum ka jaka kyntang khyndiat ha ki ri ha kaba kin wan .

en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread : ( thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days , as I commanded thee , in the time appointed of the month Abib  ; for in it thou camest out from Egypt : and none shall appear before me empty : )
kha: Ha u bnai Abib , u bnai ha uba phi la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , rakhe ïa Ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ha ka rukom kaba nga la hukum ïa phi . Ha ki hynñiew sngi jong kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , wat bam ïa uno uno u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Wat ju wan mane ïa nga khlem da wallam kano kano ka jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban sumar ia ka jingkhawai jong u kpu bym don thied: (men dei ban bam ia u kpu khlem thied hynriew sngi, kumba nga la hukum ia me, ha ka por ba la buh jong u bnai Abib namar ha ka me wan mih na Ijipt: bad ym don ba paw ha khmat jong nga thylli: )

en: Beside the burnt offering of the month , and his meat offering , and the daily burnt offering , and his meat offering , and their drink offerings , according unto their manner , for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Wanrah ïa kine nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba ju leh ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai lem bad ka jingainguh bam jong ka , bad ïa ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka . Kine ki jingainguh bam ki long ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ka jingainguh thang jong u bnai, bad ka jingainguh bam jong u, bad ka jingainguh bam jong u man ka sngi, bad ki jingainguh bam jong u, bad ki jingainguh dih jong ki, kat kum ka rukom jong ki, na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang, ka jingknia kaba la shet da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all : yea , also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .
kha: Kawei ka kupar ka wan kumjuh ha baroh , bad kane ka long kaba bakla kum kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei . Katba ki briew ki dang im , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki dap da ka jingsniew bad ka jinglamwir , bad kynsan kynsan ki ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kaba sniew napdeng kiei kiei baroh kiba la leh hapoh ka sngi, ba ka don kawei ka jingjia ha baroh: Hooid ruh ka dohnud ki khun shynrang ka dap da ka jingsniew , bad ka jingsngewsih ka don ha ka dohnud jong ki katba ki dang im , bad hadien kata ki leit sha kiba iap .

en: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it : and it shall bring forth boughs , and bear fruit , and be a goodly cedar : and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing  ; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell .
kha: halor u lumbah bakynjang tam jong ka Israel . Un sei ki tnat bad pynmih ki symbai bad kylla long u dieng Kedar ba-itynnat eh . Ki sim kiba bun jait kin im hangta bad ïoh jingda ha ka syrngiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u lum jong ka jingjrong jong ki Israel ngan thung ia ka: bad kan pynmih ia ki tnat bad kan sei soh bad kan long u sohjew uba bha: bad hapoh jong ka kin shong ki sim baroh; ha ka jingdum jong ki tnat jong ka kin shong .

en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat , saying , Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah , the  Lord  hath broken thy works . And the ships were broken , that they were not able to go to Tarshish .
kha: Hynrei u Elieser u khun jong u Dodabahu , na ka shnong Mareshah , u la maham ïa u Jehoshaphat bad ong ,  Namar ba phi la ïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah , U  Trai  un sa pynjot ïa kaei kaba phi la tei .  Bad ki liengbah ki la shah pynjot bad kim shym la lah ban ïaid duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Elizer u khun u Dodava u la iathuhlypa pyrshah ia u Jehoshaphat, u da ong: Namar ba me la iasoh bad u Ahasaiah, U Trai u la pynpra ia ki kam jong me . Bad ki lieng ki la tyrkhong , ba kim lah ban leit sha Tarshish .

en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of their companions , unto Artaxerxes king of Persia  ; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue , and interpreted in the Syrian tongue .
kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u patsha ka Persia , u Bishlam , u Mithredath , u Tabeel bad ki paralok jong ki , ki thoh shithi sha u patsha . Ïa ka shithi la thoh ha ka ktien Aramaik bad ban pynkylla ktien ha ka por ba pule ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki sngi u Artaxerxes u la thoh ia u Bishlam, u Mithredath, u Tabeel bad kiwei pat ki paralok jong ki, ha u Artaxerxes u syiem Persia; bad ka jingthoh jong ka shithi la thoh ha ka shyntur Syria , bad la pynkylla ha ka shyntur Syria .

en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .
kha: Balei te ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ? Balei ba me la leh ïa kane ka kam bymman ? Me la pynlong ïa u Uriah ban shah pynïap ha ka thma ; me la shah ïa ki Ammon ban pynïap ïa u , bad nangta me shim ïa ka tnga jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata me la leh bein ia ka hukum U Trai, ban leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat jong u ? me la pyniap ia u Urih u Hitit da ka waitlam bad me la shim ia ka tnga jong u ban long ka tnga jong me, bad me la pyniap ia u da ka waitlam jong ki khun Ammon .

en: And as soon as the commandment came abroad , the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn , wine , and oil , and honey , and of all the increase of the field  ; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly .
kha: Tang mar ïa-ai hukum , ki paid Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingai jong ki , kiba kynsai tam na u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ka ngap , bad kiwei de ki jingmih na ka lyngkha , bad ki wanrah ruh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong kiei kiei kiba ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu wan ka hukum shabar ri , ki khun Israel ki la wanrah bun ki soh ba nyngkong jong u kew , ka wain bad ka umphniang bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh baroh .

en: That confirmeth the word of his servant , and performeth the counsel of his messengers  ; that saith to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be inhabited  ; and to the cities of Judah , Ye shall be built , and I will raise up the decayed places thereof :
kha: Hynrei haba u shakri jong nga u pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa , haba nga phah ïa u nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , Nga pynlong ïa kito ki jingthmu bad ki jingïathuh lypa ban jia shisha . Nga ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki briew kin shong biang hangta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn sa tei pat . Kito ki nongbah kin ïeng na ki jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka pynskhem ia ka ktien jong u shakri jong u, bad ka pyndep ia ka jingmut jong ki nonglam khubor jong u;

en: Of the nations concerning which the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall not go in to them , neither shall they come in unto you : for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods : Solomon clave unto these in love .
kha: U shongkurim ïa ki wat haba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki Israel ban ym ïashongkha khleh bad kine ki briew , namar kin pynlong ïa ki Israel ban mane ïa kiwei ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki jaitbynriew kiba U Trai u la ong ha ki khun Israel , Phim dei ban leit sha ki , lymne kin wan shapoh jong phi: namar shisha kin pynphai noh ia ka dohnud jong phi hadien ki blei jong ki: Solomon ha kine ha ka jingieit .

en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of his servants : and afterward it shall be inhabited , as in the days of old , saith the  Lord .
kha: bad ngan aiti ha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki , ha u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Hynrei shen hadien , ki briew kin shong kin sah biang ha Ijipt , kumba ki la leh ha ki por ba la leit . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong kito kiba wad ia ka jingim jong ki, bad ha ka kti jong u Neuchastrozzar u syiem Babilon: bad hadien kata kan sa shong kumba ha ki sngi hyndai , ong U Trai .

en: Ye have sown much , and bring in little  ; ye eat , but ye have not enough  ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink  ; ye clothe you , but there is none warm  ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .
kha: Phi la bet shibun u kew , hynrei phi la ot tang khyndiat . Phi don ka bam ban bam , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynkdang ïa phi . Phi don ka waiñ ban dih , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynbuaid ïa phi ! Phi don ki jaiñkup , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynsyaid ïa phi . Bad u nongtrei um lah ban kamai kat ban biang ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la bet bun, bad phi wanrah tang khyndiat eh, hynrei phim pat biang ia ka; hynrei phim pat dap da ka um; phim phong ia phi, hynrei ym don ka bainong kaba shit; bad uta uba kamai ka bainong u kamai ia ka bainong ban buh ia ka ha ka pla kaba don ki thliew .

en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .
kha: Man la ka jingtynjuh kaba phi la mad ka long kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blei u long uba bat ïa la ka kular , bad un ym shah ban tynjuh ïa phi sha palat ka bor jong phi ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba phi shah tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba phi lah ban shah ïa ka , bad kumta un thaw ïa ka lad ba phi lah ban lait na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka jingpynshoi kaba la shim ia phi hynrei kaba ju jia ha u briew: hynrei U Blei un ym shah ia phi ban shah pynshoi palat ia kaba phi lah ban leh ; hynrei da ka jingpynshoi ruh un pynlong ia ka lad ban lait im, ba phin lah ban shah ia ka .

en: And Samuel said unto Jesse , Are here all thy children ? And he said , There remaineth yet the youngest , and , behold , he keepeth the sheep . And Samuel said unto Jesse , Send and fetch him : for we will not sit down till he come hither .
kha: Nangta u kylli ïa u ,  Phi dang don shuh ki khun shynrang ?  U Jesse u jubab ,  Don sa tang uba khatduh , hynrei u dang leit sharai ïa ki langbrot .   Bthah ïa u ban wan shane ,  u Samuel u ong .  Ngin ym ai jingkñia katba um pat wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha u Jesse, Hato ki khun jong me baroh ki dang sah ? Bad u la ong, Ka dang sah ha kaba rit tam, bad, ha khmih, u ri ia ki langbrot . U Samuel u la ong ha u Jesse: To phah bad to leit ia u: namar ngin ym shong haduh ba un da wan shane .

en: And they set on for him by himself , and for them by themselves , and for the Egyptians , which did eat with him , by themselves : because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews  ; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians .
kha: Ïa u Joseph la ai ha kawei ka miej , bad ïa ki hynmen jong u ha kawei pat . Ki nong Ijipt kiba ïabam hangta ruh ki shong kyrpang , namar ki kheiñ poh ban ïashong bam ryngkat bad ki Hebru .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh na ka bynta jong u hi, bad na ka bynta jong ki hi, bad na ka bynta ki nong Ijipt kiba la bam bad u, da ki hi: namar ki nong Ijipt kim lah ban bam ia u kpu bad ki Hebru; namar kata ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki nong Ijipt .

en: And white robes were given unto every one of them  ; and it was said unto them , that they should rest yet for a little season , until their fellowservants also and their brethren , that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled .
kha: Ha uwei pa uwei na ki la ai ïa ka jaiñkup balieh , bad la ong ïa ki ba kin shongthait sa shipor , tad ynda la dep kheiñ lut ïa ki para shakri bad parabangeit kiba la shah pynïap , kumba la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La ai ia ki jain lieh ha uwei pa uwei na ki ; bad la ong ha ki, ba kin shongthait sa khyndiat por, haduh ba ki para mraw jong ki ruh bad ki hynmen jong ki ruh kin shah pyniap kumba ki long .

en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers  skins that is above upon it , and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
kha: Na ka jait u Kohath ki mih ki longïing jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dei ban kit ia ki jingtap jong ka iingjain bad ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , bad ka jingtap jong ki khniang kiba don halor jong ka , bad ka jingtap ia ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver  ; and thy raiment was of fine linen , and silk , and broidered work  ; thou didst eat fine flour , and honey , and oil : and thou wast exceeding beautiful , and thou didst prosper into a kingdom .
kha: Pha la don ki jingdeng kiba da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , bad borabor pha ju phong ki jaiñ linen bad rusom ba la suh syntiew . Pha la bam u kpu uba la shna na u  purew babha tam bad pha la don ka ngap bad ka umphniang Olib ban bam . Ka jingbhabriew jong pha ka long kaba phyrnai itynnat , bad pha la long ka syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta me la pynitynnad da ka ksiar bad ka rupa bad ka jainkup jong me ka long kaba bha, bad ka sniehdoh bad ka jingtrei kaba la tyrkhong me la bam ia ka shini kaba bha, bad ka umsoh bad ka umphniang ; bad me la roi palat ha ka hima .

en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom , nor your spouses when they commit adultery : for themselves are separated with whores , and they sacrifice with harlots : therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall .
kha: Wat la katta ruh ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kane , namar ma phi hi phi ïa-ïaid lang bad ki nuti kiba ha ka templ , bad ryngkat bad ki , phi ai ki jingkñia ba-thala . Kumba ka proberb ka ong , ‘ Ki briew kiba khlem pyrkhat kin sa jot noh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ym pynshitom ia ki khun kynthei jong phi haba ki leh ia ka kam sniew, ne ia ki lok jong phi haba ki leh ia ka kam sniew: namar ia lade la pyniakhlad bad ki nongkhaii met: namarkata ki briew ki bym sngewthuh kin hap .

en: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , saying , Speak unto the elders of Judah , saying , Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house ? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king , even to his house .
kha: Ka khubor shaphang kata kaba ki Israel ki la ïakren ka poi ha u Dabid . Kumta u la phah ïa u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ban kylli ïa ki nongïalam Judah ,  Balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïarap ban wallam biang ïa u syiem sha ka ïingsyiem jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Dabid u la phah sha u Sadok bad ha u Abiatar ia ki lyngdoh, u da ong: To kren ha ki rangbah Judah da kaba ong: Balei phi long uba khatduh ban wanrah biang ia u syiem sha la iing ? haba iohi ia ka ktien jong ki Israel baroh ka wan sha u syiem wat sha ka iing jong u .

en: And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground  ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
kha: Nangta u jop ïa ki Moab . U la phah thiah ïa ki koidi ha madan bad pynïap ar ngut na man ki lai ngut . Kumta ki Moab ki kylla long noh ki raïot jong u , bad ki siew khajna sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkhih ia u Moab , bad u la thew ia ki da u lain , da kaba pynhap ia ki shapoh khyndew wat da ki ar lain ba u la thew ia u ban pyniap , bad da kawei ka lain kaba pura ban im . Bad kumta ki nongshong shnong ki la kylla long ki shakri jong u Dabid, bad ki la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha .

en: If , when evil cometh upon us , as the sword , judgment , or pestilence , or famine , we stand before this house , and in thy presence , ( for thy name is in this house , ) and cry unto thee in our affliction , then thou wilt hear and help .
kha: ba lada kano kano ka jingjia bashyrkhei kan ktah ban pynshitom ïa ki — ka thma , ka jingïapthem , lane ka  nemsniew — te ki lah ban wan bad ïeng ha khmat kane ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa me . Ki lah ban duwai ha me ha ka jingshitom jong ki bad ba men sngew bad pyllait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada, haba ka jingsniew ka wan ha ngi, kum ka waitlam, ka jingbishar, ne ka jingpang khlam, ngi ieng ha khmat kane ka iing, bad ha khmat jong me, (namar ka kyrteng jong me ka don ha kane ka iing), bad to pyrta ia me ha ka jingjynjar jong ngi, te me sngap bad iarap .

en: And they said unto the messengers that came , Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , To morrow , by that time the sun be hot , ye shall have help . And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh  ; and they were glad .
kha: Ki ong ha kita ki nonglamktien na Jabesh ,  Ïathuh ha ki para shnong jong phi ba lashai , shuwa shiteng ka sngi , yn sa pyllait im ïa ki .  Haba ki nong Jabesh ki ïohpdiang ïa kata ka khubor , ki sngewkmen shibun ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha ki nonglam khubor kiba la wan, Kumta phin ong ha ki briew jong u Jabesh Gilead, Ha kata ka por ba ka sngi ka shit, phin ioh jingiarap . Ki nonglam khubor ki la wan bad ki la pyni ia ka ha ki briew jong u Jabesh ; bad ki la ia sngewbha .

en: And it shall come to pass in the increase , that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh , and four parts shall be your own , for seed of the field , and for your food , and for them of your households , and for food for your little ones .
kha: Ha ka por ot , phin ai shi bynta na ka san bynta ha u syiem , bad kaba sah saw bynta kan long ka jong phi , ba phin ïoh buh symbai , bad ba phin ïoh jingbam na ka bynta ïa lade bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha ka jingmih kaba san ha u Pharaoh, bad saw bynta kin long ki jong phi, na ka bynta u symbai jong ka lyngkha bad na ka bynta ka jingbam jong phi bad na ka bynta jong ki iing jong phi bad na ka bynta ka jingbam na ka bynta ki khun rit jong phi .

en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks  ; and let them choose one bullock for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under : and I will dress the other bullock , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under :
kha: Wallam ar tylli ki masi dab ; ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin shim uwei , pynïap ïa u , ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u bad buh halor ki diengthang — hynrei wat pynmeh ding . Nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh ïa uwei pat u masi dab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin ai ia ngi ar tylli ki masi ; bad ai ba kin jied ia uwei u masi na ka bynta jong ki, bad kin buh ia ka ha ki dieng , bad ngan ym thang ding hapoh: bad ngan phong ia uwei pat u masi: bad ngan buh ia u ha ki dieng:

en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills : they shall be on the head of Joseph , and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren .
kha: Ki jingkyrkhu da u kew bad ki syntiew ki jingkyrkhu kiba don ha ki lumbah na mynhyndai bad kiei kiei kiba sngewtynnat na ki lumrit baneh junom . To kine ki jingkyrkhu kin hiar halor ka khlieh u Joseph , Ha ka shyllangmat jong uta keiñ ïa uba la pynkyrpang na la ki hynmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkyrkhu jong u kpa jong me ki la jop palat ia ki jingkyrkhu jong nga haduh u pud u sam jong ki lum bymjukut: kin don ha ka khlieh jong u Joseph bad ha ka khlieh jong u uba la iakhlad na ki hynmen jong u .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That ye which have followed me , in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory , ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban thikna ba haba U Khun U Briew u shong ha ka khet badonburom jong u ha ka Ïa kaba thymmai , te ma phi ki khat-ar ngut ki nongbud jong nga phin ïashong ruh ha ki khet , ban synshar ïa ki khat-ar ki jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Hooid nga ong ha phi, Ba phi kiba la bud ia nga, ha ka jingpynthymmai haba u Khun u briew un shong ha ka khet ka burom jong u, phi ruh phin shong ha ki shiphew tylli ki khet, da kaba bishar ia ki shiphew tylli ki jait Israel .

en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king s chamberlain their friend , desired peace  ; because their country was nourished by the king s country .
kha: U Herod u bitar shikatdei eh ïa briew jong ka Tyros bad Sidon , kumta ki la leit shi kynhun ban ïakynduh ïa u . Nyngkong ki la pynngeit ïa u Blastos , u briew uba dei khmih ïa ka ïingsyiem , ba u dei ban ïarap ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit sha u Herod bad pan ban ïasuk bad u , namar ka ri ka jong ki ka ïoh ïa ki jingbam na ka ri ka jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Herod u la sngewsih shibun eh ia ki jong ka Tyros bad ka Sidon: hynrei ki la wan da kawei ka jingmut ha u, bad haba ki la pynlong ia u Blastos u paralok jong ki, ki la kwah ia ka jingsuk ; namar ba ka ri jong ki ka la pyndap da ka ri syiem .

en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against your pillows , wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly , and I will tear them from your arms , and will let the souls go , even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly .
kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Nga isih ïa ki jingteh kti kiba phi pyndonkam ha ka jingpyrshang jong phi ban synshar ïa ka jingim bad jingïap . Ngan sloit ïa ki na ki kti jong phi bad pyllaitluid ïa ki briew kiba phi bat synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Trai Blei; Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia ki tyrpeng jong phi, ha kaba phi leit beh ia ki mynsiem ban pynlong ia ki ban her , bad ngan pynpra ia ki na ki kti jong phi , bad ngan pyllait noh ia ki mynsiem ba phi leit beh ban pynlong ia ki ban her .

en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary , and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation , and for the altar , and he shall make an atonement for the priests , and for all the people of the congregation .
kha: bad un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , ïa ka duwan , ïa ki lyngdoh , bad ïa u paidbah baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka jaka kyntang bakhuid , bad un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka iingjain bad na ka bynta ka almari , bad un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh .

en: Then the mariners were afraid , and cried every man unto his god , and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea , to lighten it of them . But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship  ; and he lay , and was fast asleep .
kha: Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , uwei pa uwei sha la u jong u blei . Nangta , khnang ban pynduna ïa ka jingma , ki bret noh ïa ka jingkit nalor lieng . Ha kata ka por , u Jonah u la hiar sha ka bynta bashapoh , u thiah ha trai ka lieng , u ïohthiah lyngngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nongleit jingleit ki la tieng , bad uwei pa uwei u la pyrta ia u blei jong u , bad u la bret noh ia ki mar kiba don ha ka lieng sha duriaw , ban pynshai ia ka na ki . Hynrei u Jonah u la leit hiar sha ki liang jong ka lieng; bad u la thiah lyngngai .

en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , Behold , if the  Lord  would make windows in heaven , might this thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
kha: U nongbud ba-hajan jong u syiem u la ong ha u Elisha ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  U Elisha u jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei u kynrad uba u syiem u la shong ha ka kti jong u u la jubab ia uta u briew jong U Blei, bad u la ong: Ha khmih lada U Trai un thaw ia ki jingkhang ha bneng , hato kane ka lah ban long ? Bad u la ong: Ha khmih me la iohi ia ka da ki khmat jong me, hynrei wat bam ia ka .

en: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him : and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , therefore will I sacrifice to them , that they may help me . But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .
kha: U kñia ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki Syria , kiba la jop ïa u . U ong ,  Ki blei jong ki Syria ki la ïarap ïa ki syiem Syria , kumta lada nga ai jingkñia sha ki , ki lah ban ïarap ïa nga ruh .  Kane ka la wanrah jingpynjot ïa u bad ha ka hima jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la knia ia ki blei jong u Damaskos kiba la pynkhih ia u: bad u la ong: Namar ki blei jong ki syiem Syria ki iarap ia ki , namarkata ngan knia ha ki , ba kin iarap ia nga . Hynrei ki la long ka jingjot jong u bad jong ki Israel baroh .

en: And it came to pass , when he saw her , that he rent his clothes , and said , Alas , my daughter ! thou hast brought me very low , and thou art one of them that trouble me : for I have opened my mouth unto the  Lord  , and I cannot go back .
kha: Haba u ïohi ïa ka , u kad ïa la ki jaiñkup ha ka jingsngewsih bad u ong ,  Waw , ko khun ! Phi la pynpait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Balei ba yn dei da ma phi kaba pynpang ïa nga ? Nga la ai ïa ka jingkular bakyntang ha U  Trai  , bad ngam lah ban kylla pat ïa la ka kular !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u la iohi ia ka, ba u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u la ong, Ah khun jong nga ! me la pynrit ia nga shibun, bad me long uwei na kita kiba pynshitom ia nga: namar nga la plie ia ka shyntur jong nga ha U Trai bad ngam lah ban leit phai biang .

en: And he went out to meet Asa , and said unto him , Hear ye me , Asa , and all Judah and Benjamin  ; The  Lord  is with you , while ye be with him  ; and if ye seek him , he will be found of you  ; but if ye forsake him , he will forsake you .
kha: U la ong ,  Shahshkor ïa nga , ko syiem Asa , bad phi u paidbah baroh jong ka Judah bad Benjamin ! U  Trai  u long lem bad phi katba phi dang ïailong bad u . Lada phi ap khmih ïa u , un shah ba phin shem ïa u , hynrei lada phi phai na u , un iehnoh noh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih ban iakynduh ia u Asa, bad u la ong ha u, To sngap ia nga, ko Asa, bad u Judah baroh bad u Benjamin baroh u don ryngkat bad phi, katba phi dang don ryngkat bad u ; bad lada phi wad ia u ; un sa lap ia u ; hynrei lada phi iehnoh ia u ; hynrei lada phi iehnoh ia u, un iehnoh ia phi .

en: And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us : and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Ka ri lum kam biang ïa ngi ; hynrei ki Kanaan ha ki ri thor ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar , na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha Beth Shan bad ïa ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ka bad na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha ka Them Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Joseph ki la ong: Ka lum kam pat biang ia ngi: bad ki nong Kanaan baroh kiba shong ha ka ri jong ka them ki don ki kali nar, baroh arngut kiba na Bethshean bad ki shnong jong ka, bad kito kiba na ka them Jesel .

en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .
kha: Ka jutang bathymmai kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel kan long kane : Ngan buh ïa ka aiñ jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh ïa ka ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kane kan long ka jutang kaba ngan leh bad ka iing Israel ; Hadien kita ki sngi , ong U Trai , ngan buh ia ka hukum jong nga ha ki bynta ba shapoh jong ki , bad ngan thoh ia ka ha ki dohnud jong ki ; bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

en: And at that time came Joshua , and cut off the Anakims from the mountains , from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab , and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel : Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities .
kha: Ha kane ka por u Joshua u la leit bad u pynduh khoit ïa ka jait ka kynja ki ramhah ba la khot kyrteng ki Anakim kiba shong basah ha ka ri lum — ha Hebron , Debir , Anab , bad ha baroh ka ri lum jong ka Judah bad ka Israel . U Joshua u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u Joshua u la wan hiar thma ia ki Anaakim na ki lum, na Hebron, na Debir, na Anab, bad na ki lum baroh jong ka Judah bad na ki lum Israel baroh: u Joshua u la pynjot lut ia ki da ki shnong jong ki .

en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand , but shalt surely be taken , and delivered into his hand  ; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon , and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth , and thou shalt go to Babylon .
kha: Phin ym lait im ; yn kem ïa phi bad yn ai noh ïa phi sha u . Phin ïohi ïa u markhmat bad kren ïa u da lade hi ; te nangta phin leit sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban lait na ka kti jong u, hynrei thikna ba me dei ban shah shim ha ka kti jong u ; bad ki khmat jong me kin iohi ia ki khmat jong u syiem Babilon bad un kren bad me da ka shyntur sha ka shyntur .

en: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael the cities , which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war . Three times did Joash beat him , and recovered the cities of Israel .
kha: Nangta u Jehoash u syiem ka Israel u jop ïa u Benhadad lai sien bad knieh pat ïa ki nongbah ïa kiba la shim da u Benhadad ha ka por ka jingsynshar u Jehoahas , u kpa jong u Jehoash .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoash u khun u Jehoah u la shim biang na ka kti u Benhadad u khun u Hazael ia ki shnong kiba u la shim na ka kti u Jehoah u kpa jong u da ka thma . Lai sien u Joash u la shoh ia u bad u la koit ia ki shnong Israel .

en: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon : for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them : therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them .
kha: Namar ka bynta jong ka Judah ka kham heh ban ïa kaba ka donkam , shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka la ai ha ka jait Simeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong ki khun Judah ka long ka pateng jong ki khun Judah: namar ka bynta jong ki khun Judah ka la palat ia ki: namarkata ki khun Judah ki don ka pateng jong ki hapoh ka pateng jong ki .

en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took the blood , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger , and purified the altar , and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar , and sanctified it , to make reconciliation upon it .
kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , u shim khyndiat ka snam , bad u pyndei ïa ka da la ka shynriah ti ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , khnang ban pynkyntang ïa ka . Nangta u theh ïa ka snam kaba sah baroh ha trai ka duwan . Ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ka bad u pynkhuid ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ia ka ; bad u Moses u la shim ia ka snam, bad u la buh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka almari sawdong da ka kti jong u, bad u la pynkhuid ia ka almari, bad u la theh ia ka snam ha trai jong ka almari, bad u la pynkyntang ia ka, ban pynlong ia ka jingpyniasuk ia ka .

en: Behold now , I have two daughters which have not known man  ; let me , I pray you , bring them out unto you , and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing  ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .
kha: Khmih shane , nga don ar ngut ki khun kynthei kiba dang sotti . Shah ngan wallam ïa ki sha phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ki katba phi mon . Hynrei wat leh ei ei ïa kine ki rangbah ; ki dei kiba nga la khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong nga , bad nga dei ban ïada ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih mynta, nga don arngut ki khun kynthei ki bym ithuh briew; to ngan wanrah ia ki shabar sha phi, bad phi leh ia ki kumba phi sngewbha ha ki khmat jong phi: tang ha kine ki briew kim leh ei ei; namar namar kata ki la wan hapoh ka jingdum jong ka tnum jong nga .

en: But the fearful , and unbelieving , and the abominable , and murderers , and whoremongers , and sorcerers , and idolaters , and all liars , shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone : which is the second death .
kha: Hynrei ki khawpud , ki nongshetkylla , ki riewkhyllah , ki nongpynïap briew , kiba leh awria , kito kiba leh byrtong , kito kiba mane bleithaw , bad kiba lamler baroh — ka jaka na ka bynta jong ki ka long ka pung kaba klang da ka ding bad u kyndok , kaba long ka jingïap kaba ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiba tieng bad ki bym ngeit bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew bad kiba pyniap briew ki don ia ka bynta jong ki ha ka pung kaba thang da ka ding bad ka dewbilat: kaba long ka jingiap kaba ar .

en: And the  Lord  came down in a cloud , and spake unto him , and took of the spirit that was upon him , and gave it unto the seventy elders : and it came to pass , that , when the spirit rested upon them , they prophesied , and did not cease .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la kren ïa u . U la shim khyndiat ka bor mynsiem kaba u la ai ha u Moses bad u ai ïa ka ha kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam . Haba kata ka bor mynsiem ka la wan shong ha ki , ki sdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa , hynrei tang shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la wan hiar ha u lyoh, bad u la kren ha u, bad u la shim ia ka mynsiem kaba la don halor jong u, bad u la ai ia ka ha ki hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah: bad ka la jia ba haba u mynsiem u la shong ha ki, ki la iathuhlypa bad kim shym la sangeh .

en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings , Jehu appointed fourscore men without , and said , If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape , he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him .
kha: Nangta ma u bad u Jonadab ki la leit shapoh ban ai ki jingkñia bad jingainguh thang sha u Baal . U la pyn-ap phraphew ngut ki rangbah shabar ka templ bad u la ai jingbthah ïa ki :  Phi dei ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew baroh ; uno uno na phi uba shah ïa uwei na ki ban lait im , un siewdor ïa ka da la ka jong ka jingim !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leit rung ban ainguh bad thang ia ki jingknia , u Jehu u la thung saw ngut ki briew shabar , bad u la ong , Lada uno uno na ki briew kiba nga la wanrah ha ki kti jong phi u lait im , uta uba pyllait ia u un long na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .

en: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah , that dwelt in the cities of Judah , they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep , and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the  Lord  their God , and laid them by heaps .
kha: Ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ki nongbah jong ka Judah ki wanrah ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong ki masi bad ki langbrot , bad ki wanrah ruh shibun ki jingai , ïa kiba ki pynkyntang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shaphang ki khun Israel bad Judah kiba shong ha ki shnong Judah , ki la wanrah ruh ia ka shiphew jong ki masi bad ki langbrot bad ka shiphew jong kiei kiei kiba kyntang ha U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines  ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat  ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :
kha: Wat la ki dieng Dumbur kim don soh bad ym don sohwaiñ ba mih ha ki dieng sohwaiñ , wat la u dieng Olib um sei ei ei bad ki lyngkha kim pynmih kew , wat la ki langbrot baroh ki ïap bad ki sem masi ki thylli ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u dieng sohjew un ym phuh, ym don soh ha ki sohjew; ka jingtrei shitom jong u olive kan ym duna, bad ki lyngkha kin ym ai doh; ka kynhun kan ym mih doh shuh shuh na ka kynhun, bad kan ym don ka kynhun ha ki stall:

en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel , whose name was called Belteshazzar  ; and the thing was true , but the time appointed was long : and he understood the thing , and had understanding of the vision .
kha: ( Ha ka snem kaba lai kaba u Syros u long u patsha jong ka Persia , ïa ka khubor la pynpaw ha u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar . Ka khubor ka long kaba shisha hynrei kaba jwat eh ban sngewthuh . La batai ïa ka ha u ha ka jingïohipaw . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong u syiem u Cyrus jong ka Persia la pynpaw ia kaei kaei ha u Daniel, uba la khot u Belteshazzar bad kaei kaei ka la long kaba shisha: bad u la sngewthuh ia kata kaei kaei bad u la sngewthuh ia ka jingphohsniew .

en: And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commandeth , Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations  ; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness , when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt .
kha: U Moses u ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ba ngin tyngkai ïa ka manna na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi , ba ki lah ban ïohi ïa kata ka jingbam ba u ai ha ngi ha ri shyiap ban bam , mynba u wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong , Kane ka long kaba U Trai u hukum: Pyndap ia ka na ka bynta ki pateng jong phi ; ba kin iohi ia u kpu da uba nga la ai bam ia phi ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: The  Lord  will not spare him , but then the anger of the  Lord  and his jealousy shall smoke against that man , and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him , and the  Lord  shall blot out his name from under heaven .
kha: U  Trai  un ym map kum ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka jingbitar shla jong u kan meh lep pyrshah ïa u , bad ki jingjynjar baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab kin ngat ha u haduh ba U  Trai  un da pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un ym pyllait ia u , hynrei nangta ka jingbitar U Trai bad ka jingsngewsih jong u kan sa bthei pyrshah ia uta u briew , bad ki jingtim baroh kiba la thoh ha kane ka kot kin sa shong ha u , bad U Trai un sa pynduh noh ia ka kyrteng jong u na shapoh bneng .

en: Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the  Lord   ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the  Lord  , and work : for I am with you , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
kha: Hynrei mynta to wat duh jingkyrmen , mano mano ruh na phi . Leh la ka kam , naba nga long ryngkat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta to long kiba skhem , ko Serubabel , ko Trai; bad to long kiba skhem, ko Joshua, ko khun u Jehozadak, u rangbah lyngdoh bad to long kiba skhem, ko phi baroh ki briew jong ka ri, ong U Trai, bad trei: namar nga don ryngkat bad phi, ong U Trai jong ki paid:

en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons that were left , Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and eat it without leaven beside the altar : for it is most holy :
kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron , bad ha ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u kiba dang sah , u Eleasar bad u Ithamar ,  Shim ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba sah na kata ka jingbam kaba la kñia sha U  Trai  , pynlong kpu khlem thiat da ka bad bam ïa ka harud ka duwan , namar kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba khuid bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha u Aaron bad ha u Eleasar bad ha u Isaramar, ki khun shynrang jong u kiba la sah: To shim ia ka jingainguh bam kaba sah na ki jingainguh U Trai ba la shna da ka ding, bad bam ia ka khlem da bam ia ka da ka jingbam: namar ka long kaba khuid tam:

en: So I returned , and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun : and behold the tears of such as were oppressed , and they had no comforter  ; and on the side of their oppressors there was power  ; but they had no comforter .
kha: Nangta nga la khmih biang ha baroh ki jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha kane ka pyrthei . Kiba la shah banbeiñ ki lynñiar , bad ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa ki . Ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa ki namar ki nongbanbeiñ jong ki , ki don ka bor ha ka liang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la wan phai, bad nga la pyrkhat ia ki jingpynshitom baroh kiba la leh hapoh ka sngi: bad ha khmih ki ummat jong kiba la shah pynshitom bein, bad kim don ka jingpyntngen ; bad ha ka liang jong ki nongpynshitom bein jong ki ka don ka bor ; hynrei kim don ka jingpyntngen .

en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .
kha: Ka la ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la buh ha ka miej jong u , ïa ki ïing sah jong ki rangbah synshar jong u , ïa ki shakri kiba shakri ïa u ha ki jingkhawai , bad ïa ki jingkñia kiba u la ai ha ka Templ . Ki la pynlyngngoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh jong ka miej jong u, bad ka jingshong jong ki shakri jong u, bad ka jingwan jong ki shakri jong u, bad ki jainkup jong u, bad ki nongrah khuri jong u, bad ka jingwan jong u ha ka iing U Trai; ym don mynsiem shuh ha ka .

en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .
kha: Shim uwei u khiew nar bad pynïeng ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . Phai khmat sha ka nongbah . Ka don ha ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba kerkut ïa ka . Kane kan long ka dak ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata to shim ia ka pan nar, bad buh ia ka kum ka kynroh nar hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah: bad buh ia ka khmat jong me pyrshah ia ka , bad kan sa shah set ha ka . Kane kan long ka dak ia ka iing Israel .

en: Yea also , because he transgresseth by wine , he is a proud man , neither keepeth at home , who enlargeth his desire as hell , and is as death , and cannot be satisfied , but gathereth unto him all nations , and heapeth unto him all people :
kha: Ka spah ka long kaba shukor . Ki briew kiba lalot ki long kiba sarong bad bym lah ban shong khop — kum ka jingïap hi da lei lei kim ju hun . Namarkata ki jop ïa kawei ka hima hadien kawei pat na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ruh, namar ba u iaid lait ia ka wain, u long u briew uba sngew sarong, u bym ju sah ha iing, uba pynheh ia ka jingkwah jong u kum ka dujok, bad u long kum ka jingiap, bad um lah ban pynhun ia u, hynrei u lum ha u ia ki jaitbynriew baroh, bad u lum ha u ia ki briew baroh:

en: Arise , cry out in the night : in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord : lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children , that faint for hunger in the top of every street .
kha: Nga la khot ïa kiba ïateh lok bad nga , hynrei ki la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga . Ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam ki la ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , ki da wad ïa ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , to pyrta ha ka por miet: ha kaba sdang jong ki watch to theh ia ka dohnud jong me kum ka um ha khmat U Trai: rah ia ki kti jong me sha u na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki khun rit jong me, kiba sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingkyrduh ha jrong jong kawei pa kawei ka lynti .

en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan shim noh napdeng jong phi ïa kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba dap da ka pop . Ngan shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki ban wan phai pat sha ka ri Israel . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhuid noh na phi ia ki nongleh pyrshah bad ia kiba iaid lait ia nga: Ngan pynmih noh ia ki na ka ri kaba ki sahkut , bad kin ym rung sha ka ri Israel: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .
kha: bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa kiba ki dei ban shakri katba ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kino na ki para Israel jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shim ia ki kum ka pateng na ka bynta ki khun jong phi hadien jong phi, ban hiar pateng ia ki kum ki mraw jong phi junom: hynrei halor ki hynmen jong phi ki khun Israel , phin ym synshar iwei ia iwei pat da ka jingsngewrit .

en: And I have said , I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , unto a land flowing with milk and honey .
kha: Nga la kular ba ngan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt ha kaba ki shah lehbeiñ , sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap — ka ri jong ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong , Ngan wanrah ia phi na ka jingjynjar jong ka ri Ijipt sha ka ri jong ki nong Hitia bad ki Hiti bad ki Amorit bad ki Perizzite bad ki Hivite bad ki Jibuite sha ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people , he said , Ye men of Ephesus , what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana , and of the image which fell down from Jupiter ?
kha: Ha kaba khatduh , u nongtrei sorkar u la lah ban pynjai jai ïa u paidbah .  Ko para nong Ephesos !  u la ong .  Uwei pa uwei u tip ba ka nongbah Ephesos ka dei ka nongsumar ïa ka templ jong ka Artemis bakhraw bad ïa u mawkyntang uba la hap na sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u nongshong shnong u la pynsngewbha ia ki briew , u la ong , Phi ki briew jong ka Ephesos , uei u briew uba ym tip kumno ba ka nongbah jong ki nong Ephesia ka long ka nongmane ia ka blei kaba khraw ka Diana bad jong ka dur kaba la hap na Jupiter ?

en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor , and ye take from him burdens of wheat : ye have built houses of hewn stone , but ye shall not dwell in them  ; ye have planted pleasant vineyards , but ye shall not drink wine of them .
kha: Phi la banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad la shim jubor na ki ïa u kew jong ki . Bad kumta phin ym ïoh sah ha ki ïing maw ba-itynnat ba phi la tei lane dih waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba itynnat ba phi la thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ka jingleit jong phi ka long halor kiba duk, bad phi shim na u ia ki jingkit maw: phi la tei ia ki iing maw ba la ot , hynrei phin ym shong ha ki ; phi la thung ia ki kper sohjew kiba sngewtynnad , hynrei phin ym dih ia ka wain na ki .

en: And Moses said unto him , As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the  Lord   ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail  ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the  Lord s .
kha: U Moses u ong ha u ,  Nga tang shu poi shabar kane ka shnong , ngan duwai ha U  Trai . U pyrthat un sangeh , bad u phria un ym hap shuh , ba phin ïoh tip ba ka pyrthei ka long ka jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u: Tang shu mih na ka shnong, ngan sa pynphriang ia ki kti jong nga sha U Trai ; bad ka jingsawa kan sangeh noh , lymne kan ym don shuh ka jingsawa shuh shuh ba me lah ban tip kumno ba ka khyndew ka long ka Trai s .

en: My heart shall cry out for Moab  ; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar , an heifer of three years old : for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up  ; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction .
kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyang jam namar ka Moab ! Ki briew ki la phet sha ki shnong jong ka Soar , bad sha ka Eglath Shelishiyah . Katto katne ki kiew ïa ka surok sha Luhith , ki da ïam haba ki leit ; katto katne ki lait phet sha Horanaim , ki da ïam sngewsih jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong nga kan iam na ka bynta u Moab ki nongleh kam sniew jong u kin phet noh sha u Soar: namar da ka jingkiew jong u Luhith da kaba iam kin leit sha jrong namar ha ka lynti jong u Horonaim kin pynmih ia ka jingpyrta jong ka jingpynjot .

en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , that he said , Behold , there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea , like a man s hand . And he said , Go up , say unto Ahab , Prepare thy chariot , and get thee down , that the rain stop thee not .
kha: Ha ka sien kaba hynñiew u wan phai bad u ong ,  Nga ïohi khyndiat u lyoh u bym da heh palat ïa ka kti briew ba u kiew na ka duriaw .  U Elijah u hukum ïa u shakri bad ong ,  Khie leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ong ïa u ban shong ha ka kali ïapom bad ban leit phai noh sha ïing shuwa ba u slap un pynsangeh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sien kaba hynriew, ba u la ong, Ha khmih, ka mih khyndiat ka lyoh na ka duriaw, kum ka kti jong u briew . Bad u la ong: To leit shaneng, to ong ha u Ahab, To pynkhreh ia ka kali jong me bad to hiar noh ia me, ba u slap un ym khang ia me .

en: Go and get thee in unto king David , and say unto him , Didst not thou , my lord , O king , swear unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ? why then doth Adonijah reign ?
kha: leit mar mar sha u Syiem Dabid bad pan na u , ‘ Syiem Kynrad , hato phim shym la kular kyntang ïa nga ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi ? Kumno te ka lah ban long ba u Adonijah u la long syiem ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad leit sha u syiem Dabid, bad to ong ha u, Hato me, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, phim shym la smai ha ka kti jong me, da kaba ong: Hooid u Solomon u khun jong me un synshar hadien jong nga, bad un shong ha ka khet jong nga ? balei te u Adonijah u synshar ?

en: But ye turned and polluted my name , and caused every man his servant , and every man his handmaid , whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure , to return , and brought them into subjection , to be unto you for servants and for handmaids .
