kha: Hynrei phi kylla pat ïa ka jingmut jong phi bad phi pynjahburom ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la shim pat ïa ki mraw ïa kiba phi la pyllaitluid kumba ki la kwah , bad phi la pynlong mraw jubor biang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la phai bad pynjakhlia ia ka kyrteng jong nga, bad uwei pa uwei u la pynlong ia u shakri jong u, bad uwei pa uwei u nongtrei jong u, uba phi la buh ha ka jinglaitluid katba ki mon, ban wan phai noh, bad phi la wanrah ia ki ha ka jingshah pyndem, ban long ha phi na ka bynta ki shakri bad na ka bynta ki nongtrei kti jong u .

en: And their father Israel said unto them , If it must be so now , do this  ; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :
kha: U Jakob u ong ha ki ,  Lada kumta te , to leit rah ïa ki jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong kane ka ri ha ki byrni jong phi kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta u lat : khyndiat ka jingiwbih , khyndiat ka ngap , ki musli musla , ka mirr , ki jait soh-ot , bad ki almond .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong ki u Israel u la ong ha ki, Lada ka dei ban long kumta mynta, to leh ia kane ka jingshim ia ki soh kiba bha tam ha ka ri ha ki lieng jong phi, bad rah ia uta u briew ia ka jingai sngewbha, khyndiat ka umsoh bad khyndiat ka umsoh bad ki jingbam ba bang, ki soh bad ki almond:

en: And he told it to his father , and to his brethren : and his father rebuked him , and said unto him , What is this dream that thou hast dreamed ? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth ?
kha: U la ïathuh ruh ïa ka jingphohsniew ha la u kpa , bad u kpa jong u , u la mai ïa u ,  Ka jingphohsniew aïu kaba kum kata ? Hato me pyrkhat ba ka kmie jong me , ki hynmen shynrang jong me , bad ma nga ngin ïawan bad nguh ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la iathuh ha u kpa jong u bad ha ki hynmen jong u: bad u kpa jong u u la pynrem ia u bad u la ong ha u: Kaei kane ka jingphohsniew kaba me la phohsniew ? Hato nga bad ka kmie jong me bad ki hynmen jong me ngin wan hiar shapoh khyndew ?

en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , and a meat offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , every thing upon his day :
kha: Kine ki long kita ki Jingkhawai Niam ha kiba phi ai burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba ïalumlang ban mane Blei bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , ïa ki jingkñia , bad ïa ki jingainguh dih , man la ka sngi kumba la buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki jingkhawai jong U Trai, kiba phin pynbna ba ki long ki jingpynbna bakhuid, ban aiti ia ka jingainguh ba la thang ha U Trai, bad ka jingainguh bam, ka jingknia bad ka jingknia dih, kawei pa kawei ha ka sngi jong u:

en: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap , and go thou after them : have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee ? and when thou art athirst , go unto the vessels , and drink of that which the young men have drawn .
kha: khmih ïa ki ban ïohi hangno ki ot bad don lang bad ki . Nga la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong nga ba kin ym leh bymdei ïa phi . Bad man ba phi sliang , leit ban dih na ki khra um ba ki la pyndap .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ki khmat jong me kin long ha lyngkha ba ki kheit, bad me leit bud ia ki: hato ngam shym la kynnoh ia ki samla ba kin ym ktah ia me ? bad haba me la sliang , leit sha ki khiew bad dih ia kata kaba ki samla ki la ring .

en: To take a spoil , and to take a prey  ; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited , and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations , which have gotten cattle and goods , that dwell in the midst of the land .
kha: Men leit kurup , bad lute ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah kiba shisien ki don ha ka jingjot . Ki long kiba la lumlang na ki jaitbynriew , bad mynta ki don la ki jingri bad ki jingdon jingem , bad ki shong ha ki lad bah ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban shim ia ka jinglute, bad ban shim ia ka jingbam ; ban pynphai ia ka kti jong me sha ki jaka ba la jot mynta , bad ha ki briew kiba la lum na ki jaitbynriew , kiba la ioh ia ki masi bad ki mar ki mata , kiba shong hapdeng ka ri .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Depart , and go up hence , thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt , unto the land which I sware unto Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , Unto thy seed will I give it :
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Khie ïamihnoh nangne , ma me bad ki paidbah kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , bad leit sha kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ban ai ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To leit noh, bad to leit kiew noh, ma me bad ki briew kiba me la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt, ka ri kaba nga la smai ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob, da kaba ong: Ha u symbai jong me ngan ai ia ka:

en: And Joab answered , The  Lord  make his people an hundred times so many more as they be : but , my lord the king , are they not all my lord s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing ? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?
kha: U Joab u jubab ,  To U  Trai  un pynroi bun ïa ki paid Israel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki long mynta ! Syiem Kynrad , ki baroh ki dei ki shakri jong phi . Balei phi kwah ban leh ïa kane bad pynkit pop ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la jubab , U Trai u pynlong ia ki briew jong u da kaba bun katba ki long: hynrei ko kynrad jong nga: hynrei hato kim dei ki shakri jong nga baroh ? balei te u kynrad jong nga u dawa ia kane ? balei un long u daw jong ka jingleh bein ia ki Israel ?

en: And unto the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs  ; two cities .
kha: Kiwei pat ki kynhun jong ki Lebi , ka kur Gershon , ka ïohpdiang ar tylli ki nongbah na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Mihngi : ka Golan ha Bashan ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) bad ka Beeshterah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Gerson, na ki jait Lebi, na kawei pat ka jaitbynriew Manasseh ki la ai ia ka Golan ha Basan ryngkat bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka, ban long ka shnong rieh tngen na ka bynta u nongpyniap briew; bad ka Beeshterah ryngkat bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka;

en: Then the priest shall see the plague : and , behold , if it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; and there be in it a yellow thin hair  ; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a dry scall , even a leprosy upon the head or beard .
kha: Lada ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh hangta u lam stem bad stang , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un iohi ia ka khlam: bad, ha khmih, lada ka kham jylliew ban ia ka sniehdoh ; bad don ha ka u shniuh uba rit ; te u lyngdoh un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid: ka long ka sniehdoh kaba rkhiang, wat ka sniehdoh kaba rkhiang ha ka khlieh ne ka ryndang .

en: The sword of the  Lord  is filled with blood , it is made fat with fatness , and with the blood of lambs and goats , with the fat of the kidneys of rams : for the  Lord  hath a sacrifice in Bozrah , and a great slaughter in the land of Edom .
kha: Ïa ka waitlam jong u yn tap da ka snam bad ka khleiñ jong ki , kum ka snam bad ka khleiñ jong ki langbrot bad ki blang ïa kiba la kñia . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa kane ka jingkñia ha ka nongbah Bosrah ; un pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynïap bakhraw ha ka ri ki Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka waitlam U Trai ka dap da ka snam, ka la tyrkhong bad ka snam jong ki langbrot bad ki blang: namar U Trai u don ka jingknia ha Bosrah bad ka jingpyniap kaba khraw ha ka ri u Edom .

en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and said unto him , Thus saith the king , Come forth . And he said , Nay  ; but I will die here . And Benaiah brought the king word again , saying , Thus said Joab , and thus he answered me .
kha: U la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u ong ha u Joab ,  U syiem u hukum ba men mih shabar .   Em ,  u Joab u jubab ,  ngan ïap hangne .  U Benaïah u la leit phai sha u syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Joab u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benaiah u la wan sha ka iing U Trai, bad u la ong ha u, Kumta u la ong u syiem, To wan shabar . Bad u la ong: Em; hynrei ngan iap hangne . Bad u Benaiah u la wanrah biang ia ka ktien syiem da kaba ong: Kumta u la ong u Joab bad kumta u la jubab ia nga .

en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains , and burn incense upon the hills , under oaks and poplars and elms , because the shadow thereof is good : therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom , and your spouses shall commit adultery .
kha: Ha ki jaka kyntang ha kliar ki lumbah ki kñia ainguh , bad ha ki lumrit ki thang jingiwbih hapoh ki dieng kiba jrong bad kiba ïar namar ka jingkahtngen jong ki ka long kaba sngewtynnat !  Kaba mih nangta , ki khun kynthei jong phi ki ïaleh nuti , bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong phi ki ïaklim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki knia halor ki lum, bad ki thang ia ka jingiwbih halor ki lum, hapoh ki dieng bad ki diengsoh bad ki elm , namar ka jingdum jong ka ka long kaba bha: namarkata ki khun kynthei jong phi kin leh ia ka kam awria bad ki lok jong phi kin leh ia ka kam awria .

en: And they came up into Judah , and brake into it , and carried away all the substance that was found in the king s house , and his sons also , and his wives  ; so that there was never a son left him , save Jehoahaz , the youngest of his sons .
kha: Ki la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ki la lute ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad ki ïalam kum koidi ïa baroh ki tnga bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u syiem lait noh tang u Ahasaïah , u khun khatduh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan shaneng ha Judah, bad ki la rung shapoh jong ka, bad ki la rah noh ia ki jingbam baroh kiba la lap ha iing syiem, bad ki khun shynrang jong u ruh, bad ki tnga jong u; haduh ba ym don khun shynrang shuh shuh uba sah ha u, lait noh tang u Jehos , uba rit tam na ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: Then all the children of Israel , and all the people , went up , and came unto the house of God , and wept , and sat there before the  Lord  , and fasted that day until even , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
kha: Nangta baroh ki briew ka Israel ki leit kiew sha Bethel bad ki ïamkthang . Ki shong hangta ha khmat U  Trai  bad kim shym bam ei ei haduh janmiet . Ki kñia ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk — baroh ha jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun Israel baroh bad ki briew baroh ki la leit shaneng bad ki la wan sha ka iing U Blei bad ki la iam bad ki la shong hangta ha khmat U Trai bad ki la shah jingit ha kata ka sngi haduh ban da janmiet .

en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? nay , they were not at all ashamed , neither could they blush : therefore they shall fall among them that fall : at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hato kin sngewlehrain namar ki la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli ? Em , kim shym la sngewlehrain satia ; kim tip hi ruh kumno ban sawkyr-ang . Bad kumta kin kyllon kumba kiwei ki la kyllon ; haba nga pynshitom ïa ki , kata kan long kaba kut jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki la sngewlehrain haba ki la leh ia ka kam kaba sngewsih ? hooid, kim shym la sngewlehrain satia, bad kim lah ban rkhie bein: namarkata kin hap hap hapdeng jong ki kiba hap: ha ka por ba nga leit jngoh ia ki kin shah pynhap noh , ong U Trai .

en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :
kha: U lyngdoh un shim khyndiat na ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon , ha ka  tikmie kamon , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un shim katto katne na ka snam jong ka jingainguh kaba la pynkylla, bad u lyngdoh un buh ia ka ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong uta uba dei ban pynkhuid bad ha ka kti kadiang jong u bad ha ka kjat kadiang jong u:

en: Son of man , thy brethren , even thy brethren , the men of thy kindred , and all the house of Israel wholly , are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said , Get you far from the  Lord  : unto us is this land given in possession .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ki ïakren shaphang jong me bad shaphang ki para Israel kiba don ha ka jinglongmraw . Ki ong , ‘ Kiba shah ringmraw ki la jngai eh ban mane ïa U  Trai . U la ai ha ngi ban ïohkynti ïa ka ri .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun briew, ko para jong me, wat ki hynmen jong me, bad ka iing Israel baroh kawei, ki long ha kiba ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong: To leit noh na U Trai: ha ngi la ai ia kane ka ri ha ka jinglong trai .

en: And when he came unto Lehi , the Philistines shouted against him : and the Spirit of the  Lord  came mightily upon him , and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire , and his bands loosed from off his hands .
kha: Ynda u poi ha Lehi , ki Philistia ki wan mareh sha u , ki da ïarisa ïa u . Hangta hi ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u bthat ïa ki tyllai kiba la khum ïa ki ksang ti bad ki kti jong u kum ki  saihon kiba la kem ding .
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha Lehi , ki Philistia ki la pyrta pyrshah ia u: bad u Mynsiem U Trai u la wan jur halor jong u , bad ki lynti kiba don ha ki kti jong u ki la kylla long kum ki flax kiba la thang da ka ding , bad ki lynti jong u ki la jah noh na ki kti jong u .

en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies , and before them that seek their life : and I will bring evil upon them , even my fierce anger , saith the  Lord   ; and I will send the sword after them , till I have consumed them :
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Elam ban sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ki , kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong nga ngan pynjot ïa ki briew ka Elam bad ngan phah ki shipai pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba ngan da pynduh khoit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pynlong ia ka Elam ban sngewsih ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki: bad ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor jong ki: bad ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor jong nga: ong u Trai; bad ngan phah ia ka waitlam hadien jong ki:

en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women , so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes , when it shall be reported , The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him , but she came not .
kha: Kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha ka hima kan sdang ban peitbeiñ ïa u tnga jong ka tang shu ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ka mahadei ka la leh . Kin ong , ‘ U syiem Serksis u hukum ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei , ban wan sha u bad ka kyntait .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka kam jong ka mahadei kan wan shabar ri ha ki kynthei baroh, haduh ba kin pynjah burom ia ki tnga jong ki ha ki khmat jong ki, haba la iathuh ia ka , U syiem Ahasheros u la hukum ia ka mahadei ban wanrah ha khmat jong u , hynrei kam shym la wan .

en: But the word of the  Lord  was unto them precept upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little  ; that they might go , and fall backward , and be broken , and snared , and taken .
kha: Dei na kata ka daw ba U  Trai  un sa hikai ïa phi kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai . Te phin jynthut ha kawei pa kawei ka jingjam ba phi shim . Phin sa mynsaw , shah riam bad phin long koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka ktien U Trai ka la long ha ki ha ka por ba ki dang sahkut, ka la sahkut ha ka lain kaba sahkut, bad hangta ka la sahkut tang khyndiat, bad hangta ka la sahkut khyndiat.

en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Take thy father s young bullock , even the second bullock of seven years old , and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath , and cut down the grove that is by it :
kha: Ha kata ka miet , U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon  Shim ïa u masi kyrtong jong u kpa jong me bad uwei pat u masi kyrtong uba hynñiew snem ka rta , pynpra noh ïa ka duwan ba u kpa jong me u la tei ha u Baal , bad pynkhyllem ïa ka dak jong ka blei Asherah kaba don ha syndah jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kajuh ka miet , ba U Trai u la ong ha u: Shim ia u khun masi jong u kpa jong me, wat ia u khun masi ba ar uba dang hynriew snem ka rta, bad bret noh ia ka jingbam jong u Baal kaba u kpa jong me u don, bad ot noh ia u khlaw uba don hajan jong u:

en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant  ; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the  Lord  with thee : notwithstanding , if there be in me iniquity , slay me thyself  ; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father ?
kha: Sngewbha leh ïa kane namar jong nga ; bad bat ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba phi la ai ha nga . Hynrei lada nga long ba la pynrem , pynïap ïa nga da lade hi ! Balei phin shim ïa nga sha i pa jong phi ban shah pynïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban leh sbun ia u shakri jong me ; namar me la wanrah ia u shakri jong me ha ka jutang U Trai bad me: wat la katta ruh lada don ha nga ka jingbymhok, to pyniap ia nga hi ; namar balei me wanrah ia nga ha u kpa jong me ?

en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees , and the other Pharisees , he cried out in the council , Men and brethren , I am a Pharisee , the son of a Pharisee : of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question .
kha: Haba u Paul u la ïohi ba katto katne na ka kynhun ki dei ki Saddusi bad kiwei pat ki Pharisi , u la kren jam ha ka Dorbar ,  Ko ki para nong Israel ! Nga dei u Pharisi , u khun jong ki Pharisi . Nga don ha ka jingshah bishar hangne namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ba kiba ïap kin mihpat !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Paul u la sngewthuh ba kawei ka bynta ka long ki Sadusi, bad kiwei pat ki Pharisi , u la pyrta ha ka dorbar , Ki briew bad ki para bangeit , nga long u Pharisi , u khun jong u Pharisi: na ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap la khot ia nga ha ka jingkylli .

en: But Jonathan Saul s son delighted much in David : and Jonathan told David , saying , Saul my father seeketh to kill thee : now therefore , I pray thee , take heed to thyself until the morning , and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself :
kha: kumta u ong ha u ,  I pa i pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Sngewbha da leh husiar lashai mynstep ; rieh ha ka jaka bym don batip bad sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jonathan u khun u la sngewbha shibun ha u Dabid: bad u Jonathan u la ong ha u Dabid: u Jonathan u la ong: U kpa jong nga u wad ban pyniap ia me: namarkata, nga kyrpad ia me, to sumar ia lade haduh mynstep, bad to sah ha ka jaka rieh:

en: Let it rest on the head of Joab , and on all his father s house  ; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue , or that is a leper , or that leaneth on a staff , or that falleth on the sword , or that lacketh bread .
kha: To ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kane kan hap halor u Joab bad ka longïing jong u baroh ! Ha kawei pa kawei ka pateng to yn don u shynrang ha ka longïing jong u , uba don ka jingpang  ñiangkulia lane ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba shyrkhei lane uba hap ban trei tang ïa ka kam ba trei ki kynthei lane uba shah pynïap ha ka thma lane uba kyrduh bam !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kan shong ha ka khlieh jong u Joab bad ha ka iing jong u baroh kawei bad wat ai ba un ym jah na ka iing u Joab uba don ka jingpang , ne uba don ka jingpang sniehdoh , ne uba shong ha u diengduh , ne uba hap ha ka waitlam , ne uba duna u kpu .

en: So he arose and went to Zarephath . And when he came to the gate of the city , behold , the widow woman was there gathering of sticks : and he called to her , and said , Fetch me , I pray thee , a little water in a vessel , that I may drink .
kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit sha Sarephath . Ynda u poi ha khyrdop shnong , u la ïohi ïa kawei ka riewkynthei kaba tam diengïap . U khot ïa ka , bad u ong ,  Sngewbha ai ha nga ka um ban dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la ieng bad u la leit sha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong, ha khmih kata ka kynthei kaba la shah ktah: bad u la khot ia ka bad u la ong: To khot ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, khyndiat ka um ha ka umphniang, ba ngan dih .

en: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the  Lord  , and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the  Lord .
kha: U syiem bad u Jehoïada ki ai ïa kata ka pisa ha kito kiba dei peit ïa ka kam shna pynbha ïa ka Templ , bad ki wai ïa ki misteri maw , ki misteri dieng , ki nongtrei nar , ban shna pynbha .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem bad u Jehoiada ki la ai ia ka ha kiba trei ia ka iing U Trai , bad ki nongshna maw bad ki nongshna nar ban pynbha ia ka iing U Trai , bad kumjuh ruh kum ki nar bad ki nar ba la shna da ka nar bad ki nar ban pynbha ia ka iing U Trai .

en: And he dealt among all the people , even among the whole multitude of Israel , as well to the women as men , to every one a cake of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house .
kha: bad u sam jingbam sha ki baroh . U ai ha uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha Israel mar uwei u kpu , shi lyngkhot ka doh syang , bad katto katne ki soh kismis . Nangta baroh ki la leit phai sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh hapdeng ki briew baroh, wat hapdeng ki Israel baroh kawei, bad ki kynthei kum ki shynrang, ha uwei pa uwei u kpu bad ka doh kaba bha bad ka wain kaba bha . Kumta ki briew baroh ki la leit noh iwei ia iwei pat sha la iing .

en: I the  Lord  have spoken it : it shall come to pass , and I will do it  ; I will not go back , neither will I spare , neither will I repent  ; according to thy ways , and according to thy doings , shall they judge thee , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban leh ei ei . Ngan ym ieh kumto ïa ki pop jong pha lane pyn-i jingsngewlem ne jingisynei . Phan shah pynshitom namar kaei kaba pha la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata: kan sa jia, bad ngan ym leit phai shuh, lymne ngan ym pyllait im, lymne ngan ym kylla bamut; bad kat kum ki jingleh jong me , kin bishar ia me , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop , and dip it in the blood that is in the basin , and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the basin  ; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning .
kha: Shim shi song u Hissop bad wieh ïa u ha ka pliang kaba don ïa ka snam jong uta u mrad , bad tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shawkad bad ha u bim ha khlieh ka jingkhang ïing jong phi . Uwei ruh um bit ban mih shabar na ïing haduh mynstep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shim ia ka snam kaba don ha ka pla, bad phin pynkhih ia ka sniehdoh bad ki arliang ki tduh da ka snam kaba don ha ka pla; bad ym don uwei ruh na phi uba leit shabar ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing jong u haduh ka por mynstep .

en: Then Abigail made haste , and took two hundred loaves , and two bottles of wine , and five sheep ready dressed , and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins , and two hundred cakes of figs , and laid them on asses .
kha: Ka Abigail ka la pynstet ban lum arspah tylli ki kpu , ar tylli ki pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ , san tylli ki langbrot kiba la syang , khathynñiew kilo u kew ba la sdieh ; shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , bad arspah tylli ki thup soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ka pynkit ïa ki halor ki kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abigail u la shna kyrkieh arspah tylli ki kpu, bad ar tylli ki bilor wain, bad san tylli ki langbrot kiba la pynkhreh, bad san tylli ki jingthew jong u kew ba la shet, bad shispah tylli ki kynhun ki soh bad arspah tylli ki cake ki sohjew, bad u la buh ia ki ha ki kada .

en: And the  Lord  delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God  ; and on them was written according to all the words , which the  Lord  spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ai ha nga ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la thoh da la ka kti ïa kata kaba u la kren ha phi napdeng ka ding ha kato ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la aiti ha nga ar tylli ki maw ba la thoh da ka kti U Blei ; bad ha ki la thoh kat kum ki ktien baroh kiba U Trai u la kren bad phi ha ka jaka ba la lum lang na pdeng ka ding ha ka sngi jong ka jingiaseng .

en: This thing is not good that thou hast done . As the  Lord  liveth , ye are worthy to die , because ye have not kept your master , the  Lord s  anointed . And now see where the king s spear is , and the cruse of water that was at his bolster .
kha: Mem shym la leh ïa la ka kamram , Abner ! Nga smai da U  Trai  uba im , ba phi baroh phi dei hok ban ïap , namar phim shym la ïada ïa la u kynrad , uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem . Peit shane ! Ha-ei u sum jong u syiem ? Ha-ei u khiew um ba la buh hajan ka khlieh jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kam kam long kaba bha kaba me la leh . Kumba U Trai u im, phi long kiba bit ban iap, namar phim shym la bat ia u kynrad jong phi, U Trai u la pynsleh . Bad mynta peit shano u syiem u don ka khnam bad ka um kaba la don ha ka bol jong u .

en: Surely the isles shall wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring thy sons from far , their silver and their gold with them , unto the name of the  Lord  thy God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he hath glorified thee .
kha: Ki dei ki liengbah kiba wan na ki ri kiba jngai , ki wallam ïa ki paidlang U Blei sha la ïing . Ki wanrah ryngkat bad ki ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai U Blei Bakhuid ka Israel , uba pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ban pyndonburom ïa ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ki isles kin ap ia nga, bad ki lieng jong u Tarshish nyngkong eh, ban wanrah ia ki khun shynrang jong me na jngai, ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki ryngkat bad ki, sha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong me bad ha U Bakhuid jong ki Israel, namar u la pyndonburom ia me .

en: And it was told the Gazites , saying , Samson is come hither . And they compassed him in , and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city , and were quiet all the night , saying , In the morning , when it is day , we shall kill him .
kha: Ki nong Gasa ki shem ba u Samson u don hangta , kumta ki kerkut ïa kata ka jaka bad ki ap ïa u baroh shi miet ha khyrdop shnong . Ki ap jar jar baroh shi miet , da kaba pyrkhat ha lade ,  Ngin ap haduh ban da kynjat shai , ban nangta ngin sa pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh ha ki Gazite, da kaba ong, U Samson u wan shane . Ki la ker sawdong ia u baroh shi miet ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong, bad ki la sngap jar baroh shi miet, ki da sngap jar baroh shi miet, ki da ong: Ha ka por mynstep, haba ka la dei ka sngi, ngin pyniap ia u .

en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down , What is sweeter than honey ? and what is stronger than a lion ? And he said unto them , If ye had not plowed with my heifer , ye had not found out my riddle .
kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ha shuwa ba u Samson un leit sha la kamra thiah , ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki ong ha u ,  Kaei kaba kham thiang ban ïa ka ngap ? Uei uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u sing ?  U Samson u jubab ,  Lada phim shym la lur da ka masi jong nga , Phin ym tip ïa ka jubab mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka shnong ki la ong ha u ha ka sngi kaba hynriew shuwa ba ka sngi kan hiar, Kaei kaba kham thiang ban ia ka ngap ? bad kaei kaba kham khlain ban ia u sing ? Bad u la ong ha ki: Lada phim shym la tyrkhong bad ka masi jong nga , phim shym la lap ia ka jingkylli jong nga .

en: And it came to pass about three months after , that it was told Judah , saying , Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot  ; and also , behold , she is with child by whoredom . And Judah said , Bring her forth , and let her be burnt .
kha: Kumba lai bnai hadien kane , don ba ïathuh ha u Judah ,  Ka pyrsa kurim jong phi ka la leh kum ka nuti , bad mynta ka la punkhun .   Sei shabar ïa ka , bad thang im ïa ka ,  ong u Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia kumba lai bnai hadien, ba la iathuh ha u Judah, da kaba ong, Ka Tamar ka khun jong me ka la leh ia ka kam runar ; bad ruh, ha khmih, ka la pun khun da ka kam runar. Bad u Judah u la ong, To wanrah ia ka shabar, bad to ai ba kan shah thang .

en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb , then she shall bring two turtles , or two young pigeons  ; the one for the burnt offering , and the other for a sin offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for her , and she shall be clean .
kha: Lada kata ka kynthei kam lah ban ai ïa u khunlangbrot , kan wallam ar tylli ki lyngdkhur ne ar tylli ki paro , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop bad u lyngdoh un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka , bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada kam lah ban wanrah ia u khun langbrot, te kan wanrah ar tylli ki turtle ne ar tylli ki khun sniang kiba dang rit .

en: But Gehazi , the servant of Elisha the man of God , said , Behold , my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian , in not receiving at his hands that which he brought : but , as the  Lord  liveth , I will run after him , and take somewhat of him .
kha: haba u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha , u ong ha lade ,  U kynrad jong nga u la pyllait ïa u Naaman ban leit noh khlem da siew ei ei ! U la dei ban pdiang ïa kaei kaba uto u Syria u tyrwa ïa u . Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan mareh hadien jong u bad ngan ïoh ei ei na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Gehasi, u shakri jong u Elisa u briew jong U Blei, u la ong, Ha khmih, u kynrad jong nga u la pyllait im ia u Naaman une u Syria, ha kaba um pdiang ha ki kti jong u ia kaba u la wanrah: hynrei kumba U Trai u im, ngan mareh hadien jong u, bad ngan shim katto katne na u .

en: And I fell down before the  Lord  , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
kha: Nangta sa shisien pat nga dem khrup ha khmat U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei , namar ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad phi la pynbitar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hap ha khmat U Trai, kumba ha kaba nyngkong, sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet: Ngam shym la bam kpu ne dih um namar ki pop jong phi baroh kiba phi la leh sniew ha khmat U Trai, ban pynkhih ia u ha ka jingbitar .

en: And he returned back from him , and took a yoke of oxen , and slew them , and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen , and gave unto the people , and they did eat . Then he arose , and went after Elijah , and ministered unto him .
kha: Nangta u Elisha u la leit sha ki shi jur ki masi dab jong u , u pynïap ïa ki masi dab bad u shet ïa ka doh da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka lyngkor kum ki diengthang ban pynmeh ding . U ai ïa ka doh ha ki briew bad ma ki ruh ki bam ïa ka . Hadien kata u leit ban bud ïa u Elijah kum u nongïarap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan phai biang na u, bad u la shim ia ka lyngkhot masi, bad u la pynkhluit ia ki da ki tiar masi, bad u la ai ha ki briew, bad ki la bam . Nangta u la ieng bad u la leit bud ia u Elijah bad u la shakri ia u .

en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering , and the shoulder of the heave offering , which is waved , and which is heaved up , of the ram of the consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons :
kha: Haba la pynsleh ïa u lyngdoh , ïa ka shadem bad ka lbong jong uta u langbrot ïa uba la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh dei ban pynkyntang sha nga kum ka jingai sngewbha bakyrpang bad kaba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pynkyntang ia ka shyntur jong ka jingainguh kaba heh, kaba la pynkhih bad kaba la pynkhih, na u langbrot jong ka jingpynkyntang, wat na kata kaba long na ka bynta u Aaron bad na kata na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u:

en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
kha: Ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa tei pat ïa ki shnong ba la jot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thung ki bri sohwaiñ bad kin dih ïa ka waiñ ; kin thung jingthung ha ki kper , bad kin bam na kaei kaba mih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel, bad kin tei ia ki shnong ba la jot, bad kin shong ha ki ; bad kin thung ia ki kper sohjew jong ka ; kin sa shet ruh ia ki kper sohjew jong ka ; bad kin bam ia ki soh jong ki .

en: And Abigail came to Nabal  ; and , behold , he held a feast in his house , like the feast of a king  ; and Nabal s heart was merry within him , for he was very drunken : wherefore she told him nothing , less or more , until the morning light .
kha: Ka Abigail ka leit phai sha u Nabal , uba don ha ïing ha ka jingkhawai kaba kat ka jingkhawai u syiem . U la buaid bad shongshit , kumta kam shym ïathuh ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abigail u la wan sha Nabal ; bad, ha khmih, u la leh ia ka jingkhawai ha iing jong u, kum ka jingkhawai jong u syiem ; bad ka dohnud jong u Nabal ka la sngewbha hapoh jong u: namar kata kam shym la iathuh ei ei ia u, kham duna ne kham bun, haduh ka jingshai mynstep .

en: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force : but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon , and a flame from the midst of Sihon , and shall devour the corner of Moab , and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones .
kha: Ki nongphetwir bymdonbor shuh ki pyrshang ban wad jingïada ha Heshbon , ka nongbah kaba u syiem Sihon shisien u la synshar , hynrei ka don ha ki thylliej ding . Ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki jaka kiba ha khmat bad ïa ki lumbah bajrong jong ki nong Moab kiba sngewtynnat ïa ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba phet ki la ieng hapoh ka jingdum jong u Hesbon namar ka bor: hynrei ka ding kan mih na Heshbon bad ka ding na pdeng u Sihon bad kan bam ia ka kut jong u Moab bad ka khlieh jong kiba iaid beit .

en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets , and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the  Lord  , after the ordinance of David king of Israel .
kha: Haba ki rangbah ki la sdang ban tei ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , ki lyngdoh ha ki jingriam jong ki , ki ïeng ha la ki jaka bad ki turoi ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki Lebi jong ka kur Asaph ki ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki shakuriaw . Ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  kat kum ki jingbthah ba la ai pateng naduh ka por u syiem Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nongtei ki la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka tempi U Trai , ki la buh ia ki lyngdoh ha ka jain jong ki da ki turoi , bad ki Lebi ki khun shynrang jong u Asaph da ki cymbal , ban iaroh ia U Trai , hadien ka jingpynbeit jong u syiem Israel .

en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them , they saw , and , behold , the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven , and they had no power to flee this way or that way : and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers .
kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki phai shadien , ki ïohi ïa ka tdem kaba kiew sha suiñbneng . Ym don lad shuh ba kin lait im , naba ki Israel kiba la phet sha ka jaka bashrah mynta ki phai kylla ban ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew jong ka Ai ki peit shadien jong ki, ki la iohi, bad, ha khmih, ka tdem jong ka shnong ka la kiew sha bneng, bad kim don bor shuh ban phet noh kumne ne kumta: bad ki briew kiba la phet sha ri khlaw ki la phai biang sha ki nongbeh .

en: On the morrow , because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews , he loosed him from his bands , and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear , and brought Paul down , and set him before them .
kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la kwah ban tip thikna ïa kaei ba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa u Paul ; kumta ha ka sngi kaba bud u la phah weng noh ïa ki kynjri na u Paul bad u la hukum ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ïa ka Dorbar baroh ban ïakynduh lang . Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , namar ba u la tip ia ka jingshisha namar ba u la shah kynnoh ha ki Jiw , u la pyllait noh ia u na ki kynhun jong u , bad u la hukum ia ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka dorbar jong ki baroh ban wan mih , bad u la wanrah ia u Paul shapoh bad u la buh ia u ha khmat jong ki .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people  ; Ye have scattered my flock , and driven them away , and have not visited them : behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings , saith the  Lord .
kha: Kane ka long kaei ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong shaphang ki nongsynshar kiba la tharai ba kin sumar ïa ki briew jong u :  Phim shym la sumar bha ïa ki briew jong nga ; phi la pynsakma ïa ki bad phi la beh noh ïa ki . Mynta ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingbymman jong phi kaba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u ong pyrshah ia ki nongsharai jong nga; Phi la pynpra ia ki langbrot jong nga, bad phim shym la leit jngoh ia ki: ha khmih , ngan leit jngoh ia phi ia ka jingsniew jong ki jingleh jong phi, ong U Trai .

en: Therefore will I give their wives unto others , and their fields to them that shall inherit them : for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness , from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .
kha: Kumta ngan ai ïa ki lyngkha jong ki ha ki trai bathymmai bad ïa ki tnga jong ki ha kiwei pat ki rangbah . Uwei uwei baroh , uba rit bad uba khraw , u pyrshang ban thaw pisa da ka jingbymhok . Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan ai ia ki tnga jong ki ha kiwei pat bad ki lyngkha jong ki ha kito ki ban hiar pateng ia ki: namar uwei pa uwei na kiba rit tam wat haduh kiba heh tam la ai ha ka jingkwah brai, naduh u nongiathuhlypa wat haduh u lyngdoh ruh uwei pa uwei u iap thok .

en: When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us  ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :
kha: U kynrad jong ka ïing un khie bad un khang ïa ka jingkhang ; nangta haba phi ïeng shabar bad sdang ban tied ha ka jingkhang bad ong , ‘ To plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong ngi , ko kynrad !’ Un jubab ïa phi , ‘ Ngam ithuh ïa phi nangno phi ïawan !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u trai iing u la ieng, bad u la khang ia ka jingkhang, bad phi sdang ban ieng shabar, bad ban tied ia ka jingkhang, da kaba ong: Ko Trai, ko Trai, to plie ia ngi; bad un jubab bad un ong ha phi: Ngam tip ia phi naei phi:

en: Because they have forsaken me , and have estranged this place , and have burned incense in it unto other gods , whom neither they nor their fathers have known , nor the kings of Judah , and have filled this place with the blood of innocents  ;
kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ki la pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka da kaba ai jingkñia hangne sha kiwei pat ki blei — ki blei kiba ym ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki lymne ki syiem jong ka Judah ki la tip ei ei . Ki la pyndap ïa kane ka jaka da ka snam jong ki briew kiba lui lui ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la iehnoh ia nga bad ki la pynkyrpang ia kane ka jaka bad ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha kiwei pat ki blei kiba kim tip ne ki kpa tymmen jong ki, ne ki syiem Judah bad ki la pyndap ia kane ka jaka da ka snam jong ki bym don pop ; .

en: And when he had brought him down , behold , they were spread abroad upon all the earth , eating and drinking , and dancing , because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines , and out of the land of Judah .
kha: Bad u leit ïalam ïa u Dabid sha ki . Ki nonglute ki saphriang kylleng ka jaka , ki da ïabam , ki da ïadih , bad ki da lehkmen , namar ki la ïoh lute shibun na ka ri ki Philistia bad na ka ri Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wanrah ia u shapoh , ha khmih ki la saphriang kylleng ka ri , ki la bam bad ki dih bad ki shad namar ka jinglute kaba khraw baroh kaba ki la shim na ka ri ki Philistia bad na ka ri Judah .

en: But the angel of the  Lord  said to Elijah the Tishbite , Arise , go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria , and say unto them , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel , that ye go to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron ?
kha: Hynrei u angel U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Elijah , u nongïathuhlypa na Tishbe , ban leit bad ïashem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u syiem Ahasaïah bad ban kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi leit ban kylli ïa u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron ? Hato ka dei namar ba phi pyrkhat ba ym don blei ha Israel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u angel U Trai u la ong ha u Elijah u Tishbite, To kiew, to leit sha ki nonglam khubor jong u syiem ka Samaria bad to ong ha ki: Hato kam dei namar ba ym don U Blei ha Israel , ba phi leit kylli ia u Baalzebul u blei jong u Ekron ?

en: And Judah said , What shall we say unto my lord ? what shall we speak ? or how shall we clear ourselves ? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants : behold , we are my lord s servants , both we , and he also with whom the cup is found .
kha: U Judah u ong ,  Ko kynrad , ngin ong aïu pat ha phi ? Kumno keiñ ngin ïasaid ? Kumno keiñ ngi lah ban sait khuid ïa lade ? U Blei u la lap ïa kane ka kam bymman jong ngi . Mynta te , baroh ngi long ki mraw jong phi , bad ym tang uta na uba la shem ïa ka khuri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong: Ngi ong aiu ia u kynrad jong nga ? kaei kaba ngin kren ? lane kumno ngin pynkhuid ia lade ? U Blei u la lap ia ka jingbymhok jong ki shakri jong me: ha khmih ngi long ki shakri kynrad jong nga, ma ngi ruh bad ma u ruh bad uba la lap ia ka khuri .

en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you : that in the seventh month , on the tenth day of the month , ye shall afflict your souls , and do no work at all , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger that sojourneth among you :
kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban bud pateng la pateng . Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong ryngkat bad ki , ki dei ban shahjingit bad ban ym trei ïa kano kano ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka hukum junom ha phi: ba ha ka sngi kaba hynriew jong u bnai , phin pynshitom ia ki mynsiem jong phi bad phin ym leh ei ei ruh em, la ka long kawei na la ka jong ka ri ne u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong phi:

en: Then shall his brother s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders , and loose his shoe from off his foot , and spit in his face , and shall answer and say , So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother s house .
kha: kata ka hynmen kynsi jong u kan leit sha u ha khmat kita ki nongïalam shnong , kan loit kawei ka juti jong u , kan bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u , bad kan ong , ‘ Kumne yn leh ïa uta u briew u bym treh ban ai symbai ïa la u hynmen .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka tnga jong u hynmen jong u kan wan sha u ha khmat ki rangbah, bad kan pyllait ia ka juti jong u na ka kjat jong u, bad kan sngap jar ha ka khmat jong u, bad kan jubab bad ong: Kumta yn leh ia uta u briew u bym tei ia ka iing jong u hynmen jong u .

en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the  Lord  , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .
kha: Ki kylla long kiba khuid haba la wanrah ïa ki ha ka duwan U  Trai . Kumta , shim ïa ki khiew buh ding jong kita ki briew kiba la shah pynïap namar ki pop jong ki , shoh pynstang ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan . Kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleh pop jong kine ki nongpop pyrshah ia la ka jong ka mynsiem , to ai ba kin pynlong ia ki da ki pliang kiba heh na ka bynta ka jingtap ia ka altar: namar ki la tyrwa ia ki ha khmat U Trai: namarkata ki long kiba la pynkyntang: bad kin long ka dak ia ki khun Israel .

en: A man to whom God hath given riches , wealth , and honour , so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth , yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof , but a stranger eateth it : this is vanity , and it is an evil disease .
kha: U Blei un ai ha ngi ka spah , ka burom bad ka jingdon jingem , ho-oid baroh kaba ngi kwah , hynrei un ym shah ïa ngi ban ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Pynban uwei pat u nongwei un ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Ka long ka bymmyntoi , bad ka shu long ka bym dei .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba U Blei u la ai ia ka spah, ka spah bad ka burom, haduh ba um kwah ei ei na ka bynta ka mynsiem jong u na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba u kwah, hynrei U Blei um ai bor ia u ban bam ia ka: kane ka long ka jingbym don jingmut bad ka long ka jingpang kaba sniew .

en: And between the passages , by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines  garrison , there was a sharp rock on the one side , and a sharp rock on the other side : and the name of the one was Bozez , and the name of the other Seneh .
kha: Ha ka khim Mikhmash , na kaba u Jonathan u hap ban ïaid lyngba ban poi sha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia , don ar tylli ki mawlong baheh kiba sohkhruh sohkhram , uwei uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka khim : ïa uwei la khot u Boses bad ïa uwei pat u Seneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapdeng ki lynti, da kaba u Jonathan u la wad ban leit sha ki Philistia garrison, u don u maw uba jem na kawei ka liang: bad ka kyrteng jong uta uba jem na kawei pat ka liang: bad ka kyrteng jong uta uba jem ka long u Boez bad ka kyrteng jong uwei pat u Seneh .

en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly , that said in her heart , I am , and there is none beside me : how is she become a desolation , a place for beasts to lie down in ! every one that passeth by her shall hiss , and wag his hand .
kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka nongbah kaba sarong katta katta ïa la ka bor bad kaba pyrkhat ba ka don ha ka jingshngain . Ki briew jong ka ki pyrkhat ba ka nongbah jong ki ka long kaba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei . Katno kan long ka jaka kaba kynjah , ka jaka ha kaba ki mradkhlaw kin pynjahthait ! Uwei uwei baroh uba ïaid lyngba jong ka un kynran dien ha ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka nongbah kaba kmen kaba shong khlem da pyrkhat, kaba ong ha ka dohnud jong ka, nga long, bad ym don shuh hajan jong nga: kumno ka kylla long ka jingpynjot , ka jaka na ka bynta ki mrad ban thiah ! uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba jong ka un rkhie bein ia ka kti jong u .

en: Behold , I will bring them from the north country , and gather them from the coasts of the earth , and with them the blind and the lame , the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together : a great company shall return thither .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa ki na shaphang shatei bad ngan lumlang ïa ki na kiba kut ka pyrthei . Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh kin wan lang bad ki , ki kynthei ba la armet bad kito ki ban sa kha . Kin sa long pat ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ki na ki rud duriaw , bad ngan lum ia ki na ki pud jong ka khyndew , bad ki kiba matlah bad kiba lyngkhuid , ka kynthei kaba don khun bad ka kaba kha khun lang: ka kynhun kaba khraw kan wan phai noh sha kata .

en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering , that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat , and before the mercy seat :
kha: Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta u paidbah , un rah ïa ka snam jong u sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un synreit ïa ka halor ka jingtap bad ha khmat jong ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba u la leh da ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un pyniap ia u blang jong ka jingknia pop, kaba long na ka bynta ki briew, bad un wanrah ia ka snam jong u hapoh ka jingtap , bad un leh ia kata ka snam kumba u la leh da ka snam jong u masi , bad un theh ia ka ha ka jaka ba la shet da ka jingisynei:

en: Only be thou strong and very courageous , that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law , which Moses my servant commanded thee : turn not from it to the right hand or to the left , that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest .
kha: Me dei ban da kut jingmut triang , ban long skhem bad ban pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u shakri jong nga , u Moses u la ai ha me . Wat leh klet ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka , bad men sa jop kat shaba me leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ma me uba khlain bad uba shlur shibun, ba me lah ban peit bniah kat kum ka hukum baroh kaba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la hukum ia me: wat phai noh na ka sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang, ba me lah ban roi shano shano ruh ba me leit .

en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood , ( for under it the people received the law , ) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?
kha: Dei ha ka nongrim jong ka jinglong lyngdoh ki Lebi ba la ai ïa ka Hukum ha ki paid Israel . Mynta , lada ka kam lyngdoh jong ki Lebi ka la long kaba janai , yn ym donkam shuh ïa uwei pat u lyngdoh ban mih , uwei uba na ka jinglong lyngdoh u Melkhisedek , ym jong u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada namarkata ka jinglong janai ka long da ka jinglong lyngdoh jong ki Lebi , (namar hapoh jong ka ki briew ki la ioh ia ka hukum , ) kaei pat ka jingdonkam ba uwei pat u lyngdoh un kiew hadien ka jingpynbeit jong u Melchisedec , bad ym dei ban khot hadien ka jingpynbeit jong u Aaron ?

en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers , which refused to hear my words  ; and they went after other gods to serve them : the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers .
kha: Ki la leit phai pat sha ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba la kyntait ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Baroh ar , ka Israel bad ka Judah ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki phai biang sha ki jingbymhok jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba la kyntait ban iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga ; bad ki la leit bud ia kiwei pat ki blei ban shakri ia ki: ka iing Israel bad ka iing Judah ki la pynkhein ia ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la leh bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime  ; but the children of Esau succeeded them , when they had destroyed them from before them , and dwelt in their stead  ; as Israel did unto the land of his possession , which the  Lord  gave unto them .
kha: Ki Hor ki la ju shong ha Edom , hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong u Iso ki beh ïa ki , ki pynjot ïa ka ri jong ki , bad ki buhai shnong ïa lade hangta , kumjuh kumba ki Israel kham hadien ki beh ïa ki nongshun jong ki na kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Horim ruh ki la shong ha Seir shuwa shuwa; hynrei ki khun u Iso ki la jop ia ki, haba ki la pynjot ia ki na khmat jong ki, bad ki la shong ha ka jaka jong ki; kumba ki Israel ki la leh ha ka ri jong u, kaba U Trai u la ai ha ki .

en: For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
kha: U Blei u long uta uba la thaw ïa ki lumbah bad uba pynlong ïa ki lyer . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u briew ; u pynkylla ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U ïaid ha kiba kynjang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong u : U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, uta uba pynlong ia ki lum, bad uba pynmih ia ka Iyer, bad uba pynbna ha u briew ia kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong u, uba pynlong ia ka jingdum mynstep, bad uba iaid ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ka khyndew, U Trai , U Blei jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .
kha: Ki lyngdoh ki ïeng hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lut ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua ban ong ïa u paidbah ban leh . Kane ka dei kata kaba u Moses u la hukum . U paidbah u la pynkloi sha shiliang ka wah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk ki la ieng hapdeng ka Jordan, haduh ba baroh ki la dep ba U Trai u la hukum ia u Joshua ban kren ha ki briew, kat kum baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum ia u Joshua: bad ki briew ki la kyrkieh bad ki la iaid lait noh .

en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons , Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations , as I commanded , saying , Aaron and his sons shall eat it .
kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,  Rah ïa kane ka doh sha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , shet ïa ka , bad bam hangta ïa ka bad u kpu uba don ha ka shang ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh ka jingpynkyntang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u, To pynkhluit ia ka doh ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain: bad hangta to bam ia u kpu uba don ha ka lyngkhot jong ki jingpynkyntang , kumba nga la hukum da kaba ong , u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin bam ia u .

en: And they came , every one whose heart stirred him up , and every one whom his spirit made willing , and they brought the  Lord s  offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation , and for all his service , and for the holy garments .
kha: bad baroh kiba mon ban leh kumta , ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  ïa kaba yn pyndonkam ha kaba shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki wallam kat ïa kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingmane , bad na ka bynta ban thain ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan, uwei pa uwei uba ka dohnud jong u ka la pynkhih ia u, bad uwei pa uwei uba ka mynsiem jong u ka la mon , bad ki la wanrah ia ka jingainguh U Trai ha ka kam jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , bad na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong u baroh , bad na ka bynta ki jain bakhuid .

en: Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .
kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki paid Israel , phi kiba hiarpateng na u Judah : Phi smai da ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad kam ba phi mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynrei phim shym buh jingmut ïa kawei ruh ka ktien kaba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane, ko iing u Jakob, kiba la khot da ka kyrteng Israel bad ki mih na ki um Judah kiba smai da ka kyrteng U Trai bad ki kdew ia U Blei jong ki Israel hynrei ym ha ka jingshisha ne ha ka hok .

en: Then David said unto the messenger , Thus shalt thou say unto Joab , Let not this thing displease thee , for the sword devoureth one as well as another : make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it : and encourage thou him .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha uta u nonglamktien ,  Pynshlur ïa u Joab bad ong ïa u ba un ym khuslai , namar phim lah ban ong mano ban ïap ha ka thma . Ïathuh ïa u ban pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kham khlaiñ ïa ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong ha u nonglam khubor: Kumta to ong ha u Joab, Wat ai ba kane ka jingkren kan pynsngewsih ia me, namar ka waitlam ka bam ia uwei kumjuh: pynlong ia ka thma jong me kaba kham khlain pyrshah ia ka shnong, bad me pynshlur ia u: bad me pynshlur ia u .

en: Rejoice , O young man , in thy youth  ; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth , and walk in the ways of thine heart , and in the sight of thine eyes : but know thou , that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment .
kha: Ko samla , to lehkmen ïa ka jinglong samla jong phi . To kmen katba phi dang samla . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh , bad bud ïa ka jingkwah ka dohnud jong phi . Hynrei kynmaw ba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To kmen ko samla, ha ka por samla jong me bad to ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan pynkmen ia me ha ki sngi samla jong me, bad to iaid ha ki lynti jong ka dohnud jong me, bad ha khmat ki khmat jong me: hynrei to tip ia me, ba na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh U Blei un wanrah ia me ha ka jingbishar .

en: When I shall say to the righteous , that he shall surely live  ; if he trust to his own righteousness , and commit iniquity , all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered  ; but for his iniquity that he hath committed , he shall die for it .
kha: Nga lah ban kular ha u briew uba bha , hynrei lada u sdang ban pyrkhat ba ka jingleh babha jong u kaba mynshuwa ka la biang bad u sdang ban leh pop , Ngan ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha ba u la leh . Un ïap namar ki pop jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ngan ong ha u hok , ba un im shuh shuh ha la ka jong ka hok bad un leh ia ka jingbymhok , ia ki hok jong u baroh yn ym kynmaw shuh shuh .

en: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury , and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego : therefore he spake , and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated .
kha: Te u Nebukhadnessar u la bitar , bad ka durkhmat jong u ka la kiew sawlep da ka jingbitar ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego . Kumta u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban pynkhluit ïa ka lawar ding hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Nebuchadnezzar u la dap da ka jingbitar, bad ka dur jong u ka la kylla pyrshah ia u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego: namarkata u la kren , bad u la hukum ba ki dei ban pynshit ia ka ding hynriew sien kham palat ia kaba ym lah ban pynshit ia ka .

en: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Beth–shemesh , and came to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate , four hundred cubits .
kha: U Jehoash u kem koidi ïa u Amasaïah , u tur shaphrang sha Jerusalem , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah naduh Khyrdop Ephraim haduh Khyrdop Kyndong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la shim ia u Amasaiah u khun u Ahasaiah ha Betheshemesh bad u la wan sha Jerusalem bad u la pynhap ia ka kynroh Jerusalem na ka khyrdop Ephram haduh ka khyrdop kaba saw spah .

en: And number thee an army , like the army that thou hast lost , horse for horse , and chariot for chariot : and we will fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they . And he hearkened unto their voice , and did so .
kha: Nangta sa khot bad buh da ka kynhun shipai kaba ka jingbun paid ka long kat kato kaba la phai dien noh na phi , buh katjuh ka jingbun ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ngin ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ki jaka madan , bad ha kane ka sien ngin jop ïa ki .  U syiem Benhadad u la mynjur bad bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to khein ia me ka kynhun shipai, kum ka kynhun shipai kaba me la duh noh, u kulai na ka bynta u kulai bad ka kali na ka bynta ka kali: bad ngin ialeh pyrshah ia ki ha ka madan , bad shisha ngin kham khlain ban ia ki . Bad u la sngap ia ka sur jong ki bad u la leh kumta .

en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? nay , they were not at all ashamed , neither could they blush : therefore shall they fall among them that fall : in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , hato phim lehrain namar ba phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli ? Em , phim shym lehrain satia ; phim shym tip hi ruh kumno ban sawkyr-ang ! Bad kumta phin kyllon kumba kiwei pat ki la kyllon ; haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , kata kan long ka jingkut jong phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki la sngewlehrain haba ki la leh ia ka kam kaba sngewsih ? hooid, kim shym la sngewlehrain satia, bad kim lah ban rkhie bein: namarkata kin hap hap hapdeng jong ki kiba hap: ha ka por ba ki leit jngoh ia ki kin shah pynhap noh , ong U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , that at midnight the  Lord  smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon  ; and all the firstborn of cattle .
kha: Hamar shiteng synñia U  Trai  u la pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh ha Ijipt , naduh u khun nyngkong jong u Pharaoh , u ban sa kiew khet , haduh u khun nyngkong jong u koidi uba ha ïingbyndi ; ïa baroh kiba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad ruh la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha ka por shiteng miet U Trai u la shoh ia u khun nyngkong baroh ha ka ri Ijipt , na u khun nyngkong jong u Pharaoh uba la shong ha ka khet jong u haduh u khun nyngkong jong u nongshah set phatok .

en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past , and it hath been testified to his owner , and he hath not kept him in , but that he hath killed a man or a woman  ; the ox shall be stoned , and his owner also shall be put to death .
kha: Hynrei lada uta u masi kyrtong mynshuwa ruh u dei uba la tynrah briew teng , bad u trai jong u um shym set ïa u wat haba la maham ïa u — te , lada u tynrah ïano ïano , shynrang ne kynthei haduh ban da ïap , dei ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad u trai jong u ruh u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u masi u la ju pynkhih ia ka horn jong u ha ki por ba la leit noh bad u la shah pyniap ha u trai jong u , bad um shym la buh ia u hapoh , hynrei ba u la pyniap ia u shynrang ne kynthei; ia u masi ruh yn pyniap .

en: Then Saul s anger was kindled against Jonathan , and he said unto him , Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman , do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion , and unto the confusion of thy mother s nakedness ?
kha: U Saul u bitar lep ïa u Jonathan bad u ong ha u ,  Me u khun pongka ! Mynta nga tip ba me ïashah liang bad u Dabid bad me pynjahburom ïa lade bad ïa kato ka kmie jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la bthei ha u Jonathan bad u la ong ha u, Me khun jong ka kynthei kaba leh pyrshah kaba bakla, ngam tip ba me la jied ia u khun jong u Jesse ha ka jingkulmar jong me hi bad ha ka jingkulmar jong ka kmie jong me ?

en: Even men , and women , and children , and the king s daughters , and every person that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Jeremiah the prophet , and Baruch the son of Neriah .
kha: Nangta u Johanan bad ki rangbah shipai baroh ki la shim noh ïa baroh kiba dang sah ha Judah sha Ijipt , lem bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la sakma kylleng : ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki khun kynthei jong u syiem . Ki la ïalam ïa baroh kiba u Nebusaradan u rangbah ai hukum u la ieh hapoh ka jingpeit u Gedalaïah , ba kynthup ïa u Barukh bad ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ki shynrang bad ki kynthei bad ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong u syiem bad uwei pa uwei u rangbah shipai u la leit noh bad u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam u khun u Shaphan bad u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa bad u Barukh u khun u Neriah .

en: And it came to pass , when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only .
kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la wan phai na Ijipt , ki khot sngewbha ïa u sha ka jingïalang paidbah bad ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ki Israel . Tang ka jait Judah kaba ïaisah ban ïaineh bad kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki Israel baroh ki la iohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la wan phai biang, ba ki la phah bad khot ia u ha ka jingiaseng bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u halor ki Israel baroh: ym don mano mano ruh kiba bud ia ka iing u Dabid hynrei tang ka jait Judah .

en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle : set yourselves , stand ye still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  with you , O Judah and Jerusalem : fear not , nor be dismayed  ; to morrow go out against them : for the  Lord  will be with you .
kha: Phin ym hap ban ïaleh ïa kane ka thma . Shu don ha la ki jaka bad ap ; phin ïohi U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa phi . Ko ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , wat sangeh ne sheptieng . Leit sha ka thma , bad U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Phi nym donkam ban ialeh ha kane ka thma: to buh ia lade, to ieng bad to iohi ia ka jingpynim U Trai bad phi, ko Judah bad Jerusalem: wat tieng, lymne to sngewsih; to leit shabar pyrshah ia ki: namar U Trai un don ryngkat bad phi .

en: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire , that thou mayest be rich  ; and white raiment , that thou mayest be clothed , and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear  ; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve , that thou mayest see .
kha: Te nga ai jingmut ïa pha ban thied ksiar na nga , ka ksiar banylla , khnang ba phan riewspah . Thied ruh ïa ki jaiñkup balieh ban kup ïa lade bad ban tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit bakhlemrain jong pha . Thied ruh katto katne ka jingtah ban tah ha ki khmat jong pha , khnang ba pha lah ban ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ai jingmut ia me ban thied na nga ia ka ksiar ba la pyrshang ha ka ding, ba me long uba riewspah bad uba lieh, ba me shah rong saw, bad ba ka jingsngewlehrain jong ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me kan ym paw shuh shuh bad pynsleh ia ki khmat jong me da ka jingsngewsih, ba me lah ban iohi .

en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity : because they trespassed against me , therefore hid I my face from them , and gave them into the hand of their enemies : so fell they all by the sword .
kha: Bad ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ki Israel ki la shah ringmraw namar ki pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga . Nga la phai noh na ki bad nga la shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongwei kin tip ba ka iing Israel ka la leit sha ka jingbymhok jong ki: namar ki la iaid lait ia nga: namar ki la iaid lait ia nga: namar kata nga la buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na ki: bad nga la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki: kumta ki la hap baroh da ka waitlam .

en: Therefore will I number you to the sword , and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter : because when I called , ye did not answer  ; when I spake , ye did not hear  ; but did evil before mine eyes , and did choose that wherein I delighted not .
kha: Kan dei ka kupar jong phi ban ïap ka jingïap bashyrkhei , namar phim shym la jubab haba nga khot ïa phi lane shahshkor haba nga kren . Phi jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan khein ia phi ha ka waitlam, bad phi baroh phin dem khrup ha ka jingpyniap: namar haba nga la khot , phim shym la jubab ; haba nga la kren , phim shym la iohsngew ; hynrei phi la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat jong nga , bad phi la jied ia kata ha kaba ngam shym la sngewbha .

en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the  Lord  at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me , and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .
kha: U la ong ha lade ,  Kumba kiei kiei ki long mynta , lada ki briew jong nga ki leit sha Jerusalem bad ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  ha ka templ kaba don hangta , kin pynkynriah ka jingnguh syiem na nga sha u Rehoboam u syiem ka Judah bad kin sa pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada une u briew u leit sha ka iing U Trai ha Jerusalem , te ka dohnud jong une u briew kan phai biang sha u kynrad jong ki, wat sha u syiem Rehoboam jong ka Judah bad kin pyniap ia nga bad kin leit phai biang sha u syiem Rehoboam jong ka Judah .

en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .
kha: Kumta te , uno uno u bymkohnguh wat ïa iba rit tam jong ki hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei pat ban leh kumjuh , un long uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng . Ha kawei pat ka liang , uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei ban leh kumjuh , un long uba khraw ha ka Hima ki Bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pynkhein ia kawei na kine ki hukum kiba rit tam, bad un hikai ia ki briew kumta, yn khot ia u uba rit tam ha ka hima bneng: hynrei uno uno uba leh bad hikai ia ki, ia uta hi yn khot ha ka hima bneng .

en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee ? are not his servants come unto thee for to search , and to overthrow , and to spy out the land ?
kha: ki nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki ong ïa u syiem ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ka long na ka bynta ka burom i pa jong phi ba u Dabid u phah ïa kine ki rangbah ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem ha phi ? Kam long kumta ! U phah ïa ki hangne kum ki nongsyntiat ban khmih ïa ka ri khnang ba un jop ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong ki khun Ammon ki la ong ha u Hanun, Phi tharai ba u Dabid u burom ia u kpa jong me, ba u la phah ia ki nongpyntngen sha me ? hato ki shakri jong u kim wan sha me ban wad bad ban pynkhih ia ka ri ?

en: For he did put his life in his hand , and slew the Philistine , and the  Lord  wrought a great salvation for all Israel : thou sawest it , and didst rejoice : wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood , to slay David without a cause ?
kha: U la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim mynba u pynïap ïa u Goliath , bad U  Trai  u la pynïoh ïa ka jingjop kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel . Mynba phi ïohi ïa kata , phi la sngewkmen . Balei te mynta , phi kwah ban leh bymdei ïa u briew uba lui lui bad ban pynïap ïa u Dabid khlem kano kano ka daw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la buh ia ka jingim jong u ha ka kti jong u, bad u la pyniap ia u Philistia, bad U Trai u la leh ia ka jingpynim kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel baroh: me la iohi ia ka, bad me la sngewbha: namar kata te me leh pop pyrshah ia ka snam bym don pop, ban pyniap ia u Dabid khlem daw ?

en: But it shall come to pass , if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day  ; that all these curses shall come upon thee , and overtake thee :
kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad phim sumar hok ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ baroh ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , kine ki jingtim baroh kin sa ngat ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kan sa jia lada phim sngap ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me, ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u baroh bad ki ain jong u kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi; ba kine ki jingtim baroh kin wan ha me, bad kin sa wan ha me:

en: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .
kha: Bad haba la kem ïa phi bad ïalam sha ka ïingbishar , wat khuslai lypa ïa kaei kaba phin kren ; haba ka por kan poi , to kren ïa kaei kaei kaba yn sa ai ha phi ha kata ka por . Namar ki ktien kiba phin sa kren , kin ym long ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba kin ialam ia phi bad ki ai ia phi, wat pyrkhat lypa ia kaei kaba phin kren: hynrei kaei kaei kaba phin sa ai ha kata ka kynta: namar ym ma phi kaba kren hynrei U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: So Gideon , and the hundred men that were with him , came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch  ; and they had but newly set the watch : and they blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers that were in their hands .
kha: U Gideon bad ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha tduh kata ka jaka sher dara shuwa ka por shiteng synñia , hamar ba dang dep ïa-bujli ïa ki nongap phira . Nangta ki put ïa ki turoi bad ki pynpait ïa ki khra ba ki bat , bad kita ki ar kynhun ruh ki leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Gideon bad ki shispah ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la wan shabar jong ka jaka sah ha kaba sdang jong ka jingpahara pdeng .

en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle , and the fruit of thy land , until thou be destroyed : which also shall not leave thee either corn , wine , or oil , or the increase of thy kine , or flocks of thy sheep , until he have destroyed thee .
kha: Kin bam ïa ki jingri jingdup bad ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad phin ïapthngan . Kin ym pynsah ei ei , ïa u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ki masi , lane ki langbrot ; bad phin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un bam ia u soh jong ki masi jong me bad u soh jong ka ri jong me, haduh ba phin da shah pynjot: kaba ruh kan ym iehnoh ia me ne u kew ne ka umphniang ne ka jingbun ki masi jong me ne ki kynhun langbrot jong me, haduh ba un da pynjot ia me .

en: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters  vessel that is broken in pieces  ; he shall not spare : so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth , or to take water withal out of the pit .
kha: Phin sa pra kum u khra , uba la phret jin haduh ba ym don shuh ka lyngkhot , da kaba yn lah ban khat ïa ki rnga bakhluit , lane tong um na ka pung-um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynpra ia ka kum ka jingpynkhluit ia ki khiew ba la tyrkhong um: khnang ba yn ym lap ha ka jingbthei jong ka da ka shyntur ban thang ding na ka ding , ne ban shim um na ka thliew .

en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer , and lay them up without the camp in a clean place , and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation : it is a purification for sin .
kha: Nangta uno uno u briew u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un khat ïa u dpei jong kata ka masi bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam shabar ka jaka sher dara , ha kaba dei ban buh kyrpang ïa ka hangta na ka bynta ka kynhun Israel ban pyndonkam ha kaba pynkhreh ïa ka um na ka bynta ka jingweng ïa ka jingbymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam . Ïa kane ka jinglehniam dei ban leh ban weng ïa ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u briew uba khuid un lum ia ka dewbilat jong ka masi , bad un buh ia ki shabar ka jaka kaba khuid , bad yn buh ia ka na ka bynta ka jingiaseng ki Israel na ka bynta ka um pyniakhlad: ka long ka jingpynkhuid ia ka pop .

en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , and took Ijon , and Abel–beth–maachah , and Janoah , and Kedesh , and Hazor , and Gilead , and Galilee , all the land of Naphtali , and carried them captive to Assyria .
kha: Ka la jia ba katba u Pekah u long syiem ba u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u kurup ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ijon , ka Abel Beth Maakah , ka Janoah , ka Kedesh , bad ka Hasor , bad ki ri jong ka Gilead , ka Galilaïa , bad ka Naphtali , bad u rah koidi ïa ki briew sha Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi u syiem Pekah u la wan u Tiglathun u syiem ka ri Asyria, bad u la shim ia ki ha ka ri Asyria baroh kawei.

en: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers  ; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them , and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them .
kha: Bad lada ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Aiñ baroh ba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ha ki , nangta ngan ym shah ba yn beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ym pynlong shuh ia ki kjat Israel ban mih na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ; tang lada kin sumar ban leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia ki , bad kat kum ka hukum baroh kaba u Moses jong nga u la hukum ia ki .

en: Why do we sit still ? assemble yourselves , and let us enter into the defenced cities , and let us be silent there : for the  Lord  our God hath put us to silence , and given us water of gall to drink , because we have sinned against the  Lord .
kha: Balei ba ngi ïashong khop ?  Ki briew jong U Blei ki ïakylli .  Ale , ngin ïaphet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , bad ïap hangta . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynrem ïa ngi ban ïap ; u la ai ha ngi ka bih ban dih , namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ngi shong sah ? to ngin ia lum lang ia lade, bad to ngin ia sngap jar hangta: namar U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la buh ia ngi ban sngap jar, bad u la ai ia ngi ia ka um kaba jyrngam ban dih, namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And , behold , one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips : then I opened my mouth , and spake , and said unto him that stood before me , O my lord , by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me , and I have retained no strength .
kha: Nangta u angel , uba syriem ïa u briew , u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga . Nga la ong ha u ,  Ko rangbah , kane ka jingïohipaw ka pyntlot ïa nga haduh katta katta ba ngam lah ban sangeh ban khynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei kum ka jingiasyriem jong ki khun shynrang u la ktah ia ki rmiang shyntur jong nga: nangta nga la plie ia ka shyntur jong nga, bad nga la kren bad nga la ong ha uta uba ieng ha khmat jong nga, ko kynrad jong nga, da ka jingphohsniew jong nga ki la kylla ha nga, bad ngam shym la bat ia ka bor .
