en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country : Is not the  Lord  in Zion ? is not her king in her ? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images , and with strange vanities ?
kha: Shahshkor ! Ha kylleng ka ri nga ïohsngew ba ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam ,  Hato U  Trai  um don shuh ha Seïon ? Hato u syiem ka Seïon um don shuh hangta ?  U  Trai  , u syiem jong ki , u jubab ,  Balei phi la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong phi bad da kaba nguh dem ïa ki blei nongwei bymmyntoi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka sur jong ka jingud jong ka khun jong ki briew jong nga namar jong ki kiba shong ha ka ri kaba jngai: Hato U Trai ha Seion ? hato u syiem jong ka ha ka ? Balei ki la pynkhih ia nga ban bitar da ki dur ba la ker jong ki bad da ki jinglong ba phylla jong ki ?

en: And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .
kha: Ngan sa ïakynduh ïa me hangta , bad najrong jong ka jingtap kaba hapdeng kita ki kherub ar tylli , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ngan iakynduh bad me, bad ngan iakynduh bad me na jrong ka jaka shong jingisynei, na ki ar tylli ki cherub kiba don halor ka synduk ka jingsakhi , na kiei kiei baroh kiba ngan ai ha me ha ka hukum ha ki khun Israel .

en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves , and that they should come and keep the gates , to sanctify the sabbath day . Remember me , O my God , concerning this also , and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy .
kha: Nga la hukum ïa ki Lebi ban pynkhuid ïa lade bad ban leit bad pahara ïa ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ba ïa ka sngi Sabbaton la sumar khuid ïa ka . Kynmaw ïa nga , A Blei , na ka bynta kane ruh , bad tyngkai ïa nga namar ka jingieit bakhraw jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hukum ia ki Lebi ba kin pynkhuid ia lade, bad ba kin wan bad sumar ia ki khyrdop, ban pynkhuid ia ka sngi Sabha . Kynmaw ia nga, ko Blei jong nga, shaphang kane ruh, bad pyllait im ia nga kat kum ka jingkhraw jong ka jingisynei jong me .

en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me ! turning away he hath divided our fields .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa ka jingïathuhkhana jong phi kum ka nuksa ïa ka jingpynjot , bad kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsih ïa ka jingshem jong phi :  La pynjot thiaw ïa ngi ! U  Trai  u la shim noh ïa ka ri jong ngi bad u la ai ïa ka sha kito kiba la ring koidi ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi un shim ia ka pharshi pyrshah ia phi, bad un iam da ka jingsngewsih kaba sngewsih: u la pynkylla lut ia ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga: kumno u la weng noh ia ka na nga ! da kaba phai noh u la phiah ia ki lyngkha jong ngi .

en: The  Lord  hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest , that ye should be officers in the house of the  Lord  , for every man that is mad , and maketh himself a prophet , that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa phi u lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u Jehoïada , bad mynta phi long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka Templ . Ka dei ka kamram jong phi ban khmih ba ïa uwei pa uwei u riewlamwir uba leh mynleh ba u long u nongïathuhlypa dei ban buh ha ki kynjri lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba da ka nar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynlong ia me u lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u Jehoiada u lyngdoh, ba phin long ki ophisar ha ka iing U Trai, namar uwei pa uwei u briew uba la mad, bad u pynlong ia lade u nongiathuhlypa, ba phin buh ia u ha phatok bad ha ki dieng .

en: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren , and that he turn not aside from the commandment , to the right hand , or to the left : to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom , he , and his children , in the midst of Israel .
kha: Da kumta un ym sngew ba u kham halor ban ïa la ki para Israel bad un ym lyndet da kumno kumno ruh ïa ki hukum U  Trai . Te un synshar bun snem , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u ruh kin ïoh synshar bun pateng ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka dohnud jong u kan ym kiew sha jrong halor ki hynmen jong u, bad ba un ym phai noh na ka hukum, sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang: haduh kaba kut ba un pynjlan ia ki sngi jong u ha ka hima jong u, ma u bad ki khun jong u, hapdeng ki Israel .

en: When I heard , my belly trembled  ; my lips quivered at the voice : rottenness entered into my bones , and I trembled in myself , that I might rest in the day of trouble : when he cometh up unto the people , he will invade them with his troops .
kha: Nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , bad nga kyiuh ; ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ki khih da ka jingsheptieng . Ka met jong nga ka jem lwep , bad ki kjat jong nga ki jynthut hapoh jong nga . Ngan ap jar jar ïa ka por ka ban wan haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la iohsngew, ka kpoh jong nga ka la khih ha ka sur: ka jingsniew ka la rung ha ki shyieng jong nga , bad nga la khih ha lade , ba ngan shongthait ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar: haba u wan shaneng sha ki briew , un hiar thma ia ki da ki shipai jong u .

en: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn , or of thy wine , or of thy oil , or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock , nor any of thy vows which thou vowest , nor thy freewill offerings , or heave offering of thine hand :
kha: Phim bit ban bam ha ki jaka ba phi shong ïa kata kaba phi wanrah sha U  Trai  , la ka dei kaba shiphew na u kew , na ka waiñ , ne na ka umphniang Olib jong phi ; lane kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi , ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular ha U  Trai  , ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi , lane kiwei kiwei pat ki jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bam hapoh ki khyrdop jong me ia ka shiphew jong u kew jong me, ne na ka wain jong me, ne na ka umphniang jong me, ne na ki jingbam ba nyngkong jong me ne na ka kynhun jong me, ne na ki jingkular jong me kiba me kular, ne ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong me, ne ki jingknia ba heh jong me:

en: Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods , and images of your mice that mar the land  ; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel : peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you , and from off your gods , and from off your land .
kha: Phi dei ban thaw ïa ki dur jong u thung bad ki dur khnai kiba la pynjulor ïa ka ri jong phi , bad phi dei ban ai burom ïa U Blei ki Israel . Lehse un sa sangeh noh na kaba pynshitom ïa phi , ïa ki blei jong phi , bad ïa ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin thaw ia ki dur jong ki khniang jong phi, bad ki dur jong ki miaw jong phi kiba pynsniew ia ka ri bad phin ai burom ia U Blei jong ki Israel: lehse un pynkhih ia la ka kti na phi, bad na ki blei jong phi, bad na ka ri jong phi .

en: For in very deed , as the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , which hath kept me back from hurting thee , except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me , surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .
kha: U  Trai  u la khang ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa phi . Hynrei nga smai da U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba lymda phi la pynkloi ban ïashem bad nga , baroh ki briew jong u Nabal kin jin da la ïap lut kat ban da mih ka step !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka jingleh kaba shisha, kumba U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u im, uba la pynsangeh ia nga ban pynmong ia me, lait noh tang ma me uba la kyrkieh bad wan iakynduh ia nga, shisha ym shym la iehnoh ia u Nabal ha ka jingshai mynstep ia uno uno uba la sngewsih pyrshah ia ka kynroh .

en: To become a friend of God , you must obtain a good knowledge of Bible truth ( 1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 ) , put faith in the things you have learned ( Hebrews 11 :6 ) , repent of your sins ( Acts 17 :30 , 31 ) , and turn around in your course of life .
kha: Ban long u paralok jong U Blei , phi dei ban tip bha shaphang ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl ( 1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 ) , ngeit ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ( Hebru 11 :6 ) , kylla ka bamut na ki pop jong phi ( Kam 17 :30 , 31 ) , bad pynkylla noh ïa la ka rukom im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban long u paralok U Blei , phi dei ban ioh ia ka jingtip kaba bha shaphang ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl (Temote 2:30), buh jingngeit ha kiei kiei kiba phi la nang (Hebru 11:6 )), kylla bamut na ki pop jong phi (Ki Kam 17 :30), bad phai noh ha ka jingim jong phi .

en: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary , having charge at the gates of the house , and ministering to the house : they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people , and they shall stand before them to minister unto them .
kha: Ki lah ban shakri ïa nga ha ka Templ da kaba khmih ïa ki khyrdop bad ban trei ïa ka kam jong ka Templ . Ki lah ban pynïap ïa ki mrad kiba ki briew ki ai na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia , bad kin don ha ka kam ban shakri ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kin long ki nongshakri ha ka jaka kyntang jong nga, ki da peit ha ki khyrdop jong ka iing: kin pyniap ia ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingknia na ka bynta ki briew , bad kin ieng ha khmat jong ki ban shakri ia ki .

en: And they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the people that were round about them , and bowed themselves unto them , and provoked the  Lord  to anger .
kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei uba la wallam ïa ki na Ijipt , bad ki la sdang ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong ki . Ki mane dem ïa ki , bad ki la pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki, uba la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt , bad ki la bud ia kiwei pat ki blei jong ki briew kiba la ker sawdong ia ki , bad ki la dem khrup ha ki , bad ki la pynkhih ia U Trai ban bitar .

en: Then the Philistines said , Who hath done this ? And they answered , Samson , the son in law of the Timnite , because he had taken his wife , and given her to his companion . And the Philistines came up , and burnt her and her father with fire .
kha: Haba ki Philistia ki kylli mano ba la leh ïa kane , ki tip ba dei u Samson uba la leh ïa kata namar ba u kthaw kurim jong u , uba na Timnah , u la ai noh ïa ka tnga jong u Samson ha u paralok jong u Samson . Kumta ki Philistia ki leit bad ki thang ïa kata ka kynthei ha ban da ïap bad thang ruh ïa ka ïing u kpa jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Philistia ki la ong: Mano ba la leh ia kane ? Ki la jubab, u Samson u khun jong u Timnite, namar u la shim ia ka tnga jong u bad u la ai ia ka ha u paralok jong u . Ki Philistia ki la wan shaneng bad ki la thang ia ka bad ia u kpa jong ka da ka ding .

en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man , and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd , to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him  ; but took the poor man s lamb , and dressed it for the man that was come to him .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , la wan poi u nongwankai ha ïing jong uba riewspah . Uta u riewspah um kwah ban pynïap ïa uwei na ki jingri jong u ban khreh bam ïa uta u nongwan ; pynban , u la shim ïa i khunlangbrot jong uba duk , bad u la khreh jingbam ïa u nongwankai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan uwei u nongleit jingleit sha uta u rangbah bad u la lait na ka bynta la ka jong ka kynhun bad na la ka jong ka kynhun , ban riam ia uta u briew uba la wan sha u ; hynrei u la shim ia uta u briew uba duk bad u la riam ia u na ka bynta uta u briew uba la wan sha u .

en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart , Who hath begotten me these , seeing I have lost my children , and am desolate , a captive , and removing to and fro ? and who hath brought up these ? Behold , I was left alone  ; these , where had they been ?
kha: Te phan ong ha lade , ‘ Mano ba la kha ïa kine ki khun baroh na ka bynta jong nga ? Nga la duh noh ïa la ki khun bad ngam lah ban ïoh khun shuh . Nga la shah ïalam mraw bad la shah beh noh — mano ba la pynheh pynsan ïa kine ki khun ? Nga la shah iehnoh marwei — nangno kine ki khun ki la wan ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ong ha ka dohnud jong me, Mano ba la kha ia nga ia kine, haba nga la duh noh ia ki khun jong nga, bad nga la jah noh, u nongshah set phatok bad u la leit noh sha ka ri ? bad mano ba la pynmih ia kine ? Ha khmih , nga la iehnoh marwei ia kine; shano ki la leit noh ?

en: In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho : he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn , and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun .
kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , u Hiel uba na Bethel u tei pat ïa ka Jerikho . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren da u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u Hiel u la duh noh ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Abiram mynba u buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka Jerikho , bad ïa u khun khatduh jong u , u Segub mynba u tei ïa ki khyrdop jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi jong u u Hiel u Bethelite u la tei ia ka Jerikho: u la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka ha Abiram u khun nyngkong jong u, bad u la buh ia ki khyrdop jong ka ha u khun ba rit tam jong u u Segub, kat kum ka ktien U Trai, kaba u la kren da u Joshua u khun u Nun .

en: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord  , in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe , in the higher court , at the entry of the new gate of the  Lord s  house , in the ears of all the people .
kha: Nangta , katba baroh ki briew ki dang ïasngap , u Barukh u la pule na ka kot kli ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la lah ong . U la leh ïa kane ha ka Templ , na ka kamra jong u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar . Ka kamra jong u ka don ha ka phyllaw kaba haneng hajan ka jaka ban rung sha ka Khyrdop Bathymmai jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Baruk u la pule ha ka Kitab ia ki ktien jong u Jeremaiah ha iing U Trai, ha ka kamra jong u Gemariah u khun u Shaphan u nongthoh, ha ka iing kaba kham halor, ha ka jingkhang thymmai jong ka iing U Trai, ha ki shkor jong ki briew baroh .

en: And they took two princes of the Midianites , Oreb and Zeeb  ; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb , and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb , and pursued Midian , and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan .
kha: Ki la kem ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb ; ki la pynïap ïa u Oreb ha u Mawsiang Oreb bad ïa u Seeb ha ka Thliew khem um sohwaiñ jong u Seeb . Ki bteng ban beh kthong ïa ki Midian bad ki wallam ïa ki khlieh jong u Oreb bad u Seeb sha u Gideon , uba don mynta sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim arngut ki rangbah jong ki nong Midian, u Oreb bad u Seeb ; bad ki la pyniap ia u Oreb halor u maw Oreb, bad u Seeb ki la pyniap ia u sohjew jong u Seeb, bad ki la beh ia u Madian, bad ki la wanrah ia ki khlieh jong u Oreb bad u Seeb sha u Gideon sha kawei pat ka liang jong u Jordan .

en: And he shall judge among the nations , and shall rebuke many people : and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
kha: Un bishar ïa ki jingkajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew . Kin tied tyrnem ïa ki waitlam jong ki sha ki jinglur lyngkha bad ïa ki sum jong ki sha ki waitbnoh khyllad tnat . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh thma shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un bishar hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad un pynrem ia kiba bun ki briew: bad kin shoh ia ki waitlam jong ki ha ki thliew , bad ki khnam jong ki ha ki thliew: ka jaitbynriew kan ym rah ia ka waitlam pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew , lymne kin ym nang thma shuh .

en: And Gideon said unto God , Let not thine anger be hot against me , and I will speak but this once : let me prove , I pray thee , but this once with the fleece  ; let it now be dry only upon the fleece , and upon all the ground let there be dew .
kha: Nangta u Gideon u ong ha U Blei ,  Wat bitar ïa nga ; shah ngan tynjuh sa tang shisien . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban pyrshang sa shisien da une u shñiuh langbrot . Ha kane ka sien , ai ba u shñiuh langbrot un rkhiang , bad ba ka khyndew pat kan jhieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la ong ha U Blei, Wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong me kan long kaba shit pyrshah ia nga, bad ngan kren tang ia kane tang shisien: to ngan pynshisha ia me, nga duwai ia me, hynrei kane tang shisien da ka snieh ; to ai ba mynta kan long kaba rkhiang tang ha ka snieh, bad ha ka khyndew baroh kan long ka dewbilat .

en: And he said unto him , We are passing from Beth–lehem–judah toward the side of mount Ephraim  ; from thence am I : and I went to Beth–lehem–judah , but I am now going to the house of the  Lord   ; and there is no man that receiveth me to house .
kha: U Lebi u jubab ,  Ngi wan na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah , bad mynta ngin leit sha la ïing , kaba sha kyndong ka ri lum Ephraim . Ym don mano mano ba khot sahmiet ïa ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Ngi iaid na Betlehemuda sha ka liang jong u lum Ephraim .

en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun , and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold , as the light of seven days , in the day that the  Lord  bindeth up the breach of his people , and healeth the stroke of their wound .
kha: U bnai un sa shai phyrnai kat ka sngi , bad ka sngi kan shai phyrnai hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba ju long , kum ka jingshai jong ki hynñiew sngi ha kawei ka sngi . Kane baroh kan jia haba U  Trai  un sop spaiñ bad pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong kiba u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka jingshai jong u bnai kan long kum ka jingshai jong ka sngi , bad ka jingshai jong ka sngi kan long hynriew shah , kum ka jingshai jong ki hynriew sngi , ha ka sngi ba U Trai u teh ia ka jingtwa jong ki briew jong u , bad u pynkoit ia ka jingmynsaw jong ki .

en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the  Lord   ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the  Lord  said to him by the hand of Moses .
kha: Kane ka la long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel ba uno uno u bym shym la hiarpateng na u Aaron um bit ban wan sha ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai  , lym kumta un shah pynjot thiaw kum u Korah bad ki nongbud jong u . Ïa kane baroh la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Eleasar da u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban long ka jingkynmaw ia ki khun Israel , ba ym don nongwei uba dei na u symbai u Aaron , uba wan hajan ban ai jingiwbih ha khmat U Trai ; ba um long kum u Korah bad kum ka kynhun jong u: kumba U Trai u la ong ha u da ka kti u Moses .

en: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , and saw an altar that was at Damascus : and king Ahaz sent to Uriah the priest the fashion of the altar , and the pattern of it , according to all the workmanship thereof .
kha: Haba u syiem Ahas u leit sha Damaskos ban ïakynduh ïa u Tiglath Pileser u Patsha , u ïohi ïa ka duwan hangta bad u phah pat sha u Uriah u lyngdoh ïa ka dur pyn-i jong ka , haduh ki jingbatai bniah kiba rit eh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ahasa u la leit sha Damaskos ban iakynduh ia u Tiglathun u syiem Assyria, bad u la iohi ia kawei ka jinglong jong ka: bad u syiem Ahasa u la phah sha u Lyngdoh ha Uliah u lyngdoh ia ka dur jong ka bad ka dur jong ka, kat kum ka jingtrei jong ka baroh .

en: They shall hold the bow and the lance : they are cruel , and will not shew mercy : their voice shall roar like the sea , and they shall ride upon horses , every one put in array , like a man to the battle , against thee , O daughter of Babylon .
kha: Ki la rah ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki long kiba runar bad ki bymsngewsynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki dang ïaid halor ki kulai . Ki long kiba la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin bat ia ka bow bad ka waitlam: ki long kiba shyrkhei, bad kin ym pyni ia ka jingsngewrit: ka sur jong ki kan khih kum ka duriaw , bad kin shong halor ki kulai , uwei pa uwei un shong ha ka jingpynbeit, kum u briew sha ka thma, pyrshah ia me, ko khun jong ka Babilon .

en: But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .
kha: Hynrei ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la beh nadien jong ki bad kem ïa u Sedekaïah ha ki pyntha hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalam ïa u sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , bad hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shipai Chalded ki la bud ia ki, bad ki la iaid lait ia u Sedekaiah ha ki madan Jerikho: bad haba ki la shim ia u, ki la wanrah ia u sha u Neuchadrezzar syiem Babilon ha Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , ha kaba u la bishar ia u .

en: For the statutes of Omri are kept , and all the works of the house of Ahab , and ye walk in their counsels  ; that I should make thee a desolation , and the inhabitants thereof an hissing : therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people .
kha: Kane kan jia namar ba phi la bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u syiem Omri bad jong u khun jong u , u syiem Ahab . Phi la ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom pynïaidkam jong ki , bad kumta ngan wallam ïa ka jingjot ha phi , bad baroh kin kyntait ïa phi . Ki briew ha kylleng kin ñiewbeiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki ain jong u Omri ki long kiba la buh, bad ki kam baroh jong ka iing u Ahab, bad phi iaid ha ki jingthmu jong ki ; ba ngan pynlong ia me ka jingpynjot , bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ka long kaba sngewsih namarkata: phin kit ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ki briew jong nga .

en: Lift up thine eyes round about , and behold : all these gather themselves together , and come to thee . As I live , saith the  Lord  , thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all , as with an ornament , and bind them on thee , as a bride doeth .
kha: Khmih baroh sawdong bad peit kaei kaba jia ! Ki briew jong pha ki ïalumlang — ki ïawan sha la ïing ! Kumba nga long U Blei uba im , phan sngewsarong ïa la ki briew , kumba sngewsarong ka nongleitkurim ïa la ki mawlynnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia ki khmat jong me sawdong, bad ha khmih: kine baroh ki ia lum lang bad ki wan sha me . Kumba nga im, ong U Trai, men phong ia me da ki baroh, kumba da ka jingpynitynnad, bad to teh ia ki ha me, kumba leh ka nongleitkurim .

en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom , and upright ones with him  ; thus shall he do : and he shall give him the daughter of women , corrupting her : but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him .
kha: U syiem ka Syria un pynkhreh ka jinghiarthma , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei . Nangta , khnang ban pynjot ïa ka hima jong u nongshun , un pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u bad tyrwa ha u ban shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei ka jingthmu jong u kan ym jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Un buh ruh ia ka khmat jong u ban rung da ka bor jong ka hima baroh kawei, bad kiba hok bad u; kumta un leh: bad un ai ia u ia ka khun kynthei, da kaba pynsniew ia ka: hynrei kan ym ieng ha ka liang jong u: hynrei kan ym long na ka bynta jong u .

en: And I said unto them , We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews , which were sold unto the heathen  ; and will ye even sell your brethren ? or shall they be sold unto us ? Then held they their peace , and found nothing to answer .
kha: Katba ngi lah , ngi la ïathied pat ïa ki para Jiw ïa kiba la die sha ki nongwei . Mynta phi pynlong ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi ban die ïa lade ha phi , ki para Jiw jong ki !  Ki nongïalam ki la sngap jar bad kim don ei ei ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha ki , Ngi hadien ka jinglah jong ngi ngi la siewspah ia ki para Jiw jong ngi kiba la die sha ki nongwei ; bad hato phin die wat ia ki para jong phi ? lane kin die ha ngi ? Nangta ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki, bad kim shem ei ei ban jubab .

en: And the sun stood still , and the moon stayed , until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies . Is not this written in the book of Jasher ? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven , and hasted not to go down about a whole day .
kha: Ka sngi ka la ïeng thik bad u bnai um shym khih tad haduh ba ka jaitbynriew ka la jop thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong ka . Ïa kane la thoh ha ka  Kitab u Jashar . Ka sngi ka la sangeh hapdeng ka sahit bneng bad kam shym la sep ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sngi ka la ieng sahkut, bad u bnai u la sahkut, haduh ba ki briew kim shym la pynrem ia ki nongshun jong ki . Hato kane kam shym la thoh ha ka kot u Jasher ? Kumta ka sngi ka la ieng sahkut hapdeng ka bneng , bad kam shym la kyrkieh ban hiar shapoh ka sngi baroh kawei .

en: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering , the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel : but the  Lord  thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines , and discomfited them  ; and they were smitten before Israel .
kha: Katba u Samuel u dang ai ïa ka jingkñia , ki Philistia ki tur sha jan ban ïaleh ; hynrei hangta U  Trai  u kyrhuh kum u pyrthat na bneng pyrshah ïa ki . Ki la shaïong ngaiñ , bad ki la phet krad ha ka jingkulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u Samuel u dang ai ia ka jingainguh thang , ki Philistia ki la jan ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel: hynrei U Trai u la pyrta da ka jingsawa kaba khraw ha kata ka sngi ha ki Philistia , bad u la pynsngewsih ia ki; bad ki la shah pynmong ha khmat ki Israel .

en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall : and , behold , if the scall be not spread in the skin , nor be in sight deeper than the skin  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u lyngdoh un peit biang ïa kata ka prum , bad lada kam pat pur bad kam kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid . Uta u briew un sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew u lyngdoh un peit ia ka sniehdoh: bad, ha khmih, lada ka sniehdoh kam shym la saphriang ha ka sniehdoh, lymne ka kham jylliew ban ia ka sniehdoh ; nangta u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khuid: bad un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un long uba khuid .

en: But thou shalt die in peace : and with the burnings of thy fathers , the former kings which were before thee , so shall they burn odours for thee  ; and they will lament thee , saying , Ah lord ! for I have pronounced the word , saith the  Lord .
kha: Men ïap ha kaba suk , bad kumba ki briew ki thang jingiwbih haba ki tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong me , kiba long ki syiem ha shuwa jong me , ha kajuh ka rukom kin thang ki jingiwbih na ka bynta jong me . Kin ïambriew namar jong me bad kin ong , ‘ U syiem jong ngi u la ïap !’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban iap ha ka jingsuk : bad da ka jingthang ia ki kpa tymmen jong me, ki syiem barim kiba la don ha khmat jong me, kumta kin thang ia me ; bad kin iam ia me, da kaba ong, Ah kynrad ! namar nga la pynbna ia ka ktien , ong U Trai .

en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof , and shalt burn with fire the city , and all the spoil thereof every whit , for the  Lord  thy God : and it shall be an heap for ever  ; it shall not be built again .
kha: Lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki briew baroh kiba shong hangta bad kynton ïa ki ha ka madan shnong . Nangta thang ïa kata ka shnong bad ïa kata ka spah ka phew baroh kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ka dei ban sah junom ha ka jingjot bad ym dei ban tei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men lum ia ka jingjot baroh jong ka ha pdeng ka lynti jong ka, bad men thang ia ka nongbah bad ia ka jingjot baroh jong ka man la ka sngi: bad kan long ka kynhun bym ju long shuh shuh .

en: And say , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O kings of Judah , and inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , the which whosoever heareth , his ears shall tingle .
kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ,  Ko ki syiem jong ka Judah bad ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan wallam kaba kum kane ka jingpynjot ha kane ka jaka ba uwei pa uwei baroh uba ïohsngew shaphang jong ka un kyndit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong , To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai , ko syiem Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ; Kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor kane ka jaka , ia kaba uno uno u iohsngew , ki shkor jong u kin khih .

en: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity , which he hath given thee under the sun , all the days of thy vanity : for that is thy portion in this life , and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun .
kha: To lehkmen ha ka jingim bad ka briew kaba phi ieit , katba phi dang im ka jingim ka bymmyntoi kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi ha kane ka pyrthei . Lehkmen ïa kawei pa kawei ka sngi bymmyntoi jong ka , namar kata baroh ka long kaba phin ïoh na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: To im da ka jingkmen bad ka tnga kaba me ieit ha ki sngi jong ka jinglong ba sniew jong me, kaba u la ai ha me hapoh ka sngi, ha ki sngi jong ka jinglong ba sniew jong me: namar kata ka long ka bynta jong me ha kane ka jingim bad ha ka jingtrei shitom jong me kaba me shim hapoh ka sngi .

en: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house , of which the  Lord  said to David , and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
kha: U la buh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa u Dabid bad ïa u Solomon u khun jong u :  Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka dei ka jaka ba nga la jied na ki ri baroh jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka dur ba la ker sawdong jong u khlaw ba u la shna ha ka iing, kaba U Trai u la ong ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon u khun jong u: Ha kane ka iing bad ha Jerusalem kaba nga la jied na ki jait Israel baroh:

en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel , whom God went to redeem to be his own people , to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness , by driving out nations from before thy people , whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?
kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kum ki Israel , ïa kaba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki ka jaitbynriew jong me . Kiei kiei ki bakhraw bad baphylla kiba me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei . Me la pyllait im ïa ki briew jong me na Ijipt bad pynher krad ïa kiwei ki jaitbynriew katba ki briew jong me ki nang tur shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei ka jaitbynriew ha ka khyndew kum ki briew jong me Israel, kiba U Blei u la leit ban siewspah ia me ban long ki briew jong u hi, ban pynlong ia me ka kyrteng jong ka jingkhraw bad ka jingtieng , da kaba beh noh ia ki jaitbynriew na khmat ki briew jong me kiba me la siewspah na Ijipt ?

en: And it came to pass from that time forth , that the half of my servants wrought in the work , and the other half of them held both the spears , the shields , and the bows , and the habergeons  ; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah .
kha: Naduh kata , shiteng na ki rangbah jong nga ki trei bad shiteng ki ïeng ban ap phira , da kaba phong ki jingphong jong ka jingkieng atiar bad bat da ki sum , ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ai ka jingkyrshan batylli ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia naduh kata ka por, ba ka shiteng na ki shakri jong nga ka la trei ha ka kam, bad kawei pat ka bynta na ki ka la bat ia ki khnam baroh arngut ki khnam bad ki bow bad ki khnam baroh arngut ki la don shadien jong ka iing jong u Judah baroh kawei .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Moses , and he said , Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother ? I know that he can speak well . And also , behold , he cometh forth to meet thee : and when he seeth thee , he will be glad in his heart .
kha: Ha kane U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Moses , bad u ong ,  Kumno shaphang u para jong me U Aaron , u Lebi ? Nga tip u tbit bha ban kren . Ha ka jingshisha , mynta u dang wan ban ïakynduh ïa me bad un kmen ban ïohi ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia u Moses bad u la ong, Hato u Aaron u dei u hynmen jong me ? Nga tip ba u lah ban kren bha . Bad ruh, ha khmih, u wan shabar ban iakynduh ia me: bad ynda u la iohi ia me, un sngewbha ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face , and bowed himself , and thanked the king : and Joab said , To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight , my lord , O king , in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant .
kha: U Joab u dem khrup haduh khyndew ha khmat u Dabid da ka jingburom bad u ong  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ! Mynta nga tip ba phi sngewbha ïa nga , namar phi la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la dem khrup ha ka khyndew ha ka khmat jong u, bad u la ainguh ia u syiem: bad u Joab u la ong: Ha ka sngi u shakri jong me u tip ba nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, ko syiem jong nga, ha kaba u syiem u la pyndep ia ka jingkyrpad jong u shakri jong u .

en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel , I am the  Lord  , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians , and I will rid you out of their bondage , and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm , and with great judgments :
kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba nga ong ha ki , ‘ Nga long U  Trai  ; ngan pyllait ïa phi bad pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw jong phi ha ki nong Ijipt . Ngan rah ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong nga ban wallam ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei halor jong ki , bad ngan pynim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ki khun Israel , Nga long U Trai , bad ngan pynmih noh ia phi na ki jingkit jong ki nong Ijipt , bad ngan pyllait noh ia phi na ka jinglong mraw jong ki , bad ngan siewspah ia phi da ka kti kaba la pynjrong bad da ki jingbishar kiba khraw:

en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men , and did eat grass as oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven , till his hairs were grown like eagles  feathers , and his nails like birds  claws .
kha: Ki kyntien ki wan urlong shisha mar kumta hi . Ïa u Nebukhadnessar la beh noh na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad u la bam phlang kum u masi dab . Ka umjer ka la hap halor ka met jong u , bad u shñiuh jong u , u la san jrong kum ki sner jong ki pukni bad ki tyrsim jong u ki jrong kum ki tnaw jong ki sim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kajuh ka kynta ka la long kaba la pyndep ha u Neuchadnezzar: bad u la shah beh noh na ki briew, bad u la bam ia u phlang kum u masi, bad ka met jong u ka la sngem da ka dewbilat bneng, haduh ba ki shniuh jong u ki la san kum ki bniat jong ki blang, bad ki bniat jong u kum ki sim .

en: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah , and all the remnant of Judah , that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall know whose words shall stand , mine , or theirs .
kha: Hynrei khyndiat na phi phin lait na ka jingïap bad leit phai na Ijipt sha Judah . Nangta kiba lait im kin tip ki ktien jongno ki la wan jia shisha , ki jong nga ne ki jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei tang khyndiat eh kiba lait na ka waitlam kin leit phai noh na ka ri Ijipt sha ka ri Judah , bad ki Judah baroh kiba sah ha ka ri Ijipt ban sah hangta kin tip ia ki ktien jongno kin ieng, jong nga ne jong ki .

en: And thou shalt be brought down , and shalt speak out of the ground , and thy speech shall be low out of the dust , and thy voice shall be , as of one that hath a familiar spirit , out of the ground , and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust .
kha: Ka Jerusalem kan long kum u ksuid uba ksaid ban kren napoh khyndew , ka sur ba la set kaba mih na ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia me yn pynhiar noh, bad ka ktien jong me kan long kaba rit na ka dewbilat, bad ka sur jong me kan long kum uwei uba don ka mynsiem kaba la tip bha, na ka khyndew, bad ka ktien jong me kan sngap jar na ka dewbilat .

en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren , that they would go before unto you , and make up beforehand your bounty , whereof ye had notice before , that the same might be ready , as a matter of bounty , and not as of covetousness .
kha: Kumta nga la pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam ban kyntu ïa kine ki parabangeit ban leit ha shuwa jong nga sha phi bad ïoh pynkhreh lypa ïa ka jingai kaba phi la kular . Te kan long kaba la pynkhreh haba nga poi , bad kan pyn-i ba phi ai namar ba phi kwah ban leh kumta , ym namar ba phi dei ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam ban kyntu ia ki para bangeit, ba kin leit sha khmat jong phi, bad ban pyndap lypa ia ka jingaiei jong phi, kaba phi la tip mynshuwa, ba kajuh kan long kaba la pynkhreh, kum ka jingaiei, bad ym kum ka jingkwah brai .

en: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering , of a cubit and an half long , and a cubit and an half broad , and one cubit high : whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice .
kha: Ki saw tylli ki miej ha ka kamra ba la pynïasoh ba la pynkhreh ban ai kum ki jingkñia batylli , ki la long da u maw ba shu phiah . Ki jrong sanphew sentimitar bad ha ki khlieh jong ki ka long hynñiewphew san sentimitar sawdong . Ïa ki tiar baroh ba pyndonkam ban pynïap ïa ki mrad ban kñia la buh halor kine ki miej .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki saw tylli ki miej ki long kiba la ot na ka bynta ka jingknia thang, kaba jrong shi cubit shiteng , bad kawei ka cuit shiteng , bad kawei ka cuit shiteng: ha kaba ki la buh ruh ia ki tiar kiba ki la pyniap ia ka jingknia thang bad ka jingknia .

en: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand  ; and he shall magnify himself in his heart , and by peace shall destroy many : he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes  ; but he shall be broken without hand .
kha: Namar ba u long uba sianti , un jop ha ki rukom shukor jong u . Un sngewsarong ïa lade bad pynjot ïa shibun briew khlem ka jingmaham . Un len wat ïa U Syiem bakhraw jong baroh , hynrei ïa u yn pynjot khlem da pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka bor ba kynja briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lyngba ka polisi jong u ruh un pynlong ia ka kam ban roi ha ka kti jong u ; bad un pynkhraw ia lade ha ka dohnud jong u, bad da ka jingsuk un pynjot ia kiba bun: un ieng ruh pyrshah ia u Syiem jong ki syiem ; hynrei un sa shah pynpra khlem kti .

en: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun , at the entering in of the house of the  Lord  , by the chamber of Nathan–melech the chamberlain , which was in the suburbs , and burned the chariots of the sun with fire .
kha: U la weng ruh ïa ki kulai ba ki syiem Judah ki la pynkyntang ha kaba mane ïa ka sngi , bad u thang ïa ki kali ïapom kiba ju pyndonkam ha kane ka jingmane . ( Ïa kine la buh ha phyllaw jong ka Templ hajan ka khyrdop bad ym da jngai na ka jaka sah jong u Nathan Melekh , u rangbah synshar ba-halor . )
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim noh ia ki kulai kiba ki syiem Judah ki la ai ha ka sngi, ha ka jaka rung jong ka iing U Trai, da ka kamra jong u Nathan ќаel ka kamra kaba don ha ki jaka ba marjan bad u la thang ia ki kali jong ka sngi da ka ding .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the firstborn said unto the younger , Behold , I lay yesternight with my father : let us make him drink wine this night also  ; and go thou in , and lie with him , that we may preserve seed of our father .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kata ka khun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka para ,  Hynne mynmiet nga la ïathiah bad i pa ; mynta to ngin pynbuaid biang ïa i ha kane ka miet ruh , bad phi sa leit thiah lang bad i . Te ma ngi baroh ar ngut ngin ïoh khun mar iwei na la u kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u khun nyngkong u la ong ha u khun rit: Ha khmih nga thiah hynnin ka miet bad u kpa jong nga: to ngin pynlong ia u ban dih wain mynta ka miet ruh; bad to leit shapoh bad me thiah bad u, ba ngin pynneh ia u symbai jong u kpa jong ngi .

en: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin , and smote them with the edge of the sword , as well the men of every city , as the beast , and all that came to hand : also they set on fire all the cities that they came to .
kha: Ki Israel ki wan phai pat ban ïaleh sa ïa kiwei ki Benjamin kiba dang sah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki baroh — ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki jingri jingdup ruh . Ki thang lut khoit ïa ki shnong baroh kiba don ha kata ka thain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la phai biang sha ki khun shynrang jong u Benjamin, bad ki la shoh ia ki da ka waitlam, bad ki briew jong kawei pa kawei ka shnong, kumjuh ruh ia ki mrad bad baroh kiba la wan shajan: ki la thang ia ki nongbah baroh kiba ki la wan sha ki .

en: And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )
kha: Hynrei mynta phi phai pyrshah ïa ka longïing jong i pa jong nga . Phi la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong i — hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah halor uwei u maw — bad namar ba u Abimelekh , u khun ba i ïoh na ka shakri jong i , u dei uba ha ïing jong phi , phi la pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Shekhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la ieng pyrshah ia ka iing u kpa jong nga ha kane ka sngi, bad phi la pyniap ia ki khun shynrang jong u, hynriewphew ngut ki briew, halor uwei u maw, bad phi la pynlong ia u Abimelekh, u khun jong u shakri jong u, u syiem halor ki briew jong u Shechem, namar u long u hynmen jong phi ; )

en: For the  Lord  will pass through to smite the Egyptians  ; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel , and on the two side posts , the  Lord  will pass over the door , and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt ban pynïap ïa ki nong Ijipt , un ïohi ïa ka snam ha u bim bad ha ki shawkad bad un ym shah ïa u Angel jong ka Jingïap ban rung shapoh ki ïing jong phi bad pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un iaid lyngba ban pynkhih ia ki nong Ijipt ; bad haba u iohi ia ka snam ha ka rong saw , bad ha ki arliang ki liang , U Trai un iaid lait ia ka jingkhang , bad un ym shah ia u nongpynjot ban wan rung sha ki iing jong phi ban pynkhih ia phi .

en: Now there were men lying in wait , abiding with her in the chamber . And she said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he brake the withs , as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire . So his strength was not known .
kha: Ka la pynbeit ban don katto katne ki rangbah ha kawei pat ka kamra , kumta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Hynrei u bthat ïa kita ki  saisiej kumba dkut u  saihon haba dei ding . Kumta kim shym tip satia ïa kaba rieh ka borbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki don ki briew kiba thiah ha ka kamra . Bad ka la ong ia u, Ki Philistia ki don halor jong me, Samson . Bad u la pynkhih ia ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki da ki

en: Then Jesus answering said unto them ,  Go your way , and tell John what things ye have seen and heard  ; how that the blind see , the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , the deaf hear , the dead are raised , to the poor the gospel is preached .
kha: U la jubab ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis ,  Khie leit noh bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi bad ïohsngew : Kiba matlah ki lah ban ïohi , kiba dkoh ki lah ban ïaid , kito kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh ki la long khuid , kiba kyllut ki lah ban ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ha kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab ia ki, To leit sha ki, bad to iathuh ha u Ioannis ia kiei kiei kiba phi la iohi bad iohsngew; kumno ba kiba matlah ki iohi, kiba lyngkhuid ki iaid, kiba pang sniehdoh ki iohsngew, kiba iap ki iohsngew, ha kiba duk la ialap ia ka gospel .

en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee : and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years , according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him .
kha: U dei ban da ïapynbeit bad uta uba thied ïa u , bad ïakheiñ ïa ki snem naduh ka por ba u la die ïa lade haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan bad ïa ka bai pyllait kin buh dor kat kum ka jingdon jong kita ki snem , ha ka nongrim jong ka bainong u nongbylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un khein ia uta uba la thied ia u naduh ka snem ba la die ia u haduh ka snem jubilee: bad ka dor jong ka jingdie jong u kan long kat kum ka jingbun ki snem , kat kum ka por jong u shakri ba la thung kam kan long bad u .

en: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation  ; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels , and in the presence of the Lamb :
kha: u hi da lade un dih ïa ka waiñ ka jong U Blei , ka waiñ ka jingbitar shla jong U , kaba u la theh noh ha ka bor jong ka baroh ha ka khuri ka jingbitar jong U ! Baroh kiba leh ïa kane kin shah pynsaja ha ka ding bad ha u kyndok ha khmat ki angel bakhuid bad ha khmat U Khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: U juh un dih ia ka wain jong ka jingbitar U Blei kaba la theh khlem da khleh lang ha ka khuri jong ka jingbitar jong u ; bad un shah pynshitom da ka ding bad u mawlyngnai ha khmat ki angel bakhuid bad ha khmat U Khunlangbrot:

en: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour , and of her that sojourneth in her house , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment : and ye shall put them upon your sons , and upon your daughters  ; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians .
kha: Man la ka kynthei Israel kan pan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh , na la ka paramarjan nong Ijipt bad na ka kynthei Ijipt kaba shong basah ha ïing jong ka . Ki Israel kin buh ïa kine kiei kiei ha la ki khun shynrang bad kynthei bad kit noh ïa ka spah jong ki nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kan shim ram na u paramarjan jong ka bad na ka kaba sah ha iing jong ka: bad phin buh ia ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi; bad ha ki khun kynthei jong phi phin pynsniew ia ki nong Ijipt .

en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness  ; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time : but they went to Baal–peor , and separated themselves unto that shame  ; and their abominations were according as they loved .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba nga lap nyngkong ïa ki Israel , ka long kumba lap ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ri shyiap . Haba nga ïohi nyngkong ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ka long kumba ïohi ïa u soh Dumbur uba ih nyngkong ha ka aïom . Hynrei haba ki la wan sha u lum Peor , ki la sdang ban mane ïa u Baal , bad tang katto katne por ki la kylla long kiba isaitmet kum kita ki blei ba ki ieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la shem ia ki Israel kum ki sohjew ha ka ri khlaw ; nga la iohi ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi kum ki khun nyngkong ha u dieng sohjew ha ka sien kaba nyngkong: hynrei ki la leit sha Baalpeor , bad ki la pyniakhlad ia lade ha kata ka jingsngewlehrain ; bad ki jinglehrain jong ki ki long katkum ka jingieit jong ki .

en: She that hath borne seven languisheth : she hath given up the ghost  ; her sun is gone down while it was yet day : she hath been ashamed and confounded : and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ka kmie kaba la duh noh ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki khun jong ka , ka la ïapler , ka da thrang ïa ka jingring mynsiem . Ka jingshai jong ka sngi jong ka , ka la kylla sha ka jingdum ; la pynjahburom ïa ka bad ka pang ka dohnud . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban pynïap ïa kito na phi kiba dang im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kaba la kha hynriew tylli ki khunlung: ka la iehnoh ia u ksuid jong ka katba ka dang sngi: ka la sngewlehrain bad sngewlehrain: bad ia ka jingsah jong ki ngan aiti ha ka waitlam ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki , U Trai .

en: Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , bad ki briew ka ri shyiap , kiba la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh jong ki . Kine ki briew baroh ki long kiba la otsher , hynrei ki bym shym la bat ïa ka jutang kaba ka thmu . Ym don mano mano na kine ki briew bad ym don mano mano na ki paid Israel kiba la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ijipt bad ka Judah bad ka Judah bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon bad u Moab bad baroh kiba don ha ki thliew ba sha jngai tam: namar kine ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long ki bym pat shah ot bad ka iing Israel baroh kawei ka long kaba khlem shah ot ha ka dohnud .

en: And Joshua adjured them at that time , saying , Cursed be the man before the  Lord  , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho : he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn , and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it .
kha: Ha kata ka por , u Joshua u maham tyngeh , u da ong ,  Uta uba pyrshang ban tei thymmai ïa ka nongbah Jerikho un long hapoh ka jingtim jong U  Trai  !  Uta uba seng ïa ka nongrim un duh noh ïa la u khun nyngkong ; Uta uba tei ïa ki khyrdop un duh noh ïa la u khun khatduh !
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la pynsngewsih ia ki ha kata ka por, u da ong: La tim ia uta u briew ha khmat U Trai, uba ieng bad tei ia kane ka shnong Jerikho: un buh ia ka nongrim jong ka ha u khun nyngkong jong u, bad ha u khun ba rit jong u un buh ia ki khyrdop jong ka .

en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the  Lord s  wrath  ; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy : for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land .
kha: Ha ka sngi haba U  Trai  un pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u , wat ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki baroh kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar jong u . Un pynkut — ka jingkut kaba kynsan — ïa uwei pa uwei uba im ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rupa jong ki ne ka ksiar jong ki kan ym lah ban pynpoi ia ki ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar jong U Trai; hynrei ka ri baroh kawei kan shah bam noh da ka ding jong ka jingsngewsih jong u: namar un pynlong wat ia ka jingleit kaba stet ia kito baroh kiba shong ha ka ri .

en: Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .
kha: Hynrei hadien kata ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngim dei ban leh kumne ! Ngi don ka khubor babha , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi . Lada ngi ap haduh mynstep ban ïathuh ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin shah pynshitom . Ïa ngin ïaleit noh shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: kane ka sngi ka long ka sngi kaba bha, bad ngi bat ia ka jingsuk jong ngi: lada ngi sah haduh ka jingshai mynstep, katto katne ka jingsniew kan wan ha ngi: mynta namarkata to wan, ba ngin leit iathuh ia ka iing syiem .

en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships , and servants that had knowledge of the sea  ; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir , and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold , and brought them to king Solomon .
kha: U syiem Hiram u phah sha u ïa ki liengbah hapoh ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u hi ryngkat bad ba la ñiah da ki maji kiba la mlien bha . Kine ki leit bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Solomon sha ka ri ki Ophir , bad ki wan kit nangta palat khatsan hajar kilo ka ksiar ïa u syiem Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u la phah ia u da ki kti jong ki shakri jong u, bad ki shakri kiba don ka jingtip shaphang ka duriaw ; bad ki la leit bad ki shakri u Solomon sha Ophir , bad ki la shim na kata ka por saw spah sanphew talent ka ksiar bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha u syiem Solomon .

en: Lest there should be among you man , or woman , or family , or tribe , whose heart turneth away this day from the  Lord  our God , to go and serve the gods of these nations  ; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood  ;
kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don napdeng jong phi u shynrang , lane ka kynthei , lane ka longïing , lane ka jait , ki ban phai noh na U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Kum uta , un long kum u thied uba pynmih u soh uba kthang bad uba don bih .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la dei ban don hapdeng jong phi u shynrang ne kynthei ne ka longiing ne ka jaitbynriew, kaba ka dohnud jong u ka phai noh ha kane ka sngi na U Trai U Blei jong ngi, ban leit shakri ia ki blei jong kine ki jaitbynriew ; ioh ba dei ban don hapdeng jong phi u tynrai uba kit ia ka sniehdoh bad u khniang;

en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place , until he come out , and have made an atonement for himself , and for his household , and for all the congregation of Israel .
kha: Naduh ka por ba u Aaron u leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid haduh ba un da mih nangta , ym bit ïano ïano ban don hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . Ynda u la pyndep ïa kata ka rukom lehniam na ka bynta ïa lade , na ka bynta la ka longïing , bad na ka bynta u paidbah baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don briew ha ka iing jong ka jingiaseng haba u leit rung ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid ha ka jaka bakhuid , haduh ba un da mih noh , bad ki la pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ka iing jong u bad na ka bynta ka jingiaseng Israel baroh .

en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;
kha: Mynta , ka bynta kaba donkam eh ka long , ba ka rukom ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kat kumba ka gospel U Khrist ka dawa , khnang ba , la nga lah ne ngam lah ban leit bad ïohi ïa phi , ngan ïohsngew ba phi ïeng skhem ha kawei ka jingthmu , bad kata , da kawei ka jingthrang , phi ïakhun lang na ka bynta ka jingngeit ha ka gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Tangba to ai ba ka jingiakren jong phi kan long kumba ka long ka gospel U Khrist: ba la nga wan bad nga iohi ia phi, lym kumta nga lah ban iohsngew ia ki kam jong phi, ba phi ieng skhem ha kawei ka mynsiem, da kawei ka jingmut kaba ialeh lang na ka bynta ka jingngeit jong ka gospel ; .

en: Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will burn her chariots in the smoke , and the sword shall devour thy young lions : and I will cut off thy prey from the earth , and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard .
kha: Nga long u nongshun jong pha !  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .  Ngan thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong pha . Ïa ki shipai jong pha yn pynïap ha ka thma , bad ngan shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la shim na kiwei . Ïa ka jingdawa jong ki nongsynran jong pha yn ym ïohsngew shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia me, ong U Trai jong ki paid, bad ngan thang ia ki kali jong ka ha ka tdem, bad ka waitlam kan bam ia ki sing samla jong me: bad ngan ot noh ia ka jingbam jong me na ka khyndew , bad ka sur jong ki nonglam khubor jong me kan ym iohsngew shuh .

en: And he returned to the man of God , he and all his company , and came , and stood before him : and he said , Behold , now I know that there is no God in all the earth , but in Israel : now therefore , I pray thee , take a blessing of thy servant .
kha: U la leit phai pat sha u Elisha lem bad baroh ki rangbah jong u bad u ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba ym don uno uno u blei hynrei tang U Blei ki Israel ; kumta sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit phai sha u briew jong U Blei, ma u bad ka kynhun jong u baroh, bad u la wan, bad u la ieng ha khmat jong u: bad u la ong: Ha khmih, mynta nga tip ba ym don Blei ha ka khyndew baroh kawei, hynrei ha Israel: namarkata, mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, to shim ia ka jingkyrkhu jong u shakri jong me .

en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted , and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted , and every one that had some white in it , and all the brown among the sheep , and gave them into the hand of his sons .
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka sngi u Laban u shim noh ïa ki blang shynrang baroh kiba thohshuid bad kiba thohbroin , bad ïa ki blang kynthei baroh kiba thohbria bad kiba thohbroin , ne kiba thohlieh ; u shim noh ruh ïa ki khunlangbrot baïong baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la weng noh ha kata ka sngi ia ki blang kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong

en: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong me namar ki pop kiba ma phi baroh phi la leh . Ma me lymne ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki la sngap ïa ki jingmaham jong nga , bad kumta ngan wallam halor baroh ïa ka jingpynjot ïa kaba nga la dep kren pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynshitom ia u bad ia u symbai jong u bad ki shakri jong u namar ka jingbymhok jong ki ; bad ngan wanrah ia ki, bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem bad ha ki briew jong ka Judah , ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba nga la pynbna pyrshah ia ki ; hynrei kim shym la sngap .

en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the  Lord  , as the  Lord  had said .
kha: bad u la kit sha Babilon ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ha ka Templ bad ïingsyiem . Kumba U  Trai  u la ïathuhlypa , u Nebukhadnessar u la pynpait ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ksiar kiba u syiem Solomon u la thaw na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah ia ki jingkynshew baroh jong ka iing U Trai bad ki jingkynshew jong ka iing syiem bad u la ot lut ia ki tiar ksiar baroh kiba u Solomon u la shna ha ka iing U Trai .

en: But if the watchman see the sword come , and blow not the trumpet , and the people be not warned  ; if the sword come , and take any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at the watchman s hand .
kha: Lada , kumno kumno , u nongap u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan bad um shym put ïa ka turoi jingmaham , u nongshun un wan bad un pynïap noh ïa kita ki nongpop ; hynrei ngan pynkit pop ïa u nongap na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u nongap u iohi ia ka waitlam ba ka wan, bad ym shah pynbna ia ka turoi, bad ki briew kim shah maham; lada ka waitlam ka wan, bad shim ia uno uno u briew napdeng jong ki, la weng noh ia u ha ka jingbymhok jong u ; hynrei ka snam jong u ngan dawa na ka kti jong u nongap .

en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them : for there is wrath gone out from the  Lord   ; the plague is begun .
kha: bad u Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim ïa u khiew buh ding jong phi , buh hangta ïa u rnga uba rhem na ka duwan , bad buh khyndiat ka jingiwbih halor ki rnga . Nangta leit rah kloi kloi ïa ka sha u paidbah bad pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki . Pynkloi ! Ka jingbitar U  Trai  ka la mih , bad ka khlam ruh ka la sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron, To shim ia ka umphniang bad to buh ia ka ding ha ka na ka almari, bad to buh ia ka jingiwbih, bad to leit noh kloi sha ka jingiaseng bad to leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki: namar ka la mih noh na U Trai; ka khlam ka la sdang .

en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Zidon  ; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee : and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall have executed judgments in her , and shall be sanctified in her .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki briew hangta ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong shaphang jong ki : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko Sidon ; ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga namar kaei kaba nga leh ïa pha . Kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai  , haba nga pyn-i katno uba khuid nga long da kaba pynshitom ïa kito kiba im hapdeng jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia me, ko Sidon bad ngan sa shah pyndonburom hapdeng jong me: bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai , ynda nga la pyndep ia ki jingbishar ha ka , bad yn pynkyntang ha ka .

en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me : and eat ye every one of his vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern  ;
kha: A wat sngap ïa u Hesekaïah ! U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem . Ïa phi baroh yn shah ban bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki soh Dumbur na ki jong ki dieng jong ki , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi —
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngap ia u Hesekaiah: namar kumta u syiem Assyria u ong: To leh ia ka jingiateh bad nga da ka jingai sngewbha, bad to mih sha nga: bad to bam ia phi uwei pa uwei na u sohjew jong u, bad uwei pa uwei na u dieng sohjew jong u, bad phi dih ia ki um jong u hi;

en: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king , it is because the people have made me afraid : and thy handmaid said , I will now speak unto the king  ; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid .
kha: Mynta , ko Syiem Kynrad , ka daw ba nga la wan ban kren ïa phi ka long ba ki paidbah ki la byrngem ïa nga , bad kumta nga la ong ha lade ba nga dei ban kren ha phi da ka jingkyrmen ba phin leh ïa kaei kaba nga kyrpad .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ba nga wan ban kren ia kane ha u kynrad jong nga, ka long namar ba ki briew ki la pyntieng ia nga: bad ka kti jong me ka la ong: bad ka kti jong me ka la ong: Ngan kren mynta ha u syiem; ka lah ban long ba u syiem un leh ia ka jingkyrpad jong u .

en: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel , from Ekron even unto Gath  ; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines . And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites .
kha: Ïa ki nongbah baroh ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh hapdeng ka Ekron bad ka Gath la pynphai pat sha ki Israel , bad kumta ki Israel ki la ïoh biang ïa ka ri jong ki baroh . Bad ka la don ruh ka jingshongsuk hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shnong kiba ki Philistia ki la shim na Israel ki la wan phai biang sha Israel, naduh Ekron haduh Gath ; bad ki pud jong ka ki la pyllait noh na ki kti jong ki Philistia . Bad ka la don ka jingsuk hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Amorit .

en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill , to set them among princes , and to make them inherit the throne of glory : for the pillars of the earth are the  Lord s  , and he hath set the world upon them .
kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka dewmet , bad u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki . U pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem , bad buh ïa ki , ha ki jaka badonburom . Ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ki dei ki jong U  Trai  ; bad ha ki u la pynshong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynmih ia kiba duk na ka dewbilat, bad u pynmih ia u nongkyrpad na ka dewbilat, ban buh ia ki hapdeng ki syiem, bad ban pynlong ia ki ban hiar pateng ia ka khet ka burom: namar ki maw jong ka khyndew ki long U Trai s , bad u la buh ia ka pyrthei halor jong ki .

en: That this shall be no grief unto thee , nor offence of heart unto my lord , either that thou hast shed blood causeless , or that my lord hath avenged himself : but when the  Lord  shall have dealt well with my lord , then remember thine handmaid .
kha: te phim donkam ban sngew babe lane bynñiaw , ko kynrad , ba phi la pynïap khlem daw lane ba phi la pynhiarkput da lade hi . Bad haba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi , ko kynrad , sngewbha wat klet ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kane kan ym long ka jingsngewsih ia me, ne ka jingsngewsih ia u kynrad jong nga, ne ba me la pynmih snam khlem da pyrkhat, ne ba u kynrad jong nga u la pynshitom bein ia lade: hynrei ynda U Trai un leh bha ia u kynrad jong nga, te kynmaw ia ka kti jong me .

en: And there was given him dominion , and glory , and a kingdom , that all people , nations , and languages , should serve him : his dominion is an everlasting dominion , which shall not pass away , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed .
kha: La ai ha u ka iktiar , ka jingpyndonburom , bad ka bor ba kynja syiem , khnang ba ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej kin shakri ïa u . Ka iktiar jong u kan neh junom , bad ka hima jong u kan ym kut shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ai ia u ia ka jingsynshar, ka burom bad ka hima, ba ki briew baroh, ki jaitbynriew bad ki ktien ki dei ban shakri ia u: ka jingsynshar jong u ka long ka jingsynshar bymjukut, bad ka hima jong u kaba ym shah pynjot .

en: And he said unto her , Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite , and said unto him , Give me thy vineyard for money  ; or else , if it please thee , I will give thee another vineyard for it : and he answered , I will not give thee my vineyard .
kha: U jubab ,  Namar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ong ïa nga . Nga la tyrwa ban thied ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong u , lane , lada u sngewdei , ban ai ïa u da kawei pat ha ka jaka jong ka , hynrei u ong ïa nga ba ngam lah ban ïoh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka, Namar nga la kren ha u Naboth u Jesreelite, bad u la ong ha u, Ai ia nga ia ka kper sohjew jong me da ka pisa ne lym kumta, lada ka mon ia me, ngan ai sa kawei pat ka kper sohjew na ka bynta jong ka: bad u la jubab: Ngan ym ai ia me ia ka kper sohjew jong nga .

en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites , the inhabitants of the land : which spake unto David , saying , Except thou take away the blind and the lame , thou shalt not come in hither : thinking , David cannot come in hither .
kha: Ka poi ka por haba u Syiem Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki mih ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki Jebus , kiba shong hangta , ki pyrkhat ba u Dabid um lah ban jop ïa ka nongbah , bad kumta ki ong ha u ,  Men ym ïohrung hangne da lei lei ; wat kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki lah ban khang ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem bad ki briew jong u ki la leit sha Jerusalem sha ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri: kiba la kren ha u Dabid: kiba la kren ha u Dabid: Lait noh tang ma me uba matlah bad uba dkoh: me ym wan rung hangne: da kaba pyrkhat: U Dabid um lah ban wan rung hangne .

en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .
kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ,  Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban sa jia . Mynta ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ban wan , men ïoh tang ïa ki kew khlaw ban bam , hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud men lah ban bet ïa u kew bad ot ïa u , bad ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka dak ha me , Phi dei ban bam ia kiei kiei kiba mih na ki hi, bad ha ka snem kaba ar kaba mih na kajuh ka ; bad ha ka snem kaba lai phi bet bad ot bad thung ia ki kper sohjew bad bam ia ki soh jong ka .

en: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest , to offer upon mine altar , to burn incense , to wear an ephod before me ? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel ?
kha: Napdeng ki jait Israel baroh nga la jied ïa ka longïing jong u ban long ki lyngdoh jong nga , ban shakri ha ka duwan , ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih , bad ban phong ïa ka ephod ban ïakren bad nga . Bad nga la ai ha ki ïa ka hok ban ïoh bynta ïa ki jingainguh thang ba-halor ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hato nga la jied ia u na ki jait Israel baroh ban long u lyngdoh jong nga, ban ainguh ha ka jingknia jong nga, ban thang jingiwbih , ban phong ia ka ephod ha khmat jong nga ? bad nga la ai ha ka iing u kpa jong me ia ki jingknia baroh kiba la shna da ka ding jong ki Israel ?

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .
kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u la shah ïa ki nonglute ban tur ïaleh bad lute ïa ki . U shah ïa ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki Israel kim lah shuh ban ïada ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la shit pyrshah ia ki Israel , bad u la aiti ia ki ha ki kti jong ki nongpynjot kiba la pynsniew ia ki , bad u la die ia ki ha ki kti jong ki nongshun jong ki sawdong , haduh ba kim lah shuh ban ieng ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki .

en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city : and they told them , saying , We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , neither voice of man , but horses tied , and asses tied , and the tents as they were .
kha: Kumta ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria , ki leit phai sha Samaria bad ki la khot ïa ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop :  Ngi la leit sha ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria bad ngim shym la ïohi ne ïohsngew ïano ïano ; ki kulai bad ki kada kiba dang shah teh , bad ki ïingjaiñ ki long kumjuh kumba ki Syria ki la ieh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la wan bad ki la khot ia ki nongrah ia ka shnong: bad ki la iathuh ha ki, ki la poi ha ka jaka sah jong ki nong Syria, bad, ha khmih, ym don briew hangta, lymne ka sur briew, hynrei ki kulai ki la tied, bad ki kada ki la tied, bad ki ïingjaiñ kumba ki long .

en: And it was so , when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court , that she obtained favour in his sight : and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand . So Esther drew near , and touched the top of the sceptre .
kha: Haba u syiem u ïohi ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei , ba ka ïeng habar , ka la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u , bad u pyn-i ïa ka ïa u diengsynshar ksiar . Nangta ka kiew shalor bad ka ktah ïa ka tduh uta u diengsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, haba u syiem u la iohi ia ka mahadei kaba ieng ha ka iingbishar, ba ka la ioh ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong u: bad u syiem u la bat sha ka Esther ia u dieng ksiar uba don ha ka kti jong u . Kumta u Esther u la wan shajan bad u la ktah ia ka tduh jong u dieng .

en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .
kha: Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phim shym shna pynbha ïa ka Templ ? Naduh mynta phim dei shuh ban bat ïa ka pisa kaba phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khnang ban ïoh shna pynbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Jehoias u la khot ia u Jehoiada u lyngdoh bad kiwei pat ki lyngdoh bad u la ong ha ki: Balei phim pynbha ia ki jingpynkhein jong ka iing ? mynta namarkata wat pdiang shuh ia ka pisa jong phi , hynrei to aiti ia ka na ka bynta ki jingpynkhein jong ka iing .

en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they said unto Samson s wife , Entice thy husband , that he may declare unto us the riddle , lest we burn thee and thy father s house with fire : have ye called us to take that we have ? is it not so ?
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki ong ïa ka tnga jong u Samson ,  Khroh ïa u tnga jong pha ban ïathuh ha ngi ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip . Lada pham lah , ngin wiang ding ïa ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad ngin thang lang ïa pha hangta . Pha ruh pha la khot sngewbha ïa ngi khnang ban lute ïa ngi , hato kam long kumta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ba ki la ong ha ka tnga jong u Samson , To pynpaw ia u tnga jong me, ba un pynbna ha ngi ia ka jingkylli , ioh ba ngin thang ia me bad ia ka iing u kpa jong me da ka ding: phi la khot ia ngi ban shim ia kata kaba ngi don ? em ?

en: Now therefore go to , proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , Whosoever is fearful and afraid , let him return and depart early from mount Gilead . And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand  ; and there remained ten thousand .
kha: Pynbna ha u paidbah , ‘ Uno uno uba sheptieng u dei ban leit phai noh sha ïing , bad ngi ngin sah hangne ha u lum Gilead .’   Kumta arphew ar hajar ngut ki leit phai noh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to leit sha ki shkor jong ki briew, da kaba ong, Uno uno uba tieng bad uba tieng, to un wan phai noh kloi na u lum Gilead . Bad ka la wan phai na ki briew arphew ar hajar; bad ka la sah shi hajar .

en: Look upon Zion , the city of our solemnities : thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation , a tabernacle that shall not be taken down  ; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed , neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken .
kha: Khmih ïa ka Seïon , ka nongbah ha kaba ngi rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong ngi . Peit ïa ka Jerusalem ! Katno ka long ka jaka kaba shngain ban shong ban sah ha ka ! Kan long kum ka ïingjaiñ ïa kaba yn ym pynkynriah shuh , kiba ïa ki snar ym shym la phut noh , bad ïa ki tyllai ym shym la pyndkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia ka Seion, ka nongbah jong ki jinglong ba sngewsih jong ngi: ki khmat jong me kin iohi ia ka Jerusalem ka jaka shong jaka sah kaba sngap jar, ka iing kaba ym lah ban pynhiar shuh shuh; ym don kawei ruh na ki dieng jong ka kaba la shah weng noh .

en: Then they came to Zerubbabel , and to the chief of the fathers , and said unto them , Let us build with you : for we seek your God , as ye do  ; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur , which brought us up hither .
kha: Kumta ki leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Serubbabel bad ïa ki rangbah kur bad ki ong ,  To ngin ïasnohkti lang bad phi ha ka jingtei ïa ka Templ . Ngi mane ïa ujuh U Blei uba phi mane , bad ngi ju ai ki jingkñia ha u naduh ka por u Esarhaddon , u patsha ka Assyria , uba phah ïa ngi ban shong ban sah hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la poi ha u Serubabel bad ha u rangbah jong ki kpa tymmen bad ki la ong ha ki: To ngin tei bad phi: namar ngi wad ia U Blei jong phi kumba phi leh; bad ngi knia ha u naduh ki sngi u Esarmaddon u syiem Assur uba la pynmih ia ngi hangne .

en: And , behold , I will send a lad , saying , Go , find out the arrows . If I expressly say unto the lad , Behold , the arrows are on this side of thee , take them  ; then come thou : for there is peace to thee , and no hurt  ; as the  Lord  liveth .
kha: Nangta ngan ong ïa u shakri jong nga ban leit tam ïa ki . Bad lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Khmih , kito ki khnam ki don ha kane ka liang jong phi ; tam ïa ki ,’ kata ka mut ba kam lei lei bad phi lah ban mih shabar . Nga smai ha U  Trai  uba im ba phin ym don ha ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ngan phah ia u khynnah, da kaba ong, To leit wad ia ki khnam . Lada nga ong shai ia u khynnah, Ha khmih, ki khnam ki don ha kane ka liang jong me, to shim ia ki nangta to wan: namar ka don ka jingsuk ha me, bad ym don ka jingsuk ha me, kumba U Trai u im.

en: So he brought down the people unto the water : and the  Lord  said unto Gideon , Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue , as a dog lappeth , him shalt thou set by himself  ; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink .
kha: U Gideon u ïalam ïa kita ki briew sha um , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Pynkhlad ïa uwei pa uwei uba jliah ïa ka um da la u thylliej kum u ksew , na uwei pa uwei uba dem khohsiew ban dih um .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la pynhiar ia ki briew sha ka um: bad U Trai u la ong ha u Gideon , Uwei pa uwei uba dih ia ka um da ka shyntur jong u , kumba u kulai u dih ia u .

en: And the Chaldeans , that fight against this city , shall come and set fire on this city , and burn it with the houses , upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal , and poured out drink offerings unto other gods , to provoke me to anger .
