kha: Kin sa thang duh ïa ka , ryngkat bad ki ïing ki sem hangno hangno ha kiba ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba thang ki jingiwbih ha u Baal halor ki tnum ïing bad da kaba theh ïa ka waiñ jong ki jingainguh sha kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Khaldes kiba ialeh pyrshah ia kane ka shnong kin wan thang ia kane ka shnong, bad kin thang ia ka da ki iing kiba ki la ai jingiwbih ha u Baal , bad ki la theh ia ki jingknia dih sha kiwei pat ki blei , ban pynkhih ia nga ban bitar .

en: Now therefore deliver us the men , the children of Belial , which are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death , and put away evil from Israel . But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel :
kha: Mynta aiti noh ïa kito ki riewbymman ha Gibeah , ba ngin ïoh pynïap ïa ki bad ban weng noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .  Hynrei ki briew ka Benjamin kim salia ïa kiwei pat ki jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to pyllait noh ia ngi ia ki briew kiba don ha Gibeah, ba ngin pyniap ia ki bad ngin weng noh ia ki na Israel . Hynrei ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Israel kin ym sngap ia ka sur jong ki hynmen jong ki:

en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee ? what thing shall I liken to thee , O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee , that I may comfort thee , O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee ?
kha: U la phah ïa ka ding nalor , ka ding kaba thang hapoh jong nga . U la buh ka jingriam na ka bynta jong nga bad u la wanrah ïa nga sha khyndew . Nangta u la iehnoh ïa nga bad ieh ïa nga ha ka jingpang baneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba ngan shim ban sakhi na ka bynta jong me ? kaei kaba ngan ianujor bad me ko khun Jerusalem ? kaei kaba ngan iaryngkat bad me , ba ngan pyntngen ia me ko khun kynthei jong ka Seion ? namar ka jingpynkhein jong me ka long kaba khraw kum ka duriaw: mano ba lah ban pynkoit ia me ?

en: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God : that of the king s goods , even of the tribute beyond the river , forthwith expenses be given unto these men , that they be not hindered .
kha: Da kane nga hukum ïa phi ban ïarap ïa ki ban tei biang ïa ka . Ïa ki jingpynlut pynsep dei ban ai khlem pynslem na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem ba la ïoh na ki khajna ha Ïuphratis Sepngi , khnang ban ym pynthut ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata nga pynlong ia ka hukum ia ki rangbah jong kine ki Jiw na ka bynta ban tei ia kane ka iing U Blei: kata ka jong ki mar ki mata jong u syiem, wat na ka khajna sha shiliang wah, khlem da pynthut ia kine ki briew .

en: And it came to pass as they came , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , that the women came out of all cities of Israel , singing and dancing , to meet king Saul , with tabrets , with joy , and with instruments of musick .
kha: Katba u Dabid u dang wan phai hadien ba u la pynïap ïa u Goliath bad katba ki shipai ki dang wan phai sha la ïing , ki kynthei na man la ka shnong ha Israel ki ïamih ban leit ïashem ïa u syiem Saul . Ki da ïarwai ïa ki jingrwai sngewkmen , ki da ïashad bad ki tem ïa ki kanjari bad ki jingtem ksai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang wan, haba u Dabid u la wan phai na ka jingpyniap ia ki Philistia, ba ki kynthei ki la mih na ki shnong Israel baroh , ki rwai bad ki shad , ban iakynduh ia u syiem u Saul , da ki jainkup bad da ki tiar ialehkai .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! U la pynpaw kaba katno u sngewbha ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa phi u syiem u ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong u . Namar ba u ieit ïa ki briew jong u , ki Israel , bad u kwah ban pynneh ïa ki junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban pynneh ïa ka hukum bad ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong me, uba la sngewbha ha me ban buh ia me ha ka khet jong u, ban long syiem na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me: namar U Blei jong me u la ieit ia ki Israel: namar ba U Trai jong me u la pynskhem ia ki junom .

en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .
kha: Nangta ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa uta u samla ,  Ale shane ! Ngi don ei ei ban ong ïa phi !  U Jonathan u ong ïa uta u samla ,  Bud ïa nga . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka kynhun ki la jubab ia u Jonathan bad u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u, bad ki la ong, To wan shaneng ha ngi, bad ngin sa pyni ia phi ia kaei kaei . U Jonathan u la ong ha u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u: To wan shakhmat hadien jong nga: namar U Trai u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki Israel .

en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngum , khnang ba kata ka jingdeng shadem kan neh halor kata ka jingpanpoh , bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la teh ia ka sniehdoh da ki ryntieh jong u ha ki ryntieh jong u khunlung da ka rong saw, ba kan long halor ka ryntieh kaba sngewtynnad jong u khunlung, bad ba ka sniehdoh kan ym shah pyllait na u khunlung; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And his brethren , men of valour , were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers , whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites , the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh , for every matter pertaining to God , and affairs of the king .
kha: U syiem Dabid u jied ar hajar hynñiewspah ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit jong ki longïing na ki kur jong u Jeraïah bad u buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki kam niam bad ki kam hima sima ha Israel kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan — ki ri jong ki Reuben , ki Gad , bad ki Manasseh ba sha Mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong u, ki rangbah shipai ki long ar hajar hynriew spah ngut ki kpa tymmen, kiba u syiem u Dabid u la pynlong ia ki nongsynshar halor ki Reubenite, ki Gadite bad ka jaitbynriew Manasseh, na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba iadei bad U Blei bad ki kam jong u syiem .

en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side  ; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate : the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
kha: Ki kamra ap phira lai tylli baroh arliang ka lynti ïaid , ki kynroh hapdeng jong ki , bad ka kamra rung baroh ki la don ki jingthew kiba katjuh kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Ka khyrdop baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kamra barit jong ka ki long lai tylli na kane ka liang bad lai tylli na kata ka liang bad ki tnum jong ka bad ki arches jong ka ki long katkum ka jingthew jong ka khyrdop kaba nyngkong: ka jingjrong jong ka ka long sanphew phut bad ka jingjrong jong ka sanphew phut .

en: All these were the children of Asher , heads of their father s house , choice and mighty men of valour , chief of the princes . And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men .
kha: Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing , ki riewïaleh bapawnam , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher ki kynthup ïa ki arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Asher, ki khlieh jong ka iing jong ki kpa jong ki, ki rangbah shipai . Bad ka jingkhein baroh kawei jong ki kiba la tbit ha ka thma bad ban ialeh thma ka long arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead , which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan , where the Philistines had hanged them , when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa :
kha: u leit shim ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad jong u Jonathan , u khun jong u na ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead . ( Ki la tuh ïa ki na ka jaka paidbah ha Beth Shan , ha kaba ki Philistia ki la sdien ïa ki met jong ki ha ka sngi ba ki la pynïap ïa u Saul halor u Lum Gilboa . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit shim ia ki shyieng u Saul bad ki shyieng u Jonathan u khun jong u na ki briew jong u Jabesh Gilead kiba la tuh ia ki na ka lynti jong ka Bethshan ha kaba ki Philistia ki la sahkut ia ki, haba ki Philistia ki la pyniap ia u Saul ha Gilboa:

en: And Jeroboam said to his wife , Arise , I pray thee , and disguise thyself , that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam  ; and get thee to Shiloh : behold , there is Ahijah the prophet , which told me that I should be king over this people .
kha: U Jeroboam u ong ha la ka tnga ,  Da riam pher ïa lade ban ym don ba ithuh ïa phi bad leit sha Shiloh , ha kaba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa u shong u sah , uta uba ong ba ngan sa long u syiem ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeroboan u la ong ha ka tnga jong u, To khie, nga kyrpad ia me, bad to pynkylla ia lade, ba ym tip ia me ba me long ka tnga jong u Jeroboan bad me poi sha Shiloh: ha khmih u Ahiah u nongiathuhlypa uba la iathuh ha nga ba nga dei ban long syiem halor kane ka jaitbynriew .

en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the  Lord  , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron , and burned it at the brook Kidron , and stamped it small to powder , and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people .
kha: U weng noh na ka Templ ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad rah ïa ka shabar ka nongbah sha ka Them Kidron , u thang ïa ka , u pynlwet phum ïa u dpei jong ka , bad pynsaphred ïa ka ha jingtep paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynmih ia ka khlaw na ka iing U Trai, khlem Jerusalem, sha ka wah Kidron, bad u la thang ia ka ha ka wah Kidron, bad u la pynkhih ia ka da ka sniehdoh kaba rit, bad u la theh ia ka sniehdoh jong ka ha ki jingtep jong ki khun ki kti .

en: And they took their journey from Elim , and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin , which is between Elim and Sinai , on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na Elim , bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba ar naduh ba ki mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ki la wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sin , kaba don hapdeng ka Elim bad ka Sinai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka jingleit jong ki na Elim bad ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei ka la poi sha ka ri khlaw Sin kaba don hapdeng ka Elim bad Sinai ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ba ar hadien ba ki la mih na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And Abram took Sarai his wife , and Lot his brother s son , and all their substance that they had gathered , and the souls that they had gotten in Haran  ; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan  ; and into the land of Canaan they came .
kha: U Abram u la shim ïa ka Sarai ka tnga jong u , bad ïa u Lot u pyrsa jong u , bad ïa ka spah ka phew baroh , bad ïa ki mraw baroh ba ki la lah ïoh ha Haran , bad ki la ïamihnoh ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la shim ia ka tnga jong u, bad u khun jong u, bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki baroh kiba ki la lum, bad ki mynsiem kiba ki la ioh ha Haran ; bad ki la leit sha ka ri Kanaan ; bad sha ka ri Kanaan ki la wan .

en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah , Because Israel took away my land , when they came up out of Egypt , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and unto Jordan : now therefore restore those lands again peaceably .
kha: U syiem Ammon u jubab ïa ki nonglamktien u Jephthah ,  Mynba ki Israel ki mihnoh na Ijipt , ki la knieh ïa ka ri jong nga naduh ka wah Arnon haduh ka wah Jabbok bad ka wah Jordan . Mynta me dei ban pynphai noh ïa ka da kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem ki khun ki shynrang u la jubab ha ki nonglam khubor jong u Jephthah, Namar ki Israel ki la shim noh ia ka ri jong nga, haba ki la mih na Ijipt, naduh u Arnon wat haduh u Jabok bad haduh Jordan: mynta to pynphai biang ia kita ki ri da kaba suk .

en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .
kha: U Dabid u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Gibeon , kiba la phasi ïa ki halor u lum ha khmat U  Trai  — baroh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap lang . Ka dei haba jan kut artat ka pyrem , ha kaba sdang ka aïom ot barli , haba la pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la aiti ia ki ha ki kti jong ki nong Gibeon bad ki la sahkut ha u lum ha khmat U Trai : bad ki la hap baroh hynriew ngut ki la iap ha ki sngi ot, ha ki sngi ba nyngkong, ha kaba sdang jong ka jingot barli .

en: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt , and took Pharaoh s daughter , and brought her into the city of David , until he had made an end of building his own house , and the house of the  Lord  , and the wall of Jerusalem round about .
kha: U Solomon u la pynlong ka jingmynjur ban ïatreilang bad u syiem Ijipt da kaba shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u . U la wan ïalam ïa ka ban shong ha ka Nongbah U Dabid haduh ba un da dep tei ïa la ka ïingsyiem , ka Templ , bad ka kynroh sawdong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la iadei bad u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt bad u la wanrah ia ka ha ka shnong u Dabid haduh ba u la pyndep ia ka iing jong u hi bad ka iing U Trai bad ka kynroh jong ka Jerusalem sawdong .

en: And I will sanctify my great name , which was profaned among the heathen , which ye have profaned in the midst of them  ; and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , saith the Lord  God  , when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes .
kha: Ynda haba ngan pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew ïa ka jingkhuid ka kyrteng bakhraw jong nga — ka kyrteng ïa kaba phi la pynjahburom hapdeng jong ki — te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ngan pyndonkam ïa phi ban pyn-i ha ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynkyntang ia ka kyrteng kaba khraw jong nga, kaba la pynjah burom hapdeng ki nongwei, kaba phi la pynjah burom hapdeng jong ki ; bad ki nongwei kin tip ba nga long U Trai , ong U Trai Blei , haba ngan long uba la pynkyntang ha phi ha khmat ki khmat jong ki .

en: In the mean time , when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people , insomuch that they trode one upon another , he began to say unto his disciples first of all ,  Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .
kha: Katba da ki hajar ngut ki briew ki dang ïalumlang , ba kumta ki la ïa-ïuh para ma ki , U Jisu u la ong nyngkong ha la ki synran ,  To sumar na u thiat jong ki Pharisi — nga mut ïa ka jingarsap jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por kaba pdeng, haba la ialum lang ia u paidbah bym lah khein, khlem da pyrkhat ba ki iaid iwei ia iwei pat, u la sdang ban ong ha ki synran jong u nyngkong eh , To husiar na ka jingleh arsap jong ki Pharisi .

en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin , and have omitted the weightier matters of the law , judgment , mercy , and faith : these ought ye to have done , and not to leave the other undone .
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi ai sha U Blei ïa kaba shiphew wat jong ki jhur pynbang jingbam , kum u pudina , u dill , bad u kumin , hynrei phim suidñiew ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai badonkam shisha jong ka Hukum , kum ka jinglehhok bad ka jingisynei bad ka jingbeit . Ïa kine phi dei ban leh , khlem da klet ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi la ai ia ka shiphew jong ka mint bad ka cummin, bad phi la iehnoh ia kiei kiei kiba kham heh jong ka ain, ka jingbishar, ka jingisynei bad ka jingngeit: kine ki la dei ban leh, bad ban ym iehnoh ia kiwei pat ki bym don jingleh .

en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you , and ye need not that any man teach you : but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things , and is truth , and is no lie , and even as it hath taught you , ye shall abide in him .
kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , U Khrist u la theh noh ïa la U Mynsiem ha phi . Katba U Mynsiem jong u , u dang ïaisah ha phi , phim donkam ïano ïano ban hikai ïa phi . Naba U Mynsiem jong u , un hikai ïa phi shaphang kiei kiei baroh , bad kaei kaba u hikai ka long kaba shisha , ym kaba lamler . Namarkata , to kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Mynsiem bad ïaisah ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingpynkhuid kaba phi la ioh na u ka sah ha phi, bad phim donkam ba uno uno un hikai ia phi: hynrei kumba kata ka jingpynkhuid ka hikai ia phi na kiei kiei baroh, bad ka long ka jingshisha, bad wat la ka la hikai ia phi, phin iaineh ha u .

en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , from the iron furnace , saying , Obey my voice , and do them , according to all which I command you : so shall ye be my people , and I will be your God :
kha: Ka dei ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la wallam noh ïa ki na Ijipt , ka ri kaba long kum ka lawar ding baklang ïa ki . Nga la ong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la lah hukum . Nga la ong ïa ki ba lada ki kohnguh , kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïoh long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba nga la hukum ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha ka sngi ba nga la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt, na ka ding nar, da kaba ong: Ko sur jong nga bad leh ia ki katba nga hukum ia phi: kumta phin long ki briew jong nga: bad ngan long U Blei jong phi:

en: O house of David , thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute judgment in the morning , and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor , lest my fury go out like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ban ai ïa kane ka khubor ha ka ïingsyiem Judah , ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid :  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong . To khmih ba yn don ka jingbishar hok man la ka sngi . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba thok ïa u . Lada phim leh kumta , ka jingbymman kaba phi leh kan pynlong ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ban meh kum ka ding kaba ym lah ban pynlip .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko iing u Dabid , kumta u Trai u la pynlong ia u uba la shah pynjot na ka kti jong u nongpynshitom bein , ioh ba ka jingbitar jong nga kan mih kum ka ding , bad thang ba ym don ba lah ban pynlip ia ka , namar ka jingsniew jong phi .

en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled  ; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt , and all the wise men thereof : and Pharaoh told them his dream  ; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh .
kha: Ynda mynstep u la sngewkhuslai ; kumta u phah khot ïa ki nongleh myntor bad ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Ijipt . U ïathuh ha ki ïa la ki jingphohsniew , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por mynstep ba ka mynsiem jong u ka la sngewsih ; bad u la phah bad khot ia ki nongleh jadu baroh jong ka ri Ijipt: bad u Pharaoh u la iathuh ha ki ia ka jingphohsniew jong u ; hynrei ym don ba lah ban batai ia ki ha u Pharaoh .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days , the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .
kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingsawa ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingkhawai shongkurim . Ki briew hangne kin im ban ïohi ba kane ka jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel; Ha khmih, ngan pynlong ia ka jingmih na kane ka jaka ha ki khmat jong phi, bad ha ki sngi jong phi, ka sur jong ka jingkmen, ka sur jong u nongleit kurim bad ka sur jong ka nongleit kurim .

en: Happy art thou , O Israel : who is like unto thee , O people saved by the  Lord  , the shield of thy help , and who is the sword of thy excellency ! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee  ; and thou shalt tread upon their high places .
kha: Suk shisha ma pha , ko Israel ! ym don kaba kum ma pha , ka jaitbynriew ba la pyllait im da U  Trai . U  Trai  hi u long ka stieh bad ka waitlam jong pha , ban ïada ïa pha bad ai ha pha ka jingjop . Ki nongshun jong pha kin wan dem wan nguh ïa pha , bad phan sa ïuhroit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkmen jong me, ko Israel: uba long kum ma me, ko briew uba la pynim da U Trai, bad uba long ka waitlam jong ka jingbha jong me ! bad ki nongshun jong me kin shem ia me ha me; bad me men iaid ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ki .

en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee  ; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet  ; and they shall call thee , The city of the  Lord  , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong kito kiba la banbeiñ ïa pha kin sa wan ban dem khrup ban burom ïa pha . Baroh kito kiba la ju ibeiñ ïa pha kin dem ngon ha ki kjat jong pha . Kin khot ïa pha , ‘ Ka Nongbah U  Trai  ,’ ‘ Ka Seïon , ka nongbah U Blei U Bakhuid ki Israel .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ruh kiba la pynshitom ia me kin wan dem ha me ; bad baroh kiba la lehbein ia me kin dem khrup ha ki tyrpeng jong me ; bad kin khot ia me: Ka shnong U Trai , Ka Seion jong U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water , which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father  ; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham : and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them .
kha: U la tih biang sa shisien ïa ki pukri ïa kiba la tih ha ka por jong u Abraham ïa kiba ki Philistia ki la set khyndew noh hadien ka jingïap jong u Abraham . U Isaak u la ai kijuh ki kyrteng ïa kita ki pukri kumba u kpa jong u , u la khot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la tih biang ia ki tyllong um, kiba ki la tih ha ki sngi u Abraham u kpa jong u; namar ki Philistia ki la pynsangeh ia ki hadien ka jingiap u Abraham: bad u la khot ia ki kyrteng jong ki hadien ki kyrteng kiba u kpa jong u u la khot ia ki .

en: But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .
kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la bishni bad ki la lumlang ïa ki riewkhñium bymsalia na ki lynti bad na u paidbah . Ki la pynkhihwin ïa ka shnong baroh kawei bad ki la tur ïa ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Jason , ha ka jingpyrshang ban lap ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ban wallam ïa ki shabar sha u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym ngeit ki la iaid kai da ka jingsngewsih, ki la ialam sha ki katto katne ki briew kiba sniew, bad ki la lum ia ka kynhun , bad ki la buh ia ka shnong baroh kawei ha ka jingkhihwin , bad ki la hiar thma ia ka iing u Jason bad ki la wad ban wanrah ia ki sha ki briew .

en: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him : therefore he shall be grieved , and return , and have indignation against the holy covenant : so shall he do  ; he shall even return , and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant .
kha: Ki nong Rom kin wan ha ki liengbah bad kin pyrshah ïa u , bad un sa sheptieng .  Te un leit phai pat ha ka jingbitar shla bad un pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong U Blei . Un bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa kata ka niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki lieng Kittim kin wan pyrshah ia u: namarkata un sngewsih, bad un wan phai noh, bad un don ka jingbitar pyrshah ia ka jutang bakhuid: kumta un leh;

en: These are spots in your feasts of charity , when they feast with you , feeding themselves without fear : clouds they are without water , carried about of winds  ; trees whose fruit withereth , without fruit , twice dead , plucked up by the roots  ;
kha: Da ki jingkhroh bym don jinglehrain , ki long ka jingthohbria ha ki jingkhawai ïasyllok jong phi . Ki kitkhia tang na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki long kum ki lyoh ba rah ka lyer , hynrei khlem wanrah slap . Ki long kum ki dieng ba khlem soh , wat ha ka synrai , ki dieng ba la rat naduh ki thied bad kiba la ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki jaka ha ki jingkhawai bam jong phi, haba ki bam ia lade khlem jingtieng: ki lyoh ki long khlem um, la rah kylleng ki Iyer ; ki dieng kiba ki soh jong ki ki tyrkhong, khlem soh, arsien ki la tyrkhong da ki tynrai ; .

en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes , and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls ! Will ye hunt the souls of my people , and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you ?
kha: bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa ki :  Ma phi ki kynthei phi long kiba la tim ! Phi suh ki jingteh kti myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei baroh bad phi thaw ki jaiñ teh khlieh myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei ban phong ha ki khlieh jong ki , khnang ba ki lah ban don ka bor halor ka jingim jong kiwei pat ki briew . Phi kwah ban don ka bor jong ka jingim bad jingïap halor ki briew jong nga bad ban pyndonkam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong ia ki kynthei kiba shna ia ki tyrpeng ha ki thliew kti baroh , bad ki shna ia ki khniang ha ka khlieh jong kawei pa kawei ka jinglong ban leit khwai ia ki mynsiem ! Hato phin leit khwai ia ki mynsiem jong ki briew jong nga , bad phin pynim ia ki mynsiem kiba wan sha phi ?

en: Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the people be assembled : who among them can declare this , and shew us former things ? let them bring forth their witnesses , that they may be justified : or let them hear , and say , It is truth .
kha: Khot hajir ïa ki jaitbynriew ban wan sha ka jingbishar . Kino na ki blei jong ki kiba lah ban ïathuhlypa ïa ka lawei ? Kino na ki kiba la ong lypa kaei ka ban jia mynta ? Ai ba kine ki blei kin wanrah ïa ki sakhi jong ki ban pynshisha ba ki long kiba dei , ban phla ïa ka jingshisha jong ki ktien jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ialum lang, bad ai ba ki briew kin ialum lang: mano napdeng jong ki kiba lah ban pynbna ia kane , bad ki pyni ia ngi ia kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa ? ai ba kin wanrah ia ki sakhi jong ki, ba kin long kiba hok: ne ai ba kin iohsngew ia ki, bad kin ong , Ka long ka jingshisha .

en: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be , then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers .
kha: Ha ka snem jong ka Jingpynïoh pat , ynda haba baroh ka bri ka khyndew ïa kaba la die la pynïoh pat sha ki trai khyndew , ïa ka jingïohkynti jong ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad yn kynthup lang junom ha kata ka jait kaba ki ïashongkurim bad kan long ka jingduh ïa ka jait jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ka jubile jong ki khun Israel kan long , te yn buh ia ka pateng jong ki ha ka pateng jong ka jaitbynriew ha kaba ki ioh: kumta yn weng noh ia ka pateng jong ki na ka pateng jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment  ; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great  ; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man  ; for the judgment is God s : and the cause that is too hard for you , bring it unto me , and I will hear it .
kha: Wat ïashah liang ha ki rai jong phi ; bishar ïa uwei pa uwei ha kajuh ka nongrim , kam pher la u long uba kumno kumno . Wat sheptieng ïano ïano , naba ki rai kiba phi ai ki wan na U Blei . Lada kano kano ka kam ïakajia ka eh than ïa phi ban rai , wallam ïa ka sha nga , bad ngan rai ïa ka .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban burom ia ki briew ha ka jingbishar ; hynrei phin sngap ia kiba rit bad kiba khraw phin ym tieng ia ka khmat u briew namar ka jingbishar ka long kaba eh palat ia phi: bad ka daw kaba eh palat ia phi, to wanrah ia ka ha nga, bad ngan iohsngew ia ka.

en: And Ahimaaz called , and said unto the king , All is well . And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king .
kha: U Ahimaas u pyrta khublei ïa u syiem , u rynsied ïa lade ha madan ha khmat jong u , bad ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ki rangbah kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Kynrad !
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahimaas u la khot bad u la ong ha u syiem, Baroh ki long kiba bha. Bad u la dem khrup ha khmat u syiem bad u la ong: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong me uba la aiti ia ki briew kiba la rah ia ka kti jong ki pyrshah ia u kynrad jong nga .

en: And said unto them , Ye shall not bring in the captives hither : for whereas we have offended against the  Lord  already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass : for our trespass is great , and there is fierce wrath against Israel .
kha: Ki ong ,  Wat wan ïalam ïa kito ki koidi shane , Ngi la leh pop lypa pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynbitar la biang ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi . Mynta phi kwah ban leh ei ei ban nang pynkit pop ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki: Phim dei ban wanrah ia ki mraw hangne: namar katba ngi la sngewsih ia U Trai mynta , phi thmu ban pyndap shuh shuh ia ki pop jong ngi bad ia ka jingleh bymman jong ngi: namar ka jingleh bymman jong ngi ka long kaba khraw , bad ka don ka jingbitar kaba jur ia ki Israel .

en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee , and prevailed against thee  ; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee : there is none understanding in him .
kha: Kiba ïateh lok bad phi ki la shukor ïa phi ; ki la beh noh ïa phi na la ka ri . Ki briew kiba ïasuk bad phi , mynta ki la jop ïa phi . Kito ki paralok kiba ju ïabam lang bad phi , ki la pynap jingriam ïa phi ; ki ong shaphang jong phi , ‘ Shano kato ka jingstad-buit baroh ba u don ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki briew jong ka jinglong ba sniew jong me ki la wanrah ia me haduh u pud: ki briew kiba la iasuk bad me ki la thok ia me, bad ki la jop ia me; kita kiba bam ia u kpu jong me ki la buh ia ka jingmynsaw hapoh jong me: ym don jingmut ei ei ha u .

en: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .
kha: Hapdeng kita ki jingthaw don kaei kaei kaba syriem kum ka dongmusa bameh , kaba ïai khih . Ka ding ka klang bad pynmih ki jingthaba leilieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka dur jong ki jingthaw ba im, ka dur jong ki ka long kum ki dewiong kiba thang ding: ka la kiew bad hiar hapdeng ki jingthaw ba im ; bad ka ding ka la shai , bad na ka ding ka la mih ka jingshai .

en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague be somewhat dark , and the plague spread not in the skin , the priest shall pronounce him clean : it is but a scab : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .
kha: Hadien hynñiew sngi , u lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa u , bad lada kata ka prum ka la nang jah bad kam shym pur satia , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long uba khuid ; ka dei tang ka prum . Uta u briew un sait ïa la ki jaiñ , bad un long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un peit biang ia u ha ka sngi kaba hynriew: bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam kam saphriang katto katne ha ka sniehdoh, u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khuid: ka long tang ka sniehdoh: bad un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un long uba khuid .

en: And he said , Behold now , my lords , turn in , I pray you , into your servant s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay  ; but we will abide in the street all night .
kha: U dem ngon ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong ,  Ko rangbah , nga don hangne ban shakri ïa phi . Sngewbha wan sha ïing jong nga . Phi lah ban sait ïa la ki kjat , bad ban sahmiet ruh . Lashai phi lah ban khie dang step , bad bteng ïa la ka jingleit .  Hynrei ki jubab ,  Em , ngin sahmiet hangne ha ka jaka bakylluid jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ha khmih mynta, ko kynrad jong nga, to phai noh sha ka iing jong u shakri jong phi, bad to sah baroh shi miet, bad to sait ia ki kjat jong phi, bad phin khie dang step bad iaid noh ia ki lynti jong phi . Ki la ong: Em; hynrei ngin sah ha lynti baroh shi miet .

en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity  ; yea , thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity , nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity  ;
kha: Pha la dei ban ym rung shapoh ka nongbah jong ki briew jong nga ban risa beiñ halor ki jingshah shitom jong ki bad ban kurup ïa ka spah jong ki ha ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la dei ban rung ha ka khyrdop jong ki briew jong nga ha ka sngi jong ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki ; .

en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah , a captain of his , conspired against him , and smote him in Samaria , in the palace of the king s house , with Argob and Arieh , and with him fifty men of the Gileadites : and he killed him , and reigned in his room .
kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka kynhun shipai u Pekahaïah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah , ki ïasylla lem bad ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah na Gilead , ki pynïap ïa u Pekahaïah ha ka bynta bashapoh jong ka kynroh ka ïingsyiem ha Samaria , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Pekah u khun jong u Remaliah, u rangbah jong u, u la thmu ia u, bad u la shoh ia u ha Samaria, ha ka iing syiem, bad u Argob bad u Arieh, bad bad u sanphew ngut ki briew na Gilead: bad u la pyniap ia u, bad u la synshar ha ka kamra jong u .

en: So the people sent to Shiloh , that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  of hosts , which dwelleth between the cherubims : and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were there with the ark of the covenant of God .
kha: Kumta ki phah nonglamktien sha Shiloh bad ki wanrah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , uba shongkhet halor ki Kherub . Bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Eli , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki wan ryngkat hangta bad ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew ki la phah sha Shiloh, ba kin wanrah na kata ka synduk ka jutang U Trai jong ki paid: bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Eli, u Hophni bad u Phinehas ki la don hangta bad ka synduk ka jutang U Blei .

en: Huram said moreover , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , that made heaven and earth , who hath given to David the king a wise son , endued with prudence and understanding , that might build an house for the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ! U la ai ha u syiem Dabid , ïa u khun uba stad , uba dap da ka jingshemphang bad ka jingtbit , uba mynta u thmu ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U  Trai  bad ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u la ong shuh shuh , La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , uba la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew , uba la ai ha u syiem u Dabid u khun uba stad , uba la pynkhih da ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang , uba lah ban tei ia ka iing na ka bynta U Trai bad ka iing na ka bynta ka hima jong u .

en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , and out of Syria–maacah , and out of Zobah .
kha: U syiem Hanun bad ki Ammon ki sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong ïa u Dabid u nongshun jong ki , kumta ki siew laiphew saw hajar kilo ka rupa ban wai ki kali ïapom bad ki nongñiah kali ïapom na ka Mesopotamia bashaneng bad na ki jylla Syria jong ka Maakah bad Sobah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Ammon ki la iohi ba ki la leh bein ia lade ha u Dabid, u Hanun bad ki khun Ammon ki la phah shi hajar talent ka rupa ban shim ia ki da ki kali kit nongpang na Mesopotamia bad na Syria iah bad na Sobah .

en: And shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Even so will I break this people and this city , as one breaketh a potter s vessel , that cannot be made whole again : and they shall bury them in Topheth , till there be no place to bury .
kha: bad ban ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong ,  Ngan pynpait ïa kane ka jaitbynriew bad ïa kane ka nongbah , bad kan long kum une u khra khyndew ba la pait u bym lah ban pyndait pat . Ki briew kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki ha Topheth namar yn ym don hangno hangno hawei pat ban tep ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid; Kumta ngan pynpra ia une u briew bad ia kane ka shnong, kumba u briew u pynpra ia ka umphniang khiew kaba ym lah ban pynlong pura: bad kin tep ia ki ha Topheth , haduh ba ym don jaka ban tep .

en: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in , the more part advised to depart thence also , if by any means they might attain to Phenice , and there to winter  ; which is an haven of Crete , and lieth toward the south west and north west .
kha: Ka kadlieng kam da long kaba bha ban rieh tlang ; kumta kiba bun ki briew ki la kham mon ban pynmih noh ïa ka sha ka duriaw bad ban pyrshang ban poi ha Phoiniki , lada long kaba lah , khnang ban rieh tlang hangta . Ka Phoiniki ka long ka kadlieng ha Krit kaba phai pyrshah shaphang shathie lam sepngi bad shatei lam sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba ka jaka ri khunswet kam shym la long kaba sngewtynnad ban leit shapoh ri, katta ka la ai jingmut ban leit noh nangta ruh, lada da kano kano ka lad ki lah ban poi sha Phenice, bad hangta ban leit sha Phenice, bad hangta ban leit shaphang shathie lam mihngi bad shaphang shathie lam mihngi .

en: And Saul said to David , Behold my elder daughter Merab , her will I give thee to wife : only be thou valiant for me , and fight the  Lord s  battles . For Saul said , Let not mine hand be upon him , but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him .
kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  Kane ka dei ka Merab ka khun jong nga kaba kham shuwa . Ngan ai ïa ka ha me kum ka tnga jong me halor ka kyndon ba me dei ban shakri ïa nga kum u shipai bashlur bad baïaineh , bad ïaleh ïa ki thma U  Trai .  ( U Saul u nang pyrkhat ba ha kane ka rukom ki Philistia kin ïoh pynïap ïa u Dabid bad um da donkam ban leh da lade . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u Dabid, Ha khmih ka khun kaba kham heh jong nga, ngan ai ia me ha ka tnga: tang ma me ialeh na ka bynta jong nga, bad ialeh ia ki thma jong U Trai . Na u Saul u la ong, Wat ai ba ka kti jong nga kan long halor jong u, hynrei to ai ba ka kti jong ki Philistia kan long halor jong u .

en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites : and the children of Aaron the priest , which were of the Levites , had by lot out of the tribe of Judah , and out of the tribe of Simeon , and out of the tribe of Benjamin , thirteen cities .
kha: Ki longïing na ka kur Kohath jong ka jait Lebi ki long kiba nyngkong eh ban ïoh ïa ki nongbah . Ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron u lyngdoh ki ïoh khatlai tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah , Simeon bad Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lot ka la mih na ka bynta ki longiing jong ki Kohat: bad ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron ki long na ki Lebi ki don shiphew tylli ki shnong na ka jait Judah bad na ka jait u Simion bad na ka jait u Benjamin .

en: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded : and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that should go out on the sabbath , and came to Jehoiada the priest .
kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u Jehoïada bad ki wallam ïa ki rangbah jong ki sha u — kito ki bym dei ban leit trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton bad kito kiba dei ban leit trei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah shiphew ngut ki la leh katkum kiei kiei baroh kiba u Lyngdoh u la hukum: bad ki la shim ia uwei pa uwei u briew jong u uba dei ban wan rung ha ka sngi saitjain , bad ki kiba dei ban leit shabar ha ka sngi saitjain .

en: Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .
kha: Te phi la jubab , ‘ Moses , ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Hynrei mynta ngin leit tur , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ban ïaleh thma , u da tharai ba ka long kaba jem ban leit hiarthma ïa kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phi la jubab bad phi la ong ha nga: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai, ngin leit sha jrong bad ialeh katba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ia ngi . Bad haba phi la ia tyngkhuh bad uwei pa uwei u tiar ialeh jong u, phi la pynkhreh ban leit sha lum .

en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons , which they shall offer unto the  Lord  in the day when he is anointed  ; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual , half of it in the morning , and half thereof at night .
kha: na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh lyngdoh ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron . Ha ka sngi ba yn pynkyntang ïa u , un ai kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  shi kilo u  purew ( kaba ïaryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba man ka sngi ) , shiteng ha ka por mynstep bad shiteng ha ka por janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh jong u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ha ka sngi ba u la pynsleh ia u; ka shi bynta na ka shi bynta na ka shini kaba bha na ka bynta ka jingknia doh kaba neh slem, shiteng na ka ha ka por mynstep bad shiteng na ka ha ka por miet .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto Aaron thy brother , that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil before the mercy seat , which is upon the ark  ; that he die not : for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat .
kha: U ong ,  Ïathuh ha u hynmen jong me u Aaron ba dei tang ha ka por kaba dei ba un leit shadien ka jingkah jong ka jaka kaba khuid tam , namar ba dei hangta ba nga mihpaw ha u lyoh halor ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang . Lada um kohnguh , un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To kren ha u Aaron hynmen jong me, ba un ym wan ha ka jaka bakhuid hapoh ka jingtap ha khmat ka jaka ba la buh ha ka synduk; ba un ym iap: namar ngan paw ha u lyoh halor ka jaka ba la buh ha ka synduk .

en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .
kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka snem u Hoshea u phah nonglamktien sha u So , u syiem ka Ijipt , ban pan ïa ka jingïarap jong u , bad u sangeh noh ka jingsiew ïa ka jingnguh syiem ba man ka snem sha ka Assyria . Haba u Shalmaneser u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Hoshea bad buh ïa u ha ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Assyria u la shem ia ka jingthmu ha Hosia: namar u la phah ia u sha u syiem Ijipt , bad um shym la wanrah ia ka jingai sngewbha ha u syiem Assyria kumba u la leh man la u snem: namarkata u syiem Assyria u la khang ia u bad u la teh ia u ha phatok .

en: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee , and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee , thou shalt do : thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee , to the right hand , nor to the left .
kha: Pdiang ïa ka rai jong ki bad leh thik kumba ki bthah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka sentens jong ka hukum kaba kin hikai ia me bad kat kum ka jingbishar kaba kin iathuh ia me: me dei ban kyntait na ka sentens kaba kin pyni ia me, sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: Go , and gather the elders of Israel together , and say unto them , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , appeared unto me , saying , I have surely visited you , and seen that which is done to you in Egypt :
kha: Khie leit lumlang ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Israel bad ïathuh ha ki ba nga U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , U Isaak , bad u Jakob , nga la mihpaw ha me . Ïathuh ruh ha ki ba nga la wan jngoh ïa ki , bad nga la ïohi aïu ki nong Ijipt ki la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad lum lang ia ki rangbah Israel bad ong ha ki: U Trai U Blei jong phi, U Blei jong u Abraham, u Isaak bad u Jakob, u la paw ha nga, u da ong: Nga la leit jngoh shisha ia phi bad nga la iohi ia kata kaba la leh ia phi ha Ijipt:

en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king , and if it please the king to grant my petition , and to perform my request , let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them , and I will do to morrow as the king hath said .
kha: Lada ma phi ko syiem phi lehsbun ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha kawei pat ka jingkhawai la shai ka sngi ba ngan pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi . Ha kata ka por ngan sa ong ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat u syiem bad lada ka long kaba sngewbha ia u syiem ban ai ia ka jingkyrpad jong nga bad ban pyndep ia ka jingkyrpad jong nga , to ai ba u syiem bad u Haman kin wan sha ka jingkhawai kaba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan leh lashai kumba u syiem u la ong .

en: And I beheld , and , lo , in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts , and in the midst of the elders , stood a Lamb as it had been slain , having seven horns and seven eyes , which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng hapdeng ka khet , ïa kaba la ker sawdong da ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki nongsharai balang . U Khunlangbrot u la paw ba u la shah pynïap . U don hynñiew tylli ki reng bad hynñiew tylli ki khmat , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem U Blei ïa kiba la phah sha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi, bad, ha pdeng ka khet bad ki saw tylli ki mrad, bad hapdeng ki rangbah, u la ieng u Khunlangbrot kumba la pyniap ia u, uba don hynriew tylli ki bniat bad hynriew tylli ki khmat, kiba long ki hynriew tylli ki Mynsiem U Blei kiba la phah shabar sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: But because the  Lord  loved you , and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers , hath the  Lord  brought you out with a mighty hand , and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .
kha: Hynrei ka long namar ba U  Trai  u ieit ïa phi bad u bat ïa la ka kular kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad namar kata u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u bad u la pyllait na ka jinglongmraw ïa phi na u Pharaoh u syiem ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba U Trai u la ieit ia phi bad namar ba un bat ia ka jingsmai kaba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , U Trai u la pynmih ia phi da ka kti kaba khlain bad u la pyllait im ia phi na ka iing jong ki mraw , na ka kti u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt .

en: Yea , all Israel have transgressed thy law , even by departing , that they might not obey thy voice  ; therefore the curse is poured upon us , and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God , because we have sinned against him .
kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong me bad ki kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me la ong . Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad kumta me la wallam ha ngi ïa ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha Ka Aiñ u Moses , u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, ki Israel baroh ki la pynkhein ia ka hukum jong me, wat da kaba leit noh, ba kin ym kohnguh ia ka sur jong me ; namarkata ka jingtim ka la tuid halor jong ngi, bad ka jingsmai kaba la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses u shakri U Blei, namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia u .

en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , Mark , I pray you , and see how this man seeketh mischief : for he sent unto me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold  ; and I denied him not .
kha: U syiem Ahab u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka ri bad u ong ,  Phi ïohi ba une u briew u kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi . U la phah khubor sha nga da kaba dawa ïa ki tnga bad ki khun jong nga , ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga bad nga la mynjur .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Israel u la khot ia ki rangbah jong ka ri baroh, bad u la ong, Mark, nga kyrpad ia phi, bad peit kumno une u briew u wad ia ka jingsniew: namar u la phah sha nga na ka bynta ki tnga jong nga bad na ka bynta ki khun jong nga bad na ka bynta ka rupa jong nga; bad na ka bynta ka ksiar jong nga; bad ngam shym la kyntait ia u .

en: And it came to pass on a certain day , as he was teaching , that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by , which were come out of every town of Galilee , and Judaea , and Jerusalem : and the power of the Lord was present to heal them .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dang hikai , katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka shnong na Galilaïa bad Judia bad na Jerusalem ; ki la ïashong hangta . Ka bor jong U Trai ka la don na ka bynta U Jisu ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei ka sngi, katba u dang hikai, ba ki don ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka hukum kiba shong hajan, kiba la mih na kawei pa kawei ka shnong Galilaia bad ka Judaea bad ka Jerusalem: bad ka bor U Trai ka la don ban pynkoit ia ki .

en: And the little chambers thereof , and the posts thereof , and the arches thereof , were according to these measures : and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about : it was fifty cubits long , and five and twenty cubits broad .
kha: Ki kamra ap phira , ki kynroh bashapoh bad ka kamra rung jong ka ki heh katjuh kat kito kiba ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . La don ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong , bad ha ka kamra rung ruh . Baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kamra rit jong ka, bad ki tnum jong ka, bad ki arphew phut ki long katkum kine ki jingthew: bad ki don ki jingkhang ha ka bad ha ki arphew phut sawdong: ka la jrong sanphew cubit bad arphew cubit .

en: And if his father have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it : and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Lada u kpa jong u um don hynmen ne para shynrang lane ki kñi , u kur uba ïajan eh bad u un ïohpateng ïa ka , bad un bat ïa ka kum la ka jong ka nongkynti . Ki Israel ki dei ban kohnguh ïa kane ka aiñ kumba nga , U  Trai  , nga la hukum ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u kpa jong u um don hynmen, te phin ai ia ka pateng jong u hajan jong u na ka iing jong u: bad kan long ha ki khun Israel ka ain bishar kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .
kha: Mynta , la kumno kumno ngan phah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong nga ban ïit ha ka ïingsyiem jong me bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad ban shim ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba ki kheiñ kordor . Kin poi hangto lashai kumba katne por .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ia ki shakri jong nga sha me ban leit sha kane ka por, bad kin wad ia ka iing jong me, bad ki iing jong ki shakri jong me; bad kan long, ba kaei kaei kaba sngewtynnad ha ki khmat jong me, kin buh ia ka ha ka kti jong ki, bad kin shim noh ia ka .

en: And saying , Sirs , why do ye these things ? We also are men of like passions with you , and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God , which made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all things that are therein :
kha: Balei phi leh ïa kane ? Ngi hi ngi long tang ki briew kiba kum ma phi ! Ngi don hangne ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , ban pynphai noh ïa phi na kine kiei kiei ki bymmyntoi sha U Blei uba im , uba la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kat kaba don ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba ong: Ki Sir , balei phi ia kine kiei kiei ? Ngi ruh ngi long ki briew kiba sngewtynnad bad phi , bad ngi ialap ha phi ba phi dei ban phai noh na kine ki jinglong ba im sha U Blei uba im uba la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew bad ka duriaw bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka:

en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds , and their post by my posts , and the wall between me and them , they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed : wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger .
kha: Ki syiem ki la shna ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad ïingsyiem jong ki marpyrshah ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad jong ka Templ jong nga , ba kumta ka don tang ka kynroh hapdeng jong ngi . Ki la pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh , bad kumta ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingpynbeit jong ki da ki jingkhang jong nga, bad ka post jong ki da ki post jong nga, bad ka kynroh hapdeng jong nga bad ki, ki la pynjakhlia wat ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da ki jingleh bymman jong ki: namar kata nga la bam ia ki ha ka jingbitar jong nga .

en: Unto this day they do after the former manners : they fear not the  Lord  , neither do they after their statutes , or after their ordinances , or after the law and commandment which the  Lord  commanded the children of Jacob , whom he named Israel  ;
kha: Ki dang ïai leh hi ïa la ki rukom barim haduh kane ka sngi . Kim shym mane ïa U  Trai  lane kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba u la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa uba u pynkyrteng u Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh kane ka sngi ki leh katkum ka akor kaba mynshuwa: kim tieng ia U Trai, lymne katkum ki ain jong ki, ne katkum ki kyndon jong ki, ne katkum ka hukum bad ka hukum kaba U Trai u la hukum ia ki khun u Jakob, ia kiba u la jer kyrteng u Israel;

en: And I called for a drought upon the land , and upon the mountains , and upon the corn , and upon the new wine , and upon the oil , and upon that which the ground bringeth forth , and upon men , and upon cattle , and upon all the labour of the hands .
kha: Nga la wallam ïa ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri — ha ki lumrit jong ka , ha ki lyngkha kew jong ka , ki bri sohwaiñ , ki brisoh Olib — ha baroh ki jingthung kiba ka khyndew ka pynmih , ha ki briew bad ki mrad , ha baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la khot ia ka jingkhriat ha ka ri bad ha ki lum bad ha u kew bad ha ka wain thymmai bad ha ka umphniang bad ha kata kaba ka khyndew ka pynmih, bad ha ki briew bad ha ki masi bad ha ka jingtrei shitom baroh .

en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose , and shouted , and pursued the Philistines , until thou come to the valley , and to the gates of Ekron . And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even unto Gath , and unto Ekron .
kha: Ki shipai Israel bad Judah ki risa shaid bad ki mareh nadien jong ki , ki beh kthong haduh Gath bad shaduh ki khyrdop ka Ekron . Ki Philistia ki la kyllon mynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti naduh Shaaraim , haduh Gath bad Ekron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ki Israel bad ki Judah ki la ieng bad ki la pyrta bad ki la beh ia ki Philistia haduh ba me da poi sha ka them bad sha ki khyrdop Ekron . Bad ki Philistia ki la hap ha ka lynti sha Shaaram, wat haduh Gath bad haduh Ekron .

en: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom , which shall never be destroyed : and the kingdom shall not be left to other people , but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms , and it shall stand for ever .
kha: Ha ka por jong kito ki nongsynshar U Blei ka bneng un seng ka hima ka ban ym kut junom . Yn ym lah ban jop ïa ka , hynrei kan pynjot thiaw ïa baroh kito ki hima , bad nangta kan neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki sngi jong kine ki syiem U Blei jong ki bneng un buh ia ka hima kaba ym shah pynjot satia: bad ka hima kan ym iehnoh ha kiwei pat ki briew , hynrei kan sa bthei bad kan bam ia kine ki hima baroh , bad kan ieng junom .

en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder , to repair the house of the  Lord  his God .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , hadien ba u la pynkhuid ïa ka ri bad ïa ka Templ da kaba pynkut noh ïa ka jingmane blei thala , u syiem Josaïah u phah lai ngut ki rangbah ban tei pynbha ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei : u Shaphan u khun jong u Asalaïah , Maaseïah , u lat ka Jerusalem , bad u Joah u khun jong u Joahas , u rangbah synshar ba-halor .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingsynshar jong u, haba u la pynkhuid ia ka ri bad ka iing, u la phah ia u Shaphan u khun u Azaliah bad u Maaseiah u Lat ka shnong bad u Joah u khun u Joah u nongthoh kot jong u .

en: And he said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Put every man his sword by his side , and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp , and slay every man his brother , and every man his companion , and every man his neighbour .
kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u hukum ïa uwei pa uwei na phi ban kieng ïa la ka waitlam , bad ïaid lyngba ïa ka jaka sher dara baroh na kane ka khyrdop sha kawei pat bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah uba long u hynmen u para jong u , ïa ki paralok jong u , bad ïa ki paramarjan jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u ong: To buh ia ka waitlam jong u ha ka liang jong u, bad leit shapoh bad shabar na ka khyrdop sha ka khyrdop baroh kawei ka jaka shong jaka sah, bad to pyniap ia u hynmen jong u, bad uwei pa uwei u paralok jong u .

en: But the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Look not on his countenance , or on the height of his stature  ; because I have refused him : for the  Lord  seeth not as man seeth  ; for man looketh on the outward appearance , but the  Lord  looketh on the heart .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Wat pynleit jingmut katno u jrong ka rynïeng bad katno u bhabriew , namar nga la kyntait ïa u ; naba ngam bishar kumba bishar ki briew . U briew u peit ïa ka dur kaba shabar , hynrei nga , nga peit ïa ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la ong ha u Samuel , Wat peit ia ka khmat jong u, ne ha ka jingjrong jong ka dur jong u ; namar nga la kyntait ia u: namar U Trai um iohi kumba u briew u iohi ; namar u briew u peit ia ka dur ba shabar , hynrei U Trai u peit ia ka dohnud .

en: I am verily a man which am a Jew , born in Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel , and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers , and was zealous toward God , as ye all are this day .
kha: Nga long u Jiw , ïa uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , hynrei ïa uba la pynheh pynsan hangne ha Jerusalem kum u shah hikai jong u Gamaliel . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka jinghikai bapyrkhing ha ka Hukum jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad nga la long uba la pynkyntang sha U Blei kumba long ma phi baroh hangne ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long shisha u briew uba la kha ha Tarsos, ka shnong ha Cilicia, hynrei nga la shah pynsan ha kane ka shnong ha ki kjat jong u Gamaliel , bad nga la shah hikai kat kum ka rukom kaba janai jong ki kpa tymmen , bad nga la sngewsih ia U Blei kumba phi long baroh ha kane ka sngi .

en: For the  Lord  shall comfort Zion : he will comfort all her waste places  ; and he will make her wilderness like Eden , and her desert like the garden of the  Lord   ; joy and gladness shall be found therein , thanksgiving , and the voice of melody .
kha: Ngan pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ïa ka Jerusalem , sha kito baroh kiba shong halor ki jingpra jong ka . Wat la ka jaka jong ka , ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka kper , kum ka kper kaba nga la thung ha Eden . Ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen kin don hangta , bad ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un pyntngen ia ka Seion: un pyntngen ia ki jaka ba la jot jong ka baroh bad un pynlong ia ka ri khlaw jong ka kum ka Eden , bad ka ri khlaw jong ka kum ka kper U Trai; ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen kan shem ha ka .

en: But it shall be on the seventh day , that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows , even all his hair he shall shave off : and he shall wash his clothes , also he shall wash his flesh in water , and he shall be clean .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un khi biang ïa la u  ñiuhkhlieh , u  ñiuhtmoh , u  ñiuhmat , bad u shñiuh baroh na ka met jong u ; un sait ruh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad un sum un sleh de , bad nangta un sa long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynriew, ba un ot ia ki shniuh jong u baroh na ka khlieh bad ki ryndang bad ki khmat jong u: bad un sait ia ki jain jong u baroh: bad un sait ia ka doh jong u ha ka um .

en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  , that we may enquire of the  Lord  by him ? And one of the king of Israel s servants answered and said , Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat , which poured water on the hands of Elijah .
kha: U syiem Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato don nongïathuhlypa hangne da uba ngi lah ban kylli na U  Trai  ?  U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki kynhun u syiem Joram u jubab ,  U Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat u don hangne . U dei u nongïarap jong u Elijah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la ong: Hato ym don hangne u nongiathuhlypa jong U Trai, ba ngin kylli ia U Trai da u ? Bad uwei na ki shakri jong ki Israel u la jubab bad u la ong: Hangne u Elisa u khun u Shaphat uba la theh um ha ki kti jong u Elijah .

en: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths , and sat under the booths : for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so . And there was very great gladness .
kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jinglongmraw , ki la shna ïa ki jakarieh bad shong hapoh jong ki . Kane ka la long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba la leh naduh ki sngi u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad baroh ki la kmen haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiaseng baroh jong ki kaba la mih na ka jingshah set ka la shna ia ki ïingsah: namar naduh ki sngi u Jeshua u khun u Nun haduh kata ka sngi kim shym la leh kumta . Bad ka la don ka jingkmen kaba khraw shibun .

en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings , wherein thou hast transgressed against me : for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride , and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain .
kha: Ha kata ka por , ma phi , ki briew jong nga phim donkam shuh ban lehrain ba phi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno baroh uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng , bad phin ym ïeng ïaleh pyrshah shuh da lei lei ïa nga ha u lum bakyntang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi wat sngewlehrain ia ki jingleh jong me baroh, ha kaba me la leh pyrshah ia nga: namar nangta ngan weng noh na pdeng jong me ia kito kiba kmen ha ka jingsarong jong me, bad me nym sngew sarong shuh namar u lum bakhuid jong nga .

en: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place  ; thou , and thy sons , and thy daughters with thee : for they be thy due , and thy sons  due , which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel .
kha: Hynrei ma me bad ki longïing jong me , phi lah ban bam ïa ka shadem bad ïa ka kjat-dien ïa kiba la ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang bad ka jingsynñiang bakyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh . Phi lah ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long kaba khuid . Ïa kine ki jingkñia ainguh la ai ha me bad ha ki khun jong me kum ka bynta kaba dei ka jong me na ki jingainguh ïasyllok jong ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sniehdoh kaba jylliew bad kaba heh phin bam ha ka jaka kaba khuid; me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me: namar ki long ki hok jong me, bad ki khun shynrang jong me kiba dei ban long ki jong ki Israel .

en: But he , beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace , declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison . And he said , Go shew these things unto James , and to the brethren . And he departed , and went into another place .
kha: U la ai dak ïa ki da ka kti jong u ba kin sngap jar , bad u la batai ha ki kumno U Trai u la ïalam ïa u shabar ka byndi .  Ïathuh ïa kane ha u Jakob bad ha kiwei pat ki parabangeit ,  u la ong ; nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la pynkhih ia ki da ka kti ban bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki, u la pynbna ha ki kumno U Trai u la pynmih ia u na phatok . Bad u la ong, To leit pyni ia kine kiei kiei ha u Jakob bad ha ki para bangeit . U la leit noh bad u la leit sha kawei pat ka jaka .

en: And Saul disguised himself , and put on other raiment , and he went , and two men with him , and they came to the woman by night : and he said , I pray thee , divine unto me by the familiar spirit , and bring me him up , whom I shall name unto thee .
kha: Kumta u Saul u riam pher ïa lade da kaba phong da kiwei pat ki jaiñ , bad ynda la dum ma u bad ar ngut na ki rangbah jong u ki leit sha kata ka kynthei .  Wad jingtip na ki mynsiem na ka bynta jong nga bad to ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka ban sa jia ,  u ong ha ka .  Khot ïa uta u mynsiem jong uta u briew uba nga khot kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la pynkylla dur ia lade, bad u la leit noh bad arngut ki briew ryngkat bad u, bad ki la wan sha kata ka kynthei ha ka por miet: bad u la ong: Nga kyrpad ia me, da ka mynsiem ba la tip bha, bad wanrah ia nga sha jrong ia u, ia uba ngan jer ha me .

en: And I saw the dead , small and great , stand before God  ; and the books were opened : and another book was opened , which is the book of life : and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books , according to their works .
kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa kiba ïap , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ïeng ha khmat jong ka khet . Ïa ki kitab la plied , bad nangta la plied sa kawei pat ka kitab , ka kitab jong kiba im . Ïa kiba ïap la bishar kat kum kaei kaba ki la leh , kumba la buh jingthoh ha ki kitab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia kiba iap, kiba rit bad kiba khraw, ha khmat U Blei; bad la plie ia kawei pat ka kot kaba long ka Kitab ka jingim: bad la bishar ia kiba iap na kita kiei kiei kiba la thoh ha ki kot , kat kum ki kam jong ki .

en: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , saith the  Lord   ; and I will requite thee in this plat , saith the  Lord . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the  Lord .
kha: ‘ Nga la ïohi mynhynnin ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Naboth bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Bad nga kular ba ngan pynshitom kylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka jaka .’ Kumta shim ïa ka met jong u Joram ,  u Jehu u hukum ïa u nongbud jong u ,  bad leit bret ïa ka ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth , khnang ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga la iohi hynnin ka sngi ia ka snam u Naboth bad ka snam jong ki khun shynrang jong u, ong u Trai ; bad ngan siew kylliang ia me ha kane ka plat , ong u Trai . Mynta to shim bad bret ia u ha ka plat jong ka khyndew kat kum ka ktien U Trai .

en: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech , that was in the court of the prison : and they let down Jeremiah with cords . And in the dungeon there was no water , but mire : so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .
kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa nga bad ki la pynhiar ïa nga da ki tyllai shapoh ka pung u khun syiem Malkhaïah , kaba don hapoh ka phyllaw ïingsyiem . Ym don um ha kata ka pung , tang ka ktieh , bad nga la ngam shapoh ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la shim ia u Jeremaiah bad ki la bret ia u ha ka thliew jong u Malkhiah u khun u Hamlekh: bad ki la pynhap ia u Jeremaiah da ki lynti . Bad ha ka thliew ym don um , hynrei ka dewbilat: kumta u Jeremaiah u la ngam ha ka dewbilat .

en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings , and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel .
kha: Ka shadem jong u mrad ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang , bad ka kjat-dien kamon ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang kaba U  Trai  u la shim na ki paid Israel bad ban ai ha ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ha ki lyngdoh pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka shyntur kaba jrong bad ka tyrpeng kaba heh nga la shim na ki khun Israel na ki jingknia jingsuk jong ki , bad nga la ai ia ki ha u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u da ka ain junom na ki khun Israel .

en: Who hath ascended up into heaven , or descended ? who hath gathered the wind in his fists ? who hath bound the waters in a garment ? who hath established all the ends of the earth ? what is his name , and what is his son s name , if thou canst tell ?
kha: Uei uba la ju long kynrad ïa ka jingtip ba kynja bneng ? Uei uba la ju kham ïa ka lyer ha la ka kti ? Lane uba la tehsong ïa ka um ha ka jaiñ lyngkhot ? Lane uba la pynskhem ïa ki pud jong ka pyrthei ? U dei uei lada phi tip ? Uei u khun jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la kiew sha bneng ne hiar ? mano ba la lum ia ka Iyer ha ki kti jong u ? mano ba la teh ia ki um ha ka jain ? mano ba la pynskhem ia ki tduh jong ka khyndew baroh ? kaei ka kyrteng jong u bad kaei ka kyrteng jong u khun jong u lada me lah ban iathuh ?

en: And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .
kha: U Aaron u dei ban teh ïa u ha ka shyllangmat jong u , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang sha nga , wat la ki briew ki bakla haba ki ai ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha ka khlieh Aaron, ba u Aaron un kit ia ka jingbymhok jong kiei kiei kiba kyntang, kiba ki khun Israel kin pynkyntang ha ki jingaiei bakhuid jong ki baroh; bad kan long beit ha ka khlieh jong u, ba kin shah pdiang ha khmat U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , when he reigned , that he smote all the house of Jeroboam  ; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed , until he had destroyed him , according unto the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite :
kha: Shisyndon u la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki dkhot baroh na ka longïing jong u Jeroboam . Kat kum ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba u shakri jong u , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh , ïa baroh ka longïing jong u Jeroboam la pynïap ; ym don shuh ba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la synshar, ba u la shoh ia ka iing jong u Jeroboiah baroh kawei u bym shym la iehnoh ia u Jeroboiah uba la ring mynsiem, haduh ba un da pynjot ia u, kat kum ka jingong U Trai, kaba u la kren da u shakri jong u u Ahiah u Shilonite:

en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .
kha: Katba u rangbah synshar u leit ban khot ïa u Mikaïah , u ong ha u ,  Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ba u syiem un jop bad phi ruh ka bha ba phin leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor uba la leit khot ia u Maiah u la kren ha u, u la ong: Ha khmih mynta, ki ktien ki nongiathuhlypa ki pynbna bha ia u syiem da kawei ka shyntur: to ai ba ka ktien jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, kan long kum ka ktien jong uwei na ki, bad kren ia kaba bha .

en: Behold , I will gather thee to thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace , neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place , and upon the inhabitants of the same . So they brought the king word again .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ngan wanrah ha Jerusalem kan ym wan tad hadien ka jingïap jong me . Ngan ai ba men ïap ha ka jingsuk .  Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat sha u syiem Josaïah ryngkat bad kane ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan lum ia me ha ki kpa tymmen jong me, bad me shah lum ha ka jingtep jong me ha ka jingsuk , lymne ki khmat jong me kin ym iohi ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba ngan wanrah ha kane ka jaka bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong kajuh . Kumta ki la wanrah biang ia ka ktien syiem .

en: And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day . And many of the people of the land became Jews  ; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .
kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad probins , hangno hangno ba la pule ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , ki Jiw ki pynlong ki shuti lehkmen ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai sngewbha bad jingkmen . Ha ka jingshisha , bun kiwei ki briew ki la kylla Jiw , namar mynta ki la sheptieng ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha man la ka jylla bad ha man la ka shnong, ha kano kano ka jaka ba u syiem bad ka hukum jong u ka wan, ki Jiw ki la ioh ia ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen, ka jingkhawai bad ka sngi kaba bha . Bad bun na ki briew jong ka ri ki la kylla long ki Jiw; namar ka jingtieng ia ki Jiw ki la hap ha ki .

en: Then said David , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , as his father shewed kindness unto me . And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father . And David s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Nga dei ban pyn-i ïa ka jingneh ka jingïalong paralok ïa u Hanun , kumba u Nahash , u kpa jong u , u la leh ïa nga .  Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Haba ki la poi ha Ammon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong u Hanun u khun u Nahas, kumba u kpa jong u u la leh sbun ia nga . U Dabid u la phah ban pyntngen ia u da ka kti jong ki shakri jong u na ka bynta u kpa jong u . Ki shakri u Dabid ki la wan sha ka ri jong ki khun Ammon .

en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego  ; these men , O king , have not regarded thee : they serve not thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
kha: La don katto katne ngut ki Jiw ïa kiba phi la buh ban khmih ïa ka probins jong ka Babilon — u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego — ki bym shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum u Syiem Kynrad . Kim shym mane ïa u blei jong phi lane dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba phi la phah pynïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don katto katne ki Jiw kiba me la buh halor ka jylla Babilon, u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego ; kine ki briew, ko syiem, kim shym la khein ia me: kim shakri ia ki blei jong me, lymne ki mane ia ka dur ksiar kaba me la buh .

en: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed , he went into his house  ; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem , he kneeled upon his knees three times a day , and prayed , and gave thanks before his God , as he did aforetime .
kha: Haba u Daniel u la tip ba ïa ka hukum la lah soi , u la leit sha ïing . Ha ka kamra kaba haneng jong ka ïing jong u la don ki jingkhangïit kiba phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta , kumba u la ju ïai leh , u la dem khohsiew ha ki jingkhangïit ba la plie bad u duwai sha U Blei lai sien shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Daniel u la tip ba la soi ia ka jingthoh, u la leit shapoh iing jong u ; bad ki jingkhang jong u ki la plie ha ka kamra jong u sha Jerusalem , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u lai sien ha ka shisngi , bad u la duwai bad u la ainguh ha khmat U Blei jong u kumba u la leh mynshuwa .

en: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway . And when the man saw that all the people stood still , he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field , and cast a cloth upon him , when he saw that every one that came by him stood still .
kha: Ka met jong u Amasa , ba la tap da ka snam , ka don hapdeng lynti . U briew jong u Joab u la ïohi ba uwei pa uwei u sangeh , kumta u tan ïa ka metïap na ka surok sha ka lyngkha bad u tap ïa ka da ka jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amasa u la iaid snam hapdeng ka surok bah . Bad haba uta u briew u la iohi ba ki briew baroh ki ieng slem , u la weng noh ia u Amasa na ka surok bah sha lyngkha , bad u la bret ia ka jain halor jong u , haba u la iohi ba uwei pa uwei uba wan hajan jong u u ieng slem .

en: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters , and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness , wherewith their enemies , and they that seek their lives , shall straiten them .
kha: U nongshun un kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad pyrshang ban pynïap ïa ki briew . Ka jingkerkut kaba shyrkhei katta katta ba ki briew hapoh ka nongbah kin ïabam iwei ïa iwei pat bad wat ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki ban bam ia ka doh jong ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki, bad kin bam ia ka doh jong u paralok jong u ha ka jingsma bad ka jingsma, bad ki nongshun jong ki, bad kita kiba wad ia ka jingim jong ki, kin pynkhih ia ki .
