en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah ngut na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Israel u la lum lang ia ki nongiathuhlypa kumba saw spah ngut ki briew bad u la ong ha ki: Hato ngan leit sha ka thma Ramothilead ne ngan leit sha ka thma ? Ki la ong: To leit shaneng; namar U Trai un aiti ia ka ha ka kti u syiem .

en: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee , and they come unto thee , and say unto thee , Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king , hide it not from us , and we will not put thee to death  ; also what the king said unto thee :
kha: Lada ki rangbah synshar ki ïohsngew ba nga la ïakren bad me , kin sa wan bad kylli ïa me kaei kaba ngi la ïakren . Kin sa kular ban ym pynïap ïa me lada me ïathuh ïa ki ïa baroh kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ki rangbah ki iohsngew ba nga la iakren bad me bad ki wan sha me bad ki ong ha me: To pynpaw ia ngi mynta ia kaei kaba me la ong ha u syiem .

en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the  Lord  thy God brought thee out : so shall the  Lord  thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .
kha: Kynmaw ruh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba shyrkhei kiba phi la ïohi , da ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad da ka borbah da ka ksang ti kaba la kner da kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi , kumta ruh un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh ïa kiba phi sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingpynshoi kiba khraw kiba me la iohi, bad ki dak bad ki jingphylla bad ka kti kaba khlain bad ka kti kaba la pynjrong shabar: kumta U Trai U Blei jong me un leh ia ki briew baroh kiba me tieng .

en: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain , according to the word of the  Lord  God of Israel , which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah , the son of Amittai , the prophet , which was of Gath–hepher .
kha: U kurup pat ïa ka ri baroh kaba dei jong ki Israel , naduh ka Khim Hamath ha ka phang shatei shaduh ka Duriaw Baïap ha ka phang shathie . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la kular lyngba u shakri jong u , u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Amittai , uba na Gath Hepher .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynphai biang ia ka rud duriaw jong ki Israel naduh ka jingrung jong u Hamath haduh ka duriaw jong ki Israel , kaba u la kren da ka kti jong u shakri jong u u Jonah , u khun jong u Amittai , u nongiathuhlypa uba long na Gathhepher .

en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his ass , and arose , and gat him home to his house , to his city , and put his household in order , and hanged himself , and died , and was buried in the sepulchre of his father .
kha: Haba u Ahithophel u la ïohi ba ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u ym shym la pdiang , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u leit phai noh sha la shnong . Ynda u la dep pynbeit ïa la ki kam ïing kam sem , u la sdien phasi ïa lade . La tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahitophel u la iohi ba ka jingmut jong u kam shym la bud, u la sngap jar ia ka tdong jong u, bad u la ieng, bad u la buh ia ka iing jong u ha ka shnong jong u, bad u la buh ia la ka iing ha ka rukom kaba iaid beit, bad u la sahkut ha ka jingtep jong u kpa jong u .

en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .
kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew bad ngan pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai kmen jong phi sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ba phin khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh bad phin phong ka jaiñ khain , bad phin long kum ki kmie ki kpa kiba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba tang marwei jong ki . Kata ka sngi kan long kaba kthang haduh kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkylla ia ki jingkhawai jong phi baroh sha ka jingsngewsih ; bad ngan wanrah ia ka jainkup ha ki tyrpeng baroh, bad ka jingsma ha kawei pa kawei ka khlieh ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka kum ka jingsngewsih jong u khun shynrang uba marwei, bad ka jingkut jong ka kum ka sngi kaba sngewsih .

en: When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city  ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street  ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .
kha: Ki la ïaid najan ka jaka ap phira kaba nyngkong bad nangta ïa kaba ar , bad ki la poi khatduh ha ka khyrdop nar kaba lam sha ka nongbah . Ka khyrdop ka la plie hi na ka bynta jong ki , bad ki la mih shabar . Ki la ïaid ha ka lynti bah , bad kynsan u angel u la iehnoh ïa u Petros .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la iaid lait ia kawei ka lynti kaba nyngkong bad kaba ar, ki la poi sha ka khyrdop nar kaba ialam sha ka shnong ; kaba la plie ia ki da ka mon jong u hi: bad ki la mih noh, bad ki la iaid lyngba kawei ka lynti ; bad mar kumta hi u angel u la leit noh na u .

en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates , until thy high and fenced walls come down , wherein thou trustedst , throughout all thy land : and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
kha: Kin tur pyrshah ïa ki shnong jong phi baroh ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , bad ki kynroh kiba jrong bad kiba skhem ha kiba ai jingshngain ïa phi kin kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un sa ker sawdong ia me ha ki khyrdop jong me baroh, haduh ba ki kynroh ba jrong bad ba la ker sawdong jong me kin hiar, ha kaba me shaniah, ha ka ri jong me baroh kawei: bad un ker sawdong ia me ha ki khyrdop jong me baroh kawei, kiba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ai ha me .

en: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men , whom he had slain because of Gedaliah , was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain .
kha: Ka pukri ha kaba u Ishmael u la bret ïa ki metïap jong kita ki rangbah kiba u la pynïap ka long kaba heh bha kaba u syiem Asa u la tih mynba u la shah tur ïaleh ha u Baasha , u syiem ka Israel . U Ishmael u la pyndap ïa kata ka pukri da ki metïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka thliew ha kaba u Ismael u la bret lut ia ki met iap jong ki briew kiba u la pyniap namar u Gedaliah: uta u syiem u la leh namar ka jingtieng ia u Baasha syiem Israel: U Ismael u khun u Nethaniah u la pyndap ia ka da ki .

en: If any man speak , let him speak as the oracles of God  ; if any man minister , let him do it as of the ability which God giveth : that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
kha: Uno uno uba ïalap , u dei ban ïalap ïa ki khubor jong U Blei ; uno uno uba shakri , u dei ban shakri da ka bor kaba U Blei u ai ïa u , khnang ba ha kiei kiei baroh yn ai ïa ka jingïaroh sha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist , ha uba ka burom bad ka bor ki long ki jong u junom la junom , Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u kren , to un kren kum ki jingkren jong U Blei ; lada uno uno u shakri, to un leh ia kata kum ka jinglah kaba U Blei U ai: ba U Blei ha kiei kiei baroh un shah pyndonburom lyngba U Jisu Khrist, ha uba u long u iaroh bad u synshar junom . Amen .

en: The  Lord  shall send upon thee cursing , vexation , and rebuke , in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do , until thou be destroyed , and until thou perish quickly  ; because of the wickedness of thy doings , whereby thou hast forsaken me .
kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew bad kyntait ïa U  Trai  , un wallam ha phi ka jingpynjot , ka jingkulmar , bad ka jingjynjar ha kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh , haduh ba phin da jot thiaw bad ïap syndon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un phah halor jong me da kaba tim, da kaba pynsngewsih, bad da kaba pynshitom, ha kaba me pynbeit ia ka kti jong me ban leh, haduh ba me da shah pynjot noh kloi; bad haduh ba me da jah noh kloi namar ka jingsniew jong me, ha kaba me la iehnoh ia nga .

en: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee  ; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel  ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .
kha: Hynrei ngan lumlang ïa phi , phi baroh ki paid Israel kiba dang sah . Ngan wallam lang ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha ka kynhun . Kum ka jaka bam phlang ba-dap da ki langbrot , ka ri jong phi kan dap biang sa shisien da ki paidbah babun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan lum shisha ia phi baroh: ngan lum lang ia ki Israel kiba sah shuh shuh: ngan buh ia ki kum ki langbrot jong u Bosrah: kin pynmih ia ka jingsawa kaba khraw namar ka jingbun briew jong ki .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they shall no more be remembered : and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .
kha: Ha kata ka por ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki bleithaw na ka ri , bad ym don mano mano ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno uba kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa bad ngan shim noh ïa ka jingkwah ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, U Trai jong ki paid, ba ngan pynduh noh ia ki kyrteng jong ki bleithaw na ka ri: bad ruh ngan pynlong ia ki nongiathuhlypa bad ia u mynsiem bymkhuid ban mih noh na ka ri .

en: And it shall be , that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , thou shalt rise early , and set upon the city : and , behold , when he and the people that is with him come out against thee , then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion .
kha: Khie joit lashai mynstep ha ka por ba mih ka sngi bad pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kynsan halor ka nongbah . Nangta haba u Gaal bad la ki rangbah ki mih shabar pyrshah ïa phi , tied tyngeh ïa ki kat kaba phi lah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, ba ha ka por mynstep, tang shu mih ka sngi, to khie dang step, bad to leit sha ka nongbah: bad, ha khmih, haba ma u bad ki briew kiba don bad u ki mih shabar pyrshah ia me, te me lah ban leh ia ki kumba me shem ia ka lad .

en: Then said they unto him , Say now Shibboleth : and he said Sibboleth : for he could not frame to pronounce it right . Then they took him , and slew him at the passages of Jordan : and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand .
kha: Ki bthah ïa u ban ong ,  Shibboleth .  Hynrei un ong  Sibboleth ,  namar um nang kynnoh beit ïa ka . Kumta ki kem bad ki pynïap ïa u ha kawei na kita ki jaka na kiba dei ban jam ïa ka Jordan . Sawphew ar hajar ngut ki Ephraim ki shah pynïap ha kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u, To ong mynta u Shibboleth: bad u la ong u Sibboleth: namar um lah ban pynpaw ia ka hok . Nangta ki la shim ia u bad ki la pyniap ia u ha ki jaka ba la buh ha Jordan: bad hangta u la hap ha kata ka por jong ki Ephraim sawphew ar hajar .

en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year , in the tenth day of the month , in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten , in the selfsame day the hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and brought me thither .
kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong ka snem thymmai , kaba long ka snem kaba arphew san hadien ba la ringmraw ïa ngi bad khatsaw snem hadien ba la jop ïa ka Jerusalem . Ha kata ka sngi nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  , bad u la rah noh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba sanphew snem jong ka jingshah set jong ngi, ha kaba sdang jong u snem, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew snem hadien kata ka shnong ka la shah shoh, ha kajuh ka sngi ka kti U Trai ka la don halor jong nga, bad ka la wanrah ia nga sha kata ka jaka .

en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me , and then eat ye every man of his own vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern :
kha: Wat shahshkor ïa u Hesekaïah . U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem wait . Yn shah ïa phi ba phin bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki soh Dumbur na ki dieng ki jong phi hi , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi hi —
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngap ia u Hesekaiah: namar kumta u syiem Assyria u ong: To leh ia ka jingiateh bad nga da ka jingai sngewbha, bad to mih sha nga, bad nangta phi bam ia uwei pa uwei u diengsoh jong u hi, bad uwei pa uwei na u diengsoh jong u hi, bad phi dih ia ki um jong u:

en: Then said he unto me , This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth : for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it  ; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga ,  Halor jong ka la thoh ïa ka jingtim kaba dei ban leit sha ka ri baroh kawei . Ha kawei ka liang jong ka kot kli ka ong ba ïa uwei pa uwei u nongtuh yn weng noh na ka ri ; bad ha kawei pat ka liang ka ong ba ïa uno uno uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai yn shim noh ïa u ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga , Kane ka long ka jingtim kaba iaid shabar ha ka khmat jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei: namar uwei pa uwei uba tuh un shah ot noh kum ha kane ka liang katkum ka ; bad uwei pa uwei uba sngap jar un shah ot noh kum ha kata ka liang katkum ka .

en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock , and his horns are like the horns of unicorns : with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth : and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim , and they are the thousands of Manasseh .
kha: U Joseph u khlaiñ kat u masi kyrtong , Kat ki reng u masi prut . Ki reng jong u kiba kat ki hajar jong u Manasseh , Bad kat ki shiphew hajar jong u Ephraim . Da ki , u tur pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew , Bad u shop ïa ki sha kaba kut jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom jong u ka long kum ka jingkha khun nyngkong jong u masi jong u, bad ki bniat jong u ki long kum ki bniat jong ki unicorn: bad ki un pynkhih ia ki briew haduh ki kut jong ka khyndew: bad ki long ki shi hajar ngut ki Ephraim , bad ki long ki hajar ngut ki Manasseh .

en: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king , and his counsellors , and before all the king s mighty princes . And I was strengthened as the hand of the  Lord  my God was upon me , and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me .
kha: Da ka jingaiei U Blei , nga la ïoh ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u patsha , ki nongai jingmut , bad ki nongsynshar bakhrawbor jong u baroh ; U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ai ïa nga ka jingshlur , bad nga la lah ban pynkohnguh ïa kiba bun ki rangbah kur jong ki Israel ban wan phai bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynjlan ia ka jingisynei ia nga ha khmat u syiem bad ki nongai jingmut jong u, bad ha khmat ki syiem kiba khlain bor baroh . Bad nga la shah pynskhem kumba ka kti U Trai U Blei jong nga ka la don halor jong nga , bad nga la ialum lang na ki rangbah Israel ban leit shaneng bad nga .

en: So there went one on horseback to meet him , and said , Thus saith the king , Is it peace ? And Jehu said , What hast thou to do with peace ? turn thee behind me . And the watchman told , saying , The messenger came to them , but he cometh not again .
kha: U nonglamktien u leit sha u Jehu bad ong ïa u ,  U syiem u kwah ban tip la phi wan ne em kum u paralok .   Kata kam dei ka kam jong me !  u Jehu u jubab .  Bud nadien jong nga .  Uta u nongap phira uba don ha ka jaka ap phira u la ïathuh ba u nonglamktien u la poi sha ka kynhun hynrei u khlem wan phai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit phai noh sha u kulai ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la ong, Kumta u ong ia u syiem, Hato ka long ka jingsuk ? U Jehu u la ong, Me don kaei ka jingiadei bad ka jingsuk ? To phai noh shadien jong nga . Bad u nongap u la iathuh da kaba ong: U nonglam khubor u la wan sha ki , hynrei um wan shuh .

en: I make a decree , That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel : for he is the living God , and stedfast for ever , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed , and his dominion shall be even unto the end .
kha: Nga hukum ba ha kylleng ka hima jong nga uwei pa uwei u dei ban sheptieng bad burom ïa U Blei jong u Daniel .  U long U Blei uba im bad un synshar junom . Ïa ka hima jong u yn ym pynjot lano lano ruh , bad ka bor jong u kan ym poi lano lano ruh sha ka jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pynlong ia ka hukum , Ba ha ka jingsynshar jong nga baroh kawei ka jingsynshar jong nga kan khih bad ka tieng ha khmat U Blei jong u Daniel: namar u long U Blei uba im, bad uba skhem junom, bad ka hima jong u kaba ym shah pynjot, bad ka jingsynshar jong u kan long haduh kaba kut .

en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .
kha: Hynrei mem shym iehnoh ïa ki hangta ha ka ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw . Mem shym la shim noh ïa u lyoh lane ïa ka ding uba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me ha ki jingisynei ba bun jong me wat iehnoh ia ki ha ka ri khlaw: u lum jong u lyoh um shym la leit noh na ki ha ka por mynstep , ban ialam ia ki ha ka lynti ; lymne ia u lum ding ha ka por miet , ban pyni ia ki ia ka jingshai bad ka lynti ha kaba ki dei ban leit .

en: And let these my words , wherewith I have made supplication before the  Lord  , be nigh unto the  Lord  our God day and night , that he maintain the cause of his servant , and the cause of his people Israel at all times , as the matter shall require :
kha: To ai ba un leh-isynei borabor ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa u syiem jong ki kat kum ki jingdonkam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kine ki ktien jong nga, kiba nga la kyrpad ha khmat U Trai, kin long hajan U Trai U Blei jong ngi man ka sngi bad ka miet, ba un pynneh ia ka daw jong u shakri jong u bad ka daw jong ki briew jong u Israel ha man la ka por, kumba ka kam kan long:

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute ye judgment and righteousness , and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor : and do no wrong , do no violence to the stranger , the fatherless , nor the widow , neither shed innocent blood in this place .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba beit . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba shukor ïa u . Wat lehbeiñ ne banbeiñ ïa ki nongwei , ki khunswet , ne ki riewkynthei , bad wat pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui ha kane ka jaka kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Pynbeit ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok, bad pyllait ia kiba la shah pynjot na ka kti jong u nongpynshitom bein: bad wat leh ei ei: wat leh ei ei ia u nongwei , u bym don kpa, ne ia ka riewkynthei .

en: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing , because , when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us , ye received it not as the word of men , but as it is in truth , the word of God , which effectually worketh also in you that believe .
kha: Bad don sa kawei pat ka daw balei ba ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei . Haba ngi la wallam ha phi ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , phi la ïohsngew bad pdiang ïa ka , ym kum ka khubor na ki briew hynrei kum ka khubor jong U Blei , kaba long shisha kumta . Naba U Blei u trei ha phi kiba ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ruh ngi ainguh ia U Blei khlem sangeh, namar haba phi la pdiang ia ka ktien U Blei kaba phi la iohsngew na ngi, phim shym la pdiang ia ka kum ka ktien ki briew, hynrei kumba ka long ha ka jingshisha, ka ktien U Blei kaba trei ruh ha phi kiba ngeit .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thy filthiness was poured out , and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers , and with all the idols of thy abominations , and by the blood of thy children , which thou didst give unto them  ;
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Pha la law ïa la ki jaiñ , bad kum ka nuti , pha la ai ïa lade ha ki nongleh-ieit jong pha bad ha baroh ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong pha , bad pha la pynïap ïa la ki khun kum ki jingkñia ïa ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei; Namar ka jingjakhlia jong me ka la tuid shabar, bad ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me ka la lap lyngkhuid lyngba ki jingkhaii met jong me bad ki nongieit jong me baroh, bad da ki bleithaw jong me baroh, bad da ka snam jong ki khun jong me, kiba me la ai ha ki;

en: And Harbona , one of the chamberlains , said before the king , Behold also , the gallows fifty cubits high , which Haman had made for Mordecai , who had spoken good for the king , standeth in the house of Haman . Then the king said , Hang him thereon .
kha: Nangta uwei na ki uba kyrteng u Harbonah , u ong ,  U Haman u la dep ïaid shaphrang ha kaba u la shna ïa ka diengphasi ha ka ïing jong u khnang ba un phasi ïa u Mordekai , uba pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi , ko syiem . Bad ka long kaba jrong arphew ar mitar !   Sdien phasi ïa u Haman ha ka !  u syiem u hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Habona uwei na ki kamra u la ong ha khmat u syiem , Ha khmih ruh, ki lum sanphew cubit kiba u Haman u la leh na ka bynta u Mordecai uba la kren bha na ka bynta u syiem u ieng ha iing u Haman . Nangta u syiem u la ong: To sngap ia u ha kata ka por .

en: The father shall be divided against the son , and the son against the father  ; the mother against the daughter , and the daughter against the mother  ; the mother in law against her daughter in law , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
kha: Ki kpa ki long pyrshah ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , bad ki khun shynrang pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki ; ki kmie kin long pyrshah ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki ; ki kiaw kurim kin long pyrshah ïa ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong ki bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa un iakhlad bad u khun shynrang bad u khun shynrang bad ka kmie bad ka kmie bad ka kmie bad ka kmie .

en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo , and brought him to Jerusalem , and buried him in his own sepulchre . And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and anointed him , and made him king in his father s stead .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki buh ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom bad kit ïa ka sha Jerusalem , ha kaba la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Ki briew ka Judah ki la jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah , bad pynsleh syiem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la rah ia u ha ka kali kaba la iap na Megiddo, bad ki la wanrah ia u sha Jerusalem bad ki la tep ia u ha la ka jong ka jingtep . Ki briew jong ka ri ki la shim ia u Jehosa u khun u Josiah bad ki la pynlong ia u syiem ha ka jaka jong u kpa jong u .

en: O  Lord  , are not thine eyes upon the truth ? thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved  ; thou hast consumed them , but they have refused to receive correction : they have made their faces harder than a rock  ; they have refused to return .
kha: Da shisha U  Trai  u peit ïa ka jingïaineh . U la shoh ïa phi , hynrei phim shym pynleit jingmut ; u la pynlwet ïa phi , hynrei phi la kyntait ban ïoh jinghikai . Phi long kiba mutlop bad phim shym phai na ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , hato ki khmat jong me kim don ha ka jingshisha ? me la pynkhih ia ki , hynrei kim shym la sngewsih ; me la bam ia ki , hynrei ki la kyntait ban ioh ia ka jingpynbeit: ki la pynlong ia ki khmat jong ki kiba kham eh ban ia u maw ; ki la kyntait ban wan phai .

en: The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u bad ki shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jinglong tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki kam jong u Asa bad ka bor jong u baroh bad ki nongbah kiba u la tei kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ? Wat la katta ruh ha ka por ba u la tymmen u la pang ha ki kjat jong u .

en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took him out : and the king asked him secretly in his house , and said , Is there any word from the  Lord  ? And Jeremiah said , There is : for , said he , thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon .
kha: Hadien kata u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah khot ïa nga , bad hangta ha ka ïingsyiem u la kylli ïa nga ha kaba jar jar ,  Hato don khubor ei ei na U  Trai  ?   Ka don ,  nga la jubab , bad nga ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa phi yn sa aiti noh ha u syiem ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sedekaiah u syiem u la phah ia u: bad u syiem u la kylli ia u da kaba rieh ha iing jong u , bad u la ong: Hato don ka ktien na U Trai ? Bad u Jeremaiah u la ong: Ka don: namar u la ong: ia me yn aiti ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon .

en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh , which they bring unto the  Lord  , whether it be of men or beasts , shall be thine : nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem , and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem .
kha: Uno uno ïa uba la kha nyngkong , la u dei u briew ne u jingri , ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga u long u jong me . Hynrei me dei ban pdiang ïa ka jingsiew ban thied pat ïa uwei pa uwei u khun ba la kha nyngkong , bad uwei pa uwei u jingri ba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la ñiew ba u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kaba plie ia ka matrix ha ka doh baroh, kaba ki wanrah sha U Trai, la ka long na ki briew ne ki mrad, kan long ka jong me: wat la katta ruh ia u khun nyngkong jong u briew men siewspah shisha, bad ia u khun nyngkong jong ki mrad ba jakhlia men siewspah .

en: And gladness is taken away , and joy out of the plentiful field  ; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing , neither shall there be shouting : the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses  ; I have made their vintage shouting to cease .
kha: Ym don mano mano bakmen mynta ha ki lyngkha baseisoh . Ym don mano mano ba pyrta jam lane rwai ha ki bri sohwaiñ . Ym don ba ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ ban shna waiñ ; ki jingpyrta jam jong ka jingkmen ki la kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkmen ka la jah noh na ka lyngkha kaba bun ; bad ha ki kper sohjew kan ym don jingrwai , lymne kan ym don ka jingsawa: ki nongleit jingleit kin ym mih wain ha ki jaka sait vote jong ki; nga la pynlong ia ki ban pyrta ban sangeh noh .

en: And they shall cover the face of the earth , that one cannot be able to see the earth : and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped , which remaineth unto you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field :
kha: Kin jyllei kat haduh ba kin tap lin ïa ka khyndew baroh . Kin bam lut khoit ïa kata baroh kaba u phria um shym la pynjot , bad wat ïa ki dieng kiba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin tap ia ka khyndew, ba ym lah ban iohi ia ka khyndew: bad kin bam ia ka jingsah jong kata kaba la lait im, kaba sah ha phi na ka sniehdoh , bad kin bam ia u dieng baroh uba mih na ka bynta jong phi:

en: O  Lord  , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth , and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and things wherein there is no profit .
kha: A  Trai  , me long uta uba ïada ïa nga bad uba ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ; me ïarap ïa nga ha ki por jingjynjar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha me na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei bad ong ,  Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la don ei ei hynrei tang ki blei thala , ym don ei ei hynrei tang ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, ka bor jong nga, bad ka kut jong nga, bad ka jaka rieh jong nga ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar, ki Jutang kin wan sha me na ki kut jong ka khyndew , bad kin ong , Hooid ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la hiar pateng ia ki jinglamler , ki bym don jingmyntoi ei ei .

en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me , nor with my son , nor with my son s son : but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee , thou shalt do unto me , and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned .
kha: Kumta to kular skhem hangne ha khmat U Blei ba men ym shukor ïa nga , ïa ki khun ki kti jong nga , lane ïa ki nonghiarpateng jong nga . Nga la ju lehhok ïa me , kumta to kular ba men lehhok kylliang ïa nga bad ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me shong me sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to smai ha nga hangne da U Blei ba phin ym leh thok ia nga, ne ia u khun jong nga: hynrei kat kum ka jingbha kaba nga la leh ha me, me dei ban leh ia nga bad ia ka ri ha kaba me la leit sah .

en: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , at Beth–shemesh , and brought him to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate , four hundred cubits .
kha: U Jehoash u la ïohkem ïa u Amasaïah bad u ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh nongbah naduh ka Khyrdop Ephraim haduh ka Khyrdop Dong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joash u syiem Israel u la shim ia u Amasaiah u khun u Joash ha Bethesh bad u la wanrah ia u sha Jerusalem bad u la pynhap ia ka kynroh Jerusalem na ka khyrdop Ephram haduh ka khyrdop kaba saw spah .

en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision , and them that sat on them , having breastplates of fire , and of jacinth , and brimstone : and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions  ; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone .
kha: Bad ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai jong ki : Ki don ki jingïada shadem kiba saw kum ka ding , kiba jngum kum u Sapphir , bad kiba stem kum u kyndok . Ki khlieh jong ki kulai ki la long kum ki khlieh sing , bad na ki shyntur jong ki la mih ka ding , ka tdem bad u kyndok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta nga la iohi ia ki kulai ha ka jingphohsniew , bad kita kiba shong ha ki, ki don ki bniat jong ka ding bad ka jain bad ka rong saw: bad ki khlieh jong ki kulai ki long kum ki khlieh sing; bad na ki shyntur jong ki ki la mih ka ding bad ka tdem bad ka rong saw .

en: And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Men leh aïu ïa kine katne katne ?  U Siba u jubab ,  Ki kada ki dei na ka bynta ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Syiem Kynrad ban shong , u kpu bad u soh ki dei na ka bynta ki rangbah jong phi ban bam , bad ka waiñ ka dei na ka bynta jong ki ban dih haba ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Siba , Kaei kaba phi mut da kine ? Bad u Siba u la ong , Ki kada ki long na ka bynta ka iing syiem ban shong ha ka por ; bad u kpu bad u soh slap na ka bynta ki samla ban bam ; bad ka wain , ba kiba la tyrkhong ha ka ri khlaw kin dih .

en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren , an east wind shall come , the wind of the  Lord  shall come up from the wilderness , and his spring shall become dry , and his fountain shall be dried up : he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels .
kha: Wat lada ki paid Israel ki roi kum ki ñiut , ngan phah ïa ka lyer khluit na mihngi kaba na ri shyiap , bad kan pyntyrkhong ïa ki umpohliew bad ki pung-um jong ki . Kan rong noh ïa kano kano kaba kordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u long uba seisoh hapdeng ki hynmen jong u, ka Iyer jong U Trai kan wan shaneng na ka ri khlaw, bad ka tyllong um jong u kan sa tyrkhong: un pynsniew ia ka spah jong ki tiar kiba sngewtynnad baroh .

en: For I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to save thee : though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee , yet will I not make a full end of thee : but I will correct thee in measure , and will not leave thee altogether unpunished .
kha: Ngan wan sha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan ym shah ïa phi ban leit khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan long u bym leh shiliang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga don ryngkat bad me, ong U Trai, ban pynim ia me: wat la nga pynlong ia me khlem da shah pynshitom satia: hynrei ngan ym pynlong ia me khlem da shah pynshitom satia .

en: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation , because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day , and said unto the people , There are six days in which men ought to work : in them therefore come and be healed , and not on the sabbath day .
kha: U rangbah synshar jong ka synagog u la bitar ba U Jisu u la pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta u la kren bad u la ong ha u paidbah ,  Don hynriew sngi ha kaba ngi dei ban trei ; kumta to wan ha kito ki sngi bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah , hynrei ym ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translated_en_to_kha: U nongsynshar jong ka synagog u la jubab da ka jingbitar, namar ba U Jisu u la pynkoit ha ka sngi Sabha, bad u la ong ha ki briew: Ki don hynriew sngi ha kaba ki briew ki dei ban trei: ha ki namarkata ki wan bad shah pynkoit, ym ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: And the  Lord  shall make thee the head , and not the tail  ; and thou shalt be above only , and thou shalt not be beneath  ; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , which I command thee this day , to observe and to do them :
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi ki nongïalam napdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ym ki nongbud ; phin ïai manbha bad phin ym kyrduh lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynlong ia me ia ka khlieh, bad ym ia ka tdong ; bad me dei ban long tang ha jrong, bad me dei ban long hapoh ; lada me sngap ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong me, kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi, ban peit bad ban leh ia ki:

en: At that time , saith the  Lord  , they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah , and the bones of his princes , and the bones of the priests , and the bones of the prophets , and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , out of their graves :
kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki shyieng jong ki syiem bad jong ki rangbah synshar ka Judah , kumjuh ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh , jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Jerusalem , yn khlong noh na ki jingtep jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por , ong U Trai , kin pynmih ia ki shyieng jong ki syiem Judah bad ki shyieng jong ki syiem jong u bad ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh bad ki shyieng jong ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki shyieng jong ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem na ki jingtep jong ki:

en: And God said unto him , Because thou hast asked this thing , and hast not asked for thyself long life  ; neither hast asked riches for thyself , nor hast asked the life of thine enemies  ; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment  ;
kha: bad kumta u ong ha u ,  Namar ba me la pan ïa ka jingstad ban synshar hok , ha ka jaka ka jingim bajlan na ka bynta ïa lade lane ka spah lane ka jingïap ki nongshun jong me , ngan leh ïa kaba me la pan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u: Namar me la kylli ia kane ka jingjia, bad me khlem pan ia lade ia ka jingim kaba jrong ; bad me khlem pan ia ka jingim jong ki nongshun jong me ; hynrei me la pan ia lade ia ka jingsngewthuh;

en: Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .
kha: Ïarap lem ïa la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki sha sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U  Trai  un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ hangta , kumba u la leh ïa phi hangne . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai sha kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba U Trai un da ai jingjahthait ia ki hynmen jong phi, kumjuh ruh ia phi, bad haduh ba kin da ioh ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha ki sha shiliang ka Jordan: bad nangta phin leit phai noh ia uwei pa uwei sha ka jaka jong u, kaba nga la ai ha phi .

en: And it shall come to pass , if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day , that the  Lord  thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth :
kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad sumar hok ïa ki hukum jong u baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , un kyntiew ïa phi ha khlieh eh jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia lada me sngap jar ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me, ban peit bad ban leh ia ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi, ba U Trai U Blei jong me un buh ia me ha jrong halor ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew:

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam , and all that he did , and his might , how he warred , and how he recovered Damascus , and Hamath , which belonged to Judah , for Israel , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jeroboam Uba Ar u la leh , ki thma bashlur jong u , bad kumno u pynïoh pat ïa ka Damaskos bad ka Hamath sha ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jeroboan bad ka jingleh jong u baroh, kumno u la ialeh thma bad kumno u la pynkoit ia u Damakos bad u Hamath, kiba dei ki jong u Judah na ka bynta ki Israel , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings that sit upon David s throne , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .
kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyndap ïa ki briew ha kane ka ri da ka waiñ tad haduh ba kin buaid : ki syiem , kiba long kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ong ha ki , Kumta ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan pyndap ia ki nongshong shnong baroh jong kane ka ri , wat ia ki syiem kiba shong ha ka khet u Dabid bad ki lyngdoh bad ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki nongshong shnong baroh jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And thou , son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning the Ammonites , and concerning their reproach  ; even say thou , The sword , the sword is drawn : for the slaughter it is furbished , to consume because of the glittering :
kha: Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki nong Ammon , kiba krenbeiñ ïa ki Israel . Ong ha ki :   ‘ Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynjot ; ïa ka la pynphyrnai ban pynïap , ban thaba kum ka leilieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, ko khun u briew, me iathuhlypa bad ong, Kumta u Trai U Blei u ong shaphang ki Ammon, bad shaphang ka jingshah lehbein jong ki; wat me ruh me ong: Ka waitlam, ka waitlam ka la ring: namar ka jingpyniap ka la tyrkhong, ban bam namar ka jingshai:

en: The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day , ) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .
kha: Nangta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la pan na u Pilat ban shah ïa ki ban pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong kita ki briew kiba la shah sahnarphna , bad ban pynhiar noh ïa ki met jong ki na ki diengphna . Ki la kyrpad ïa kane namar ba ka la dei ka Sngi Thohdieng , bad kim kwah ba ki met kin sah kumta ha ki diengphna ha ka sngi Sabbaton , naba ka sngi Sabbaton ka long kyrpang kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw namarkata, namar ba ka long ka jingpynkhreh, ba ki met kim dei ban sah ha ka sngi Sabha , (namar kata ka sngi Sabha ka long ka sngi kaba heh , ) ki la kyrpad ia u Pilat ba ki kjat jong ki kin shah pynpra , bad ba kin shah weng noh .

en: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal  ; and , behold , I will come down unto thee , to offer burnt offerings , and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings : seven days shalt thou tarry , till I come to thee , and shew thee what thou shalt do .
kha: Men nang leit sha khmat jong nga sha Gilgal ; ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ap hangta hynñiew sngi haduh ba ngan da wan bad ïathuh ha me kaei ba men leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban hiar ha khmat jong nga sha Gilgal ; bad, ha khmih, ngan wan hiar sha me, ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ban knia ia ki jingknia jingsuk: hynriew sngi me dei ban sahkut haduh ba ngan da wan sha me bad ngan pyni ia me ia kaei kaba me dei ban leh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Let your hands be strong , ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the  Lord  of hosts was laid , that the temple might be built .
kha: To long shlur ! Mynta phi ïohsngew ïa kijuh ki kyntien ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka por ba la buh nongrim na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid To ai ba ki kti jong phi kin long kiba skhem , phi kiba iohsngew ha kine ki sngi ia kine ki ktien da ka shyntur jong ki nongiathuhlypa kiba la don ha ka sngi ba la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka iing U Trai jong ki paid .

en: He said furthermore unto me , Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations .
kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ? Khmih ïa kito kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki paid Israel ki leh hangne , ban beh noh ïa nga sha jngai bad kham sha jngai na ka jaka bakhuid jong nga . Men dang ïohi shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham jahburom ban ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong shuh shuh ha nga, ko khun u briew, me iohi ia kaei kaba ki leh ? wat ia ki jingleh bymman kiba khraw kiba ka iing Israel ka iaid hangne , ba nga dei ban leit noh na ka jaka kyntang jong nga ? hynrei me phai biang bad me sa iohi ia ki jingleh bymman kiba kham khraw .

en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion , and turneth the shadow of death into the morning , and maketh the day dark with night : that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name :
kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki khlur , ki Pleïades    bad Orion    , u pynkylla ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai mynsngi , bad ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U khot na ka bynta ki um jong ka duriaw bad theh ïa ki ha sla khyndew . Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To wad ia uta uba pynlong ia ki hynriew tylli ki khlur bad ka Orion , bad u pynkylla ia ka jingdum jong ka jingiap haduh mynstep: uba khot ia ki um duriaw bad u theh ia ki shabar ha ka khmat ka khyndew: U Trai u long ka kyrteng jong u:

en: And they said , Stand back . And they said again , This one fellow came in to sojourn , and he will needs be a judge : now will we deal worse with thee , than with them . And they pressed sore upon the man , even Lot , and came near to break the door .
kha: Hynrei ki ong ,  Kynriah sharud , me u nongwei shi sngi ! Me dei uei ba men batai ïa ngi kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ? Kynriah sharud , ïoh ba ngin pynshitom ïa me kham palat ban ïa ki .  Ki khynñiat shadien ïa u Lot bad ki tur sha khmat ban pynpait ïa ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong, To ieng biang . Ki la ong biang, Une uwei u paralok u la wan rung sha ka jaka sah, bad un donkam ia u nongbishar: mynta ngin kham sniew ia me, ban ia ki . Ki la pynkhih ia uta u briew, wat ia u Lot ruh, bad ki la wan hajan ban pynpra ia ka jingkhang .

en: Thus speak unto the Levites , and say unto them , When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance , then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the  Lord  , even a tenth part of the tithe .
kha: ban ong ha ki Lebi ,  Haba phi ïohpdiang na ki Israel ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew ba U  Trai  u ai ha phi kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi , phi dei ban wanrah ïa kaba shiphew na kata kum ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to kren ha ki Lebi bad to ong ha ki: Haba phi shim na ki khun Israel ia ka shiphew kaba nga la ai ha phi na ki na ka bynta ka pateng jong phi , te phin aiti ia ka jingknia kaba heh na ka bynta U Trai .

en: So that the  Lord  could no longer bear , because of the evil of your doings , and because of the abominations which ye have committed  ; therefore is your land a desolation , and an astonishment , and a curse , without an inhabitant , as at this day .
kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi ka ri jong phi kan sah ha ki jingjot bad ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ka la long ka jingïohi ba-itriem , bad ki briew ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim , namar U  Trai  um lah shah shuh ïa ki kam bymman bad basniew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba U Trai um lah shuh ban shah , namar ka jingsniew jong ki jingleh jong phi , bad namar ki jingleh bymman kiba phi la leh; namarkata ka ri jong phi ka long ka jingjot bad ka jinglyngngoh bad ka jingtim , khlem u nongshong shnong , kumba ha kane ka sngi .

en: And David spake to the men that stood by him , saying , What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine , and taketh away the reproach from Israel ? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine , that he should defy the armies of the living God ?
kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa ki rangbah kiba ïeng hajan jong u ,  Un ïoh aïu uta u briew uba pynïap ïa une u Philistia bad uba pyllait ïa ki Israel na kane ka jingjahburom ? Nalor kata , uei une u Philistia bymngeit uba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong U Blei uba im ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kren ha ki briew kiba ieng hajan jong u, u da ong, Kaei kaba dei ban leh ia uta u Philistia bad u weng noh ia ka jingshah lehbein na Israel ? namar mano une u Philistia u bym pat shah ot , ba un pyrshah ia ki shipai jong U Blei uba im ?

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the great trumpet shall be blown , and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria , and the outcasts in the land of Egypt , and shall worship the  Lord  in the holy mount at Jerusalem .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi kan wan , ïa ka turoi yn put ban khot pat na Assyria bad Ijipt ïa baroh ki Israel kiba don ha ka jinglongmraw hangta . Kin wan bad mane ïa U  Trai  ha Jerusalem , ha u lum bakyntang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba ka turoi kaba khraw kan sa bthei, bad kin wan kiba la pynkhreh ban jah noh ha ka ri Assyria bad ki nongshah beh ha ka ri Ijipt bad kin mane ia U Trai ha u lum bakhuid ha Jerusalem .

en: And when he was come unto us , he took Paul s girdle , and bound his own hands and feet , and said , Thus saith the Holy Ghost , So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle , and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles .
kha: U la wan sha ngi , u la shim ïa u panpoh jong u Paul , u la teh ïa la ki kti bad ki kjat da uta , bad u la ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong : Ïa u trai jong une u panpoh yn teh ha kane ka rukom da ki Jiw ha Jerusalem , bad kin sa aiti ïa u ha ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan sha ngi, u la shim ia u Paul, bad u la teh ia la ki jong ki kti bad ki kjat, bad u la ong, Kumta u Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong: Kumta ki Jiw ha Jerusalem kin teh ia uta u briew uba don ia kane ka kynjri, bad kin aiti ia u ha ki kti jong ki Jutang .

en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth–maim , and all the Sidonians , them will I drive out from before the children of Israel : only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance , as I have commanded thee .
kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa ka ri baroh jong ki nong Sidon , kiba shong ha ka ri lum hapdeng ki lum Lebanon bad Misrephoth Maim . Ngan beh noh ïa kine ki briew katba ki Israel ki nang tur sha khmat . Me dei ban pynbynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki Israel , kumba nga la hukum ïa me ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri lum naduh Lebanon haduh Misrephothmaim, bad ki nong Sidon baroh, ngan beh noh ia ki na khmat ki khun Israel: tang ma me da ka lot ha ki Israel na ka bynta ka pateng kumba nga la hukum ia me .

en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial , whose name was Sheba , the son of Bichri , a Benjamite : and he blew a trumpet , and said , We have no part in David , neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to his tents , O Israel .
kha: Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba don ha Gilgal , uwei u riewkai uba kyrteng u Sheba , u khun jong u Bikri , uba na ka jait Benjamin . U put ïa ka turoi bad u pyrta ,  Weng ïa u Dabid ! Ngin ym bud ïa u ! Ïa noh sha ïing , ko Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la jia hangta uwei u briew uba la tip kyrteng kum u Sheba, u khun jong u Bikri, u Benjamin: bad u la pyrta ia ka turoi, bad u la ong: Ngim don bynta ha u Dabid, lymne ngi don pateng ha u khun u Jesse: uwei pa uwei ha ki ïingjaiñ jong u, ko Israel .

en: Then answered one of the servants , and said , Behold , I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth–lehemite , that is cunning in playing , and a mighty valiant man , and a man of war , and prudent in matters , and a comely person , and the  Lord  is with him .
kha: Uwei na kita ki nongap jong u , u ong ,  U Jesse , uba na ka shnong Bethlehem , u don u khun uba long u nongtem nongput uba tbit . U long ruh uba shlur bad uba bhabriew , u shipai uba bha bad uba pnah thylliej . U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei na ki shakri u la jubab , bad u la ong: Ha khmih nga la iohi ia u khun jong u Jesse u Bethlehemite , uba stad ha kaba ialehkai bad u briew uba shlur uba khlain bor bad u briew uba stad ha ki kam bad u briew uba stad bad U Trai u don ryngkat bad u .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations , that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon  ; and they shall serve him : and I have given him the beasts of the field also .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba un buh ka lyngkor nar halor kine ki jaitbynriew baroh bad ba kin shakri ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia . U  Trai  u la ong ba un pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shakri ïa u Nebukhadnessar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel; nga la buh ia ka nar ha ka ryndang jong kine ki jaitbynriew baroh, ba kin shakri ia u syiem Babilon; bad kin shakri ia u: bad nga la ai ia u ia ki mrad khlaw ruh .

en: And it was so , when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes , that he sent to the king , saying , Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes ? let him come now to me , and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel .
kha: Haba u Elisha , u nongïathuhlypa u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha u syiem :  Balei phi khuslai haduh katta katta ? Phah ïa uta u briew sha nga , bad ngan pyn-i ha u ba don u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta haba u briew jong U Blei u la iohsngew ba u syiem Israel u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, ba u la phah sha u syiem da kaba ong: Balei me la pynkhih ia ki jain jong me ? to ai ba un wan mynta sha nga bad un tip ba don u nongiathuhlypa ha Israel .

en: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .
kha: Kito kiba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki ïailong ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid halor jong ki . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba khlem khuid bad u bym pynkhuid ia lade, kata ka mynsiem kan shah ot noh na ka jingiaseng , namar ba u la pynjakhlia ia ka jaka kyntang jong U Trai: ka um jong ka jingpyniakhlad kam shym la tuid ha u; u long uba khlem khuid .

en: Behold , I will send my messenger , and he shall prepare the way before me : and the Lord , whom ye seek , shall suddenly come to his temple , even the messenger of the covenant , whom ye delight in : behold , he shall come , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u jubab ,  Ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien jong nga ban pynkhreh ïa ka lynti na ka bynta jong nga . Te U Trai uba phi ap khmih lynti , un wan kynsan kynsan ha ka Templ jong u . U nonglamktien uba phi sliang ban ïohi un wan bad pynbna ïa ka jutang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan phah ia u nonglam khubor jong nga , bad un pynkhreh ia ka lynti ha khmat jong nga: bad U Trai uba phi wad, un wan kynsan sha ka tempi jong u: wat u nonglam khubor jong ka jutang uba phi sngewbha: ha khmih , un wan , U Trai jong ki paid .

en: Then David arose from the earth , and washed , and anointed himself , and changed his apparel , and came into the house of the  Lord  , and worshipped : then he came to his own house  ; and when he required , they set bread before him , and he did eat .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u khie joit na madan , u sum u sleh , u sad ïa la u shñiuh , bad u pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Nangta u la leit bad mane ha ka ïing U  Trai . Haba u la wan phai sha ka ïingsyiem ; u pan jingbam , bad u la bam ïa ka mar ïadep sam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ieng na ka khyndew, bad u la sait ia lade, bad u la pynkylla ia ka jain jong u, bad u la wan shapoh ka iing U Trai, bad u la mane: nangta u la wan sha la ka jong ka iing; bad haba u la dawa, ki la buh kpu ha khmat jong u, bad u la bam .

en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar : and the Ethiopians were overthrown , that they could not recover themselves  ; for they were destroyed before the  Lord  , and before his host  ; and they carried away very much spoil .
kha: Ki phet ïap , bad u Asa lem bad ki kynhun jong u ki beh kthong ïa ki haduh Gerar . Te bun na ki nong Sudan ki la ïap haduh ba ka kynhun shipai kam shym lah shuh ban lum pat bad ïaleh . Ki la shah pyndem lin ha U  Trai  bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ka kynhun shipai ka la ïoh rah bun ka jinglute .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la beh ia ki haduh Gerar: bad ki nong Ethiopia kim lah ban pynbha ia lade ; namar ki la shah pynjot ha khmat U Trai, bad ha khmat u host jong u ; bad ki la rah noh shibun eh .

en: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel , as a cloud to cover the land  ; it shall be in the latter days , and I will bring thee against my land , that the heathen may know me , when I shall be sanctified in thee , O Gog , before their eyes .
kha: Men sa tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel kum ka  erïong kaba beh halor ka ri . Haba ka por ka poi , ngan phah ïa me ban hiarthma ïa ka ri jong nga , khnang ban pyn-i ha ki jaitbynriew uei nga long , ban pyn-i ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga da kaei kaba nga leh lyngba jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me wan shaneng pyrshah ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel, kum u lyoh ban tap ia ka ri ha ki sngi kiba hadien, bad ngan wanrah ia me pyrshah ia ka ri jong nga, ba ki jaitbynriew kin ithuh ia nga, haba ngan sa pynkyntang ha me, ko Gog, ha khmat ki khmat jong ki .

en: And they fetched up , and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , by their means .
kha: Ki pynbiang ïa ki syiem jong ka Hit bad ka Syria da ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , da kaba die ïa ki kali ïapom ha ka dor hynriewspah ki sbai rupa kawei bad ïa ki kulai ha ka dor shispah sanphew ki sbai rupa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit sha jrong bad ki la wanrah na Ijipt ia ka kali kaba la shna da ki shiphew snem: bad kumta ki la wanrah ia ki kulai na ka bynta ki syiem Hiti baroh bad na ka bynta ki syiem Syria da ki dawai jong ki .

en: Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and from the middle of the river , and from half Gilead , even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
kha: Uwei u dei u Sihon , u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon . Ka hima jong u ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead : naduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad na ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them , shaduh ka wah Jabbok , ka khappud jong ki Ammon ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Syiem Sihon u la shong ha Heshbon bad u la synshar na Aroer kaba don ha rud wah Arnon bad na pdeng wah bad na pdeng wah Gilead haduh ka wah Jabok kaba long u pud u sam jong ki khun Ammon ; .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , How long wilt thou mourn for Saul , seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel ? fill thine horn with oil , and go , I will send thee to Jesse the Beth–lehemite : for I have provided me a king among his sons .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,  Sa katno slem men dang ïai sngewsih ïa u Saul ? Nga la kyntait ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel . Hynrei mynta pynïoh katto katne ka umphniang Olib bad leit sha Bethlehem , sha u briew uba kyrteng u Jesse , namar nga la jied ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u ban long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Samuel, Katno por phin sngewsih ia u Saul, namar nga la kyntait ia u ban synshar ia ki Israel ? pyndap ia ka horn jong me da ka umphniang bad leit noh: namar nga la pynbiang ia nga u syiem napdeng ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death , ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof : for of a truth the  Lord  hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .
kha: Hynrei to tip skhem ïa kane : Lada phi pynïap ïa nga , ma phi bad ki briew jong kane ka nongbah phin long kiba la rem ha kaba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui namar u dei U  Trai  uba la phah ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kane ka jingmaham .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to tip shisha ba lada phi pyniap ia nga, phin wanrah shisha ia ka snam kaba khlem pop halor jong phi bad halor kane ka shnong bad halor ki nongshong shnong jong ka: namar shisha U Trai u la phah ia nga sha phi ban kren ia kine ki ktien baroh ha ki shkor jong phi .

en: Turn again , and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of David thy father , I have heard thy prayer , I have seen thy tears : behold , I will heal thee : on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the  Lord .
kha: ban leit phai pat sha u Hesekaïah , u nongsynshar jong ki briew U  Trai  , bad ban ong ha u ,  Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong me , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me bad nga la ïohi ïa ki ummat jong me . Ngan pynkhiah ïa me , bad hadien lai sngi men leit sha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai biang ia me bad iathuh ha u Hesekaiah u rangbah jong nga: Kumta u Trai, U Blei u kpa jong me, nga la iohsngew ia ka jingduwai jong me: ha khmih , ngan pynkoit ia me: ha ka sngi kaba lai me leit sha ka iing U Trai .

en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet , and toward her children which she shall bear : for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness , wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates .
kha: Wat ka kynthei kaba jem tam ka dohnud kaba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , kaba riewspah katta katta katba kam donkam ban ïaid shano shano , kan leh kumjuh . Ynda u nongshun u kerkut ïa ka shnong jong ka , kan sa kyrduh jingbam kat ban da bam buhrieh wat ïa la i khun ba ka dang shu kha bad ïa iba la kha ruh . Kan ym ai ei ei ïa la u tnga uba ka ieit lane ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shaphang u khun jong ka uba mih na pdeng ki kjat jong ka, bad shaphang ki khun jong ka kiba kan kha: namar kan bam ia ki namar ba ki duna na kiei kiei baroh ha ka jingjyllei bad ka jingjyllei, ha kaba u nongshun jong me un pynshitom ia me ha ki khyrdop jong me .

en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon , distress them not , nor meddle with them : for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession  ; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession .
kha: Te phin sa poi hajan ka ri ki Ammon , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot . Wat pynjynjar ïa ki lane ïaleh thma bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba me wan hajan ki khun Ammon, wat pynshitom ia ki, lane ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki: namar ngan ym ai ia me ia ka jaka jong ki khun Ammon; namar nga la ai ia ka ha ki khun u Lot na ka bynta ka jaka .

en: Because ye have said , We have made a covenant with death , and with hell are we at agreement  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , it shall not come unto us : for we have made lies our refuge , and under falsehood have we hid ourselves :
kha: Phi sarong ba phi la pynlong ïa ka jingïateh bad ka jingïap bad poi sha ka jingïakut bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Phi sngewthikna ba phin lait na ka jingjot haba kan wan , namar phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler bad ki jingshukor ban pyllait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la ong , Ngi la leh ia ka jutang bad ka jingiap, bad bad ka dujok ngi ia mynjur lang haba ka jingsma kaba tuid palat kan iaid lyngba: namar ngi la pynlong ia ki jingthung jong ngi, bad hapoh ka jinglamler ngi la buhrieh ia lade:

en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .
kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba man ki hynñiew snem ki dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uno uno u mraw Hebru uba la shakri ïa ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki hynriew snem to pyllait noh ia u hynmen jong u u Hebru, uba la die ha me ; bad haba u la shakri ia me hynriew snem , me dei ban pyllait noh ia u na me: hynrei ki kpa jong phi kim shym la sngap ia nga , lymne ki la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong ki .

en: And it came to pass , as they were burying a man , that , behold , they spied a band of men  ; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha : and when the man was let down , and touched the bones of Elisha , he revived , and stood up on his feet .
kha: Shisien , katba dang leit ontep , la ïohi ïa kawei na kine ki kynhun , bad ki paidbah ki pynhap ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep u Elisha bad ki phet krad . Mar ïadei ka metïap ha ki shyieng u Elisha , uta u briew u im pat bad u ïeng joit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba ki dang tep ia u briew, ba, ha khmih, ki la leit jngoh ia u briew ha ka jingtep jong u Elisha: bad haba uta u briew u la shah pynhap noh bad u la ktah ia ki shyieng jong u Elisha, u la im bad u la ieng ha la ki kjat .

en: And he set a carved image , the idol which he had made , in the house of God , of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
kha: U buh ïa ka durblei ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u la ong ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon u khun jong u :  Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka long ka jaka ïa kaba nga la jied na baroh kawei ka ri jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka dur ba la ker , ka bleithaw kaba u la thaw, ha ka iing U Blei, na kaba U Blei u la ong ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon u khun jong u: Ha kane ka iing bad ha Jerusalem kaba nga la jied ha khmat ki jait Israel baroh: Ngan buh ia ka kyrteng jong nga junom:

en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :
kha: Un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang na la ka sla ti bad khyndiat ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ha ka shkor kamon , ka  tikmie kamon , bad ka  jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka umphniang kaba sah ha ka kti jong u u lyngdoh un buh ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong uta uba dei ban pynkhuid, bad ha ka ktieh kadiang jong u bad ha ka ktieh kadiang jong u, ha ka snam jong ka jingaiti kaba la pynkhuid:

en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father  ; he turned not aside from it , doing that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  : nevertheless the high places were not taken away  ; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places .
kha: Kum u Asa u kpa jong u , uba ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ; hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iaid ha ki lynti baroh jong u kpa jong u; um shym la phai noh na ka, u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai: wat la katta ruh ym shym la weng noh ia ki jaka ba jrong; namar ki briew ki la tyrwa bad thang ia ka jingiwbih haduh mynta ha ki jaka ba jrong .

en: Let our lord now command thy servants , which are before thee , to seek out a man , who is a cunning player on an harp : and it shall come to pass , when the evil spirit from God is upon thee , that he shall play with his hand , and thou shalt be well .
kha: Kumta , syiem kynrad , ai ka hukum ïa ngi bad ngin leit wad ïa u briew uba nang ban tem duitara . Te haba u mynsiem bymman u wan ha phi , uta u briew un tem ïa la ka duitara , bad phin sa shait sa koit pat .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba u kynrad jong ngi mynta un hukum ia ki shakri jong me kiba don ha khmat jong me, ban wad ia u briew uba long u nonglehkai uba stad ha ka harp: bad kan sa jia , haba ka mynsiem bymman na U Blei ka don halor jong me , ba un ialehkai da ka kti jong u , bad me phin sa koit .

en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year , and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof : it shall be a jubilee unto you  ; and ye shall return every man unto his possession , and ye shall return every man unto his family .
kha: Bad to pynkyntang khuid ïa ka snem kaba sanphew bad pynbna ïa ka jinglaitluid ha ki traishnong baroh jong kata ka ri . Ha kane ka snem , ïa ki jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka , lane sha ki khun ki ksiew jong u , bad uno uno u briew uba la shah die mraw un leit phai pat sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin pynkyntang ia ka snem kaba sanphew snem, bad phin pynbna ia ka jinglaitluid ha ka ri baroh kawei: kan long ka jubilee ha phi; bad phin pynphai biang ia uwei pa uwei sha la ka iing ka sem .

en: And I contended with them , and cursed them , and smote certain of them , and plucked off their hair , and made them swear by God , saying , Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons , nor take their daughters unto your sons , or for yourselves .
kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki rangbah , nga la tim ïa ki , shoh ïa ki bad pajut ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Nangta nga la pynlong ïa ki ban smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba kim dei shuh ba ma ki ne ki khun jong ki kin shongkha khleh bad ki nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ialeh pyrshah ia ki, bad nga la tim ia ki, bad nga la ot noh ia ki shniuh jong ki, bad nga la pynlong ia ki ban smai da U Blei, da kaba ong: Phim dei ban ai ia ki khun kynthei jong phi ha ki khun shynrang jong ki, lymne ban shim ia ki khun kynthei jong ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi, ne na ka bynta jong phi hi .

en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance , and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly , and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which should not be done , and are guilty  ;
kha: Lada dei u paid Israel baroh uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka kynhun Israel baroh kawei ka pop lyngba ka jingbymtip , bad ia kata ka long kaba buhrieh na ki khmat jong ka jingiaseng , bad ki la leh katto katne pyrshah ia kano kano ka hukum U Trai kaba iadei bad kiei kiei kiba ym dei ban leh;

en: They said moreover unto Pharaoh , For to sojourn in the land are we come  ; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks  ; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan : now therefore , we pray thee , let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen .
kha: Ngi la wan ban sah ha kane ka ri , namar ha Kanaan ka don ka  nemsniew kaba jur katta katta haduh bym don phlang shuh ïa ki jingri jong ngi . Sngewbha ai jingbit ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha ka thain Goshen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong shuh shuh ha u Pharaoh , Na ka bynta ban sah ha ka ri ngi wan; namar ki shakri jong me kim don jaka ri dohkha na ka bynta ki kynhun jong me; namar ka jingkyrduh ka long kaba jur ha ka ri Kana: mynta , ngi kyrpad ia me, to ai ba ki shakri jong me kin shong ha ka ri Goshen .

en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near  ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :
kha: Mynba u Pharaoh u shah ïa uta u paidbah ban leit noh , U Blei um shym ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba poi shatei sha ka phang Philistia , wat la ka long kaba jan tam . U Blei u ong ,  Ngam kwah ba kine ki briew kin kylla dien bad kin leit phai pat sha Ijipt haba ki ïohi ba ki hap ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Pharaoh u la pyllait noh ia ki briew, ba U Blei um shym la ialam ia ki lyngba ka ri Philistia, wat la kata ka la jan ; namar U Blei u la ong: To ai ba ki briew kin kylla bamut haba ki iohi ia ka thma:

en: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death ? did he not fear the  Lord  , and besought the  Lord  , and the  Lord  repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them ? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls .
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah bad ki briew jong ka Judah kim shym la pynïap ïa u Mikah . Pynban , u Hesekaïah u la pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  bad u la pyrshang ban pynïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u . Bad U  Trai  u la kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam ha ki . Mynta ngi la jan wallam ka jingpynjot bashyrkhei halor jong ngi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah bad u Judah baroh ki la pyniap ia u ? um shym la tieng ia U Trai , bad u la kyrpad ia U Trai , bad U Trai u la kylla bamut ia u na ka jingsniew kaba u la pynpaw pyrshah ia ki ? Kumta ngi lah ban pynbna ia ka jingsniew kaba khraw pyrshah ia ka mynsiem jong ngi .

en: Notwithstanding , lest we should offend them , go thou to the sea , and cast an hook , and take up the fish that first cometh up  ; and when thou hast opened his mouth , thou shalt find a piece of money : that take , and give unto them for me and thee .
kha: Hynrei ngim kwah ban pynmong ïa kine ki briew . Kumta khie leit sha ka pung bad bret ïa u khwai . Shim ïa ka dohkha ba la ngat nyngkong , bad hapoh ka shyntur jong ka men shem ïa ka pisa kaba shongdor biang na ka bynta ka khajna Templ ïa nga bad ïa me . To shim ïa ka bad siew ïa ki khajna jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh, ioh ba ngin pynsngewsih ia ki, to leit sha duriaw, bad to bret ia ka hook, bad to shim ia ki dohkha kiba wan nyngkong eh ; bad ynda me la plie ia ka shyntur jong u, men shem ia ka pisa: kata ka shim, bad ai ha ki na ka bynta jong nga bad me .

en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold  ; beside ornaments , and collars , and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian , and beside the chains that were about their camels  necks .
kha: Ki sohshkor ksiar ba u Gideon u ïohpdiang ki khia la jan arphew kilo , bad kane kam shym kynthup ïa ki jingdeng , ki kpieng bad ki jaiñ sawbthuh ba ki syiem Midian ki kup , lymne ki jingdeng kiba don sawdong ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkhia jong ki shkor ksiar kiba u la pan ka long shihajar hynriew spah tylli ki nar ksiar nalor ki jingdeng ksiar, bad ki ryndang , bad ki jain rong saw kiba don ha ki syiem Madian , bad nalor ki kynjri kiba don shaphang ki ryndang jong ki kulai jong ki .

en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king , for her bowels yearned upon her son , and she said , O my lord , give her the living child , and in no wise slay it . But the other said , Let it be neither mine nor thine , but divide it .
kha: Ka kmie kaba shisha , da ka dohnud kaba shlei da ka jingieit ïa la u khun , ka ong ha u syiem ,  Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka !  Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong ,  Wat ai ïa u hano hano na ngi ; to leh bad phiah arliang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kren ia kata ka kynthei kaba u khun ba im jong ka u la long ha u syiem, namar ki bniat jong ka ki la kwah eh ia u khun jong ka, bad ka la ong, ko kynrad jong nga, to ai ia ka ia u khun ba im, bad ha ka jingbym don jingstad ba to pyniap ia u. Hynrei uwei pat u la ong, Wat long u jong nga ne jong me, hynrei to phiah ia ka .

en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai na ka skul jong ki Epikuri bad ki Stoik ki la ïatainia ruh bad u . Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la kylli ,  Aïu une u sarong bieit u pyrshang ban kren ?  Kiwei pat ki jubab ,  U i kumba u kren shaphang ki blei nongwei .  Ki la ong ïa kane namar ba u Paul u la ïalap shaphang U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta katto katne ki riewstad jong ki nong Epop, bad ki Stock, ki la iakynduh ia u . Bad don kiba ong , Kaei kaba une u babler un ong ? kiwei pat ki long kumba u long u nongpynkylla ia ki blei kiba phylla: namar u la ialap ha ki ia U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication , that thou hast made before me : I have hallowed this house , which thou hast built , to put my name there for ever  ; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad jingkyrpad rit jong me . Nga la pynkyntang ïa kane ka ïing kaba me la tei kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan peit ïa ka bad ngan don hangta borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u , Nga la iohsngew ia ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong me, ba me la leh ha khmat jong nga: Nga la pynkyntang ia kane ka iing kaba me la tei, ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong nga hangta junom; bad ki khmat jong nga bad ka dohnud jong nga kin don hangta junom .

en: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldeans , who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary , and had no compassion upon young man or maiden , old man , or him that stooped for age : he gave them all into his hand .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u wallam ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad tur ïaleh ïa ki . U syiem u pynïap ïa ki samla shynrang ka Judah , wat hapoh ka Templ hi . Um don jingsngewsynei ïano ïano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , uba pang ne uba koit . U Blei u aiti ïa ki baroh ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la wanrah ia ki ha ki khun samla jong ki Khaldes, kiba la pyniap ia ki da ka waitlam ha ka iing jong ki , bad um shym la sngewsynei ia u samla ne u samla rangbah ne ia uta uba la dem khrup ha ka rta: u la aiti ia ki baroh ha ka kti jong u .

en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire , and the house of Joseph a flame , and the house of Esau for stubble , and they shall kindle in them , and devour them  ; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau  ; for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: Ki briew jong u Jakob bad jong u Joseph kin long kum ka ding ; kin pynjot ïa ki briew u Iso kumba ka ding ka thang ïa u phlangïap . Yn ym don uba hiarpateng na u Iso u ban lait im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing u Jakob kan long ka ding, bad ka iing u Joseph kan long ka ding, bad ka iing u Iso kan long ka ding ha ki, bad kin bam ia ki; bad kan ym don shuh ka iing u Iso; namar U Trai u la kren ia kata .

en: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed for inheritance to them .
kha: Kaba bud harum ka long ka jingïathuh ba kumno ïa ka ri Kanaan kaba ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la pynbynta hapdeng ki paid Israel . U Eleasar u lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad ki nongïalam jong ki longïing jong ki jait Israel ki pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ri kiba ki khun Israel ki la ioh pateng ha ka ri Kanaan , kaba u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u Joshua u khun u Nun bad ki khlieh jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki khun Israel ki la sam ia ki .

en: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish , and said unto their brethren , Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod , and teraphim , and a graven image , and a molten image ? now therefore consider what ye have to do .
kha: Nangta kita ki rangbah san ngut kiba la leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri sawdong ka Laish ki ong ha la ki paralok ,  Hato phi tip ba hangne ha kawei na kine ki ïing ka don ka bleithaw da ka dieng ba la suit da ka rupa ? Ki don ruh kiwei ki bleithaw bad ka ephod . Kaei phi pyrkhat ba ngin leh ?
