translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia ki san ngut ki briew kiba la leit shabar ka ri Laish bad u la ong ha ki hynmen jong ki: Hato phi tip ba ka don ha kine ki iing ka effod bad ka teraphim bad ka dur ba la ker bad ka dur ba la khleh lang ? mynta to pyrkhat ia kaei kaba phi dei ban leh .

en: And he shall take of it his handful , of the flour of the meat offering , and of the oil thereof , and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering , and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour , even the memorial of it , unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta un shim shi kham u  purew bad ka umphniang , bad ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka , bad un thang ha ka duwan kum ka dak ba ïa kata baroh la kñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Ka jingiw na kane ka jingainguh ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim na ka kti jong u, na ka shini jong ka jingainguh bam bad na ka umphniang jong ka, bad na ka umphniang jong ka baroh kaba don halor ka jingainguh bam, bad un thang ia ka ha ka jaka bam kaba thiang, wat ia ka jingkynmaw jong ka, ha U Trai .

en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor , and Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions  ; the Dinaites , the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Susanchites , the Dehavites , and the Elamites ,
kha: Na u Rehum , u lat , na u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , na ki paralok jong ki , ki nongbishar bad na baroh ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar , kiba long ki rangbah traishnong na Erekh , Babilon bad Susa ha ka ri Elam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Rehum u nongthoh khubor, bad u Shimshai u nongthoh khubor, bad kiwei pat ki paralok jong ki; ki Dinanite, ki Apharshi, ki Apharshi, ki Apharshi, ki Archeshi, ki Babilon, ki Susanite, ki Dehavites bad ki Elamite .

en: And it came to pass , when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned , and was dead , that Jezebel said to Ahab , Arise , take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , which he refused to give thee for money : for Naboth is not alive , but dead .
kha: Ka Jesebel mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor , ka ong ïa u Ahab ,  U Naboth u la ïap . To khie leit mynta bad shimti noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ kaba um shym treh ban die ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Jesbel u la iohsngew ba u Naboth u la shah pyniap bad u la iap, ba u Jesbel u la ong ha u Ahab, To ioh ia ka kper sohjew jong u Naboth u Jeselete, kaba u la kyntait ban ai pisa ia me: u Naboth um im hynrei u la iap .

en: The soul that sinneth , it shall die . The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father , neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son : the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him , and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him .
kha: Ka dei ïa uta uba leh pop ban ïap . U khun um dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong u kpa jong u , lymne u kpa namar ka pop jong u khun jong u . Yn ai bainong ïa u briew uba bha namar ka jinglehbha , bad u briew uba sniew un shahshitom namar ka jingsniew kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem kaba leh pop kan iap . U khun un ym kit ia ka jingbymhok jong u kpa: ka hok jong u hok kan long halor jong u bad ka jingsniew jong u bymman kan long halor jong u .

en: And I brought them into the house of the  Lord  , into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God , which was by the chamber of the princes , which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :
kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka kamra jong ki synran jong u Hanan u nongïathuhlypa u khun jong u Igdalaïah . Kane ka kamra ka long halor ka kamra u Maaseïah u khun jong u Shallum , u rangbah synshar bapawkhmat jong ka Templ , bad hajan ki kamra jong kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la wanrah ia ki ha ka iing U Trai, ha ka kamra jong ki khun shynrang jong u Hanan, u khun shynrang jong u Blei, uba don hajan ka kamra jong ki rangbah, kaba don halor ka kamra jong u Maaseiah u khun shynrang jong u Shallum:

en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob , and hath not pitied : he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah  ; he hath brought them down to the ground : he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof .
kha: Baroh shi miet lynter ka ïam ; ki ummat ki tuid ha ki ngab jong ka . Na baroh ki paralok jong ka kiba mynshuwa , ym don iwei ruh iba sah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Kiba ïateh lok bad ka ki la shetkylla ïa ka bad baroh ki la long pyrshah ïa ka mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la bam lut ia ki jaka shong jong u Jakob: u la pynhap ha ka jingbitar jong u ia ki jingbat ba skhem jong ka khun Judah ; u la pynhap ia ki shapoh khyndew: u la pynjakhlia ia ka hima bad ki syiem jong ka .

en: And Joab sent to Tekoa , and fetched thence a wise woman , and said unto her , I pray thee , feign thyself to be a mourner , and put on now mourning apparel , and anoint not thyself with oil , but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead :
kha: kumta u phah khot ïa ka kynthei kaba sian kaba shong ha Tekoa . Haba ka la wan poi , u ong ha ka ,  Leh mynleh kumba phi don ha kaba ïambriew ; kup ïa ki jaiñ ïambriew , bad wat sad ïa la u shñiuh . Leh kum ka briew kaba la ïambriew la slem bah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la phah sha Tekoa bad u la leit sha ka kynthei kaba stad, bad u la ong ha ka, nga kyrpad ia me, to leh ia lade ba me long u nongsngewsih, bad to phong ia ka jain kaba iam mynta, bad wat pynsleh ia lade da ka umphniang, hynrei to long kum ka kynthei kaba la slem bha na ka bynta kiba iap:

en: And Saul said , Let us go down after the Philistines by night , and spoil them until the morning light , and let us not leave a man of them . And they said , Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee . Then said the priest , Let us draw near hither unto God .
kha: U Saul u ong ha ki rangbah jong u ,  Ïa ngin leit hiar bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia mynmiet , ngin lute ïa ki haduh ban da kynjat shai , bad ngin pynïap lut ïa ki baroh .   Leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  ki jubab . Hynrei u lyngdoh u ong ,  To ngin da kylli shuwa na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong , To ngin hiar sha ki Philistia ha ka por miet, bad ngin pynsniew ia ki haduh ka jingshai mynstep, bad ngin ym iehnoh ia u briew na ki . Ki la ong: To leh ia kaba bha ha me . Nangta u lyngdoh u la ong u lyngdoh: To ngin iajan bad u Blei .

en: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly , which shall go up and come into thine house , and into thy bedchamber , and upon thy bed , and into the house of thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thine ovens , and into thy kneadingtroughs :
kha: Ka wah Nile kan jyllei da ki jakoid kat haduh ba kin kynthih na wah bad rung shapoh ïingsyiem jong me , sha kamra thiah jong me bad halor jingthiah jong me , sha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew jong me , bad wat ha ki jaka shet kpu jong me bad ki khiew shet kpu jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka wah kan pynmih bun ki khnai, ki ban leit shapoh iing jong me, bad ha ka kamra thiah jong me, bad ha ka kamra thiah jong me, bad ha ka iing jong ki shakri jong me, bad ha ki briew jong me, bad ha ki thliew jong me, bad ha ki thliew jong me:

en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and all his army , and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion , and all the people , fought against Jerusalem , and against all the cities thereof , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga mynba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , ba la kyrshan da ki shipai na baroh ki hima bad ki jaitbynriew kiba la hap hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki shnong ba-marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la wan ha u Jeremaiah na U Trai, haba u Neuchastrozzar u syiem Babilon bad ki shipai jong u baroh bad ki hima baroh jong ka ri jong u, bad ki briew baroh ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem bad pyrshah ia ki nongbah jong ka baroh .

en: And Abraham took Ishmael his son , and all that were born in his house , and all that were bought with his money , every male among the men of Abraham s house  ; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day , as God had said unto him .
kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Abraham u la kohnguh ïa U Blei bad u la otsher ïa u Ishmael u khun jong u , bad ïa kiwei pat ki shynrang baroh na ka longïing longsem jong u , kynthup ruh ïa ki mraw baroh kiba la kha ha longïing longsem jong u bad kito kiba u la lah thied .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la shim ia u Ishmael u khun jong u, bad ia baroh kiba la kha ha iing jong u, bad ia baroh kiba la thied da ka pisa jong u, uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ki shynrang jong u Abraham; bad u la ot ia ka doh jong ki ha kajuh ka sngi .

en: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee : thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen , and of the wheels , and of the chariots , when he shall enter into thy gates , as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach .
kha: Ki lyoh pui pui ba pynmih da ki kulai jong ki , kin tap ïa pha . Ka jingsawa na ki kulai ba paring ïa ki kali kit mar bad ki kali ïapom kin pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kynroh jong pha katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah ba la pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbun ki kulai jong u kan tap ia me: ki kynroh jong me kin khih ha ka jingsawa jong ki kulai bad ki tyrpeng bad ki kali kit mar jong me haba u rung ha ki khyrdop jong me, katba ki briew ki rung ha ka shnong ha kaba la pynlong ia ka jingpynkhein .

en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  shall choose : because the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase , and in all the works of thine hands , therefore thou shalt surely rejoice .
kha: Pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kata ka jaka mane Blei . To lehkmen , namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ki jingmih baroh ba phi la ïoh ot bad ïa ka kam jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi men leh ia ka jingkhawai kaba sngewbha ia U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied: namar U Trai U Blei jong me un kyrkhu ia me ha ka jingroi jong me baroh, bad ha ki kam jong me baroh, namarkata me sngewbha shisha .

en: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee  ; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee : for thy merchants were the great men of the earth  ; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived .
kha: Ïa ka jingshai ka sharak yn ym ïohi shuh da lei lei ha pha ; ïa ka sur u nongleitkurim bad ka nongleitkurim yn ym ïohsngew shuh ha pha ! Ki nongkhaïi jong pha ki la long kiba donbor tam ha ka pyrthei baroh , bad da ka myntor balamler pha la shukor ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingshai jong ka sharak kan ym shai shuh ha me bad ka sur jong u nongleit kurim bad ka nongleitkurim kan ym iohsngew shuh ha me: namar ki nongkhaii jong me ki long ki briew kiba khraw jong ka khyndew; namar da ki jingleh jadu jong me baroh ki la shah thok .

en: But if ye turn unto me , and keep my commandments , and do them  ; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven , yet will I gather them from thence , and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there .
kha: Hynrei lada phi phai pat sha nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum ïa phi , ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jaka sha kaba nga la jied ban mane ïa nga , wat la ïa phi la pynsakma sha kiba kut ka pyrthei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi phai sha nga bad phi sumar ia ki hukum jong nga, wat la ki don na phi kiba la bret shabar sha ka bynta kaba kut tam jong ka bneng , hynrei ngan lum ia ki naduh hangta , bad ngan wanrah ia ki sha ka jaka kaba nga la jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong nga hangta .

en: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering :
kha: Un pyndei ruh khyndiat ka umphniang ha kijuh ki jaka ha kiba u la tah snam : ha ka shkor kamon jong uta u briew , ka  tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un buh ia ka umphniang kaba don ha ka kti jong u ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong u uba dei ban pynkhuid, bad ha ka ktieh kadiang jong u bad ha ka ktieh kadiang jong u, ha ka jaka jong ka snam jong ka jingaiti kaba la pynkhuid:

en: So the children went in and possessed the land , and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gavest them into their hands , with their kings , and the people of the land , that they might do with them as they would .
kha: Ki la jop ïa ka ri Kanaan ; me la jop ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Me la ai ïa ki briew jong me ka bor ban leh ïa kaba ki sngewbha bad ki briew bad ki syiem ka Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki khun ki la rung bad ki la bat ia ka ri, bad me la pyndem ha khmat jong ki ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri, ki nongshong shnong jong ki, bad me la ai ia ki ha ki kti jong ki, bad ki syiem jong ki bad ki briew jong ka ri, ba kin leh ia ki katba ki mon .

en: The other disciples therefore said unto him , We have seen the Lord . But he said unto them , Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails , and put my finger into the print of the nails , and thrust my hand into his side , I will not believe .
kha: Kumta kiwei pat ki synran ki la ïathuh ïa u ,  Ngi la ïohi ïa U Trai !  U Thomas u la ong ha ki ,  Lymda nga ïohi ïa ki dien preg ha ki kti jong u bad ïoh buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong nga ha kito ki dien preg bad ïa ka kti jong nga ha ka krung jong u , ngan ym ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la ong ha u , Ngi la iohi ia U Trai . Hynrei u la ong ha ki kti jong u ia ka dak jong ki nail bad nga buh ia ka kti jong nga ha ka dak jong ki nail bad nga buh ia ka kti jong nga ha ka liang jong u , ngan ym ngeit .

en: Then said they , What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him ? They answered , Five golden emerods , and five golden mice , according to the number of the lords of the Philistines : for one plague was on you all , and on your lords .
kha: Ka jingai sngewbha aïu ngin phah ïa u ?  Ki briew ki kylli . Ki la jubab ,  San tylli ki dur jong u thung kiba da ka ksiar bad san tylli ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u syiem Philistia . Ïa kajuh ka khlam la pynngat ha phi baroh bad ha baroh san ngut ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong: Kaei ka jingainguh kaba sniew kaba ngin pynphai biang ia u ? Ki la jubab, San tylli ki khnai ksiar bad san tylli ki miaw ksiar kat kum ka jingbun ki kynrad jong ki Philistia: namar kawei ka khlam ka la don ha phi baroh bad ha ki kynrad jong phi .

en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule  ; he marketh it out with a line  ; he fitteth it with planes , and he marketh it out with the compass , and maketh it after the figure of a man , according to the beauty of a man  ; that it may remain in the house .
kha: U misteri u thew ïa ka dieng , u buh dak ïa ka dur da u mawthoh , u ohdur ïa ka da ki tiar jong u , bad u pynlong ïa ka ha ka dur u briew , ka durbriew ba-itynnat , ban buh ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongshna dieng u pynjrong ia ka kyndon jong u ; u buh dak ia ka da u lain u pynbeit ia ka da ki liengsuin , bad u buh dak ia ka da ka kompas , bad u pynlong ia ka kat kum ka dur jong u briew; kat kum ka jingitynnad jong u briew ; ba kan sah ha iing .

en: And he shall judge among many people , and rebuke strong nations afar off  ; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up a sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
kha: Un pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hapdeng ki bor bakhraw hajan bad hajngai . Kin shoh tyrnem ïa la ki waitlam ban pynlong ki lyngkor bad ïa ki sum sha ki wait ngor tnat dieng . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh shuh ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un bishar hapdeng ki briew kiba bun, bad un pynrem ia ki jaitbynriew kiba khlain bor na jngai; bad kin shoh ia ki waitlam jong ki ha ki thliew: ka jaitbynriew kan ym rah ia ka waitlam pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew , lymne kin ym nang thma shuh .

en: And when Absalom s servants came to the woman to the house , they said , Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan ? And the woman said unto them , They be gone over the brook of water . And when they had sought and could not find them , they returned to Jerusalem .
kha: Haba ki rangbah synshar jong u Absalom ki la wan sha kata ka ïing bad kylli ïa kata ka briew ,  Shaei u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan ?   Ki la jam ïa ka wah ,  ka la jubab . Ki rangbah ki la wad ïa ki hynrei kim lap ïa ki , bad kumta ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Absalom ki la wan sha kata ka iing, ki la ong, Hangno u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan ? Bad kata ka kynthei ka la ong ha ki, Ki la leit sha shiliang ka wah um . Bad haba ki la wad bad kim lah ban shem ia ki, ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .

en: I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill  ; but time and chance happeneth to them all .
kha: Nga la sngewthuh sa kawei pat , ba ha kane ka pyrthei ki nongmareh kiba stet kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ki jingïamareh thong , bad kiba shlur kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ka thma . Ki briew kiba stad kim ju ïai kamai sah ban im , ki briew kiba proh jingmut kim ju ïai ïoh spah , bad ki briew kiba lah ban leh ei ei kim ju ïai kiew sha ki kyrdan bashalor . Ka kupar basniew ka jia ha uwei pa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la wan phai, bad nga la iohi hapoh ka sngi, ba ka jingiakop kam long kaba stet, ne ka thma kaba khlain, ym pat u kpu ha kiba stad, lymne ka spah ha ki briew kiba sngewthuh, lymne ka jingsngewbha ia ki briew kiba tbit; hynrei ka por bad ka lad ka jia ia ki baroh .

en: And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .
kha: Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron , bad ki ong ha u ,  Kane hangne ka dei ka khlieh u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul , u nongshun jong phi , uba la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Ha kane ka sngi U  Trai  u la shah ïa u Syiem Kynrad ban pynhiarkput ïa u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ka khlieh jong u Ishaboshet ha u Dabid ha u Hebron bad ki la ong ha u syiem: Ha khmih ka khlieh jong u Ishaboshet u khun u nongshun jong me u la wad ia ka jingim jong me; bad U Trai u la pynrem ia u syiem jong nga ha kane ka sngi u Saul bad na u symbai jong u .

en: Son of man , Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre : every head was made bald , and every shoulder was peeled : yet had he no wages , nor his army , for Tyre , for the service that he had served against it :
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la hiarthma ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Tyros . U la pynlong ïa ki shipai jong u ban kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia haduh ba ki khlieh jong ki , ki la dkhoi ki shñiuh bad ki tyrpeng jong ki , ki la tyrkhong khait , hynrei u syiem lymne ka kynhun shipai jong u kim shym ïoh ei ei na baroh ki jinglehshitom jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u briew , u Neuchadrezzar u syiem Babilon u la pynlong ia ka kynhun shipai jong u ban shakri ia ka jingshakri kaba khraw pyrshah ia ka Tyros: kawei pa kawei ka khlieh ka la tyrkhong: hynrei um don jingsiew ei ei, ne ka kynhun shipai jong u, na ka bynta ka Tyros, na ka bynta ka jingshakri kaba u la shakri pyrshah ia ka:

en: And when they were come in , they went up into an upper room , where abode both Peter , and James , and John , and Andrew , Philip , and Thomas , Bartholomew , and Matthew , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon Zelotes , and Judas the brother of James .
kha: Ki la rung sha ka nongbah bad ki la leit sha ka kamra ha kaba ki la sah : U Petros , u Ïoannis , u Jakob bad u Andriw , u Philip bad u Thomas , u Bartholomai bad u Matthaïos , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Simon u Riew-ieit Ri , bad u Judas u khun jong u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan rung shapoh kawei ka kamra kaba shalor, ha kaba u Petros bad u Jakob bad u Ioannis bad u Andrei, u Philip bad u Thomas, u Bartholome bad u Mathaios, u Jakob u khun u Alphaeus bad u Simon u Judas u hynmen u Jakob .

en: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Beth–shemesh , and went along the highway , lowing as they went , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left  ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth–shemesh .
kha: Kita ki masi kynthei ki leit beit beit shaphang Beth Shemesh , bad khlem da phai na ka lynti ba ki leit , ki da pah artat katba ki dang leit . Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki bud nadien jong ki haduh u pud jong ka Beth Shemesh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kine ki la iaid beit sha ka lynti jong ka Bethshemesh bad ki la iaid lyngba ka lynti bah, ki la iaid sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang; bad ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la iaid bud ia ki haduh u pud u sam jong ka Bethshemesh .

en: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee , and shall pursue thee , and overtake thee , till thou be destroyed  ; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee :
kha: Kine ki jingpynjot baroh kin sa ngat ha phi , bad kin bam bad lynshop ïa phi haduh ba phin da jot thiaw , namar ba phim kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad phim sumar ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata kine ki jingtim baroh kin wan ha me bad kin bud ia me, bad kin sa pynjot ia me, haduh ba me da shah pynjot ; namar ba me sngap ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me, ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u bad ki ain jong u kiba u la hukum ia me:

en: These words the  Lord  spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice : and he added no more . And he wrote them in two tables of stone , and delivered them unto me .
kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi baroh mynba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U la kren da ka sur kaba donbor napdeng kata ka ding bad u lyoh uba rben , mynba u ai ïa ki ha phi khlem da bynrap ïa kiwei pat . Nangta u thoh ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap bad u ai ïa ki ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki ktien U Trai u la kren ha ka jingiaseng jong phi baroh ha ka jaka ba la lum na pdeng ka ding, na ka lyoh bad na ka jingdum kaba jylliew: bad um shym la pyndap shuh . Bad u la thoh ia ki ha ki ar tylli ki miej maw , bad u la aiti ia ki ha nga .

en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the handstaves , and the spears , and they shall burn them with fire seven years :
kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ki Israel kin ïamih shabar bad khar ïa ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh ïa ka ban thang diengïap . Kin sliew ding da ki stieh , ki ryntieh , ki khnam , ki sum bad ki dieng tangon , bad kin biang haduh hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba shong ha ki shnong Israel kin leit sha khmat, bad kin thang ia ki tiar ialeh, baroh ar ki shipai bad ki khnam, ki bow bad ki khnam bad ki khnam bad ki khnam bad ki khnam bad ki khnam bad ki khnam bad kin thang ia ki da ka ding hynriew snem:

en: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee , and thy backslidings shall reprove thee : know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter , that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , and that my fear is not in thee , saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
kha: Ka jingsniew jong me hi kan pynshitom ïa me , bad ka jingphai noh jong me na nga kan pynrem ïa me . Men ïoh tip haduh katno kaba kthang bad kaba bakla ka long ban iehnoh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , bad mem shym long shuh uba ïaineh ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsniew jong me hi kan pynbeit ia me, bad ki jingkylla jong me kin pynrem ia me: to tip namarkata bad to iohi ba ka long kaba sniew bad kaba sngewsih, ba me la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad ba ka jingtieng jong nga kam don ha me, ong U Trai U Blei jong ki paid .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , If thou return , then will I bring thee again , and thou shalt stand before me : and if thou take forth the precious from the vile , thou shalt be as my mouth : let them return unto thee  ; but return not thou unto them .
kha: Ïa kane U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Lada me wan phai , ngan shim pat ïa me , bad men long biang u shakri jong nga . Lada ha ka jaka ban kren khlem jingmut me pynbna ïa ka khubor ba don jingmut , men long biang u nongïathuhlypa jong nga . Ki briew kin wan phai pat sha me , bad mem donkam ban leit sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai , te ngan wanrah biang ia me, bad me phin ieng ha khmat jong nga: bad lada me shim noh ia kaba kordor na ka jingsniew , me long kum ka shyntur jong nga: to ai ba kin wan phai biang sha me; hynrei wat pynphai biang ia me sha ki .

en: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt  ; and he shall burn them , and carry them away captives : and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt , as a shepherd putteth on his garment  ; and he shall go forth from thence in peace .
kha: Ngan tbeh ïa ka ding ha ki templ jong ki blei ki Ijipt , bad u syiem ka Babilonia un thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ne ïalam noh ïa ki . Katba ki nongap langbrot ki dang jied ïa ki jaiñ jong ki kiba lait na ki jynreiñ , te u syiem ka Babilonia un jied pynkhuid ïa ka ri Ijipt bad nangta ki mih da ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan thang ia ka ding ha ki iing jong ki blei Ijipt bad un thang ia ki, bad un rah noh ia ki da ki mraw: bad un pynkhreh ia lade bad ka ri Ijipt, kumba u nongaplangbrot u buh ha ka jain jong u ; bad un leit noh nangta da ka jingsuk .

en: So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .
kha: U shakri u la leit phai bad u la ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u kynrad jong u . U kynrad u la bitar shla bad u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ To leit kloi sha ki lynti bah bad ki lynti rit jong ka nongbah , bad wallam ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba matlah , bad kiba dkoh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta uta u shakri u la wan, bad u la pyni ia u kynrad jong u ia kine kiei kiei . Nangta u kynrad iing u la bitar ia u shakri jong u, To leit noh kloi sha ki lynti bad ki lynti jong ka shnong, bad wanrah ia kiba duk bad kiba lyngngoh bad kiba matlah .

en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha , saying , Thy servant my husband is dead  ; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the  Lord  : and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen .
kha: Ka riewkynthei jong u dkhot ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ka la leit sha u Elisha bad ka ong ,  Kynrad , u tnga jong nga u la ïap ! Kumba phi tip , u dei u briew uba sheptieng ïa U Blei , hynrei mynta u briew uba ai ram ïa u , u la wan ban shim noh ïa ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong nga ban long ki mraw kum ka jingsiew ïa ka ram u tnga jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la pyrta kawei ka kynthei na ki tnga jong ki nongiathuhlypa ha u Elisha, ka da ong, U shakri jong me u la iap bad me tip ba u shakri jong me u la tieng ia U Trai: bad u nongshim ram u wan ban shim ia u arngut ki khun shynrang jong nga ban long ki mraw jong nga .

en: When the boughs thereof are withered , they shall be broken off : the women come , and set them on fire : for it is a people of no understanding : therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them , and he that formed them will shew them no favour .
kha: Ki tnat jong ki dieng ki la stai bad kdiah noh , bad ki kynthei ki ïatam ïa ki ban pynlong diengthang . Namar ba ki briew kim sngewthuh ei ei , U Blei U Nongthaw jong ki un ym sngewlem ïa ki lane pyn-i ïa ki kano kano ka jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki tnat jong ka ki la tyrkhong: ki kynthei ki wan , bad ki thang ia ki: namar ka long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlem jingmut: namarkata uta uba la thaw ia ki un ym isynei ia ki , bad uta uba la thaw ia ki un ym pyni ia ki .

en: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham , the son of Uzziah , king of Judah , that Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah , king of Israel , went up toward Jerusalem to war against it , but could not prevail against it .
kha: Haba u Syiem Ahas , u khun jong u Jotham bad u ksiew jong u Ussaïah , u synshar ïa ka Judah , la khie ka thma . U Resin , u syiem ka Syria , bad u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah , u syiem ka Israel , ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem , hynrei kim shym lah ban kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi u Ahasa u khun jong u Uzziah u syiem Judah u Rezin u syiem Syria bad u Pekah u khun jong u Realiah u syiem Israel ki la leit sha Jerusalem ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka .

en: And he said , It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel : I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles , that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Nga don ka kam kaba kham khraw ïa me , ko shakri jong nga . Ym tang ba men rah pat sha ka jingkhraw ïa ki paid Israel kiba la lait im , hynrei ngan pynlong ruh ïa me ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew — khnang ba ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohlait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ka long kaba jem ba me long u shakri jong nga ban pynmih ia ki jaitbynriew Jakob bad ban pynphai biang ia ki Israel ba la pynneh pynsah: Ngan ai ruh ia me ia ka jingshai ha ki Jutang, ba me long ka jingpynim jong nga haduh kaba kut jong ka pyrthei .

en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him  ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .
kha: Lada uno uno u wallam ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa phi bad rah ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia bad u ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Lada phim leh kumta , un tan ïa phi ha khmat u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi ha ki nongap phira , bad ïa phi yn buh ha ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me leit bad u nongshun jong me ha u majistor, kumba me don ha lynti, to ai ka jingminot ba phin shah pyllait na u ; ioh ba un pyniap ia me ha u nongbishar, bad u nongbishar un aiti ia me ha u ophisar, bad u ophisar un bret ia me ha phatok .

en: And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering  ; I give it all .
kha: Shim ïa ka , Syiem Kynrad ,  u Araunah u ong ,  bad leh ïa ka katba phi sngewbit . Hangne ki don ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh ha ka duwan , bad hangne ki don ki lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang , bad u kew ban ai kum ka jingainguh . Nga ai ïa ki baroh ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ornan u la ong ha u Dabid, To shim ia ka ha me, bad to ai ba u kynrad jong nga un leh ia kaba bha ha ki khmat jong u: ha me, nga ai ia me ia ki masi ruh na ka bynta ki jingknia thang, bad ki tiar ot dieng, bad u kew na ka bynta ka jingainguh doh; nga ai lut .

en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .
kha: U Absalom bad ki Israel baroh ki ong ,  Ka jingai jingmut jong u Hushai ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel .  U  Trai  u la rai ban pynpulom ïa ka jingai jingmut babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjot kan wan ha u Absalom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom bad ki briew baroh ki Israel ki la ong , Ka jingmut jong u Hasha u Arket ka kham bha ban ia ka jingmut jong u Ahitoh . Namar U Trai u la buh ban jop ia ka jingmut babha jong u Ahitoh , ha ka jingthmu ba U Trai un wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha u Ahitoh .

en: And it shall be to me a name of joy , a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth , which shall hear all the good that I do unto them : and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it .
kha: Ka Jerusalem kan long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen , ka burom bad ka jingsngew sarong ïa nga ; bad ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei kin sheptieng bad khynñiuh haba kin ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga leh ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ka jingroi jingpar kaba nga wallam ha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha nga ka kyrteng jong ka jingkmen, ka jingiaroh bad ka burom ha khmat ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew, ki ban iohsngew ia ka jingbha baroh kaba nga leh ha ki: bad kin tieng bad kin khih na ka bynta ka jingbha baroh bad na ka bynta ka jingroi jingpar baroh kaba nga pynpaw ha ka .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Ahijah , Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son  ; for he is sick : thus and thus shalt thou say unto her : for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself to be another woman .
kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u ba ka tnga u Jeroboam kan wan wad jingtip na u shaphang u khun jong ka , uba pang . Bad U  Trai  u bthah ïa u Ahijah aïu ban ong . Haba ka tnga u Jeroboam ka la poi , ka leh mynleh ïa lade kum kawei pat ka briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Ahiah, Ha khmih, ka tnga jong u Jeroboan ka wan ban pan ei ei na phi na ka bynta u khun jong ka ; namar u pang: kumta bad kumta me ong ia ka: namar kan long, haba ka wan rung, ba kan leh ia lade ba ka long kawei pat ka kynthei .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , In an acceptable time have I heard thee , and in a day of salvation have I helped thee : and I will preserve thee , and give thee for a covenant of the people , to establish the earth , to cause to inherit the desolate heritages  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha la ki briew ,  Haba ka por ban pyllait im ïa phi ka la poi , ngan pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewbha jong nga ïa phi bad ban sngap ïa ki jingkhot kyrpad jingïarap . Ngan ri bad ïada ïa phi bad lyngba jong phi ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki briew baroh . Ngan shah ba phi shongduh sa shisien ha la ka ri kaba mynta ka la shu sah shrah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Ha ka por kaba lah ban pdiang nga la iohsngew ia me , bad ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynim nga la iarap ia me: bad ngan pynneh ia me na ka bynta ka jutang jong ki briew , ban pynskhem ia ka khyndew , ban pynlong ia me ban hiar pateng ia ki pateng ba la jot;

en: But Saul and the people spared Agag , and the best of the sheep , and of the oxen , and of the fatlings , and the lambs , and all that was good , and would not utterly destroy them : but every thing that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .
kha: Hynrei u Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki pynsah im ïa u Agag , bad kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam , ïa ki khun masi bad ki khunlangbrot kiba kynsai tam , bad ïa kano kano kaba kordor ; ki la pynjot tang ïa kata ka bymlarkam ne bymdonkam ei ei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Saul bad ki briew ki la pyllait im ia u Agag, bad ia kaba bha tam na ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ki shyieng bad ki langbrot bad baroh kaba bha: hynrei ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la sniew bad kiba la sniew: ba ki la pynjot lut .

en: And David spake unto the  Lord  when he saw the angel that smote the people , and said , Lo , I have sinned , and I have done wickedly : but these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , be against me , and against my father s house .
kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa u angel uba u pynïap ïa ki briew , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Dei ma nga uba la leh pop . Nga dei uta uba la leh bakla . Kine ki briew bapli ki la leh aïu ? Me dei ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kren ha U Trai haba u la iohi ia u angel uba la shoh ia ki briew, bad u la ong: Lo, nga la leh sniew: hynrei kine ki langbrot ki la leh aiu ? to ai ba ka kti jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, kan long pyrshah ia nga bad pyrshah ia ka iing u kpa jong nga .

en: And it came to pass at the end of the year , that the host of Syria came up against him : and they came to Judah and Jerusalem , and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people , and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus .
kha: Haba ka synrai ka la poi ha kata ka snem , ka kynhun shipai Syria ka la tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïalam baroh , bad ki la kit shibun ki mar lute sha Damaskos .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong u snem , ka kynhun shipai Syria ka la wan pyrshah ia u: bad ki la wan sha Judah bad Jerusalem , bad ki la pynjot ia ki rangbah baroh na ki briew , bad ki la phah ia ka jinglute jong ki baroh sha u syiem ka Damekhos .

en: And another angel came out from the altar , which had power over fire  ; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle , saying , Thrust in thy sharp sickle , and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth  ; for her grapes are fully ripe .
kha: Nangta sa uwei pat u angel , uba dei khmih ïa ka ding , u la wan na ka duwan . U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam sha uta u angel uba la don ka rashi kaba nep ,  To pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi , bad ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bri sohwaiñ jong ka pyrthei , namar ba ki sohwaiñ ki la ih !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u angel u la mih na ka almari;

en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother , And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? ask for him the kingdom also  ; for he is mine elder brother  ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah .
kha: Balei ba phi pan na nga ban ai ïa ka Abishag ha u ?  u syiem u kylli .  Phi lah ban sa pan ruh na nga ban ai ha u ïa ka khet ruh . Nalor kata , u dei u hynmen ba kham heh jong nga , bad ba u Abiathar u lyngdoh bad u Joab ki don ha ka liang jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka kmie jong u, Bad balei phi kylli ia u Abishag u Shunam na ka bynta u Adonijah ? pan na ka bynta jong u ruh; namar u long u hynmen rangbah jong nga; wat na ka bynta jong u, bad na ka bynta u Abhiar u lyngdoh bad na ka bynta u Joab u khun jong u Seruiah .

en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
kha: Ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem ha ka kur u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir u ksiew jong u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , ki la leit sha u Moses bad kiwei pat ki nongïalam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ki khun shynrang jong ka Gilead, u khun shynrang jong u Machir, u khun shynrang jong u Joseph, ki la wan hajan bad ki la kren ha khmat u Moses bad ha khmat ki rangbah jong ki khun Israel:

en: And Moses and Aaron did so , as the  Lord  commanded  ; and he lifted up the rod , and smote the waters that were in the river , in the sight of Pharaoh , and in the sight of his servants  ; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood .
kha: Nangta U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Ha khmat jong u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , u Aaron u la rah ïa la u diengduh bad u tied ïa ka sla um jong ka wah Nile , bad ka um baroh ka la kylla snam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh kumta kumba U Trai u la hukum; bad u la pynkhih ia ki um kiba don ha ka wah ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki shakri jong u baroh ki la kylla snam .

en: And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .
kha: Ki briew kin jubab , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la iehnoh na U  Trai  U Blei uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ki la ai ïa la ka jingnguh ïa kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane ïa ki . Kata ka long balei ba U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka apot .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad yn jubab ia ki , Namar ki la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki, uba la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt , bad u la bat ia kiwei pat ki blei , bad u la shakri ia ki: namar kata u la wanrah ia kane ka jingsniew baroh ha ki .

en: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all , of every sort of your oblations , shall be the priest s : ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough , that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kin ïoh ïa kaba bha tam na ki soh nyngkong jong ka jingot bad na baroh kiei kiei kiwei ïa kiba la ainguh ha nga . Man ka por ba ki briew ki shet kpu , kin ai sha ki lyngdoh ïa u kpu banyngkong kum ka jingainguh , bad ki jingkyrkhu jong nga kin neh ha ki ïing ki sem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba nyngkong eh na kiei kiei baroh, bad ka jingkyrkhu baroh, na ki jingainguh jong phi baroh: phi ruh phin ai ha u lyngdoh ia ka doh jong phi kaba nyngkong eh, khnang ba un pynlong ia ka jingkyrkhu ban shongthait ha ka iing jong me .

en: When I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; and thou givest him not warning , nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way , to save his life  ; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew basniew , un sa ïap noh bad mem shym la maham u ban kylla noh na ki lynti jong u , khnang ba u lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jingim , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me ïa ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga ong ha kiba sniew , Me dei ban iap shuh shuh bad me ai jingmaham ia u, lymne kren ban maham ia u bymman na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u, ban pynim ia ka jingim jong u; uta u juh u briew uba sniew un iap ha ka jingbymhok jong u ; hynrei ka snam jong u ngan dawa ha ka kti jong me .

en: And they said unto him , Hold thy peace , lay thine hand upon thy mouth , and go with us , and be to us a father and a priest : is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man , or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel ?
kha: Ki ong ,  Sngap jar . Wat ang shikyntien ruh . Ale bad ngi bad long u lyngdoh bad u nongaibuit jong ngi . Hato phim kham lah ban long u lyngdoh ïa ka jait Israel baroh kawei ban tang ïa kawei ka longïing jong uwei u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, To bat ia ka jingsuk jong me, to buh ia ka kti jong me ha ka shyntur jong me, bad to leit bad ngi, bad to long ia ngi u kpa bad u lyngdoh: hato ka kham bha ia me ban long u lyngdoh ha ka iing jong uwei u briew ne ba me long u lyngdoh ha ka jaitbynriew bad ka iing ha Israel ?

en: But he himself went a day s journey into the wilderness , and came and sat down under a juniper tree : and he requested for himself that he might die  ; and said , It is enough  ; now , O  Lord  , take away my life  ; for I am not better than my fathers .
kha: U Elijah u ïaid baroh shi sngi ha ka ri khlaw . U la sangeh bad shong ha ka jingkah syrngiew u dieng bad u kwah tang ban ïap noh .  Ka la long palat , ko  Trai  ,  u la duwai .  Shim noh ïa ka jingim jong nga ; ka bha ïa nga ban ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma u hi u la leit sha ka ri khlaw, bad u la wan shong hapoh u dieng sohjew: bad u la kyrpad ia lade ba un iap ; bad u la ong: Ka la biang ; mynta ko Trai, shim noh ia ka jingim jong nga ; namar ngam kham bha ban ia ki kpa tymmen jong nga .

en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch , whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon : he went and said thus unto him  ; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king , and I will shew unto the king the interpretation .
kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , ïa uba u syiem u la lah hukum ban pynïap ïa ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem . U la ong ha u ,  Wat pynïap ïa ki . Ïalam ïa nga sha u syiem , bad ngan ïathuh ha u aïu ka jingphohsniew jong u ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Daniel u la leit shapoh u Aroioh, uba u syiem u la buh ban pynjot ia ki riewstad jong ka Babilon: u la leit bad u la ong kumta ha u; Wat pynjot ia ki riewstad jong ka Babilon: to wanrah ia nga ha khmat u syiem, bad ngan pyni ha u syiem ia ka jingbatai .

en: Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u khiew shet ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh ka Judah yn pynkyrpang na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ki briew kiba ai ïa ki jingkñia kin pyndonkam ïa ki ban phon ïa ka doh jong ki jingkñia . Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh uno uno u nongkhaïi ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, kawei pa kawei ka khiew ha Jerusalem bad ha Judah kan long kaba khuid ha U Trai jong ki paid: bad baroh kiba knia kin wan bad shim na ki, bad ki symbai ha kata ka sngi kan ym don shuh u nong Kana ha ka iing U Trai jong ki paid .

en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance : for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me , and art gone up  ; thou hast enlarged thy bed , and made thee a covenant with them  ; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it .
kha: Phi pynïeng ïa ki blei ba-ijli ha khmat ka jingkhang ki jingkhang bah ki ïing jong phi . Phi la lyndet ïa nga ; phi law ïa la ki jaiñ bad kiew halor ki jingthiah baheh jong phi ryngkat bad kiba ieit jong phi , ïa kiba phi la siewdor ban ïathiah lang bad ki . Bad hangta phi pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ki jingkhang ruh bad ki post me la buh ia ka jingkynmaw jong me: namar me la lap ia lade ha uwei pat u briew uba kham heh u la nang heh;

en: His prayer also , and how God was entreated of him , and all his sin , and his trespass , and the places wherein he built high places , and set up groves and graven images , before he was humbled : behold , they are written among the sayings of the seers .
kha: Ka jingduwai u syiem bad ka jingjubab U Blei ïa ka , bad ka jingthoh shaphang ki pop kiba u la leh ha shuwa ba un kylla-kaba-mut — ka jingsniew kaba u la leh , ki jaka mane blei thala bad ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah kaba u la thaw bad ki bleithaw kiba u la mane — baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong ki Nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingduwai jong u ruh , bad kumno U Blei u la shah pynngop ha u , bad ka pop jong u baroh , bad ki jaka ba u la tei ia ki jaka ba jrong , bad u la buh ia ki lum bad ki dur ba la ker , shuwa ba un sngewrit: ha khmih , la thoh ia ki hapdeng ki ktien jong ki nongiohi .

en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and went northward , and said unto Jephthah , Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon , and didst not call us to go with thee ? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire .
kha: Ki rangbah Ephraim ki khreh ban ïaleh thma ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha Saphon bad ki ong ha u Jephthah ,  Balei phi leit ïaleh ïa ki Ammon khlem da khot lem ïa ngi ban leit lang bad phi ? Ngin thang im ïa me hapoh ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Ephraim ki la ialum lang bad ki la leit shaphang shathie bad ki la ong ha u Jephthah: Balei me la iaid shajan ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon bad phim shym la khot ia ngi ban leit ryngkat bad me ? ngin thang ia ka iing jong me da ka ding .

en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies , and of the ashes , and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron , unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east , shall be holy unto the  Lord   ; it shall not be plucked up , nor thrown down any more for ever .
kha: Ka them baroh kawei , ha kaba la tep ïa kiba ïap bad ha kaba la bret ïa ki jakhlia , bad baroh ki pyntha shaneng ka wah Kidron haduh ka Khyrdop Kulai shaphang mihngi , kin long kiba kyntang ha nga . Ka nongbah kan ym shah pynpra shuh lane shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka them baroh kawei jong ki met iap bad ka dewbilat bad ki lyngkha baroh haduh ka wah Kidron , haduh ka tduh jong ka khyrdop kulai shaphang mihngi , kan long kaba khuid ha U Trai; kan ym shah rong noh shuh ha U Trai;

en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies  ; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them  ; and they shall flee , as fleeing from a sword  ; and they shall fall when none pursueth .
kha: Ngan pynlong ha kito na phi kiba dang sah ha ka jinglongmraw ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw kat haduh ba ka jingriew ka sla dieng ha ka jingbeh ka lyer kan pynher krad ïa phi . Phin her ïap la kumba shah beh ha madan thma , bad phin kyllon haba u nongshun um pat don hajan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor jong ki kiba sah ha phi ngan phah ia ka jingsngewsih ha ki dohnud jong ki nongshun jong ki ; bad ka jingsawa jong u sla ba la pynkhih kan beh ia ki ; bad kin phet noh, kumba phet noh na ka waitlam ; bad kin hap haba ym don ba beh .

en: And she said , As the  Lord  thy God liveth , I have not a cake , but an handful of meal in a barrel , and a little oil in a cruse : and , behold , I am gathering two sticks , that I may go in and dress it for me and my son , that we may eat it , and die .
kha: Ka jubab ,  Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong phi , ba ngam don kpu ei ei . Baroh kaba nga don ka long tang shi kham u  purew ha ka pliang bad shi jaw ka umphniang Olib ha u klong . Nga wan hangne ban lum khyndiat ki diengïap ban rah sha ïing bad ban pynkhreh na kaba khyndiat kaba nga don na ka bynta u khun jong nga bad ïa lade . Kata kan dei ka jingbam khatduh jong ngi , bad nangta ngin sa ïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong: Kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u im, ngam don ka cake, hynrei ka kti ka bam ha ka barel, bad khyndiat ka umphniang ha ka umphniang: bad, ha khmih, nga lum ar tylli ki dieng, ba ngan leit rung bad phong ia ka na ka bynta jong nga bad u khun jong nga, ba ngin bam ia ka bad ngin iap .

en: Bath–sheba therefore went unto king Solomon , to speak unto him for Adonijah . And the king rose up to meet her , and bowed himself unto her , and sat down on his throne , and caused a seat to be set for the king s mother  ; and she sat on his right hand .
kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit sha u syiem ban ïakren bad u na ka bynta u Adonijah . U syiem u la ïeng joit ban khublei ïa la ka kmie , bad u nguh ïa ka . Nangta u shong ha la ka khet , bad la wan buh sa kawei shapoh ha kaba ka la shong sha ka liang ka mon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bathsheba u la leit sha u syiem Solomon, ban kren ia u na ka bynta u Adonijah . U syiem u la ieng ban iakynduh ia ka, bad u la dem khrup ha ka khet jong u, bad u la pynlong ia ka jaka shong ban buh ia ka kmie jong u syiem; bad ka la shong ha ka liang kadiang jong u .

en: And command ye them , saying , Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan , out of the place where the priests  feet stood firm , twelve stones , and ye shall carry them over with you , and leave them in the lodging place , where ye shall lodge this night .
kha: bad hukum ïa ki ban shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , na kata hi ka jaka ha kaba ki lyngdoh ki la ïeng . Ong ïa ki ban bah ïa kine ki maw bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba kin sah ha kata ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to hukum ia ki da kaba ong: To shim ia phi na pdeng ka Jordan, na ka jaka ba ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh ki ieng skhem, shiphew maw bad phin rah ia ki bad phi, bad phin iehnoh ia ki ha ka jaka sah, ha kaba phin sah mynta ka miet .

en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis , and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene ,
kha: Ka la long ka snem kaba khatsan jong ka jingsynshar u Patsha Tiberios ; u Pontios Pilat u la long u lyngskor jong ka Judia , U Herod u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Galilaïa , bad u Philip u para jong u , u la long u nongsynshar jong ka thain Ituria bad Trakhonitis ; u Lysanias u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Abilene ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingsynshar u Tiberio Kaisar, u Pontius u long u Lat jong ka ri Judaea, bad u Herod u long u nongsynshar jong ka ri Galilaia, bad u hynmen jong u u Philip u long u nongsynshar jong ka ri Ioria bad ka ri Trachoni , bad u Lysanias u long u nongsynshar jong ka ri Bilat .

en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him , Will ye plead for Baal ? will ye save him ? he that will plead for him , let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning : if he be a god , let him plead for himself , because one hath cast down his altar .
kha: Hynrei u Joash u ong ha kito baroh kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u ,  Hato phi ïeng na ka bynta u Baal ? Hato phi ïasaid da ïa u ? Uno uno uba ïasaid na ka bynta jong u un shah pynïap ha shuwa ka step . Lada u Baal u dei u blei , ieh un ïada hi ïa lade . Ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joash u la ong ha baroh kiba ieng pyrshah ia u, Hato phin kyrpad ia u Baal ? phin pynim ia u ? uta uba kyrpad ia u, to ai ba un shah pyniap katba u dang step: lada u long u blei, to ai ba un kyrpad ia lade, namar u la pynhap ia ka ainguh jong u .

en: Her former husband , which sent her away , may not take her again to be his wife , after that she is defiled  ; for that is abomination before the  Lord  : and thou shalt not cause the land to sin , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
kha: uta u tnga nyngkong um dei shuh ban ïapoi shongkurim bad ka , namar ba ka la shah pyntngit . Lada u leh kumta , kan long kaba ijli ha khmat U  Trai  , bad phim dei ban leh kum kata ka pop kaba sngewshyrkhei ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U tnga barim jong ka uba la phah noh ia ka, um lah ban shim biang ia ka ban long ka tnga jong u, hadien ba ka la shah pynjakhlia ; namar kata ka long kaba sngewsih ha khmat U Trai: bad me dei ban leh pop ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai pateng ia me .

en: And it came to pass , when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother s brother , and the sheep of Laban his mother s brother , that Jacob went near , and rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the flock of Laban his mother s brother .
kha: Haba u Jakob u ïohi ïa ka Rakhel bad ka kynhun langbrot u kñi jong u , u Laban , u leit sha ka pukri , u pyntyllun sharud ïa u maw , bad u la ai um ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la iakynduh ia ka khun jong u Laban bad ki langbrot jong u Laban u hynmen jong u, ba u Jakob u la leit shajan bad u la pynkhih ia u maw na ka thliew um bad u la ai um ia ka kynhun jong u Laban u hynmen jong u .

en: Now it came to pass , when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and Geshem the Arabian , and the rest of our enemies , heard that I had builded the wall , and that there was no breach left therein  ; ( though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates  ; )
kha: U Sanballat , u Tobiah , u Geshem bad kiba sah na ki nongshun jong ngi , ki la ïohsngew ba ngi la lah pyndep ïa ka jingtei ïa ka kynroh bad ba ym don shuh ki jinglait thliew ha ka , wat la ngim pat shym la pynïeng ki khyrdop ha ki jaka ban shna ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia, haba u Sanballat, bad u Tobiah, bad u Geshem u Arab, bad kiwei pat ki nongshun jong ngi, ki la iohsngew ba nga la tei ia ka kynroh bad ba ym shym la don ka jingpynkhein kaba sah ha ka ; (haduh kata ka por ngam shym la buh ia ki jingkhang ha ki khyrdop ; )

en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord  , and went down to Joppa  ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof , and went down into it , to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord .
kha: U Jonah pynban , u la leit sha ka jaka kaba marpyrshah khnang ban phet noh na U  Trai . U la leit sha Joppa , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa leit sha Spain . U la siew ïa ka bai lynti bad u la rung shapoh ryngkat bad ki nongtrei liengbah kiba leit sha Spain , ha kaba un long jngai na U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jonah u la ieng ban phet noh sha Tarshish na khmat U Trai, bad u la leit hiar sha Joppa ; bad u la shem ia ka lieng kaba leit sha Tarshish: kumta u la siew ia ka bai kali jong ka, bad u la leit hiar shapoh jong ka, ban leit bad ki sha Tarshish na khmat U Trai .

en: And when I was present with you , and wanted , I was chargeable to no man : for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied : and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you , and so will I keep myself .
kha: Bad ha ka por ba nga la don bad phi , ngam shym la pynkhuslai ïa phi ban ïarap haba nga la donkam pisa ; ki parabangeit kiba la wan na Makedonia ki la wanrah sha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la donkam . Kum ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta ruh ha ka lawei : Da lei lei ngan ym bankhia ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la don ryngkat bad phi, bad nga kwah, ngam shym la shah kynnoh iano iano ruh: namar kata kaba duna ha nga ki para kiba wan na Makedonia ki la pynbiang: bad ha kiei kiei baroh nga la iada ia lade na kaba long uba khia ia phi, bad kumta ngan sumar ia lade .

en: So the people went forth , and brought them , and made themselves booths , every one upon the roof of his house , and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate , and in the street of the gate of Ephraim .
kha: Kumta ki briew ki la ïoh ïa ki tnat bad shna ïa ki ïingtrep halor ki tnum ïing ba madan jong ki ïing jong ki , ha la ki jaka , ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , bad ha ki jaka paidbah basawdong hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad hajan ka Khyrdop Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew ki la leit shabar bad ki la wanrah ia ki, bad ki la shna ia ki ïingsah jong u, bad ha ki phyllaw jong ki, bad ha ki phyllaw jong ka iing U Blei bad ha ka lynti jong ka khyrdop um bad ha ka lynti jong ka khyrdop jong ka Ephram .

en: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year , which is the year of tithing , and hast given it unto the Levite , the stranger , the fatherless , and the widow , that they may eat within thy gates , and be filled  ;
kha: Shisien man ka lai snem , ai kawei-na-kaba-shiphew — kaba shiphew na ki jingthung jong phi — ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba ha man la ka shnong kin ïoh bam kdang . Haba phi la leh ïa kane ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me la pyndep ia ka shiphew jong me baroh, kaba long ka snem kaba lai, bad me la ai ia ka ha u Lebi, u nongwei, u khlem kpa bad u riewkynthei, ba kin bam hapoh ki khyrdop jong me, bad kin dap;

en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord  : but , lo , I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour s hand , and into the hand of his king : and they shall smite the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them .
kha: ( U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan ym isynei shuh ïano ïano ha ka pyrthei . Ma nga da lade ngan buh ïa ki briew baroh hapoh ka bor jong ki nongsynshar jong ki . Kine ki nongsynshar kin pynjot ïa ka pyrthei , bad ngan ym pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong ki .  )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan ym sngewsynei shuh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri: hynrei, ha khmih, ngan aiti ia ki briew ha ka kti jong u paramarjan jong u: bad kin sa pynkhih ia ka ri, bad na ka kti jong ki ngan ym pyllait ia ki .

en: And David s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people . And David said unto the  Lord  , I have sinned greatly in that I have done : and now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  , take away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
kha: Hynrei hadien ba u Dabid u la dep shim ïa ka jingkheiñbriew , ka jingïatiplem jong u ka la sdang ban pynshitom ïa u , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei ha kaba leh ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la leh bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngewsih ia u hadien ba u la khein ia ki briew . Bad u Dabid u la ong ha U Trai: bad mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, ko Trai, to weng noh ia ka jingbymhok jong u shakri jong me; namar nga la leh bieit shibun .

en: And I will turn thee back , and put hooks into thy jaws , and I will bring thee forth , and all thine army , horses and horsemen , all of them clothed with all sorts of armour , even a great company with bucklers and shields , all of them handling swords :
kha: Ngan pynphai sawdong ïa u , ngan buh ki khwai ha ki tyngam jong u bad ngan patan noh ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh . Ka kynhun shipai jong u ka long kaba khraw , lem bad ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai kiba riam ryntih , bad man la u shipai uba rah ka stieh bad kieng ka waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynphai biang ia me, bad ngan buh ia me ha ki bniat jong me, bad ngan wanrah ia me, bad ki shipai jong me baroh, ki kulai bad ki kulai shong kulai, baroh ki la phong da ki jainkup kiba bun jait, wat ka kynhun kaba khraw bad ki shipai kiba bat ia ki waitlam:

en: And she said unto him , My father , if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the  Lord  , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth  ; forasmuch as the  Lord  hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies , even of the children of Ammon .
kha: Ka ong ha u ,  Lada phi la kular ha U  Trai  , leh ïa nga kumba phi la kular ban leh , naba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ba phin pynhiarkput ïa ki Ammon , ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u: Ko kpa jong nga, lada me la plie ia ka shyntur jong me ha U Trai, to leh ia nga katba kata ka la mih na ka shyntur jong me; kumba U Trai u la shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang na ka bynta jong me na ki nongshun jong me, wat na ki khun jong u Ammon .

en: And he saith unto them ,  Ye shall drink indeed of my cup , and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with : but to sit on my right hand , and on my left , is not mine to give , but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father .
kha: Phin sa dih shisha na ka khuri jong nga ,  U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ,  hynrei ngam don ka hok ban jied ïa uno u ban shong sha liang kamon jong nga bad sha liang kadiang jong nga . Kine ki jaka ki long na ka bynta kito ïa kiba U Kpa jong nga u la pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Phin dih shisha na ka khuri jong nga, bad shah pynbaptis da ka jingpynbaptis kaba nga shah pynbaptis: hynrei ban shong ha ka liang kadiang jong nga bad ha ka liang kadiang jong nga, kam dei ka jong nga ban ai, hynrei yn ai ha ki na ka bynta jong nga .

en: And he fenced it , and gathered out the stones thereof , and planted it with the choicest vine , and built a tower in the midst of it , and also made a winepress therein : and he looked that it should bring forth grapes , and it brought forth wild grapes .
kha: U la tih ïa ka khyndew bad u la weng ïa ki maw na ka ; u la thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba kynsai . U la tei ka jaka ap phira ban khmih sumar ïa ki , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ban ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ . U la ap ïa ki sohwaiñ ban ih , hynrei uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ u long uba jew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ker ia ka, bad u la lum ia ki maw jong ka, bad u la thung ia ka da u sohjew uba bha tam, bad u la tei ia ka tower hapdeng jong ka: bad u la peit ba kan pynmih ia ki sohjew khlaw .

en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David , the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob , and the Syrians of Zobah , twenty thousand footmen , and of king Maacah a thousand men , and of Ish–tob twelve thousand men .
kha: Ki Ammon ki la sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong nongshun ïa u Dabid , kumta ki la phah wai arphew hajar ngut ki shipai Syria na Bethrehob bad na Sobah , khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah na Tob , bad ïa u syiem Maakah lem bad shihajar ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki khun shynrang ki la iohi ba ki la ia tyngkhuh ha khmat u Dabid, ki khun shynrang ki la phah bad ki la thung ia ki nong Syria jong ka Bethrehob bad ki nong Syria jong ka Sobah, arphew hajar ngut ki nongtrei kjat bad u syiem Maah u la ioh shi hajar ngut ki briew bad u Ishii u la phah ia ki shiphew hajar ngut ki nong Syria .

en: And Abner said unto David , I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king , that they may make a league with thee , and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth . And David sent Abner away  ; and he went in peace .
kha: U Abner u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ngan leit noh mynta , bad ngan pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha phi ko Syiem Bakhraw . Kin pdiang ïa phi kum u syiem , bad nangta phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi la kwah bad phin synshar halor ka ri baroh kawei .  U Dabid u ai ka jingkular jingshngain ïa u Abner bad u phah noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner u la ong ha u Dabid , Ngan ieng bad leit noh bad ngan lum lang ia ki Israel baroh ha u kynrad jong nga u syiem, ba kin leh ia ka jingiateh bad me, bad ba me lah ban synshar halor kiei kiei baroh kiba ka dohnud jong me ka kwah . U Dabid u la phah noh ia u Abner; bad u la leit noh da ka jingsuk .

en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u lat uba don ha ka kam ha shuwa jong nga , u la long ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad ki ju dawa sawphew ki pisa rupa shi sngi na ka bynta ka jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki shakri jong ki , ki ju banbeiñ ïa ki briew . Hynrei ngam shym leh kumta , namar nga burom ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Lat barim kiba la don ha khmat jong nga ki la shim na ki briew bad ka wain, nalor sawphew Shekel rupa ; yea, wat ki shakri jong ki ruh ki la synshar ia ki briew: hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta, namar ka jingtieng ia U Blei .

en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha u mawsiang bah ha Gibeon , u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Joab u la phong ka jaiñ ïaleh thma , bad ka waitlam hapoh ka jingsop jong ka ïa kaba la teh pynskhem ha u panpoh jong u . Katba u wan sha khmat ka waitlam ka la hap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la don ha u maw uba heh uba don ha Gibeon , u Amasa u la leit sha khmat jong ki . Bad ka jain Joab kaba u la phong ka la tyrkhong ha u , bad halor jong ka ka la tyrkhong da ka waitlam kaba la pyndait ha ki tyrpeng jong u ha ka tyrpeng jong u; bad katba u dang iaid shabar ka la hap noh .

en: And they took the bullock which was given them , and they dressed it , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon , saying , O Baal , hear us . But there was no voice , nor any that answered . And they leaped upon the altar which was made .
kha: Ki la shim ïa u masi dab ba la wanrah sha ki , ki la pynkhreh ïa u , bad ki la duwai ha u Baal haduh shiteng sngi . Ki la pyrta jam ,  Jubab ïa ngi , ko Baal !  bad ki la shad sawdong ïa ka duwan kaba ki la shna . Hynrei kim shym ïoh jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia uta u masi uba la ai ha ki, bad ki la phong ia ka, bad ki la pyrta ia ka kyrteng u Baal naduh mynstep haduh shiteng sngi, ki da ong: Ko Baal, to iohsngew ia ngi . Hynrei ym shym la don sur , ne uno uno uba jubab . Bad ki la iaid halor ka almari kaba la shna .

en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread , and shall say , Put me , I pray thee , into one of the priests  offices , that I may eat a piece of bread .
kha: Kat uba dang sah na ki khun ki ksiew jong me un leit ha uta u lyngdoh bad pan na u ïa ka pisa bad ka jingbam , bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ba un ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh khnang ba un ïoh ei ei ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan jia ba uwei pa uwei uba sah ha iing jong me un wan bad un ia tyngkhuh bad u na ka bynta ka rupa bad ka jingbam ba la shet bad un ong: To buh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, ha kawei na ki kam lyngdoh, ba ngan bam ia u kpu .

en: And when he shall stand up , his kingdom shall be broken , and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven  ; and not to his posterity , nor according to his dominion which he ruled : for his kingdom shall be plucked up , even for others beside those .
kha: Hynrei haba u la khlaiñbor bha , ka hima jong u kan pait bad yn phiah ha ki saw bynta . Ki syiem ki bym shym hiarpateng na u kin synshar ha ka jaka jong u , hynrei kin ym don ïa ka bor kaba u la don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda un ieng , ka hima jong u kan sa bthei sha ki saw tylli ki Iyer bneng ; bad ym ha ka pateng jong u: namar ka hima jong u kan sa shah rong noh: wat na ka bynta kiwei pat kiba don hajan jong u .

en: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year , in the first month , the first day of the month , the waters were dried up from off the earth : and Noah removed the covering of the ark , and looked , and , behold , the face of the ground was dry .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong mynba u Noah u la dap hynriewspah wei snem , ka um ka la rngad noh na ka khyndew . U Noah u lied noh ïa ka jingtap jong kata ka lieng , u khmih sawdong , bad u ïohi ba ka khyndew ka la nang rkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynriew spah bad kaba nyngkong, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong, ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, ki um ki la tyrkhong na ka khyndew: bad u Noah u la weng noh ia ka jingtap jong ka lieng, bad u la peit, bad ha khmih ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof , when I shall bring again their captivity  ; The  Lord  bless thee , O habitation of justice , and mountain of holiness .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Haba ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew sha ka ri jong ki , sa shisien pat kin ong ha ka ri Judah bad ki shnong jong ka ,   ‘ To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa u lum bakyntang jong ka Jerusalem , ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba u shong .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel; Haduh mynta kin pyndonkam ia kane ka ktien ha ka ri Judah bad ha ki shnong jong ka, haba ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki ; U Trai un kyrkhu ia me, ko jaka shong jong ka hok, bad u lum jong ka jingkhuid .

en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs , even glory to the righteous . But I said , My leanness , my leanness , woe unto me ! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously  ; yea , the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously .
kha: Na ki bynta bajngai tam ka pyrthei ngin ïohsngew ïa ki jingrwai jingïaroh ïa ki Israel , ka jaitbynriew bahok . Hynrei ym don jingkyrmen na ka bynta jong nga ! Nga shu duh lehnoh-ei ! Ki nongshetkylla ki ïai shetkylla , bad ka kam shyrkhei jong ki ka nang sniew nang sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaba kut tam jong ka khyndew ngi la iohsngew ia ki jingrwai, wat ia ka burom ia kiba hok . Hynrei nga la ong, Ka jinglong rit paid jong nga ! ki nongkhaii kiba thok ki la leh thok;

en: Arise and thresh , O daughter of Zion : for I will make thine horn iron , and I will make thy hoofs brass : and thou shalt beat in pieces many people : and I will consecrate their gain unto the  Lord  , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to leit bad pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong phi ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ kum u masi kyrtong uba don ki reng nar bad ki kjat rnong . Phin pynlwet ïa ki jaitbynriew ba bun , bad ïa ka spah kaba ki la ïoh da ka jingleh jubor phin ai sngewbha ïa nga , U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie bad thymmai, ko khun jong ka Seion: namar ngan pynlong ia ka nar jong me, bad ngan pynlong ia ki tyrpeng jong me: bad me phin pynkhih ia kiba bun ki briew: bad ngan pynkyntang ia ka jingmyntoi jong ki ha U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel , and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation  ; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
kha: Lum ïa kane ka jingainguh na ki Israel , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kane ka khajna ka long ka jingsiew na ka bynta la ka jingim , bad ngan kynmaw ban da ban ker ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ka pisa ba la pynkhuid na ki khun Israel bad men buh ia ka na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka iingjain paidbah; ba kan long ka jingkynmaw ia ki khun Israel ha khmat U Trai , ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ki mynsiem jong phi .

en: At the same time my reason returned unto me  ; and for the glory of my kingdom , mine honour and brightness returned unto me  ; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me  ; and I was established in my kingdom , and excellent majesty was added unto me .
kha: Haba ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai , ïa ka burom jong nga , ka jinglong syiem jong nga , bad ka burom jong ka hima jong nga la ai pat ha nga . Ki rangbah synshar jong nga bad ki rangbah donburom jong nga ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , bad la ai pat ha nga ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem , bad wat ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka jingmut jong nga ka la wan phai sha nga ; bad na ka bynta ka burom jong ka hima jong nga, ka burom bad ka jingshai jong nga ka la wan phai biang sha nga ; bad ki nongai jingmut jong nga bad ki kynrad jong nga ki la wad ia nga ; bad nga la pynskhem ha ka hima jong nga, bad ka jingkhraw kaba bha ka la pyndap ha nga .

en: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , they , and their princes , the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem : and this city shall remain for ever .
kha: Nangta ki syiem bad ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki kin rung ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad kin don kajuh ka bor ba kynja syiem kaba u Dabid u la don . Ryngkat lem bad ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , kin shong ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai , bad ka nongbah Jerusalem kan ïai dap borabor da ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin rung ha ki khyrdop jong kane ka shnong ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar kiba shong ha ka khet u Dabid, ki shong ha ki kali bad ha ki kulai , ma ki bad ki nongsynshar jong ki, ki shynrang Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem: bad kane ka shnong kan sah junom .

en: And he said unto him , Say now unto her , Behold , thou hast been careful for us with all this care  ; what is to be done for thee ? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king , or to the captain of the host ? And she answered , I dwell among mine own people .
kha: u ong ha u Gehasi ,  Kylli ïa ka kaei kaba nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ban siew kylliang na ka bynta ki jinglehshitom baroh ha kaba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . Lehse kan kwah ba ngan leit sha u syiem lane sha u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai bad ban pynïakren na ka bynta jong ka .   Nga don hangne baroh kaba nga donkam hapdeng ki briew jong nga ,  ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, To ong mynta ha ka, Ha khmih, me la sumar ia ngi bad kane ka jingsumar baroh? hato phi la shah kren ha u syiem ne ha u rangbah shipai ? Bad ka la jubab , nga shong hapdeng ki briew jong nga hi .

en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father , and kept all his precepts , and done according unto all that he hath commanded you :
kha: Te nga la ong ïa ka kur Rekhab ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Phi la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong phi u Jonadab u la ai ha phi ; phi la bud ïa baroh ki jingbthah jong u , bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeremaiah u la ong ha ka iing ki nongrep: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid Israel ; Namar phi la kohnguh ia ka hukum jong u Jehonadab u kpa jong phi, bad phi la sumar ia ki jingbthah jong u baroh, bad phi la leh katba u la hukum ia phi:

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel , whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people , and officers over them  ; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation , that they may stand there with thee .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah badonburom ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongïalam jong u paidbah , wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin ïeng hangta hajan jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To wanrah ha nga hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah Israel kiba me tip ba ki long ki rangbah jong ki briew bad ki ophisar halor jong ki ; bad wanrah ia ki sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , ba kin ieng hangta bad me .

en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , The prophets prophesy lies in my name : I sent them not , neither have I commanded them , neither spake unto them : they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination , and a thing of nought , and the deceit of their heart .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuh ïa ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; ngam shym phah ïa ki , lymne ngam shym la ai kino kino ki hukum lane kren shikyntien ha ki . Ki jingïohipaw kiba ki ïakren kim shym wan na nga ; ki jingïathuh lypa ki long kiei kiei ki bymdondor kiba ki la mutdur .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha nga: Ki nongiathuhlypa kim shym la phah ia ki, lymne ngam shym la hukum ia ki, lymne ngam shym la kren ia ki: ki iathuhlypa ha phi ia ka jingphohsniew kaba bakla bad ka jingpynpaw pyrthei kaba bakla, bad ka jingleh thok jong ka dohnud jong ki .
