en: But fear not thou , O my servant Jacob , and be not dismayed , O Israel : for , behold , I will save thee from afar off , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and be in rest and at ease , and none shall make him afraid .
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng , ko ki paid Israel , wat ym kyiuh . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri kaba jngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat sha ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin sngewshngain , bad yn ym don u ban pyntieng ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat tieng ia me, ko shakri jong nga u Jakob, bad wat sngewsih, ko Israel: namar, ha khmih, ngan pynim ia me na jngai, bad u symbai jong me na ka ri jong ki.

en: For , behold , the day cometh , that shall burn as an oven  ; and all the proud , yea , and all that do wickedly , shall be stubble : and the day that cometh shall burn them up , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that it shall leave them neither root nor branch .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ka sngi ka la nang wan ha kaba ïa kiba sarong baroh bad ïa ki briew kiba sniew yn thang kum u phlangïap . Ha kata ka sngi kin shah thang lut , bad yn ym don kaba sah na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ka sngi ka wan, kata kan thang kum ka oven bad ki briew kiba sngew sarong baroh, em, bad baroh kiba leh sniew, kin long kiba sniew: bad ka sngi kaba wan kan thang ia ki, ong U Trai jong ki paid, ba kan ym iehnoh ia ki tynrai ne tnat .

en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers  ; even the chief of the fathers , as they were counted by number of names by their polls , that did the work for the service of the house of the  Lord  , from the age of twenty years and upward .
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lebi , kat kum ki kur bad ki longïing , bad ïa uwei pa uwei na ki la buh jingthoh da ka kyrteng . Uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew , uba arphew snem ka rta ne tam , u ïoh ka bynta ha ka kam ha ka Templ jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi hadien ka iing jong ki kpa jong ki; kumba la khein ia ki da ki kyrteng jong ki da ki poll jong ki, kiba la leh ia ka kam na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Trai, naduh ka rta kaba arphew snem shaneng .

en: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters , and that spreadeth out her roots by the river , and shall not see when heat cometh , but her leaf shall be green  ; and shall not be careful in the year of drought , neither shall cease from yielding fruit .
kha: U long kum u dieng uba mih hajan ka wahduid bad uba ki thied ki ksam sha ka um . Um sheptieng haba ka jingshit ka suiñbneng ka wan , namar ki sla jong u ki sah jyrngam ; um don jingkhuslai haba ym don slap ; u ïai pynmih soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un long kum u dieng ba la thung da ki um, bad uta u pynphriang ia ki tynrai jong ka harud wah , bad un ym iohi haba ka jingshit ka wan , hynrei ka sla jong ka kan long kaba jyrngam ; bad kan ym sumar ha ka snem jong ka jingkhriat , lymne kan ym sangeh ban ai soh .

en: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit , and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes : even so , Father  ; for so it seemed good in thy sight .
kha: Ha kata ka por la pyndap ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad u la ong ,  Ko Kpa , U Trai jong ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymnang bymstad ïa kaei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba shemphang . Ho-oid , ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka kynta U Jisu u la kmen ha ka mynsiem, bad u la ong, ko Kpa, ko Trai jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew, ba me la buhrieh ia kine kiei kiei na kiba stad bad kiba stad, bad me la pynpaw ia ki ha ki babes: wat la katta ruh, ko Kpa, namar kumta ka la long kaba bha ha khmat jong me .

en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring , like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab , and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father s house , which were better than thyself :
kha: Pynban me la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem ka Israel bad me la ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem sha ka jinglong bymïaineh shuh ha U Blei , kumba u Ahab bad ki nongmih bujli jong u ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel sha ka jingbymïaineh . Me la pynïap wat ïa la ki para shynrang , kiba long ki rangbah kiba kham bha ban ïa kaba me long .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la iaid ha ka lynti jong ki syiem Israel, bad me la pynlong ia u Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ban leit kai, kum ki nongkhaii met jong u Ahab, bad me la pyniap ruh ia ki hynmen jong me na ka iing u kpa jong me, kiba kham bha ban ia me:

en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you , that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel , to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them ?
kha: Phi tharai ba ka long kaei kaei kaba rit ba U Blei ki Israel u la pynkyrpang ïa phi na ka kynhun , ba phi lah ban leit sha u , ban leh ïa ka kamram jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  , bad ban ai jingshakri ïa ka kynhun bad ban shakri ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long tang kaei kaei kaba rit ha phi, ba U Blei jong ki Israel u la pyniakhlad ia phi na ka jingiaseng Israel , ban wanrah ia phi hajan jong u ban leh ia ka jingshakri jong ka iingjain U Trai , bad ban ieng ha khmat ka jingiaseng ban shakri ia ki ?

en: And it came to pass , when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister s hands , and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister , saying , Thus spake the man unto me  ; that he came unto the man  ; and , behold , he stood by the camels at the well .
kha: U Laban u la ïohi ïa ka sati khmut bad ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka para jong u , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka ba ka ïathuh ïa kaei kaba uta u briew u la ong ha ka . U leit sha u shakri jong u Abraham , uba ïeng hajan ki ut jong u harud kata ka pukri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u la iohi ia ki shkor bad ki shyieng ha ki kti jong ka para jong u, bad haba u la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka Rebekah ka para jong u, da kaba ong: Kumta u la kren ia uta u briew ha nga; bad, ha khmih, u la ieng hajan ki kulai ha ka thliew .

en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel , because he was sick .
kha: U la leit phai pat sha ka nongbah Jesreel ban ïohkhiah na ki jingmong jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jngoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan phai biang ha Jesel namar ki jingmynsaw kiba la ai ha u ha Rama, haba u la ialeh bad u Hazael syiem Syria . U Asariah u khun u Jehoram u syiem Judah u la leit hiar ban peit ia u Jehoram u khun u Ahab ha Jesel , namar u la pang .

en: Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for , and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .
kha: U Jeraïah u dei u nongïalam jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron . Ha ka snem kaba sawphew ba u Dabid u la long syiem , la don ka jingtohkit shaphang ka pateng longïing jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , bad la shem ba ki shipai bapawkhmat kiba na kane ka longïing la lap ba ki shong ki sah ha Jaser ha ka ri Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng ki Hebron u Jeriah u rangbah, wat hapdeng ki Hebron, kat kum ki pateng jong u . Ha ka snem kaba sawphew jong ka jingsynshar u Dabid la wad ia ki , bad la lap hapdeng jong ki ia ki briew kiba khlain bor ha Jaser Gilead .

en: Therefore the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the Lord , saith thus  ; Wailing shall be in all streets  ; and they shall say in all the highways , Alas ! alas ! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning , and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing .
kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , u ong ,  Kan don ka jinglynñiar bad ki jingïam sngewsih ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Wat ïa ki nongrep yn khot ban ïam na ka bynta kiba ïap lem bad kito ïa kiba lah da siew ban ïambriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai , U Blei jong ki paid, U Trai , u ong kumta; Ka Jingkyrpad kan long ha ki surok baroh; bad kin ong ha ki surok bah baroh: Alas ! bad kin khot ia u nongrep ban iam , bad kiba tbit ban iam .

en: From Sihor , which is before Egypt , even unto the borders of Ekron northward , which is counted to the Canaanite : five lords of the Philistines  ; the Gazites , and the Ashdothites , the Eshkalonites , the Gittites , and the Ekronites  ; also the Avites :
kha: kumjuh ruh ka ri jong ka Abbim ha ka phang bashathie ( ka jaka naduh ka wahduid Shihor ha ki khappud jong ka Ijipt haduh khappud Ekron ha ka phang bashatei , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka dei ka jong ki Kanaan ; ki syiem Philistia ki la shong ha Gasa , Ashdod , Ashkelon , Gath , bad Ekron ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Sihor kaba don ha khmat ka ri Ijipt, haduh ki pud jong ka Ekron shaphang shathie, kaba la khein ha ki nong Kana: san ngut ki kynrad jong ki Philistia; ki Gazite bad ki Ashdodite, ki Eshkalonite, ki EGronite bad ki Ekronite ruh:

en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Go unto the altar , and offer thy sin offering , and thy burnt offering , and make an atonement for thyself , and for the people : and offer the offering of the people , and make an atonement for them  ; as the  Lord  commanded .
kha: Nangta u ong ha u Aaron ,  Khie leit sha ka duwan bad kñia ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa ka jingainguh thang ba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong phi bad ïa ki pop jong ki paidbah . Leh ïa kane ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop jong ki paidbah , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron, To leit sha ka jingknia pop jong me bad ka jingainguh thang jong me, bad to leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ki briew: bad to ai ia ka jingainguh jong ki briew, bad to leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki; kumba U Trai u la hukum .

en: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah , even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite , they and their men .
kha: Kumta u Ishmael u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah , u Seraïah u khun jong u Tanhumeth , ki khun shynrang jong u Ephai na Netophah , bad u Jesanaïah na Maakah ki la leit bad la ki rangbah sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la poi ha u Gedaliah ha Mizpah, u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah, bad u Johanan bad u Jonathan ki khun shynrang jong u Karaniah bad u Seraiah u khun shynrang jong u Tanhmet bad ki khun shynrang jong u Ephaiah u Nethaniah bad u Jezaniah u khun shynrang jong ki .

en: Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai jong ka jingshah jingit , ka Esther ka phong ïa ki jingriam syiem jong ka bad ka leit bad ïeng ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka ïingsyiem , kaba phai khmat sha ka kamra ba don ka khet syiem . U syiem u don hapoh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kaba phai khmat sha ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba lai, ba ka Esther ka la phong ia ka jain syiem jong ka, bad ka la ieng ha ka phyllaw ba shapoh jong ka iing syiem: bad u syiem u la shong ha ka khet syiem jong u ha ka iing syiem .

en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .
kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim shym shahshkor ïa la ki nongïalam . Ki Israel kim shym la ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki kpa jong ki , ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  , hynrei kane ka pateng bathymmai shen ka la sangeh ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la katta ruh kim shym la sngap ia ki nongbishar jong ki, hynrei ki la leit shongkurim hadien kiwei pat ki blei, bad ki la dem khrup ha ki: ki la phai noh kloi na ka lynti kaba ki kpa jong ki ki la iaid shapoh, ki kohnguh ia ki hukum U Trai; hynrei kim shym la leh kumta .

en: I considered the horns , and , behold , there came up among them another little horn , before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots : and , behold , in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man , and a mouth speaking great things .
kha: Katba nga dang khmih ïa ki reng , nga la ïohi ïa ka reng kaba rit , kaba mih napdeng kiwei pat . Ka la tar ïa ki lai tylli ki reng kiba la don lypa hangta . Kane ka reng ka la don ki khmat briew bad ka shyntur kaba kob sarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pyrkhat ia ki bniat, bad, ha khmih, ka la wan shaneng hapdeng jong ki sa kawei pat ka bniat kaba rit, ha khmat jong ki la don lai tylli ki bniat kiba nyngkong kiba la tyrkhong da ki tynrai: bad, ha kane ka bniat ki la don ki khmat kum ki khmat u briew, bad ka shyntur kaba kren ia kiei kiei kiba khraw .

en: And Saul said unto the Kenites , Go , depart , get you down from among the Amalekites , lest I destroy you with them : for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel , when they came up out of Egypt . So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites .
kha: U la phah ka jingmaham sha ki Ken , ki briew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la lehsbun ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt :  Khie leit bad iehnoh ïa ki Amalek , ba kumta ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lem bad ki .  Kumta ki Ken ki mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha ki Kenite, To leit noh, to hiar noh na ki Amalek, ioh ngan pynjot ia phi bad ki: namar phi la pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia ki khun Israel baroh, haba ki la mih na Ijipt . Kumta ki Kenite ki la leit noh na ki Amalekite .

en: Because ye have burned incense , and because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , nor walked in his law , nor in his statutes , nor in his testimonies  ; therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .
kha: Kane ka jingjot mynta ka la wan ha phi namar ba phi ai jingkñia sha kiwei ki blei bad leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba phi la thang ia ka jingiwbih bad namar ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai bad phim shym la kohnguh ia ka ktien U Trai , lymne ha ki ain jong u , lymne ha ki jingphla jong u; namar kata ka jingsniew ka la jia ha phi, kumba ha kane ka sngi .

en: And Hilkiah , and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath , the son of Hasrah , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college : ) and they spake to her to that effect .
kha: Kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem , u Hilkaïah bad kiwei ki leit ïasyllok bad ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa kaba sah ha ki bynta ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u khun ksiew jong u Harhas , ki long kiba sumar ïa ki jaiñkup ha ka Templ . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Hilkiah bad ki kiba u syiem u la thung, ki la leit sha ka jingiathuhlypa, ka tnga jong u Shallum u khun u Hasrah, u nongsumar ia ka jainkup thok .

en: For it is the life of all flesh  ; the blood of it is for the life thereof : therefore I said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh : for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof : whosoever eateth it shall be cut off .
kha: Ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw uba im ka don ha ka snam , bad dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , bad ba ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long ka jingim jong ka doh baroh: ka snam jong ka ka long na ka bynta ka jingim jong ka: namarkata nga la ong ha ki khun Israel: Phin bam ia ka snam jong ka doh baroh: namar ka jingim jong ka doh baroh ka long ka snam jong ka: uno uno uba bam ia ka un shah ot noh .

en: They say , If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man s , shall he return unto her again ? shall not that land be greatly polluted ? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers  ; yet return again to me , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , bad ka iehnoh ïa u bad ka long noh ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , um dei ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane kan pyntngit lut ïa ka ri . Hynrei , ko Israel , pha la lah don shibun ki nongleh-ieit , bad mynta pha kwah ban wan phai sha nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong , Lada u briew u la weng noh ia la ka tnga bad ka leit noh na u bad u la kylla long uwei pat u briew u sngewbha ban wan phai biang sha ka ? hato kata ka ri kan ym long kaba la pynjakhlia shibun ? hynrei me la ialehkai bad ki nongieit kiba bun; hynrei to wan phai biang sha nga, ong U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , when the judge was dead , that they returned , and corrupted themselves more than their fathers , in following other gods to serve them , and to bow down unto them  ; they ceased not from their own doings , nor from their stubborn way .
kha: Hynrei haba u nongïalam u ïap , ki briew ki phai biang sha la ki rukom barim bad ki im kham sniew ban ïa ka pateng ba ha shuwa . Ki shakri bad mane ïa kiwei ki blei , bad da ka jingtamsneng ki ïai leh ïa la ki rukom bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u nongbishar u la iap, ba ki la wan phai, bad ki la pynsniew ia lade kham palat ia ki kpa jong ki, ha kaba bud ia kiwei pat ki blei ban shakri ia ki, bad ban dem khrup ha ki; kim shym la sangeh na la ki jong ki kam, ne na ka lynti kaba sting jong ki .

en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah , which they have done to provoke me to anger , they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets , and the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
kha: Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka namar baroh kaba sniew ba la leh da ki paid ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki syiem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingsniew baroh jong ki khun Israel bad ki khun Judah kiba ki la leh ban pynbitar ia nga , ma ki, ki syiem jong ki, ki rangbah jong ki, bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong ki bad ki briew jong ka Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem .

en: For I heard the defaming of many , fear on every side . Report , say they , and we will report it . All my familiars watched for my halting , saying , Peradventure he will be enticed , and we shall prevail against him , and we shall take our revenge on him .
kha: Nga ïohsngew uwei uwei baroh u ïa-pasiaw ,  Ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha kylleng ! Ïa ngin ïamudui ïa u sha ki bor pynïaid !  Wat ki paralok kiba ïajan eh ki ap khmih ïa ka jingkyllon jong nga .  Lehse lah ban pynthame ïa u ,  ki ong ;  te ngi lah ban kem ïa u bad ïoh pynhiarkput .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la iohsngew ia ka jingshah pynjah burom jong kiba bun, ka jingtieng ha man la ki liang . Ka khubor, ki ong, bad ngin sa iathuh ia ka . Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong nga ki la peit ia ka jingsangeh jong nga, ki da ong , La pynlong ia u ban shah pynngop , bad ngin sa jop ia u , bad ngin sa shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang jong ngi ha u .

en: And the fourth angel sounded , and the third part of the sun was smitten , and the third part of the moon , and the third part of the stars  ; so as the third part of them was darkened , and the day shone not for a third part of it , and the night likewise .
kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la put ïa la ka turoi . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi la shoh , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bnai , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki khlur , ba ka jingshai jong ki ka la jah noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka jingtyngshaiñ ; ym shym la don jingshai ha ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi bad ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba saw u la sawa , bad ka bynta kaba lai jong u bnai ka la shah rong noh , bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ki khlur; kumta ka bynta kaba lai jong ki ka la dum, bad ka sngi kam shym la shai na ka bynta ka bynta kaba lai jong ka, bad ka miet kumjuh .

en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim , and the horse from Jerusalem , and the battle bow shall be cut off : and he shall speak peace unto the heathen : and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea , and from the river even to the ends of the earth .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan weng noh ïa ki kali thma na Israel bad shim ïa ki kulai na Jerusalem ; ïa ki ryntieh ba la pyndonkam ha ka thma yn pynjot . U syiem jong phi un pynlong jingïasuk hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ; un synshar na ka duriaw sha ka duriaw , na ka wah Ïuphratis sha kiba kut jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ot noh ia ka kali na Ephraim, bad ia u kulai na Jerusalem, bad ia ka bow thma yn ot noh: bad un kren ia ka jingsuk ha ki jaitbynriew: bad ka jingsynshar jong u kan long naduh duriaw haduh duriaw, bad naduh ka wah haduh ki kut jong ka khyndew .

en: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a solemn assembly  ; and ye shall do no servile work therein .
kha: Man la ka sngi ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , phin kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam . Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang biang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam . Kata ka long ka sngi mane Blei ; phim dei ban trei ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi phin ai ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai: ha ka sngi kaba phra phin ai ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai: ka long ka jingiaseng kaba pura; bad phin ym leh ei ei ha ka .

en: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years . And the prophet Jeremiah went his way .
kha: bad u la ong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki briew baroh :  U  Trai  u la ong ba kane ka dei kumno ba un pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la buh halor ka ryndang jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad un leh ïa kane hapoh ar snem .  Nangta nga la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hananiah u la kren ha khmat ki briew baroh, u da ong: Kumta u Trai Wat la katta ruh ngan pynpra ia ka jingkit jong u syiem Babilon na ka ryndang jong ki jaitbynriew baroh hapoh ar snem ba pura . Bad u nongiathuhlypa Jeremaiah u la leit noh .

en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him , because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him  ; ( for Hadarezer had war with Tou  ; ) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .
kha: Kumta u phah ïa u Joram u khun jong u ban leit khublei bad ai burom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh thma bunsien . U Joram u wallam ki jingai sngewbha ba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa bad ka rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia u khun jong u sha u syiem Dabid, ban kylli ia ka jingbha jong u, bad ban ai khublei ia u, namar u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Hadareer, bad u la shoh ia u ; (na u Hadareer u la ialeh thma bad u Tou ; ) bad bad bad u baroh ki jait khiew ksiar bad rupa bad rupa .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , When thou wast young , thou girdedst thyself , and walkedst whither thou wouldest : but when thou shalt be old , thou shalt stretch forth thy hands , and another shall gird thee , and carry thee whither thou wouldest not .
kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Haba me dang samla , me ju long uba la pynkhreh bad me leit kat shaba me mon ; hynrei haba me la tymmen , men kner la ki jong ki kti bad uwei pat un teh un khum ïa me bad un ïalam ïa me sha kaba mem kwah ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha me, haba me dang samla, me la pynkhih ia lade bad me la iaid katba me mon: hynrei ynda me la tymmen, men pynkhih ia ki kti jong me, bad uwei pat un bat ia me, bad un kit ia me katba me ym mon .

en: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters  ; and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre , to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa , according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .
kha: Ki briew ki ai pisa ban siew ïa ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng bad ïa ka jingbam jingdih bad ka umphniang Olib ban phah sha ki nongbah jong ka Tyros bad Sidon kum ka jingïabujli na ka bynta ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon , ban wallam lyngba ka duriaw sha Joppa . Ïa kane baroh la leh da ka jingai jingbit u Syros , u patsha ka Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai pisa ruh ia ki nongshna nar, bad ia ki nongshna nar, bad ka umphniang, bad ka umphniang, ha ki jong u Sidon bad ha ki jong u Tyros, ban wanrah ia ki dieng cedar na Lebanon sha ka duriaw Joppa, kat kum ka jingai sngewbha kaba ki don na u Cyrus u syiem ka Persia .

en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , in the ninth month , that they proclaimed a fast before the  Lord  to all the people in Jerusalem , and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem .
kha: Ha u bnai bakhyndai jong ka snem kaba san ba u Jehoïakim u la long u syiem ka Judah , ki briew ki la shahjingit ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha U  Trai . Ïa ka jingshahjingit la leh da baroh kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem bad da baroh kito kiba la wan hangta na ki shnong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra jong u Jehosiah u khun jong u Josiah u syiem Judah, ha ka taiew kaba hynniew, ba ki la pynbna ia ka jingleh niam ha khmat U Trai ha ki briew baroh ha Jerusalem bad ha ki briew baroh kiba wan na ki shnong Judah sha Jerusalem .

en: For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .
kha: Naba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki ,  Phi long u paidlang uba mutlop . Lada ngan leit ryngkat bad phi wat tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa phi . Law noh mynta ïa kito ki jingdeng jong phi , bad ngan sa rai ngan leh kumno ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: To ong ha ki khun Israel: Phi long ki briew kiba la tyrkhong: Ngan wan shapoh hapdeng jong me ha ka khyllipmat: namarkata mynta nga weng noh ia ki jingpynitynnad jong me na me, ba ngan tip aiu ia me .

en: And I will bring the third part through the fire , and will refine them as silver is refined , and will try them as gold is tried : they shall call on my name , and I will hear them : I will say , It is my people : and they shall say , The  Lord  is my God .
kha: Bad ngan tynjuh ïa ka bynta kaba lai kaba dang lait im bad ngan pynkhuid ïa ki kumba phrang ïa ka rupa da ka ding . Ngan tynjuh ïa ki kumba la ju tynjuh ïa ka ksiar . Nangta kin duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa ki . Ngan ïathuh ïa ki ba ki long ki briew jong nga , bad kin phla ba nga long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia ka bynta kaba lai lyngba ka ding, bad ngan pynkhuid ia ki kumba la pynkhuid ia ka rupa, bad ngan tynjuh ia ki kumba la pyrshang ia ka ksiar: kin khot ia ka kyrteng jong nga: Ngan iohsngew ia ki: Nga ong: Ka long ki briew jong nga: bad kin ong: U Trai u long U Blei jong nga .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Behold , I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel  ; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing , and to thy sons , by an ordinance for ever .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Da kynmaw ba nga la ai ha me ïa ki jingainguh kiba kyrpang kiba la ai ïa nga ki bym dei kiba la thang kum ki jingkñia . Nga la ai ïa ki ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me kum ka bynta ba la ai ha me junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Aaron , Ha khmih nga ruh nga la ai ia me ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong nga na ki jingknia ba la pynkyntang baroh jong ki khun Israel; ha me nga la ai ia ki namar ka jingpynkhuid bad ha ki khun shynrang jong me, da ka jingpynbeit bymjukut .

en: And it was so , that after the  Lord  had spoken these words unto Job , the  Lord  said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee , and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .
kha: Hadien ba U  Trai  u la dep kren ha u Job , U ong ha u Eliphas ,  Nga bitar ïa me bad ïa ki ar ngut ki paralok jong me , namar mem shym kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga , kumba u Job u shakri jong nga u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, ba U Trai u la kren ia kine ki ktien ha u Job, U Trai u la ong ha u Eliphas u nong Temani, Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la bthei pyrshah ia me bad pyrshah ia me arngut ki paralok jong me: namar phim shym la kren ia kata kaba dei, kumba u shakri jong nga u Job u la kren .

en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill , she caught him by the feet : but Gehazi came near to thrust her away . And the man of God said , Let her alone  ; for her soul is vexed within her : and the  Lord  hath hid it from me , and hath not told me .
kha: hynrei haba ka la wan ha u Elisha ka la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u bad ka la bat ïa ki kjat jong u . U Gehasi u la mut sa ban khynñiat ïa ka sharud , hynrei u Elisha u ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka . Mem ïohi ba ka khuslai jur ? Bad U  Trai  um shym ïathuh ei ei shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la poi ha u briew jong U Blei ha lum, ka la kem ia u da ki kjat: hynrei u Gehasi u la wan hajan ban pynkhih ia ka . Bad uta u briew jong U Blei u la ong: Ai ba ka long marwei namar ka mynsiem jong ka ka la sngewsih hapoh jong ka: bad U Trai u la buhrieh ia ka na nga .

en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had  ; and they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died , and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers . And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .
kha: Ki sei ïa u na ka kali ïapom jong u , ki buh ïa u ha ka kali ïapom kaba ar kaba u don hangta , bad ki kit ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ki ïambriew namar ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la shim ia u na kata ka kali, bad ki la buh ia u ha ka kali kaba ar kaba u la don; bad ki la wanrah ia u sha Jerusalem , bad u la iap ha kawei na ki jingtep jong ki kpa jong u . Bad u Judah bad ka Jerusalem baroh ki la iam na ka bynta u Josiah .

en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; and it shall be thine , and thy sons  with thee , by a statute for ever  ; as the  Lord  hath commanded .
kha: Kin wallam ïa ka kjat-dien bad ïa ka shadem katba dang kñia ïa ka khleiñ kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai . Kine ki bynta ki long ki jong me bad jong ki khun jong me pateng la pateng , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tyrpeng kaba heh bad ka sniehdoh kaba heh kin wanrah ryngkat bad ki jingknia ba la shna da ka ding jong ka shini, ban pynkhih ia ka na ka bynta ka jingknia kaba heh ha khmat U Trai ; bad kan long ka jong me, bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me, da ka ain junom; kumba U Trai u la hukum .

en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , saying , The king of Moab hath rebelled against me : wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle ? And he said , I will go up : I am as thou art , my people as thy people , and my horses as thy horses .
kha: U la phah ktien sha u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah :  U syiem ka Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; hato phin ïasoh bad nga ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u ?   Ngan ïasoh ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u jubab .  Nga kloi ban ïarap ïa phi kat kaba nga lah bad kumta ruh ki long ki rangbah bad ki kulai jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit bad u la phah sha u syiem Judah, u da ong, U syiem u Moab u la leh pyrshah ia nga: me leit bad nga pyrshah ia u Moab ban ialeh thma ? Bad u la ong: Ngan leit sha jrong: Nga long kum ma me, ko ki briew jong nga kum ki briew jong me, bad ki kulai jong nga kum ki kulai jong me .

en: Say unto them , Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations , that goeth unto the holy things , which the children of Israel hallow unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , that soul shall be cut off from my presence : I am the  Lord .
kha: Lada uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong phi , katba u dang long u bymkhuid , u wan hajan ki jingainguh kiba kyntang ïa kiba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , un ym lah shuh lano lano ruh ban shakri ha kata ka duwan . Kane kan ïailong kumta pateng la pateng . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ha ki , Uno uno na ki symbai jong phi baroh napdeng ki pateng jong phi , uba leit sha kiei kiei kiba kyntang , kiba ki khun Israel ki pynkyntang ha U Trai , da kaba don ka jingbymkhuid jong u halor jong u , kata ka mynsiem kan shah ot noh na khmat jong nga: Nga long U Trai .

en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants  ; behold , his bedstead was a bedstead of iron  ; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon ? nine cubits was the length thereof , and four cubits the breadth of it , after the cubit of a man .
kha: ( U Og u long u syiem uba khatduh na ki Rephaim . Ka jingthiah jong u , kaba la shna da u nar , ka long saw mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka pyngkiang , kat kum ka jingthew ba dei rukom . Dang lah ban ïohi ïa ka ha ka nongbah Rabbah jong ki Ammon . )
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta tang u syiem u Og u la sah ha ka jaka kaba sah jong u; ha Rabha jong ki khun Ammon ? hynniew cubit ka jingjrong jong ka, bad saw cubit ka jingjylliew jong ka, hadien ka cubit jong u briew .

en: And Samson lay till midnight , and arose at midnight , and took the doors of the gate of the city , and the two posts , and went away with them , bar and all , and put them upon his shoulders , and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron .
kha: Hynrei u Samson u thiah tang haduh shiteng synñia . U khie nangta bad u bat khak ïa ka khyrdop shnong bad u rat syndon ïa ka — ki jingkhang , ki shawkad , u nar-khang bad baroh . U bah ïa ki ha la ka tyrpeng bad u rah ïa ki baroh artet lynti sha kliar jong u lum uba marpyrshah ïa ka Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la thiah haduh shiteng miet, bad u la khie ha ka por shiteng miet, bad u la leit noh bad ki ar tylli ki post, bar bad bar baroh, bad u la buh ia ki ha ki tyrpeng jong u, bad u la rah ia ki sha jrong jong u lum uba don ha khmat u Hebron .

en: Of how much sorer punishment , suppose ye , shall he be thought worthy , who hath trodden under foot the Son of God , and hath counted the blood of the covenant , wherewith he was sanctified , an unholy thing , and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace ?
kha: Te , kaei kan long ïa u briew uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Khun U Blei ? uba ñiew dew thala ïa ka snam jong ka jutang U Blei kaba pynkhuid ïa u na ka pop ? uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Mynsiem ka jingaiei ? To pyrkhat haduh katno kan long ka jingpynshitom kaba kham shyrkhei kaba u dei ban ïoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka jingpynshitom kaba kham sngewsih, phi tharai ba un long uba bit dor, uba la iaid hapoh ka kjat U Khun U Blei , bad uba la khein ia ka snam jong ka jutang , da kaba u la pynkyntang ia u , kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid , bad u la leh wat hapdeng U Mynsiem ka jingaiei ?

en: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother , his mother said , I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the  Lord  from my hand for my son , to make a graven image and a molten image : now therefore I will restore it unto thee .
kha: U pynphai pat ïa ka pisa sha la ka kmie , bad ka ong ,  Ban khang ïa ka jingtim ban hap ha u khun jong nga , nga hi da lade nga aiti da kaba kyntang ïa kane ka rupa sha U  Trai . Yn pyndonkam ïa ka ban shna ka durblei da ka dieng ba la suit da ka rupa . Te mynta ngan ai pat ïa ki sbai rupa sha phi
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pynphai biang ia ka shiphew spah tylli ki rupa ha ka kmie jong u, ka kmie jong u ka la ong , nga la aiti lut ia ka rupa ha U Trai na ka kti jong nga na ka bynta u khun jong nga: mynta ngan pynphai biang ia ka ha me .

en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall , when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit : and all the trees of Eden , the choice and best of Lebanon , all that drink water , shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth .
kha: Haba nga phah ïa u shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyllon jong u , kan pynkhynñiuh ïa ki jaitbynriew . Baroh ki dieng ha Eden bad ki dieng baroh kiba kynsai , kiba la ïoh um bha jong ka Lebanon kiba la leit sha ka pyrthei shapoh kin sa sngewkmen ha ka jingkyllon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynlong ia ki jaitbynriew ban khih ha ka jingsawa jong ka jinghap jong u, haba nga bret ia u shapoh dujok bad ki kiba hiar shapoh ka thliew: bad ki dieng Eden baroh: bad ki dieng Eden baroh kiba la jied bad kiba bha tam jong ka Lebanon baroh kiba dih um, kin shah pyntngen ha ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka khyndew .

en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , The Chaldeans made out three bands , and fell upon the camels , and have carried them away , yea , and slain the servants with the edge of the sword  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Lai kynhun ki nonglute Khaldi ki wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi , ki shim noh ïa ki ut , bad ki pynïap ïa baroh ki shakri jong phi lait sa tang ïa nga . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren, la wan ruh uwei pat, bad u la ong, Ki Khaldes ki la mih lai tylli ki kynhun, bad ki la hap halor ki kulai, bad ki la rah noh ia ki, hooid, bad ki la pyniap ia ki shakri da ka tduh jong ka waitlam ; bad nga la lait tang marwei ban iathuh ia me .

en: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah , from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king , that is , twelve years , I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor .
kha: Ha baroh ki khat-ar snem ba nga long u lat jong ka ri Judah , naduh ka snem kaba khat-ar ba u Artakserksis u long u patsha haduh ka snem kaba arphew ar , ki ba-ha-ïing jong nga lymne ma nga , ngi ïabam ïa ka jingbam ba ngi dei ban ïoh kum u lat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata naduh ka por ba la thung ia nga ban long u Lat jong ki ha ka ri Judah, naduh ka snem kaba arphew haduh ka snem kaba arphew snem jong u Artaxerxes u syiem, kata, shiphew snem , ma nga bad ki hynmen jong nga kim shym la bam ia u kpu jong u Lat .

en: That there came certain from Shechem , from Shiloh , and from Samaria , even fourscore men , having their beards shaven , and their clothes rent , and having cut themselves , with offerings and incense in their hand , to bring them to the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , shuwa ba uno uno un tip shaphang ka jingshah pynïap u Gedalaïah , phraphew ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha Shekhem , Shiloh bad Samaria . Ki la khi ïa la ki  ñiuhtmoh , kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki pynmong ïa lade . Ki dang ïashim kew bad jingiwbih ban ai ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba la wan na Shehem, na Shiloh, bad na Samaria, wat saw ngut ki briew kiba la shah ot ryndang bad ki jain jong ki ki la tyrkhong bad ki la ot ia lade, da ki jingainguh bad ki jingiwbih ha ka kti jong ki, ban wanrah ia ki sha ka iing U Trai .

en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them : they have made them a molten calf , and have worshipped it , and have sacrificed thereunto , and said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Ki la da ïaid sakma noh na kata ka lynti ha kaba nga la hukum ïa ki ban ïaid ; ki la thaw ïa lade u khun masi ba la saiñ da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u , bad ki la ai jingkñia ha u . Ki ïa-ong ba une u long u blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phai noh kloi na ka lynti kaba nga la hukum ia ki: ki la pynlong ia ki khun masi ba la khleh lang bad ki la mane ia ka bad ki la knia ia ka hangta bad ki la ong: Kine ki long ki blei jong me, ko Israel, kiba la wanrah ia me na ka ri Ijipt .

en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , and Shebna , and Joah , unto Rab–shakeh , Speak , I pray thee , to thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and talk not with us in the Jews  language in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki ïathuh ïa u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ka ktien Aramaik ïa ngi , ko kynrad . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïasngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eliakim u khun u Hilkiah bad u Shebna bad u Joah, ha Rabtakeh, To kren, nga kyrpad ia me, ha ki shakri jong me ha ka ktien Syria ; namar ngi sngewthuh ia ka: bad wat kren bad ngi ha ka ktien Jiw ha ki shkor jong ki briew kiba don ha ka kynroh .

en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law , when thou art passed over , that thou mayest go in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , a land that floweth with milk and honey  ; as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee .
kha: bad thoh ha ki ïa kine ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh . Ynda phi la rung sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la kular ha phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban thoh ha ki ia ki ktien jong kane ka hukum baroh, haba me la iaid lait noh, ba me lah ban leit sha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me, ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap; kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la kular ia me .

en: Then ye shall answer them , That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord   ; when it passed over Jordan , the waters of Jordan were cut off : and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever .
kha: phin ïathuh ïa ki ba ka um jong ka Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka jam ïa ka wah . Kine ki maw kin ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki paid Israel shaphang kaei kaba la jia hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin jubab ia ki , Ba ki um Jordan ki la jah noh ha khmat ka synduk ka jutang U Trai; haba ka la iaid lyngba ka Jordan: bad kine ki maw kin long ka jingkynmaw ia ki khun Israel junom .

en: And the Levites took down the ark of the  Lord  , and the coffer that was with it , wherein the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone : and the men of Beth–shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the  Lord .
kha: Ki Lebi ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba don kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki halor uta u mawbah . Nangta ki nong Beth Shemesh ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa kiwei pat ki jingkñia ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Lebi ki la shim ia ka synduk U Trai bad ka synduk kaba don ryngkat bad ka, ha kaba ki mawkordor ksiar ki la don, bad ki la buh ia ki ha u maw uba heh: bad ki briew jong ka Bethshesh ki la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia ha kajuh ka sngi ha U Trai .

en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die : and he called his son Joseph , and said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me  ; bury me not , I pray thee , in Egypt :
kha: Shuwa ba u Jakob un ïap , u khot ïa u Joseph u khun jong u , bad u ong ha u ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga , bad kular da shisha ba phin ym tep ïa nga ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka por ka la jan ba ki Israel kin iap: bad u la khot ia u khun jong u u Joseph, bad u la ong ha u, Lada mynta nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, nga kyrpad ia me, ka kti jong me hapoh ka tyrpeng jong nga, bad to leh sngewbha bad shisha bad nga; wat tep ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, ha Ijipt:

en: When a man hath taken a wife , and married her , and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes , because he hath found some uncleanness in her : then let him write her a bill of divorcement , and give it in her hand , and send her out of his house .
kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew , bad hadien u shem ha ka ïa kaei kaei ha kaba um sngewbha ; u rai ba um mon shuh ïa ka , kumta u thoh ïa ki kot ïapyllait tnga bad u ai ïa ki ha ka , bad u phah mihnoh ïa ka na ka ïing jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew u la shim ia ka tnga bad u la shongkurim ia ka bad ka la jia ba kam shym la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha ki khmat jong u, namar u la shem ia ka jingbymkhuid ha ka: nangta to ai ba un thoh ia ka ia ka bill jong ka jingpyniakhlad bad ai ia ka ha ka kti jong ka, bad phah noh ia ka na ka iing jong u .

en: The Spirit of the Lord  God  is upon me  ; because the  Lord  hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek  ; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives , and the opening of the prison to them that are bound  ;
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem jong u . U la jied ïa nga bad phah ïa nga ban wallam ïa ka khubor babha sha kiba duk , ban pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud , ban pynbna ka jingpyllait ïa ki mraw bad ka jinglaitluid ïa kito kiba ha ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Trai Blei U Trai U don halor jong nga; namar U Trai u la pynsleh ia nga ban ialap ia ka khubor babha sha ki briew kiba jemnud; u la phah ia nga ban teh ia kiba la tyrkhong dohnud, ban pynbna ia ka jinglaitluid ha ki mraw, bad ka jingplie ia ka phatok ha kito kiba la shah teh;

en: And if the man like not to take his brother s wife , then let his brother s wife go up to the gate unto the elders , and say , My husband s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel , he will not perform the duty of my husband s brother .
kha: Hynrei lada u para jong uta uba la ïap um mon ban shongkurim ïa ka , ka dei ban leit ha khmat ki nongïalam shnong bad ban ong , ‘ U para kynsi jong nga um treh ban pynneh ïa ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u hapdeng ki Israel ; um mon ban pyndep ïa la ka kamram .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uta u briew um sngewtynnad ban shim ia ka tnga jong u hynmen jong u, te un leit sha ka khyrdop sha ki rangbah, bad un ong: U hynmen jong nga u kyntait ban pynmih ia ka kyrteng ha Israel jong u hynmen jong nga .

en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as I am gone from thee , that the Spirit of the  Lord  shall carry thee whither I know not  ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he cannot find thee , he shall slay me : but I thy servant fear the  Lord  from my youth .
kha: Kumno kan long lada U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u rah noh ïa phi sha ka jaka bymtip tang mar ïamih ma nga ? Nangta , haba ngan ïathuh ïa u Ahab ba phi don hangne , bad um lah ban shem ïa phi , un sa pynïap ïa nga . To kynmaw ba nga long uba mane hok ïa U  Trai  naduh ba nga dang khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia tang shu leit noh na me, ba U Mynsiem U Trai un rah ia me ha kaba ngam tip; bad kumta haba nga wan bad nga iathuh ha u Ahab, bad um lah ban shem ia me, un pyniap ia nga: hynrei nga u shakri jong me nga tieng ia U Trai naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga .

en: And when she looked , behold , the king stood by a pillar , as the manner was , and the princes and the trumpeters by the king , and all the people of the land rejoiced , and blew with trumpets : and Athaliah rent her clothes , and cried , Treason , Treason .
kha: Hangta ka la ïohi ïa u syiem thymmai uba ïeng hajan ki rishot ba don ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ , kumba long ka rukom . La ker sawdong ïa u da ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki nongput turoi , bad ki paidbah ki ïarisa da ka jingkmen bad put ïa ki turoi . Ka Athalaïah ka tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jinglyng-a bad ka pyrta ,  Ka Jingshetkylla . Ka Jingshetkylla !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka peit, ha khmih, u syiem u la ieng hajan u maw, kumba ka long, bad ki rangbah bad ki turoi da u syiem, bad ki briew baroh ki la ia risa bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ki turoi: bad ka Athaliah ka la pynkhih ia ki jain jong ka, bad ka la pyrta, Ka Jinglehrain, ka Jinglehrain .

en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , Micaiah the son of Imlah , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me , but evil . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
kha: U Ahab u jubab ,  Don sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u , namar um ju ïathuhlypa ïa kaba bha shaphang jong nga , borabor ka dei tang ïa kaba sniew suda .   Phim dei ban ong kumta !  U Jehoshaphat u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat, U dang don uwei u briew, u Micaiah u khun jong u Imlah, da uba ngi lah ban kylli na U Trai: hynrei nga shun ia u ; namar um ju iathuhlypa ia nga uba bha hynrei uba sniew . Bad u Jehoshaphat u la ong: Wat u syiem un ong kumta .

en: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt .
kha: Ho-oid , ngan pyntlot ïa u bad pynkhlaiñ ïa u syiem ka Babilonia . Haba nga ai ha u ïa ka waitlam jong nga bad u kdew ïa ka ban thew sha ka liang ka Ijipt , baroh kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynskhem ia ki kti jong u syiem Babilon bad ki kti jong u Pharaoh kin hap noh bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai haba ngan buh ia ka waitlam jong nga ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon bad un pynjrong ia ka sha ka ri Ijipt .

en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .
kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u la thoh ka kren pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . Ka ong ,  Ki blei jong ki hima kim shym lah ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong nga , bad da lei lei U Blei jong u Hesekaïah un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thoh ruh ia ki shithi ban iaid pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , bad ban kren pyrshah ia u , da kaba ong , Kumba ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew ki bym shym la pyllait ia ki briew jong ki na ka kti jong nga , kumta u Blei jong u Hesekaiah un ym pyllait ia ki briew jong u na ka kti jong nga .

en: And also I have withholden the rain from you , when there were yet three months to the harvest : and I caused it to rain upon one city , and caused it not to rain upon another city : one piece was rained upon , and the piece whereupon it rained not withered .
kha: Nga la khang ïa u slap haba ki jingthung ki dang donkam eh ïa u . Nga la pynhap slap ha kawei ka nongbah , hynrei ym ha kawei pat . U slap u la hap ha kawei ka lyngkha hynrei kawei pat ka lyngkha ka la tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh nga la bat ia u slap na phi, haba dang don lai bnai ban ot: bad nga la pynlong ia u slap ha kawei ka shnong , bad ngam shym la pynlong ia u slap ha kawei pat ka shnong: kawei ka bynta ka la slap ha kawei pat ka shnong: bad ka bynta ha kaba u slap um shym la tyrkhong .

en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle  ; and the city shall be taken , and the houses rifled , and the women ravished  ; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity , and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city .
kha: U  Trai  un wallam lang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ban ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ïa ka nongbah yn sa shim noh , ïa ki ïing la lute , bad ïa ki kynthei la batbor . Shiteng na ki briew kin leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw , hynrei ïa kiba sah na ki yn ym shim noh na ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan lum ia ki jaitbynriew baroh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem ban ialeh thma ; bad ia ka shnong yn shim noh ia ki iing kiba la shah rong noh bad ki kynthei kiba la shah rong noh bad shiteng na ka shnong kin leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: Keeping mercy for thousands , forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin , and that will by no means clear the guilty  ; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children , and upon the children s children , unto the third and to the fourth generation .
kha: Nga bat ïa la ka kular na ka bynta ki bun hajar ki pateng bynriew bad nga map ïa ka jingbymman , bad ïa ka pop ; hynrei , ngan pynshitom ïa ki khun ki ksiew haduh ka pateng bynriew kaba lai bad kaba saw namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynsah ia ki hajar ngut ki khun, ka jingbymhok bad ka jingpynkhein bad ka pop, bad kata kan ym pynkhuid da lei lei ia ki kpa kiba don pop ha ki khun bad ha ki khun ki ksiew, haduh ka pateng kaba lai bad kaba saw .

en: But do not thou yield unto them : for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men , which have bound themselves with an oath , that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him : and now are they ready , looking for a promise from thee .
kha: Hynrei wat shahshkor ïa ki , namar don palat sawphew ngut ki briew ki ban rieh bad apthap ïa u . Ki la shim smai ban ym bam lane dih tad ynda ki la pynïap ïa u . Ki la khreh mynta ban leh ïa kata bad ki ap ïa ka rai jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat ailad ia ki: namar ki don palat sawphew ngut ki briew kiba la teh ia lade da ka jingsmai, ba kin ym bam ne dih haduh ba kin da pyniap ia u bad mynta ki la pynkhreh: ki wad ia ka jingkular na me .

en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab s hand : so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground , and struck him not again  ; and he died . So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri .
kha: U Amasa um shym don jingïada na ka waitlam kaba u Joab u bat ha kawei pat ka kti jong u , bad u Joab u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh , bad ki snier jong u ki mih shaid ha madan . U ïap ha shen , bad u Joab um donkam ban dung biang sa shisien . Nangta u Joab bad u Abishai , u para jong u ki la leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Amasa um shym la pyrkhat ia ka waitlam kaba don ha ka kti jong u Joab: kumta u la pynkhih ia u ha ka ryndang kaba phra, bad u la pynmih ia ki bniat jong u shapoh khyndew, bad um shym la shoh shuh ia u ; bad u la iap . Kumta u Joab bad u Abisai u hynmen jong u u la bud ia u Sheba u khun u Bichri .

en: And that day Joshua took Makkedah , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof he utterly destroyed , them , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain : and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho .
kha: U Joshua u la tur ïaleh bad kurup ïa ka Makkedah bad ïa u syiem jong ka ha kata ka sngi . U pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka nongbah ; ym don uwei ruh uba lait im . U leh ïa u syiem ka Makkedah kumba u la leh ïa u syiem ka Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi u Joshua u la shim ia ka da ka waitlam, bad u syiem jong ka u la pynjot lut ia ki, bad ia ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta; um shym la shah shuh: bad u la leh ia u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem

en: Then spake Elisha unto the woman , whose son he had restored to life , saying , Arise , and go thou and thine household , and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn : for the  Lord  hath called for a famine  ; and it shall also come upon the land seven years .
kha: Mynta u Elisha u la lah ïathuh ha ka briew kaba shong ha Shunem , ha kaba ïa u khun jong ka u la pynim pat , ba U  Trai  un phah ïa ka  nemsniew ka ban neh hynñiew snem ha ka ri bad ba ka dei ban mihnoh bad ka longïing jong ka bad leit sah shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kren ia u Elisa ha kata ka kynthei, kaba u la pynim biang ia u khun jong u, u da ong: To khie, bad to leit noh ia ka iing jong me, bad to leit sah ha ka jaka ba me lah ban sah: namar U Trai u la khot ia ka jingkyrduh bam bad kan wan ruh ha ka ri hynriew snem .

en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :
kha: Phi kynmaw aïu u la leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun u Eliab uba na ka jait Reuben . Hangta ha khmat jong phi baroh , ka khyndew ka ang bad ka nguid ïa ki lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ , ki shakri , bad ki jingri jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaba u la leh ha u Datan bad u Abiram, ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab: kumno ka khyndew ka la plie ia ka shyntur jong ka, bad ka la rong noh ia ki, bad ki iing jong ki, bad ki iing jong ki, bad ki jingbam baroh kiba don ha ki, hapdeng ki Israel baroh:

en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning , neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use , nor given ought thereof for the dead : but I have hearkened to the voice of the  Lord  my God , and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me .
kha: Mynba nga ïambriew , ngam shym la bam ei ei na ka ; mynba nga long u bymkhuid , ngam shym la rah ei ei na ka shabar ïing ; bad ngam shym la ai ei ei na ka kum ka jingainguh ïa kiba ïap . Nga la kohnguh ïa me , ko  Trai  ; nga la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba me la hukum ïa nga kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la bam ia ka ha ka jingsngewsih jong nga, bad ngam shym la shim ia ka na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam bymkhuid, bad ngam shym la ai ia ka na ka bynta kiba iap: hynrei nga la sngap ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong nga, bad nga la leh katba me la hukum ia nga .

en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .
kha: Nangta ki paidbah ki leit sha ka templ u Baal bad ki pynkyllon ïa ka ; ki pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ïa ki bleithaw , bad ki pynïap ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jong u Baal , ha khmat ki duwan . U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki nongap phira kiba dei treikam ha ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh jong ka ri ki la leit shapoh ka iing u Baal, bad ki la pynkhih ia ki jingkhang jong u bad ki dur jong u ki la pynkhih bha ia ki, bad ki la pyniap ia u Mattan u lyngdoh jong u Baal ha khmat ki almari . Bad u lyngdoh u la thung ia ki ophisar halor ka iing U Trai .

en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , that wast inhabited of seafaring men , the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it !
kha: Kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha :  Ïa nongbah bapawnam la pynjot ! Ïa ki liengbah jong ka la rong noh na ki duriaw . Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki synshar ïa ki duriaw bad pyntriem ïa baroh kiba shong harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin shim ia ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta jong me, bad kin ong ha me, Katno me la shah pynjot, kata ka la shong ha ki briew kiba iaid duriaw, ka nongbah kaba pawnam, kaba la khlain ha duriaw , ma ka bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka, kiba pynlong ia ka jingtieng jong ki ban long ha baroh kiba pynshitom ia ka !

en: And it was told king David , saying , The  Lord  hath blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that pertaineth unto him , because of the ark of God . So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed–edom into the city of David with gladness .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u ïohsngew ba namar ka Synduk ka Jutang , U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing jong u Obed Edom bad baroh kat kiba u don ; kumta u leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na ka ïing jong u Obed ban leit rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad ka jinglehkmen kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u syiem Dabid, da kaba ong, U Trai u la kyrkhu ia ka iing u Obeddom bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba iadei bad u, namar ka synduk U Blei . Kumta u Dabid u la leit rah ia ka synduk U Blei na ka iing u Obeddom sha ka shnong u Dabid da ka jingkmen .

en: And the king said unto Araunah , Nay  ; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price : neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  my God of that which doth cost me nothing . So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver .
kha: Hynrei u syiem u jubab ,  Em , ngan da siewdor ïa ka . Ngan ym ai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ïa ki jingkñia kiba nga khlem da siewdor ei ei .  Bad u la thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad ïa ki masi dab ha ka dor sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Aragah, Em; hynrei ngan thied shisha ia ka na me ha ka dor: bad ngan ym ai ia ki jingknia thang ha U Trai U Blei jong nga na kata kaba ym shym la pynlut ei ei ia nga . Kumta u Dabid u la thied ia ka jingbam bad ki masi sanphew sekel rupa .

en: But his wife said unto him , If the  Lord  were pleased to kill us , he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands , neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these .
kha: Hynrei ka tnga jong u ka jubab ,  Lada U  Trai  u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ngi , un ym jin da la pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong ngi ; un ym jin da la pyn-i ha ngi ïa kine baroh lane ïathuh ha ngi ïa kita kiei kiei mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka tnga jong u ka la ong ha u, Lada U Trai u sngewbha ban pyniap ia ngi, un ym shym la pdiang ia ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingainguh bam ha ki kti jong ngi, lymne un ym shym la pyni ia kine kiei kiei baroh, lymne un ym shym la iathuh ia ngi ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: God sent Jesus to earth for three reasons : ( 1 ) To teach us the truth about God ( John 18 :37 ) , ( 2 ) to maintain perfect integrity , providing a model for us to follow ( 1 Peter 2 :21 ) , and ( 3 ) to sacrifice his life to set us free from sin and death .
kha: Don lai tylli ki daw ba balei U Blei u la phah ïa u Jisu sha ka pyrthei . ( 1 ) ban hikai ïa ngi ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei ( Ioannis 18 :37 ) , ( 2 ) ban ïaineh ha ka hok bad ban long u nuksa na ka bynta jong ngi . ( 1 Petros 2 :21 ) , bad ( 3 ) ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait ïa ngi na ka pop bad ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la phah ia U Jisu sha ka pyrthei na ki lai tylli ki daw: ( 1) Ban hikai ia ngi ia ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei (U loannis 18:37 )), ( 2) ban pynneh ia ka jinglong ba janai, kaba ai nuksa ia ngi ban bud (U Petros 2 :21 )), bad ( 3) ban aiti ia ka jingim jong u ban pyllait ia ngi na ka pop bad ka jingiap .

en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim  ; and they shall be upon Aaron s heart , when he goeth in before the  Lord  : and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the  Lord  continually .
kha: Buh ïa u Urim bad u Thummim    hapoh ka jingdeng shadem , khnang ba u Aaron un rah ïa ki haba u wan ha khmat ka jingdon kaba kyntang jong nga . Kum ha kata ka por , u dei ban phong ïa kane ka jingdeng shadem , khnang ba u lah ban tip bad sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong nga na ka bynta ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ha ka shyntur jong ka jingbishar ia ka Urim bad ka Thummim ; bad kin long ha ka dohnud u Aaron haba u leit shapoh ha khmat U Trai: bad u Aaron un kit ia ka jingbishar jong ki khun Israel ha khmat U Trai beit .

en: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him , and did hastily catch it : and they said , Thy brother Ben–hadad . Then he said , Go ye , bring him . Then Ben–hadad came forth to him  ; and he caused him to come up into the chariot .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Benhadad ki ap khmih ïa ka dak babha , bad haba u Ahab u ong  shi para ,  ki pynkloi shisyndon bad ong ,  Kumba phi ong , u Benhadad u long kum uba shi para jong phi !   Wallam ïa u sha nga ,  u Ahab u hukum . Haba u Benhadad u poi , u Ahab u khot sngewbha ïa u ban kiew ha ka kali ïapom bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki briew ki la peit bniah la kaei kaei kan wan na u, bad ki la kem kyrkieh ia ka: bad ki la ong, U hynmen jong me u Benhadad . Nangta u la ong, To wanrah ia u . Nangta u Benhadad u la wan shajan jong u; bad u la pynlong ia u ban wan sha jrong ha ka kali .

en: And it came to pass , when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat , that they said , It is the king of Israel . Therefore they compassed about him to fight : but Jehoshaphat cried out , and the  Lord  helped him  ; and God moved them to depart from him .
kha: Kumta haba ki ïohi ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat , baroh ki tharai ba u dei u syiem Israel , bad ki phai ban tur ïaleh ïa u . Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la pyrta , bad U  Trai  U Blei u la pyllait im ïa u bad pynphai noh ïa ka jingtur ïaleh na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki rangbah jong ki kali ki la iohi ia u Jehoshaphat, ba ki la ong, Ka long ka syiem Israel . Kumta ki la ker sawdong ia u ban ialeh: hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la pyrta , bad U Trai u la iarap ia u; bad U Blei u la pynkhih ia ki ban leit noh na u .

en: And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases  ;
kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum lem bad ki apostol , u la ïeng ha ka jaka madan lem bad kiba bun ki synran jong u . U paid byllien u la don hangta na kylleng ka Judia bad na Jerusalem bad na ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon kiba harud duriaw ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan hiar bad ki, bad u la ieng ha ka madan, bad ka kynhun ki synran jong u, bad ki briew kiba bun na Judaea baroh bad Jerusalem bad na rud duriaw Tyros bad Sidon, kiba la wan ban iohsngew ia u bad ban shah pynkoit na ki jingpang jong ki;

en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , he shall surely be put to death , and all the congregation shall certainly stone him : as well the stranger , as he that is born in the land , when he blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , shall be put to death .
kha: Uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba shong ha Israel uba krenbeiñ ïa U  Trai  un shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba kren bein ia ka kyrteng U Trai, un shah pyniap shisha, bad ka jingiaseng baroh kan sa pyniap ia u: kumjuh ruh ia u nongwei uba la kha ha ka ri , haba u kren bein ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .
kha: Ka la long namar phim don ka jingngeit kaba biang ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi don ka jingngeit kaba heh kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban ong ïa une u lumrit , ‘ Khie leit noh nangne shatai !’ bad un leit . Phi lah ban leh ïa kano kano !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Namar ka jingbymngeit jong phi: namar shisha nga ong ha phi, Lada phi don ka jingngeit kum u symbai ba la khleh lang, phin ong ha une u lum: Pynduh noh ia u; bad kan weng noh ia phi.

en: But Moses  hands were heavy  ; and they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat thereon  ; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side  ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .
kha: Haba ki kti u Moses ki la sakhrai , u Aaron bad u Hur ki rah uwei u maw ba un shong , katba ma ki pat ki ïeng ha syndah jong u , uwei sha kadiang bad uwei pat sha kamon , bad ki kyrshan ïa ki kti jong u , ki da kyrshan skhem ïa ki kumta haduh ban da sep ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki kti jong u Moses ki long kiba heh ; bad ki la shim ia u maw, bad u la shong ha kata ka por ; bad u Aaron bad u Hur ki la sah ha ki kti jong u, uta uba don ha kawei ka liang, bad uwei pat ha kawei pat ka liang; bad ki kti jong u ki la long kiba skhem haduh ban da hiar ka sngi .

en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants  ; come up to us quickly , and save us , and help us : for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us .
kha: Ki rangbah ka Gibeon ki la phah ktien sha u Joshua ha ka jaka sher dara ha Gilgal , ki da ong ,  Kynrad , wat iehnoh ïa ngi ! Wan mar mar ban ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyllait im ïa ngi ! Baroh ki syiem Amor ha ri lum ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Gibeon ki la phah sha u Joshua sha ka shnong Gilgal, ki da ong: Wat slap ia ka kti jong me na ki shakri jong me; to wan shaneng kloi sha ngi, bad to pynim ia ngi: namar ki syiem jong ki Amorit baroh kiba shong ha ki lum ki ialum lang pyrshah ia ngi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The fast of the fourth month , and the fast of the fifth , and the fast of the seventh , and the fast of the tenth , shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness , and cheerful feasts  ; therefore love the truth and peace .
kha: Ki jingshah jingit kiba la long ha u bnai basaw , uba san , uba hynñiew , bad uba shiphew kin kylla long ki Jingkhawai Niam ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen ïa ki paid Judah . Phi dei ban ieit ïa ka jingshisha bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid Ka jingstet jong u bnai uba saw, bad ka jingstet jong ka hynriew bnai, bad ka jingstet jong ka hynriew bnai, kan long ha ka iing jong u Judah ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen kaba kmen; namarkata ka jingbam kaba kmen bad kaba kmen .

en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who , if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .
kha: Kito kiba dang sah napdeng ki jaitbynriew kin long kum u sing uba wad jingbam ha ka khlaw ne ha ka jaka bam phlang : U rung hapdeng ki langbrot , u kynrup ïa ki , bad tar lyngkhot ïa ki — bad hangta ym don jingkyrmen ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsah jong u Jakob kan long hapdeng ki Jutang hapdeng ki mrad khlaw: kiba , lada u iaid lyngba , baroh ar ki iaid shapoh bad ki iam , bad ym don ba lah ban pynpoi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Jehu , Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes , and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart , thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Jehu ,  Me la leh ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la kwah ïa me ban leh . Kumta nga kular ha me ba ki khun ki ksiew jong me , haduh kaba saw pateng bynriew , kin long ki syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Jehu , Namar ba me la leh bha ha kaba pyndep ia kaba dei ha ki khmat jong nga , bad me la leh ia ka iing u Ahab kat kum ka jingdon ha ka dohnud jong nga baroh .

en: And thou , son of man , be not afraid of them , neither be afraid of their words , though briers and thorns be with thee , and thou dost dwell among scorpions : be not afraid of their words , nor be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .
kha: Hynrei ma me , ko khun u briew , wat sheptieng ïa ki lane ïa kano kano ba ki ong . Kin beiñ bad ym kheiñ ïa me ; bad kan long kumba im hapdeng ki  ñianglartham . La katta ruh , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah lane ïa kano kano kaba ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me khun u briew, wat tieng ia ki, wat tieng ia ki ktien jong ki, wat la ki bniat bad ki bniat ki don bad me, bad me sah hapdeng ki khnai: wat tieng ia ki ktien jong ki, wat la phi sngewsih ia ki khmat jong ki, wat la ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah .

en: And as the evil figs , which cannot be eaten , they are so evil  ; surely thus saith the  Lord  , So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah , and his princes , and the residue of Jerusalem , that remain in this land , and them that dwell in the land of Egypt :
kha: Te ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah , ïa ki nongsaiñ hima sawdong jong u , ïa kiba sah na ki briew ka Jerusalem kiba dang sah ha kane ka ri , ne kynriah sha ri Ijipt — ma nga , U  Trai  ngan leh ïa ki baroh kum ïa kine ki soh Dumbur kiba da sniew shisha ki bym long bam shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba ki soh kiba sniew ki bym lah ban bam, ki long kiba sniew kumta shisha u ong U Trai: Kumta ngan ai ia u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah bad ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongsynshar jong u kiba sah ha kane ka ri bad ia kita kiba sah ha ka ri Ijipt:

en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee , of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth  ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .
kha: Shim bad me ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mrad , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaroi bad saphriang kylleng ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: To wanrah bad me ia kiei kiei baroh kiba im kiba don bad me, na ka doh baroh, bad na ki masi bad na ki mrad baroh kiba iaid ha ka khyndew; ba kin nangroi shibun ha ka khyndew bad kin nangroi ha ka khyndew .

en: And the hangings of the court , and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court , which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about , and their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and all that is made for them : so shall they serve .
kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long phra hajar hynriewspah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingkhang jong ka phyllaw bad ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw kaba don hajan ka ïingjain bad hajan ka ïingkhang sawdong , bad ki nar jong ki baroh ki tiar jong ka jingshakri jong ki: kumta kin shakri .

en: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth , which thou shalt bring of thy land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt put it in a basket , and shalt go unto the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name there .
kha: iwei pa iwei na phi phin buh ha ka shang ïa u soh nyngkong hadien ba phi la lum na uwei pa uwei u jait jingthung , bad leit rah ïa ka sha ka jaka mane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba men shim na ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka khyndew baroh, kiba me wanrah na ka ri jong me kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me, bad men buh ia ka ha ka basket , bad men leit sha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me un jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong u hangta .

en: So Hazael went to meet him , and took a present with him , even of every good thing of Damascus , forty camels  burden , and came and stood before him , and said , Thy son Ben–hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
kha: Kumta u Hasael u pynkit ïa baroh ki jait jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong ka Damaskos ha ki sawphew tylli ki ut bad u leit sha u Elisha . Haba u Hasael u la ïakynduh ïa u , u ong ,  U shakri jong phi u syiem Benhadad u la phah ïa nga ban kylli na phi la un dang koit ne em na ka jingpang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Hazael u la leit iakynduh ia u, bad u la shim ia ka jingai sngewbha bad u, wat na ka jingbha jong u Damasi, sawphew tylli ki kulai, bad u la wan bad u la ieng ha khmat jong u, bad u la ong, U khun jong me u Benhadad u la phah ia nga sha me, u da ong, Hato ngan koit na kane ka jingpang ?

en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
kha: Naduh kata ka por , namar jong u Joseph , U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing longsem jong u nong Ijipt , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ïing ka sem jong u lane ha lyngkha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia naduh ka por ba u la pynlong ia u ha iing jong u bad ha ka iing jong u baroh kaba u don, ba U Trai u la kyrkhu ia ka iing Ijipt na ka bynta u Joseph; bad ka jingkyrkhu U Trai ka la long halor kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha iing bad ha lyngkha .

en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph , and I will bring them again to place them  ; for I have mercy upon them : and they shall be as though I had not cast them off : for I am the  Lord  their God , and will hear them .
kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki paid Judah ; ngan pyllait im ïa ki paid Israel . Ngan don ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki baroh sha ïing . Kin long kum kiba ngam pat ju kyntait ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynskhem ia ka iing u Judah bad ngan pynim ia ka iing u Joseph, bad ngan wanrah biang ia ki ban buh ia ki ; namar nga isynei ia ki: bad kin long kumba ngam shym la bret noh ia ki: namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki: bad ngan sngap ia ki .

en: Then I heard one saint speaking , and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake , How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice , and the transgression of desolation , to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot ?
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei u angel uba kylli ïa uwei pat ,  Haduh katno kine kiei kiei kiba la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kin ïailong ? Haduh katno ka pop ba-ijli kan bujli ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ? Haduh katno ïa ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng bad ïa ka Templ yn kyrdem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iohsngew ia uwei u riewkhuid uba kren , bad uwei pat u riewkhuid uba la kren ha kata ka por , Katno ka jingphohsniew shaphang ka jingknia kaba man ka sngi , bad ka jingpynkhein ia ka jingpynjot , ban ai ia ka jaka kyntang bad ka jaka ri jingri ban shah pynkhih hapoh ka kjat ?

en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
