kha: Lai sien shisnem , ki shynrang jong phi baroh ki dei ban wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha kata ka jaka mane Blei : ha ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , bad ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep . Kim dei ban wan thylli ha khmat U  Trai  ;
translated_en_to_kha: Lai sien ha ka shisnem baroh ki shynrang jong me kin paw ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka jaka kaba un jied; bad ha ka jingkhawai jong ki taiew bad ha ka jingkhawai jong ki taiew: bad kin ym paw ha khmat U Trai:

en: Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim sa uwei pat u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me, ko khun u briew, to shim ia uwei u dieng, bad thoh halor jong u, Na ka bynta u Judah bad na ka bynta ki khun Israel jong u: nangta shim sa uwei pat u dieng: nangta sa u shim sa uwei pat u dieng: Na ka bynta u Joseph, u dieng Ephram bad na ka bynta ka iing Israel baroh:

en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence , and thou hast sinned : therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God : and I will destroy thee , O covering cherub , from the midst of the stones of fire .
kha: Me la bunkam ha kaba thied bad kaba die , bad kane ka la ïalam ïa me sha ka jingleh jubor bad ka pop . Te nga pynbor ïa me ban ieh ïa u lumbah bakhuid jong nga , bad u angel uba ap phira ïa me u la beh noh ïa me na ki mawlynnai batyngshaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingbun ki mar jong me ki la pyndap ia me da ka jingleh donbor: namarkata ngan bret noh ia me kum u lum U Blei: bad ngan pynjot ia me, ko u cherub uba tap ia me, na pdeng ki maw ding .

en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh , nor the inhabitants of Beth–anath  ; but he dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh and of Beth–anath became tributaries unto them .
kha: Ki jait Naphtali kim shym la beh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Beth Shemesh bad ha Bethanath . Ki paid Naphtali ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka , hynrei ki la pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Naphtali um shym la beh noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Bethshemesh, ne ki nongshong shnong jong ka Bethanath ; hynrei u la shong hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri: wat la katta ruh ki nongshong shnong jong ka Bethshemesh bad ka Bethanath ki la kylla long ki nongshong shnong ha ki .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tip ba nga long uba khuid . Ki paid Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei; Ynda nga la lum ia ka iing Israel na ki briew kiba la pynsaphriang ia ki, bad yn pynkyntang ha ki ha khmat ki nongwei , te kin shong ha ka ri jong ki kaba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob .

en: And Samson said , Let me die with the Philistines . And he bowed himself with all his might  ; and the house fell upon the lords , and upon all the people that were therein . So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life .
kha: bad u pyrta ,  Ai ngan ïap bad ki Philistia !  U khynñiat da ka bor jong u baroh , bad kata ka ïing ka la khyllem halor ki san ngut ki syiem bad ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka . U Samson u la pynïap kham bun ha ka por ba u ïap ban ïa kita kiba u la pynïap mynba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la ong, To ngan iap bad ki Philistia . Bad u la dem khrup da ka bor baroh bad ka iing ka la hap ha ki kynrad bad ha ki briew baroh kiba don hangta . Kumta kiba iap kiba u la pyniap ha ka jingiap jong u ki kham bun ban ia kiba u la pyniap ha ka jingim jong u .

en: Thou also , which hast judged thy sisters , bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they : they are more righteous than thou : yea , be thou confounded also , and bear thy shame , in that thou hast justified thy sisters .
kha: Bad mynta pha dei ban shah ïa ka jingjahburom jong pha . Ki pop jong pha ki kham sniew katta katta ban ïa kito ki jong ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha kumta ba ki i lui lui hajan jong pha . Mynta to sawkyr-ang bad shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong pha , namar pha pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha ban paw ba ki long kiba sngur .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh, me la bishar ia ki para kynthei jong me, to shah ia la ka jong ka jingsngewlehrain namar ki pop jong me kiba me la leh kham sngewsih ban ia ki: ki kham hok ban ia me: hooid, to sngewlehrain ruh, bad to shah ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong me, ha kaba me la pynshisha ia ki para kynthei jong me .

en: And Jonathan said to David , Go in peace , forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  be between me and thee , and between my seed and thy seed for ever . And he arose and departed : and Jonathan went into the city .
kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  U Blei un don ryngkat bad phi . U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ma nga bad ma phi , bad kiba hiarpateng na phi bad kiba hiarpateng na nga , kin bat ïa ka kular bakyntang kaba ngi la pynlong iwei ïa iwei .  Nangta u Dabid u leit noh , bad u Jonathan u leit phai pat sha shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la ong ha u Dabid, To leit suk, kumba ngi la smai ha ka kyrteng U Trai, da kaba ong: U Trai un long hapdeng jong nga bad me bad hapdeng u symbai jong nga bad u symbai jong me junom . U la ieng bad u la leit noh: bad u Jonathan u la leit shapoh ka nongbah .

en: Have they not sped ? have they not divided the prey  ; to every man a damsel or two  ; to Sisera a prey of divers colours , a prey of divers colours of needlework , of divers colours of needlework on both sides , meet for the necks of them that take the spoil ?
kha: Ki dang ïawad ïa kiei kiei ban kurup bad ïabynta , Kawei lane ar ngut ki kynthei na ka bynta uwei uwei u shipai , ka jaiñ baremdor na ka bynta u Sisera , bad ki jaiñ ba la thain itynnat na ka bynta ka ryndang jong ka syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kim shym la sngap jar ? hato kim shym la phiah ia u mrad ha uwei pa uwei u nongleit jingleit u la shah rong noh ha ki rong saw, u mrad ba la rong saw, ki rong saw ha baroh arliang , ki iakynduh ia ki ryndang jong ki kiba shim ia ka jingsniew ?

en: And now , behold , the  Lord  hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years , even since the  Lord  spake this word unto Moses , while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness : and now , lo , I am this day fourscore and five years old .
kha: Hynrei mynta , ha khmih , ka la long sawphew san snem naduh ba U  Trai  u la ong ïa kata ha u Moses . Kata ka la long mynba ki Israel ki dang ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , bad U  Trai  , kumba u la kular , u la ri pynim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, U Trai u la pynim ia nga, kumba u la ong, kine ki sawphew san snem, wat la U Trai u la kren ia kane ka ktien ha u Moses, katba ki khun Israel ki la iaid kai ha ka ri khlaw: bad mynta, ha khmih, nga la dap sawphew san snem .

en: And say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys  ; Behold , I , even I , will bring a sword upon you , and I will destroy your high places .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki lum ka Israel ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  — ban sngap ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki lumbah , ki lumrit , ki khap maw bad ki them : Ngan phah ïa ka waitlam ban pynjot ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong , Phi ki lum Israel , to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai Blei ; Kumta u Trai Blei u ong ha ki lum, bad ha ki lum, ha ki wah bad ha ki them ; Ha khmih, nga, wat nga ruh, ngan wanrah ia ka waitlam halor jong phi, bad ngan pynjot ia ki jaka ba jrong jong phi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Where is the bill of your mother s divorcement , whom I have put away ? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you ? Behold , for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves , and for your transgressions is your mother put away .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Phi tharai ba nga la phah noh ïa la ki briew kum u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga ? Hangno te , ki don ki kot pyllait tnga ? Phi tharai nga la die ïa phi sha ka jingshahtehmraw kum u briew uba die ïa la ki khun kum ki mraw ? Em , phi la leit shahtehmraw noh namar ki pop jong phi ; la phah noh ïa phi namar ki kam bymman jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Hangno ka bill jong ka jingïaphetrieh jong ka kmie jong phi kaba nga la weng noh ? lane mano na ki nongkit ram jong nga ha kiba nga la die noh ïa phi ? Ha khmih , namar ki jingbymhok jong phi phi la die noh ia lade , bad namar ki jingpynkheiñ jong phi la weng noh ia ka kmie jong phi .

en: And Joab came into the house to the king , and said , Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants , which this day have saved thy life , and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters , and the lives of thy wives , and the lives of thy concubines  ;
kha: U Joab u leit sha ïing jong u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Ha kane ka sngi phi la pynlehrain ïa ki rangbah jong phi — ki rangbah kiba la pyllait im ïa phi , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi , bad ïa ki tnga bad ki tnga kliar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la wan shapoh iing ha u syiem bad u la ong: Me la pynjah burom ia ki khmat jong me baroh kiba me la pynim ia ka jingim jong me bad ia ka jingim jong ki khun shynrang jong me bad ki khun kynthei jong me bad ia ka jingim jong ki tnga jong me;

en: And all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , which were dukes of Sihon , dwelling in the country .
kha: Ka kynthup ïa ki nongbah baroh jong ka jaka padun bad ka hima baroh kawei jong u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon . U Moses u la jop ïa u , bad ruh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Midian : u Ebi , u Rekem , u Sur , u Hur , bad u Reba . Kine baroh ki la synshar na ka bynta u Sihon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shnong baroh jong ka ri, bad ka hima jong u Sikhon u syiem ki Amorites, kiba la synshar ha Heshbon, kiba u Moses u la synshar bad ki rangbah jong ka Madian, u Evi bad u Rekem, bad u Suri bad u Huri bad u Reba, kiba long ki syiem jong u Sihon, kiba shong ha ka ri .

en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee : the unclean and the clean may eat thereof , as of the roebuck , and as of the hart .
kha: La katta ruh , phi lah ban pynïap bad bam ïa ki jingri jong phi kat shaba phi shong phi sah . Phi lah ban bam kat kumba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi . Baroh na phi , kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la me lah ban pyniap bad bam ia ka doh ha ki khyrdop jong me baroh, kat kum ka jingkyrkhu U Trai U Blei jong me uba u la ai ha me: kaba jakhlia bad kaba khuid ka lah ban bam ia ka, kum ka doh masi , bad kum ka doh masi .

en: And David lifted up his eyes , and saw the angel of the  Lord  stand between the earth and the heaven , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders of Israel , who were clothed in sackcloth , fell upon their faces .
kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha shiteng suiñ , u da bat ïa la ka waitlam ha la ka kti , uba la pynkhreh ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem . Nangta u Dabid bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah — baroh na ki , kiba la phong ki jaiñ khain — ki dem pynrit , bad la ki khlieh kiba kynduh ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la iohi ia u angel U Trai ba u ieng hapdeng ka khyndew bad ka bneng , u la pynkhih ia ka waitlam ha ka kti jong u kaba la pynkhih shabar halor ka Jerusalem . Nangta u Dabid bad ki rangbah Israel kiba la phong da ka jainkup ki la hap ha ki khmat jong ki .

en: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , Stand up and bless the  Lord  your God for ever and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .
kha: Kine ki Lebi harum ki ai ïa ka jingkhot sha ka jingmane : u Jeshua , u Kadmiel , u Bani , u Hashabneïah , u Sherebaïah , u Hodaïah , u Shebanaïah , bad u Pethahaïah . Ki ong :  Ïeng bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; ïaroh ïa u junom la junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong u , wat la ym don ka jingïaroh ba kynja briew kaba khraw palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Lebi, u Jeshua, bad u Kadmiel, u Bani, u Hashabnia, u Shebeiah, u Shebaniah, bad u Pethaiah, ki la ong: To ieng bad to kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong phi junom: bad la kyrkhu ia ka kyrteng ba donburom jong me, kaba la pynkhraw halor ka jingkyrkhu bad jingiaroh baroh .

en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , but hast fretted me in all these things  ; behold , therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head , saith the Lord  God  : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations .
kha: Pha la klet kumno nga la leh ïa pha mynba pha dang samla , bad pha la pynbitar ïa nga da kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh . Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la pynlong ïa pha ban shah na ka bynta jong ki baroh . Balei pha bynrap ïa ka jingawria jakhlia ha baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba pha la leh ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba me khlem kynmaw ia ki sngi samla jong me, hynrei me la pynkhih ia nga ha kine kiei kiei baroh; ha khmih , namarkata nga ruh ngan pynphai ia ka lynti jong me ha ka khlieh jong me: bad me dei ban leh ia kane ka jinglehrain halor ki jinglehrain jong me baroh .

en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun , that Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid , and laid great stones in the cave s mouth , which remain until this very day .
kha: Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai ka hukum , bad la pynhiar noh ïa kita ki metïap bad bret ha kajuh ka krem ha kaba ki la ïarieh mynshuwa . La buh ïa ki maw kiba heh ha ka jaka rung sha ka krem , bad ki dang don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba ka sngi ka la hiar, u Joshua u la hukum, bad ki la weng noh ia ki na ki dieng bad ki la bret ia ki ha ka krem ha kaba ki la buhrieh, bad ki la buh ia ki maw kiba heh ha ka shyntur jong ka krem kiba sah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded , and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that were to go out on the sabbath : for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses .
kha: Ki Lebi bad ki briew ka Judah ki leh kumba la bthah da u Jehoïada . Ym shym la phah noh ïa ki rangbah haba ki la pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Sabbaton , kumta ki rangbah ai hukum ki ïoh lang ïa kito kiba dang wan sha la ki kam bad kito kiba la pyndep kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki Lebi bad ki Judah baroh ki la leh katba kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u Lyngdoh u la hukum, bad u la shim ia ki briew jong u kiba dei ban wan rung ha ka sngi Sabha: namar u Lyngdoh u la kyntait ia ki jinghikai .

en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army  ; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army  ; but he shall not stand : for they shall forecast devices against him .
kha: Un pynmih da ka jingshlur ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban tur ïaleh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt , u ban pynkhreh ban ïaleh pyrshah da ka kynhun shipai babun bad bakhrawbor . Hynrei ïa u syiem ka Ijipt yn shukor bad un ym jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynkhih ia ka bor bad ka jingshlur jong u pyrshah ia u syiem jong ka thain shatei lam mihngi bad u syiem jong ka thain shatei un shah pynkhih ban ialeh thma da ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad kaba khlain bor bha; hynrei un ym ieng: namar kin iathuh lypa ia ki jingthmu pyrshah ia u .

en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel , thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude : and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Beth–aven .
kha: Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel ; ki don laiphew hajar tylli ki kali thma , hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki shipai kiba bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki leit sha Mikhmash , kaba sha mihngi na Bethaben bad ki sher dara hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la ialum lang bad ki Israel, laiphew hajar tylli ki kali bad hynriew hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai, bad ki briew kum ka dewbilat kaba don ha rud duriaw ha ka jingbun: bad ki la wan shaneng, bad ki la iaid ha Michmash, shaphang mihngi na Bethaven .

en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?
kha: Ha khmat ki paralok jong u bad ki shipai Samaria u ong ,  Kaei , kine ki Jiw shem-lanot , ki tharai ba ki leh ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba da ka jingkñia jingainguh ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka shi sngi ? Hato ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki synrum ba la ing ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha khmat ki hynmen jong u bad ki shipai jong ka Samaria bad u la ong, Kiei kine ki Jiw kiba tlot ? kin pynskhem ia lade ? kin pyniap ? kin pynkut noh ia ki maw na ki thliew jong ki jaboh kiba la thang ?

en: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing , and shall add the fifth part thereto , and give it unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering , and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: U dei ban siew ïa kata baroh ïa kaba u la klet ban wallam bad un siew tam arphew bynta na ka shispah . Un ai ïa kata ha u lyngdoh , bad u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia da uta u mrad namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynbeit ia ka jingma kaba u la leh ha ka jingkhuid, bad un pyndap ia ka ha ka bynta kaba phra: bad u lyngdoh un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u da u langbrot jong ka jingainguh kaba bakhuid .

en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth  ; that there be just men , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked  ; again , there be wicked men , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous : I said that this also is vanity .
kha: Hynrei kane ka long ka bym don jingmut . Khmih kaei kaba jia ha ka pyrthei : Teng teng uba hok u ïoh ïa ka jingshah pynshitom jong u bymman , bad ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa ka bainong jong kiba hok . Nga ong ba ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jinglong kaba sniew kaba la leh ha ka khyndew ; ba ki don tang ki briew kiba sniew shuh shuh, ki don ki briew kiba sniew, ha kiba ka jia kat kum ka kam jong kiba hok: Nga la ong ba kane ruh ka long kaba sniew .

en: But Jehosheba , the daughter of king Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons which were slain  ; and they hid him , even him and his nurse , in the bedchamber from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .
kha: Tang u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah u lait im . U la jan shah pynïap ryngkat bad kiwei , hynrei la pyllait im ïa u da ka ñiakha jong u , ka Jehosheba , kaba long ka khun jong u syiem Jehoram bad ka bakha u Ahasaïah . Ka shim ïa u lem bad ka nongsumar jong u sha ka kamra thiah kaba don ha ka Templ bad ka la pynrieh ïa u na ka Athalaïah , kumta um shym la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehosebek u khun jong u syiem u Ahasaiah u la shim ia u Joash u khun u Ahasaiah bad u la tuh ia u na ki khun syiem kiba la shah pyniap; bad ki la buhrieh ia u, wat ia u bad ka nurse jong u, ha ka kamra thiah jong u na Athaiah, haduh ba um shym la shah pyniap .

en: And it came to pass , that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them , and all the men of war , then they fled , and went forth out of the city by night , by the way of the king s garden , by the gate betwixt the two walls : and he went out the way of the plain .
kha: Mynba u syiem Sedekaïah bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka nongbah ha ka por mynmiet . Ki la phet na ka lynti jong ka kper syiem , ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop kaba pynïasoh ïa ki ar tylli ki kynroh , bad phet na ka liang jong ka Them Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah u la iohi ia ki, bad ki shipai baroh, ki la phet noh, bad ki la mih noh na ka shnong ha ka por miet, hajan ka kper syiem, hajan ka khyrdop kaba don ki ar tylli ki kynroh: bad u la leit shabar ka madan .

en: If thy brother , the son of thy mother , or thy son , or thy daughter , or the wife of thy bosom , or thy friend , which is as thine own soul , entice thee secretly , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which thou hast not known , thou , nor thy fathers  ;
kha: Wat u hynmen u para jong phi , u khun jong phi , ka khun jong phi , ka tnga kaba phi ieit , lane u paralok uba jan eh jong phi , ki lah harieh harieh ban khring ïa phi ban leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ïa kiba phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju mane mynno mynno .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u hynmen jong me, u khun jong me, ne u khun jong me, ne ka tnga jong me, ne ka tnga jong me, kaba long kum ka mynsiem jong me hi, to pynkhih ia me da kaba rieh, da kaba ong: To ngin leit shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei, kiba me, ne ki kpa tymmen jong me;

en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear you , when ye depart thence , shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them . Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
kha: Lada phi wan poi ha ka shnong kaba ki briew kim khot sngewbha ïa phi lane kim sngap ïa phi , mihnoh na ka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi . Kata kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym pdiang ia phi, ne iohsngew ia phi, haba phi leit noh nangta, to pynkhih ia ka dewmet hapoh ki kjat jong phi na ka bynta ka jingsakhi pyrshah ia ki . Hooid nga ong ha phi , Kan kham shah ia ka Sodom bad ka Gomorraha ha ka sngi bishar , ban ia kata ka nongbah .

en: Therefore I am full of the fury of the  Lord   ; I am weary with holding in : I will pour it out upon the children abroad , and upon the assembly of young men together : for even the husband with the wife shall be taken , the aged with him that is full of days .
kha: Ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ïa ki ka pluh ruh hapoh jong nga , A  Trai  , bad ngam lah ban kun slem shuh ïa ka .  Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To theh noh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga halor ki khynnah ha ki surok bad ha ki jingïalang jong ki samla shynrang . Ïa ki rangbah bad ki tnga jong ki yn shim noh , bad wat ïa kiba tymmen tam yn ym pynsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga dap da ka jingbitar jong U Trai; nga la thait da kaba bat: Ngan theh ia ka ha ki khun shabar ri, bad ha ka jingiaseng samla lang: namar wat ia u tnga bad ka tnga ruh yn shim noh ia u .

en: This matter is by the decree of the watchers , and the demand by the word of the holy ones : to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will , and setteth up over it the basest of men .
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingrai jong ki angel kiba la kloi bad kiba peitngor . Kumta te , shah ba ki briew baroh ha kylleng ban tip ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u don ka bor halor jong ki hima ki briew bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied — wat ha ki bym da paw eh na ki briew .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka kam ka long da ka hukum jong ki nongpeitkai , bad ka jingdawa da ka ktien jong ki riewkhuid: ha ka jingthmu ba kiba im kin tip ba ka synshar kaba khraw tam ha ka hima ki briew , bad ka ai ia ka ha uno uno uba u mon , bad ka shong halor jong ka .

en: And the bullock for the sin offering , and the goat for the sin offering , whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp  ; and they shall burn in the fire their skins , and their flesh , and their dung .
kha: Ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa uta  langsohmoh ïa kiba la kñia kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kiba ka snam jong ki la leit rah sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban weng noh ïa ka pop , dei ban leit rah shabar ka jaka shong dara bad thang ïa ki hangta . Ïa ka snieh , ka doh , bad ki snier jong ki ruh dei ban thang lang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop, bad u blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop, uba la wanrah ia ka snam jong u ban pynkhuid ha ka jaka bakhuid, uwei un rah shabar ka jaka kyntang ; bad kin thang ha ka ding ia ki sniehdoh jong ki bad ka doh jong ki bad ka sboh jong ki .

en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) And Jehu said , If it be your minds , then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel .
kha: Nangta u Jehu u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram uba dang don ha Jesreel , ha kaba u la leit ban ïoh jingkoit na ki jingmong kiba u la ïoh ha ka thma ha Ramoth pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Kumta u Jehu u la ong ha ki para rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Lada phi don bad nga , pynthikna ba uwei ruh na phi un ym leit noh na Ramoth bad maham ïa ki briew jong ka Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem Joram u la wan phai biang ha Jesel na ki jingmynsaw kiba ki Syria ki la ai ha u, haba u la ialeh bad u Hazael syiem Syria . ) Bad u Jehu u la ong: Lada ka long ka jingmut jong phi, te wat leit noh na ka shnong ban leit iathuh ia ka ha Jesel .

en: And Terah took Abram his son , and Lot the son of Haran his son s son , and Sarai his daughter in law , his son Abram s wife  ; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldeans , to go into the land of Canaan  ; and they came unto Haran , and dwelt there .
kha: U Terah u shim ïa u Abram u khun jong u , ïa u Lot u ksiew jong u , uba long u khun jong u Haran , bad ïa ka pyrsa kurim jong u ka Sarai , ka tnga jong u Abram , bad ki ïamih lang noh na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan . Ki la leit haduh ha Haran bad ki la ïashong ïasah noh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Terah u la shim ia u Abram u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u Haran u khun jong u, bad u Sarai u khun jong u, u khun jong u u Abram u la leit noh bad ki na Ur jong ki Khaldes, ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan; bad ki la poi ha Haran bad ki la shong hangta .

en: And I saw as the colour of amber , as the appearance of fire round about within it , from the appearance of his loins even upward , and from the appearance of his loins even downward , I saw as it were the appearance of fire , and it had brightness round about .
kha: Ka dur ka i phyrnai la kum ka rnong hapdeng ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi kum ka rong jong u amber, kumba ka long ka dur jong ka ding sawdong jong ka, naduh ka dur jong ki tyrpeng jong u wat shaneng, bad naduh ka dur jong ki tyrpeng jong u wat shapoh , nga la iohi kumba ka long ka dur jong ka ding sawdong .

en: In that thou lovest thine enemies , and hatest thy friends . For thou hast declared this day , that thou regardest neither princes nor servants : for this day I perceive , that if Absalom had lived , and all we had died this day , then it had pleased thee well .
kha: Phi pyrshah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa phi bad kyrshan ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi ! Phi la pynpaw shai ba ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong phi kim long ei ei ïa phi . Nga lah ban ïohi ba phin jin da la sngewhun lada u Absalom u dang im mynta bad ba ngi baroh ngin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata me ieit ia ki nongshun jong me, bad me shun ia ki paralok jong me . Namar me la pynbna ia me ha kane ka sngi, ba me khein ia ki syiem ne ki shakri: namar ha kane ka sngi nga sngewthuh ba lada u Absalom u la im, bad baroh ngi la iap ha kane ka sngi, te ka la pynsngewbha ia me bha .

en: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .
kha: Bad u la shukor ïa ki briew baroh kiba im ha ka pyrthei da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u ban leh ha khmat jong uta u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong . U mradkhlaw u la ong ïa ki ban tei ka durblei ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u mradkhlaw ïa uba la shah pynmynsaw da ka waitlam bad pynban uba dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka pynbiej ia kita kiba shong ha ka khyndew da kita ki kambah kiba u don ka bor ban leh ha khmat u mrad ; da kaba ong ha ki kiba shong ha ka khyndew , ba kin thaw dur ia uta u mrad uba don ka jingmynsaw da ka waitlam bad u la im .

en: That the  Lord  may continue his word which he spake concerning me , saying , If thy children take heed to their way , to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul , there shall not fail thee ( said he ) a man on the throne of Israel .
kha: Lada me kohnguh ïa u , U  Trai  un bat ïa ka kular kaba u la pynlong haba u ong ïa me ba ki khun ki ksiew jong nga kin synshar ïa ka Israel katba ki dang phikir ban kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum da ka dohnud baroh bad ka mynsiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Trai un bteng ia ka ktien jong u kaba u kren ia nga, da kaba ong, Lada ki khun jong me ki sumar ia ka lynti jong ki, ban iaid ha khmat jong nga ha ka jingshisha da ka dohnud jong ki baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong ki baroh, kan ym jah noh shaphang jong me (u la ong u briew ha ka khet Israel ) .

en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar , which is in the king s dale : for he said , I have no son to keep my name in remembrance : and he called the pillar after his own name : and it is called unto this day , Absalom s place .
kha: Mynba u dang im , u Absalom u la tei u mot na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka Them jong u Syiem , naba um don khun shynrang u ban ri pynim ïa ka kyrteng jong u . Kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u da la ka jong ka kyrteng , bad haduh kane ka sngi la tip ïa u kum u Mot jong u Absalom .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Absalom ha ka jingim jong u u la shim bad pynsan ia lade ia u maw, uba don ha ka jaka jong u syiem: namar u la ong: Ngam don khun ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong nga ha ka jingkynmaw: bad u la khot ia u maw hadien ka kyrteng jong u hi: bad la khot ia ka haduh kine ki sngi: bad la khot ia ka haduh kine ki sngi:

en: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel , I fear my lord the king , who hath appointed your meat and your drink : for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort ? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king .
kha: U Ashpenas pat u la sheptieng ïa u syiem , kumta u la ong ha u Daniel ,  U syiem u la rai ïa kaei kaba phin bam bad dih , bad lada mem i kum uba bit kum kiwei pat ki samla shynrang , u lah ban pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah jong ki nongsynshar u la ong ha u Daniel, nga tieng ia u kynrad jong nga uba la buh ia ka jingbam bad ka jingdih jong phi: namar balei un iohi ia ki khmat jong phi kiba kham sniew ban ia ki khun kiba long na ka jait jong phi ? te phin pynlong ia nga ban pynjot ia ka khlieh jong nga ha u syiem .

en: For ask now of the days that are past , which were before thee , since the day that God created man upon the earth , and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other , whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it ?
kha: Phai sha ka mynnor , sha kata ka por shuwa ban kha ïa phi , ter shi ter haduh kata ka por mynba U Blei u la thaw ïa u briew ha ka pyrthei . Wad ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Hato kaei kaei kaba khraw kat kane ka la ju jia mynshuwa ? Don mo u briew uba la ju ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei kaba kat kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kylli mynta na ki sngi kiba la leit noh, kiba la long ha khmat jong me, naduh ka sngi ba U Blei u la thaw ia u briew ha ka khyndew , bad kylli na kawei ka liang ka bneng sha kawei pat , la don ne em kaei kaei kaba kum kane kaba khraw ?

en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he went down to Ashkelon , and slew thirty men of them , and took their spoil , and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle . And his anger was kindled , and he went up to his father s house .
kha: Hangta hi ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u leit hiar sha Ashkelon , ha kaba u pynïap laiphew ngut ki rangbah , u law ïa ki jaiñ jong ki , bad u ai ïa ki jaiñkup baremdor ha kita ki shynrang kiba batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip . Hadien kata , u leit phai noh sha la ïing , da kaba bitar halor kaei kaba la jia ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Trai u la wan ha u, bad u la leit hiar sha u Ashkelon, bad u la pyniap ia ki laiphew ngut ki briew jong ki, bad u la shim ia ka jainkup jong ki, bad u la ai ia ki jainkup ia ki jainkup ia ki kiba la batai ia ka jingkylli . Bad ka jingbitar jong u ka la bthei bad u la leit sha ka iing u kpa jong u .

en: And his fame went throughout all Syria : and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments , and those which were possessed with devils , and those which were lunatic , and those that had the palsy  ; and he healed them .
kha: Ka khubor shaphang jong u ka la phriang kylleng ka ri Syria baroh kawei , ba ki briew ki la wallam ha u ïa baroh kito kiba pang , kiba shahshitom na ki jingpang babun jait , bad kiba pang bhur , bad kiba ïapshiliang — bad U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka nam jong u ka la leit kylleng ka Syria: bad ki la wanrah ha u ia ki nongpang baroh kiba la shah sumar bad ki jingpang ba la shah pynshitom bein, bad kito kiba la shah ktah ha ki ksuid bad kito kiba la shah ktah ha ki ksuid, bad kito kiba la shah ktah ha ka met bad u la pynkoit ia ki .

en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity , whose name is Holy  ; I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit , to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite ones .
kha: Nga long U Blei uba khraw bad uba khuid , uba im shi junom . Nga shong ha ki jaka kiba jrong bad kiba khuid , bad nga im ruh bad ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kylla-kaba-mut , kumta ba ngan pynïoh biang ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u long uba jrong bad uba jrong uba shong ha ka bymjukut, uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid bad kaba khuid, bad ma u ruh uba don ka mynsiem kaba jylliew bad kaba pynrit mynsiem, ban pynim biang ia ka mynsiem jong kiba pynrit mynsiem .

en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . And Jehu followed after him , and said , Smite him also in the chariot . And they did so at the going up to Gur , which is by Ibleam . And he fled to Megiddo , and died there .
kha: Haba u syiem Ahasaïah u ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , kumta u phet ïap ha la ka kali ïapom sha ka shnong Beth Haggan , ba la beh kthong da u Jehu .  Pynïap ïa u ruh !  U Jehu u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u katba u dang ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u ha ka lynti kaba kiew sha Gur kaba hajan ka shnong Ibleam . Hynrei u la ïohlad ban nang leit tad haduh ba un da poi ha ka nongbah Megiddo , ha kaba u ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Ahasaiah u syiem Judah u la iohi ia kane, u la phet noh da ka lynti jong ka iing kper . U Jehu u la bud ia u bad u la ong: To sngap ia u ruh ha ka kali . Ki la leh kumta ha ka por ba ki leit sha Gur kaba don ha Ibleam . Bad u la phet noh sha Megiddo bad u la iap hangta .

en: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and his brethren the priests , and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and his brethren , and builded the altar of the God of Israel , to offer burnt offerings thereon , as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God .
kha: bad u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak , ki para lyngdoh jong u , bad u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel , ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u , ki la ïatei biang ïa ka duwan jong U Blei ki Israel , khnang ba ki lah ban thang ki jingkñia halor jong ka kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses , u briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeshua u khun u Jozadak bad ki hynmen jong u ki la ieng ha ka ain jong u Moses u briew jong U Blei .

en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam , and to the princes of Judah , that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak , and said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have forsaken me , and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak .
kha: U Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Rehoboam bad ki nongïalam jong ka Judia kiba la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ban lait im na u Shishak . U ong ïa ki ,  Kane ka dei ka khubor na U  Trai  ïa phi : ‘ Phi la iehnoh ïa nga , te mynta nga la iehnoh ïa phi sha u Shishak .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Shemaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la wan sha u Rehoboam bad ha ki rangbah Judah kiba la ialum lang ha Jerusalem namar u Shishak bad u la ong ha ki: Kumta ong U Trai , Phi la iehnoh ia nga bad namarkata nga ruh nga la iehnoh ia phi ha ka kti u Shishak .

en: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence , and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor , and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Beth–el , one carrying three kids , and another carrying three loaves of bread , and another carrying a bottle of wine :
kha: Men ïaid nangta haduh ba men poi ha u dieng uba kyntang ha Tabor ; hangta men ïakynduh lai ngut ki rangbah kiba leit kñia jingainguh ha U Blei ha Bethel . Uwei na ki un ïalam lai tylli ki khunblang , uwei pat un rah lai tylli ki kpu , bad uba lai un kieng ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to leit sha khmat nangne sha ka madan Tabor, bad hangta kin iakynduh ia me lai ngut ki briew kiba leit sha U Blei sha Betel, uwei u kit lai ngut ki khun, bad uwei pat u kit lai tylli ki kpu bad uwei pat u kit ia ka bilor wain:

en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes , and thou shalt not eat thereof : thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face , and shall not be restored to thee : thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies , and thou shalt have none to rescue them .
kha: Ïa ki masi jong phi yn pynïap ha khmat jong phi hi , hynrei phin ym ïoh bam ïa ka doh jong ki . Ïa ki kada jong phi yn rong jubor ha khmat jong phi hi , bad yn ym pynphai pat ïa ki sha phi . Ïa ki langbrot jong phi yn ai noh ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad yn ym don ba ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka masi jong me kan shah pyniap ha khmat ki khmat jong me: ka tdong jong me kan shah weng noh da kaba shyrkhei na khmat jong me: ia ki langbrot jong me yn ai ha ki nongshun jong me .

en: And the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses of the kings of Judah , shall be defiled as the place of Topheth , because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven , and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods .
kha: Ki ïing jong ka Jerusalem bad ki ïing jong ki syiem ka Judah , bad shisha baroh ki ïing ha kiba halor ki tnum jong ki la thang ïa ki jingiwbih sha ki khlur bad ha kaba ïa ka waiñ la theh kum ka jingainguh sha kiwei pat ki blei — ma ki baroh kin long ki bymkhuid kum ka Topheth .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iing jong ka Jerusalem bad ki iing jong ki syiem Judah kin long kiba la pynjakhlia kum ka jaka jong u Tophet , namar ki iing baroh kiba ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki tnum jong ki ha ka bneng baroh kawei .

en: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
kha: bad phin ym lah da lei lei ban sngewthuh aïu U Blei u leh . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym shem da lei lei . Ki briew kiba stad ki lah ban kam ba ki tip , hynrei kim tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iohi ia ka kam U Blei baroh, ba u briew um lah ban shem ia ka kam kaba la leh hapoh ka sngi: namar wat la u briew u trei shitom ban wad ia ka, hynrei un ym shem shuh shuh ia ka;

en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee , and will keep the passover to the  Lord  , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it  ; and he shall be as one that is born in the land : for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof .
kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong basah bad phi u kwah ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , nyngkong eh phi dei ban otsher shuwa ïa ki shynrang baroh na ka ïing jong u . Hadien kata , lah ban kheiñ ïa u kum u traishnong , bad nangta u lah ban ïashim bynta ha ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u nongwei un sah bad me bad un sumar ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long kaba la ot ia ki shynrang jong u baroh, bad nangta un wan hajan bad un sumar ia ka ; bad un long kum uta uba la kha ha ka ri: namar ym don u briew u bym pat ot u ban bam ia ka .

en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them  ; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows , or concerning the bond of her soul , shall not stand : her husband hath made them void  ; and the  Lord  shall forgive her .
kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U  Trai  un map ïa ka , namar ba u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka na kaba bat ïa ka kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la pynlong ia ki khlem da don shuh ha ka sngi ba u la iohsngew ia ki te kaei kaei kaba la mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong ka, ne shaphang ka jingteh jong ka mynsiem jong ka, kan ym ieng: shaphang u tnga jong ka u la pynlong ia ki khlem da don shuh bad U Trai un map ia ka .

en: And Moses said unto them , If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan , every man armed to battle , before the  Lord  , and the land shall be subdued before you  ; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession :
kha: Lada ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jam sha shiliang ka Jordan kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  bad lada da ka jingïarap jong ki phi lah ban jop ïa ka ri , te ai ha ki ïa ka ri Gilead kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki, Lada ki khun Gad bad ki khun Reuben kin iaid ryngkat bad phi ha Jordan, uwei pa uwei u briew uba la pynkhreh ban ialeh thma ha khmat U Trai, bad ka ri kan shah pyndem ha khmat jong phi; te phin ai ia ki ia ka ri Gilead:

en: Wherefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God   ; Surely , because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things , and with all thine abominations , therefore will I also diminish thee  ; neither shall mine eye spare , neither will I have any pity .
kha: Namarkata , namar ba nga long U Blei uba im — kane ka long ka ktien U  Trai  Nongsynshar — namar pha la pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga da kiei kiei kiba basniew , ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , ngan kyntait ïa pha khlem isynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, kumba nga im, ong U Trai Blei; Hooid, namar ba me la pynjakhlia ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga da kiei kiei baroh kiba sngewsih jong me, bad da ki jingleh bymman jong me baroh, namarkata ngan pynduna ia me; bad ka khmat jong nga kan ym pyllait ia me, lymne ngan ym don jingsngewrit ei ei ruh em .

en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces , and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire , and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate : for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot , and they shall return to the hire of an harlot .
kha: Ïa ki bleithaw bakordor jong ka baroh yn pynpait lyngkhot , baroh kaba la ai sha ki nuti ka templ yn pynjot ha ka ding , bad ki durblei jong ka baroh kin long ka kynton ba la shu ieh . Ka Samaria ka la lum ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta ki jinglehniam ba pynseisoh , bad mynta ki nongshun jong ka kin rah noh ïa ki na ka bynta ki nuti ka templ shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki dur ba la ker jong ka baroh kin shah thang ha ka ding , bad ki lum jong ka baroh kin shah thang da ka ding: namar ka la lum ia ka na ka bai lutksan jong ka .

en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon , and from Cuthah , and from Ava , and from Hamath , and from Sepharvaim , and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel : and they possessed Samaria , and dwelt in the cities thereof .
kha: U patsha ka Assyria u wallam ïa ki briew na ki nongbah Babilon , Kuth , Ibbah , Hamath , bad Sepharbaim , bad pynshongduh ïa ki ha ki nongbah ka Samaria , ha ka jaka jong ki Israel ba la shah ringmraw . Ki shimti ha lade ïa kine ki nongbah bad ki sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Assyria u la wanrah ia ki briew na Babilon, bad na Cuta, bad na Ava, bad na Hamat, bad na Sepharvaim, bad u la buh ia ki ha ki shnong Samaria ha ka jaka jong ki khun Israel: bad ki la don ha ki shnong jong ka .

en: Now therefore , my lord , as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , seeing the  Lord  hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood , and from avenging thyself with thine own hand , now let thine enemies , and they that seek evil to my lord , be as Nabal .
kha: U dei U  Trai  uba la khang ïa phi ban pynhiarkput bad pynïap ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Bad mynta nga smai ha phi da U  Trai  uba im ba ki nongshun jong phi bad baroh kiba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi kin shah pynshitom kum u Nabal .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ko kynrad jong nga, kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, haba U Trai u la khang ia me ban wan pynmih snam, bad na kaba pynshitom ia lade da ka kti jong me hi, mynta to ai ba ki nongshun jong me, bad kita kiba wad ia ka jingsniew ia u kynrad jong nga, kin long kum u Nabal .

en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not , and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: U dei ban wanlam sha u lyngdoh kum ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kat kum ba la buh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia u langbrot khlem jingduna na ka kynhun langbrot, da ka jingkhein jong me, na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba khlem jingduna, ha u lyngdoh: bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u shaphang ka jingbymtip jong u ha kaba u la bakla bad u la sngewsih ia ka .

en: And he received the sign of circumcision , a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised : that he might be the father of all them that believe , though they be not circumcised ; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also :
kha: Ïa u la otsher hadien , bad ka jingotsher ïa u ka la long ka dak ban pyn-i ba namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok shuwa ban otsher ïa u . Bad kumta u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong baroh kiba ngeit ha U Blei bad ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok da u , wat la ïa ki ym shym la otsher .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ioh ia ka dak jong ka jingkren bein, ka muhor jong ka hok jong ka jingngeit kaba u dang long uba khlem ot: ba un long u kpa jong kito baroh kiba ngeit, wat la kim shym la ot lyngkot; ba ka hok kan long kaba la pynngat ha ki ruh:

en: And he said unto him , Went not mine heart with thee , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee ? Is it a time to receive money , and to receive garments , and oliveyards , and vineyards , and sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and maidservants ?
kha: Hynrei u Elisha u ong ,  Hato ngam shym la don hangta ha ka mynsiem haba u briew u hiar na ka kali ïapom jong u ban ïashem ïa me ? Kane kam dei ka por ban pdiang ïa ka tyngka bad ki jaiñ , ki brisoh olib bad ki bri sohwaiñ , ki langbrot bad ki masi lane ki shakri !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Hato ka dohnud jong nga kam shym la leit phai biang na ka kali jong u ban iakynduh ia me ? Hato ka dei ka por ban pdiang ia ka pisa bad ban pdiang ia ki jain bad ki kper olive bad ki kper sohjew bad ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ki nongtrei bad ki nongtrei ?

en: But there remained two of the men in the camp , the name of the one was Eldad , and the name of the other Medad : and the spirit rested upon them  ; and they were of them that were written , but went not out unto the tabernacle : and they prophesied in the camp .
kha: Ar ngut na kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam , u Eldad bad u Medad , ki sah ha ka jaka shong dara bad kim shym la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ . Hangta ha ka jaka shong dara , kata ka bor mynsiem ka wan ha ki , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la sah arngut ki briew ha ka shnong , ka kyrteng jong uta uba la sah ha ka shnong bad ka kyrteng jong uwei pat u Medad: bad ka mynsiem ka la shong ha ki; bad ki la long na kita kiba la thoh; hynrei kim shym la leit shabar sha ka shnong: bad ki la iathuhlypa ha ka shnong .

en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God , and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left .
kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba-im . Ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingkrenbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ïa ki . Kumta to duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew jong ngi kiba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong me un iohsngew ia ki ktien u Rabsakh, ia uba u syiem jong u u la phah ban kren bein ia U Blei uba im, bad un pynrem ia ki ktien kiba U Trai U Blei jong me u la iohsngew: namar kata to rah ia ka jingduwai jong me na ka bynta kaba sah .

en: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam , and said to Samson , Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us ? what is this that thou hast done unto us ? And he said unto them , As they did unto me , so have I done unto them .
kha: Kumta lai hajar ngut ki rangbah Judah ki leit sha kata ka krem mawsiang ha Etam bad ki ong ha u Samson ,  Mem tip ba ki Philistia ki dei ki nongsynshar jong ngi ? Me la leh aïu ïa ngi ?  U jubab ,  Nga la leh ïa ki tang kaei kaba ki la leh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta lai hajar ngut ki briew jong ka Judah ki la leit sha jrong jong u maw Etam, bad ki la ong ha u Samson, Hato phim tip ba ki Philistia ki long ki nongsynshar halor jong ngi ? kaei kane kaba me la leh ia ngi ? Bad u la ong ha ki: Kumba ki la leh ia nga .

en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth–el the fifteenth day of the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart  ; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel : and he offered upon the altar , and burnt incense .
kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba phra , ka sngi kaba u hi u la buh , u leit sha Bethel bad u kñia ka jingainguh ha ka duwan ban rakhe ïa ka jingkhawai niam ba u la seng na ka bynta ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la tyrwa halor ka jingbam kaba u la leh ha Betel ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, wat ha u bnai uba u la thmu da ka dohnud jong u hi; bad u la buh ia ka jingkhawai ha ki khun Israel: bad u la tyrwa halor ka jingknia bad u la thang ia ka jingiwbih .

en: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that were in all the countries , heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah , and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan  ;
kha: Ha kata ka por , baroh ki paid Israel kiba don ha Moab , Ammon , Edom bad ha kiwei ki ri , ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la shah katto katne ki nong Israel ban ïaisah ha Judah bad ba u la pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh haba ki Jiw baroh kiba don ha Moab bad hapdeng ki Ammon bad kiba don ha ki ri baroh ki la iohsngew ba u syiem Babilon u la iehnoh ia ka jingsah jong u Judah bad ba u la buh halor jong ki ia u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam u khun u Shaphan;

en: And , behold , one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses , and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel , who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Uwei u Israel u la ïalam ïa kawei ka kynthei Midian sha la ïingjaiñ , ha kaba ïohi jong u Moses bad ka kynhun baroh , katba ki dang ïa-ïam sngewsih ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei na ki khun Israel u la wan bad u la wanrah ha ki hynmen jong u ia ka kynthei Midan ha khmat u Moses bad ha khmat ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kaba iam ha khmat ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: But the Levites have no part among you  ; for the priesthood of the  Lord  is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them .
kha: Pynban , ki Lebi kin ym ïoh kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri lem bad phi , namar ka bynta jong ki ka long ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai . Bad da shisha , ki jait Gad , Reuben , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi te ki la lah ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ïa kaba u Moses u shakri jong U  Trai  u la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Lebi kim don bynta hapdeng jong phi; namar ka jinglong lyngdoh jong U Trai ka long ka pateng jong ki: bad u Gad bad u Reuben bad shiteng ka jait Manasseh ki la ioh ia ka pateng jong ki sha lyndet ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .

en: And the  Lord  delivered it also , and the king thereof , into the hand of Israel  ; and he smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain in it  ; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ruh ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa u syiem jong ka . Kim shym la iehnoh wat uwei ruh , hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ha ka . Ki la leh ïa u syiem jong ka kumba ki la leh ïa u syiem ka Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la aiti ruh ia ka, bad u syiem jong ka, ha ka kti jong ki Israel; bad u la shoh ia ka da ka tduh jong ka waitlam, bad ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta; um shym la shah ei ei ban sah ha ka; hynrei u la leh ia u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ia u syiem Jerikho .

en: And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi u Dabid u ong ha ki rangbah jong u ,  Hato don uno uno hangne uba isih ïa ki Jebus kumba isih ma nga ? Haduh katta kat ban pynïap ïa ki ? Te khie leit kiew lyngba ka nur-um bad tur ïaleh ïa kito ki bapli ki matlah bad ki dkoh .  ( Dei na kata ka daw ba la ong ,  Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh kim lah ban rung sha ka ïing ka jong U  Trai .  )
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha kata ka sngi , Uno uno uba kiew sha ka thliew bad uba pynkhih ia ki nongleh kam sniew bad kiba matlah kiba la shun ia ka mynsiem u Dabid . Namarkata ki la ong: U nongleh kam sniew bad uba matlah un ym wan shapoh iing .

en: Belshazzar , whiles he tasted the wine , commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem  ; that the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , might drink therein .
kha: Katba ki dang ïadih , u Belshassar u la ai hukum ban wallam ha ki khuri ksiar bad rupa bad ha ki pliang kiba u Nebukhadnessar u kpa jong u , u la rah noh na ka Templ kaba ha Jerusalem . U syiem u la phah shim ïa ki khnang ba ma u , ki rangbah donburom jong u , ki tnga jong u , bad ki tnga kliar jong u ki lah ban dih na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Belshasar , uba u la mad ia ka wain , u la hukum ban wanrah ia ki khiew ksiar bad rupa kiba u kpa jong u u la shim na ka tempi kaba don ha Jerusalem; ba u syiem bad ki rangbah jong u, ki tnga jong u bad ki tnga jong u, kin dih ha ka .

en: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste , and the high places shall be desolate  ; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate , and your idols may be broken and cease , and your images may be cut down , and your works may be abolished .
kha: Ïa baroh ki nongbah ka Israel yn pynjot noh , kumta ba ïa ki duwan jong ki bad ki bleithaw jong ki yn pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai , ïa ki duwan jingiwbih jong ki yn pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad ïa ki jingtei jong ki baroh yn sa pynjot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jaka shong jong phi baroh ki shnong kin shah pynjot , bad ki jaka ba jrong jong phi kin shah pynjot shuh shuh ba ki nongleh kam sniew jong phi kin shah pynjot bad shah pynjot , bad ki bleithaw jong phi kin shah pynpra bad sangeh noh , bad ki dur jong phi kin shah pynduh noh .

en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel  ; his cupbearers also , and their apparel  ; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .
kha: Ka la ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la sam ha ka miej jong u , ki jaka sah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , ka jingpynbeit ryntih ïa ki nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem jong u bad ki jingriam ba ki phong , ki jaiñ jong ki shakri jong u , kiba ap ha ki jingkhawai bad ki jingainguh ba u kñia ha ka Templ . Ka la shu lyngngoh ngaiñ bad sngewphylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh jong ka miej jong u, bad ka jingshong jong ki shakri jong u, bad ka jingwan jong ki shakri jong u, bad ki jainkup jong u ruh, bad ki jainkup jong ki ruh, bad ka jainkup jong u ruh, da kaba u la leit sha ka iing U Trai; ym don mynsiem shuh ha ka .

en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness  ;
kha: Lada jia ba ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki duwai sha me , ki da phla haduh katno ki la long kiba pop bad kiba bymman , to sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ki A  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada kin pyrkhat ia lade ha ka ri ha kaba la rah ia ki mraw, bad kin kylla bamut, bad kin kyrpad ia me ha ka ri jong kita kiba la rah ia ki mraw, da kaba ong: Ngi la leh pop bad ngi la leh khlem akor;

en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom , and which is in the valley of the giants on the north , and descended to the valley of Hinnom , to the side of Jebusi on the south , and descended to En–rogel ,
kha: Nangta u hiar arsut shaduh trai jong u lum na uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Hinnom , ha ka tduh kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Them Rephaim . Nangta u suh arsut lyngba ka Them Hinnom , shathie na ka sharing lum jong ka Jebus , sha ka Enrogel .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la hiar sha ka tduh jong u lum uba don ha khmat ka them u khun Hinnom bad kaba don ha ka them ki rangbah shaphang shathie bad u la hiar sha ka them Hinnom sha ka liang ka Jebusi shaphang shathie bad u la hiar sha ka them Enrogel .

en: The  Lord  hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul , in whose stead thou hast reigned  ; and the  Lord  hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son : and , behold , thou art taken in thy mischief , because thou art a bloody man .
kha: Me la knieh ïa ka hima jong u Saul , bad mynta U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa me namar ka jingpynïap ïa kiba bun na ka longïing jong u Saul . U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka hima ha u Absalom , u khun jong me , bad me la jot , ma me u nongpynïap briew !
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynphai biang ia ka snam jong ka iing u Saul, ha ka jaka jong u u la synshar ; bad U Trai u la aiti ia ka hima ha ka kti u khun jong me: bad, ha khmih, me la shim ha ka jingsniew jong me, namar me long u briew uba snam .

en: And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .
kha: Phi la jam ïa ka Jordan bad wan poi sha ka Jerikho . Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , kumba la leh ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . Hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la leit sha shiliang ka Jordan, bad ki briew jong ka Jerikho ki la ialeh pyrshah ia phi, ki Amorit bad ki Peris bad ki Kanaan bad ki Hit bad ki Girgash bad ki Hebus; bad nga la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong phi .

en: But the people answered , Thou shalt not go forth : for if we flee away , they will not care for us  ; neither if half of us die , will they care for us : but now thou art worth ten thousand of us : therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city .
kha: Phim dei ban leit lang bad ngi ,  ki la ong .  Kam don jingktah ei ei ïa u nongshun lada kiba sah na ngi ki phai dien bad phet lane lada shiteng na ngi ki la shah pynïap ; hynrei phi ïaryngkat dor bad shiphew hajar ngut na ngi . Kan kham bha lada phi shong hangne ha ka nongbah bad phah jingïarap ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la jubab: Me dei ban leit noh: namar lada ngi phet noh, kin ym sumar ia ngi ; lymne lada shiteng na ngi ngin iap: hynrei mynta me long shi hajar ngut na ngi: namarkata mynta ka kham bha ba me iarap ia ngi na ka shnong .

en: Speak , I pray you , in the ears of all the men of Shechem , Whether is better for you , either that all the sons of Jerubbaal , which are threescore and ten persons , reign over you , or that one reign over you ? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh .
kha: ban kylli ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ,  Kano phi kham mon ? Ba baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon kin synshar ïa phi ne tang da uwei u briew ? Kynmaw ba u Abimelekh u dei u para doh para snam jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren, nga kyrpad ia phi, ha ki shkor jong ki shynrang baroh jong u Shechem, Hato ka kham bha ia phi, ne ba ki khun shynrang jong u Jerubaal baroh, kiba long hynriewphew ngut ki briew, ki synshar halor jong phi, ne ba uwei u synshar halor jong phi ? kynmaw ruh ba nga long ka shyieng bad ka doh jong phi .

en: And it shall come to pass , that as the  Lord  rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you  ; so the  Lord  will rejoice over you to destroy you , and to bring you to nought  ; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u pynmanbha bad pynroi ïa phi da kaba kmen , kumta ruh da kaba kmen un pynjot bad pynduh pyndam ïa phi . Yn sa rat dyngkhong ïa phi na kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba kumba U Trai u la sngewbha ia phi ban leh bha ia phi, bad ban pynbun ia phi; kumta U Trai un sngewbha ia phi ban pynjot ia phi, bad ban wanrah ia phi sha ka jaka kaba khlem sangeh bad phin sa shah rong noh na ka ri kaba phi leit ban ioh ia ka .

en: And it shall come to pass , that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit  ; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare : for the windows from on high are open , and the foundations of the earth do shake .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban lait na ka jingshyrkhei un hap ha ka  liewlep , bad uno uno uba lait na ka  liewlep un ngat ha ka jingriam . U  lapbah un theh na suiñbneng , bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei yn pynkhih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba uta uba phet noh na ka jingsawa jong ka jingtieng un hap ha ka thliew ; bad uta uba wan shaneng na pdeng ka thliew un shah shim ha ka snare: namar ki jingkhang na jrong ki plie , bad ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ki khih .

en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me , because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor  ; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted , to preach deliverance to the captives , and recovering of sight to the blind , to set at liberty them that are bruised ,
kha: U Mynsiem jong U Trai u long ha nga , namar ba u la jied ïa nga ban wallam ka khubor babha ha kiba duk . U la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ka jingpyllaitluid ïa ki koidi bad ka jingpynïoh ïa ka jingimat ha kiba matlah ; ban pyllait ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Trai u don halor jong nga , namar u la pynsleh ia nga ban ialap ia ka gospel sha kiba duk ; u la phah ia nga ban pynkoit ia kiba la tyrkhong , ban ialap ia ka jingpyllait im sha ki mraw bad ban pynkoit ia kiba matlah , ban set ia kiba la tyrkhong .

en: Tell ye , and bring them near  ; yea , let them take counsel together : who hath declared this from ancient time ? who hath told it from that time ? have not I the  Lord  ? and there is no God else beside me  ; a just God and a Saviour  ; there is none beside me .
kha: Ale bad ai ïa ka kam jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; ai ba ki nongïasaid kin ïasyllok uwei ïa uwei pat . Mano ba la ïathuhlypa slem mynshuwa kaei ban jia ? Hato ym dei ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei uba pynim ïa la ki briew ? Ym don uwei pat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia phi, bad wanrah ia ki hajan uyesyes, to ai ba kin ia kren lang: mano ba la pynbna ia kane naduh kata ka por ? mano ba la iathuh ia ka naduh kata ka por ? bad ym don Blei shuh nalor jong nga; u Blei uba hok bad u Nongpynim; ym don shuh nalor jong nga .

en: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands , burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt , whither ye be gone to dwell , that ye might cut yourselves off , and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth ?
kha: Balei ba phi pynbitar ïa nga da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad da kaba kñia ha kiwei ki blei hangne ha Ijipt , ha kaba phi la wan ban shong ban sah ? Hato phi leh ïa kane ban pynjot ïa lade , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei kin ñiewbeiñ ïa phi bad pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba phi pynkhih ia nga da ki kam jong phi, da kaba thang ia kiwei pat ki blei ha ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la leit sah , ba phin ot noh ia lade bad ba phin long ka jingtim bad ka jingshah lehbein hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew ?

en: The  Lord  hath done that which he had devised  ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee , he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .
kha: Nga kner ïa la ki kti , hynrei ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga . U  Trai  u la khot ïa ki nongshun pyrshah ïa nga na ki liang baroh ; ki la leh ïa nga kum ïa kaei kaei kaba jakhlia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leh ia kata kaba u la thmu; u la pyndep ia ka ktien jong u ha ki sngi hyndai: u la pynhap noh: bad u la pynlong ia u nongshun jong me ban sngewbha halor jong me .

en: And he smote the men of Beth–shemesh , because they had looked into the ark of the  Lord  , even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men : and the people lamented , because the  Lord  had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynïap hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah kiba na Beth Shemesh namar ba ki khmih shapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . Bad u paidbah u ïam pangnud namar ba U  Trai  u la pynjia kat kata ka jingpynïap hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shoh ia ki briew jong ka Bethshesh, namar ki la peit sha ka synduk U Trai, wat u la shoh ia ki briew sanphew hajar bad shiphew ngut ki briew: bad ki briew ki la iam namar ba U Trai u la pyniap ia kiba bun ki briew da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw .

en: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands , that they should not worship devils , and idols of gold , and silver , and brass , and stone , and of wood : which neither can see , nor hear , nor walk :
kha: Kiba sah na u bynriew , baroh kito kiba ym shym la pynïap noh da kine ki jingïapthem , kim shym la phai noh na kaei kaba ki hi ki la pynlong . Kim shym la sangeh ban mane ïa ki ksuid , lane ïa ki blei ba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , u maw , bad da ka dieng , ki bym lah ban ïohi , ne ïohsngew , ne ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki briew ki bym shym la shah pyniap ha kine ki khlam ki dang kylla bamut na ki kam jong ki kti jong ki, ba kim dei ban mane ia ki ksuid bad ki bleithaw ksiar bad rupa bad nar bad maw bad dieng: kiba ym lah ban iohi ne iohsngew ne iaid:

en: Let thy servant , I pray thee , turn back again , that I may die in mine own city , and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother . But behold thy servant Chimham  ; let him go over with my lord the king  ; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee .
kha: Nangta shah ba ngan leit phai pat sha ïing bad ban ïap hajan ka jingtep jong i mei bad i pa jong nga . Une hangne u Shimham , u khun jong nga , u ban shakri ïa phi ; shim ïa u bad phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ; bad leh na ka bynta jong u katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba u shakri jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, un phai biang, ba ngan iap ha la ka jong ka shnong, bad ngan shah tep ha ka jingtep jong u kpa jong nga bad ka kmie jong nga . Hynrei ha khmih u shakri jong me u Chhamham; to u leit noh bad u syiem jong nga; bad leh ia u ia kaba mon ha me .

en: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high , and fears shall be in the way , and the almond tree shall flourish , and the grasshopper shall be a burden , and desire shall fail : because man goeth to his long home , and the mourners go about the streets :
kha: Phin sheptieng ïa ki jaka kynjang bad ka jingïaid lynti kan long kaba ma . U shñiuh jong phi un kylla lieh ; da kaba shitom eh phin tan pynïaid ïa lade , bad baroh ki jingkwah jong phi kin duh noh . Ngi leit sha ka jaka shongthait kaba khatduh , bad nangta kan don ka jingïambriew ha ki lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh haba kin tieng ia kaba jrong, bad ki jingtieng kin long ha lynti, bad u dieng almond un phuh, bad u phlang un long ka jingkit, bad ka jingkwah kan jah noh: namar u briew u leit sha la iing kaba jrong, bad ki nongsngewsih ki leit kylleng ki surok:

en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom . And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and cast it out to Joab . And he blew a trumpet , and they retired from the city , every man to his tent . And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king .
kha: Nangta ka leit sha ki briew jong ka nongbah lem bad ka jingthmu jong ka , bad ki la khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Sheba bad bret ïa ka sha u Joab nalor ka kynroh . U la put ïa ka turoi kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , bad ki leit phai noh sha ïing . Bad u Joab u la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem sha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kata ka kynthei ka la leit sha ki briew baroh ha ka jingstad jong ka . Ki la ot noh ia ka khlieh jong u Sheba u khun u Bichri bad ki la bret noh ia ka sha u Joab . U la beh ia ka turoi bad ki la shongthait na ka shnong, uwei pa uwei sha ka ïingjahtang jong u . U Joab u la leit phai biang sha Jerusalem sha u syiem .

en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites , and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah , and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year , and see that ye hasten the matter . Howbeit the Levites hastened it not .
kha: U la hukum ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban leit sha ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ban lum na ki briew baroh kat ban biang ban shna pynbha ïa ka Templ man ka snem . U ong ïa ki ban leh kloi , hynrei ki Lebi ki pyntud ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum lang ia ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad u la ong ha ki: To leit sha ki shnong Judah bad lum pisa na ki Israel baroh ban pynbha ia ka iing U Blei jong phi man la u snem . Katba ki Lebi kim shym la pynkloi ia ka .

en: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong  ; there hath not been ever the like , neither shall be any more after it , even to the years of many generations .
kha: Kan sa long ka sngi kaba dum bad kaba pynlong jingkhuslai , ka sngi kaba ïong bad ba-dum lyoh . Ka kynhun bakhraw jong ki puit ka tur kum ka jingdum kaba pyiar halor ki lumbah . Ym ju don mynno mynno ruh kum kane , bad yn ym don shuh lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi jong ka jingdum bad ka jingdum, ka sngi jong ki lyoh bad ka jingdum kaba jylliew, katba ka step ka la saphriang halor ki lum: ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad ka met kaba khlain kam shym la long kum kata, lymne kan ym long shuh hadien jong ka, wat haduh ki snem jong ki pateng kiba bun .

en: And Moses called unto Joshua , and said unto him in the sight of all Israel , Be strong and of a good courage : for thou must go with this people unto the land which the  Lord  hath sworn unto their fathers to give them  ; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it .
kha: Nangta u Moses u khot ïa u Joshua , bad hangta ha khmat ki Israel u ong ha u ,  To long uba kut jingmut bad sngewskhem bha , namar me long uta u ban ïalam ïa kine ki briew bad pynïoh kynti ha ki ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la khot ia u Joshua bad u la ong ha u ha khmat ki Israel baroh: To long kiba khlain bad kiba shlur: namar me dei ban leit bad une u briew sha ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban ai ia ki; bad me dei ban pynlong ia ki ban hiar pateng ia ka .

en: If brethren dwell together , and one of them die , and have no child , the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger : her husband s brother shall go in unto her , and take her to him to wife , and perform the duty of an husband s brother unto her .
kha: Lada ar ngut shi para ki ïashong lang ha kajuh ka jaka bad uwei na ki u ïap khlem da ïoh khun shynrang , ka tnga jong uta uba ïap kam dei ban shongkurim ïa uno uno u bym dei na ka ïing ka sem jong u ; u para jong uta uba la ïap u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki hynmen ki shong lang bad uwei na ki u iap, bad ka tnga jong kiba iap kan ym shongkurim khlem u nongwei: u hynmen jong ka un leit shapoh jong ka bad un shim ia ka ha u bad un leh ia ka kamram jong u hynmen jong ka .

en: That he told her all his heart , and said unto her , There hath not come a razor upon mine head  ; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother s womb : if I be shaven , then my strength will go from me , and I shall become weak , and be like any other man .
kha: Ha kaba khatduh u ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha .  Ïa u shñiuh jong nga ym pat ju khap ,  u ong ,  Ïa nga la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir naduh ka por ba kha ïa nga . Lada la khi ïa u shñiuh jong nga , ngan duh noh ïa ka bor bad ngan long uba tlot kumba long lem kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u la iathuh ia ka da ka dohnud baroh kawei bad u la ong ha ka, Ym shym la wan ka jingsma ha ka khlieh jong nga ; namar nga la long u Nazarete ha U Blei na ka kpoh jong nga: lada nga shah ot noh, te ka bor jong nga kan leit noh na nga, bad ngan sa tlot kum uwei pat u briew .

en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .
kha: U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka jaka mane ha Bethel kaba la tei da u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop . U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka duwan , u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki maw jong ka , bad u pynlwet phum ïa ki ; u la thang ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Asherah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka jaka bam kaba don ha Betel bad ka jaka kaba jrong kaba u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat u la leh pop, baroh ar kata ka jaka bad ka jaka kaba jrong kaba u la thang, bad u la thang ia ka jaka kaba jrong, bad u la thang ia ka da ka sniehdoh .

en: Therefore go thou , and read in the roll , which thou hast written from my mouth , the words of the  Lord  in the ears of the people in the  Lord s  house upon the fasting day : and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities .
kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa me ban rung hangta ha kawei pat ka sien ba ki briew kin ïashahjingit . Men pule jam na ka kot kli , khnang ba kin ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh ba U  Trai  u la lah ong ha nga bad ba nga la dep phah thoh ha me . Leh ïa kane ha ka jaka ba baroh ki lah ban ïohsngew ïa me , kynthup ïa ki paid Judah kiba la wan rung shapoh na ki shnong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to leit sha ka roll kaba me la thoh na ka shyntur jong nga, ki ktien U Trai ha ki shkor jong ki briew ha ka iing U Trai ha ka sngi ba u la shah jingstet: bad ruh me dei ban pule ia ki ha ki shkor jong ki Judah baroh kiba mih na ki shnong jong ki .

en: And afterward they made ready for themselves , and for the priests : because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night  ; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves , and for the priests the sons of Aaron .
kha: Hadien ba la dep ïa kane , ki Lebi ki pynbiang doh na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , namar ba ki lyngdoh ki bunkam haduh mynmiet , ha kaba thang tylli ïa ki jingri bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ki la pynkhreh ia lade, bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh: namar ki lyngdoh ki la trei shitom ha kaba ai ia ki jingknia thang bad ka shini haduh ban da miet; namarkata ki Lebi ki la pynkhreh ia lade bad na ka bynta ki lyngdoh ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron .
