en: And they took strong cities , and a fat land , and possessed houses full of all goods , wells digged , vineyards , and oliveyards , and fruit trees in abundance : so they did eat , and were filled , and became fat , and delighted themselves in thy great goodness .
kha: Ki briew jong me ki la jop ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , ki ri baseisoh , ki ïing ba-dap da ka spah , ki pukri ba la dep tih lypa , ki dieng Olib , ki diengsoh , ki bri sohwaiñ . Ki bam ïa baroh kaba ki kwah bad ki man sngaid ; ki lehkmen ha baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba me la ai ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki nongbah kiba khlain, bad ka ri kaba heh, bad ki don ki iing kiba dap da ki mar baroh, ki thliew sohjew bad ki kper soh ha ka jingbun: kumta ki la bam, bad ki la dap, bad ki la sngewbha ia lade ha ka jingbha jong me kaba khraw .

en: These are the generations of Jacob . Joseph , being seventeen years old , was feeding the flock with his brethren  ; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah , and with the sons of Zilpah , his father s wives : and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report .
kha: bad kane ka dei ka khana shaphang ka longïing longsem jong u Jakob . U Joseph , u samla uba la khathynñiew snem ka rta , u ap sumar ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang lem bad la ki hynmen shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong ka Bilhah bad ka Silpah , ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Joseph u wanrah ki jingïathuh bymsngewtynnat ha la u kpa shaphang kaei ba ki hynmen jong u ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki pateng jong u Jakob . U Joseph, haba u la dap shiphew snem ka rta, u la ai bam ia ka kynhun bad ki hynmen jong u ; bad u khynnah u la don bad ki khun shynrang jong u Bilhah bad ki khun shynrang jong u u Zilpah: bad u Joseph u la wanrah ha u kpa jong u ia ka khubor kaba sniew jong u .

en: Thou , even thou , art  Lord  alone  ; thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host , the earth , and all things that are therein , the seas , and all that is therein , and thou preservest them all  ; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .
kha: Bad nangta ki Israel ki duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai :  Ma me , Ko  Trai  , tang ma me hi marwei me long U  Trai  ; me thaw ïa ki bneng bad ki khlur jong ka sahit bneng . Me thaw ïa ka ryngkew bad ïa ka duriaw bad baroh kiba don ha ki ; me ai jingim ïa baroh . Ki bor ha bneng ki dem bad ki mane ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me, wat me, ko Trai tang ma me, me la thaw ia ka bneng, ka bneng jong ki bneng, bad ki shipai jong ki baroh, ka khyndew bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka, ki duriaw bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka, bad me pynneh pynsah ia ki baroh; bad ka kynhun ki bneng ka mane ia me .

en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her : for he said , My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel , because the places are holy , whereunto the ark of the  Lord  hath come .
kha: U Solomon u wan ïalam noh ïa la ka tnga , ka khun u syiem Ijipt , na ka Nongbah u Dabid sha ka ïing ba u la tei ïa ka . U ong ,  Kam dei ban shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Dabid , u syiem ka Israel , namar ha kano kano ka jaka ha kaba ka Synduk ka Jutang ka la don ka long kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la wanrah ia ka khun jong u Pharaoh na ka shnong u Dabid sha ka iing kaba u la tei na ka bynta jong ka: namar u la ong: Ka tnga jong nga kan ym shong ha ka iing u Dabid u syiem Israel , namar ki jaka ki long kiba khuid , ha kaba ka synduk U Trai ka la wan .

en: And his daughter in law , Phinehas  wife , was with child , near to be delivered : and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken , and that her father in law and her husband were dead , she bowed herself and travailed  ; for her pains came upon her .
kha: Ka pyrsa kurim u Eli , ka tnga u Phinehas , ka la armet , bad ka la jan dei ka por ba kan kha khun . Haba ka ïohsngew ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ba u kthaw kurim bad u tnga jong ka ki la ïap , kynsan ka la suh kha bad ka la kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khun jong u, ka tnga jong u, ka la don ha ka por ba la kha khun: bad haba ka la iohsngew ia ka khubor ba la shim ia ka synduk U Blei , bad ba u kpa tymmen jong ka bad u tnga jong ka ki la iap , ka la dem khrup bad ka la kha khun namar ki jingpang jong ka ki la wan ha ka .

en: And say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid  ; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them .
kha: Nangta sa ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam ïa u shakri jong nga u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia sha kane ka jaka , bad un buh ïa ka khet jong u halor kine ki maw kiba me la tep , bad un pyiar ïa ka ïingjaiñ syiem halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai jong ki Israel; Ha khmih , ngan phah bad shim ia u syiem Babilon , u shakri jong nga , bad ngan buh ia ka khet jong u halor kine ki maw kiba nga la buhrieh bad un pynphriang ia ka pavilion syiem jong u halor jong ki .

en: In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynriew , U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa . Ka khubor ka la long na ka bynta u lat ka Judah , u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel , bad na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Darius u syiem, ha ka sngi kaba hynriew, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Serubabel u khun u Shealtiel u Lat ka Judah bad ha u Joshua u khun u Jehozadak u rangbah lyngdoh .

en: And they said , The man asked us straitly of our state , and of our kindred , saying , Is your father yet alive ? have ye another brother ? and we told him according to the tenor of these words : could we certainly know that he would say , Bring your brother down ?
kha: Ki jubab ,  Uta u briew u ïai kylli bniah shaphang jong ngi bad shaphang ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi , u da ong , ‘ I pa jong phi i dang im ne em ? Phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’ Ngi hap ban jubab ïa kita ki jingkylli . Kumno ngi lah ban tip ba un ong ïa ngi ban wan ïalam ïa u para jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong , Uta u briew u la kylli ia ngi da kaba sngap jar ia ka jylla jong ngi, bad na ki paralok jong ngi, u da ong, Hato u kpa jong phi u dang im ? phi don uwei pat u hynmen ? bad ngi la iathuh ia u kat kum ka por jong kine ki kyntien: hato ngi lah ban tip shisha ba un ong , To wanrah ia u hynmen jong phi shapoh ?

en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom , saying , Let me , I pray thee , pass through thy land : but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab : but he would not consent : and Israel abode in Kadesh .
kha: Nangta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Edom ban pan jingbit ban ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Hynrei u syiem Edom um shym shah ïa ki . Ki kyrpad ruh ïa u syiem Moab , u ruh um shym shah ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki hap ban sah ha Kadesh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u syiem u Edom, ki da ong: To ai ba ngan iaid lyngba ka ri jong me: hynrei u syiem u Edom un ym sngap ia kata . Bad kumjuh ruh ki la phah sha u syiem u Moab: hynrei um shym la mynjur: bad ki Israel kin sah ha Kadesh .

en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer an offering unto the  Lord  before the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; blood shall be imputed unto that man  ; he hath shed blood  ; and that man shall be cut off from among his people :
kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u pynïap ïa u masi lane u langbrot lane  langsohmoh kum ka jingainguh ïa U  Trai  hangno hangno lait noh ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum . U la pynmih snam bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew ki jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat wanrah ia ka ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingmane jong ka jingiaseng, ban aiti ia ka jingainguh ha U Trai ha khmat ka iingmane jong U Trai; ka snam kan long kaba la pynngat ha uta u briew; u la pynmih snam; bad uta u briew un shah ot noh na ki briew jong u:

en: And Joshua said , Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you , and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Hivites , and the Perizzites , and the Girgashites , and the Amorites , and the Jebusites .
kha: Katba phi nang tur sha khmat , un beh noh da shisha ïa ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Hib , ki Peris , ki Girgash , ki Amor , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong , Da kane phin sa tip ba U Blei uba im u don hapdeng jong phi bad ba un beh noh na khmat jong phi ia ki nong Kanaan bad ki Hit bad ki Hit bad ki Perizi bad ki Girgash bad ki Amorit bad ki Jesus .

en: But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .
kha: Pynban um shym la pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong ki , hynrei u la bud ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha Ka Hukum u Moses :  Ïa ki kmie ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba ma u hi u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei um shym la pyniap ia ki khun jong ki, hynrei u la leh kumba la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses, ha kaba U Trai u la hukum da kaba ong: Ki kpa kin ym iap na ka bynta ki khun , lymne ki khun kin ym iap na ka bynta ki kpa tymmen , hynrei uwei pa uwei un iap na ka bynta la ka jong ka pop .

en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres , which he had made for himself in the city of David , and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries  art : and they made a very great burning for him .
kha: bad la tep ha ka jingtep mawsiang ïa kaba u la shna na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka nongbah u Dabid . Ki la pyndonkam ki musla bad ki umphniang iwbih ban pynkhreh ïa ka met jong u na ka bynta ka jingontep , bad ki la tei ïa ka ding kaba khraw ban leh sngewsih ïa ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tep ia u ha la ki jong ki jingtep, kiba u la shna na ka bynta lade ha ka shnong u Dabid, bad ki la buh ia u ha ka jingthiah kaba la pyndap da ki jingsma kiba thiang bad ki jait jingbam ba thiang ba la pynkhreh da ki jingbam ba thiang: bad ki la thang shibun eh ia u .

en: Else , if thou wilt not let my people go , behold , I will send swarms of flies upon thee , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thy houses : and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground whereon they are .
kha: Lada mem treh , ngan pynshitom ïa me da kaba phah ïa ki skain sha me , sha ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad sha ki briew jong me . Ki ïing jong ki nong Ijipt bad ka madan madiah baroh kin dap da ki skain suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta lada phim pyllait ia ki briew jong nga, ha khmih, ngan phah ia ki khnai ha me, bad ha ki shakri jong me, bad ha ki briew jong me, bad ha ki iing jong me: bad ki iing jong ki nong Ijipt kin dap da ki khnai kiba jylliew bad ruh ha ka khyndew ha kaba ki don .

en: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel , I said unto Peter before them all , If thou , being a Jew , livest after the manner of Gentiles , and not as do the Jews , why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews ?
kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba kim shym la ïaid ha ka lynti kaba beit jong ka jingshisha ka Gospel , nga la ong ïa u Petros ha khmat jong ki baroh ,  Me dei u Jiw , pynban , me la im kum u Jentil , ym kum u Jiw . Kumno te , me lah ban pynbor ïa ki Jentil ban im kum ki Jiw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba nga iohi ba kim iaid beit kat kum ka jingshisha jong ka gospel , nga la ong ha u Petros ha khmat jong ki baroh: Lada me long u Jiw , me im kat kum ka rukom jong ki Jutang bad ym kum ki Jiw , balei me pynbor ia ki Jutang ban im kumba ki Jiw ki im ?

en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth  ; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night , that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein : for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous , and then thou shalt have good success .
kha: Pynthikna ba ïa kane ka kitab ka Hukum dei ban pule borabor ha ka jingmane jong me . Puson ïa ka mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la thoh ha ka . Te men sa manbha bad long uba jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka Kitab ka hukum kan ym mih na ka shyntur jong me hynrei men pyrkhat ha ka sngi bad ka miet , ba me lah ban peit ban leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh ha ka: namar nangta men pynlong ia ka lynti jong me kaba roi bad nangta men sa ioh ia ka jingjop kaba bha .

en: Therefore hear the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Edom  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them .
kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga don pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Edom , bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah Teman . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad uwei pa uwei un sngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iohsngew ia ka jingmut jong U Trai, ba u la shim ia ka Edom ; bad ki jingthmu jong u, ba u la thmu pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Teman: Hooid u la pynlong ia ki jaka shong jong ki ban jah noh bad ki .

en: For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father : and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra ba u Josaïah u long syiem , haba u dang khynnah bha , u sdang ban mane ïa U Blei jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u . Saw snem hadien u sdang ban pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad baroh kiwei de ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar jong u, katba u dang rit, u la sdang ban wad ia U Blei u kpa jong u: bad ha ka snem kaba shiphew u la sdang ban pynkhuid ia ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem na ki jaka ba jrong, bad ki lum bad ki dur ba la ker bad ki dur ba la khleh lang .

en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and pour out their blood by the force of the sword  ; and let their wives be bereaved of their children , and be widows  ; and let their men be put to death  ; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle .
kha: Hynrei mynta , ko  Trai  , ai ba ki khun jong ki , kin ym ïoh jingbam haduh ban da ïap ; ai ba kin shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ai ba ki kynthei kin duh noh ïa la ki tnga bad ïa ki khun jong ki ; ai ba ki rangbah kin ïap na ka jingpang bad ba ki samla shynrang kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to aiti noh ia ki khun jong ki sha ka jingkyrduh bam , bad to theh ia ka snam jong ki da ka bor jong ka waitlam bad ai ba ki tnga jong ki kin shah pynduh noh ia ki khun jong ki; bad to ai ba ki tnga jong ki kin shah pyniap;

en: The land also shall be left of them , and shall enjoy her sabbaths , while she lieth desolate without them : and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity : because , even because they despised my judgments , and because their soul abhorred my statutes .
kha: Nyngkong , la kumno kumno , ka ri ka dei ban lait na ki briew jong ka , ba kumta kan ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingshongthait kaba pura , bad ki dei ban shah pynshitom ha ban da biang namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri ruh kan sah noh na ki, bad kan sngewbha ia ki sngi shongthait jong ka, katba ka dang sah khlem ma ki: bad kin pdiang ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingbymhok jong ki: namar ba ki la lehbein ia ki jingbishar jong nga, bad namar ba ka mynsiem jong ki ka la sngewsih ia ki ain jong nga .

en: And ye have this day rejected your God , who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations  ; and ye have said unto him , Nay , but set a king over us . Now therefore present yourselves before the  Lord  by your tribes , and by your thousands .
kha: Nga long U Blei jong phi , uta uba pyllait ïa phi na ki jingjynjar bad ki jingshitom jong phi baroh hynrei mynta phi la kyntait ïa nga bad phi la pan na nga ban ai ïa phi da u syiem . Namar kata , ïalumlang ïa lade ha khmat U  Trai  , shi jait shi jait , bad shi kur shi kur .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la kyntait ia U Blei jong phi ha kane ka sngi, uba hi u la pynim ia phi na ki jingeh bad ki jingjynjar jong phi baroh .

en: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing : for Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , took of the accursed thing : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against the children of Israel .
kha: Ïa ka jinghukum U  Trai  ïa ki Israel ban ym shim na Jerikho ïa kaei kaei kaba dei ban pynjot thiaw , ym shym la kohnguh . U briew uba kyrteng u Akhan um shym la kohnguh ïa kata ka hukum , bad kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa ki Israel . ( U Akhan u dei u khun jong u Karmi bad u ksiew jong u Sabdi , bad uba na ka kur Serah , kaba long shi bynta na ka jait Judah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun Israel ki la leh ia ka kam kaba la shah kyntait: namar u Achan u khun u Carmi u khun u Jabdi u khun u Zraham u khun u Judah u la shim ia ka kam kaba la shah kyntait: bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki khun Israel .

en: Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .
kha: Nangta ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïaid tawiar ïa ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab haduh ba kin da poi ha ka dong mihngi jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka wah Arnon . Ki sher dara hangta , hynrei kim shym jam ïa ka Arnon namar u dei u pud ki Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la iaid lyngba ka ri khlaw, bad ki la ker sawdong ia ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab, bad ki la wan shaphang mihngi jong ka ri Moab, bad ki la iaid sha shiliang kawei pat ka liang jong u Arnon: namar u Arnon u la long u pud u sam jong u Moab .

en: Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered ,  Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .
kha: Kumta u Pilat u la kylli ïa u ,  Haba kumta , me , me dei u syiem ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me hi me ong ba nga long u syiem . Ïa nga la kha bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei na ka bynta kane kawei ka jingthmu , ban kren shaphang ka jingshisha . Uno uno uba dei jong ka jingshisha u shahshkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u: Me long u syiem te ? U Jisu u la jubab , Me ong ba nga long u syiem . Ha kane ka daw la kha ia nga bad na kane ka daw nga la wan sha ka pyrthei , ba nga dei ban sakhi ia ka jingshisha . Uwei pa uwei uba long na ka jingshisha u iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga .

en: Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .
kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki mraw bad ban ym pynlong mraw shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki rangbah baroh bad ki briew baroh kiba la rung ha ka jutang ki la iohsngew ba uwei pa uwei un pyllait ia la u briew bad uwei pa uwei u shakri jong u, u la leit noh khlem da shakri shuh ia lade na ki, te ki la kohnguh bad ki la pyllait noh ia ki .

en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Behold , this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the  Lord   ; and such things have befallen me : and if I had eaten the sin offering to day , should it have been accepted in the sight of the  Lord  ?
kha: Te u Aaron u jubab ,  Lada nga la bam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop mynta ka sngi , hato U  Trai  un sngewbha ? Ki paidbah ki la wallam ïa la ki jingkñia namar ka pop sha U  Trai  mynta ka sngi , bad ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang jong ki , pynban kum kine kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei ki dang wan jia ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la ong ha u Moses, Ha kane ka sngi ki la aiti ia ka jingknia pop bad ka jingknia thang jong ki ha khmat U Trai ; bad kum kita kiei kiei ki la jia ha nga: bad lada nga la bam ia ka jingknia pop ha ka sngi , hato la pdiang ia ka ha khmat U Trai ?

en: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?
kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la sdang ban hikai ha ka synagog . Bun ki briew ki la don hangta ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u , baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .  Ka jingstad aïu kane ba la ai ha u ? Kumno u leh ïa ki kambah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sngi Sabha ka la poi, u la sdang ban hikai ha ka synagog: bad bun ki la lyngngoh, ki da ong: Naei une u briew ia kine kiei kiei ? bad kaei ka jingstad kaba la ai ha u , ba wat ia kine ki kam kiba khraw la leh da ki kti jong u ?

en: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest , The king hath commanded me a business , and hath said unto me , Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee , and what I have commanded thee : and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga wan hangne na ka bynta ka kam u syiem . U ong ïa nga ban ym don mano mano ban tip ïa kaei kaba u la phah ïa nga ban leh . Shaphang ki briew jong nga pat , nga la ïapynbeit ba kin ïakynduh ïa nga ha kawei ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Ahimeleh u lyngdoh, bad u la ong ha nga, Wat ai ba uno uno un tip ia ka kam ha kaba nga phah ia me bad ia kaei kaba nga la hukum ia me: bad nga la thung ia ki shakri jong nga ha kata ka jaka .

en: And he said unto his mother , The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee , about which thou cursedst , and spakest of also in mine ears , behold , the silver is with me  ; I took it . And his mother said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my son .
kha: U ong ha la ka kmie ,  Mynba don ba tuh ïa ki shi hajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na phi , phi buh ka jingtim halor uta u nongtuh . Nga la ïohsngew phi leh kumta . Khmih , nga don ka pisa . Dei ma nga uba shim ïa ki .  Ka kmie jong u ka ong ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko khun jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka kmie jong u, Ki shiphew spah tylli ki rupa kiba la shim na me, shaphang kata kaba me la tim, bad kaba la kren ha ki shkor jong nga ruh, ha khmih kata ka rupa ka don bad nga; nga la shim ia ka . Bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong: To long uba la kyrkhu na U Trai, ko khun jong nga .

en: And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .
kha: Ki kylli ,  Hato don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel baroh ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha Mispah ?  ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bakyntang ba uno uno u bym shym la leit sha Mispah un shah pynïap . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ong , Mano ba don hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh ki bym shym la wan shaneng bad ka jingiaseng sha U Trai ? Namar ki la leh ia ka jingsmai kaba khraw shaphang uta u bym shym la wan shaneng sha U Trai sha U Trai sha Mizpah da kaba ong: U la shah pyniap shisha .

en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword  ; and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters : for I will pour their wickedness upon them .
kha: Ki briew ha kiba ki la kren ïa kine kiei kiei kin ïap ha kajuh ka rukom . Ïa ki met jong ki yn bret shabar ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki . Kane kan jia ha ki baroh — kynthup ïa ki tnga jong ki , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki . Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew kiba ki iathuhlypa kin shah bret noh ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem namar ka jingkyrduh bad ka waitlam bad kin ym don shuh ban tep ia ki, ia ki, ne ia ki tnga jong ki, ne ia ki khun shynrang jong ki: namar ngan theh ia ka jingsniew jong ki halor jong ki .

en: But if they be prophets , and if the word of the  Lord  be with them , let them now make intercession to the  Lord  of hosts , that the vessels which are left in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah , and at Jerusalem , go not to Babylon .
kha: Lada ki dei da shisha ki nongïathuhlypa bad lada ki don ïa ka khubor jong nga , shah ïa ki ban kylli ïa nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ban ym shah ïa ki jingkynshew kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem ban shah rah sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ki long ki nongiathuhlypa bad lada ka ktien U Trai ka don bad ki, to ai ba kin leit sha U Trai jong ki paid, ba ki tiar kiba sah ha ka iing U Trai bad ha ka iing u syiem Judah bad ha Jerusalem kim leit sha Babilon .

en: The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: U syiem un ïam pangnud , u khun syiem un duh jingkyrmen , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la leh , bad ngan bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi la bishar ïa kiwei . Kane kan pyn-i ha phi ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem un iam bad u syiem un sa shah rong noh bad ki kti jong ki briew jong ka ri kin sa shah pynshitom: Ngan leh ia ki kat kum ka lynti jong ki, bad kat kum ki ri khlaw jong ki ngan bishar ia ki; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him , and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him : for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :
kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Joram , u khun jong u ban khublei ïa u Syiem Dabid bad ban ai khublei ïa u namar ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh pyrshah la bunsien . U Joram u rah na ka bynta u Dabid ki jingai sngewbha kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u To u la phah ia u khun jong u sha u syiem Dabid, ban ai khublei ia u, bad ban kyrkhu ia u, namar u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Hadadezer: namar u Hadadezer u la ialeh thma bad u To . Bad u Joram u la wanrah ryngkat bad u ia ki tiar rupa bad ki tiar ksiar bad ki tiar nar:

en: And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the  Lord  our God all these things unto us ? then shalt thou answer them , Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land , so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours .
kha: Haba ki kylli balei ba nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , ïathuh ïa ki , ko Jeremaïah , ba kumba ki la phai noh na nga bad shakri ïa ki blei nongwei ha ka ri jong ki hi , kumta kin shakri ïa ki nongwei ha ka ri ka bym dei ka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, haba phin ong, Balei U Trai jong ngi U leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh ha ngi ? te to jubab ia ki , Kumba phi la iehnoh ia nga bad phi la shakri ia ki blei nongwei ha ka ri jong phi .

en: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host , and said unto them , Have her forth of the ranges : and whoso followeth her , let him be slain with the sword . For the priest said , Slay her not in the house of the  Lord .
kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap hapoh ka jaka jong ka Templ , kumta u khot ïa ki rangbah shipai bad u ong ,  Ïalam ïa ka shabar napdeng ki laiñ jong ki nongap phira , bad pynïap ïa uno uno uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jehoiada u lyngdoh u la pynmih ia ki rangbah jong ki spah ngut kiba la buh halor ka kynhun shipai, bad u la ong ha ki, To leh ia ka na ki kynroh: bad uno uno uba bud ia ka, to ai ba un shah pyniap da ka waitlam . Namar u lyngdoh u la ong: Wat pyniap ia ka ha iing U Trai .

en: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart , she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines , saying , Come up this once , for he hath shewed me all his heart . Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and brought money in their hand .
kha: Haba ka Delilah ka sngewthuh ba u la ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha , ka phah ktien sha ki syiem Philistia bad ka ong ,  Wan biang sa shisien . U la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingshisha .  Kumta ki la ïawan bad ki wanrah artat ïa ki sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka Delilah ka la iohi ba u la iathuh ia ka ia ka dohnud jong u baroh kawei, ka la phah bad ka la khot ia ki kynrad jong ki Philistia, ka da ong: To wan shaneng ia kane shisien , namar u la pyni ia nga ia ka dohnud jong u baroh kawei . Nangta ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la wan shaneng sha ka bad ki la wanrah pisa ha ka kti jong ki .

en: And Absalom met the servants of David . And Absalom rode upon a mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak , and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth  ; and the mule that was under him went away .
kha: Kynsan u Absalom u ïakynduh katto katne ki rangbah jong u Dabid . U Absalom u dang shong ha u khashor , bad katba u khashor u dang ïaid napoh u dieng Sning uba heh , ka khlieh u Absalom ka sahkut ha ki tnat dieng . U khashor u la mareh bad u Absalom u la shah iehnoh da kaba sdien ha shiteng suiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la iakynduh ia ki shakri u Dabid . U Absalom u la shong halor u kulai , bad u kulai u la leit shapoh ki tnat kiba heh jong u oak , bad ka khlieh jong u ka la bat ia u oak , bad la rah ia u hapdeng ka bneng bad ka khyndew; bad u kulai uba don hapoh jong u u la leit noh .

en: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers  ; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them , according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses .
kha: Bad lada ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ïa ki , te ngan ym shah ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ym weng shuh ia ka kjat jong ki Israel na ka ri kaba nga la buh na ka bynta ki kpa tymmen jong phi; kumta kin sumar ban leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia ki, kat kum ka hukum baroh kawei bad ki ain bad ki hukum da ka kti u Moses .

en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger , he shall both wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the even : then shall he be clean .
kha: Uno uno u briew , la u dei u Israel ne u nongwei , uba bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad un sum , bad ap haduh janmiet shuwa ba yn ñiew ïa u ba u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem kaba bam ia kaba la iap hi, ne kaba la shah pynpra da ki mrad , la ka long kawei na ka ri jong phi ne u nongwei , un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un sait ia lade ha ka um bad un long uba khlem khuid haduh ka por janmiet: nangta un sa khuid .

en: And when they arose early on the morrow morning , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the  Lord   ; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold  ; only the stump of Dagon was left to him .
kha: Kum la shai dang step phyrngab ki ïohi ba u mot u la kyllon biang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ha kane ka sien ka khlieh bad ki kti jong u baroh ar tylli ki la dkut bad ki don hamar ka jingkhang ; sah sa tang ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep mynstep , ha khmih u Dagon u la hap ha khyndew ha khmat ka synduk U Trai; bad ka khlieh jong u Dagon bad baroh ar tylli ki kti jong u ki la shah ot noh ha ka jingkhang; tang ka tduh jong u Dagon ka la sah ha u .

en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day , it shall not be accepted , neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it : it shall be an abomination , and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity .
kha: Lada la bam ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba lai , U Blei un ym pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong uta u briew . Ïa kata ka jingainguh yn ym ñiew kum ka jingainguh jong u hynrei yn kheiñ ba ka long ka bymkhuid , bad uno uno uba bam ïa ka un kit hi ïa la ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada don ka doh jong ka jingknia jingsuk jong u ha ka sngi kaba lai , ym dei ban pdiang ia ka , lymne ym dei ban pynngat ia ka ha uta uba ai ia ka: kan long kaba sngewsih , bad ka mynsiem kaba bam ia ka kan kit ia ka jingbymhok jong u .

en: And I will set my jealousy against thee , and they shall deal furiously with thee : they shall take away thy nose and thine ears  ; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword : they shall take thy sons and thy daughters  ; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire .
kha: Namar ba nga bitar ïa pha , ngan shah ïa ki ban leh ïa pha ha ka jingbitar jong ki . Kin ot ïa ka khmut jong pha bad ïa ki shkor jong pha bad kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha . Ho-oid , kin shim ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei na pha bad kin thang im ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka jingsngewsih jong nga pyrshah ia me, bad kin leh bitar ia me: kin weng noh ia ka shyntur jong me bad ki shkor jong me; bad ki shyieng jong me kin hap da ka waitlam: kin shim ia ki khun shynrang jong me bad ki khun kynthei jong me; bad ia ka jingsah jong me yn bam da ka ding .

en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .
kha: U jubab ,  A  Trai  , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri ïa me borabor — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Nga la sngewsih shibun eh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki paid: namar ki khun Israel ki la iehnoh ia ka jutang jong me, ki la pynhap ia ki nongrim jong me, bad ki la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong me da ka waitlam ; bad nga, wat ia nga hi, nga sah sah sah sah; bad ki wad ia ka jingim jong nga, ban shim noh ia ka .

en: Know therefore and understand , that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks , and threescore and two weeks : the street shall be built again , and the wall , even in troublous times .
kha: Kynmaw ïa kane bad to shemphang ïa ka : Naduh ka por ba la ai ïa ka hukum ban tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , tad haduh ba wan u nongïalam ba la jied da U Blei , ki hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem kin leit noh . Ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat lem bad ki lynti bah bad ki jingïada bakhlaiñ , bad kan ïeng haduh hynñiew sien ki hynriewphew ar snem , hynrei kane kan long ka por ki jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Tip namarkata bad sngewthuh , ba naduh ka jingleit sha Jerusalem bad ban tei ia ka Jerusalem haduh u Messiah u Syiem un long hynriew taiew bad hynriewphew taiew: ka lynti kan long kaba la tei pat, bad ka kynroh, wat ha ki por kiba jynjar .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you , and have not walked in my statutes , neither have kept my judgments , neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you  ;
kha: Mynta to sngew , ko Jerusalem , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , Nga ong . Da kaba pham kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga ne sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , pha la pynmih kham bun ki jingeh ban ïa kito ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong pha , pha la shu bud tynneng ïa ki rukom leh jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai Blei Uba kham bun ban ia ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi, bad kim shym la iaid ha ki ain jong nga, lymne kim shym la bat ia ki jingbishar jong nga, lymne kim shym la leh kat kum ki jingbishar jong ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi;

en: And they shall dwell safely therein , and shall build houses , and plant vineyards  ; yea , they shall dwell with confidence , when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God .
kha: Kin im hangta ha ka jingshongshngain . Kin tei ïa ki ïing bad kin pynlong ïa ki bri sohwaiñ . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki paramarjan jong ki baroh kiba la ñiew ïa ki da ka jingibeiñ , bad ki Israel kin shong skhem . Te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin shong suk hangta, bad kin thung ia ki kper sohjew, em, kin shong da ka jingshaniah, haba nga la pyndep ia ki jingbishar halor kita baroh kiba pynjah burom ia ki sawdong jong ki ; bad kin tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart , saying , The seventh year , the year of release , is at hand  ; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother , and thou givest him nought  ; and he cry unto the  Lord  against thee , and it be sin unto thee .
kha: Wat kyntait ban ai kylliang ei ei ïa u , tang namar ba ka snem map ram ka la jan poi . Wat shah ba kum kata ka jingmut bymman kan rung ha phi . Lada phi kyntait ban ai kylliang , un sa kyang ha U  Trai  pyrshah ïa phi , te kan long pop ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ba ym don jingpyrkhat ha ka dohnud bymman jong me, da kaba ong, Ka snem kaba hynriew, ka snem jong ka jingpyllait im, ka don ha kti bad ka khmat jong me ka long kaba sniew pyrshah ia u hynmen baduk jong me, bad me ai ia u da kaba sniew.

en: And it came to pass , after the year was expired , at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab , and his servants with him , and all Israel  ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried still at Jerusalem .
kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem haba ki syiem ki ju leit sha ka thma , u Dabid u la phah ïa u Joab lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad ka kynhun shipai Israel ; ki la jop ïa ki Ammon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah . Hynrei u Dabid hi u la sah ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ba la kut ka snem, ha ka por ba ki syiem ki leit sha ka thma, ba u Dabid u la phah ia u Joab bad ki shakri jong u ryngkat bad u, bad ki Israel baroh ki la pynjot ia ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon bad ki la pynjot ia u Rabbah . Hynrei u Dabid u dang sah ha Jerusalem .

en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven , and with the creeping things of the ground : and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth , and will make them to lie down safely .
kha: Ha kata ka por , ngan pynlong ka jutang bad baroh ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , khnang ba kin ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan weng noh ruh ïa baroh ki tiar thma na ka ri , baroh ki waitlam bad ki ryntieh , bad ngan ailad ba ki briew jong nga kin ïoh im ha ka jingsuk bad jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi ngan leh ia ka jutang na ka bynta jong ki bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki sim bneng bad bad ki jingthung ba jylliew jong ka khyndew: bad ngan pynpra ia ka bow bad ka waitlam bad ka thma na ka khyndew , bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban thiah suk .

en: I am this day fourscore years old : and can I discern between good and evil ? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink ? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women ? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king ?
kha: Nga la dap phraphew snem ka rta , bad ym don shuh kata kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ngam don jingmad shuh ïa kaei ba nga bam bad dih , bad ngam lah shuh ban ïohsngew ïa ki sur jong ki nongrwai . Ngan long tang ka jingbankhia ïa U Syiem Kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga dang saw snem ka rta: bad nga lah ban ithuh hapdeng ka jingbha bad ka jingsniew ? hato u shakri jong me u lah ban sngew ia kaei kaba nga bam ne kaei kaba nga dih ? nga lah ban iohsngew shuh ia ka sur jong ki shynrang kiba rwai bad ki kynthei kiba rwai ? namar kata te u shakri jong me u dang long ka jingkit ia u kynrad jong nga u syiem ?

en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely because my flock became a prey , and my flock became meat to every beast of the field , because there was no shepherd , neither did my shepherds search for my flock , but the shepherds fed themselves , and fed not my flock  ;
kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , phin kham bha ba phi shahshkor ïa nga . Ki langbrot jong nga ki la shah patar ha ki mradkhlaw kiba pynïap bad bam ïa ki namar bym don u nongsharai . Ki nongsharai jong nga kim shym la pyrshang ban wad ïa ki langbrot . Ki la sumar bha ïa lade bad ym ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang im , ong U Blei Trai , shisha namar ba ka kynhun jong nga ka la kylla long ka jingbam ha uwei pa uwei u mrad lyngkha , namar ym don nongap langbrot jong nga , hynrei ki nongap langbrot jong nga kim shym la wad ia ka kynhun jong nga;

en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone , and salt , and burning , that it is not sown , nor beareth , nor any grass groweth therein , like the overthrow of Sodom , and Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim , which the  Lord  overthrew in his anger , and in his wrath :
kha: Ki lyngkha kin long shrah bad kin ym seisoh shuh , naba kin dap da u kyndok bad ka mluh suda ; yn ym thung ei ei hangta , bad wat u ñiut ruh , un ym mih hangta . Ka ri jong phi kan long kum ki shnong Sodom bad Gomorrah , kum ka Admah bad ka Seboiim , ïa kiba U  Trai  u la pynjot mynba u bitar shla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba ka ri baroh kawei ka long kaba jyrngam, bad kaba thang, ba ym shym la bet, ne kaba khlem shah, ne uno uno u phlang u mih ha ka, kum ka jingtwa jong u Sodom bad u Gomorrah, u Admah bad u Seboiim, kiba U Trai u la pynkhih ha ka jingbitar jong u:

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; In those days it shall come to pass , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations , even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew , saying , We will go with you : for we have heard that God is with you .
kha: Ha kito ki sngi shiphew ngut ki nongwei kin wan sha uwei u Jiw bad ong , ‘ Ngi kwah ban ïoh bynta ha ka lawei jong phi , namar ngi la lah ïohsngew ba U Blei u don bad phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid Ha kita ki sngi kan sa jia, ba shiphew ngut ki briew kin shim na ki ktien baroh jong ki jaitbynriew, wat kin bat ia ka tduh jong uta uba long u Jiw, da kaba ong: Ngin ia leit bad phi: namar ngi la iohsngew ba U Blei U don ryngkat bad phi .

en: Then said she , I pray thee , let the king remember the  Lord  thy God , that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more , lest they destroy my son . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth .
kha: Ka ong ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , sngewbha duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , khnang ba u ba-ha-ïing jong nga uba kitkhlieh ban wad kput na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u khun jong nga un ym leh ïa ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw da kaba pynïap ïa uwei pat u khun jong nga .   Nga kular ha U  Trai  uba im ,  u Dabid u jubab ,  ba ïa u khun jong pha yn ym pynmynsaw da lei lei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la ong , nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba u syiem un kynmaw ia U Trai U Blei jong me, ba phin ym shah shuh ia ki nongpynshitom bein ia ka snam ban pynjot shuh shuh ia u khun jong nga . Bad u la ong , Kumba U Trai u im , ym don uwei ruh u shniuh jong u khun jong me uba hap ha ka khyndew .

en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , for ever .
kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , khnang ba ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha . Phin ïaishong sah ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ba kan long ka nongkynti jong phi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban sumar ia ki ain jong u bad ki hukum jong u kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi, ba kan iaid bha bad me bad ki khun jong me hadien jong me, bad ba me lah ban pynjlan ia ki sngi jong me ha ka khyndew kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me, junom .

en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , on the morrow after that day , even a thousand bullocks , a thousand rams , and a thousand lambs , with their drink offerings , and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki pynïap ïa ki jingri kum ki jingkñia , da kaba pynkyntang ïa ki sha U  Trai  , bad nangta ki ai ïa ki ha ki briew ban bam . Shuh shuh , ki la kñia shihajar tylli ki masi lyngraw , shihajar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad shihajar tylli ki khunlangbrot , ïa kiba ki la thang tylli halor ka duwan . Ki la wanrah ruh ki jingainguh waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la knia ia ki jingknia ha U Trai, bad ki la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang ha U Trai, ha ka sngi kaba bud, wat shi hajar tylli ki masi, shi hajar tylli ki langbrot bad shi hajar tylli ki langbrot bad ki jingknia dih jong ki, bad ki jingknia ba la shet ha ki Israel baroh:

en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through , and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . Therefore Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
kha: U ong ha u samla uba rah atiar jong u ,  Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad dung ïap ïa nga , kumta ba kine ki Philistia bymriewblei kin ym ïoh dung bad pynïap ïa nga .  Hynrei uta u samla u la sheptieng eh ban leh ïa kata . Kumta u Saul u shim ïa la ka waitlam bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Saul ha u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u, To ring ia ka waitlam jong me, bad to pynkhih ia nga lyngba kata ka waitlam, ioh ba kine ki bym pat shah ot kin wan bad kin pynkhih ia nga lyngba, bad kin leh bein ia nga . Hynrei u nongrah tiar jong u un ym leh bein ia nga . Namar kata u la tieng .

en: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven  ; which things the angels desire to look into .
kha: U Blei u la pynpaw ha kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka jingtrei jong ki kam shym la long na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , katba ki dang lah kren shaphang kito kiei kiei ïa kiba phi la ïohsngew mynta na ki nonglamktien kiba la pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la phah na bneng . Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba wat ki angel ki thrang ban shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiba la pynpaw ia ka , ba ym ha lade , hynrei ha ngi ki la shakri ia kiei kiei kiba la iathuh mynta ha phi da ki kiba la ialap ia ka gospel ha phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la phah na bneng; kiei kiei kiba ki angel ki kwah ban peit bniah .

en: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation , when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali , and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , in Galilee of the nations .
kha: Yn ym don kano kano ka lad ïa ki ban lait phet na kane ka por jingjynjar . Ïa ka ri jong ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali la pynjahburom shisien , hynrei ka lawei kan wanrah burom ïa kane ka thain , na ka Mediterranian sha ka phang mihngi sha ka ri ha kawei ka liang jong ka Jordan , bad wat sha Galilaïa hi , ha kaba ki nongwei ki shong ki sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka jingdum kan ym long kumta ha ka jingsngewsih jong ka, haba ha kaba nyngkong u la pynshitom tang khyndiat eh ia ka ri u Sebulun bad ka ri Naphtali , bad hadien kata u la pynshitom kham jur ia ka da ka lynti jong ka duriaw , sha lyndet ka Jordan , ha Galilaia jong ki jaitbynriew .

en: Behold , this day thine eyes have seen how that the  Lord  had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave : and some bade me kill thee : but mine eye spared thee  ; and I said , I will not put forth mine hand against my lord  ; for he is the  Lord s  anointed .
kha: Phi lah ban shem da lade hi ba dang myntan hapoh ka krem U  Trai  u la buh ïa phi hapoh ka bor jong nga . Katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ki ong ïa nga ban pynïap ïa phi , hynrei nga sngewsynei ïa phi bad ong ba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi , namar phi dei uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka sngi ki khmat jong me ki la iohi kumno ba U Trai u la aiti ia me ha ka kti jong nga ha ka krem: bad don kiba la pyniap ia me: hynrei ka khmat jong nga ka la pyllait im ia me; bad nga la ong: Ngan ym pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia u kynrad jong nga; namar u long U Trai uba la pynsleh .

en: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .
kha: Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka kam sniew kaba ngi , ki shakri jong U Blei u kpa jong phi , ngi la leh .  U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phin ong ha u Joseph: Map ia me mynta, ia ka jingleh bymman jong ki hynmen jong me, bad ka pop jong ki; namar ki la leh bein ia me: bad mynta, ngi duwai ia me, map ia ka jingleh bymman jong ki shakri U Blei jong me . Bad u Joseph u iam haba ki kren ia u .

en: For the  Lord  shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water , and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers , and shall scatter them beyond the river , because they have made their groves , provoking the  Lord  to anger .
kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki Israel , bad kan khynñiuh kumba pynkhih ïa u khah ha ka wahduid . Un rat dyngkhong ïa ki paid Israel na kane ka ri kaba bha kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad un pynsakma ïa ki sha lyndet ka wah Ïuphratis , namar ba ki la pynbitar lep ïa u da kaba thaw ïa ki bleithaw jong ka blei Asherah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Trai un pynkhih ia ki Israel, kumba la pynkhih ia u khniang ha ka um, bad un pynmih ia ki Israel na kane ka ri kaba bha kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki, bad un pynpra ia ki sha shiliang wah, namar ki la pynlong ia ki khlaw jong ki, da kaba pynkhih ia U Trai .

en: Wherefore David arose and went , he and his men , and slew of the Philistines two hundred men  ; and David brought their foreskins , and they gave them in full tale to the king , that he might be the king s son in law . And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife .
kha: u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki leit bad pynïap arspah ngut ki Philistia . U wanrah ïa ki doh otsher jong ki baroh sha u syiem bad u da ñiew ïa ki ha u , khnang ba un lah ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u . Kumta u Saul u hap ban ai ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ban shongkurim ïa u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la ieng bad u la leit noh ia ki Philistia arspah ngut ki briew jong u bad u Dabid u la wanrah ia ki jainkup jong ki, bad ki la ai ia ki ha ka jingiathuhkhana kaba pura ha u syiem, ba un long u khun syiem ha ka ain . U Saul u la ai ia u ia ka khun jong u ha ka tnga jong u.

en: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness , thee and all the fish of thy rivers : thou shalt fall upon the open fields  ; thou shalt not be brought together , nor gathered : I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven .
kha: Ngan bret ïa me bad ïa kito ki dohkha baroh sha ka ri shyiap . Ka met jong me kan hap ha khyndew bad kan sah khlem tep ïa ka . Ngan ai ïa ka ha ki sim bad ki mrad ban long jingbam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan iehnoh ia me ha ka ri khlaw, ia me bad ia ki dohkha jong me baroh: men hap ha ki lyngkha ba plie; men ym shah pynlong lang: nga la ai jingbam ia me ha ki mrad khlaw bad ha ki sim bneng .

en: And I looked , and behold a pale horse : and his name that sat on him was Death , and Hell followed with him . And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth , to kill with sword , and with hunger , and with death , and with the beasts of the earth .
kha: Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai uba lieh bthuh . Ïa u nongshong kulai la ai kyrteng  ka Jingïap  , bad ka Hades ka bud syndah nadien . La ai ha ki ka bor halor shipawa na ka pyrthei , ban pynïap da ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ka khlam , bad da ki mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga peit, bad ha khmih u kulai uba lieh: bad ka kyrteng jong u kaba shong halor jong u ka long ka jingiap, bad ka Dujok ka la bud ia u . Bad la ai bor ia ki halor ka bynta kaba saw jong ka khyndew, ban pyniap da ka waitlam, bad da ka jingkyrduh, bad da ki mrad khlaw .

en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger  ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction  ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .
kha: Pha la dei ban ym risa beiñ halor ka jingshem jynjar jong ki hynmen ki para jong pha ha Judah . Pha la dei ban ym lehkmen ha ka sngi ka jingpynjot ïa ki . Pha la dei ban ym rkhie ïa ki ha ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban peit ia ka sngi jong u hynmen jong me ha ka sngi ba u la kylla long u nongwei ; bad me dei ban sngewbha ia ki khun Judah ha ka sngi ba ki la shah pynjot ; bad me dei ban kren da ka jingsngew sarong ha ka sngi ba u la shah pynjot .

en: For the fields of Heshbon languish , and the vine of Sibmah : the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof , they are come even unto Jazer , they wandered through the wilderness : her branches are stretched out , they are gone over the sea .
kha: Ïa ki kper hajan ka Heshbon bad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah la pynjot — kito ki bri sohwaiñ kiba ïa ka waiñ jong ki la pyndonkam ban pynbuaid ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki hima . Ha kawei ka sien ki dieng sohwaiñ ki saphriang kat shaduh ka nongbah Jaser , bad shaphang mihngi sha ka ri shyiap , bad shaphang sepngi sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Duriaw Baïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki lyngkha Heshbon ki la tyrkhong, bad ki kper sohjew jong ka Sibmah: ki kynrad jong ki nongwei ki la pynpra ia ki jingthung ba kongsan jong ka, ki la wan wat sha Jazer ruh, ki la iaid lyngba ka ri khlaw: ki tnat jong ka ki la iaid shabar duriaw .

en: Therefore it shall come to pass , that as all good things are come upon you , which the  Lord  your God promised you  ; so shall the  Lord  bring upon you all evil things , until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
kha: Hynrei kumba u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha phi , kumta ruh un pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingbyrngem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kan sa jia , ba kumba kiei kiei baroh kiba bha ki wan ha phi , kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kular ia phi; kumta U Trai un wanrah ia kiei kiei baroh kiba sniew ha phi, haduh ba un da pynjot ia phi na kane ka ri kaba bha kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , get thee down quickly from hence  ; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves  ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them  ; they have made them a molten image .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khie leit hiar kloi na une u lum , namar kita ki briew jong me ïa kiba me la ïalam na Ijipt , ki la mut sniew bad ki la leh bymman . Ki lah da kynriah noh na kata ka lynti ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa ki , bad ki la thaw pynban ïa ka durblei na ka bynta ïa lade .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga, To khie noh kloi na kata ka por namar ki briew jong me kiba me la wanrah na Ijipt ki la pynsniew ia lade ; ki la kylla noh kloi na ka lynti kaba nga la hukum ia ki ; ki la pynlong ia ki ka dur kaba la tyrkhong .

en: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel , and say unto the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury , because ye have borne the shame of the heathen :
kha: Kumta to ïathuhlypa ha ka ri Israel ; ïathuh ha ki lumbah bad ki lumrit , ha ki wahduid bad ki jaka them , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ka jingbitar lep namar ka rukom ha kaba ki jaitbynriew ki la krenbeiñ bad pynpoh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To iathuhlypa namarkata shaphang ka ri Israel, bad to ong ha ki lum bad ha ki lum, ha ki wah bad ha ki them: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Ha khmih nga la kren ha ka jingsngewsih jong nga bad ha ka jingbitar jong nga, namar ba phi la kit ia ka jinglehrain jong ki nongwei:

en: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem , Arise , and let us flee  ; for we shall not else escape from Absalom : make speed to depart , lest he overtake us suddenly , and bring evil upon us , and smite the city with the edge of the sword .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh kiba don bad u ha Jerusalem ,  Ngi dei ban ïaphet noh shisyndon lada ngi kwah ban lait na u Absalom ! Pynkloi ! Ïoh ba un poi shen hangne bad jop ïa ngi bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ha ka nongbah !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha ki shakri jong u baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ha Jerusalem: To khie noh bad ngin phet noh na u Absalom: to pynkloi ban leit noh: ioh ba un sa iaid lait noh kynsan ia ngi, bad un wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha ngi, bad un shoh ia ka nongbah da ka tduh jong ka waitlam .

en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .
kha: Mynta , to leit ban pynskhem biang ïa ki rangbah jong phi . Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba lada phim leh kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na ki u ban don bad phi lashai mynstep . Kata kan long ka jingjynjar kaba sniew tam kaba phin shah ha ka jingim jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to khie noh, to leit noh bad kren suk ia ki shakri jong me: namar nga smai da U Trai, lada phim leit noh, kan ym sah bad me mynta ka miet: bad kata kan kham sniew ia me ban ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba la jia ia me naduh ka por samla jong me haduh mynta .

en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said , Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house , and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ïathuh :  Ki shakri jong phi ki la shim ïa ka pisa kaba don ha ka Templ , bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki rangbah kiba dei khmih ïa ki jingshna pynbha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shaphan u nongthoh u la wan sha u syiem bad u la wanrah biang ia ka ktien syiem bad u la ong: Ki shakri jong me ki la lum ia ka pisa kaba la lap ha iing bad ki la aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong ki kiba leh ia ka kam, kiba don ka jingpeit ia ka iing U Trai .

en: But the poor man had nothing , save one little ewe lamb , which he had bought and nourished up : and it grew up together with him , and with his children  ; it did eat of his own meat , and drank of his own cup , and lay in his bosom , and was unto him as a daughter .
kha: katba uba duk pat u don tang iwei i khunlangbrot , iba u la thied . U sumar ïa i , bad i heh i san ha ïing jong u lem bad ki khun ki kti jong u . U ju bsa ïa i na ka jingbam jong u hi , bad shah ïa i ban dih na ka khuri jong u , bad u thum ïa i ha ka pneh jong u . Ita i khunlangbrot i la long kum ka khun kynthei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba duk um don ei ei, lait noh tang uwei u langbrot barit, uba u la thied bad u la ai bam: bad ka la san ryngkat bad u, bad ki khun jong u; bad ki khun jong u ki la bam ia la ka jong ka doh, bad ki la dih ia la ka jong ka khuri bad ki la thiah ha ka kpoh jong u hi.

en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .
kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi u la leit ai jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid . U la khot sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh , ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , bad ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad mynta hi ki dang ïabam ïadih bad u bad ki pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Adonijah !’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la leit hiar ha kane ka sngi, bad u la pyniap ia ki masi bad ki langbrot kiba heh ha ka jingbun, bad u la khot ia ki khun syiem baroh, bad ki rangbah shipai, bad u Abiatar u lyngdoh ; bad, ha khmih, ki bam bad dih ha khmat jong u, bad ki ong, U Blei u la pynim ia u syiem Adonijah .

en: And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou killed , and also taken possession ? And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood , even thine .
kha: Ong ïa u , ba nga U  Trai  nga ong ïa u , ‘ Hadien ba me la pynïap ïa u briew hato men shim ruh ïa ka khyndew jong u ?’ ïathuh ruh ha u ïa kaei ba nga ong : ‘ Ha kata hi ka jaka ba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam u Naboth , kin jliah ruh ïa ka snam jong me !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren ia u, da kaba ong, Kumta u la pyniap ia u Trai, bad u la shim ruh ia ka jaka ? Bad me dei ban kren ia u da kaba ong: Kumta u ong u Trai .

en: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .
kha: U Jehoash u la phah ïa kane ka jubab sha u Amasaïah :  Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah khubor sha u dieng Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong me ban shongkurim ïa u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid lynti nangta bad u ïuhroit ïa u dieng shiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joash u syiem Israel u la phah sha u Amasaiah u syiem Judah, u da ong, Ka jingsawa kaba don ha Lebanon ka la phah sha u sohjew uba don ha Lebanon, da kaba ong: Ai ia ka khun jong me ha u khun jong nga: bad hangta u la iaid lyngba u mrad khlaw uba don ha Lebanon .

en: And the voice of harpers , and musicians , and of pipers , and trumpeters , shall be heard no more at all in thee  ; and no craftsman , of whatsoever craft he be , shall be found any more in thee  ; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee  ;
kha: Ïa ka sur jingtem jong ki duitara bad ka sur jong ki nongrwai , jong ki nongput ïa ka tangmuri bad ïa ka turoi , yn ym ïohsngew shuh ha pha ! Ïa uno uno u nongtrei ha kano kano ka kam yn ym shem shuh ha pha ; bad ïa ka jingsawa jong u mawtylliat yn ym ïohsngew shuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sur jong ki nongtem bad ki nongtem, bad ki pipe bad ki turoi, kan ym iohsngew shuh ha me ; bad ym don u nongtrei kti, na kano kano ka kam shna jingshna, yn sa shem shuh ha me ; bad ka sur jong u mawsiang yn ym iohsngew shuh ha me ; .

en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons  by a statute for ever from the children of Israel : for it is an heave offering : and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings , even their heave offering unto the  Lord .
kha: Kane ka long ka rai jong nga ka ban ym kylla ba haba ki briew jong nga ki pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok , ka shadem bad ka lbong jong u mrad ki long ka bynta jong ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long ka jingai sngewbha jong ki briew sha nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ka jingainguh kaba heh na ki khun Israel: namar ka long ka jingainguh kaba heh: bad kan long ka jingainguh kaba heh na ki khun Israel na ka jingknia jong ki ia ka jingainguh jingsuk jong ki .

en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people , to the priests , and to the Levites : Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel , rulers of the house of God , gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki ai sngewbha ïa ki paidbah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi ba kin pyndonkam . Bad ki rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ka Templ — u Hilkaïah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Sekharaïah , bad u Jehiel — ki ai ïa ki lyngdoh ar hajar hynriewspah tylli ki langbrot bad ki khunblang bad laispah tylli ki masi lyngraw na ka bynta ki jingkñia ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong u ki la ai mon sngewbha ia ki briew, ha ki lyngdoh bad ha ki Lebi: U Hilkiah bad u Sekharaiah bad u Jehiel ki nongsynshar jong ka iing U Blei ki la ai ha ki lyngdoh na ka bynta ki jingknia jong ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ar hajar hynriew spah tylli ki masi rit bad lai spah tylli ki masi rit .

en: Now when I passed by thee , and looked upon thee , behold , thy time was the time of love  ; and I spread my skirt over thee , and covered thy nakedness : yea , I sware unto thee , and entered into a covenant with thee , saith the Lord  God  , and thou becamest mine .
kha: Katba nga dang ïaid lyngba biang , nga la ïohi ba ka por ka la poi ïa pha ban shoh jingieit . Nga la tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit jong pha da ka jaiñ jynsur jong nga bad nga la kular ban ieit ïa pha . Ho-oid nga la pynlong ka jutang shongkurim bad pha , bad pha long ka jong nga .  Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba nga la iaid lyngba jong me, bad nga peit ia me, ha khmih, ka por jong me ka la long ka por jong ka jingieit ; bad nga la pynphriang ia ka ryndang jong nga halor jong me, bad nga la tap ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me: hooid, nga la sngap jar ha me, bad nga la rung ha ka jutang bad me, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass , and in iron , and in purple , and crimson , and blue , and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem , whom David my father did provide .
kha: Mynta to phah sha nga u briew uba tbit ban ohdur , ban trei ha ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , bad ka nar , bad ha kaba thain ïa ka jaiñ kaba jngum , kaba sawbthuh , bad kaba rong saw . Un trei bad ki nongshna jingshna jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem kiba u Dabid u kpa jong nga u la jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Phah ia nga mynta u briew uba stad ban trei ha ka ksiar, bad ha ka rupa, bad ha ka nar, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad kata ka lah ban long kaba tbit ban tep bad ki briew kiba sniew kiba don bad nga ha Judah bad ha Jerusalem, kiba u kpa jong nga u la pynbiang .

en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
kha: Lada u shñiuh ha ka dak khluit ding u la kylla lieh bad kata ka dak ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba la sdang na kata kaba khluit ding , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un peit ia ka: bad, ha khmih, lada u shniuh ha ka jaka ba shai u la kylla lieh, bad ka kham jylliew ban ia ka sniehdoh ; ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba la tyrkhong na ka jingthang: namar kata u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long u bymkhuid: ka long ka khlam sniehdoh .

en: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep  ; also fowls were prepared for me , and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine : yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor , because the bondage was heavy upon this people .
kha: Man ka sngi nga ai uwei u masi , hynriew tylli na ki langbrot babha tam , bad bun tylli ki syiar bad man ka shiphew sngi nga pynbiang ka waiñ thymmai . Hynrei nga tip kiei ki jingkit bakhia ki briew ki hap ban shah , kumta ngam shym la dawa ïa ka baibam kaba u lat u don hok ban ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kata ka ; kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong nga man ka sngi ka long kawei ka masi bad hynriew tylli ki sim ba la jied ruh na ka bynta jong nga, bad shisien ha ka shi sngi ka buh ia ki jait wain baroh: hynrei na ka bynta kine baroh ym donkam ia u kpu jong u Lat, namar ka jinglong mraw ka la long kaba khia ia une u briew .

en: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms , and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen  ; and I will overthrow the chariots , and those that ride in them  ; and the horses and their riders shall come down , every one by the sword of his brother .
kha: bad pynkyllon ïa ki hima bad pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki . Ngan pynkylla khongpong ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ; ki kulai kin ïap , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ïa-pynïap para ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynhap ia ka khet jong ki hima bad ngan pynjot ia ka bor jong ki hima ki nongwei bad ngan pynhap ia ki kali kit mar, bad kito kiba shong ha ki ; bad ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai jong ki kin wan hiar , uwei pa uwei da ka waitlam jong u hynmen jong u .

en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph : and these are the names of his daughters  ; Mahlah , Noah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Tirzah .
kha: Ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah , ki long ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad u khun u Hepher, u khun u Machir, u khun u Manasseh: bad kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun kynthei jong u; u Mahlah, u Noah, bad u Hoglah, bad u Milkah, bad u Tirsah .

en: And her husband arose , and went after her , to speak friendly unto her , and to bring her again , having his servant with him , and a couple of asses : and she brought him into her father s house : and when the father of the damsel saw him , he rejoiced to meet him .
kha: Te uta u briew u leit bud ïa ka bad u pyrshang ban khroh ïa ka ba kan wan phai pat sha u . U ïalam bad u ïa uwei u shakri bad ar tylli ki kada . Ka kynthei ka ïalam ïa u Lebi sha ïing , bad haba u kpa jong ka u ïohi ïa u , u pdiang sngewbha ïa u da kaba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U tnga jong ka u la ieng, bad u la leit bud ia ka, ban kren paralok bad ka, bad ban wanrah biang ia ka, da kaba don ia u shakri jong u bad u: bad ka la wanrah ia u ha iing u kpa jong ka: bad haba u kpa jong u u kpa u la iohi ia u: u la sngewbha ban iakynduh ia u .

en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth , and spread it for her upon the rock , from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven , and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day , nor the beasts of the field by night .
kha: Nangta ka Rispah , ka khun jong u Aïah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka la pyndonkam da ka jaiñ khain ban thaw jingda ïa lade halor u mawsiang ha kaba don ki metïap , bad ka la sah hangta naduh kaba sdang ka aïom ot haduh ban da hap u slap synrai . Ha ka por mynsngi ka ju beh ïa ki sim na ki metïap , bad ha ka por mynmiet ka ju ïada ïa ki na ki mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rizpah ka khun jong u Aiah u la shim ia ka jain lyngkhuid, bad u la pynphriang ia ka na ka bynta jong ka ha u maw, naduh ba la sdang ban ot haduh ba ka um ka la tuid halor jong ki na bneng , bad um shym la shah ia ki sim Iyer ban shongthait ha ki ha ka por mynstep , ne ia ki mrad khlaw ha ka por miet .

en: And David came to his house at Jerusalem  ; and the king took the ten women his concubines , whom he had left to keep the house , and put them in ward , and fed them , but went not in unto them . So they were shut up unto the day of their death , living in widowhood .
kha: Haba u Dabid u la wan poi ha la ka ïingsyiem ha Jerusalem , u shim ïa ki shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar kiba u la iehnoh ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingap phira . U la pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki , hynrei um shym ïathiah shongkha bad ki . La buh ïa ki hangta baroh ki sngi ka jingim jong ki , da kaba im kum ki kynthei ba la ïap lok .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan sha la iing ha Jerusalem; bad u syiem u la shim ia ki shiphew ngut ki kynthei jong u kiba u la iehnoh ban sumar ia ka iing, bad u la buh ia ki ha ka ward bad u la ai bam ia ki . Kumta ki la shah khang haduh ka sngi jong ka jingiap jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy land , for good : for the  Lord  will again rejoice over thee for good , as he rejoiced over thy fathers :
kha: U  Trai  un pynroi kyrhai ïa phi kat ha kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh kyrhai ki khun ki kti bad kyrhai ki jingri , bad ki lyngkha jong phi ruh kin pynmih kyrhai . Un da sngewbha eh ban pynmanbha ïa phi kumba u la sngewbha ban pynmanbha ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong me un pynlong ia me uba bun ha ka kam baroh jong me, ha u soh jong ka met jong me, bad ha u soh jong ka ri jong me, na ka bynta ka jingbha: namar U Trai un sngewbha pat ia me na ka bynta ka jingbha, kumba u la sngewbha ia ki kpa tymmen jong me:

en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant , wherein your fathers have dwelt  ; and they shall dwell therein , even they , and their children , and their children s children for ever : and my servant David shall be their prince for ever .
kha: Kin shong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob , ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shong ki sah . Kin shong junom hangta , bad kumta ruh ki khun jong ki bad baroh kiba hiarpateng na ki . U syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga , u Dabid un synshar halor jong ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin shong ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u Jakob u shakri jong nga, ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shong ; bad kin shong hangta, wat ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki junom: bad u shakri jong nga u Dabid un long u syiem jong ki junom .

en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest s office for every thing of the altar , and within the veil  ; and ye shall serve : I have given your priest s office unto you as a service of gift : and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death .
kha: Hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phin pyndep ïa ka jingkitkhlieh ka jinglong lyngdoh kaba ïadei bad ka duwan bad kaei kaba don ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam . Kine kiei kiei ki long ki jingkitkhlieh jong me , naba nga la ai ha me ïa ka kam lyngdoh kum ka jingai sngewbha . Uno uno uwei pat u briew u bym bit bym biang uba wan hajan kita ki tiar kiba kyntang un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me kin bat ia ka kam lyngdoh jong phi na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh jong ka jingtap ; bad phin shakri: Nga la ai ia ka kam lyngdoh jong phi ha phi kum ka jingshakri jong ka jingai: bad u nongwei uba wan hajan un shah pyniap .

en: And the priest shall look on the plague , after that it is washed : and , behold , if the plague have not changed his colour , and the plague be not spread  ; it is unclean  ; thou shalt burn it in the fire  ; it is fret inward , whether it be bare within or without .
kha: Hadien kata un khmih bha ïa ka , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh kam kylla rong , wat la kam pur , ka dang long hi ka bymkhuid ; dei ban thang noh ïa ka , kam pher la kata ka jingbthuh ka long na shapoh ne shalor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un peit ia ka khlam hadien ba la sait ia ka: bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam kam shym la kylla rong, bad ka khlam kam shym la saphriang ; ka long kaba khlem khuid ; me dei ban thang ia ka ha ka ding ; ka la tyrkhong shapoh .

en: For verily I say unto you , That whosoever shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; and shall not doubt in his heart , but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass  ; he shall have whatsoever he saith .
kha: Nga ong skhem ha phi ba uno uno uba ong ha une u lum ban ïeng bad pynnoh ïa lade sha ka duriaw bad u bym don jingartatien ha ka dohnud jong u , hynrei ba u da ngeit ïa kaei kaba u ong kan long , yn leh na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha nga ong ha phi , Ba uno uno un ong ha une u lum , To long uba la shah beh noh bad me shapoh duriaw ; bad wat artatien ha ka dohnud jong u; hynrei un ngeit ba kita kiei kiei kiba u ong kin sa jia; un sa leh ia kaei kaei kaba u ong .

en: And forgettest the  Lord  thy maker , that hath stretched forth the heavens , and laid the foundations of the earth  ; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor , as if he were ready to destroy ? and where is the fury of the oppressor ?
kha: Hato phi la klet ïa U  Trai  uba la thaw ïa phi , uba pynïar ïa ki bneng bad uba pynïeng ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei ?
