Balei phi im ha ka jingïai-sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar shla jong kito kiba banbeiñ ïa phi , jong kito kiba long ba la kloi ban pynjot ïa phi ? Ka jingbitar shla jong ki kam lah shuh da lei lei ban ktah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to klet noh ia U Trai jong me, uba la pynjrong ia ki bneng, bad uba la buh ia ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ; bad u la tieng beit man la ka sngi namar ka jingbitar jong u nongpynshitom bein , kumba u la pynkhreh ban pynjot ? bad shano ka jingbitar jong u nongpynshitom bein ?

en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee , and the pride of thine heart , O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , that holdest the height of the hill : though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle , I will bring thee down from thence , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ym don ba sheptieng ïa pha katta kumba pha pyrkhat ba ki long kumta . Pha shong ha ki synrang maw , ha kliar ki lumbah ; hynrei wat la pha shong hajrong tam kum u pukni , U  Trai  un wallam ïa pha sha tbian . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng jong me ka la pynbiej ia me, bad ka jingsarong jong ka dohnud jong me, ko me uba shong ha ki thliew jong u maw, uba bat ia ka jingjrong jong u lum: wat la me dei ban pynlong ia ka bniat jong me kum ka blang, ngan pynhiar ia me naduh hangta, ong U Trai .

en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .
kha: Mynta , shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , khnang ba phi lah ban buh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to buh ia ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi ban wad ia U Trai U Blei jong phi; bad to tei ia ka jaka kyntang jong U Trai Blei , ban wanrah ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai bad ki tiar bakhuid jong U Trai .

en: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city , when the days of the siege are fulfilled : and thou shalt take a third part , and smite about it with a knife : and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind  ; and I will draw out a sword after them .
kha: Ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong uta u shñiuh men thang hapoh ka nongbah , ynda la dep ka jingkerkut . Shim ïa ka bynta kaba ar bad shaiñ ïa ka da ka waitlam jong me haba me ïaid baroh sawdong ka nongbah . Ïa ka bynta kaba dang sah men pynher ha ka lyer , bad ngan sa pynbud da ka waitlam jong nga nadien jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban thang da ka ding ia kawei ka bynta hapdeng ka nongbah, haba la pyndep ia ki sngi jong ka jingshah ker kut: bad me dei ban shim ia ka shi bynta kaba lai: bad kawei ka bynta kaba lai me dei ban pynphriang ha ka Iyer ; bad ngan sei ia ka wait hadien jong ki .

en: Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .
kha: Nangta ki briew ki la ong ,  To ngin leh ei ei shaphang u Jeremaïah ! Yn don borabor ki lyngdoh ki ban hikai ïa ngi , ki rangbah bastad ban ai jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei . To ngin wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong: To wan, bad to ngin ia thmu pyrshah ia u Jeremaiah ; namar ka hukum kan ym jah noh na u lyngdoh, lane ka ktien na u nongiathuhlypa . To wan, bad to ngin ia sngap ia u da ka shyntur jong u .

en: And his servants said unto him , Behold now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings : let us , I pray thee , put sackcloth on our loins , and ropes upon our heads , and go out to the king of Israel : peradventure he will save thy life .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki leit sha u bad ki ong ,  Ngi ïohsngew ba ki syiem Israel ki long kiba isynei . Ai jingbit ïa ngi ba ngin leit sha u syiem jong ka Israel ryngkat bad ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ki syngkai jong ngi bad ki tyllai sawdong ki ryndang jong ngi , bad lehse un pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la ong ha u, Ha khmih mynta, ngi la iohsngew ba ki syiem Israel ki long ki syiem kiba isynei: to ngin ia kren bein ia me ha ki tyrpeng jong ngi, bad ki lynti ha ki khlieh jong ngi, bad ngin leit sha u syiem Israel: da kaba u pynim ia ka jingim jong me .

en: But the firstling of a cow , or the firstling of a sheep , or the firstling of a goat , thou shalt not redeem  ; they are holy : thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar , and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki blang ym dei ban thied pat ; ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , bad dei ban kñia ïa ki . Synreit ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan bad thang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka masi kaba nyngkong ne kaba nyngkong eh jong u langbrot ne ka blang , wat siew kylliang shuh shuh: me dei ban theh ia ka snam jong ki ha ka jaka bam bad me dei ban thang ia ka shini jong ki na ka bynta ka jingknia kaba la shet da ka ding, na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang ia U Trai .

en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , If ye have faith , and doubt not , ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree , but also if ye shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; it shall be done .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi ngeit bad phim sngew artatien , phin lah ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa une u dieng Dumbur . Bad ym tang kane , hynrei phin lah wat ban ong ha une u lum , ‘ Khie joit bad pynnoh ïa lade sha duriaw ,’ bad un leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Hooid nga ong ha phi, lada phi don ka jingngeit bad phim artatien, phin ym leh tang ia kane kaba la leh ha u dieng sohjew hynrei lada phi ong ha une u lum , To long uba la weng noh ia me bad to long uba la bret ha duriaw; kan sa long .

en: Again , thou shalt say to the children of Israel , Whosoever he be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel , that giveth any of his seed unto Molech  ; he shall surely be put to death : the people of the land shall stone him with stones .
kha: Ong ha ki Israel , uno uno na phi lane u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , uba ai ïa uwei na ki khun jong u ha u blei Molekh , u dei ban shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien, to ong ha ki khun Israel: Uno uno na ki khun Israel ne na ki nongwei kiba sah ha Israel , uba ai ia uno uno u symbai jong u ha u Molek ; u dei ban shah pyniap: ki briew jong ka ri kin sa pyniap da ki maw .

en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest , neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest : thou shalt leave them unto the poor , and to the stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba ha tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit kylla dien ban khar ïa ki sohkew kiba sah ; ieh ïa ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad ki nongwei ; Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi kheit ia ka jingot jong ka ri jong phi, wat nym ktah ia ki thliew lyngkha jong phi haba phi kheit: men iehnoh ia ki ha kiba duk bad ha u nongwei: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And this is thine  ; the heave offering of their gift , with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel : I have given them unto thee , and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee , by a statute for ever : every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it .
kha: Nalor kine , kiwei pat ki jingai kiba kyrpang ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga ki dei ki jong me . Nga ai ïa ki ha me , ha ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong me , ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uwei pa uwei na ka longïing jong me uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam u lah ban bam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba heh jong ki, ryngkat bad ki jingknia ba la tyrkhong jong ki Israel: Nga la ai ia ki ha me bad ha ki khun shynrang jong me bad ha ki khun kynthei jong me bad me, da ka ain junom: uwei pa uwei uba khuid ha ka iing jong me un bam ia ka .

en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar , and bring it down to the ground , so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered , and it shall fall , and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Nga thmu ban pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh ba la pushara lieh , ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka , bad ban pynpaw shabar ïa ki maw nongrim . Kan khyllem bad pynïap ïa phi baroh . Te uwei uwei baroh un tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynpra ia ka kynroh kaba phi la pynkhih da ka dewbilat kaba khlem da tyrkhong, bad ngan pynhap ia ka shapoh khyndew, khnang ba ka nongrim jong ka kan sa paw, bad phin sa shah pynjot hapdeng jong ka: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast burned this roll , saying , Why hast thou written therein , saying , The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land , and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast ?
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha u syiem ,  Me la thang ïa ka kot kli , bad me la kylli ïa u Jeremaïah balei ba u la thoh ba u syiem ka Babilonia un wan bad pynjot ïa kane ka ri bad pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki mrad jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ong ha u syiem Judah , Kumta u la thang ia kane ka kot lyngkdop, da kaba ong: Balei me la thoh ha kata ka jaka, da kaba ong: U syiem Babilon un wan pynjot shisha ia kane ka ri bad un pynlong ia u briew bad u mrad ban sangeh noh na kata ka jaka ?

en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt : your young men have I slain with the sword , and have taken away your horses  ; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Nga la phah ïa ka khlam ha phi kum kata kaba nga la phah ha Ijipt . Nga la pynïap ïa ki samla shynrang jong phi ha ka thma bad nga la knieh noh ïa ki kulai jong phi . Nga la pyndap ïa ki thliew khmut jong phi da ka jingiwtung ki metïap ha ki jaka shong dara jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phah hapdeng jong phi ia ka jingpang kum ka ri Ijipt: ki samla jong phi ki la pyniap da ka waitlam , bad nga la shim noh ia ki kulai jong phi ; bad nga la pynlong ia ka sniehdoh jong ki jaka shong jong phi ban wan shaneng sha ki shyntur jong phi: hynrei phim shym la wan phai sha nga , ong U Trai .

en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh , The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years : few and evil have the days of the years of my life been , and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage .
kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Ha ka jingim jong nga kaba ïaidwir nawei shawei nga la dap shispah laiphew snem . Kita ki snem ki long kiba khyndiat bad kiba eh , ym kum ki snem kiba jrong ba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynlut ha ka jingïaid wir .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha u Pharaoh , Ki sngi jong ka jingleit jingwan jong nga ki long shispah laiphew snem: tang khyndiat bad ki sngi jong ka jingim jong nga ki la long , bad kim shym la poi sha ki sngi jong ki snem jong ka jingim jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga ha ki sngi jong ka jingleit jingwan jong ki .

en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse , that there may be meat in mine house , and prove me now herewith , saith the  Lord  of hosts , if I will not open you the windows of heaven , and pour you out a blessing , that there shall not be room enough to receive it .
kha: Wallam ïa ka jingmih baroh jong kawei-na-kaba-shiphew sha ka Templ , khnang ba yn don ka bam kyrhai hangta . To tynjuh ïa nga bad phin sa ïohi ba ngan plie ïa ki jingkhangïit jong ka bneng bad theh noh ha phi kyrhai ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: To wanrah ia ka shiphew ha ka iing buh jingbam baroh, ba kan don ka jingbam ha ka iing jong nga, bad to pynshisha ia nga mynta, ong U Trai jong ki paid , lada ngan ym plie ia phi ia ki jingkhang jong ka bneng , bad ngan theh ia phi ia ka jingkyrkhu , ba kan ym don jaka ban pdiang ia ka .

en: And when the  Lord  raised them up judges , then the  Lord  was with the judge , and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge : for it repented the  Lord  because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them .
kha: Man ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , U  Trai  u ïarap ïa uta u nongïalam bad u pyllait im ïa ki briew na ki nongshun jong ki katba uta u nongïalam u dang im . U  Trai  u sngewsynei ïa ki namar ba ki la ud ha ki jingshitom bad jingshah banbeiñ jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai u la pynmih ia ki da ki nongbishar, te U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u nongbishar, bad u la pyllait noh ia ki na ka kti ki nongshun jong ki baroh ki sngi jong u nongbishar: namar ka la kylla bamut ia U Trai namar ka jingud jong ki namar jong ki kiba la pynshitom bein ia ki bad pynsngewsih ia ki .

en: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence , and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee : and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee  ; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds , and I will draw out a sword after them .
kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki briew jong pha kin ïap na ka jingpang bad jingthngan ha ka nongbah ; shi bynta pat kin ïap da ka waitlam shabar ka nongbah ; bad ïa ka shi bynta kaba dang sah ngan pynsakma sha ki sawlyer , bad ngan beh ïa ki nadien da ka waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta kaba lai jong me kan iap da ka jingpang khlam, bad da ka jingkyrduh kin sa shah pynjot hapdeng jong me: bad ka bynta kaba lai kan hap da ka waitlam sawdong jong me; bad ngan sa pynphriang ia kawei ka bynta kaba lai ha ki Iyer baroh , bad ngan sa sei ia ka waitlam hadien jong ki .

en: And the men of David said unto him , Behold the day of which the  Lord  said unto thee , Behold , I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand , that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee . Then David arose , and cut off the skirt of Saul s robe privily .
kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka kabu jong phi ! U  Trai  u la ïathuh ïa phi ba un buh ïa u nongshun ha ka bor jong phi bad phi lah ban leh ïa u kat kaba phi kwah .  U Dabid u par sor sor bad u ot shi lyngkhot na ka jaiñkup u Saul khlem ka jingtip u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong u Dabid ki la ong ha u , Ha kata ka sngi ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha me, Ha khmih ngan aiti ia u nongshun jong me ha ka kti jong me, ba me lah ban leh ia u katba phi mon . Nangta u Dabid u la ieng bad ot noh ia ka lyngkhot lyngkhai jong u Soul .

en: Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father s house , and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die : because she hath wrought folly in Israel , to play the whore in her father s house : so shalt thou put evil away from among you .
kha: te ki dei ban leit ïalam ïa kata ka briew ha khmat ka jingkhang ïing u kpa jong ka , bad ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong kin lynthem maw ïa ka hangta haduh ba kan da ïap . Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jahburom ha Israel da kaba pynjot ïa la ka jingsotti shuwa ka jingshongkurim . Da kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin pynmih ia ka dam sha ka jingkhang jong ka iing u kpa jong ka, bad ki shynrang jong ka kin pynduh ia ka da ki maw ba ka iap: namar ba ka la leh be-ijot ha Israel: kumta to weng noh ia ka jingsniew na phi .

en: He appointed also the king s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings , to wit , for the morning and evening burnt offerings , and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths , and for the new moons , and for the set feasts , as it is written in the law of the  Lord .
kha: Na la ki kynhun jingri u pyndap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet , bad na ka bynta kito ïa kiba ainguh ha ka sngi Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei ki jinglehkmen ïa kiba donkam da ka hukum jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ruh ia ka bynta jong u na ka bynta ki jingknia thang, ban bam, na ka bynta ki jingknia thang mynstep bad janmiet, bad ki jingknia thang na ka bynta ki sngi saitjain bad ki bnai thymmai, bad na ka bynta ki jingkhawai ba la buh ha ka ain U Trai .

en: And they shall answer , Because they forsook the  Lord  their God , who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt , and have taken hold upon other gods , and have worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath the  Lord  brought upon them all this evil .
kha: Te ki briew kin jubab , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la kyntait ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , bad ki la snoh ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa ki . Namarkata , U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka apot .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin jubab , Namar ki la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki, uba la wanrah ia ki kpa tymmen jong ki na ka ri Ijipt , bad ki la bat ia kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane ia ki: namar kata U Trai u la wanrah ia kine ki jingsniew baroh .

en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said , Hear me , my brethren , and my people : As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and for the footstool of our God , and had made ready for the building :
kha: U Dabid u ïeng ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong ,  Ko ki para ri jong nga , to shahshkor ïa nga . Nga la kwah ban tei ka ïingshong neh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ka jingïuhkjat jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Nga la pynkhreh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban ai burom ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ieng ha la ki kjat bad u la ong: To sngap ia nga, ko para jong nga: Katba ia nga pat nga la don ha ka dohnud jong nga ban tei ia ka iing shongthait na ka bynta ka synduk ka jutang U Trai bad na ka bynta ka jaka shong kjat jong U Blei jong ngi: bad nga la pynkhreh ia ka jingtei:

en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him , and pronounce him unclean .
kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa kata ka prum , bad lada u shñiuh hangta u la kylla lieh bad kata ka prum ka i kumba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un peit ia ka khlam ha ka sniehdoh jong ka doh: bad haba u shniuh ha ka khlam u la kylla lieh, bad ka khlam ha ka khmat ka kham jylliew ban ia ka sniehdoh jong ka doh jong u: bad u lyngdoh un peit ia u: bad un pynbna ia u ba u long u bymkhuid .

en: Them take , and purify thyself with them , and be at charges with them , that they may shave their heads : and all may know that those things , whereof they were informed concerning thee , are nothing  ; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly , and keepest the law .
kha: Khie leit bad ki bad ïasoh bad ki ha ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid bad siew ïa ki jinglut jingsep jong ki ; nangta kin lah ban khi ïa la ki khlieh . Ha kane ka rukom uwei pa uwei un tip ba kam don ka jingshisha ha kano kano na kita kiei kiei kiba la ïathuh ha ki shaphang jong me , hynrei ba ma me hi me im kat kum ka Hukum u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shim , bad pynkhuid ia lade bad ki , bad to long kiba don ha ki khlieh jong ki: bad baroh ki lah ban tip ba kita kiei kiei kiba la pyntip shaphang jong me, kim long ei ei hynrei ba me ruh me iaid beit iaid ryntih bad me sumar ia ka hukum .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Edom , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he did pursue his brother with the sword , and did cast off all pity , and his anger did tear perpetually , and he kept his wrath for ever :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Edom ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la beh krad ïa la ki hynmen ki para , ïa ki Israel bad khlem da pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki . Ka jingbitar jong ki kam don pud bad kim shah ba kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein jong u Edom, bad na ka bynta saw tylli, ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong u ; namar u la beh ia la u hynmen da ka waitlam, bad u la bret noh ia ka jingsngewsih baroh, bad ka jingbitar jong u ka la iam junom, bad u la bat ia ka jingbitar jong u junom:

en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim , saying , Come down against the Midianites , and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan . Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan .
kha: U Gideon u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka ri lum Ephraim baroh ban ong ,  Ale wan hiar ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian . Ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah , ban khang ïa ki Midian na kaba jam ïa ki sha shiliang .  Ki rangbah Ephraim ki la ïalumlang , bad ki la ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha kita ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor ha baroh kawei ka lum Ephraham, u da ong, To wan hiar sha ki nong Midjan bad shim ha khmat jong ki ia ki um haduh Bethbarah bad ka Jordan . Nangta ki briew baroh jong ka Ephraham ki la ialum lang bad ki la shim ia ki um haduh Bethbarah bad ka Jordan .

en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God  ; and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left .
kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar ba-halor tam ban ibeiñ ïa U Blei uba im . To ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingibeiñ bad un pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ha ki . Kumta duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew kiba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong me un iohsngew ia ki ktien baroh jong u Rabshakeh, ia uba u syiem jong u u la phah ban kren bein ia U Blei uba im ; bad un pynrem ia ki ktien kiba U Trai U Blei jong me u la iohsngew: namar kata to rah ia ka jingduwai jong me na ka bynta kiba sah .

en: For the  Lord  our God , he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage , and which did those great signs in our sight , and preserved us in all the way wherein we went , and among all the people through whom we passed :
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la wallam ïa ki kpa jong ngi bad ïa ngi ruh na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt , bad ngi la ïohi ïa ki kambah ba u la leh . U la ri pynim ïa ngi shano shano shaba ngi leit hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ba ngi la ïaid lyngba .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai jong ngi , ma u hi uba la pynmih ia ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi na ka ri Ijipt , bad uba la leh ia kita ki dak kiba khraw ha khmat jong ngi , bad u la pynneh ia ngi ha ka lynti baroh ha kaba ngi la leit noh bad hapdeng ki briew baroh kiba ngi la iaid lyngba:

en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him : and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind , with chariots , and with horsemen , and with many ships  ; and he shall enter into the countries , and shall overflow and pass over .
kha: Haba ka kynta kaba khatduh jong u syiem ka Syria ka la jan wan artat , u syiem ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa u , bad u syiem ka Syria un ïaleh pyrshah da la ka bor baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ki liengbah kiba bun . Un hiarthma ïa kiba bun ki ri , kum ka jingshlei ki um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por kaba kut u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un wan pyrshah ia u: bad u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un wan pyrshah ia u kum ka lyer kaba rkhie bein, bad ki kali bad ki kulai bad da ki shipai kiba bun; bad un rung sha ki ri; bad un tuid bad un iaid lait noh .

en: But I say unto you , That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment : and whosoever shall say to his brother , Raca , shall be in danger of the council : but whosoever shall say , Thou fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ïa uno uno uba bitar ïa la u para yn wallam sha ka jingbishar , ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ Me u bymlarkam ei ei !’ yn wallam ha khmat ka Dorbar Bah , bad ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ u bieit bymmyntoi’ un don ha ka jingma ka jingleit sha ka dujok ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba uno uno uba bitar ia u hynmen jong u khlem daw un don ha ka jingma jong ka jingbishar: bad uno uno uba ong ha u hynmen jong u , Raca , un don ha ka jingma jong ka dorbar: hynrei uno uno uba ong , Me bieit , un don ha ka jingma jong ka ding dujok .

en: And her mother in law said unto her , Where hast thou gleaned to day ? and where wroughtest thou ? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee . And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought , and said , The man s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz .
kha: Ka Naomi ka kylli ïa ka ,  Hangno phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh ? Ha ka lyngkha jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phi !  Kumta ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka Naomi ba ka la trei ha ka lyngkha kaba dei jong u briew uba kyrteng u Boas .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kmie tymmen jong ka ka la ong ia ka, Hangno me la leit sha ka sngi ? bad hangno me la leit sha ka sngi ? la kyrkhu ia uta uba la ithuh ia me . Bad ka la pyni ia ka kmie tymmen jong ka bad kaba ka la leh bad ka .

en: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .
kha: Uno uno uba kheiñ kor bha ïa kano kano ka sngi , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , uno uno u ban bam ïa kaei kaei , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Uno uno uba kyntait ban bam ïa kino kino ki jingbam , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai bad u ainguh sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba peit ia ka sngi , u peit ia ka ha U Trai ; bad uta u bym khein ia ka sngi, ha U Trai um ju khein ia ka . Uta uba bam, u bam ia U Trai, namar u ainguh ia U Trai ; bad uta u bym bam, ha U Trai um ju bam, bad u ainguh ia U Blei .

en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion , to give unto them beauty for ashes , the oil of joy for mourning , the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness  ; that they might be called trees of righteousness , the planting of the  Lord  , that he might be glorified .
kha: ban ai ha kito kiba ïam sngewsih ha Seïon ïa ka jingkmen bad jingsngewbha ha ka jaka ka jingsngewsih , ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh ha ka jaka ki ummat kthang . Kin long kum ki dieng ba U  Trai  da lade hi u la thung . Baroh kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Bad ïa U Blei yn ai ka jingïaroh ïa kaei ba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban thung ia ki kiba iam ha ka Seion, ban ai ha ki ia ka jingitynnad na ka bynta ka dewbilat, ka umphniang jong ka jingkmen na ka bynta ka jingsngewsih, ka jain iaroh ia ka mynsiem jong ka jingkhia; ba kin shah khot ki dieng jong ka hok, ka jingthung ia U Trai, ba un shah pyndonburom .

en: And these are the garments which they shall make  ; a breastplate , and an ephod , and a robe , and a broidered coat , a mitre , and a girdle : and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother , and his sons , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
kha: Ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh : ka jingdeng shadem , ka ephod , ka barandi , ka sopti ba la suh pynpur itynnat , ka jaiñspong , bad ka jaiñ panpoh . Kin suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u khnang ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki jain kiba kin shna da ka sniehdoh, bad ka jainkup, bad ka jainkup kaba la tyrkhong, ka jainkup bad ka jainkup: bad kin shna ia ki jainkup ba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad ki khun shynrang jong u, ba un shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: Set ye up a standard in the land , blow the trumpet among the nations , prepare the nations against her , call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat , Minni , and Ashchenaz  ; appoint a captain against her  ; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers .
kha: To ai ïa ka dak ban tur ïaleh ! Put ïa ka turoi khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin ïohsngew ! Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia ! Ong ïa ki hima Ararat , Minni , bad Ashkenas ban tur ïaleh . Thung ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh . Wallam ïa ki kulai kum ka kynhun ki puit .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ka nongrim ha ka ri, pynkhih ia ka turoi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew, pynkhreh ia ki jaitbynriew pyrshah ia ka, khot lang ia ki hima Ararat , ka Mini bad ka Ashchenaz; thung ia u kapten pyrshah ia ka; ki kulai ki wan shaneng kum ki khniang kiba sniew .

en: And the beast was taken , and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him , with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast , and them that worshipped his image . These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone .
kha: Ïa u mradkhlaw la ring koidi , lem bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler uba la leh ki kambah ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . ( Ka la long da kito ki kambah ba u la shukor ïa kito kiba la don ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw bad ïa kito kiba la mane ïa ka dur jong u mradkhlaw . ) Ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler la bret im sha ka pung ding kaba klang da u kyndok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la shim ia uta u mrad bad bad u nongiathuhlypa lamler uba la leh ia ki kambah ha khmat jong u, da kaba u la shukor ia kita kiba la ioh ia ka dak jong uta u mrad bad ia kita kiba la mane ia ka dur jong u . Ia kine baroh arngut la bret im ha ka pung ding kaba la thang da u maw .

en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers , and their queens thy nursing mothers : they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth , and lick up the dust of thy feet  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me .
kha: Ki syiem kin long kum ki kpa ïa pha ; ki mahadei kum ki kmie . Kin dem khrup ha khmat jong pha bad kin burom ïa pha ; da kaba pynrit kin pyn-i burom ïa pha . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai  ; uba ap ïa ka jingïarap jong nga un ym duh jingkyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem kin long ki kpa kiba ai dud ia me, bad ki mahadei jong ki kin dem khrup ha me da ka khmat sha ka khyndew , bad kin lympat ia ka dewmet jong ki kjat jong me bad me phin tip ba nga long U Trai: namar kin ym sngewlehrain ia nga .

en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth , saying , Give me thy vineyard , that I may have it for a garden of herbs , because it is near unto my house : and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it  ; or , if it seem good to thee , I will give thee the worth of it in money .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ahab u ong ha u Naboth ,  Ai noh ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ jong me ha nga ba ngan pynlong ka kper jhur ïa ka , namar ka don harud ka ïingsyiem jong nga . Ngan ai pli ïa me da ka bri sohwaiñ kaba kham bha ha ka jaka jong ka , lane , lada me sngewdei , ngan da siewdor kaba biang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la kren ha u Naboth, u da ong, Ai ia nga ia ka kper sohjew jong me, ba ngan ioh ia ka kum ka kper jong ki jingthung jingtep, namar ka don hajan ka iing jong nga: bad ngan ai ia me na ka bynta kata ka kper sohjew kaba kham bha ban ia ka; lane lada ka long kaba bha ha me, ngan ai ia me ia ka dor jong ka ha ka pisa .

en: And the  Lord  smelled a sweet savour  ; and the  Lord  said in his heart , I will not again curse the ground any more for man s sake  ; for the imagination of man s heart is evil from his youth  ; neither will I again smite any more every thing living , as I have done .
kha: Ka jingiw jong ka jingkñia ainguh ka la pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , bad U la ong ha lade ,  Lano lano ruh ngan ym buh ïa ka pyrthei hapoh ka jingtim namar kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ; nga tip ba naduh ba ki dang samla , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki long kiba sniew . Lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , kumba nga la leh ha kane ka sien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la sngap jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar

en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Babylon  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them .
kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga la don pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Babilon bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad baroh kin sngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iohsngew ia ka jingmut jong U Trai, ba u la shim ia ka Babilon ; bad ki jingthmu jong u, ba u la thmu pyrshah ia ka ri jong ki Khaldes: Hooid u la pynlong ia ka jaka shong jong ki ban jah noh bad ki .

en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .
kha: U jubab ,  A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri borabor ïa me — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Nga la sngewsih shibun eh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki paid: namar ki khun Israel ki la iehnoh ia ka jutang jong me, ki la pynhap ia ki nongrim jong me, bad ki la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong me da ka waitlam ; bad nga, wat ia nga hi, nga sah sah sah sah; bad ki wad ia ka jingim jong nga, ban shim noh ia ka .

en: And he said , Open the window eastward . And he opened it . Then Elisha said , Shoot . And he shot . And he said , The arrow of the  Lord s  deliverance , and the arrow of deliverance from Syria : for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek , till thou have consumed them .
kha: Nangta , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah u nongïathuhlypa , u syiem u plie ïa ka jingkhang kaba phai khmat sha Syria .  Siat ïa u khnam !  u Elisha u hukum . Hamar ba u syiem u siat ïa u khnam , u nongïathuhlypa u pyrta ,  Me long u khnam jong U  Trai  , da u , un sa ïoh ka jingjop halor ka Syria . Men ïaleh ïa ki Syria ha Aphek haduh ba men da jop thiaw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Plie ia ka jingkhang shaphang mihngi . Bad u la plie ia ka . Nangta u Elisha u la ong, Shot . Bad u la siat . Bad u la ong: Ka khnam jong ka jingpyllait im na Syria: namar me dei ban shoh ia ki Syria ha Aphek haduh ba me la bam ia ki .

en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble , and the flame consumeth the chaff , so their root shall be as rottenness , and their blossom shall go up as dust : because they have cast away the law of the  Lord  of hosts , and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Kumta mynta , kumba u skum kba bad u phlang tyrkhong ki ran bad ing ha ka ding , ki thied jong phi kin pyut bad ki syntiew jong phi kin tyrkhong bad shah rong noh ha ka lyer , namar ba phi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei bakhuid ka Israel u la hikai ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumba ka ding ka bam ia u sboh bad ka ding ka bam ia u sohjew , kumta ka tynrai jong ki kan long kum ka jingsniew bad ka syntiew jong ki kan kiew kum ka dewbilat: namar ki la bret noh ia ka hukum U Trai jong ki paid bad ki la leh bein ia ka ktien jong U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel , and all the heads of the tribes , the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel , unto king Solomon in Jerusalem , that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of the city of David , which is Zion .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u phah khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ki jait bad ki kur jong ki Israel ban wan sha u sha Jerusalem khnang ban leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  na ka Seïon , ka Nongbah u Dabid , sha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la lum lang ia ki rangbah Israel bad ki khlieh jong ki Israel baroh, ha u syiem Solomon ha Jerusalem , ba kin wanrah ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai na ka shnong u Dabid kaba long ka Seion .

en: For when ye offer your gifts , when ye make your sons to pass through the fire , ye pollute yourselves with all your idols , even unto this day : and shall I be enquired of by you , O house of Israel ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
kha: Wat haduh mynta phi ai ïa kijuh ki jingai sngewbha bad pyntngit ïa lade da kijuh ki bleithaw da kaba kñia ïa la ki khun sha ki ha ka ding . Bad nangta ma phi ki Israel phi dang ïai wan ban kylli kaei ka long ka mon jong nga ! Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba phi ai ia ki jingai sngewbha jong phi, haba phi pynlong ia ki khun shynrang jong phi ban iaid lyngba ka ding, phi pynjakhlia ia lade da ki bleithaw jong phi baroh: bad ngan ym shah kylli ha phi ko iing Israel ? Kumba nga im, ong U Trai Blei , ngan ym shah kylli ha phi .

en: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment , and two hundred shekels of silver , and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight , then I coveted them , and took them  ; and , behold , they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent , and the silver under it .
kha: Napdeng kita ki mar kiba ngi la kurup , nga la ïohi kawei ka barandi Babilon kaba itynnat , kumba ar kilo ka rupa , bad shi lyngkhot ka ksiar kaba khia palat shiteng kilo . Nga la ikwah eh ïa ki , bad nga la shim ïa ki . Phin shem ba la tep ïa ki hapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong nga , bad ka rupa ka don ha trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la iohi hapdeng ki jain kiba bha, bad arspah tylli ki nar rupa bad kawei ka wike ksiar kaba sanphew tylli ki nar , te nga la kwah eh ia ki, bad nga la shim ia ki ; bad, ha khmih, ki la buhrieh ha ka khyndew hapdeng ka ïingjaiñ jong nga, bad ka rupa hapoh jong ka .

en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil : the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
kha: U Ahab u jubab ,  Don sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u namar um ju ïathuhlypa kaba bha ïa nga ; ka ju long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew .   Phim dei ban ong kumta !  u Jehoshaphat u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat: Don shuh uwei u briew, da uba ngi lah ban kylli na U Trai: hynrei nga shun ia u ; namar um ju iathuhlypa ia nga: u long kumjuh u khun jong u Imlah . Bad u Jehoshaphat u la ong: Wat u syiem un ong kumta .

en: And they shall come against thee with chariots , wagons , and wheels , and with an assembly of people , which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about : and I will set judgment before them , and they shall judge thee according to their judgments .
kha: Kin tur ïaleh ïa pha naphang shatei , da kaba wanrah ïa ka kynhun shipai babun lem bad ki kali ïapom bad ki , ki kali ba-dap kyrhai ka jingbam . Da kaba kieng da ki stieh bad ki jingïada khlieh , kin ker sawdong ïa pha . Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki , bad kin bishar ïa pha da la ki jong ki aiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin wan pyrshah ia me da ki kali kit mar, ki kali kit mar bad ki kali kit mar, bad da ka jingiaseng briew, ki ban buh pyrshah ia me da ka jingkhang bad ka jingdawa sawdong: bad ngan buh ia ka jingbishar ha khmat jong ki: bad kin bishar ia me kat kum ki jingbishar jong ki .

en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God , Entreat now the face of the  Lord  thy God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . And the man of God besought the  Lord  , and the king s hand was restored him again , and became as it was before .
kha: U Syiem Jeroboam u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Sngewbha duwai na ka bynta jong nga ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad kyrpad ba un pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong nga !  U nongïathuhlypa u la duwai ha U  Trai  , bad la pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab bad u la ong ha uta u briew jong U Blei, To sngap mynta ia ka khmat U Trai U Blei jong me, bad duwai na ka bynta jong nga, ba ka kti jong nga kan long biang ia nga . Bad uta u briew jong U Blei u la kyrpad ia U Trai bad ka kti jong u syiem ka la long biang ia u, bad u la kylla long kumba u la long mynshuwa .

en: But a wife might choose to leave her husband if ( 1 ) he stubbornly refuses to support his family , ( 2 ) he is so violent that her health and life are in danger , or ( 3 ) his extreme opposition makes it impossible for her to worship Jehovah .—1 Corinthians 7 :12 , 13 .
kha: Hynrei ka tnga ka lah ban jied ban shongkhlad na la u tnga tang lada ( 1 ) u leh bym salia bad um kitkhia ban bsa ïa la ka ïing ( 2 ) u shoh u dat haduh ba ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingim jong ka , ka shong syier lane ( 3 ) ka jingpynthut palat jong u ka khang lad ïa ka ha ka ban mane ïa U Jehobah , kum ha kaba pule ïa ka Baibl , ha kaba leit jingïaseng bad ha kaba leit ïalap .—1 Korinth 7 :12 , 13 .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka tnga ka lah ban jied ban iehnoh ia la u lok lada ( 1 ) u kyntait da kaba sting ban kyrshan ia la ka iing ka sem , ( 2 ) u long uba shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba ka koit ka khiah bad ka jingim jong ka ka don ha ka jingma , lane ( 3 ) ka jingpyrshah kaba palat jong u ka pynlong ia ka ban mane ia U Jehobah .

en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field , and hast forgot a sheaf in the field , thou shalt not go again to fetch it : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands .
kha: Haba phi lum ïa u kew bad phi kum klet shi song ha lyngkha , wat leit tam shuh ïa u ; ieh ïa u hangta na ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ka kam jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me ot ia ka jingot jong me ha ka lyngkha jong me, bad me klet ia ka lyngkha, wat leit shim biang ia ka: kan long na ka bynta u nongwei, na ka bynta u khlem kpa bad na ka bynta u riewkynthei: ba U Trai U Blei jong me un kyrkhu ia me ha ki kam jong me baroh .

en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them , that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither , and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood , until he stood before the congregation .
kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah jakarieh ïa kiba la jied na ka bynta ki paid Israel baroh , bad na ka bynta uno uno u nongwei uba shong hapdeng jong ki . Uno uno uba pynïap briew da ka jingjia ryngkhat u lah ban shem jingïada hangta na uta uba wad kput ; kim lah ban pynïap ïa u lymda u ïohpdiang shuwa ïa ka jingbishar paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah ba la buh na ka bynta ki khun Israel baroh , bad na ka bynta u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong ki , ba uno uno u briew uba pyniap briew khlem da tip u lah ban phet noh sha kata ka jaka , bad ban ym iap da ka kti jong u nongpyniap snam , haduh ba un da ieng ha khmat ka jingiaseng .

en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven , and when thou seest the sun , and the moon , and the stars , even all the host of heaven , shouldest be driven to worship them , and serve them , which the  Lord  thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven .
kha: Sumar ban ym shah pynshoi kat haduh ban da mane bad shakri ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi ha sahit bneng — la ka long ka sngi , u bnai , lane ki khlur , ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha kiwei pat ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba kin ïoh mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ioh ba men rah ia ki khmat jong me sha bneng, bad haba me iohi ia ka sngi bad u bnai bad ki khlur, wat ia ki khlur baroh ki bneng, to shah pynkhih ban mane ia ki, bad to shakri ia ki, ia kiba U Trai U Blei jong me u la phiah ha ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba don hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei .

en: In that I command thee this day to love the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments , that thou mayest live and multiply : and the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , lada phi ieit ïa u , lada phi kohnguh ïa u , bad lada phi sumar ïa ki aiñ jong u , phin manbha bad phin long ruh ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me, ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u bad ban sumar ia ki hukum bad ki hukum jong u bad ki jingbishar jong u, ba me lah ban im bad ban nangroi: bad U Trai U Blei jong me un kyrkhu ia me ha ka ri kaba me leit ban ioh ia ka .

en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them , and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the  Lord s  house  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
kha: Ki pynpyiar la ki thapniang bad kiew shajrong na ka khyndew katba nga dang peit ïa ki , bad ki shalyntem ki bud lang ïa ki . Ki sangeh shiphang ha ka phalor kaba shaphang mihngi ka Templ , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ka shong halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki cherub ki la kiew ia ki bniat jong ki, bad ki la kiew na ka khyndew ha khmat jong nga: haba ki la mih noh , ki tyrpeng ruh ki la don hajan jong ki , bad uwei pa uwei u la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka iing U Trai; bad ka burom U Blei Israel ka la don halor jong ki .

en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley , and they that were on the other side Jordan , saw that the men of Israel fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , they forsook the cities , and fled  ; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
kha: Haba ki Israel kiba ha shiliang kata ka them Jesreel bad kiba sha mihngi ka wah Jordan ki ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ki Israel ka la phet ïap bad u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kyllon ïap , ki ruh ki iehnoh noh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong shnong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel kiba don sha shiliang ka them bad kiba don sha shiliang ka wah Jordan ki la iohi ba ki briew Israel ki la phet noh bad ba u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la iap .

en: Also , thou son of man , the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak one to another , every one to his brother , saying , Come , I pray you , and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko khun u briew , ki briew jong me ki ïakren shaphang jong me haba ki ïakynduh hajan ki kynroh ka nongbah ne ha ki lynti hajan jingkhang ki ïing jong ki . Ki ïa-ong para ma ki , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit bad sngap ka ktien aïu kaba wan na U Trai mynta .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh, ko khun briew, ki khun jong me ki dang ia kren pyrshah ia me da ki kynroh bad ha ki jingkhang jong ki iing, bad ki ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, uwei pa uwei ha u hynmen jong u, da kaba ong: To wan, nga kyrpad ia phi, bad to sngap ia kaei ka ktien kaba wan na U Trai .

en: Now it came to pass in the seventh month , that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama , of the seed royal , and the princes of the king , even ten men with him , came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah  ; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah .
kha: Ha u bnai uba hynñiew jong kata ka snem , u Ishmael , u khun jong u Nethanaïah bad u ksiew jong u Elishama , u dkhot ka longïing syiem bad uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba hakhlieh duh jong u syiem , u la leit sha Mispah lem bad shiphew ngut ki rangbah ban peit ïa u Gedalaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha ka hynriew bnai, ba u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah u khun u Elishama, bad ki rangbah syiem, wat shiphew ngut ki rangbah ki la wan sha u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam ha Mizpah; hangta ki la bam lang ha Mizpah .

en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time , then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place  ; but thou and thy father s house shall be destroyed : and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this ?
kha: Lada pha sngap jar ha ka por kum kane , ka jingïarap kan wan na bneng ïa ki Jiw , bad kin lait im , hynrei phan ïap , bad ka longïing u kpa jong pha kan kut noh . Pynban mano ba lah ban tip — lehse ka dei na ka bynta ka por kum kane ba la pynlong mahadei ïa pha !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada me bat ia ka jingsuk jong me ha kane ka por, te kan mih ka jingpynheh bad ka jingpyllait im ia ki Jiw na kawei pat ka jaka ; hynrei ma me bad ka iing u kpa jong me kin shah pynjot: bad mano ba tip la me wan sha ka hima na ka bynta kane ka por ?

en: For , lo , I will raise up a shepherd in the land , which shall not visit those that be cut off , neither shall seek the young one , nor heal that that is broken , nor feed that that standeth still : but he shall eat the flesh of the fat , and tear their claws in pieces .
kha: Nga la buh u nongaplangbrot ban khmih ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong nga , hynrei um shym la ïarap ïa ki langbrot kiba la shah byrngem da ka jingpynjot ; lymne ba u leit wad ïa kaba la jah noh , lane pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la mynsaw , lane bsa ïa kiba khiah . Pynban u bam ïa ka doh jong ki langbrot kiba sngaid bad u weng noh ïa ki khnap jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan pynmih ia u nongap langbrot ha ka ri, u bym ju leit jngoh ia kiba la shah ot noh, lymne un ym wad ia uta uba dang rit, lymne un ym pynkoit ia uta uba la tyrkhong, lymne un ym ai bam ia uta uba ieng: hynrei un bam ia ka doh jong ka shini, bad un pynkhih ia ki bniat jong ki.

en: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream , there is but one decree for you : for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me , till the time be changed : therefore tell me the dream , and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof .
kha: ban ai ha phi baroh ïa kajuh ka jingpynshitom lada phim ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew . Phi la ïamynjur para ma phi ban ïathuh ïa nga ki jinglamler namar ba phi kyrmen ba ha ka por babiang kiei kiei kin kylla . Ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad nangta ngan tip ba phi lah ruh ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym pynpaw ha nga ia ka jingphohsniew, ka don tang kawei ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi: namar phi la pynkhreh ia ki ktien kiba thok bad kiba bamsap ban kren ha khmat jong nga, haduh ba ka por kan kylla: namarkata to iathuh ia nga ia ka jingphohsniew, bad ngan tip ba phi lah ban pyni ia nga ia ka jingbatai jong ka .

en: Speak not thou in thine heart , after that the  Lord  thy God hath cast them out from before thee , saying , For my righteousness the  Lord  hath brought me in to possess this land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  doth drive them out from before thee .
kha: Wat ong ha la ka dohnud ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynher krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi , ka long namar ka hok jong ngi ba U  Trai  u la wan ïalam ïa ngi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .  Pynban ka long namar ka jingbymman kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  u la beh krad ïa ki namar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kren ha ka dohnud jong me, hadien ba U Trai U Blei jong me u la beh noh ia ki na khmat jong me, da kaba ong: Na ka bynta ka hok jong nga U Trai u la wanrah ia nga ban don ia kane ka ri: hynrei na ka bynta ka jingsniew jong kine ki jaitbynriew U Trai u beh noh ia ki na khmat jong me .

en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem , saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make booths , as it is written .
kha: Kumta ki ai ïa kine ki jingbthah bad ki phah ïa ki sha baroh ha Jerusalem bad kiwei pat ki nongbah bad ki shnong :  Khie leit sha ki lum bad pom ïa ki tnat na ki dieng Kseh , ki dieng Olib , ki dieng Martl , ki dieng Tlai bad kiwei ki dieng , ban shna ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba kin pynmih bad pynbna ha ki shnong jong ki baroh, bad ha Jerusalem, da kaba ong, To leit sha u lum, bad to shim ia ki tnat olive, bad ki tnat pine, bad ki tnat sohjew, bad ki tnat sohjew, bad ki tnat dieng kiba jylliew, ban shna ia ki tnat , kumba la thoh .

en: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds , the officers of the host , and said unto them , Have her forth without the ranges : and him that followeth her kill with the sword . For the priest had said , Let her not be slain in the house of the  Lord .
kha: U Jehoïada um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , te u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai :  Rah ïa ka shabar napdeng ki ar laiñ ba ïeng ki nongap phira , bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehoiada u lyngdoh u la hukum ia ki rangbah jong ki spah ngut ki rangbah shipai bad u la ong ha ki: To leh ia ka shabar ki kynroh: bad uta uba bud ia ka da ka waitlam . Namar u lyngdoh u la ong , Wat pyniap ia ka ha iing U Trai .

en: And Jonadab said unto him , Lay thee down on thy bed , and make thyself sick : and when thy father cometh to see thee , say unto him , I pray thee , let my sister Tamar come , and give me meat , and dress the meat in my sight , that I may see it , and eat it at her hand .
kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u ,  Khie leit thiah , bad leh mynleh pang . Haba i pa jong phi i wan jngoh ïa phi , ong ha i , ‘ Sngewbha ong ïa i para jong nga i Tamar ban wan bad ai bam ïa nga . Nga kwah ïa i ban pynkhreh jingbam hangne ha kaba nga lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad ba in ai bam ïa nga da ma i hi .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonadab u la ong ha u, To thiah ha ka jingthiah jong me, bad haba u kpa jong me u wan ban iohi ia me, to ong ha u, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba ka para jong nga ka wan, bad to ai bam ia nga ia ka doh ha khmat jong nga, ba ngan iohi ia ka, bad ngan bam ia ka ha ka kti jong ka .

en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .
kha: Hadien kane , u Manasseh u tei pynjrong ïa ka kynroh bashabar ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nongbah u Dabid , na ka tduh jong ka them hajan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Dohkha bad ka jaka jong ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . U buh ruh ïa u shipai pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ki shipai ha man ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien kane u la tei ia ka kynroh kaba khlem ka shnong u Dabid, ha ka liang sepngi jong u Gihon, ha ka them, wat haduh ka jingrung ha ka khyrdop dohkha, bad u la ker sawdong ia ka sawdong ka Ophel, bad u la pynkiew ia ka haduh katta katta, bad u la buh ia ki nongialam shipai ha ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong jong ka Judah baroh .

en: Fear thou not , O Jacob my servant , saith the  Lord  : for I am with thee  ; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee : but I will not make a full end of thee , but correct thee in measure  ; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished .
kha: Ngan wan ha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki hima baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan nym shah ba phin lait khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan lehhok . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia me, ko Jakob jong nga, ong U Trai: namar ngan pynlong ia me uba khlem shah pynshitom pura: hynrei ngan ym pynlong ia me uba khlem shah pynshitom pura: hynrei ngan ym pynbeit ia me ha ka rukom; hynrei ngan ym iehnoh ia me khlem da shah pynshitom pura .

en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest , who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the  Lord  : at his word shall they go out , and at his word they shall come in , both he , and all the children of Israel with him , even all the congregation .
kha: Un hap shaniah ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh , ban wad ïa ka mon jong nga da kaba pyndonkam ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   . Da kumne u Eleasar un kdew ïa u Joshua bad u paid Israel ha ki kam jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ieng ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh, uba pan jingmut na ka bynta jong u hadien ka jingbishar jong u Urim ha khmat U Trai: ha ka ktien jong u kin leit noh, bad ha ka ktien jong u kin wan rung, ma u bad ki khun Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, wat ia ka jingiaseng baroh .

en: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off , but not for himself : and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary  ; and the end thereof shall be with a flood , and unto the end of the war desolations are determined .
kha: Bad ha kaba kut jong kata ka por ïa u nongïalam ba la jied jong U Blei yn pynïap khlem bishar hok . Ïa ka nongbah bad ïa ka Templ yn pynjot da ka kynhun shipai kaba hiarthma jong u nongsynshar badonbor . Kaba kut kan wan kum ka jingshlei um , ka da wallam ïa ka thma bad ïa ka jingpynjot kaba U Blei u la lah pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien laiphew snem bad ar taiew yn ot noh ia u Messiah, hynrei ym na ka bynta jong u: bad ki briew jong u syiem ki ban wan kin pynjot ia ka shnong bad ka jaka kyntang; bad ka jingkut jong ka kan long da ka jingshlei um, bad haduh kaba kut jong ka jingpynjot thma .

en: The merchandise of gold , and silver , and precious stones , and of pearls , and fine linen , and purple , and silk , and scarlet , and all thyine wood , and all manner vessels of ivory , and all manner vessels of most precious wood , and of brass , and iron , and marble ,
kha: ym don mano mano ban thied ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila jong ki ; ki mar linen , ka jaiñ sawbthuh , ka jaiñ rusom , bad ka jaiñ basaw hain hain ; ïa baroh ki jait dieng bakynsai bad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba la shna na ka bniat hati bad na ka dieng baremdor , na ka rnong , ka nar , bad u maw marbl ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki mar ksiar bad rupa bad ki maw ba kordor bad ki mawkordor bad ki jain kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad bad kiba itynnad .

en: So it came to pass , when the king s commandment and his decree was heard , and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace , to the custody of Hegai , that Esther was brought also unto the king s house , to the custody of Hegai , keeper of the women .
kha: Haba u syiem u la pynmih ïa ka jingpynbna bathymmai bad shibun ki samla kynthei la wallam sha Susa , ka Esther ka la long kawei na ki . Ïa ka ruh la buh ha ka ïingsyiem hapoh ka jingsumar u Hegai , uba peit ïa ka ïing ki kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la jia, haba la iohsngew ia ka hukum jong u syiem bad ka hukum jong u, bad haba la ialum lang ha u Shushan ka iing syiem, ha ka jingsumar jong u Hegai, ba la wanrah ruh ia ka Esther sha ka iing syiem, ha ka jingsumar jong u Hegai, u nongsumar ia ki kynthei .

en: Children in whom was no blemish , but well favoured , and skilful in all wisdom , and cunning in knowledge , and understanding science , and such as had ability in them to stand in the king s palace , and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans .
kha: Ki dei ban long kiba bhabriew , kiba nep jingmut , kiba la ïoh jinghikai bha , kiba stet ban nang , bad kiba lait na ka jinganna , ba kumta kin lah ban long kiba bit ban shakri ha ka ïingbishar jong u syiem . U Ashpenas u dei ban hikai ïa ki ban pule bad ban thoh ïa ka ktien ki nong Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah ha kiba ym shym la don jingduna, hynrei kiba la sngewtynnad bha, bad kiba stad ha ka jingstad baroh, bad kiba stad ha ka jingstad, bad kiba sngewthuh ia ka jingstad, bad kiba kum kita ki don ka jinglah ha ki ban ieng ha ka iing syiem jong u syiem, bad kiba ki lah ban hikai ia ka jingnang jingstad bad ka shyntur jong ki Khaldi .

en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood , and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree , and the head slippeth from the helve , and lighteth upon his neighbour , that he die  ; he shall flee unto one of those cities , and live :
kha: Kum ka nuksa , haba ar ngut ki briew ki leit thoh dieng lang sha khlaw bad , katba uwei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u dieng , u sdie u lait na u sping bad u leit dei ha uta uwei pat , bad kumta u ïap , u lah ban phet sha kawei na kita ki lai tylli ki shnong , bad un leit rieh bad ïohlait im hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u briew u leit shapoh khlaw bad u paramarjan jong u ban tih dieng, bad ka kti jong u ka shim ia ka stroke da ka ax ban ot ia u dieng, bad ka khlieh ka slip na ka helve, bad ka jingshai ha u paramarjan jong u, ba u iap; un phet noh sha kawei na kita ki nongbah, bad un im:

en: When thou shalt beget children , and children s children , and ye shall have remained long in the land , and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , to provoke him to anger :
kha: Haba phi la shong slem ha kata ka ri bad phi la ïoh khun ïoh ksiew , wat leh pop da kaba thaw blei ïa lade da kano kano ka dur . Kata ka long ka kam bymman ha khmat U  Trai  , bad kan pynbitar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me kha khun bad ki khun ki ksiew bad phi la sah slem ha ka ri, bad phin pynsniew ia lade bad phin thaw ia ka dur ba la ker ne ka dur jong kano kano ka jinglong bad phin leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me, ban pynkhih ia u ban bitar:

en: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers , and the wickedness of the kings of Judah , and the wickedness of their wives , and your own wickedness , and the wickedness of your wives , which they have committed in the land of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem ?
kha: Hato phi la klet ïa ki kam bymman baroh ïa kiba la leh ha ki shnong jong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem da ki kpa tymmen jong phi , da ki syiem ka Judah bad ki tnga jong ki , bad da ma phi bad ki tnga jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi la klet ia ka jingsniew jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ka jingsniew jong ki syiem Judah bad ka jingsniew jong ki tnga jong ki bad ka jingsniew jong phi hi bad ka jingsniew jong ki tnga jong phi kiba ki la leh ha ka ri Judah bad ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem ?

en: And Nehemiah , which is the Tirshatha , and Ezra the priest the scribe , and the Levites that taught the people , said unto all the people , This day is holy unto the  Lord  your God  ; mourn not , nor weep . For all the people wept , when they heard the words of the law .
kha: Haba u paidbah u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ïa ki , la pynkhih ïa ki dohnud jong ki bad ki sdang ban ïam . Kumta u Nehemaïah , uba long u lat , u Esra , uba long u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum , bad ki Lebi kiba dang batai ïa ka Hukum , ki la ong ha u paidbah ,  Kane ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kumta phim dei ban sngewsih ne ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nehemaiah uba long u Tirshatha bad u Esra u lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba la hikai ia ki briew baroh ki la ong ha ki briew baroh , Kane ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U Trai U Blei jong phi; wat iam . Na ka bynta ki briew baroh ki iam haba ki iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka hukum .

en: When that year was ended , they came unto him the second year , and said unto him , We will not hide it from my lord , how that our money is spent  ; my lord also hath our herds of cattle  ; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands :
kha: Ha ka snem kaba bud , ki ïawan sha u , bad ki ïa-ong ,  Kynrad , ngin ym buhrieh ïa ka jingshisha na phi ba ki pisa jong ngi baroh ki la lut , bad ba ki jingri jingdup jong ngi ki la dei ki jong phi . Ngim don ei ei shuh ban ai ïa phi lait noh sa tang ki met jong ngi bad ki lyngkha jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda kata ka snem ka la kut noh , ki la wan sha u ha ka snem kaba ar , bad ki la ong ha u , Ngin ym buhrieh ia ka na u kynrad jong nga , kumno ba ka pisa jong ngi ka la pynlut ; u kynrad jong nga ruh u don ki kynhun masi jong ngi;

en: And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house  ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .
kha: Kumta u Ananias u la leit , u la rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba u Saul u don , bad u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u .  Ko Saul , u para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  U Trai u la phah ïa nga — U Jisu hi , uba la mihpaw ha me ha ka lynti katba me dang wan shane . U la phah ïa nga khnang ba men ïoh imat pat bad ban pyndap ïa me da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Haniah u la leit shapoh iing; bad u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha u, u Brother u la ong: U Trai, u Jisu, uba la paw ha me ha ka lynti kumba me wan, u la phah ia nga, ba me lah ban pdiang ia ka jingpeit jong me, bad ba me pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Namar ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki ban lute ïa phi bad pynjot ïa phi . Ngan pynjot lut ïa phi ba phin ym long shuh ka jaitbynriew lane ban don ka ri la ka jong . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , namarkata ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor jong me , bad ngan aiti ia me na ka bynta ka jingshah pynjot ha ki jaitbynriew ; bad ngan pynduh noh ia me na ki ri: Ngan pynjot ia me ; bad me phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Son of man , take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt , and say unto him , Thou art like a young lion of the nations , and thou art as a whale in the seas : and thou camest forth with thy rivers , and troubledst the waters with thy feet , and fouledst their rivers .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ai ka jingmaham bakyntang ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . Ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na nga : Me leh kum u sing hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hynrei me long kum u kuratia uba pashait um ha wah . Me pynjngut ïa ka um da ki kjat jong me bad me pyntngit ïa ki wah .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to shim ia ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt, bad to ong ha u, Me long kum u sing rit jong ki jaitbynriew: bad me wan shabar bad ki wah jong me, bad me pynkhuslai ia ki um jong me da ki kjat jong me, bad me pynsniew ia ki wah jong ki .

en: And David said , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , because his father shewed kindness to me . And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father . So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun , to comfort him .
kha: U syiem Dabid u ong ,  nga dei ban pyn-i ïa ka jinglong paralok bashisha ïa u Hanun , kumba u kpa jong u , u Nahash u la leh ïa nga .  Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Haba ki la poi ha Ammon bad ïakynduh ïa u syiem Hanun ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong , Ngan pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia u Hanun u khun u Nahas, namar u kpa jong u u la pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia nga . U Dabid u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor ban pyntngen ia u shaphang u kpa jong u . Kumta ki shakri u Dabid ki la wan sha ka ri jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon sha Hanun, ban pyntngen ia u .

en: Speak unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will profane my sanctuary , the excellency of your strength , the desire of your eyes , and that which your soul pitieth  ; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword .
kha: ba ngan ai ha ki Israel ïa kane ka khubor : Pha sarong ha ka jingkhraw jong ka Templ . Pha sngewbha ban khmih ïa ka bad ban leit jngoh ïa ka , hynrei U  Trai  un pyntngit ïa ka . Bad ki dkhot ba kham samla ha ki longïing jong pha kiba la shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ia ka iing Israel , Kumta u Trai Blei baroh kawei un pynjah burom ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga, ka jingbha jong ka bor jong phi, ka jingkwah jong phi, bad kata kaba ka mynsiem jong phi ka sngewsih; bad ki khun shynrang jong phi bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kiba phi la iehnoh kin hap da ka waitlam .

en: And David sware moreover , and said , Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes  ; and he saith , Let not Jonathan know this , lest he be grieved : but truly as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , there is but a step between me and death .
kha: Hynrei u Dabid u jubab ,  I pa jong phi i tip bha katno ba phi sngewieit ïa nga , bad i la rai ba phin ym tip ïa kaei ba i thmu ban leh , namar ba phin sa sngewkthang eh . Nga smai ha phi da U  Trai  uba im ba nga don sa tang shisien jam na ka jingïap !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngap jar shuh shuh, bad u la ong, U kpa jong me u tip shisha ba nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha ki khmat jong me ; bad u ong, Wat tip ia kane, ioh ba un sngewsih: hynrei shisha kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ka don tang kawei ka step hapdeng jong nga bad ka jingiap .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered , in that your transgressions are discovered , so that in all your doings your sins do appear  ; because , I say , that ye are come to remembrance , ye shall be taken with the hand .
kha: Kane namarkata ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Ïa ki pop jong phi la pynpaw . Baroh ki tip katno kiba bymman phi long . Phi pyn-i ïa la ki pop ha ki kam jong phi baroh . Phi long ba la pynrem , bad ngan aiti noh ïa phi ha ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Namar ba phi la pynlong ia ka jingbymhok jong phi ban kynmaw, ha kaba la lap ia ki jingpynkhein jong phi baroh, kumta ha ki jingleh jong phi baroh ki paw; namar nga ong, ba phi wan sha ka jingkynmaw, phin sa shah shim da ka kti .

en: I know also , my God , that thou triest the heart , and hast pleasure in uprightness . As for me , in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things : and now have I seen with joy thy people , which are present here , to offer willingly unto thee .
kha: Nga tip ba me tynjuh ïa ka dohnud jong uwei pa uwei bad me sngewbha bad ki briew kiba im hok . Ha ka hok bad ka jinglong sngur nga la ai da ka mon sngewbha ïa kane baroh sha me , bad nga la ïohi katno ki briew jong me kiba la ïalumlang hangne ki kmen ban wanrah ki jingainguh sha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ruh, ko Blei jong nga, ba me pyrshang ia ka dohnud, bad me sngewbha ha ka jinglong hok . Katba ia nga, ha ka jinglong hok jong ka dohnud jong nga nga la tyrwa mon sngewbha ia kine kiei kiei baroh: bad mynta nga la iohi da ka jingkmen ia ki briew jong me kiba don hangne, ban aiti mon sngewbha ha me .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Again there shall be heard in this place , which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast , even in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , that are desolate , without man , and without inhabitant , and without beast ,
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kane ka jaka ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ba kam don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im ha ka . Bad ki ong ïa kaba dei ; ki shnong ka Judah bad ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki long thylli ; ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Sa shisien yn sa iohsngew ha kane ka jaka, kaba phi ong ba kan long kaba la jot khlem briew bad khlem mrad, wat ha ki shnong Judah bad ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem, kiba la jot khlem briew bad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem mrad khlem m

en: He shall put on the holy linen coat , and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh , and shall be girded with a linen girdle , and with the linen mitre shall he be attired : these are holy garments  ; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water , and so put them on .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki jinghikai shuwa ba u Aaron un rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , u dei ban da sum , bad nangta un kup ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ; ka sopti linen , ka patlun lyngkot , ka jingpanpoh , bad ka jaiñspong .
translated_en_to_kha: Un phong ia ka jain lin kaba khuid, bad un phong da ka jain lin kaba khuid ha ka doh jong u, bad da ka jain lin ba la khleh lang: kine ki long ki jain kiba khuid namarkata;

en: Therefore at that time , when all the people heard the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and all kinds of musick , all the people , the nations , and the languages , fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
kha: Bad kumta , mar syn ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki tiar put tiar tem , ki briew jong baroh ki ri , ki jaitbynriew , bad ki jait ktien ki la ïadem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u Syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ha kata ka por , haba ki briew baroh ki la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka kornet , ka flute , ka harp , ka sackbut , ka jingrwai bad ki jait jingrwai baroh , ki briew baroh , ki jaitbynriew bad ki ktien ki la hap bad ki la mane ia ka dur ksiar kaba u Nebuchadnear u syiem u la buh .

en: And he said unto them , This is that which the  Lord  hath said , To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the  Lord  : bake that which ye will bake to day , and seethe that ye will seethe  ; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning .
kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ba lashai ka dei ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyrpang sha u . Shet mynta kat ïa kaba phi dei ban shet , bad pynthnam kat ïa kaba phi dei ban pynthnam . Sa buh kyrpang kat ïa kaba tam bad tyngkai ïa ka na ka bynta lashai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kane ka long kaba U Trai u la ong: To buh ia kata kaba pher ha U Trai: to bam ia kata kaba phin sa shet ha ka sngi , bad to bam ia kata kaba phin sa bam ha ka sngi .

en: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath , from doing thy pleasure on my holy day  ; and call the sabbath a delight , the holy of the  Lord  , honourable  ; and shalt honour him , not doing thine own ways , nor finding thine own pleasure , nor speaking thine own words :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada phi ñiew ïa ka Sabbaton kum kaba kyntang bad phin ym beh tang ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi ha kata ka sngi ; lada phi ñiewkor ïa ka sngi kaba khuid jong nga bad lada phi burom ïa ka khlem da leit jingleit , treikam , lane shu bunktien bieit ha kata ka sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me pynphai noh ia ka kjat jong me na ka sngi saitjain jong nga bad khot ia ka sngi saitjain jong nga, ka ktien bakhuid jong U Trai, kaba donburom; bad to burom ia u, wat leh ia la ki jong ki lynti, lane wad ia la ka jong ka jingsngewbha;

en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh  ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh : he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land , of every one according to his taxation , to give it unto Pharaoh–neco .
kha: U syiem Jehoïakim u la lum khajna na ki briew kat kum ka jingdon spah jong ki , khnang ban pynmih ïa ka pisa ba dei ban siew ïa ka bai nguh syiem kumba la dawa da u syiem Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoilim u la ai ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha u Pharaoh hynrei u la siew khajna ia ka ri ban ai ia ka pisa katkum ka hukum jong u Pharaoh: u la shim ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki briew jong ka ri, na uwei pa uwei katkum ka khajna jong u, ban ai ia ka ha u Pharaohneco .

en: All the heave offerings of the holy things , which the children of Israel offer unto the  Lord  , have I given thee , and thy sons and thy daughters with thee , by a statute for ever : it is a covenant of salt for ever before the  Lord  unto thee and to thy seed with thee .
kha: Nga ai ha me , ha ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me , ha ki por ki ban wan baroh ïa ki jingai bakyrpang baroh ba ki Israel ki ai ha nga . Kane ka long ka jutang bym lah pynkheiñ kaba nga la pynlong bad me lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki jingainguh bakhuid kiba ki khun Israel ki ai ha U Trai , nga la ai ha me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad ki khun kynthei jong me bad me: ka long ka jutang jong ka umsoh junom ha khmat U Trai ha me bad ha u symbai jong me bad me .
