en: And that which they have need of , both young bullocks , and rams , and lambs , for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven , wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail :
kha: Man ka sngi , khlem pep , phi dei ban ai ïa ki lyngdoh ha Jerusalem ïa kaei kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ba ki donkam : ki masi lyngraw , ki langbrot , lane ki khunlangbrot ban kñia kum ki jingainguh sha U Blei jong ka Bneng , lane u kew , ka mluh , ka waiñ , lane ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kaba ki donkam, ki masi bad ki langbrot kiba dang rit, na ka bynta ki jingknia thang jong U Blei jong ka bneng, u kew, ka umsoh, ka wain bad ka umphniang kat kum ka jingthung ia ki lyngdoh kiba don ha Jerusalem , to ai ba kin ioh ia ki man ka sngi khlem pep:

en: And the princes , governors , and captains , and the king s counsellors , being gathered together , saw these men , upon whose bodies the fire had no power , nor was an hair of their head singed , neither were their coats changed , nor the smell of fire had passed on them .
kha: Baroh ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem ki la ïalumlang ban khmih ïa ki lai ngut ki rangbah , ki bym shym la pynmynsaw da ka ding . U shñiuh jong ki u khlem ing , ki jaiñ jong ki , ki khlem ing , bad ym shym la don kano kano ka jingsma tdem ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem, ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah jong ki, bad ki nongai jingmut jong ki syiem, ki la ialum lang, ki la iohi ia kine ki briew, ha kiba ka ding kam don bor , lymne u shniuh khlieh jong ki um shym la rwai , lymne ka jingsma jong ka ding ka la iaid ha ki .

en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city , and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city , they shall take him into the city unto them , and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .
kha: U lah ban phet ïap sha kawei na kine ki nongbah , un leit sha ka jaka bishar ha ka khyrdop sha ka nongbah , bad batai ha ki nongïalam ïa kaba la jia . Nangta kin shah ba un rung shapoh ka nongbah bad kin ai jaka sah ïa u , ba kumta u lah ban shong ban sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba uta u phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong un ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka shnong , bad un pynbna ia ka daw jong u ha ki shkor jong ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong , kin shim ia u shapoh ka shnong ha ki , bad kin ai jaka ia u , ba un shong hapdeng jong ki .

en: So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asaiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college  ; ) and they communed with her .
kha: U Hilkaïah , u Ahikam , u Akhbor , u Shaphan , bad u Asaïah , ki leit ban kylli na ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa , kaba shong ba sah ha ka jaka ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u ksiew jong u Harhas , uba dei khmih ïa ki barandi ka Templ . ) Ki batai ha ka , ïa kaei kaba la jia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Hilkiah u lyngdoh, bad u Ahbor, bad u Shaphan, bad u Ashaiah, ki la leit sha ka jingiathuhlypa, ka tnga jong u Shallum u khun u Tikvah, u khun u Hach, u nongsumar ia ka wardrobe ; (mynta ka la shong ha Jerusalem ha ka kolej ; ) bad ki la iasoh bad ka .

en: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain , so was the appearance of the brightness round about . This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the  Lord . And when I saw it , I fell upon my face , and I heard a voice of one that spake .
kha: Ka shai baroh sawdong da ka jingshai kaba phyrnai kaba don lut ha ka baroh ki rong jong u simpyllieng . Kane ka long ka jingshai kaba thaba kaba pynpaw ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . Haba nga la ïohi ïa kane , nga kyllon kram da pyllup ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka dur jong ka bow kaba don ha u lyoh ha ka sngi slap , kumjuh ruh ka dur jong ka jingshai sawdong . Kane ka la long ka dur jong ka jinglong jong ka burom U Trai . Bad haba nga la iohi ia ka , nga la hap ha ka khmat jong nga , bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong uta uba kren .

en: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .
kha: Hynrei u syiem Jehoash u phah kylla ïa ka jubab kumne :  Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah ïa ka khubor sha u dieng Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong phi ban shongkurim bad u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid nangta bad u kyrdem ïa u dieng shiah shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoash u syiem Israel u la phah sha u Amasaiah u syiem Judah, u da ong, Ka jingsawa kaba don ha Lebanon ka la phah sha u sohjew uba don ha Lebanon, da kaba ong: Ai ia ka khun jong me ha u khun jong nga: bad hangta u la iaid lyngba u mrad khlaw uba don ha Lebanon .

en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great , and he shall divide the spoil with the strong  ; because he hath poured out his soul unto death : and he was numbered with the transgressors  ; and he bare the sin of many , and made intercession for the transgressors .
kha: Bad kumta ngan ai ha u ïa ka burom , ka jaka hapdeng kiba khraw bad kiba donbor . U la aiti mon sngewbha ïa la ka jingim bad u la shim bynta lem bad ki riewbymman . U la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki nongpop kiba bun bad u la duwai ba ki kin ïoh ïa ka Jingmap-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan phiah ia u da kaba khraw, bad un phiah ia ka jingjot bad kaba khlain ; namar u la theh ia ka mynsiem jong u haduh ka jingiap: bad u la shah khein bad ki nongleh bymman ; bad u la kit ia ka pop jong kiba bun , bad u la leh ia ka jingkyrpad na ka bynta ki nongleh bymman .

en: Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .
kha: Te nga la shim ïa kawei pat ka kot kli bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u sekretari jong nga u Barukh , bad u la thoh hangta ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha ka kot kli kaba nyngkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba nga la ong ha u ban thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la shim sa kawei pat ka kot, bad u la ai ha u Barukh u nongthoh, u khun u Neriah; uba la thoh ha ka ktien jong u Jeremaiah baroh ki ktien jong ka kot kiba u syiem Judah u la thang ha ka ding: bad la pyndap shuh shuh ia ki da ki kyntien kiba kum kita .

en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when I chose Israel , and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob , and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt , when I lifted up mine hand unto them , saying , I am the  Lord  your God  ;
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Mynba nga la jied ïa ka Israel , nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ki . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha Ijipt bad ong ïa ki : Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong ha ka sngi ba nga la jied ia ki Israel, bad nga la pynkiew ia la ka kti sha u symbai jong ka iing u Jakob, bad nga la pynpaw ia lade ha ki ha ka ri Ijipt , haba nga la pynkiew ia la ka kti sha ki, da kaba ong, Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi;

en: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison , and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers  street , until all the bread in the city were spent . Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison .
kha: Kumta u syiem Sedekaïah u la hukum ba yn set ïa nga ha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem . Nga la sah hangta , bad man ka sngi ïa nga la ai uwei u kpu na ka jaka shet kpu haduh ba baroh u kpu ha ka nongbah u la lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sedekaiah u syiem u la hukum ba kin pynlong ia u Jeremaiah ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok bad ba kin ai ia u man ka sngi ia u kpu na ka lynti jong ki nongshet kpu baroh ha ka nongbah . Kumta u Jeremaiah u la sah ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok .

en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the  Lord  , neither shall they be pleasing unto him : their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners  ; all that eat thereof shall be polluted : for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ha kito ki ri nongwei kin ym lah ban ai ka jingainguh waiñ ha U  Trai  , lane wanlam ki jingkñia ha u . Ki jingbam jong ki kin pyntngit ïa uno uno uba bam ïa ki , kum ki jingbam ba bam ha ka por ïapbriew . Yn pyndonkam ïa ki tang ban pynkdang ïa la ka jingthngan ; ym don kawei ruh ka ban shim kum ka jingainguh ha ka Templ U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym ai wain ia U Trai , bad kin ym sngewbha ia u: ki jingknia jong ki kin long ha ki kum u kpu jong ki nongsngewsih; baroh kiba bam ia ka kin long kiba la pynjakhlia: namar u kpu jong ki na ka bynta ka mynsiem jong ki un ym wan sha ka iing U Trai .

en: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail , and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child , the voice of the daughter of Zion , that bewaileth herself , that spreadeth her hands , saying , Woe is me now ! for my soul is wearied because of murderers .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam , kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha , ka jinglynñiar kum ka kynthei kaba kha ïa i khun nyngkong jong ka . Ka la long ka jingïam jong ka Jerusalem kaba kwah eh ban ring mynsiem , ka da kner noh ïa ka kti jong ka bad ong ,  Nga long kaba la tim ! Ki wan ban pynïap ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kum ka kynthei kaba kha khun nyngkong, bad ka jingsngewsih kum ka jong ka, ka sur jong ka khun nyngkong jong ka Seion, kaba pynkhih ia lade, kaba pynjylliew ia ki kti jong ka, da kaba ong: Ko nga mynta ! namar ka mynsiem jong nga ka la tyrkhong namar ki nongpyniap briew .

en: And David answered the priest , and said unto him , Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days , since I came out , and the vessels of the young men are holy , and the bread is in a manner common , yea , though it were sanctified this day in the vessel .
kha: Da shisha kim shym leh kumta ,  u Dabid u jubab .  Ki rangbah jong nga ki ju sumar khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam wat haba ngi don ha ka jingïaleh kaba malu mala ; katno tam lei lei ha kane ka por ha kaba ngi don ha ka jingïaleh kaba kham kyrpang !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la jubab ia u lyngdoh bad u la ong ha u, Na ka jingshisha la buh ia ki kynthei na ngi kumba lai sngi, naduh ba nga la mih noh, bad ki khiew jong ki samla ki long kiba khuid, bad u kpu u long ha ka rukom kaba ju long, hooid, wat la la pynkyntang ia ka mynta ka sngi ha ka khiew .

en: And the king shall do according to his will  ; and he shall exalt himself , and magnify himself above every god , and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods , and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished : for that that is determined shall be done .
kha: U syiem ka Syria un leh kat kaba u sngewbha . Un kob ba u long kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u blei , kham halor wat ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Un lah ban leh ïa kane tad haduh ha ka por haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa u . U Blei un leh thik ïa kaei kaba u la thmu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem un leh katkum ka mon jong u ; bad un pynkhraw ia lade halor u blei baroh, bad un kren ia kiei kiei kiba phylla pyrshah ia U Blei jong ki blei, bad un roi haduh ba ka jingbitar kan long kaba la pyndep: namar kata ka long kaba la buh .

en: See therefore , and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself , and come ye again to me with the certainty , and I will go with you : and it shall come to pass , if he be in the land , that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah .
kha: Wad bha ïa ki jaka ha kiba u rieh , bad da kynmaw ban wanrah khubor beit beit sha nga . Te ngan sa leit bad phi ; bad lada u dang don ha kata ka thain , ngan kthong ïa u , wat la nga hap ban wad ha ka ri Judah baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit namarkata , bad to tip ia ki jaka ba rieh ha kaba u buhrieh ia lade, bad to wan biang sha nga da ka jingthikna, bad ngan leit bad phi: bad kan sa jia lada u don ha ka ri, ba ngan wad ia u ha ki hajar ngut ki Judah baroh .

en: They said therefore among themselves , Let us not rend it , but cast lots for it , whose it shall be : that the scripture might be fulfilled , which saith , They parted my raiment among them , and for my vesture they did cast lots . These things therefore the soldiers did .
kha: Ki shipai ki la ong para ma ki ,  To ngin ym tar pynkad ïa ka , to ngin ïakynting sbai ban shem mano ba ïoh ïa ka .  Kane ka la jia khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha :  Ki la pynïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong nga hapdeng jong ki bad ki la ïakhalai ïa ka jaiñkup jong nga .  Kane ka long kaei kaba ki shipai ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong namarkata hapdeng jong ki , To ngin ym pynkylla ia ka, hynrei ngin ia thep ia ka, kaba kan long: ba ka jingthoh kan long: ba ka jingthoh kan long: ba ka jingthoh kan long: Ba ki la iakhlad noh ia ka jainkup jong nga hapdeng jong ki . Kine kiei kiei kiba ki shipai ki la leh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , waters rise up out of the north , and shall be an overflowing flood , and shall overflow the land , and all that is therein  ; the city , and them that dwell therein : then the men shall cry , and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl .
kha: U ong :  Ha khmih ! Ki um ki la nang shlei na shatei bad kin tuid stet kum ka wah ba la shlei um . Kin tap ïa ka ri bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka , ki nongbah bad ki briew kiba im hangta . Ki briew kin pyrta jingïarap ; baroh kiba ha ka pyrthei kin ïamkthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Ha khmih ki um ki kiew na shaphang shathie, bad kan long ka jingshlei um kaba tuid palat, bad baroh kaba don ha kata ka jaka; bad kita kiba shong ha ka: nangta ki briew kin iam, bad ki nongshong shnong baroh kin iam .

en: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , thy servants , to whom thou swarest by thine own self , and saidst unto them , I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed , and they shall inherit it for ever .
kha: Kynmaw ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , ki shakri jong me . Kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba me la pynlong bad ki ban ai ha ki ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , bad ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ïa kata ka ri baroh kaba me la kular ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia u Abraham, u Isaak bad ki Israel jong me, ha kiba me sngewsih da ka jinglong jong me hi, bad nga la ong ha ki , Ngan pynbun ia u symbai jong me kum ki khlur bneng , bad ia kane ka ri baroh kaba nga la kren ngan ai ha u symbai jong me , bad kin hiar pateng ia ka junom .

en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
kha: Te u Jehoïada u shim ïa ka synduk , u ksam thliew ha ka jingtap , bad u buh ïa ka synduk hajan ka duwan , ha ka phang kamon haba rung sha ka Templ . Ki lyngdoh kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki thep ha ka synduk ïa ka pisa baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehoiada u lyngdoh u la shim ia ka shyntur, bad u la buh ia ka hajan ka jingtap jong ka, bad u la buh ia ka hajan ka liang kadiang katba u wan shapoh ka iing U Trai: bad ki lyngdoh kiba la buh ia ka jingkhang ki la buh ha ka pisa baroh kaba la wanrah shapoh ka iing U Trai .

en: And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning , and taught . But the high priest came , and they that were with him , and called the council together , and all the senate of the children of Israel , and sent to the prison to have them brought .
kha: Ki apostol ki la kohnguh , bad haba dang byrngut ki la rung sha ka Templ bad ki la sdang ban hikai . U Rangbah Lyngdoh bad kiba synran ïa u ki la khot lang ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw na ka bynta ka jingïalang ba-pura jong ka Dorbar ; nangta ki la phah hukum sha ka byndi ban wallam ïa ki apostol ha khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la rung shapoh ka tempi mynstep bad ki la hikai . Hynrei u rangbah lyngdoh u la wan bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u bad u la khot ia ka dorbar bad ki khun Israel baroh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will give Pharaoh–hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies , and into the hand of them that seek his life  ; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , his enemy , and that sought his life .
kha: Ngan aiti noh ïa u Hophra u syiem ka Ijipt ha ki nongshun jong u kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa u , kumba nga la aiti ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , uba la long u nongshun jong u bad uba kwah ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la ong u Trai ; Ha khmih , ngan ai ia u Pharaoh ̌hophra u syiem Ijipt ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong u , bad ha ka kti jong ki kiba wad ia ka jingim jong u .

en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen . Now thou , O Belteshazzar , declare the interpretation thereof , forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation : but thou art able  ; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee .
kha: Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh ,  ong u syiem Nebukhadnessar .  Mynta , ko Belteshassar , ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Ym don man mano na ki nongai jingmut na ka ïingsyiem jong nga kiba lah ban ïathuh ha nga , hynrei me lah , namar ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingphohsniew nga u syiem Neuchadnezzar nga la iohi . Mynta me, ko Beltesar, to pynbna ia ka jingbatai jong ka, namar ba ki riewstad baroh jong ka hima jong nga kim lah ban pyntip ha nga ia ka jingbatai: hynrei me lah ban leh; namar ka mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid ka don ha me .

en: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward , from the hill that lieth before Beth–horon southward  ; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , a city of the children of Judah : this was the west quarter .
kha: Nangta u khun sha kawei pat ka liang , da kaba phai shathie na ka liang sepngi jong uta u lum bad u suh shaduh ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) , kaba dei jong ka jait Judah . Une u dei u pud uba shaphang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam u la mih nangta, bad u la ker sawdong ia ka tduh jong ka duriaw shaphang shathie, na u lum uba don ha khmat u Bethhoron shaphang shathie; bad ki jingleit shabar jong ka ki long ha Kirjatbaal, kaba long Kirjatjaram, ka shnong jong ki khun Judah: kane ka la long ka jaka sah jong ki khun shatei lam mihngi .

en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle s son , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase , before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison .
kha: bad nga la ai ïa ki ha u Barukh , u khun jong u Neraïah bad u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Nga la ai ïa ki ha u ha ka jingïadon lang u Hanamel bad ki sakhi kiba la soi ïa ka dulir thied jaka bad ki rangbah kiba ïashong ha ka phyllaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ai ia ka sakhi jong ka jingthied ha u Baruk u khun u Neriah, u khun u Maaseiah, ha khmat u khun u Hanameel jong nga, bad ha khmat ki sakhi kiba la kyrshan ia ka kot thied, ha khmat ki Jiw baroh kiba shong ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok .

en: But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .
kha: Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid bha bad ki ïaid sheng sheng . Ki la dih waiñ bad dih kyiad haduh katta katta haduh ba ki jynthut kulmar . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïabuaid haduh katta katta ba kim sngewthuh shuh ïa ki jingïohipaw ba U Blei u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid haduh ba kim lah shuh ban ai jingrai ïa ki kam ba la wanrah ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki ruh ki la bakla lyngba ka wain, bad lyngba ka jingdih kaba jur ki la jah noh lyngba ka jingdih kaba jur, ki la shah rong noh ha ka wain, ki la jah noh lyngba ka jingdih kaba jur; ki bakla ha ka jingpeit bniah .

en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her , all the beasts of the nations : both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it  ; their voice shall sing in the windows  ; desolation shall be in the thresholds : for he shall uncover the cedar work .
kha: Kan long ka jaka ha kaba ki kynhun jingri , ki masi , bad ki mrad ba bun jait kin dem . Ki dkhoh kin shong ha ki jingjot jong ka bad kin pah na ki jingkhangïit . Ki tyngab kin pah ha ki khmat jingkhang . Ïa ki dieng Kedar jong ki jingtei jong ka yn sloit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kynhun kin thiah hapdeng jong ka, ki mrad baroh: baroh ar ki bniat bad ka sniehdoh kin sah ha ki bniat ba shalor jong ka; ka sur jong ki kan rwai ha ki jingkhang; ka jingpynjot jong ki kan long ha ki jingkhang: namar un sa pynpaw ia ka kam cedar .

en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee ? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee , to search the city , and to spy it out , and to overthrow it ?
kha: ki nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki ong ha u syiem ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei na ka bynta ka burom jong u kpa jong phi ba u Dabid u la phah ïa kine ki rangbah ban pynpaw ka jingsngewlem ha phi ? Ym kumta da shisha ! U la phah ïa ki hangne kum ki nongsyntiat ban swar ïa ka nongbah , ba kumta u lah ban jop ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ki khun Ammon ki la ong ha u Hanun u kynrad jong ki, Phi tharai ba u Dabid u burom ia u kpa jong me, ba u la phah ia ki nongpyntngen sha me ? hato u Dabid u la phah kham bha ia ki shakri jong u sha me, ban wad ia ka shnong bad ban leit shabar bad ban pynpra ia ka ?

en: Therefore prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they have made you desolate , and swallowed you up on every side , that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen , and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers , and are an infamy of the people :
kha: To ïathuhlypa , nangta , bad to pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong . Mynba ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan ki la kurup bad lute ïa ki lumbah ka Israel , baroh ki la krenbeiñ ïa ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iathuhlypa bad ong , Kumta u Trai Blei u la pynlong ia phi ban shah pynjot , bad ki la sngap jar ia phi na baroh ki liang , ba phin long ka jingdon jingem ha ki bynta ba sah jong ki nongwei , bad phi la shah shim ha ki rmiang shyntur jong ki nongkren bein , bad phi long ka jingjah burom jong ki briew:

en: Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .
kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga kylli : Hato une u dieng sohwaiñ un im bad san ? Hato u pukni uba nyngkong un ym rat ïa u na ki thied , phut noh ïa ki sohwaiñ , bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat bad shah ïa ki ban ïapstai ? Kam da shim shibun eh ka jingkhlaiñ lane ka hima bakhlaiñbor ban rat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ma me: Kumta u Trai Blei un roi ? un ym tan ia ki tynrai jong ka, bad un ym ot ia u soh jong ka, ba un tyrkhong ? kan tyrkhong ha ki sla jong ka baroh ki sla jong ka .

en: And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold , Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him , with a couple of asses saddled , and upon them two hundred loaves of bread , and an hundred bunches of raisins , and an hundred of summer fruits , and a bottle of wine .
kha: Haba u Dabid u la jam kham sha khmat na ka kliar lum , u la ïakynduh kynsan ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Mephibosheth , uba la don bad u shi jur ki kada kiba kit arspah tylli ki kpu , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh ba dang shu kheit , bad kawei ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iaid khyndiat sha jrong jong u lum, ha khmih u Siba u shakri jong u Mephishet u la iakynduh ia u, bad ar tylli ki kada ki la ia tyngkhuh bad halor jong ki arspah tylli ki kpu bad shispah tylli ki soh kba, bad shispah tylli ki soh slap bad ka bilor wain .

en: If the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee , then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock , which the  Lord  hath given thee , as I have commanded thee , and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .
kha: Lada kata ka jaka mane Blei ka jngai eh , phi lah , ha kano kano ka por ba phi kwah , ban pynïap ïa kano kano ka masi lane ka blang ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi , bad bam ïa ka doh jong ka ha la ïing , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba jngai palat na me , te me dei ban pyniap ia ka kynhun jong me bad na ka kynhun jong me kaba U Trai u la ai ha me kumba nga la hukum ia me, bad me dei ban bam ha ki khyrdop jong me ia kaei kaei kaba ka mynsiem jong me ka kwah .

en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: Nangta un weng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka baroh , kumba ju weng ïa ka khleiñ na ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad un thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , khnang ba ka jingiw na ka kan pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew , bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un weng noh ia ka shini baroh na ka bynta jong u, kumba la weng noh ia ka shini na ka jingknia jingsuk ; bad u lyngdoh un thang ia ka ha ka almari na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai ; bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u; bad un shah map ia u .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city , and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword , and thy land shall be divided by line  ; and thou shalt die in a polluted land : and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land .
kha: Bad kumta , ko Amasaïah , U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ka tnga jong me kan long ka nuti ha ki lynti bah , bad ïa ki khun jong me yn sa pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka khyndew jong me yn phiah bad sam ha kiwei pat ; bad me ïa lade men ïap ha ka ri bymngeit blei . Bad ki paid Israel da shisha kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai; ka tnga jong me kan long ka nongkhaii met ha ka nongbah, bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin hap da ka waitlam, bad ka ri jong me kan sa phiah da ka lain ; bad me kan iap ha ka ri kaba la jakhlia: bad ki Israel kin leit sha ka ri jong u .

en: And the  Lord  sent against him bands of the Chaldeans , and bands of the Syrians , and bands of the Moabites , and bands of the children of Ammon , and sent them against Judah to destroy it , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servants the prophets .
kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ki kynhun kieng atiar jong ka Babilonia , ka Syria , ka Moab , bad ka Ammon pyrshah ïa u Jehoïakim ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , kumba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong u ba un leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phah pyrshah ia u da ki kynhun jong ki Khaldes bad ki kynhun jong ki nong Syria bad ki kynhun jong ki nong Moab bad ki kynhun jong ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Ammon bad u la phah ia ki pyrshah ia ka Judah ban pynjot ia ka kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u la kren da ki shakri jong u ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Behold , I am against them that prophesy false dreams , saith the  Lord  , and do tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their lightness  ; yet I sent them not , nor commanded them : therefore they shall not profit this people at all , saith the  Lord .
kha: To sngew ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ! Nga long pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa la ki jingphohsniew kiba dap da ki jinglamler . Ki ïathuh ïa kine ki jingphohsniew bad ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da ka jinglamler bad ka jingsngewmeng jong ki . Ngam shym la phah ne hukum ïa ki ban leit , bad kim shym la long satia ka jingïarap ïa ki briew . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia ki kiba iathuhlypa ia ki jingphohsniew lamler , ong U Trai , bad nga iathuh ia ki , bad nga pynlong ia ki briew jong nga ban bakla da ki jinglamler jong ki , bad da ka jingshai jong ki; hynrei ngam shym la phah ia ki; namar kata kin ym ioh jingmyntoi satia ia une u briew .

en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices , which they offer in the open field , even that they may bring them unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest , and offer them for peace offerings unto the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingmut jong kane ka hukum ka long ba naduh mynta ki Israel ki dei ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ki mrad ba ki ju pynïap ha lum ha wah . Mynta ki dei ban wallam ïa ki ha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ bad pynïap ïa ki kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut ba ki khun Israel kin wanrah ia ki jingknia jong ki ha ka lyngkha kaba plie, wat ba kin wanrah ia ki sha U Trai, ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjahthait jong ka jingiaseng, ha u lyngdoh bad kin aiti ia ki na ka bynta ki jingknia jingsuk ha U Trai .

en: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel , which were holy unto the  Lord  , Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build  ; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders : serve now the  Lord  your God , and his people Israel ,
kha: U ai ruh ïa kine ki jingbthah sha ki Lebi , ki nonghikai jong ki Israel , ïa kiba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  :  Buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bakyntang ha ka Templ kaba u syiem Solomon , u khun jong u Dabid , u la tei . Phim dei ban rah shuh ïa ka na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , hynrei phi dei ban shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki Lebi kiba la hikai ia ki Israel baroh kiba la long kiba khuid ha U Trai: To buh ia ka synduk bakhuid ha ka iing kaba u Solomon u khun u Dabid u la tei; kan ym long ka jingkit ha ki tyrpeng jong phi: to shakri mynta ia U Trai U Blei jong phi bad ki briew jong u ki Israel .

en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years : and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt ka ri ba sah kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei . Na ka bynta sawphew snem ki nongbah ka Ijipt kin sah ha ka jingjot , ki jingjot kiba kham sniew ban ïa kito ha kiwei pat ki nongbah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ki nongphetwir . Kin phet sha man ki ri bad ban im hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ka ri Ijipt kaba la jot hapdeng ki ri kiba la jot , bad ki shnong jong ka kiba la jot kin sa jah rngai sawphew snem: bad ngan pynpra ia ki nong Ijipt hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan pynpra ia ki lyngba ki ri .

en: Sheba , and Dedan , and the merchants of Tarshish , with all the young lions thereof , shall say unto thee , Art thou come to take a spoil ? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey ? to carry away silver and gold , to take away cattle and goods , to take a great spoil ?
kha: Ki briew kiba na Sheba bad Dedan bad ki nongkhaïi na ki shnong jong ka Spain kin kylli ïa me , ‘ Hato me la lumlang ïa ka kynhun shipai bad tur ïaleh khnang ban lute bad pynjot ? Hato me thmu ban knieh noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki jingri bad ïa ki jingdon jingem , bad phet noh pat bad kito ki mar lute baroh ?’
translated_en_to_kha: U Sheba bad u Dedan bad ki nongkhaii jong ka Tarshish baroh ki wan ban shim ia ka jinglute ? me la lum ia ka kynhun jong me ban shim ia ka jinglute ? ban rah noh ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ban shim noh ia ki masi bad ki mar ki mata kiba heh ?

en: Therefore hear ye the word of the  Lord  , all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt  ; Behold , I have sworn by my great name , saith the  Lord  , that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt , saying , The Lord  God  liveth .
kha: Hynrei mynta to shahshkor ïa ka jingsmai kaba ma nga U  Trai  , nga la pynlong ha ka kyrteng bakhrawbor jong nga sha phi ki Israel baroh kiba don ha Ijipt : ngan ym shah shuh ïano ïano na phi ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ban pynlong jingsmai da kaba ong , ‘ Nga smai da U  Trai  Nongsynshar uba im !’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai, ko Judah baroh kiba shong ha ka ri Ijipt , ha khmih nga la smai da ka kyrteng kaba khraw jong nga , ong U Trai , ba ka kyrteng jong nga kan ym shah shuh ha ka shyntur jong uno uno u briew jong ka Judah ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel , and fought against all his enemies on every side , against Moab , and against the children of Ammon , and against Edom , and against the kings of Zobah , and against the Philistines : and whithersoever he turned himself , he vexed them .
kha: Hadien ba u Saul u la long u syiem ki Israel , u la ïaleh ïa baroh ki nongshun jong u kylleng : ki paid Moab , Ammon , Edom , ki syiem ka Sobah , bad ki Philistia . Man kaba u ïaleh u jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Saul u la shim ia ka hima halor ki Israel, bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki nongshun jong u baroh shilynter, pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon, bad pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon, bad pyrshah ia ki syiem Sobah bad pyrshah ia ki Philistia: bad katba u phai noh ia lade, u la pynsngewsih ia ki .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the mountains shall drop down new wine , and the hills shall flow with milk , and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters , and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the  Lord  , and shall water the valley of Shittim .
kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki lumbah yn tap da ki bri sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki masi yn shem ha uwei pa uwei u lum ; yn don kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki wahduid baroh ha Judah . Ka wahduid kan tuid na ka Templ jong U  Trai  , bad kan ai um ïa ka Them Akasia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba ki lum kin pynhap ia ka wain thymmai, bad ki lum kin tuid da ka dud, bad ki wah Judah baroh kin tuid da ki um, bad ka pung um kan mih na ka iing U Trai, bad kan ai um ia ka them Shittim .

en: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words , and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the  Lord  pronounced all this great evil against us ? or what is our iniquity ? or what is our sin that we have committed against the  Lord  our God ?
kha: Haba me ïathuh ha ki ïa kane baroh , kin kylli ïa me balei ba nga la kut jingmut ban pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki . Kin kylli kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shah pynrem bad kaei ka pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia haba me pyni ia kine ki ktien baroh bad kin ong ha me , Balei ba U Trai u la pynpaw ia kane ka jingsniew kaba khraw baroh pyrshah ia ngi ? lane kaei ka jingbymhok jong ngi ? lane kaei ka pop jong ngi kaba ngi la leh pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi ?

en: Her priests have violated my law , and have profaned mine holy things : they have put no difference between the holy and profane , neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean , and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths , and I am profaned among them .
kha: Ki lyngdoh ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong nga bad kim burom ïa kaei kaba khuid . Kim pynïapher hapdeng kaei kaba khuid bad kaei ka bymkhuid . Kim hikai ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kiba khuid bad kiba jakhlia , bad kim suidñiew ïa ka Sabbaton . Kaba mih ka long ba ki paid Israel kim ñiewkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh jong ka ki la pynkhein ia ka hukum jong nga, bad ki la pynjah burom ia kiei kiei kiba khuid jong nga: kim shym la pynpaw ia ka jingiapher hapdeng kaba khuid bad kaba khuid, bad ki la buhrieh ia ki khmat jong ki na ki sngi saitjain jong nga, bad nga la pynjah burom hapdeng jong ki .

en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah , when he fought against Hazael king of Syria . And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel , because he was sick .
kha: U la leit phai sha ka nongbah Jesreel ban ïoh jingkoit ïa ki jingmong jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jngoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Joram u la leit phai biang ha Jesel na ki jingmynsaw kiba ki Syria ki la ai ha u ha Rama , haba u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Hazael syiem Syria . U Ahasaiah u khun u Jehoram u syiem Judah u la leit hiar sha Jesel .

en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him : for he had said , I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers . And he laid him down upon his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .
kha: U Ahab u leit phai sha la ïing , u da sngewsih bad bitar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ong ha u . U dem ha la ka jingthiah , u phai shaphang ka kynroh , bad um treh bam ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la wan shapoh iing jong u da kaba khia bad kaba sngewsih namar ka ktien kaba u Naboth u Jesreelite u la kren ha u: namar u la ong , Ngan ym ai ia me ia ka pateng jong ki kpa jong nga . U la thiah ia u ha ka jingthiah jong u, bad u la pynphai noh ia la ka khmat bad un ym bam ia u kpu .

en: And he took the rulers over hundreds , and the captains , and the guard , and all the people of the land  ; and they brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king s house . And he sat on the throne of the kings .
kha: bad nangta ma u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongïada ïa u syiem , bad ki nongap phira ha ïingsyiem ki synran ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ïingsyiem , bad bud sa u paidbah baroh . U Joash u rung lyngba ka Khyrdop Phira bad u shong ha la ka jaka ha ka khet .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki nongsynshar palat da ki spah ngut, bad ki rangbah bad ki shipai baroh kawei bad ki la pynhap ia u syiem na ka iing U Trai , bad u la wan hiar da ka lynti jong ka khyrdop jong ki shipai sha ka iing syiem . Bad u la shong ha ka khet jong ki syiem .

en: And the man said unto me , Son of man , behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears , and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee  ; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither : declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel .
kha: U ong ha nga ,  To khmih , ko khun u briew , shahshkor kyndiang bad pynleit jingmut bha ïa kata baroh kaba nga pyn-i ha me ; namar ba na ka bynta kane la ïalam ïa me hangne . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kata baroh ba me ïohi sha ki briew ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, to sngap da ki khmat jong me, bad to sngap da ki shkor jong me, bad to buh ia ka dohnud jong me ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ngan pyni ia me; to pynbna ia kiei kiei baroh kiba me iohi ha ka iing Israel .

en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains  ; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal : yea , ye shall flee , like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah : and the  Lord  my God shall come , and all the saints with thee .
kha: Phin lait phet lyngba kane ka them kaba pynkhlad arliang ïa une u lumbah . Phin phet kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh mynba u jumai u khynñiuh ha ka por jong u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah . U  Trai  U Blei jong nga un wan , un wallam ïa ki angel baroh lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin phet noh sha ka them jong ki lum namar ka them jong ki lum kan poi sha Azal: Hooid, phin phet noh kumba phi la phet noh na khmat ka jingkhynñiuh jumai ha ki sngi jong u Usiah syiem Judah: bad U Trai U Blei jong nga un wan, bad ki riewkhuid baroh bad me .

en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem , he assembled all the house of Judah , with the tribe of Benjamin , an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men , which were warriors , to fight against the house of Israel , to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon .
kha: Ynda u Rehoboam u poi ha Jerusalem , u lumlang shi lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam na ki jait Judah bad Benjamin . U la thmu ban leit hiarthma bad ban pynïoh pat hapoh ka bor jong u ïa ki jait bashatei jong ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehoboam u la wan sha Jerusalem, u la lum lang ia ka iing u Judah baroh kawei, bad ka jaitbynriew Benjamin, shispah hynriew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied, kiba long ki shipai, ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka iing Israel, ban wanrah biang ia ka hima ha u Rehoboam u khun u Solomon .

en: And he shall dwell in that city , until he stand before the congregation for judgment , and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days : then shall the slayer return , and come unto his own city , and unto his own house , unto the city from whence he fled .
kha: U lah ban sah ha ka nongbah haduh ban da bishar paidbah ïa u bad haduh ka jingïap jong u briew uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kata ka por . Hadien kata , u lah ban leit phai pat sha ïing sha la ka shnong , na kaba u la phet ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shong ha kata ka shnong, haduh ba un da ieng ha khmat ka jingiaseng na ka bynta ka jingbishar, bad haduh ka jingiap jong u rangbah lyngdoh uba don ha kita ki sngi: nangta u nongpyniap briew un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka shnong bad sha la ka jong ka iing, sha ka shnong na kaba u la phet noh .

en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe also these two signs , neither hearken unto thy voice , that thou shalt take of the water of the river , and pour it upon the dry land : and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land .
kha: Lada jia ba kim ngeit ïa kine ki kambah baroh ar , bad lada ki kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaba me ong , shim khyndiat ka um na ka wah Nile bad theh ïa ka ha ka khyndew . Kata ka um kan sa kylla snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ruh lada kim ngeit ia kine ki ar tylli ki dak, lymne kin sngap ia ka sur jong me, ba me shim ia ka um jong ka wah bad theh ia ka ha ka ri kaba rkhiang: bad ka um kaba me shim na ka wah kan kylla snam ha ka ri kaba rkhiang .

en: Wherefore the  Lord  God of Israel saith , I said indeed that thy house , and the house of thy father , should walk before me for ever : but now the  Lord  saith , Be it far from me  ; for them that honour me I will honour , and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la kular mynshuwa ba ka ïing jong me bad ka kur ka jait jong me kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh . Hynrei mynta ngam shah shuh ba kan long kumta . Pynban , ngan pyndonburom ïa kito kiba pyndonburom ïa nga , bad ngan ibeiñ ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u ong, nga la ong shisha ba ka iing jong me bad ka iing u kpa jong me, kin iaid ha khmat jong nga junom: hynrei mynta u Trai u ong: To long kiba jngai na nga; namar jong ki kiba burom ia nga ngan burom ia nga, bad kita kiba lehbein ia nga kin shah burom tang khyndiat eh .

en: Then his father and his mother said unto him , Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren , or among all my people , that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines ? And Samson said unto his father , Get her for me  ; for she pleaseth me well .
kha: Hynrei u kpa bad ka kmie jong u ki ong ïa u ,  Balei phin da leit sha kito ki Philistia bymngeit ban ïoh ïa ka kurim ? Hato phim lah ban shem ïa ka theisamla na la ka kur ka jait , hapdeng ki briew jong ngi baroh ?  Hynrei u Samson u ong ha la u kpa ,  Kane ka dei kaba nga kwah ba phin pynïoh na ka bynta jong nga . Nga itynnat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u kpa jong u bad ka kmie jong u ki la ong ha u, Hato ym don ka kynthei napdeng ki khun kynthei jong me ne napdeng ki briew jong nga baroh ? U Samson u la ong ha u kpa jong u: To ioh ia ka na ka bynta jong nga; namar ka sngewbha ia nga .

en: Now therefore go to , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a device against you : return ye now every one from his evil way , and make your ways and your doings good .
kha: Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ba nga thaw ki jingthmu bathymmai pyrshah ïa ki bad nga khreh ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ïathuh ïa ki ban sangeh ban im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop — ban pynkylla ïa ki rukom im jong ki bad ïa kiei kiei kiba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to leit sha ki briew jong ka Judah bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem, da kaba ong, Kumta ong U Trai .

en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it , the  Lord  repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed the people , It is enough : stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite .
kha: Haba u angel U  Trai  u la jan pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , U  Trai  u la kylla ka jingmut ban pynshitom ïa ki briew bad u ong ha u angel uba pynïap ïa ki ,  Sangeh ! Ka la biang katto !  U angel u la don hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u angel u la pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ka Jerusalem ban pynjot ia ka, U Trai u la kylla bamut ia u na ka jingsniew, bad u la ong ha u angel uba la pynjot ia ki briew: Ka la biang mynta: to sah noh ia ka kti jong me . Bad u angel U Trai u la don hajan ka jaka bam jong u Aragah u Jebus .

en: So that none of the remnant of Judah , which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall escape or remain , that they should return into the land of Judah , to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there : for none shall return but such as shall escape .
kha: Yn ym don na ki briew jong ka Judah kiba la iehnoh shadien bad kiba la wan sha Ijipt ban shong ban sah kin lait phet ne lait ïap . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban leit phai sha Judah , sha kaba ki sliang ban shong ban sah sa shisien pat . Yn ym don ba ïoh wan phai lait noh katto katne ki nongphetwir .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki briew kiba sah ha ka ri Ijipt ban sah hangta, ba kin phet noh ne sah, ba kin leit phai noh sha ka ri Judah, ha kaba ki kwah ban leit phai noh ban shong hangta: namar ym don mano mano ruh ban wan phai hynrei kiba lait .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .
kha: Wat tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hynmen ki para jong phi hi , ki paid Israel . Khie ïaleit noh sha ïing phi baroh . Kaei kaba jia ka long kaba nga mon .  Baroh ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Phim dei ban kiew, ne ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki hynmen jong phi: to leit phai noh uwei pa uwei sha la iing ; namar kane ka long na nga . Ki la sngap namarkata ia ka ktien U Trai bad ki la leit phai noh kat kum ka ktien U Trai .

en: In the cities of the mountains , in the cities of the vale , and in the cities of the south , and in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ha ki shnong jong ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie , ha ka ri ki Benjamin , ha ki shnongrit sawdong ka Jerusalem bad ha ki shnong ka Judah , ki nongaplangbrot sa shisien kin ñiew biang ïa la ki langbrot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki shnong lum, ha ki shnong jong ka ri, bad ha ki shnong jong ka ri Sepngi, bad ha ki jaka ba marjan bad ka Jerusalem bad ha ki shnong Judah, ki kynhun ki iaid biang hapoh ki kti jong uta uba la pynkhih ia ki, ong U Trai .

en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem : and it shall be lifted up , and inhabited in her place , from Benjamin s gate unto the place of the first gate , unto the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king s winepresses .
kha: Ïa ka thain baroh kawei naduh Geba ha ka phang bashatei bad shaduh Rimmon ha ka phang bashathie , yn pynmadan . Ka Jerusalem kan ïeng halor ka ri sawdong jong ka ; ka nongbah kan kot naduh ka Khyrdop Benjamin shaduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong , ha kaba la ju don ka khyrdop ba-mynshuwa , bad na u Mot Hananel sha ki jaka khñiot waiñ jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri baroh kawei kan kylla long ka madan naduh Gba haduh Rimmon shaphang shathie jong ka Jerusalem: bad kan shong ha ka jaka jong ka, naduh ka khyrdop kaba nyngkong, haduh ka jaka jong ka khyrdop kaba nyngkong, bad naduh ka kut jong u Hanel haduh ki jaka ri sohjew jong u syiem .

en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water , there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the  Lord  , even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel : then shall the people of the  Lord  go down to the gates .
kha: Sngap ! Ki paid ba sawa sawdong ki pukri um Ki pynbna ïa ki jingjop jong U  Trai  , Ki jingjop jong ki paid Israel ! Nangta ki briew jong U  Trai  ki ïaid arsut na ki nongbah jong ki
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la pyllait na ka jingsawa jong ki nongsiat um ha ki jaka ba la ring um , hangta kin pynkhih ia ki kam hok jong U Trai , wat ki kam hok sha ki nongshong shnong jong u ha Israel: nangta ki briew jong U Trai kin hiar sha ki khyrdop .

en: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them , and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them , a leopard shall watch over their cities : every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces : because their transgressions are many , and their backslidings are increased .
kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki sing na khlaw kin pynïap ïa ki , ki suri na ka ri shyiap kin tar lyngkhot ïa ki , bad ki  labasa kin ïaid apthap lyngba ki shong jong ki . Lada kito ki briew ki mih shabar , yn tar lyngkhot ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba bun bad na ka por sha ka por ki la phai dien noh na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u sing na khlaw un pyniap ia ki, bad u blang jong ki janmiet un pynsniew ia ki: uwei pa uwei uba leit shabar hangta un shah pynpra: namar ki jingpynkhein jong ki ki long kiba bun bad ki tyrpeng jong ki ki nang kiew .

en: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter  ; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me , saying , Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof , and let us cut him off from the land of the living , that his name may be no more remembered .
kha: Nga la long kum i khunlangbrot balui lui iba la shah ïalam sha ka jingpynïap , bad ngam shym tip ba ka la long pyrshah ïa nga ba ki la ïapynkhreh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki la ïa-ong ,  To ngin khet ïa u dieng katba u dang khlaiñ ; to ngin pynïap ïa u khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la long kum u langbrot ne u masi uba la wanrah sha ka jingpyniap ; bad ngam tip ba ki la thmu pyrshah ia nga , ki da ong , To ngin pynjot ia u dieng bad u soh jong u , bad to ngin ot noh ia u na ka ri jong kiba im , ba ka kyrteng jong u kan ym kynmaw shuh .

en: Understand therefore this day , that the  Lord  thy God is he which goeth over before thee  ; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them , and he shall bring them down before thy face : so shalt thou drive them out , and destroy them quickly , as the  Lord  hath said unto thee .
kha: Hynrei to tip mynta ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïaid ha shuwa jong phi kum ka ding kaba bam duh . Un jop bad pyndem ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , ba phi lah ban beh krad bad pynjot ïa ki kloi kloi , kumba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewthuh namarkata ha kane ka sngi , ba U Trai U Blei jong me u long uba leit sha khmat jong me kum ka ding kaba bam ia ki , bad un pynjot ia ki ha khmat jong me: kumta men beh noh ia ki, bad pynjot kloi ia ki kumba U Trai u la ong ha me .

en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled , for a son , or for a daughter , she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon , or a turtledove , for a sin offering , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest :
kha: Ynda ka por pynkhuid ïa ka , ka la kut , la ka long na ka bynta u khun ne ka khun , ka dei ban wallam sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ïa u khunlangbrot uba shisnem kum ka jingainguh thang bad ïa ka lyngdkhur ne ka paro kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la pyndep ia ki sngi jong ka jingpynkhuid jong ka, na ka bynta u khun shynrang ne kynthei, kan wanrah ia u khun langbrot uba nyngkong na ka bynta ka jingknia thang bad u khun sniang uba dang rit, ne u khun masi, na ka bynta ka jingknia pop, ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng, ha u lyngdoh:

en: And I looked , and rose up , and said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , Be not ye afraid of them : remember the Lord , which is great and terrible , and fight for your brethren , your sons , and your daughters , your wives , and your houses .
kha: Nga ïohi ba ki briew ki khuslai , kumta nga ong ha ki bad ha ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ngi . Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei , bad u ïaleh na ka bynta ki briew ka ri jong phi , ki khun jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki ïing jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la peit, bad nga la ieng, bad nga la ong ha ki rangbah bad ha ki nongsynshar bad ha kiwei pat ki briew: Wat tieng ia ki: kynmaw ia U Trai uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei, bad ialeh na ka bynta ki hynmen jong phi, ki khun shynrang jong phi, bad ki khun kynthei jong phi, bad ki iing jong phi .

en: The day following , when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there , save that one whereinto his disciples were entered , and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat , but that his disciples were gone away alone  ;
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki paidbah kiba la sah ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw ki la sngewthuh shai ba la don tang kawei ka lieng hangta . Ki la tip ba U Jisu um shym la kiew ha ka lem bad ki synran jong u , hynrei ba ki la leit noh khlem ma u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , haba ki briew kiba ieng sha shiliang duriaw ki la iohi ba ym don lieng shuh hangta , lait noh tang kata kaba ki synran jong u ki la rung , bad ba U Jisu um shym la leit bad ki synran jong u shapoh ka lieng , hynrei ba ki synran jong u ki la leit noh marwei;

en: Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .
kha: Ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wan bad tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga . Ïoh lehse ngin lah ban jop ïa ki bad beh noh ïa ki na kane ka ri . Nga tip ba haba phi pynbna ka jingkyrkhu , ki briew ki ïoh ka jingkyrkhu , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingtim , la buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, to tim ia nga ia une u briew ; namar ki long kiba khlain palat ia nga: lehse ngan jop , ba ngin pynkhih ia ki , bad ba ngan beh noh ia ki na ka ri: namar nga ong ba uta uba me kyrkhu u long uba la tim .

en: And God said moreover unto Moses , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath sent me unto you : this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .
kha: Ong ïa ki Israel ba ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , u la phah ïa me sha ki . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong nga junom la junom ; kumne ruh ki pateng bynriew ki ban dang wan ki dei ban khot ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong shuh shuh ha u Moses , Kumta to ong ha ki khun Israel , U Trai U Blei jong phi , U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Jakob u la phah ia nga sha phi: kane ka long ka kyrteng jong nga junom bad kane ka long ka jingkynmaw jong nga ha ki pateng baroh .

en: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread , which thy sons and thy daughters should eat : they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds : they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees : they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword .
kha: Kin bam duh ïa ki jingthung bad ïa ki jingbam jong phi ; kin pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi . Kin pynïap ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi jong phi bad pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad diengsoh Dumbur jong phi . Ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh ha kiba phi shaniah yn pynjot da ka kynhun shipai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin bam ia u soh jong me, bad ia u kpu jong me, uba ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me kin bam: kin bam ia ki langbrot bad ki kynhun jong me: kin bam ia ki diengsoh bad ki diengsoh jong me: kin pynkhih ia ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong jong me, ha kaba me shaniah, da ka waitlam .

en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites , the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , the king of Eglon , gathered themselves together , and went up , they and all their hosts , and encamped before Gibeon , and made war against it .
kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem Amor , ki syiem ka Jerusalem , ka Hebron , ka Jarmuth , ka Lakhish , bad ka Eglon , ki ïasoh lang kawei , ki kerkut ïa ka Gibeon , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki san ngut ki syiem ki Amorites, u syiem Jerusalem, u syiem Jerokhton, u syiem Jerokhton, u syiem Lachish, u syiem Eglon ki la ialum lang bad ki la leit kiew, ma ki bad ki shipai jong ki baroh, bad ki la ia shong shnong ha khmat u Gibeon bad ki la ialeh thma pyrshah ia ka .

en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka la phah khot ïa u Barak u khun jong u Abinoam na ka nongbah Kedesh kaba ha Naphtali bad ka ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha me ïa kane ka hukum : ‘ Shim shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali bad Sebulun bad ïalam ïa ki sha u Lum Tabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la phah bad khot ia u Barak u khun u Abinoam na Kdeshanaptali, bad ka la ong ha u, Hato U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la hukum, da kaba ong: To leit sha u lum Tabor bad shim bad me shi hajar ngut ki khun u Naphtali bad ki khun u Sebulun ?

en: But my words and my statutes , which I commanded my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers ? and they returned and said , Like as the  Lord  of hosts thought to do unto us , according to our ways , and according to our doings , so hath he dealt with us .
kha: Lyngba ki shakri jong nga ki nongïathuhlypa nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham , hynrei ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la shahshitom ïa kaba mih nangta . Nangta ki la kylla-kaba-mut bad ki la pdiang ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la lah pynshitom ïa ki kumba ki dei ban shah bad kumba nga la kut jingmut ban leh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki ktien jong nga bad ki ain jong nga kiba nga la hukum ia ki shakri jong nga ki nongiathuhlypa jong phi ? bad ki la wan phai bad ki la ong: Kumba U Trai jong ki paid u la pyrkhat ban leh ia ngi kat kum ki lynti jong ngi bad kat kum ki jingleh jong ngi .

en: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the  Lord  , and in the audience of our God , keep and seek for all the commandments of the  Lord  your God : that ye may possess this good land , and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever .
kha: Kumta mynta , ko paidbah jong nga , ha khmat U Blei jong ngi bad ha khmat kane ka jingïalang ki Israel baroh , ki paidlang jong U  Trai  , nga kyntu ïa phi ba phin kohnguh da kaba phikir bha ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi , ba kumta phi lah ban ïai bat kynti ïa kane ka ri kaba bha bad kumta ba phin lah ban ai pateng ïa ka junom ha ki pateng ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha khmat ki Israel baroh kawei ka jingiaseng U Trai bad ha khmat U Blei jong ngi, to sumar bad wad ia ki hukum baroh jong U Trai U Blei jong phi: ba phin ioh ia kane ka ri kaba bha, bad iehnoh ia ka kum ka pateng na ka bynta ki khun jong phi hadien jong phi junom .

en: For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .
kha: U la phah ïa ka khubor sha kawei pa kawei ka jylla jong u syiem ha ka ktien bad ka rukom thoh jong kata ka probins    , kaba ong ba uwei pa uwei u tnga u long u kynrad jong ka ïing jong u bad kaba u kren kan long ka bor kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la phah shithi sha ki jylla baroh jong u syiem, sha kawei pa kawei ka jylla katkum ka jingthoh jong ka, bad sha uwei pa uwei u briew katkum ka ktien jong u, ba uwei pa uwei un bat ia ka jingsynshar ha la ka jong ka iing bad ba dei ban pynmih ia ka katkum ka ktien jong uwei pa uwei u briew .

en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob , These daughters are my daughters , and these children are my children , and these cattle are my cattle , and all that thou seest is mine : and what can I do this day unto these my daughters , or unto their children which they have born ?
kha: U Laban u jubab ïa u Jakob ,  Kine ki kynthei ki dei ki khun jong nga ; ki khun jong ki , ki dei ki jong nga , bad kine ki kynhun jingri ki dei ki jong nga . Ha ka jingshisha , kaei kaei baroh kat kaba me ïohi hangne ki dei ki jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Jakob, Kine ki khun kynthei jong nga, bad kine ki khun ki long ki khun jong nga, bad kine ki masi jong nga, bad baroh kaba me iohi ka long ka jong nga: bad nga lah ban leh aiu mynta ka sngi ia kine ki khun kynthei jong nga ne ia ki khun jong ki kiba ki la kha ?

en: And David said , Solomon my son is young and tender , and the house that is to be builded for the  Lord  must be exceeding magnifical , of fame and of glory throughout all countries : I will therefore now make preparation for it . So David prepared abundantly before his death .
kha: U Dabid u pyrkhat ,  Ka Templ ba u Solomon u khun jong nga un tei ka dei ban long kaba ishongkun bad donnam ha ka pyrthei . Hynrei u dang samla bad um pat ju mlien , kumta nga dei ban pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ka .  Kumta u Dabid u la pynbiang lypa shibun ki tiar shuwa ba un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong , U Solomon u khun jong nga u dang samla bad u dang rit, bad ka iing kaba dei ban tei na ka bynta U Trai ka dei ban long kaba phylla palat, kaba don ka nam bad ka burom ha kylleng ki ri: namarkata mynta ngan pynkhreh ia ka . Kumta u Dabid u la pynkhreh shibun shuwa ka jingiap jong u .

en: And the man said unto Joab , Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand , yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king s son : for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Beware that none touch the young man Absalom .
kha: Hynrei uta u briew u jubab ,  Wat la phi ai ïa nga shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , ngan ym rah iwei i shynriah ti pyrshah ïa u khun jong u syiem . Baroh ngi la ïohsngew ba u syiem u hukum ïa phi , ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Ittai , ‘ Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u samla Absalom .’
translated_en_to_kha: Utei u briew u la ong ha u Joab , Wat la nga dei ban ioh shi hajar Shekel ka rupa ha ka kti jong nga: hynrei ngan ym pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia u khun syiem: namar ha ka jingsngap jong ngi u syiem u la kynnoh ia me bad u Abisai bad u Itai, da kaba ong: To husiar ba ym don ba un ktah ia u samla u Absolman .

en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests , which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities , in every several city , the men that were expressed by name , to give portions to all the males among the priests , and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites .
kha: Napdeng ki lyngdoh kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew u Aaron , lane ha ki jaka phlang kiba dei jong kine ki nongbah , la don ki rangbah ba kitkhia ban sam ïa ka jingbam sha ki shynrang baroh ha ka longïing ki lyngdoh bad sha uwei pa uwei uba don kyrteng ha ka kur ki Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh na ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron ki lyngdoh kiba don ha ki lyngkha jong ki shnong jong ki, ha man la ki shnong, ki shynrang kiba la pynpaw da ka kyrteng , ban ai ia ki bynta sha ki shynrang baroh napdeng ki lyngdoh , bad ha baroh kiba la khein da ki jaitbynriew Lebi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .
kha: Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad ki shipai jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom jong ki shipai jong me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih , ngan pynphai biang ia ki tiar ialeh kiba don ha ki kti jong phi , ha kaba phi ialeh pyrshah ia u syiem Babilon bad pyrshah ia ki Khaldian kiba ia tyngkhuh bad phi shabar jong ki kynroh , bad ngan lum ia ki hapdeng kane ka nongbah .

en: And the men of Israel said , Have ye seen this man that is come up ? surely to defy Israel is he come up : and it shall be , that the man who killeth him , the king will enrich him with great riches , and will give him his daughter , and make his father s house free in Israel .
kha: Peit ïa une u briew  ki ïakren para ma ki .  Sngap ïa ki jingkob jong u . U syiem Saul un ai ka nong kaba khraw ïa u briew u ban pynïap ïa u ; u syiem un ai ruh ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u kam donkam ban siew khajna .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la ong: Hato phi la iohi ia une u briew uba wan shaneng? shisha ban pyrshah ia ki Israel u wan shaneng: bad kan long ba uta u briew uba pyniap ia u, u syiem un pynriewspah ia u da ka spah kaba khraw, bad un ai ia u ia ka khun jong u, bad un pyllait im ia ka iing jong u kpa jong u ha Israel .

en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .
kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka Templ . Hangta hajan jong ka khyrdop nga la ïohi arphew san ngut ki rangbah kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Assur bad u Pelataïah u khun jong u Benaïah , ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u mynsiem u la rah ia nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka iing U Trai: bad ha ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop sanphew ngut ki briew kiba nga la iohi ia u Jaasaiah u khun u Azur bad u Peltia u khun u Benaiah .

en: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones , and lay away their robes , and put off their broidered garments : they shall clothe themselves with trembling  ; they shall sit upon the ground , and shall tremble at every moment , and be astonished at thee .
kha: Baroh ki syiem jong ki hima ba don hajan ka duriaw kin wan hiar na ki khet jong ki . Kin law noh ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki jaiñ ba-itynnat jong ki bad kin shong kyiuh ha ka khyndew . Kin sngewtriem haduh katta katta ha ka kupar jong pha kat haduh ba kim lah ban sangeh na jingkyiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah duriaw baroh kin hiar na ki khet jong ki bad kin pynjah burom ia ki jain jong ki: kin phong ia lade da kaba khih ; kin shong ha ka khyndew bad kin khih ha man la ka khyllipmat bad kin sngew lyngngoh ia me .

en: Up , sanctify the people , and say , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow : for thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee , O Israel : thou canst not stand before thine enemies , until ye take away the accursed thing from among you .
kha: Ïeng joit ! Pynkhuid ïa u paidbah bad pynkhreh ban wan ha khmat jong nga . Bthah ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi lashai ka sngi , namar ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel nga don kane ban ong : ‘ Israel , phi don ha ki jingdon jingem jong phi katto katne kiba nga la hukum ïa phi ban pynjot ! Phim lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi tad haduh ba phin da lait na kine kiei kiei !’
translated_en_to_kha: Up , pynkhuid ia ki briew , bad ong , Pynkhuid ia lade ha ka por lashai: namar kumta u ong U Trai Blei jong ki Israel: Ka don kaei kaei kaba la shah tim hapdeng jong me ko Israel: me lah ban ieng ha khmat ki nongshun jong me, haduh ba phin da weng noh ia kaei kaei kaba la shah tim na pdeng jong phi .

en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself , and took the captains of hundreds , Azariah the son of Jeroham , and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan , and Azariah the son of Obed , and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah , and Elishaphat the son of Zichri , into covenant with him .
kha: Hadien ka jingap kaba hynriew snem , u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la rai ba ka la dei ka por ban leh ei ei . U ïateh kular bad san ngut ki rangbah shipai : u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jeroham , u Ishmael u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Obed , u Maaseïah u khun jong u Adaïah , bad u Elishaphat u khun jong u Sikhri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynriew u Jehoiada u la pynskhem ia lade, bad u la shim ia ki rangbah shiphew ngut, u Asariah u khun u Jerhoham bad u Ismael u khun u Jehohanan bad u Asariah u khun u Obed bad u Maesaiah u khun u Adaiah bad u Elisahat u khun u Zichri .

en: I will bring it forth , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and it shall enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house , and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba un phah shabar ïa kane ka jingtim , bad kan rung shapoh ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei u nongtuh bad sha ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai . Kan ïaineh ha ki ïing jong ki bad ieh ïa ki ha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia ka shabar , ong U Trai jong ki paid, bad kan rung ha ka iing jong u nongtuh bad ha ka iing jong uta uba smai lamler da ka kyrteng jong nga: bad kan sah hapdeng ka iing jong u, bad kan bam ia ka da ki dieng jong ka bad ki maw jong ka .

en: And he said , Behold , I make a covenant : before all thy people I will do marvels , such as have not been done in all the earth , nor in any nation : and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the  Lord  : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta nga pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel . Ha khmat jong ki ngan leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ïa kiba ym pat ju leh mynno mynno ha ka pyrthei hapdeng kano kano ka jaitbynriew . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa ki kam kiba khraw kiba ma nga , U  Trai  nga lah ban leh , namar ngan leh ïa kaei kaei kaba khraw na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ha khmih nga leh ia ka jutang: ha khmat ki briew jong me baroh ngan leh ia ki jingphylla, kumba ym shym la leh ha ka ri baroh kawei: bad ki briew baroh kiba me don hapdeng jong me kin iohi ia ka kam U Trai: namar ka long kaba shyrkhei ia me .

en: Then ye shall bring them both out unto the gate of that city , and ye shall stone them with stones that they die  ; the damsel , because she cried not , being in the city  ; and the man , because he hath humbled his neighbour s wife : so thou shalt put away evil from among you .
kha: ïalam ïa ki baroh ar ngut shabar shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap . Kata ka briew ka dei ban ïap namar ba kam shym la kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , wat la ka don hapoh shnong , bad uta u shynrang pat u dei ban ïap namar u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka , bad kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin ialam ia ki baroh arngut sha ka khyrdop jong kata ka shnong, bad phin pynduh ia ki da ki maw ba kin iap; ka dam, namar ba kam shym la iam, namar ba ka la don ha ka shnong ; bad u briew, namar ba u la pynrit ia ka tnga jong u para marjan jong u: kumta phin weng noh ia ki na ka jingsniew hapdeng jong phi .

en: In this thing the  Lord  pardon thy servant , that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leaneth on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon : when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon , the  Lord  pardon thy servant in this thing .
kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ba U  Trai  un map ïa nga haba nga synran ïa la u syiem sha ka templ u Rimmon , u blei Syria , bad mane ïa u . Da shisha U  Trai  un map ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka kam U Trai u map ia u shakri jong me, ba haba u kynrad jong nga u leit shapoh ka iing u Rimmon ban mane hangta, bad u shong ha ka kti jong nga, bad nga dem ha ka iing u Rimmon: haba nga dem ha ka iing u Rimmon , U Trai u map ia u shakri jong me ha kane ka kam .

en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing : they commit adultery , and walk in lies : they strengthen also the hands of evildoers , that none doth return from his wickedness : they are all of them unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .
kha: Hynrei ha ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem nga la ïohi ba ki leh kaba kham sniew : ki klim bad ki kren lamler ; ki pynshlur ïa ki briew ban leh ïa ka bymdei , kumta ba ym don ba sangeh noh ïa kaei kaba sniew . Ha nga , ki long baroh kiba sniew kum ki briew ka Sodom , bad ka Gomorrah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ruh ha ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka Jerusalem ia kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei: ki leh ia ka kam sniew, bad ki iaid ha ki jinglamler: ki pynskhem ruh ia ki kti jong ki nongleh bymman jong u: kim ju wan phai na ka jingsniew jong u: ki long baroh na ki ha nga kum u Sodom, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka kum u Gomorrah .

en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish , saying , I have offended  ; return from me : that which thou puttest on me will I bear . And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold .
kha: U Hesekaïah u phah ïa ka khubor sha u Sennakherib , uba don ha Lakhish :  Nga la leh bakla ; sngewbha pynsangeh ïa ka jingtur ïaleh jong phi , bad ngan siew kat kaba phi dawa .  Ka jubab u nongsynshar ka long ba u Hesekaïah un phah sha u shiphew ton ka rupa bad shi ton ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u syiem Judah u la phah sha u syiem Assyria sha u Lachish, u da ong, Nga la pynsngewsih ia nga: kata kaba me buh ha nga ngan kit . Bad u syiem Assyria u la thung ha u syiem Judah lai spah talent rupa bad laiphew talent ksiar .

en: And say thou unto the people , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow , and ye shall eat flesh : for ye have wept in the ears of the  Lord  , saying , Who shall give us flesh to eat ? for it was well with us in Egypt : therefore the  Lord  will give you flesh , and ye shall eat .
kha: Mynta ong ïa ki paidbah , ‘ Pynkhuid ïa lade na ka bynta lashai ; bad phin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam . U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ba phi ïakren khñium bad ong ba phi mutdur ba phi don khyndiat ka doh , bad ba phi kham ïoh bam bha ha Ijipt . Te mynta U  Trai  un ai ka doh ba phin bam , bad phi dei ban bam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ia ki briew: Pynkhuid ia lade ban bam doh: namar phi la iam ha ki shkor U Trai, da kaba ong: Mano ba ai doh ia ngi ban bam ? namar ka la long kaba bha bad ngi ha Ijipt: namarkata U Trai un ai doh ia phi bad phin bam .

en: And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .
kha: Kumta u rangbah uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ki riewpawkhmat bad ki nongsumar , ki la phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Jehu :  Ngi long ki shakri jong phi bad ngi long kiba la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong ; hynrei ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano ; leh katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la long halor ka iing, bad uta uba la long halor ka shnong, ki rangbah ruh bad ki nongrah khun, ki la phah sha u Jehu, ki da ong: Ngi long ki shakri jong me bad ngin leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba me dei ban hukum ia ngi: ngi ym leh ia kaba bha ha ki khmat jong me .

en: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace , and spake , and said , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , ye servants of the most high God , come forth , and come hither . Then Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , came forth of the midst of the fire .
kha: Kumta u Nebukhadnessar u la leit kiew sha ka jingkhang jong ka lawar ding baklang bad u la pyrta ,  Ko Shadrakh ! Ko Meshakh ! Ko Abednego ! Ko shakri jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! To mihnoh shabar !  Bad kumta hi ki la wan mih shabar .
