translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Neuchadnezzar u la wan hajan ka shyntur jong ka ding kaba thang, bad u la kren, bad u la ong, Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego, phi ki shakri jong U Blei uba ha khlieh duh . Nangta u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego, ki la mih na pdeng ka ding .

en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering , and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :
kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad un shim khyndiat ka snam bad un tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong uta u briew , ka  tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pyniap ia u khun langbrot jong ka jingainguh kaba la pynkylla dur , bad u lyngdoh un shim katto katne na ka snam jong ka jingainguh kaba la pynkylla dur bad un buh ia ka ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong uta uba dei ban pynkhuid bad ha ka kti kadiang jong u bad ha ka kjat kadiang jong u:

en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers , uncircumcised in heart , and uncircumcised in flesh , to be in my sanctuary , to pollute it , even my house , when ye offer my bread , the fat and the blood , and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations .
kha: Ki la pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga da kaba shah ïa ki nongwei bym shym la otsher , ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa nga ban rung sha ka Templ katba ïa ka khleiñ bad ka snam jong ki jingkñia la dang ainguh ha nga . Kumta ki briew jong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por ba phi la wanrah ha ka jaka kyntang jong nga, ki bym pat shah ot ha ka doh, bad ki bym pat shah ot ha ka doh, ban don ha ka jaka kyntang jong nga, ban pynjakhlia ia ka, wat ia ka iing jong nga ruh, haba phi aiti ia u kpu jong nga, ka shini bad ka snam jong nga, bad ki la pynpra ia ka jutang jong nga namar ki jingleh bymman jong phi baroh .

en: But the priests the Levites , the sons of Zadok , that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me , they shall come near to me to minister unto me , and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood , saith the Lord  God  :
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Hynrei kito ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jait Lebi kiba hiarpateng na u Sadok pat , ki la shakri hok ïa nga ha ka Templ mynba kiwei pat ki paid Israel ki la phai noh na nga . Kumta mynta ki long ma ki , ki ban shakri ïa nga bad wan ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ban ai ïa nga ka khleiñ bad ka snam jong ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki lyngdoh ki Lebi, ki khun shynrang jong u Sadok, kiba la bat ia ka kam jong nga haba ki khun Israel ki la jah noh na nga , kin wan hajan jong nga ban shakri ia nga , bad kin ieng ha khmat jong nga ban aiti ha nga ia ka shini bad ka snam , ong U Trai Blei:

en: Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .
kha: Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki shakri jong me , phin ïarep ha ka khyndew na ka bynta ka longïing jong u Saul , u kynrad jong phi , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nangta ban pynbiang bam ïa ki . Hynrei u Mephibosheth hi un ïailong uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka miej bam jong nga .  ( U Siba u don khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang bad arphew ngut ki shakri . )
translated_en_to_kha: Me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad ki shakri jong me, phin wanrah ia ki soh, ba u khun kynrad jong me un ioh jingbam: hynrei u khun kynrad jong me un bam ia u kpu ha ka miej jong nga . Mynta u Siba u don shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad arphew ngut ki shakri .

en: And Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , stood before it in those days , ) saying , Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother , or shall I cease ? And the  Lord  said , Go up  ; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand .
kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei ka don hangta ha Bethel ha kito ki sngi , bad u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u khun ksiew jong u Aaron , u khmih ïa ka , ki briew ki kylli ïa U  Trai  ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh pyrshah biang ïa ki Benjamin , ki para jait jong ngi , ne ngin keiñ noh ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki . Lashai ka sngi ngan ai ïa ka jingjop ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Phinehas u khun u Eleasar u khun u Aaron u la ieng ha khmat jong ka ha kita ki sngi, ) u da ong: Hato ngan leit shabar ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki khun shynrang jong nga ? Bad U Trai u la ong: To leit shaneng; namar lashai ngan aiti noh ia ki ha ka kti jong me .

en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite  ; the same is Jerusalem : and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward , which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward :
kha: bad artet lyngba ka Them Hinnom ter ter sha ka phang bashathie jong u lum ha kaba don ka nongbah Jerusalem jong ki Jebus . Nangta u pud u kiew artet sha ka kliar u lum ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Them Hinnom , ha ka tduh bashatei jong ka Them Rephaim .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la kiew da ka them u khun Hinnom sha ka liang sepngi jong ka ri Jesus: bad u pud u sam u la kiew sha jrong jong u lum uba don ha khmat ka them Hinnom shaphang shathie:

en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries , Shelemiah the priest , and Zadok the scribe , and of the Levites , Pedaiah : and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur , the son of Mattaniah : for they were counted faithful , and their office was to distribute unto their brethren .
kha: Nga buh ïa kine ki rangbah ban khmih ïa ki kamra buh tiar : U Shelemaïah , u lyngdoh ; u Sadok , u riewstad ka Hukum ; bad u Pedaïah , u Lebi . U Hanan , u khun jong u Sakkur bad u ksiew jong u Mattanaïah , u long u nongïarap jong ki . Nga tip nga lah ban shaniah ïa kine ki rangbah ban lehhok ha kaba sam ïa ki mar sha ki para ba-ïatrei lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynlong ia ki nongtrei ha ki jaka buh jingbam, u Seldiah u lyngdoh bad u Sadok u nongthoh bad ki Lebi: bad hajan jong ki la don u Han u khun u Sakur u khun u Mathaniah: namar la khein ia ki da kaba iaineh, bad ka kam jong ki ka long ban sam sha ki hynmen jong ki .

en: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up , and came in thither , and took the graven image , and the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image : and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war .
kha: ki san ngut ki nongsyntiat ki rung beit shapoh ïing bad ki shim ïa kata ka bleithaw ba la suit da ka rupa , kiwei pat ruh ki bleithaw , bad ïa ka ephod , katba u lyngdoh u dang ïeng ha ka khyrdop bad ki hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah kiba la kieng atiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki san ngut ki briew kiba la leit ban leit shabar ki la leit shapoh ka ri, bad ki la wan rung shapoh kata, bad ki la shim ia ka dur ba la ker bad ka effod bad ka effod bad ka dur ba la khleh lang: bad u lyngdoh u la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop ryngkat bad ki hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba la thung da ki tiar ialeh thma .

en: Now therefore give me this mountain , whereof the  Lord  spake in that day  ; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there , and that the cities were great and fenced : if so be the  Lord  will be with me , then I shall be able to drive them out , as the  Lord  said .
kha: Kumta mynta , ai ha nga ïa ka ri lum ba U  Trai  u la kular ïa nga ha kata ka sngi mynba ki briew jong nga lem bad nga , ngi la wanrah ïa kata ka khubor . Ngi la ïathuh ïa phi ha kato ka por ba ka jait ki ramhah kiba la khot ki Anakim ki la don hangta ha ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong da ki kut bakhraw . Lehse U  Trai  hi un don ryngkat bad nga , bad ngan beh krad ïa ki , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ia nga ia une u lum, na uba U Trai u la kren ha kata ka sngi; namar me la iohsngew ha kata ka sngi ba ki Anaim ki la don hangta: lada U Trai un don ryngkat bad nga, te ngan lah ban beh noh ia ki kumba U Trai u la ong .

en: For , lo , I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country : and they shall set themselves in array against her  ; from thence she shall be taken : their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man  ; none shall return in vain .
kha: Ngan pynkhih ïa ka kynhun ki hima kiba khlaiñ shaphang shatei bad pynlong ïa ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia . Kin ïeng ryntih ban ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka ri bad ban jop ïa ka . Ki long ki nongbeh mrad batbit , kiba siat khnam bym ju lait na ka sohpdung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan pynmih bad pynlong ia ka jingwan sha Babilon ka kynhun ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw na ka ri Sepngi: bad kin buh ia lade ha ka jaka pyrshah ia ka ; nangta yn shim ia ka: ki khnam jong ki kin long kum u briew uba stad uba khlain bor; ym don ba wan phai noh khlem da pynlut por .

en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
kha: U Joshua u la khie dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shipai ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep : nyngkong , ka kynhun shipai na sha khmat ; hadien kata , ki hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ; nangta , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ; bad khatduh , ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba kit hynriew tylli ki turoi jong ki langbrot ki la iaid beit shakhmat bad ki la beh ia ki turoi: bad ki shipai ki la leit sha khmat jong ki ; hynrei ki shipai ki la wan shadien hadien ka synduk U Trai , ki lyngdoh ki iaid shakhmat bad ki turoi .

en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing , as the uncleanness of man , or any unclean beast , or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which pertain unto the  Lord  , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
kha: Shuh shuh , lada uno uno u bam ïa ka doh jong kane ka jingainguh hadien ba u la ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , la ka dei kaba na u briew ne na u mrad , ïa u ruh yn ym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka mynsiem kaba ktah ia kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid, kum ka jingbymkhuid jong u briew, ne uno uno u mrad bymkhuid ne uno uno u mrad bymkhuid uba sngewsih bad bam ia ka doh jong ki jingknia ba suk kiba iadei bad U Trai, wat ia kata ka mynsiem ruh yn ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law , but by the faith of Jesus Christ , even we have believed in Jesus Christ , that we might be justified by the faith of Christ , and not by the works of the law : for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified .
kha: Pynban , ngi tip ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha khmat U Blei tang da ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Ngi ruh , ngi la ngeit ha U Khrist Jisu khnang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha U Khrist bad ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Namar ym don uno uno ruh ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ba u briew um shah pynksan da ki kam jong ka hukum hynrei da ka jingngeit U Jisu Khrist , wat ngi ruh ngi la ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , ba ngin shah pynksan da ka jingngeit U Khrist: namar da ki kam jong ka hukum ym shah pynksan ia ka doh .

en: Then the angel of the  Lord  put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand , and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes  ; and there rose up fire out of the rock , and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes . Then the angel of the  Lord  departed out of his sight .
kha: Nangta u angel jong U  Trai  u kner bad u pyndei ha ka doh bad u kpu da ka tduh jong u diengduh ba u bat . Ka ding ka la mih na u mawsiang bad ka la thang ïa kata ka doh bad ïa u kpu . Nangta u angel u jah noh jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u angel U Trai u la buh ia ka tduh jong u diengduh kaba don ha ka kti jong u , bad u la ktah ia ka doh bad ki kpu bym don thied ; bad ka la mih ka ding na u maw , bad u la bam ia ka doh bad ki kpu bym don thied . Nangta u angel U Trai u la leit noh na ka jingpeit jong u .

en: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were of a garden : he hath destroyed his places of the assembly : the  Lord  hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion , and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest .
kha: Ka burom ba-itynnat tam jong ka Jerusalem ka long ka bynta jong ka mynnor . Ki nongïalam jong ka ki long kum ki skei kiba tlot na ka jingthngan , kaba ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , ka la jan duh noh katba ki phet na ki nongbeh mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la weng noh da ka jingleh donbor ia ka iing jong u, kumba ka long ka kper: u la pynjot ia ki jaka jong u: U Trai u la pynlong ia ki jingkhawai bad ki jingkhawai niang sngi ban shah klet noh ha Seion , bad u la leh bein ha ka jingbitar jong u syiem bad u lyngdoh .

en: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyre , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thine heart is lifted up , and thou hast said , I am a God , I sit in the seat of God , in the midst of the seas  ; yet thou art a man , and not God , though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa u nongsynshar ka Tyros kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha u : Ba la pynhieng da ka jingsarong , me kam ba me dei U Blei . Me ong ba kum U Blei me shong ha ka khet , ba la ker sawdong da ki duriaw . Me lah ban leh mynleh kum U Blei , hynrei , em , me long uba kynja briew , ym uba kynja blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , to ong ha u syiem jong ka Tyros , Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong: Namar ka dohnud jong me ka la kiew shaneng, bad me la ong: Nga long U Blei, nga shong ha ka jaka shong jong U Blei, hapdeng ki duriaw;

en: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :
kha: Ngan beh kthong ïa ki da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin sngewtriem ha kaei kaba ki ïohi . Kylleng kylleng nga pynsakma ïa ki , ki briew kin kyndit bad sngewshyrkhei ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew kin krenbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynshitom ia ki da ka waitlam, da ka jingkyrduh bad da ka jingpang khlam, bad ngan aiti noh ia ki sha ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew, ban long ka jingtim, bad ka jinglyngngoh, bad ka jingkyrhuh, bad ka jingshah lehbein, hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba nga la beh noh ia ki:

en: And it shall be , when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain , that we will say unto them , Be favourable unto them for our sakes : because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war : for ye did not give unto them at this time , that ye should be guilty .
kha: Lada ki kpa lane ki hynmen shynrang jong ki , ki wan ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi , phi lah ban ong , ‘ Sngewbha shah ba kin don bad ngi , namar ngim shym shim ïa ki na phi ha ka madan thma ban long ki tnga jong ngi . Bad haba phim shym la ai ïa ki ha ngi , phim long kiba la pynrem ba phi la pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba ki kpa jong ki ne ki hynmen jong ki ki wan sha ngi ban ujor, ba ngin ong ha ki: To sngewbha ia ki na ka bynta jong ngi: namar ngim shym la buh ia ka tnga jong u ha ka thma: namar phim shym la ai ha ki ha kane ka por , ba phi dei ban long kiba don pop .

en: And they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field : they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and seven times shall pass over thee , until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .
kha: Ïa me yn beh noh na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , men shong men sah bad ki mradkhlaw , bad bam phlang kum u masi dab haduh hynñiew snem . Nangta men pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u don ka bor halor baroh ki hima ki briew bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin beh noh ia me na ki briew, bad ka jaka shong jong me kan long bad ki mrad khlaw: kin pynlong ia me ban bam ia u phlang kum u masi, bad hynriew sien kin iaid halor jong me, haduh ba men da tip ba ka long kaba ha khlieh duh ha ka hima ki briew, bad ai ia ka ha uno uno uba u mon .

en: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ban ym dih waiñ , bad haduh kane hi ka sngi ym don uwei ruh na ki uba dih ïa kaba kumno kumno ruh ka waiñ . Hynrei nga la ïai kren ha phi , bad phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u Jehonadab u khun u Rehab, ba u la hukum ia ki khun jong u ban ym dih wain, ki long kiba la leh kumta haduh kine ki sngi kim dih ei ei, hynrei ki kohnguh ia ka hukum jong u kpa jong ki: wat la nga la kren ha phi, da kaba khie dang step bad kren hynrei phim shym la sngap ia nga .

en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within thy gates : then shalt thou arise , and get thee up into the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose  ;
kha: Lada don ki kam kiba kham eh ïa ki nongbishar shnong ban rai , kum ki mokotduma ïaknieh khyndew , lane kiba dei shaphang kaba ïashoh ïadat , lane kito kiba hap ban pynïapher hapdeng ka jingpynïap briew bad kawei pat ka jait jingpynïap briew , leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ïa kaba la jied da U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada mih ka kam kaba eh palat ia me ha ka jingbishar, hapdeng ka snam bad ka snam, hapdeng ka jingkyrpad bad ka jingkyrpad, bad hapdeng ka jingkyrpad bad ka jingkyrpad, ka long ka kam kaba ialeh pyrshah hapoh ki khyrdop jong me: te me dei ban ieng, bad me dei ban ieng ia me ha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me un jied;

en: As Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses , an altar of whole stones , over which no man hath lift up any iron : and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , and sacrificed peace offerings .
kha: U la tei ïa ka kat kum ki jingbthah ba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel , kumba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses :  Ka duwan ba la tei da ki maw ki bym shym la shtah da ki tiar nar .  Halor jong ka ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia ha U  Trai  , bad ki la ainguh ruh ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la hukum ia ki khun Israel kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab u Moses , ka jingknia maw baroh kawei , halor kaba ym don mano mano ruh ba la rah ia ka nar: bad ki la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang ha U Trai .

en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia , All the kingdoms of the earth hath the  Lord  God of heaven given me  ; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem , which is in Judah . Who is there among you of all his people ? The  Lord  his God be with him , and let him go up .
kha: Kane ka dei ka hukum jong u Syros , u Patsha ka ri Persia . U  Trai  , U Blei ka Bneng , u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynshar halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad u la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong u ha Jerusalem kaba ha Judah . Mynta , ma phi baroh kiba long ki briew jong U Blei , khie leit shata , bad to ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un long lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Cyrus u syiem jong ka ri Persia , Baroh ki hima jong ka khyndew ki la ai ha nga; bad u la bthah ia nga ban tei ia u ia ka iing ha Jerusalem kaba don ha Judah . Mano ba don hapdeng jong phi na ki briew jong u baroh ? U Trai jong u u long bad u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thou shalt sleep with thy fathers  ; and this people will rise up , and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land , whither they go to be among them , and will forsake me , and break my covenant which I have made with them .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shen men sa ïap noh , bad ynda me ïap u paidbah un sa phai noh na nga bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki . Kin kyntait ïa nga bad mane ïa ki blei thala jong kata ka ri sha kaba kin sa leit rung .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Ha khmih, me thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong me bad une u briew un kiew, bad un leit shongkurim ia ki blei jong ki nongwei jong ka ri, ha kaba ki leit sha ki jaka ba ki don hapdeng jong ki, bad kin iehnoh ia nga, bad kin pynpra ia ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la leh bad ki .

en: And , behold , six men came from the way of the higher gate , which lieth toward the north , and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand  ; and one man among them was clothed with linen , with a writer s inkhorn by his side : and they went in , and stood beside the brasen altar .
kha: Mar kumta hynriew ngut ki briew ki wan na ka khyrdop kaba shabar kaba don shaphang shatei jong ka Templ , uwei uwei u rah la ka tiar ïaleh . Ryngkat bad ki la don u briew uba kup da ki jaiñ linen , uba rah ki tiar ban thoh . Baroh ki wan bad ïeng hajan ka duwan kaba da ka rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, hynriew ngut ki briew ki la wan na ka lynti jong ka khyrdop kaba kham halor, kaba don shaphang shathie, bad uwei pa uwei u briew hapdeng jong ki u la phong da ka jain lin, bad u nongthoh da ka sniehdoh ha ka liang jong u: bad ki la rung shapoh bad ki la ieng hajan ka jaka bam ba la shet.

en: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds , with the captains and the guard , and brought them to him into the house of the  Lord  , and made a covenant with them , and took an oath of them in the house of the  Lord  , and shewed them the king s son .
kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynñiew u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u phah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba peit ïa ki nongai jingïada ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad u ong ïa ki ban wan sha ka Templ , ha kaba u la pynlong ïa ki ban mynjur da kaba smai ïa kaei ba u thmu ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoiada u la phah ia ki nongsynshar kiba don ha ka iing U Trai bad u la wanrah ia ki ha ka iing U Trai bad u la leh ia ka jutang bad ki, bad u la shim ia ka jingsmai jong ki ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And the men were afraid , because they were brought into Joseph s house  ; and they said , Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in  ; that he may seek occasion against us , and fall upon us , and take us for bondmen , and our asses .
kha: Haba la ïalam ïa ki sha ka ïing , ki la sheptieng bad ki la ïa-pyrkhat ,  La ïalam ïa ngi shane imat namar kito ki pisa ba la pynphai ha ki byrni jong ngi ha ka sien kaba nyngkong . Kin sa kynrup kynsan ïa ngi , kin shim noh ïa ki kada jong ngi , bad kin pynlong ïa ngi ki mraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la tieng namar la wanrah ia ki ha iing u Joseph bad ki la ong: Namar ka pisa kaba la pynphai biang ha ki lyngkhot jong ngi ha ka sien kaba nyngkong la wanrah ia ngi ha ka por ba un wad ia ngi, bad un hap ha ngi, bad un shim ia ngi kum ki mraw, bad ki tdong jong ngi .

en: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon s princes , then thy soul shall live , and this city shall not be burned with fire  ; and thou shalt live , and thine house :
kha: Te nga la ong ha u Sedekaïah ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Lada phi pyndem ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia , ïa ka jingim jong phi yn tyngkai , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn ym thang noh . Ïa phi bad ïa ka longïing jong phi yn pyllait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la ong ha u Sedekaiah , Kumta u Trai, U Blei jong ki Israel; Lada me leit sha ki syiem Babilon, te ka mynsiem jong me kan im, bad kane ka shnong kan ym shah thang da ka ding ; bad me men im, bad ka iing jong me:

en: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day , and not to bear a burden , even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day  ; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem , and it shall not be quenched .
kha: Hynrei ki dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton kum ka sngi bakyntang . Kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit lyngba ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi , namar lada ki leh kumta , ngan buh ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem ha ka ding . Ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ïingsyiem jong ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym sngap ia nga ban pynkhuid ia ka sngi Sabha bad ban ym kit jingkit, wat ban rung ha ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem ha ka sngi Sabha; te ngan thang ding ha ki khyrdop jong ka, bad kan bam ia ki iing jong ka Jerusalem, bad kan ym shah pynlip .

en: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city , and all the labours thereof , and all the precious things thereof , and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies , which shall spoil them , and take them , and carry them to Babylon .
kha: Ngan shah ruh ba ki nongshun jong ki kin lute ïa baroh ka spah jong kane ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh , wat ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki syiem ka Judah , bad kit noh ïa kiei kiei baroh sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ngan aiti lut ia ka bor jong kane ka shnong bad ia ki jingtrei ba kordor jong ka baroh bad ia ki jingdon jingem jong ki syiem Judah baroh ngan aiti ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki .

en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .
kha: Ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga maham ïa ki ba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot kin shah pynïap . Kito kiba shong ha ka ri kin shah bam da ki mradkhlaw . Kito kiba rieh ha ki lumbah bad ki krem kin ïap da ka jingpang .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong kumta ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei U Blei U Blei U la im, shisha kito kiba don ha ki thliew kin hap da ka waitlam , bad uta uba don ha ka lyngkha ba plie ngan ai ha ki mrad ban shah bam , bad kito kiba don ha ki kut bad ha ki krem kin iap na ka jingpang khlam .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thy days approach that thou must die : call Joshua , and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation , that I may give him a charge . And Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Me te , men ym im slem shuh . Khot ïa u Joshua bad wan ïalam ïa u sha ka Ïingjaiñ khnang ba ngan ai hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ha khmih, ki sngi jong me ki la jan ba me dei ban iap: khot ia u Joshua, bad to pyni ia lade ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng, ba ngan ai ia u ia ka jingkitkhlieh . U Moses bad u Joshua ki la leit sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof , wherewith they minister about it , even the censers , the fleshhooks , and the shovels , and the basins , all the vessels of the altar  ; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers  skins , and put to the staves of it .
kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap Sinai U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin buh ha ka ia ki tiar jong ka baroh, ha kaba ki shakri sawdong jong ka, wat ia ki shyieng , ki shyieng bad ki shyieng , ki tiar jong ka almari baroh .

en: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities , by the iniquity of thy traffick  ; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee , it shall devour thee , and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee .
kha: Me la leh kat kata kaba sniew ha kaba thied bad die haduh ba ki jaka mane jong me ki la long kiba thala . Te nga la tbeh ding ïa ka nongbah bad thang duh ïa ka . Baroh kiba khmih ha me mynta ki ïohi ïa me ba la kylla dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynjakhlia ia ki jaka kyntang jong me da ka jingbun ki jingbymhok jong me, da ka jingbymhok jong ka jingkhaii jong me; namarkata ngan pynmih ia ka ding na pdeng jong me;

en: And many people shall go and say , Come ye , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for out of Zion shall go forth the law , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .
kha: bad ki briew jong ki , kin ong ,  Ïa ngin kiew ïa u lum jong U  Trai  , sha ka Templ jong U Blei ka Israel . Un hikai ïa ngi kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ; ngin ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u la jied . Naba ka jinghikai jong U  Trai  ka wan na Jerusalem ; na Seïon u kren ha ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki briew kin leit bad kin ong: To wan, bad to ngin leit sha u lum U Trai, sha ka iing U Blei u Jakob bad un hikai ia ngi ia ki lynti jong u ; bad ngin iaid ha ki lynti jong u: namar na ka Seion ngin iaid shaphrang ia ka hukum bad ka ktien U Trai na Jerusalem .

en: And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem , in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver : and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .
kha: Ïa ka met jong u Joseph , kaba ki paid Israel ki la wanrah na Ijipt , la tep ha Shekhem , ha kata ka jaka ba u Jakob u la thied ha ka dor shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na ki khun jong u Hamor , u kpa jong u Shekhem . Ïa kane ka jaka la ïohpateng da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shyieng jong u Joseph kiba ki khun Israel ki la wanrah na Ijipt, ki la tep ia ki ha Shechem, ha ka jaka kaba u Jakob u la thied na ki khun shynrang jong u Hamor u kpa jong u Shechem da ki shispah tylli ki rupa: bad ka la long ka pateng jong ki khun u Joseph .

en: I will greatly rejoice in the  Lord  , my soul shall be joyful in my God  ; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation , he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness , as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments , and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels .
kha: Ko Jerusalem to shadkmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh . Ka long kum ka nongleitkurim kaba riam na ka bynta ka jingkyntiew kurim jong ka . U Blei u la pynkup ïa ka da ka jingpynim bad ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan sngewbha shibun ha U Trai, ka mynsiem jong nga kan sngewbha ha U Blei jong nga namar u la phong ia nga da ki jain jong ka jingpynim, u la tap ia nga da ka jainkup jong ka hok, kumba u nongleit kurim u pynitynnad ia lade da ki jingdeng , bad kum ka nongleit kurim ka pynitynnad ia lade da ki jingdeng jong ka .

en: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come , and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all the walls thereof round about , and against all the cities of Judah .
kha: namar nga khot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka phang bashatei ban ïawan . Ki syiem jong ki kin pynïeng ïa ki khet jong ki ha ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad sawdong ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ruh sawdong ïa kiwei pat ki nongbah jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan khot ia ki longiing baroh jong ki hima shaphang shathie, ong U Trai; bad kin wan, bad kin buh ia ka khet jong u ha ka jingrung jong ki khyrdop Jerusalem , bad pyrshah ia ki kynroh jong ka baroh sawdong , bad pyrshah ia ki nongbah Judah baroh .

en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of oil olive and of honey , that ye may live , and not die : and hearken not unto Hezekiah , when he persuadeth you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us .
kha: haduh ba u patsha un pynshong pynsah pat ïa phi ha ka ri kumba ka dei ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai sohwaiñ bad yn don ki kew ban pynlong kpu ; ka dei ka ri ki Olib , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap . Lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba u hukum , phin ym ïap , hynrei phin im . Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ba phin pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba ngan da wan shim noh ia phi sha ka ri kaba kum ka ri jong phi hi, ka ri u kew bad ka kper sohjew, ka ri kaba don umphniang olive bad ka umsohsoh, ba phin im: bad wat sngap ia u Hesekaiah haba u pynsngewthuh ia phi da kaba ong: U Trai un pyllait ia ngi .

en: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .
kha: Naba don shibun ki daw baïapher balei ba ki briew kim lah ban shongkurim : katto katne , namar ba la kha ïa ki kumta ; kiwei pat , namar ba ki briew ki pynlong ïa ki kumta ; bad kiwei pat kim shongkurim na ka bynta ka Hima ki bneng . Ai ba uta uba lah ban pdiang ïa kane ka jinghikai un leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki don katto katne ki eunuk kiba la kha kumta na ka kpoh jong ki: bad ki don katto katne ki eunuk kiba la pynlong ia ki eunuk jong ki briew: bad ki don ki eunuk kiba la pynlong ia lade ki eunuk na ka bynta ka hima bneng na ka bynta ka hima bneng . Uta uba lah ban pdiang ia ka , to un pdiang ia ka .

en: For this people s heart is waxed gross , and their ears are dull of hearing , and their eyes they have closed  ; lest at any time they should see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and should understand with their heart , and should be converted , and I should heal them .
kha: namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki la bthi , bad ki la set ïa ki shkor jong ki bad ki la khapbrip la ki khmat . Lymda kumta , ki khmat jong ki , kin jin da la ïohi , ki shkor jong ki kin jin da la ïohsngew ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki kin jin da la shemphang , bad kin jin da la wan phai pat sha nga ,’ ong U Blei , ‘ bad ngan pynkhiah ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka dohnud jong ki briew ka la tyrkhong, bad ki shkor jong ki ki la tyrkhong, bad ki khmat jong ki ki la khang; ioh ha kano kano ka por ba kin iohi da ki khmat jong ki, bad ki iohsngew da ki shkor jong ki, bad ki dei ban sngewthuh da ka dohnud jong ki, bad nga dei ban pynkoit ia ki .

en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers , that floweth with milk and honey  ; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves , and waxen fat  ; then will they turn unto other gods , and serve them , and provoke me , and break my covenant .
kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba nga la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Hangta kin ïoh bam katba ki kwah , bad kin im pahuh pahai . Hynrei kin phai noh sha kiwei pat ki blei bad kin mane ïa ki . Kin sa kyntait ïa nga bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ynda nga la wanrah ia ki sha ka ri kaba nga la sngap jar ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki, kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ; bad kin sa bam bad pyndap ia lade, bad kin sa pyndap ia ka shini ; nangta kin phai sha kiwei pat ki blei, bad kin shakri ia ki, bad kin pynkhih ia nga, bad kin pynpra ia ka jutang jong nga .

en: And every creature which is in heaven , and on the earth , and under the earth , and such as are in the sea , and all that are in them , heard I saying , Blessing , and honour , and glory , and power , be unto him that sitteth upon the throne , and unto the Lamb for ever and ever .
kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingthaw baroh ha bneng , ha khyndew , ha ka pyrthei shapoh , bad ha ka duriaw — baroh kiei kiei kiba im ha ka pyrthei — bad ki ïarwai :  Ha uta uba shong halor ka khet bad ha U Khunlangbrot , long ka jingïaroh bad ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom bad ka bor , junom la junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw uba don ha bneng bad ha khyndew bad uba don ha duriaw bad kiba don ha ki baroh ki la iohsngew ba nga ong: Ka jingkyrkhu bad ka burom bad ka burom bad ka bor, to long ha uta uba shong halor ka khet bad ha U Khunlangbrot junom .

en: Even after a certain rate every day , offering according to the commandment of Moses , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts , three times in the year , even in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles .
kha: u la kñia ki jingainguh thang kat kum ka jingdawa jong ka Hukum u Moses na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi kaba khuid : ki Sabbaton , ki Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam kiba man ka snem — ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , bad ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat hadien katto katne ka por man la ka sngi, da kaba ai katkum ka hukum jong u Moses, ha ki sngi saitjain bad ha ki bnai thymmai, bad ha ki jingkhawai niam ba la shet, lai sien ha ka snem , wat ha ka jingkhawai niam u kpu khlem thied bad ha ka jingkhawai niam jong ki taiew .

en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean , and between unclean fowls and clean : and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast , or by fowl , or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground , which I have separated from you as unclean .
kha: Namar kata , phi dei ban pynïapher ïa ki mrad bad ki sim ki bakhuid na kito ki bymkhuid . Wat bam ïa ki mrad bad ki sim ki bymkhuid . Nga la ñiew ïa ki , ki bymkhuid , bad kaba bam ïa ki ka pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban pyniapher ia ki mrad kiba khuid bad ki sim kiba khuid bad kiba khuid: bad phin ym pynlong ia ki mynsiem jong phi kiba sngewsih da u mrad ne da u khnai ne da kano kano ka jait jingthaw ba im kaba iaid ha ka khyndew kaba nga la pyniakhlad na phi kum ki bymkhuid .

en: He saith unto him the third time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time , Lovest thou me ? And he said unto him , Lord , thou knowest all things  ; thou knowest that I love thee . Jesus saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .
kha: Ha ka sien kaba lai U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa nga ?  U Petros u la sngewsih namar ba U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ha ka sien kaba lai ,  Me ieit ïa nga ?  kumta u la ong ha u ,  Ko Trai , me tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ; me tip ba nga ieit ïa me !  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U ong ha u ha ka sien kaba lai, ko Simon, ko khun u Jonah, me ieit ia nga ? U Petros u la sngewsih namar u la ong ha u ha ka sien kaba lai, Me ieit ia nga ? Bad u la ong ha u, ko Trai, me tip ia kiei kiei baroh; me tip ba nga ieit ia me . U Jisu u ong ha u, To ai bam ia ki langbrot jong nga .

en: And Moses took the tabernacle , and pitched it without the camp , afar off from the camp , and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation . And it came to pass , that every one which sought the  Lord  went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation , which was without the camp .
kha: Man ka por ba ki Israel ki sher dara , u Moses u shim ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang bad u pynïeng ïa ka kham ha pajih na kata ka jaka sher dara . La khot ïa ka , ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad uno uno uba kwah ban ïasyllok bad U  Trai  u ju leit sha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ka ïingjahthait bad u la pynlong ia ka shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah, sha jngai na ka jaka shong jaka sah . Bad ka la jia ba uwei pa uwei uba wad ia U Trai u la leit shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah jong ka kynhun .

en: And Samson s wife wept before him , and said , Thou dost but hate me , and lovest me not : thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people , and hast not told it me . And he said unto her , Behold , I have not told it my father nor my mother , and shall I tell it thee ?
kha: Kumta ka tnga u Samson ka leit ha khmat jong u ryngkat bad ki ummat bad ka ong ,  Pleng , phim ieit satia ïa nga ! Phi isih ïa nga ! Phi buh jingkyntip ha ki paralok jong nga , hynrei phim shym ïathuh ha nga ka mut aïu !  U ong ,  Khmih , ngam shym pat la ïathuh ha la i pa bad i mei . Balei keiñ ngan ïathuh ha phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la iam ha khmat jong u, bad u la ong, Me to shun ia nga, bad ngam ieit ia nga: me la buh ia ka jingkylli ha ki khun jong nga, bad me khlem iathuh ia kata ha nga . Bad u la ong ha ka: Ha khmih ngam shym la iathuh ia kata ha u kpa jong nga ne ha ka kmie jong nga bad ngan iathuh ia kata ha me ?

en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you  ; and evil will befall you in the latter days  ; because ye will do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands .
kha: Nga tip ba hadien ka jingïap jong nga , phin sa leh ïa ki kam bymman bad kyntait ïa kaba nga la hikai ïa phi . Bad ha ki sngi ki ban wan ka jingjynjar kan ngat ha phi , namar ba phin pynbitar ïa U  Trai  da kaba phi leh ïa kata kaba u la adong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba hadien ka jingiap jong nga phin pynsniew lut ia lade, bad phin phai noh na ka lynti kaba nga la hukum ia phi ; bad ka jingsniew kan sa jia ha phi ha ki sngi kiba hadien ; namar phin leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , ban pynkhih ia u ban bitar lyngba ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong phi .

en: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet  ; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept , and the priests , and the Levites , and all Judah and Israel that were present , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
kha: Naduh ki sngi jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa , ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ym pat ju rakhe kum kane . Ym don napdeng ki syiem ba-mynshuwa kiba la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum kane ba la rakhe da u Syiem Josaïah , ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , bad ki paid Judah , Israel , bad Jerusalem
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym shym la don ka jingkhawai kaba kum kata ha Israel naduh ki sngi u Samuel u nongiathuhlypa bad ki syiem Israel baroh kim shym la leh ia kata ka jingkhawai kumba u Josiah u la leh, bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad ki Judah bad ki Israel baroh kiba la don lang bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem .

en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah , when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah , which were carried away captive unto Babylon .
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga hadien ba u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la lah pyllait ïa nga ha Ramah . Ïa nga la leit ïalam shata ha ki kynjri , ryngkat bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kiba la leit ïalam kum ki koidi sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la wan ha u Jeremaiah na U Trai, hadien kata u Nebuzaradan u rangbah shipai u la pyllait noh ia u na Ramah , haba u la shim ia u da ki kynjri napdeng baroh kiba la shah rah noh sha Jerusalem bad Judah , kiba la shah rah noh sha Babilon .

en: In the evening she went , and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king s chamberlain , which kept the concubines : she came in unto the king no more , except the king delighted in her , and that she were called by name .
kha: Kan leit hangta ha ka por janmiet , bad ha ka step babud yn ïalam ïa ka sha kawei pat ka ïing ki kynthei bad yn buh hapoh ka jingpeit jong u Shaashgas , u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki tnga kliar u syiem . Kan ym leit shuh sha u syiem lymda u sngewtynnat eh ïa ka ba un phah khot ïa ka da ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por janmiet ka la leit phai noh sha ka iing kaba ar jong ki kynthei, sha ka jaka sumar jong u Shasha, u syiem u la buh ia ki kynthei: kam wan rung shuh sha u syiem, lait noh tang u syiem u la sngewbha ia ka, bad ba la khot ia ka da ka kyrteng .

en: And many nations shall come , and say , Come , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , and to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for the law shall go forth of Zion , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .
kha: bad ki briew jong ki , kin ong ,  ïa ngin ïaleit sha u lum jong U  Trai  , sha ka Templ jong U Blei ki Israel . Naba un hikai ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ; ngin ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u la jied . Naba ka jinghikai U  Trai  ka wan na Jerusalem ; na Seïon u kren ha la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki jaitbynriew kin wan, bad kin ong, To wan, bad to ngin leit sha u lum U Trai bad sha ka iing U Blei u Jakob bad un hikai ia ngi ia ki lynti jong u ; bad ngin iaid ha ki lynti jong u: namar ka hukum kan leit noh na ka Seion bad ka ktien U Trai na Jerusalem .

en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor , which is by the river of the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , Behold , there is a people come out from Egypt : behold , they cover the face of the earth , and they abide over against me :
kha: Kumta u syiem Balak u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïakynduh ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba don ha Pethor hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka ri jong ki Amaw . Ki wallam sha u ïa kane ka khubor na u Balak ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba kawei ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la wan na Ijipt ; kita ki briew ki la saphriang kylleng bad ki thmu ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ki nonglam khubor namarkata sha u Balaam u khun u Beor sha u Pethor, uba don hajan ka ri jong ki khun jong u, ban khot ia u, da kaba ong: Ha khmih ki don ki briew kiba mih na Ijipt: ha khmih ki tap ia ka khmat ka khyndew bad ki iaid pyrshah ia nga:

en: Behold the mounts , they are come unto the city to take it  ; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans , that fight against it , because of the sword , and of the famine , and of the pestilence : and what thou hast spoken is come to pass  ; and , behold , thou seest it .
kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki la tei ïa ki kynton kerkut sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban kurup ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong ki . Me lah ban ïohi ba baroh kaba me la kren ka la urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki lum ki wan sha ka nongbah ban shim ia ka ; bad ka nongbah ka la shah aiti ha ka kti jong ki Khaldes , kiba ialeh pyrshah ia ka , namar ka waitlam bad ka jingkyrduh: bad kaei kaba me la kren ka la jia ; bad, ha khmih me iohi ia ka .

en: Say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his fellows , and will put them with him , even with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they shall be one in mine hand .
kha: to ïathuh ha ki , ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Israel , bad ngan buh lang ïa u bad uta uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Judah . Na kita ar tylli ngan pynlong uwei u dieng , bad ngan bat ïa u ha ka kti jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai U Blei U Blei U la ong: Ha khmih , ngan shim ia u dieng u Joseph uba don ha ka kti jong u Ephraim bad ki jait Israel jong u, bad ngan buh ia ki bad u, wat bad u dieng u Judah, bad ngan pynlong ia ki uwei u dieng ha ka kti jong nga .

en: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial , of those that went with David , and said , Because they went not with us , we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered , save to every man his wife and his children , that they may lead them away , and depart .
kha: Hynrei don napdeng kita kiba la leit ryngkat bad u Dabid , ki bymman bad ki riewkai , kiba ong ,  Kine kim shym la leit ryngkat bad ngi , bad kumta ngim dei ban ai bynta ei ei ïa ki na ka jinglute . Ki lah ban shim tang ïa la ki tnga bad ïa la ki khun ki kti , bad ai kin leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba sniew baroh kiba la leit bad u Dabid, bad u la ong: Namar ba kim shym la leit bad ngi , ngin ym ai ia ki ia ka jingbam ba ngi la koit , ban pynim ia ka tnga jong u bad ki khun jong u baroh kawei .

en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the  Lord  will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem  ; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet , and their eyes shall consume away in their holes , and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth .
kha: U  Trai  un wallam ka jingpang bashyrkhei halor ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka doh jong ki kan pyut noh katba ki dang im ; ki khmat bad ki thylliej jong ki kin pyut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka khlam ha kaba U Trai un pynkhih ia ki briew baroh kiba la ialeh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem; Ka doh jong ki kan bam noh katba ki dang ieng ha ki kjat jong ki , bad ki khmat jong ki kin bam noh ha ki thliew jong ki , bad ka shyntur jong ki kan bam noh ha ka shyntur jong ki .

en: Go , gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan , and fast ye for me , and neither eat nor drink three days , night or day : I also and my maidens will fast likewise  ; and so will I go in unto the king , which is not according to the law : and if I perish , I perish .
kha: To khie leit bad ïalumlang ïa baroh ki Jiw ha Susa ; pynlong ka jingshah jingit bad duwai na ka bynta jong nga . Wat bam lane dih ei ei na ka bynta lai sngi bad lai miet . Ki shakri kynthei jong nga bad ma nga , ngin leh kumjuh . Hadien kata , ngan leit sha u syiem , wat la ka long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ . Lada ka dei ïa nga ban ïap na ka bynta kata , ai ngan ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit, to lum lang ia ki Jiw baroh kiba don ha Shushan, bad phim bam ne dih lai sngi, miet ne sngi: Nga ruh bad ki shakri jong nga ngin ialeh kumjuh ; bad kumta ngan leit sha u syiem, kaba ym long katkum ka hukum: bad lada nga jah noh , ngan jah noh .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren ha ka jingbitar lep jong nga pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong bad khamtam pyrshah ïa ka Edom . Da kaba shadkmen bad da kaba leh ibeiñ , ki kurup ïa ka ri jong nga bad shim kynti ïa ki jaka phlang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai U Blei U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai

en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for : that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee , as do thy people Israel  ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .
kha: Na bneng , ha kaba me shong , sngap ïa u bad leh ïa kaei kaba u kyrpad ïa me ban leh , khnang ba baroh ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei kin tip ïa me bad kohnguh ïa me kumba ki paid Israel ki leh . Te kin tip ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan long ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ha bneng ia ka jaka shong jong me, bad to leh katba u nongwei u khot ia me: ba ki briew baroh jong ka khyndew kin tip ia ka kyrteng jong me, ban sheptieng ia me, kumba ki briew jong me ki tieng ia me.

en: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam , that is beside Zarethan : and those that came down toward the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , failed , and were cut off : and the people passed over right against Jericho .
kha: ka um ka sangeh ban tuid bad ka lang shi jaka , kham jngai na kaba wan tuid ha Adam , ka nongbah hajan ka Sarethan . Ïa ka jingtuid jong ka arsut sha ka Duriaw Baïap la pyndkut , bad u paidbah u la lah ban jam sha shiliang hajan ka Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki um kiba wan hiar na jrong ki la ieng bad ki la kiew sha jrong bha na ka shnong u Adam, kaba don hajan ka Saretan: bad kito kiba wan hiar sha ka duriaw jong ka madan, wat ka duriaw mluh ruh, ki la jah noh: bad ki briew ki la iaid beit sha ka duriaw Jerikho .

en: For this , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not kill , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness , Thou shalt not covet ; and if there be any other commandment , it is briefly comprehended in this saying , namely , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
kha: Ki hukum ,  Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat ikwah ïa kaei kaba dei jong kiwei pat  — ïa kine baroh , bad kino kino kiwei pat , la kynthup lang ha kawei ka hukum ,  Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane , Wat leh be-ijot , Wat pyniap , Wat tuh , Wat shah sakhi lamler , Wat kwah shuh shuh ia ka hukum; bad lada don kawei pat ka hukum , la sngewthuh lyngkot ha kane ka jingong , kata , Me dei ban ieit ia u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ia lade .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning : I covered the deep for him , and I restrained the floods thereof , and the great waters were stayed : and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi ba u dieng u leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan pynlong ïa ki um shapoh khyndew ban tap ïa u kum ka dak ka jingïambriew . Ngan set noh ïa ki wah bad ngan ym shah ïa ki wahduid ban tuid shabar . Namar ba u dieng u la ïap , ngan wallam ka jingdum halor ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki dieng ha khlaw ba kin ïapstai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei baroh kawei ha ka sngi ba u la leit sha ka jingtep: nga la tap ia ka jingjylliew na ka bynta jong u: bad nga la teh ia ka jingshlei um jong ka: bad nga la pynlong ia u Lebanon ban iam na ka bynta jong u: bad ki dieng kiba heh ki la tyrkhong na ka bynta jong u .

en: And Absalom rose up early , and stood beside the way of the gate : and it was so , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment , then Absalom called unto him , and said , Of what city art thou ? And he said , Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel .
kha: U ju khie dang step phyrngab bad u ju leit ïeng harud lynti ha ka khyrdop shnong . Haba uno uno u briew u wan hangta bad ka jingïakajia kaba u kwah ïa u syiem ban pynbeit , u Absalom u ju khot ïa u , bad kylli ïa u , u dei uba nangno . Bad hadien ba u briew u la ïathuh ïa u na kano ka jait u dei ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la ieng dang step, bad u la ieng hajan ka lynti jong ka khyrdop: bad ka la long kumta, ba haba uno uno u briew uba don ka jingiakren u la wan sha u syiem ban bishar, te u Absalom u la khot ia u bad u la ong: Na kano ka shnong me long ? Bad u la ong: U shakri jong me u long na kawei na ki jait Israel .

en: Now when Job s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him , they came every one from his own place  ; Eliphaz the Temanite , and Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite : for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him .
kha: Lai ngut na ki paralok u Job ki long u Eliphas na ka nongbah Teman , u Bildad na ka ri Shuah , bad u Sophar na ka ri Naamah . Ynda ki la ïohsngew katno ba u Job u shah jynjar , ki ïakut ban leit bad pyntngen ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Job u la iohsngew ia kane ka jingsniew baroh kaba la wan ha u, ki la wan uwei pa uwei na la ka jong ka jaka;

en: And when thou art spoiled , what wilt thou do ? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson , though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold , though thou rentest thy face with painting , in vain shalt thou make thyself fair  ; thy lovers will despise thee , they will seek thy life .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , pha long kaba la tim ! Balei pha riam ha kaba saw syn-iang ? Balei pha deng jingdeng bad airong ïa ki khmat jong pha ? Pha pynbhabriew ïa lade ym na ka bynta kano kano ! Ki nongleh-ieit jong pha ki la kyntait ïa pha bad ki kwah ban pynïap ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba me la shah pynsniew , kaei kaba me leh ? Wat la me phong ia lade da ka rong saw, wat la me pynsniew ia me da ki jingdeng ksiar, wat la me pynkhuid ia ka khmat jong me da ka rong saw, ha ka por ba me pynlong ia lade uba bha; ki nongieit jong me kin leh bein ia me, kin wad ia ka jingim jong me .

en: And he humbled thee , and suffered thee to hunger , and fed thee with manna , which thou knewest not , neither did thy fathers know  ; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the  Lord  doth man live .
kha: U la pyndem ïa phi , u la pynshahthngan ïa phi , bad hadien kata u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju ïoh mynno mynno . Ban hikai ïa phi ba u briew um im tang da u kpu hynrei da ka ktien baroh kaba mih na U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynrit ia me, bad u la ai bam ia me da ka manna, kaba me khlem tip, bad ki kpa tymmen jong me kim tip ba u lah ban pyntip ia me ba u briew um im tang da u kpu , hynrei da ka ktien baroh kaba mih na ka shyntur U Trai u briew u im .

en: And keep the charge of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and his testimonies , as it is written in the law of Moses , that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest , and whithersoever thou turnest thyself :
kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Aiñ u Moses , khnang ba haba me leit shano shano me lah ban manbha ha kaei kaei kaba me leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to sumar ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong U Trai U Blei jong me, ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u, ban sumar ia ki ain jong u, bad ki jingbishar jong u, bad ki jingphla jong u, kumba la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses, ba me lah ban jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me leh, bad ha kaba me phai ia lade:

en: And when they go forth into the utter court , even into the utter court to the people , they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered , and lay them in the holy chambers , and they shall put on other garments  ; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments .
kha: Shuwa ba kin leit sha ka phyllaw ba kham shabar ha kaba don ki paidbah , ki dei ban loit noh shuwa ïa ki sopti ba ki phong haba ki don ha ka kam hapoh ka Templ bad ban iehnoh ïa ki ha ki kamra bakhuid . Kin phong da kiwei pat ki sopti khnang ba kin buh noh ïa ki sopti bakyntang na kaba pynmynsaw ïa ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki leit sha ka phyllaw kaba shabar, wat sha ka phyllaw kaba shabar sha ki briew, kin weng noh ia ki jain jong ki ha kaba ki shakri, bad kin buh ia ki ha ki kamra bakhuid, bad kin phong da kiwei pat ki jain ; bad kin ym pynkyntang ia ki briew da ki jain jong ki .

en: And Moses said , Behold , I go out from thee , and I will entreat the  Lord  that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people , to morrow : but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the  Lord .
kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Nga tang shu mih nangne , ngan kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ba la shai ka sngi ki skain kin phet noh na phi , na ki rangbah synshar jong phi , bad na ki briew jong phi . Hynrei phim dei ban shukor shuh ïa ngi bad khang ïa ki briew ban leit kñia ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Ha khmih nga mih noh na me, bad ngan kyrpad ia U Trai ba ki khnai kin leit noh na u Pharaoh, na ki shakri jong u, bad na ki briew jong u, ban leit noh: hynrei wat ai ba u Pharaoh un leh thok shuh shuh ha kaba ym shah ia ki briew ban leit knia ha U Trai .

en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man , so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah , saith the  Lord   ; that they might be unto me for a people , and for a name , and for a praise , and for a glory : but they would not hear .
kha: Kumba ki patlun lyngkot ki biang sbiak sawdong ka syngkai , kumta nga la thmu ba baroh ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah kin snoh skhem ha nga . Nga la leh ïa kane khnang ba kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad wallam ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; hynrei kim shym kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka kynhun ka rung ha ki tyrpeng jong u briew, kumta nga la pynlong ia nga ban rung ha nga ia ka iing Israel baroh kawei bad ka iing Judah baroh kawei, ong U Trai; ba kin long ha nga na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew, bad na ka bynta ka nam, bad na ka bynta ka burom: hynrei kin ym iohsngew .

en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel , and because of their transgressions in all their sins : and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation , that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam namar ka jingbymkhuid jong ki Israel bad namar ki pop jong ki baroh . U dei ban leh kumne ha ka Ïingjaiñ namar ka ïeng hapdeng ka jaka shong dara , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka jaka bakhuid, namar ka jingbymkhuid jong ki khun Israel bad namar ki jingpynkhein jong ki ha ki pop jong ki baroh: bad kumta un leh na ka bynta ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng kaba sah hapdeng jong ki hapdeng ka jingbymkhuid jong ki .

en: And the children of Israel said unto them , Would to God we had died by the hand of the  Lord  in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the flesh pots , and when we did eat bread to the full  ; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness , to kill this whole assembly with hunger .
kha: Kan jin da la bha ba U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa ngi ha ri Ijipt . Hangta , la kumno kumno , ngi dang ïoh ban shong bad bam doh bad kyrhai ka jingbam kat kaba ngi kwah . Hynrei phi la wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri shyiap ban pynïapthngan ïa ngi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ong ha ki, Hato ha U Blei ngi la iap da ka kti U Trai ha ka ri Ijipt, haba ngi la shong hajan ki khiew bad haba ngi la bam ia u kpu haduh katta katta namar phi la wanrah ia ngi sha kane ka ri khlaw , ban pyniap ia kane ka jingiaseng baroh kawei da ka jingkyrduh .

en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and said unto her , Entice him , and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him , that we may bind him to afflict him : and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver .
kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit sha ka bad ki ong ,  Khroh ïa u Samson ban ïathuh ha pha balei ba u long uba khlaiñbor bad kumno ngin lah ban jop ïa u , khum ïa u bad pynlong ba un ym lah leh ei ei shuh . Uwei pa uwei na ngi un ai ïa pha mar shihajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la wan shaneng sha ka, bad ki la ong ha ka, To sngewthuh ia u, bad to peit shano ka bor kaba khraw jong u ka don, bad da kano ka lad ngi lah ban jop ia u, ba ngin teh ia u ban pynshitom ia u: bad ngin ai ia me iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia phi: bad ngin ai ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi ia phi .

en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses , every man according to his service , the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings , to minister , and to give thanks , and to praise in the gates of the tents of the  Lord .
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u pynskhem biang ïa ka kynhun ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , hapoh jong kata uwei pa uwei u don la ka jong ka jong ka kamram . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok , kaba shim bynta ha ka jingmane ha ka templ , bad kaba ai ïa ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ha ki bynta bapher jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la buh ia ki jingbam jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi hadien ki jingbam jong ki, uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingshakri jong u, ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ki jingknia thang bad na ka bynta ki jingknia jingsuk, ban shakri, bad ban ainguh ha ki khyrdop jong ki ïingjaiñ U Trai .

en: And Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother , answered and said , Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king s sons  ; for Amnon only is dead : for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar .
kha: Hynrei u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , kim shym la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh . Tang u Amnon uba la ïap . Phi lah ban ong da kaba peit ïa u Absalom ba u la kut jingmut skhem ban leh ïa kane naduh ka por ba u Amnon u la batbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonadab u khun u Shimeah u hynmen u Dabid u la jubab bad u la ong, Wat ai ba u kynrad jong nga un tharai ba ki la pyniap ia ki samla baroh ki khun shynrang u la iap tang u Amnon: namar da ka jingthung ia u Absalom ia kane la pynbeit naduh ka sngi ba u la pynbor ia ka para jong u ka Tamar .

en: Therefore fear thou not , O my servant Jacob , saith the  Lord   ; neither be dismayed , O Israel : for , lo , I will save thee from afar , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and shall be in rest , and be quiet , and none shall make him afraid .
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng ; ko ki paid Israel , wat ym sngewshyrkhei . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri bajngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat sha ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin shngain , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat tieng, ko shakri jong nga u Jakob, ko Trai; wat nym sngewsih, ko Israel: namar, ha khmih, ngan pynim ia me na jngai, bad ia u symbai jong me na ka ri jong ki.

en: And the sons of Tola  ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations  ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .
kha: U Tola u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ussi , u Rephaïah , u Jeriel , u Jahmai , u Ibsam , bad u Shemuel . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing kiba na ka kur Tola , bad ki dei ruh ki shipai bapawnam . Ha ka por u syiem Dabid , ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki don arphew ar hajar hynriewspah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Tola ; Uzi, bad u Jeriah, bad u Jahmai, bad u J bemam, bad u Shemuel, ki khlieh jong ka iing u kpa jong ki, ha ka por ba ki long ki briew kiba donbor ha ki pateng jong ki; kiba don ha ki sngi u Dabid arphew hajar hynriew spah .

en: Let the priests , the ministers of the  Lord  , weep between the porch and the altar , and let them say , Spare thy people , O  Lord  , and give not thine heritage to reproach , that the heathen should rule over them : wherefore should they say among the people , Where is their God ?
kha: Ki lyngdoh , kiba shakri ïa U  Trai hapdeng ka duwan bad ka jaka rung ka Templ , ki dei ban ïam bad duwai :  To isynei ïa la ki briew , A  Trai . To wat ai ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi da kaba ong , ‘ Hangno U Blei jong phi ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki lyngdoh , ki nongshakri jong U Trai kin iam hapdeng ka phyllaw bad ka almari bad ai ba kin ong: To ai ia ki briew jong me, ko Trai, bad wat ai ia ka pateng jong me ban kren bein ia ki: namar kata ki dei ban ong hapdeng ki briew: Hangno U Blei jong ki ?

en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes , the governors , and the captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
kha: Te u syiem u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ban ïawanlang — ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , ki kommisshonor , ki nongbat tyngka , ki nongbishar , ki majistor , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ki jylla . Ki la dei ban wan sha ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka durbriew kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Neuchadnezzar u syiem u la phah ban lum lang ia ki syiem, ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah , ki nongbishar , ki nongshong shnong , ki nongai jingmut , ki nongshong shnong bad ki nongsynshar baroh jong ki jylla , ban wan sha ka jingpynkyntang ia ka dur kaba u Neuchadnezzar u syiem u la buh .

en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the  Lord  , that is in the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering , which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Un tah snam khyndiat ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan ka jingiwbih thang kaba hapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad un theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh thang , kiba don ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un theh katto katne ka snam ha ki bniat jong ka miej kaba don ha khmat U Trai , kaba don ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , bad un theh ia ka snam baroh ha trai jong ka jaka thang kaba don ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And the king called the Gibeonites , and said unto them  ; ( now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel , but of the remnant of the Amorites  ; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them : and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah . )
kha: ( Ki paid Gibeon kim dei ki Israel ; ki dei ka kynhun barit ki Amor ïa kaba ki Israel ki la kular ban ïada , hynrei u Saul u la pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ki namar ka jingshitrhem na ka bynta ki paid Israel bad Judah . )
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la khot ia ki nong Gibeon bad u la ong ha ki (mynta ki nong Gibeon kim dei na ki khun Israel , hynrei na ki Amorites; bad ki khun Israel ki la smai ha ki: bad u Saul u la wad ban pyniap ia ki ha ka jingkmen jong u ia ki khun Israel bad Judah .)

en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea , even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters , saying , Go , ye swift messengers , to a nation scattered and peeled , to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden down , whose land the rivers have spoiled !
kha: Na kata ka ri , ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki la wan arsut ïa ka Nile ha ki lieng ba la shna da ki khah . Khie noh sha ïing , ko nonglamktien bastet ! Rah noh ïa ka khubor sha ka ri jong phi kaba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , sha ka jaitbynriew jong phi kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , sha ki briew jong phi kiba jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha kylleng ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka phah ia ki nonglam khubor da ka duriaw, wat ha ki lieng kiba tuid ha ki um, ki ong, To leit noh sha ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang bad kaba la tyrkhong, sha ka jaitbynriew kaba shyrkhei naduh ba ki sdang haduh mynta; ka jaitbynriew kaba la mih bad kaba la iaid shapoh , kaba ki wah ki la jot !

en: And it came to pass , when all the kings which were on this side Jordan , in the hills , and in the valleys , and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon , the Hittite , and the Amorite , the Canaanite , the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite , heard thereof  ;
kha: Ïa ki jingjop jong ki Israel la bna ha baroh ki syiem kiba shaphang sepngi jong ka Jordan — ha ki lumrit , ha trai ki lum , bad ha ka pyntha rud duriaw jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian haduh ka Lebanon ha ka phang bashatei ; kine ki dei ki syiem jong ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki syiem baroh kiba don ha kane ka liang ka Jordan, ha ki lum bad ha ki them bad ha ki rud duriaw bah baroh ki jaka ba la buh ha ka Lebanon, u Hitit bad u Amorit, u Kanaan, u Perizi, u Hivit bad u Jibi, ki la iohsngew ia ka;

en: O Lord , I beseech thee , let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant , and to the prayer of thy servants , who desire to fear thy name : and prosper , I pray thee , thy servant this day , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . For I was the king s cupbearer .
kha: To shahshkor mynta ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad ïa ki jingduwai jong baroh kiwei pat ki shakri jong me kiba kwah ban ai ïa me ka burom . Ai ïa ka jingjop mynta ka sngi bad pynlong ba u patsha un leh-isynei ïa nga .  Ha kita ki sngi nga la long u nongrah waiñ jong u patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai mynta ia ka shkor jong me, bad ia ka jingduwai jong ki shakri jong me, kiba kwah ban sheptieng ia ka kyrteng jong me: bad nga roi: bad nga roi: nga kyrpad ia me, ko shakri jong me ha kane ka sngi . Bad to ai ia u ia ka jingisynei ha khmat une u briew . Namar nga la long u nongrah ia ka khuri jong u syiem .

en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the  Lord  : for they shall all know me , from the least of them unto the greatest of them , saith the  Lord  : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more .
kha: Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban hap hikai ïa la u para ri ban tip ïa U  Trai  , namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam . Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingbakla jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym hikai shuh ia u para marjan jong u, bad uwei pa uwei u para jong u, da kaba ong: To tip ia U Trai: namar baroh kin ithuh ia nga, naduh kiba rit tam na ki haduh kiba khraw tam na ki: namar ngan map ia ka jingbymhok jong ki, bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ia ka pop jong ki .

en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp , they went into one tent , and did eat and drink , and carried thence silver , and gold , and raiment , and went and hid it  ; and came again , and entered into another tent , and carried thence also , and went and hid it .
kha: Haba ki rangbah saw ngut ki poi harud kata ka jaka shong dara , ki leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ , ki bam ki dih kat kaba don , ki la rah noh ïa ka rupa , ka ksiar , bad ki jaiñ ba ki shem bad ki leit noh bad buhrieh ïa ki ; nangta ki wan phai , ki la rung ha kawei pat ka ïingjaiñ bad ki leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongpang niangthohlieh ki la poi sha kawei ka ïingjaiñ, ki la leit shapoh kawei ka ïingjaiñ, bad ki la bam bad dih, bad ki la rah ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ka jainkup, bad ki la leit buhrieh ïa ka ; bad ki la wan phai biang, bad ki la rung sha kawei pat ka ïingjaiñ, bad ki la leit buhrieh ïa ka .

en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia , that the word of the  Lord  spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished , the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia , that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom , and put it also in writing , saying ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong ba u Syros ka ri Persia u long u patsha . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kaei kaba u la ong lyngba u nongïathuhlypa Jeremaïah ban urlong shisha . U pynsngew ha u Syros ban pynmih ïa ka hukum harum bad ban phah ha ka jingthoh ïa ka ban pule jam ha kylleng ka hima jong u :
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong u Syiem Jeremaiah, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la kren da ka shyntur u Jeremaiah, U Trai u la pynkhih ia ka mynsiem u Syiem Jeremaiah, ba u la pynlong ia ka jingpynbna ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei, bad u la buh ruh ia ka ha ka jingthoh , da kaba ong:

en: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them , and said , What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? And they answered , Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath . And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither .
kha: Kumta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad khot lang ïa baroh san ngut ki syiem Philistia bad kylli ïa ki ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel ?   Leit rah ïa ka sha Gath ,  ki la jubab ; kumta ki bah ïa ka sha Gath , kawei pat ka nongbah ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah namarkata bad ki la lum lang ia ki kynrad jong ki Philistia baroh ha ki , bad ki la ong: Ngi leh aiu ia ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel ? Ki la jubab , Ai ba ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel kan iaid sha Gath . Ki la rah ia ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel sawdong .

en: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city , to finish the transgression , and to make an end of sins , and to make reconciliation for iniquity , and to bring in everlasting righteousness , and to seal up the vision and prophecy , and to anoint the most Holy .
kha: Hynñiew sien ki hynñiewphew snem ki long ka jingjlan jong ka por ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong me bad ïa ka nongbah bakhuid jong me na ka pop bad ka jingsniew . Ïa ka pop yn map bad yn seng ïa ka jingbishar hok bymjukut , khnang ba ka jingïohipaw bad ka jingïathuhlypa kin wan urlong shisha , bad ïa ka Templ bakhuid yn pynkyntang biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriewphew taiew ki long kiba la buh ha ki briew jong me bad ha ka nongbah bakhuid jong me, ban pyndep ia ka jingpynkhein ia ki pop, bad ban pynlong ia ka jingpyniasuk na ka bynta ka jingbymhok , bad ban wanrah ia ka hok bymjukut , bad ban khang ia ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingiathuhlypa jong me , bad ban pynsleh ia kaba khuid tam .
