en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla , wat la ym shym don kiba la lute ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por ban lute bad shetkylla kan kut , bad ma ki hi kin sa long kiba shah lute bad kiba shah shetkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewsih ia me uba la pynsniew, bad me khlem shah pynsniew ; bad ki la leh thok ia me ! haba me sangeh ban pynsniew ia me, me shah pynsniew ; bad haba me la pynkut noh ban leh thok ia me .

en: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .
kha: U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad ki rangbah kur ki ong ïa ki ,  Ngim donkam ïa ka jingïarap jong phi ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin tei hi ïa ka da lade , kumba u Syros , u patsha ka Persia , u la hukum ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Serubabel bad u Jeshua bad kiwei pat ki kpa Israel ki la ong ha ki: Phim don ei ei bad ngi ban tei ia ka iing ha U Blei jong ngi ; hynrei ngi hi ngin tei ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , kumba u syiem u Cyrus u syiem ka Persia u la hukum ia ngi .

en: That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
kha: Hato dei na kata ba phi baroh phi la ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khun jong nga hi u la ïateh kular bad u Dabid . Ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga lane ïathuh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki rangbah jong nga , u don hangne mynta , u da wad ïa ka kabu ban pynïap ïa nga , bad ba u khun jong nga u la pynshlur ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phi baroh phi la thmu pyrshah ia nga , bad ym don ba iohi ia nga ba u khun jong nga u la leh ia ka jingiateh bad u khun jong u Jesse , bad ym don uwei ruh na phi uba sngewsih ia nga , ne uba iohi ha nga ba u khun jong nga u la pynkhih ia u shakri jong nga pyrshah ia nga, ban thiah ha kane ka sngi ?

en: Howbeit the  Lord  God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever : for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler  ; and of the house of Judah , the house of my father  ; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel :
kha: U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , u la jied ïa nga bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ban synshar junom ïa ki Israel ; u la jied ïa ka jait Judah ban pynmih nongïalam , bad na ka jait Judah u la jied ïa ka ïing u kpa jong nga . Na baroh kata ka longïing ka long ka jingsngewbha jong u ban shim ïa nga bad ban pynlong ïa nga u syiem halor ki Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la jied ia nga ha khmat ka iing jong u kpa jong nga baroh kawei ban long syiem halor ki Israel: namar u la jied ia u Judah ban long u nongsynshar ; bad na ka iing Judah:

en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the  Lord  upon the house , they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement , and worshipped , and praised the  Lord  , saying , For he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohi ïa ka ding ba ka wan hiar na bneng bad ba ka jingshai ka dap ha ka Templ , ki dem khrup ha lynti ba la siang maw , ki da mane ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa U namar ka jingbha bad ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki khun Israel baroh ki la iohi ia ka ding kaba la hiar, bad ka burom U Trai halor ka iing, ki la dem khrup ha ka khyndew halor ka lynti iaid kjat, bad ki la mane ia U Trai, ki da ong: Na ka bynta jong u u long uba bha; namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .
kha: Nangta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui ïa u Daniel , bad la bret ïa ki , lem bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . Ha shuwa ban kin poi sha tbian jong ka thliew , ki sing ki la kynrup ïa ki bad pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum , bad ki la wanrah ia kita ki briew kiba la kynnoh ia u Daniel , bad ki la bret ia ki ha ka thliew jong ki sing , ma ki, ki khun jong ki bad ki tnga jong ki; bad ki sing ki don ka jinglong trai jong ki baroh .

en: Take thou also unto thee wheat , and barley , and beans , and lentiles , and millet , and fitches , and put them in one vessel , and make thee bread thereof , according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side , three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof .
kha: Mynta shim khyndiat u kew , u barli , u phresbin , u motor , u krai , bad uwei pat u kynja kew . Khleh lang ïa ki baroh bad shna kpu . Kata ka dei kaba men bam na ka bynta ki laispah khyndaiphew tylli ki sngi ba me thiah pyrshing sha ka krung kadiang .
translated_en_to_kha: To shim ruh ia u kew bad u kew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u buh ia ki ha kawei ka umphniang bad u shna ia u kpu jong u kat kum ka jingbun ki sngi ba me thiah ha ka liang jong me, lai spah hynniewphew sngi .

en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea , which cannot be measured nor numbered  ; and it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people , there it shall be said unto them , Ye are the sons of the living God .
kha: Ki briew ka Israel kin sa bun kum u shyiap ka duriaw , kin bun haduh bym lah shuh ban ñiew lane ban thew . Mynta U Blei u ong ïa ki ,  Phim dei ki briew jong nga ,  hynrei ka sngi kan poi ha kaba un ong ha ki ,  Phi dei ki khun jong U Blei uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingdon jong ki khun Israel kan long kum ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw kaba ym lah ban thew ne khein ; bad kan sa jia ha kata ka jaka ba la ong ha ki , Phim dei ki briew jong nga , hangta yn ong ha ki , Phi long ki khun U Blei uba im .

en: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest , which stood above the people , and said unto them , Thus saith God , Why transgress ye the commandments of the  Lord  , that ye cannot prosper ? because ye have forsaken the  Lord  , he hath also forsaken you .
kha: Nangta U Mynsiem U Blei u wan ha u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada u lyngdoh . U la ïeng ha ka jaka ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa u , bad u pyrta ,  U  Trai  U Blei u kylli balei ba phim shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u bad ba phi wallam ka jingpynjot halor lade hi ! Phi la iehnoh ïa u , kumta u la iehnoh ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Blei u la wan ha u Seariah u khun jong u Jehoiada u lyngdoh uba la ieng halor ki briew bad u la ong ha ki: Kumta u ong U Blei: Balei phi pynkhein ia ki hukum U Trai ba phim lah ban jop ? namar ba phi la iehnoh ia U Trai , u la iehnoh ruh ia phi .

en: And they shall fill thy houses , and the houses of all thy servants , and the houses of all the Egyptians  ; which neither thy fathers , nor thy fathers  fathers have seen , since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day . And he turned himself , and went out from Pharaoh .
kha: Kin dap ha ki ïingsyiem jong me , bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew jong me baroh . Kin long kiba kham sniew ban ïa kano kano kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la ju ïohi .’   Nangta u Moses u phai bad u mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pyndap ia ki iing jong me baroh, bad ki iing jong ki nong Ijipt baroh; kiba ki kpa tymmen jong me kim shym la iohi, naduh ka sngi ba ki la don ha ka khyndew haduh kane ka sngi . U la phai noh sha la ka jong ka jaka bad u la leit noh na u Pharaoh .

en: This shall be thine of the most holy things , reserved from the fire : every oblation of theirs , every meat offering of theirs , and every sin offering of theirs , and every trespass offering of theirs , which they shall render unto me , shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons .
kha: Kine harum ki long ki jong me na ki jingainguh kiba kyntang tam ïa ki bym shym la thang ha ka duwan : ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ki jingainguh namar ka jingpalat . Baroh kaba la wanrah ha nga kum ka jingainguh bakyntang ka long ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kan long ka jong me na kiei kiei kiba khuid tam, kaba la buh kyrpang na ka ding: ka jingainguh bam jong ki, bad ka jingainguh pop jong ki baroh kawei, bad ka jingainguh pop jong ki baroh kawei, kaba kin ai ha nga, kan long kaba khuid tam na ka bynta jong me bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong me .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , of Ahab the son of Kolaiah , and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah , which prophesy a lie unto you in my name  ; Behold , I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall slay them before your eyes  ;
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la kren shaphang u Ahab u khun jong u Kolaïah bad u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Maaseïah , kiba ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong U . U la ong ba un aiti ïa ki ha ka bor jong u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , u ban pynïap ïa ki ha khmat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel, u Ahab u khun u Kolaiah, bad u Sedekaiah u khun u Maaseiah, uba iathuhlypa ia phi ha ka kyrteng jong nga; Ha khmih , ngan aiti ia ki ha ka kti u Neuchadrezzar u syiem Babilon; bad un pyniap ia ki ha khmat jong phi;

en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns , nor Taanach and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns : but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
kha: Ki jait Manasseh kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Beth Shan , Taanakh , Dor , Ibleam , Megiddo bad ha ki nongrit kiba hajan ; ki Kanaan ki dang shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Manasseh kam shym la beh noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Bethshean bad ki shnong jong ka, ne ki shnong jong ka, ne ki nongshong shnong jong ka Dork bad ki shnong jong ka, ne ki nongshong shnong jong ka Ibleam bad ki shnong jong ka: hynrei ki nongshong shnong jong ka Megiddo bad ki shnong jong ka: hynrei ki nongshong shnong jong ka kin shong ha kata ka ri .

en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place , according to the commandment of David , and Asaph , and Heman , and Jeduthun the king s seer  ; and the porters waited at every gate  ; they might not depart from their service  ; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them .
kha: Kine ki nongtem nongput harum na ka kur u Asaph jong ki Lebi ki don ha la ki jaka ba la aiti ha ki da ki jingbthah u Syiem Dabid : u Asaph , u Heman , bad u Jeduthun , u nongïathuhlypa jong u syiem . Ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop ka Templ kim shym donkam ban mihnoh na ki jaka ba ki ap , namar kiwei pat ki Lebi ki pynkhreh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongrwai ki long ha ka jaka jong ki, kat kum ka hukum u Dabid, bad u Asaph, bad u Heman, bad u Heman u syiem u la ap ia ka met bad ki nongap khyrdop ki la ap ha man la ka khyrdop; kim lah ban mih na ka jingshakri jong ki; namar ki hynmen jong ki ki Lebi ki la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki .

en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron , and said unto them , Ye take too much upon you , seeing all the congregation are holy , every one of them , and the  Lord  is among them : wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the  Lord  ?
kha: Ki la ïalumlang ha khmat u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki ong ha ki ,  Phi la leh shaba palat ! Baroh ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki long ki jong U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u don lem bad ngi baroh . Balei te Moses me buh ïa lade uba halor jong ka kynhun jong U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ialum lang pyrshah ia u Moses bad pyrshah ia u Aaron bad ki la ong ha ki, Phi shim palat ia phi, haba phi iohi ia ka jingiaseng baroh ka long kaba khuid, uwei pa uwei na ki: namar kata phi pynkiew ia lade halor ka jingiaseng U Trai ?

en: And Moses said , This shall be , when the  Lord  shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full  ; for that the  Lord  heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him : and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us , but against the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u Moses u la ong ,  Dei U  Trai  u ban ai ïa phi ka doh ban bam ha ka por janmiet bad kyrhai u kpu ha ka por mynstep , namar ba u la ïohsngew haduh katno phi la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u . Haba phi khñium pyrshah ïa ngi , phi ïakhñium shisha keiñ pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong, Kane kan long, haba U Trai un ai ia phi ha ka por janmiet ban bam, bad ha ka por mynstep ban bam, namar ba U Trai u iohsngew ia ki jingkyrhuh jong phi kiba phi ud pyrshah ia u: bad ngi long aiu ? ki jingkyrhuh jong phi kim long pyrshah ia ngi hynrei pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits : The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth  ; even the bottom shall be a cubit , and the breadth a cubit , and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span : and this shall be the higher place of the altar .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingthew jingwoh jong ka duwan , kiba long ha kajuh ka rukom kumba thew ïa ka Templ . Ha baroh sawdong ka trai jong ka duwan ka don ka nur kaba sanphew sentimitar ka jingjylliew bad sanphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad ka rmiang ha ka tduh kaba shabar kaba long arphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki jingthew jong ka almari hadien ki cubit: Ka cuit ka long ka cuit bad ka kti ka long ka cuit , bad ka jingjrong jong ka ka long ka cuit , bad u pud jong ka da ka tduh jong ka sawdong jong ka: kane kan long ka jaka kaba kham heh jong ka almari .

en: Also I shook my lap , and said , So God shake out every man from his house , and from his labour , that performeth not this promise , even thus be he shaken out , and emptied . And all the congregation said , Amen , and praised the  Lord . And the people did according to this promise .
kha: Nangta nga shim ïa ka jaiñ ba nga teh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong nga bad kynther ïa ka .  Kumne U Blei un kynther ïano ïano na phi u bym bat ïa la ka kular ,  nga ong .  U Blei un shim noh ïa ki ïing jong phi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi don , bad un iehnoh ïa phi khlem don ei ei shuh .  Baroh kiba don hangta ki ong ,  Amen !  bad ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai . Bad ki nongïalam ki bat ïa ka kular jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga la pynkhih ia ka tyrpeng jong nga, bad nga la ong, Kumta U Blei u pynkhih ia u briew na ka iing jong u, bad na ka jingtrei shitom jong u, kata kam pyndep ia kane ka jingkular, wat kumta ruh u la shah pynkhih noh, bad u la thylli . Bad ka jingiaseng baroh ka la ong, Amen, bad u la iaroh ia U Trai . Bad ki briew ki la leh kat kum kane ka jingkular .

en: And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place  ; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him .
kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban phong ïa ki man ka por ba ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ne haba ki leit sha jan ka duwan ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , khnang ba kin ym shah pynïap ba ki thad burom ïa lade . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba neh shi rta ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dei ban don ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u haba ki wan rung sha ka jaka shong jaka sah jong ka jingiaseng, lane haba ki wan hajan ka jaka kyntang; ba kin ym kit ia ka jingbymhok, bad kin iap: kan long ka ain junom ia u bad ia u symbai jong u hadien jong u .

en: And they beat down the cities , and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone , and filled it  ; and they stopped all the wells of water , and felled all the good trees : only in Kir–hareseth left they the stones thereof  ; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it .
kha: bad pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki . Katba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka lyngkha baseisoh , uwei pa uwei u Israel u ju kawang maw ha ka haduh ba la tap lin ïa baroh ki lyngkha ; ki la pynsangeh ruh ïa ki umpohliew bad ki la pom ïa ki diengsoh . Ha kaba khatduh tang ka nongbah Kir Heres ka dang sah , bad ki nongkawang maw ki kerkut ïa ka bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynhap ia ki shnong, bad ha kawei pa kawei ka jaka kaba bha ki la bret ia u maw jong u, bad ki la pyndap ia u ; bad ki la pynsangeh ia ki tyllong um baroh: tang ha Kirhares ki la iehnoh ia ki maw jong ka ; wat la ki sngap jar ki la iaid kylleng kylleng .

en: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit , and knowledge , and understanding , interpreting of dreams , and shewing of hard sentences , and dissolving of doubts , were found in the same Daniel , whom the king named Belteshazzar : now let Daniel be called , and he will shew the interpretation .
kha: U la don ka jinglah kaba kham pher bad u long uba stad bad uba tbit ha kaba batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , uba ai jubab ïa ki jingkyntip , bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan ; kumta to phah khot ïa une u briew , u Daniel , ïa uba u syiem u la ai kyrteng u Belteshassar , bad un ïathuh ïa phi aïu kane baroh ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: La lap ia u Daniel uba bha tam, bad ka jingtip, bad ka jingsngewthuh, ka jingbatai ia ki jingphohsniew, bad ka jingpyni ia ki sentens kiba eh, bad ka jingpynkylla ia ki jingartatien, la lap ha u juh u Daniel, uba u syiem u la jer kyrteng u Belteshaar: mynta to ai ba u Daniel un shah khot, bad un pyni ia ka jingbatai .

en: And , behold , all the women that are left in the king of Judah s house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon s princes , and those women shall say , Thy friends have set thee on , and have prevailed against thee : thy feet are sunk in the mire , and they are turned away back .
kha: Ha ka , nga la ïohi ba ïa baroh ki kynthei kiba dang sah ha ka ïingsyiem ha Judah ba la ïalam ïa ki shabar sha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ha sngap ïa kaei kaba ki ïakren katba ki dang ïaleit :   ‘ Ki paralok bajan tam u syiem ki la ïalam bakla ïa u , ki la ïaid lait ïa u . Bad mynta ba ki kjat jong u ki la ngam ha ka ktieh , ki paralok jong u ki la iehnoh ïa u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, baroh ki kynthei kiba sah ha ka iing jong u syiem Judah kin shah rah sha u syiem Babilon, bad kita ki kynthei kin ong: Ki paralok jong me ki la buh ia me bad ki la jop ia me: ki kjat jong me ki la ngam ha ka dewbilat bad ki la phaidien noh .

en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : to your tents , O Israel : now see to thine own house , David . So Israel departed unto their tents .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki la pyrta ,  Long ba la ñiewbeiñ ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin leit noh sha ïing ! To ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi ïa lade !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki Israel baroh ki la iohi ba u syiem um shym la sngap ia ki, ki briew ki la jubab ia u syiem, ki da ong: Ngi don ka pateng ha u khun u Jesse: ha ki ïingjaiñ jong phi, ko Israel: mynta to peit ha la ka jong ka ïing, ko Dabid . Kumta ki Israel ki la leit noh sha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .

en: And Moses took of the anointing oil , and of the blood which was upon the altar , and sprinkled it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon his sons  garments with him  ; and sanctified Aaron , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
kha: U Moses u shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh bad khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha ka duwan bad u synreit ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ki bad ïa ki jaiñ jong ki sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ka umphniang pynsleh bad ia ka snam kaba la don halor ka almari bad u la theh ia ka ha u Aaron bad ha ki jain jong u bad ha ki jain jong u bad ha ki jain jong u; bad u Aaron bad ki jain jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pynkyntang ia u Aaron bad ki jain jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: Finally , brethren , whatsoever things are true , whatsoever things are honest , whatsoever things are just , whatsoever things are pure , whatsoever things are lovely , whatsoever things are of good report ; if there be any virtue , and if there be any praise , think on these things .
kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong nga , to pyndap ïa ki jingmut jong phi da kito kiei kiei kiba bha bad kita kiba dei ïaroh : Kiei kiei kiba shisha , kiba donburom , kiba beit , kiba khuid , kiba itynnat , bad kiba donburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Khatduh eh, ko para bangeit, kaei kaei kaba shisha, kaei kaei kaba hok, kaei kaei kaba khuid, kaei kaei kaba khuid, kaei kaei kaei kaba khuid, kaei kaei kaei kaba sngewtynnad, kaei kaei kaei kaba bha ka khubor ; lada don kano kano ka jingbha, bad lada don kano kano ka jingiaroh, pyrkhat ia kine kiei kiei .

en: And the men did the work faithfully : and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah , the Levites , of the sons of Merari  ; and Zechariah and Meshullam , of the sons of the Kohathites , to set it forward  ; and other of the Levites , all that could skill of instruments of musick .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba trei ïa ka kam ki long kiba da sngur hok . La peit bniah halor jong ki da ki saw ngut ki Lebi : u Jahath bad u Obadaïah na ka kur Merari , bad u Sekharaïah bad u Meshullam na ka kur Kohath . ( Ki Lebi ki dei ki nongtem nongput batbit bha . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang ki la leh ia ka kam da ka jingshaniah: bad ki nongpeit jong ki ki long u Jahath bad u Obadaiah, ki Lebi, na ki khun shynrang jong u Meria ; bad u Sekharaiah bad u Meshullam, na ki khun shynrang jong ki Kohathi, ban buh ia ka shuwa; bad kiwei kiwei ki Lebi, baroh kiba lah ban leh ia ki tiar ialehkai .

en: And it shall come to pass , that when they make a long blast with the ram s horn , and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet , all the people shall shout with a great shout  ; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat , and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him .
kha: Nangta ki dei ban pynsawa ïa kawei ka sur kaba jlan . Tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa kata , ki briew baroh ki dei ban risa jam , bad ki kynroh jong ka nongbah kin khyllem . Nangta ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei kan leit beit beit shapoh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba haba ki pynlong ia ka jingsawa kaba jrong bad ka turoi langbrot bad haba phi iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ka turoi , ki briew baroh kin pyrta da ka jingsawa kaba khraw; bad ka kynroh jong ka nongbah kan hap noh beit , bad ki briew kin kiew beit beit ha khmat jong u .

en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you , nor persuade you on this manner , neither yet believe him : for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand , and out of the hand of my fathers : how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand ?
kha: Mynta wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi lane ïalam bakla ïa phi kumta . Wat ngeit ïa u ! Ym don blei jong kano kano ka hima uba la lah ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na uno uno u patsha ka Assyria . Kumta da kaba thikna une U Blei jong phi un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ba u Hesekaiah un shukor ia phi, ne un pynsngewthuh ia phi ha kane ka rukom: namar ym don u blei jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ne ka hima uba lah ban pyllait ia ki briew jong u na ka kti jong nga bad na ka kti jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga: katno u Blei jong phi un pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong nga ?

en: And Moses said unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons , Uncover not your heads , neither rend your clothes  ; lest ye die , and lest wrath come upon all the people : but let your brethren , the whole house of Israel , bewail the burning which the  Lord  hath kindled .
kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , ki khun shynrang jong u ,  Wat ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñ ban pyn-i ba phi ïam sngewsih , lada phi leh kumta phin ïap , bad U  Trai  un bitar ïa u paidlang baroh . Hynrei ïa baroh ki para jait Israel jong phi la shah ba kin ïa-ïam briew na ka bynta kane ka jingïap ba la wallam da ka ding kaba U  Trai  u la phah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron bad ha u Eleasar bad u Isaramar jong u, wat nym tap ia ki khlieh jong phi, lymne wat pynkhih ia ki jain jong phi, ioh ba phin iap, bad ioh ba ka jingbitar kan wan ha ki briew baroh: hynrei to ai ba ki hynmen jong phi, ka iing Israel baroh kawei, kin iam ia ka jingthang kaba U Trai u la pynkhih .

en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah , and had taken Beth–shemesh , and Aijalon , and Gederoth , and Soco with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof : and they dwelt there .
kha: Ha kane kajuh ka por ki Philistia ruh ki hiarthma ïa ki shnong kiba ha ki kjat lum kiba shaphang sepngi bad ïa ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ki la ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shemesh , ka Aijalon , bad ïa ka Gederoth , bad ruh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Soko , ka Timnah , bad ka Gimso lem bad ki nongrit jong ki , bad ki shongduh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ruh ki la hiar thma ia ki shnong kiba rit bad kiba shaphang shathie jong ka Judah, bad ki la shim ia ka Bethshesh, bad u Aijalon bad u Soco bad ki shnong jong ka, bad ka Timnah bad ki shnong jong ka, u Gimzo ruh bad ki shnong jong ka: bad ki la shong hangta .

en: And they took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof , and all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining , according to all that he had done to Eglon  ; but destroyed it utterly , and all the souls that were therein .
kha: Ki la pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka bad ïa uwei pa uwei baroh ha ka nongbah bad ha ki shnong kiba markhap . U Joshua u pynjot thiaw ïa kata ka nongbah , kumba u la leh ïa ka Eglon . Ym shym don uwei ruh hangta uba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka, bad ki la pynkhih ia ka da ka tduh jong ka waitlam, bad u syiem jong ka, bad ki shnong jong ka baroh, bad ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta; um shym la iehnoh ia ka, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha u Eglon; hynrei u la pynjot lut ia ka, bad ia ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta .

en: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel , and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .
kha: Namar kane , ngan pynhap ïa ka jingjynjar ha ka longïing syiem jong me bad ngan pynïap ïa ki khun ki ksiew shynrang baroh , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh . Ngan pynduh khoit ïa ka longïing jong me ; kumba sar lut ïa ka jakhlia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha ka iing u Jeroboan, bad ngan ot noh na u Jeroboan uba la shah khang bad uba la shah khang ha Israel , bad ngan weng noh ia kaba sah jong ka iing u Jeroboan, kumba u briew u shim noh ia ka sboh , haduh ba kan da jah noh baroh .

en: And David came to the two hundred men , which were so faint that they could not follow David , whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor : and they went forth to meet David , and to meet the people that were with him : and when David came near to the people , he saluted them .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u leit phai sha kita ki arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba la thait eh ban leit ryngkat bad u bad kiba la sah shadien hangta ha ka wahduid Besor . Kita ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u Dabid bad ki briew jong u , bad u Dabid u leit sha ki bad u khublei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan sha ki arspah ngut ki briew kiba la lyngngoh haduh katta katta ba kim lah ban bud ia u Dabid, kiba ki la pynlong ruh ban sah ha ka wah Besor: bad ki la leit sha khmat u Dabid bad ban iakynduh ia ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u: bad haba u Dabid u la wan hajan ki briew: bad haba u Dabid u la ia khublei ia ki .

en: Now as they were making their hearts merry , behold , the men of the city , certain sons of Belial , beset the house round about , and beat at the door , and spake to the master of the house , the old man , saying , Bring forth the man that came into thine house , that we may know him .
kha: Katba ki dang pynsngewbha ïa lade kumta , kynsan kynsan la don ki riewthala na kata ka shnong ki kerkut ïa kata ka ïing , ki da tied tyngeh ïa ka jingkhang . Ki ong ha uta u tymmen ,  Sei shabar ïa uto u briew uba rung ha ïing jong phi ! Ngin ïathiah shongkha bad u !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba ki dang pynkmen ia ki dohnud jong ki, ha khmih, ki briew jong ka shnong, ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ka iing sawdong, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u trai iing, u tymmen, ki da kren ia u rangbah, ki da ong: To wanrah ia uta u briew uba la wan shapoh iing jong me, ba ngin ithuh ia u .

en: And the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and the spirit of all the remnant of the people  ; and they came and did work in the house of the  Lord  of hosts , their God ,
kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhih mynsiem ïa uwei pa uwei ban trei ha ka Templ : U Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah ; u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw . Ki la sdang ban trei ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhih ia ka mynsiem jong u Serubabel u khun jong u Shealtiel, u Lat ka Judah, bad ka mynsiem jong u Joshua u khun u Jehozadak, u rangbah lyngdoh bad ka mynsiem jong ki briew baroh kiba sah ha ka met bad ki la wan bad ki la trei ha ka iing U Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki .

en: And there went forth a wind from the  Lord  , and brought quails from the sea , and let them fall by the camp , as it were a day s journey on this side , and as it were a day s journey on the other side , round about the camp , and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth .
kha: Kyndit kyndit U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer kaba wan kit ïa ki  iar khiar na duriaw , kiba her kumba shi mitar na sla khyndew . Kine ki dem ha ka jaka sher dara bad baroh sawdong jong ka da bun bun kilomitar kat shaba phai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka Iyer na U Trai, bad ka la wanrah ia ki khnai na duriaw, bad ki la hap hajan ka jaka sah, kumba ka long ka jingleit sngi ha kawei pat ka liang, sawdong ka jaka sah, bad kumba ka long ar cubit ka jingjrong ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew .

en: There be the princes of the north , all of them , and all the Zidonians , which are gone down with the slain  ; with their terror they are ashamed of their might  ; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword , and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit .
kha: Ki khun syiem baroh na shaphang shatei ki don hangta , bad kumta ruh ki nong Sidon . Ka bor jong ki shisien ka pynphriang ïa ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei mynta ki leit hiar ha ka jingjahburom bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma bad ki la thiah ha ka jingjahthait , khlem otsher . Ki ïoh bynta ïa ka jingjahburom bad kito kiba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki syiem jong ka ri Sepngi baroh, bad ki Sidonian baroh, kiba la leit hiar bad kiba la shah pyniap; ki sngewlehrain ia ka bor jong ki; bad ki thiah khlem da ot bad ki kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam, bad ki kit ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki bad ki kiba leit hiar shapoh ka thliew .

en: And the king stood in his place , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments , and his testimonies , and his statutes , with all his heart , and with all his soul , to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book .
kha: U ïeng hajan ka jaka ïeng ki syiem bad u pynlong ka jutang bad U  Trai  ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u da la ka dohnud bad mynsiem baroh , bad ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingdawa ba ïasoh bad ka jutang , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ieng ha ka jaka jong u, bad u la leh ia ka jutang ha khmat U Trai, ban iaid hadien U Trai, bad ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u, bad ki jingphla jong u, bad ki ain jong u baroh, da ka dohnud jong u baroh, bad da ka mynsiem jong u baroh, ban pyndep ia ki ktien jong ka jutang kiba la thoh ha kane ka kot .

en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and spake to all the people of Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Zion shall be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .
kha: Mynba u Hesekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Mikah u nongïathuhlypa na Moresheth u la bthah ïa baroh ki briew ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong ,   ‘ Ïa ka Seïon yn lur kum ka lyngkha , ka Jerusalem kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra , bad u lum ka Templ un kylla khlaw .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Micah u Morasthite u la iathuhlypa ha ki sngi u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah, bad u la kren ha ki briew baroh kawei, u da ong: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid beg u Seion un sa rep kum ka lyngkha, bad ka Jerusalem kan kylla long ki lum jong ka iing kum ki jaka ba jrong jong ka khlaw .

en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites  ; and it shall be a desolate heap , and her daughters shall be burned with fire : then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei ka por ka poi haba ngan pynlong ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah Rabbah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ka thma , bad yn ieh ïa ka ha ka jingjot bad ïa ki nongrit jong ka ban thang haduh khyndew . Nangta ki Israel kin shim pat ïa la ka jaka na kito kiba la shim ïa ka na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba ngan pynmih ia ka jingsawa thma ha Rabbah jong ki Ammonite ; bad kan long ka kynhun kaba la jot , bad ki khun kynthei jong ka kin shah thang da ka ding: nangta ki Israel kin long ki nongioh pateng ia ki kiba long ki nongioh pateng jong u , ong U Trai .

en: Therefore it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it , that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven  ; thou shalt not forget it .
kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri bad u la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh kiba shong sawdong jong phi , pynïap lut ïa ki Amalek baroh , khnang ban ym don shuh uba kynmaw ïa ki . Wat klet ïa kane !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kan long, haba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ai jingjahthait ia me na ki nongshun jong me baroh sawdong, ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ia me ia ka pateng ban ioh ia ka, ba me dei ban pynduh noh ia ka jingkynmaw ia u Amalek na shapoh bneng; me dei ban klet ia ka .

en: Now it came to pass , when Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai , and had utterly destroyed it  ; as he had done to Jericho and her king , so he had done to Ai and her king  ; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel , and were among them  ;
kha: U Adonisedek , u syiem ka Jerusalem , u ïohsngew ba u Joshua u la kurup bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka Ai bad u la pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka , kumba u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa u syiem jong ka . U ïohsngew ruh ba ki nong Gibeon ki la ïasuk bad ki Israel bad ba ki shong hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia, haba u Adonizedek u syiem Jerusalem u la iohsngew kumno u Joshua u la shim ia ka Ai, bad u la pynjot lut ia ka; kumba u la leh ia u Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka, kumta u la leh ia u Ai bad u syiem jong ka; bad kumno ki nongshong shnong jong ka Gibeon ki la iasuk bad ki Israel, bad ki la long hapdeng jong ki;

en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army , and will drive him into a land barren and desolate , with his face toward the east sea , and his hinder part toward the utmost sea , and his stink shall come up , and his ill savour shall come up , because he hath done great things .
kha: Ngan weng ïa ka kynhun ki puit kaba la wan na shaphang shatei bad ngan pynphai katto katne na ki sha ka ri shyiap . Kito kiba don ha ki bynta ba ha khmat kin shah beh sha ka Duriaw Baïap , kito kiba don ha ka bynta ba hadien sha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ki metïap jong ki kin iwtung . Ngan pynjot ïa ki namar baroh kaba ki la leh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan weng noh na phi ia ka kynhun shipai kaba shaphang shathie, bad ngan beh noh ia u sha ka ri kaba khlem sboh bad kaba la jot , bad ka khmat jong u sha ka duriaw mihngi , bad ka jingkhang jong u kan kiew sha jrong tam , bad ka jingsniew jong u kan kiew sha jrong , namar u la leh ia kiei kiei kiba khraw .

en: And they said unto him , Behold now , there be with thy servants fifty strong men  ; let them go , we pray thee , and seek thy master : lest peradventure the Spirit of the  Lord  hath taken him up , and cast him upon some mountain , or into some valley . And he said , Ye shall not send .
kha: bad ki ong ,  Don sanphew ngut na ngi hangne , baroh ki rangbah bakhlaiñ . Ïa ngin leit bad wad ïa u kynrad jong phi . Lehse U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la rah noh ïa u bad iehnoh ïa u halor uno re uno u lumbah lane ha kano re kano ka them .   Em , phim dei ban leit ,  u Elisha u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Ha khmih mynta, don bad ki shakri jong me sanphew ngut ki briew kiba khlain bor, ngi kyrpad ia me bad ngi wad ia u kynrad jong me: ioh ba u Mynsiem U Trai un shim ia u, bad un bret ia u ha u lum ne ha kawei ka them . Bad u la ong: Phin ym phah .

en: Then said I , What come these to do ? And he spake , saying , These are the horns which have scattered Judah , so that no man did lift up his head : but these are come to fray them , to cast out the horns of the Gentiles , which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it .
kha: Nga la kylli ,  Kine ki rangbah ki la ïawan ban leh aïu ?  U la jubab ,  Ki la ïawan ban pyntriem bad pynkyllon ïa ki hima kiba la pynlwet khoit ïa ka ri Judah bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong: Kaei kaba kine ki wan ban leh ? Bad u la kren, u la ong, Kine ki long ki bniat kiba la pynphriang ia ka Judah: hynrei kine ki wan ban pynpra ia ki, ban bret noh ia ki bniat jong ki Jutang kiba la pynkiew ia ka bniat jong ki halor ka ri Judah ban pynphriang ia ka .

en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them , to shew it unto Esther , and to declare it unto her , and to charge her that she should go in unto the king , to make supplication unto him , and to make request before him for her people .
kha: U ai ha u Hathakh ïa ka kopi jong ka jingpynbna kaba u la pynmih ha Susa , kaba hukum ïa ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw . U Mordekai u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ka sha ka Esther , ban batai ha ka ïa kaei kaba long , bad ban ong ïa ka ban ïasaid bad u syiem bad kyrpad ïa u ban don jingisynei ïa ki briew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la ai ia u ia ka kopi jong ka jingthoh kaba la ai ha u Shushan ban pynjot ia ki, ban pyni ia ka ha ka Esther bad ban pynbna ia ka ha ka , bad ban kynnoh ia ka ba ka dei ban leit sha u syiem , ban kyrpad ia u bad ban kyrpad ha khmat jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong ka .

en: Let us pass , I pray thee , through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .
kha: Sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lynti na ka hima jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri jong ngi , ngin ym sakma na ka lynti ïaid lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi , bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri jong phi . Ngin ïaid na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da ïaid lait na ka hima jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin iaid lyngba ka ri jong me: ngin ym iaid lyngba ki lyngkha ne lyngba ki kper sohjew: ngin ym iaid da ka lynti kaba jrong jong u syiem: ngin ym phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering  ; he shall put no oil upon it , neither shall he put any frankincense thereon : for it is a sin offering .
kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wanrah ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur , un wallam shi kilo u  purew kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Um dei ban theh kano kano ka umphniang Olib ne kano kano ka jingiwbih halor jong u , namar ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ym ka jingkñia bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada um lah ban wanrah ar tylli ki turtle ne ar tylli ki sniang rit , uta uba la leh pop un wanrah ia ka jingknia jong u ia ka shiphew na ka shini kaba bha na ka bynta ka jingknia pop; un ym buh umphniang ei ei halor kata: namar ka long ka jingknia pop .

en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the  Lord  , choose you this day whom ye will serve  ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but as for me and my house , we will serve the  Lord .
kha: Te lada phim mon ban shakri ïa u , jied ha kane hi ka sngi ïano phin shakri , ïa ki blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la mane ha Mesopotamia , ne ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , kiba ha ka ri jong ki phi shong phi sah mynta . Hynrei ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka long kaba sniew ha phi ban shakri ia U Trai, to jied ia phi ha kane ka sngi ia uba phin shakri la ki blei kiba ki kpa jong phi ki la shakri kiba la don sha shiliang ka jingshlei um, ne ki blei jong ki Amorites ha kiba phi shong: hynrei ia nga bad ka iing jong nga ngin shakri ia U Trai .

en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light , and the sweet incense , and the daily meat offering , and the anointing oil , and the oversight of all the tabernacle , and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary , and in the vessels thereof .
kha: bad u Moses u la leh kumta kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka kam jong u Eleasar u khun u Aaron u lyngdoh u don ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai, bad ka jingiwbih kaba thiang, bad ka jingainguh bam kaba man ka sngi, bad ka umphniang kaba pynsleh ia ka iingjain baroh .

en: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots , and a noise of horses , even the noise of a great host : and they said one to another , Lo , the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites , and the kings of the Egyptians , to come upon us .
kha: U Trai u la pynlong ïa ki Syria ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingwan jong ki shipai babun , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad ki Syria ki la pyrkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la khot nong ïa ki syiem Hit bad Ijipt bad ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban wan tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Trai u la pynlong ia ka kynhun ki nong Syria ban iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ki kali kit mar, bad ka jingsawa jong ki kulai: bad ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: Lo , u syiem Israel u la thung ia ki syiem ki Hit bad ki syiem ki nong Ijipt ban wan hiar thma ia ngi .

en: Neither said they , Where is the  Lord  that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , that led us through the wilderness , through a land of deserts and of pits , through a land of drought , and of the shadow of death , through a land that no man passed through , and where no man dwelt ?
kha: Kim shym salia ïa nga , wat haba nga la pyllait ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalam ïa ki lyngba ka ri khlaw : Ka jaka ki ri shyiap bad ki thliew shyiap , ka ri kaba tyrkhong bad kaba ma ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong basah bad ba ym don mano mano wat ban ïaid lyngba .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la ong ruh: Hangno U Trai uba la pynmih ia ngi na ka ri Ijipt, uba la ialam ia ngi lyngba ka ri khlaw bad ki thliew , lyngba ka ri jong ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , lyngba ka ri kaba ym don briew uba iaid lyngba bad ha kaba ym don briew uba shong ?

en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them : therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem , and took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and dwelt therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their father .
kha: Haba ki paidbah na ka jait Dan ki la duh noh ïa la ka jaka , ki la leit sha Laish bad tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ki jop ïa ka , ki pynïap ïa ki briew hangta , bad ki kam kynti ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki shong ki sah hangta bad ki pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah na ka Laish sha ka Dan , da kaba kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u Dan u kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw jong ki khun u Dan ka la mih tang khyndiat eh na ka bynta jong ki: namarkata ki khun u Dan ki la leit sha ka jaka ialeh pyrshah ia u Lechem, bad ki la shim ia ka da ka waitlam, bad ki la bat ia ka, bad ki la shong ha ka, bad ki la khot ia u Lehem, u Dan, hadien ka kyrteng u Dan jong ki .

en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold , and for their lamps of gold , by weight for every candlestick , and for the lamps thereof : and for the candlesticks of silver by weight , both for the candlestick , and also for the lamps thereof , according to the use of every candlestick .
kha: na ka bynta kawei kawei ka sharak bad uwei uwei u diengpynïeng sharak ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ka jingkhia na ka bynta ki sharak ksiar, bad na ka bynta ki sharak ksiar jong ki, kat kum ka jingkhia jong kawei pa kawei ka sharak: bad na ka bynta ki sharak rupa da ka jingkhia, baroh ar na ka bynta ka sharak ksiar, bad ruh na ka bynta ki sharak jong ka, kat kum ka jingpyndonkam ia kawei pa kawei ka sharak .

en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine  ; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king , Will he force the queen also before me in the house ? As the word went out of the king s mouth , they covered Haman s face .
kha: U la dem ïa lade ha ka jaka shong shaniah jong ka Esther ban kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingisynei . Haba u syiem u wan phai pat shapoh kamra na ki kper , haba u ïohi ïa kane , u syiem u pyrta jam ,  Hato une u briew un leh be-ijot ïa ka mahadei hangne hi ha khmat jong nga , ha ka ïingsyiem jong nga ?  U syiem um pat kut bha ka jingkren , ba ki ïunukh ki tap ïa ka khlieh u Haman .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la mih na ka kper jong ka iing syiem sha ka jaka jong ka jingkhawai wain bad u Haman u la hap ha ka jingthiah ha kaba u Esther u la don . Nangta u la ong u syiem , Hato un pynbor ia ka mahadei ruh ha khmat jong nga ha iing ? Katba ka ktien ka la mih na ka shyntur jong u syiem .

en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it : and as he was destroying , the  Lord  beheld , and he repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed , It is enough , stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
kha: Nangta u phah ïa u angel ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem ; hynrei u kylla ïa kaba u mut bad u ong ha u angel ,  Keiñ noh ! Katto ka la biang !  U angel u ïeng hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la phah ia u angel sha Jerusalem ban pynjot ia ka: bad katba u dang pynjot ia ka: bad u la iohi ia u, bad u la kylla bamut ia u na kaba sniew, bad u la ong ha u angel uba la pynjot: Ka la biang mynta, to sah noh ha ka kti jong me . Bad u angel U Trai u la ieng hajan ka jingthang jong u Ornan u Jebus .

en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel , What have I to do with thee ? get thee to the prophets of thy father , and to the prophets of thy mother . And the king of Israel said unto him , Nay : for the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab .
kha: Balei ngan ïarap ïa phi ?  u Elisha u ong ïa u syiem ka Israel .  Khie leit bad kylli na kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba u kpa bad ka kmie jong me ki la kylli .   Em !  u Joram u jubab .  U dei U  Trai  uba la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem ka Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la ong ha u syiem Israel, Nga don jingiadei bad me? to poi sha ki nongiathuhlypa jong u kpa jong me bad sha ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka kmie jong me . Bad u syiem Israel u la ong ha u: Em: namar U Trai u la khot ia kine ki lai ngut ki syiem lang, ban aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong u Moab .

en: And Jehiel , and Azaziah , and Nahath , and Asahel , and Jerimoth , and Jozabad , and Eliel , and Ismachiah , and Mahath , and Benaiah , were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother , at the commandment of Hezekiah the king , and Azariah the ruler of the house of God .
kha: Shiphew ngut ki Lebi ki shimti ban trei hapoh jong ki : u Jehiel , Asasaïah , Nahath , Asahel , Jerimoth , Josabad , Eliel , Ismakhaïah , Mahath , bad u Benaïah . La leh ïa kane baroh hapoh ka bor jong u syiem Hesekaïah bad u Asaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehiel, bad u Ahasaiah, bad u Ahasaiah, bad u Jeriramot, bad u Elel, bad u Ismahiah, bad u Mahat, bad u Benaiah, ki long ki nongpeit hapoh ka kti u Koniah bad u Shimei u hynmen jong u, ha ka hukum jong u Hesekaiah u syiem bad u Asariaiah u nongsynshar jong ka iing U Blei .

en: And he took the captains of hundreds , and the nobles , and the governors of the people , and all the people of the land , and brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  : and they came through the high gate into the king s house , and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom .
kha: Ki rangbah shipai , ki riewpawkhmat , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki briew baroh , ki ïadon lang bad u Jehoïada ha jingïa-ïaid paidbah kaba wan ïalam ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ka ïingsyiem . Ki rung na ka khyrdop bah , bad u syiem u shong halor ka khet .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki rangbah jong ki spah ngut ki rangbah bad ki nongsynshar jong ki briew bad ki briew baroh: bad ki la wan lyngba ka khyrdop kaba jrong sha ka iing syiem .

en: And David said to Solomon his son , Be strong and of good courage , and do it : fear not , nor be dismayed : for the  Lord  God , even my God , will be with thee  ; he will not fail thee , nor forsake thee , until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the  Lord .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ha u Solomon u khun jong u ,  To long uba sngewskhem bad uba kut jingmut . Sdang ïa ka kam bad wat ai kano kano ruh kan pynsangeh ïa me . U  Trai  U Blei , uba nga shakri un don bad me . Un ym iehnoh ïa me , hynrei un don ryngkat bad me tad haduh ba men pyndep ïa ka kam kaba dei ban trei ha ka Templ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Solomon u khun jong u, To long uba skhem bad uba shlur bha, bad to leh ia kata: wat tieng, lymne wat sngewsih: namar U Trai Blei, wat U Blei jong nga ruh, un ym don bad me; un ym pynduh ia me, lymne un ym iehnoh ia me, haduh ba me da pyndep ia ka kam baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong U Trai .

en: And he will love thee , and bless thee , and multiply thee : he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
kha: Un ieit bad kyrkhu ïa phi , ba phin nang roi kyrhai . Un kyrkhu ruh ba phin ïoh shibun ki khun ki kti ; un kyrkhu ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ba phin ïoh u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ; bad un kyrkhu ruh ïa phi da kaba ai ha phi shibun ki masi bad ki langbrot , ha kata ka ri ïa kaba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ieit ia me, bad un kyrkhu ia me, bad un kyrkhu ia me: un kyrkhu ruh ia u soh jong ka kpoh jong me, bad ia u soh jong me, bad ka wain jong me, bad ka umphniang jong me, bad ki kynhun langbrot jong me, ha ka ri kaba u la sngap jar ia ki kpa tymmen jong me ban ai ia me .

en: O Lord , according to all thy righteousness , I beseech thee , let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem , thy holy mountain : because for our sins , and for the iniquities of our fathers , Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us .
kha: Me la ïada ïa ngi ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta te to wat bitar shuh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka long ka nongbah jong me , u lum bakyntang jong me . Baroh ki briew ha ki ri ba-marjan ki khmih beiñ ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong me namar ki pop jong ngi bad ka jingbymman ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, kat kum ka hok jong me baroh, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba ka jingbitar jong me bad ka jingbitar jong me kan kylla noh na ka nongbah Jerusalem jong me: namar ki pop jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki jingbymhok jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong me ki kylla long ka jingkren bein ia ngi baroh .

en: If it please the king , let there go a royal commandment from him , and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes , that it be not altered , That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus  ; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she .
kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa u Syiem , pynmih ka jingpynbna syiem ba ka Bashti kan ym lah shuh ban wan ha khmat u syiem . Hukum ban thoh ïa kata ha ki aiñ jong ka Persia bad Media , khnang ba kata kan ym kylla shuh . Nangta ai ïa ka jaka jong ka kum ka mahadei sha kano kano ka kynthei kaba kham bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka long kaba sngewbha ia u syiem , to ai ba kan leit noh ha ka hukum syiem na u , bad to ai ba kan thoh hapdeng ki ain jong ki Persia bad ki Media , ba kan ym kylla , Ba ka Vashti kan ym wan shuh ha khmat u syiem Ahasueros; bad to ai ba u syiem un ai ia ka jaka syiem jong ka ha uwei pat uba kham bha ban ia ka .

en: And , behold , thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite of Bahurim , which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim : but he came down to meet me at Jordan , and I sware to him by the  Lord  , saying , I will not put thee to death with the sword .
kha: Don ruh u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , na ka shnong Bahurim kaba ha Benjamin . U la tim tyngeh ïa nga ha ka sngi kaba nga leit sha Mahanaim , hynrei haba u la ïakynduh ïa nga ha ka wah Jordan , nga la ai ha u ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ba ngan ym shah ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, me don bad me u khun jong u Gera, u Benjaminite jong u Bahurim, uba la tim ia nga da ka jingtim kaba jur ha ka sngi ba nga leit sha Mahanaim: hynrei u la wan hiar ban iakynduh ia nga ha Jordan , bad nga la smai ha u da U Trai, da kaba ong, ngan ym pyniap ia me da ka waitlam .

en: Take the rod , and gather thou the assembly together , thou , and Aaron thy brother , and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes  ; and it shall give forth his water , and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock : so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink .
kha: Shim ïa u diengduh uba don ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad nangta ma me bad u Aaron men lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh . Hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh kren ha utai u mawsiang , bad ka um kan mihnoh na u . Ha kane ka rukom men pynmih um na uta u mawsiang na ka bynta jong u paidbah , khnang ba ma ki lem bad ki jingri jong ki kin ïoh dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia u diengduh bad to lum lang ia ka jingiaseng, ma me bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me, bad to kren ha u maw ha khmat ki khmat jong ki ; bad kan pynmih ia ka um jong u, bad men pynmih ia ki um na u maw: kumta men ai ia ka jingiaseng bad ki mrad jong ki ban dih .

en: And the people said unto Saul , Shall Jonathan die , who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel ? God forbid : as the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground  ; for he hath wrought with God this day . So the people rescued Jonathan , that he died not .
kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki ong ha u Saul ,  Hato u Jonathan , uba la jop ka jingjop kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel , un shah pynïap ? Em ! Ngi kular ha U  Trai  uba im ba uwei u shñiuh na ka khlieh jong u ruh un ym hap ha khyndew . Kaei kaba u la leh ha kane ka sngi la leh da ka jingïarap jong U Blei .  Kumta ki paidbah ki la pyllait im ïa u Jonathan na kaba shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ong ha u Saul, Hato u Jonathan un iap, uba la leh ia kane ka jingpynim kaba khraw ha Israel ? U Blei u la khang: kumba U Trai u im, ym don uwei ruh u shniuh khlieh jong u uba hap ha khyndew namar u la leh bad U Blei ha kane ka sngi . Kumta ki briew ki la pyllait im ia u Jonathan, ba um shym la iap .

en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom : also he observed times , and used enchantments , and used witchcraft , and dealt with a familiar spirit , and with wizards : he wrought much evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
kha: U kñia ïa la ki khun shynrang ha ka Them Hinnom kum ki jingainguh thang . U leh ïa ki jingkhan bad ki jingleh myntor bad u wad jingmut na ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongleh byrtong . U leh pop palat pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ki khun jong u ban iaid lyngba ka ding ha ka them jong u khun Hinnom: ruh u la iohi ia ki por , bad u la pyndonkam ia ki jingleh jadu , bad u la leh ia ka mynsiem kaba la tip bha: u la leh ia kaba sniew shibun ha khmat U Trai , ban pynkhih ia u ban bitar .

en: And as Josiah turned himself , he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount , and sent , and took the bones out of the sepulchres , and burned them upon the altar , and polluted it , according to the word of the  Lord  which the man of God proclaimed , who proclaimed these words .
kha: Nangta u Josaïah u peit baroh sawdong , bad ïohi katto katne ki jingtep hangta halor lum ; u sei shabar ïa ki shyieng na ki bad u thang ha ka duwan . Ha kane ka rukom u ñiewsang ïa ka duwan , u leh ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la ïathuh lypa mynshuwa eh ha ka por ka jinglehniam katba u syiem Jeroboam u dang ïeng hajan ka duwan . U syiem Josaïah u peit sawdong bad ïohi ïa ka jingtep jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïathuhlypa ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: U Josiah u la phai noh ia lade, u la leit jngoh ia ki jingtep kiba don hangta ha u lum, bad u la phah, bad u la shim ia ki shyieng na ki jingtep, bad u la thang ia ki ha ka jaka tep bad u la pynjakhlia ia ka kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u briew U Blei u la pynbna .

en: The  Lord  God of heaven , which took me from my father s house , and from the land of my kindred , and which spake unto me , and that sware unto me , saying , Unto thy seed will I give this land  ; he shall send his angel before thee , and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence .
kha: U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng , u la ïalam noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga bad na ka ri ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad u la kular skhem ha nga ba un ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Un phah ïa u angel jong u ha shuwa jong me , ba me lah ban pynïoh hangta ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei jong ka bneng uba la shim ia nga na ka iing u kpa jong nga, bad na ka ri jong nga, bad uba la kren ha nga, bad uba la smai ha nga, da kaba ong: Ha u symbai jong me ngan ai ia kane ka ri; un phah ia u angel jong u ha khmat jong me, bad me dei ban shim ia ka tnga ha u khun jong nga naduh kata ka por .

en: Therefore I make a decree , That every people , nation , and language , which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , shall be cut in pieces , and their houses shall be made a dunghill : because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort .
kha: Te mynta nga hukum ba lada uno uno na kano kano ka hima , ka jaitbynriew , lane ka ktien uba kren khlem burom ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , dei ban tar ïa u na ka kti bad kjat , bad ïa ka ïing jong u dei ban pynlong ka kynton ki jingpra . Ym don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im kumne .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga pynlong ia ka hukum , Ba uwei pa uwei u briew, u jaitbynriew bad ka ktien, uba kren ia kaei kaei kaba bakla pyrshah ia U Blei jong u Shadrak , u Meshah bad u Abednego , yn ot noh ia ki ha ki bynta ba la ot: namar ym don uwei pat u Blei uba lah ban pynpoi hadien kane ka jait .

en: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide : and as soon as the sun was down , Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree , and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city , and raise thereon a great heap of stones , that remaineth unto this day .
kha: U la phasi ïa u syiem jong ka Ai ha uwei u dieng bad u ieh ïa ka met jong u hangta haduh janmiet . Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai hukum ban weng noh ïa kata ka metïap , bad la bret ïa ka ha ka jaka rung sha ka khyrdop ka nongbah . Ki la tap ïa ka da ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang sah hangta mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ai u la sahkut ha u dieng haduh ban da sdang: bad tang shu sep ka sngi , u Joshua u la hukum ba kin shim ia ka met jong u na u dieng bad kin bret ia ka ha ka jingkhang jong ka shnong bad kin pynkiew ia ka ha ka jingkhang jong ka shnong .

en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit , and the earth shall yield her increase , and they shall be safe in their land , and shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have broken the bands of their yoke , and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them .
kha: Ki dieng kin sei ïa u soh , ki lyngkha kin pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad uwei pa uwei un shongshngain ha la ka ri . Ynda haba nga dkhat ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa ki briew jong nga bad nga pyllait ïa ki na kito kiba pynlong mraw ïa ki , te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u dieng jong ka lyngkha un ai ia u soh jong u, bad ka khyndew kan ai ia ka jingmih jong ka, bad kin sa shong shngain ha ka ri jong ki, bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai , haba nga la pynpra ia ki teh jong ka lyngkhot jong ki , bad nga la pyllait noh ia ki na ka kti jong kito kiba shakri ia ki .

en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead , and purifieth not himself , defileth the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel : because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him , he shall be unclean  ; his uncleanness is yet upon him .
kha: Kito kiba ktah ïa ka metïap bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki sah hi ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ki . Kita ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ jong U  Trai  , bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba ktah ia ka met iap jong uno uno u briew uba la iap bad u bym pynkhuid ia lade, u pynjakhlia ia ka iingjain U Trai ; bad ia kata ka mynsiem yn ot noh na Israel: namar ba ka um pyniakhlad kam shym la tuid halor jong u , un long u bymkhuid ; ka jingbymkhuid jong u ka dang don ha u .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Judah , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have despised the law of the  Lord  , and have not kept his commandments , and their lies caused them to err , after the which their fathers have walked :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Judah ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki jinghikai jong nga bad kim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ki la shah ïalam bakla da kijuh ki blei thala ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein jong u Judah, bad na ka bynta saw tylli, ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar ba ki la leh bein ia ka hukum U Trai , bad kim shym la bat ia ki hukum jong u , bad ki jinglamler jong ki ki ki la pynlong ia ki ban bakla , hadien kata kaba ki kpa jong ki ki la iaid:

en: And he brought forth the people that were therein , and put them under saws , and under harrows of iron , and under axes of iron , and made them pass through the brickkiln : and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon . So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem .
kha: bad u la pyntrei ïa ki briew jong ka ha ki kurat , ki mohkhiew , bad ki sdie nar , bad u la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ha kaba shna maw-it . U la leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei pat ki nongrit jong ka Ammon baroh . Nangta ma u lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ki briew kiba don hangta, bad u la buh ia ki hapoh ki nar, bad hapoh ki nar nar, bad hapoh ki nar nar, bad u la pynlong ia ki ban iaid lyngba ia ki nar: bad kumta u la leh ia ki ha ki shnong jong ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Ammon baroh . Kumta u Dabid bad ki briew baroh ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .

en: Therefore he said unto Judah , Let us build these cities , and make about them walls , and towers , gates , and bars , while the land is yet before us  ; because we have sought the  Lord  our God , we have sought him , and he hath given us rest on every side . So they built and prospered .
kha: U ong ïa ki paid Judah ,  To ngin pynskhem ïa ki nongbah da kaba tei ïa ki kynroh bad ki kut , bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang khyrdep . Ngi long trai ïa ka ri namar ba ngi la leh ïa ka mon U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U la ïada ïa ngi bad u la ai jingshngain na ki liang baroh .  Bad kumta ki tei bad ki manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ong ha Judah , To ngin tei ia kine ki shnong, bad ngin pynlong sawdong ia ki kynroh, bad ki khyrdop bad ki bar, katba ka ri ka dang don ha khmat jong ngi ; namar ngi la wad ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi, bad u la ai shongthait ia ngi na man la ki liang . Kumta ki la tei bad ki la roi .

en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , with all the remnant of the people , obeyed the voice of the  Lord  their God , and the words of Haggai the prophet , as the  Lord  their God had sent him , and the people did fear before the  Lord .
kha: Te u Serubbabel bad u Joshua bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia , ki la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la ong ïa ki ban leh . Ki la sheptieng bad ki la kohnguh ïa u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa , u nonglamktien jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Serubabel u khun u Shealtiel bad u Joshua u khun u Jehozadak, bad ki briew baroh ki la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai jong ki bad ki ktien U Haggai u nongiathuhlypa jong ki, kumba U Trai jong ki u la phah ia u, bad ki briew ki la tieng ha khmat U Trai .

en: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the  Lord   ; because he is good , for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel . And all the people shouted with a great shout , when they praised the  Lord  , because the foundation of the house of the  Lord  was laid .
kha: Ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , da kaba ïai rwai ïa ka banktien    :  U  Trai  u long uba bha , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ki Israel ka long bymjukut .  Baroh ki pyrta jam katba don ka bor , da kaba ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar ka jingtei ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ ka la sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rwai lang da kaba iaroh bad ainguh ia U Trai ; namar ba u long uba bha, namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom ha ki Israel . Bad ki briew baroh ki la pyrta da ka jingsawa kaba khraw haba ki la iaroh ia U Trai , namar ba la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And the priest said , The sword of Goliath the Philistine , whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah , behold , it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod : if thou wilt take that , take it : for there is no other save that here . And David said , There is none like that  ; give it me .
kha: U Ahimelekh u jubab ,  Nga don ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia ïa uba phi la pynïap ha ka Them Elah ; ka don ha lyndet ka ephod , kaba la sop da ka jaiñ . Lada phi kwah ïa ka , to shim — dei tang ma ka , ka atiar hangne .   Ai ïa ka ha nga ,  u Dabid u ong .  Ym don hangno hangno ka waitlam kaba kham bha !
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh u la ong: Ka waitlam jong u Philistia, kaba me la pynkhih ha ka them Elah: ha khmih, ka la tap hangne da ka jain hadien ka ephod: lada me shim ia kata: namar ym don kawei pat lait noh tang kata hangne . Bad u Dabid u la ong: Ym don kum kata ka; to ai ia nga .

en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .
kha: Hangne nga don . Lada nga la leh ïa kano kano kaba bakla , sakhi pyrshah ïa nga ha khmat U  Trai  bad ha khmat u syiem uba u la pynsleh . Hato nga la shim ïa ka masi ne ka kada jongno jongno ? Hato nga la shukor ne banbeiñ ïano ïano ? Hato nga la bamsap nano nano ? Lada nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei ngan pynphai noh ïa kata kaba nga la shim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, hangne nga don: sakhi pyrshah ia nga ha khmat U Trai, bad ha khmat jong u ba la pynsleh: uba nga la shim ia ka tdong jongno ? lane mano ba nga la shim ? mano ba nga la pynshitom ? lane na ka kti jongno nga la ioh ia ka pisa ban pynmatlah ia ki khmat jong nga da kata ? bad ngan pynphai biang ia ka .

en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .
kha: Kumta u Haman u ong ïa u syiem .  Ka don kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang kylleng sawdong ka hima jong phi bad ba lah ban shem ha kawei pa kawei ka probins   . Ki bud ïa ki dustur kiba ïapher na ki jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Nalor kata kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka hima , kumta kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban shah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Haman u la ong ha u syiem Ahasauerus, Don ki briew kiba la saphriang shabar ri bad kiba la saphriang hapdeng ki briew ha ki jylla baroh jong ka hima jong me; bad ki ain jong ki ki long kiba pher na ki briew baroh; namar kata kim ju bat ia ki ain syiem: namarkata kam dei na ka bynta u syiem ban shah shitom ia ki .

en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor , and so northward , looking toward Gilgal , that is before the going up to Adummim , which is on the south side of the river : and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh , and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel :
kha: na ka Them Jingjynjar artet sha Debir , bad nangta ka phai shatei sha Gilgal , kaba marpyrshah ka Khim Adummim ha ka phang bashathie jong ka them . Nangta ka ïaid sha ki umpohliew ka Enshemesh , ka mih sha Enrogel ;
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la kiew sha Debir na ka them Achor, bad kumta shaphang shathie, kaba don ha khmat ka jingleit sha Adummim kaba don shaphang shathie jong ka wah: bad u pud u sam u la iaid sha ki um jong ka Enshesh, bad ki jingleit shabar jong ka ki long ha Enrogel:

en: And they built the high places of Baal , which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom , to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech  ; which I commanded them not , neither came it into my mind , that they should do this abomination , to cause Judah to sin .
kha: Ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal ha ka Them Hinnom , ban kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki ha u blei Molekh . Ngam shym la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane , bad kam ju rung wat ha ka jingmut jong nga ba kin leh kum ïa kata kaei kaei bad pynlong ïa ki paid Judah ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tei ia ki jaka ba jrong jong u Baal, kiba don ha ka them u khun Hinnom, ban pynlong ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki ban iaid lyngba ka ding haduh Moech ; kaba ngam shym la hukum ia ki, bad kam shym la wan ha ka jingmut jong nga, ba kin leh ia kane ka kam kaba sngewsih, ban pynlong ia u Judah ban leh pop .

en: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you , saying , Behold , the vessels of the  Lord s  house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you .
kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa ki lyngdoh bad ïa ki paidbah ba U  Trai  u la lah ong :  Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ong ba ïa ki jingkynshew ka Templ yn sa wanrah pat shen shen na Babilonia . Ki shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga kren ha ki lyngdoh bad ha kine ki briew baroh, da kaba ong: Kumta u Trai u ong: Wat iathuh ia ki ktien jong ki nongiathuhlypa jong phi kiba iathuhlypa ha phi, da kaba ong: Ha khmih ia ki tiar jong ka iing U Trai mynta yn sa wanrah biang na Babilon: namar ki iathuhlypa ia phi .

en: If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .
kha: Kam long ka jingmyntoi ïa ngi ban leit shapoh ka nongbah namar ngin sa ïapthngan hangta , hynrei lada ngi shong hangne , ngin ïap kumjuh . Kumta , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , hynrei lehse kin pyllait im ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi ong , Ngin rung shapoh ka shnong , te ka jingkyrduh ka don ha ka shnong , bad ngin iap hangta : bad lada ngi sah hangne ruh ngin iap . Mynta to ngin hap ha ka kynhun ki nong Syria: lada ki pynim ia ngi; bad lada ki pyniap ia ngi, ngin sa iap noh .

en: And he said , Let me go , I pray thee  ; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city  ; and my brother , he hath commanded me to be there : and now , if I have found favour in thine eyes , let me get away , I pray thee , and see my brethren . Therefore he cometh not unto the king s table .
kha: ‘ Sngewbha , shah ba ngan leit ,’ u ong , ‘ namar ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi ki pynlong ka jingkhawai jingkñia ha shnong , bad u hynmen jong nga u la hukum ba nga dei ban don hangta . Te kumta , lada phi long u paralok jong nga , shah ba ngan leit jngoh ïa la ki kur ki jait .’ Dei namar kata ba um shym la don ha la ka jaka ha ka miej bam jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: To ngan leit noh, nga duwai ia me namar ba ka iing jong ngi ka don ka jingknia ha ka shnong bad u hynmen jong nga, u la hukum ia nga ban don hangta : bad mynta lada nga la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha ki khmat jong me, to ngan leit noh, nga duwai ia me, bad nga peit ia ki hynmen jong nga . Namarkata u wan sha ka miej syiem .

en: And it came to pass , when the king of Israel had read the letter , that he rent his clothes , and said , Am I God , to kill and to make alive , that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy ? wherefore consider , I pray you , and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me .
kha: Haba u syiem Israel u pule ïa ka shithi , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai bad u kyang jam ,  Kumno u syiem Syria u khmih lynti ïa nga ban pynkhiah ïa une u briew ? Hato u pyrkhat ba nga dei U Blei , lem bad ka bor jong ka jingim bad ka jingïap ? Ka shai kdar ba u pyrshang ban sdang ïakajia bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem Israel u la pule ia ka shithi, ba u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u la ong, Hato nga long U Blei, ban pyniap bad ban pynim, ba une u briew u phah sha nga ban pynkoit ia u briew uba pang sniehdoh jong u? namar kata to pyrkhat, nga kyrpad ia phi, bad peit kumno u wad ia ka jingialeh pyrshah ia nga .

en: And say unto the Ammonites , Hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou saidst , Aha , against my sanctuary , when it was profaned  ; and against the land of Israel , when it was desolate  ; and against the house of Judah , when they went into captivity  ;
kha: Ong ïa ki ba kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Phi la ïasngewtynnat ban ïohi ba ïa ka Templ jong nga la pyntngit , ban ïohi ïa ka ri Israel la pynjot thiaw , ban ïohi ïa ki paid ka Judah ba ki shah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki Ammon , To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai U Blei U Trai U Trai U Blei U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai

en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab s brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . And the king said unto the people , I will surely go forth with you myself also .
kha: Nangta u phah ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , ryngkat bad u Joab lem bad u Abishai , u para jong u Joab bad u Ittai uba na Gath , kiba long ki nongai hukum ha la ka kynhun kynhun . Bad u syiem u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Nga ruh da lade ngan leit lang bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah ia ka bynta kaba lai jong ki briew hapoh ka kti jong u Joab bad ka bynta kaba lai hapoh ka kti jong u Abisai u hynmen jong u Seruiah bad ka bynta kaba lai hapoh ka kti jong u Itai u nong Gadit . Bad u syiem u la ong ha ki briew , Ngan leit noh shisha bad phi ruh .

en: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the  Lord   ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king s matters : also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and the  Lord  shall be with the good .
