kha: U Amaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , un don ïa ka bor kaba hakhlieh tam ha baroh ki kam niam , bad u Sebadaïah u khun jong u Ishmael , u lat ka Judah , un don ïa ka bor bahakhlieh duh ha baroh ki kam hima sima . Ki Lebi kin kitkhlieh ban peit halor ki jingpyntreikam ïa ki jingrai jong ki ïingbishar . Long shlur bad pyndep ïa kine ki jingbthah , bad to U  Trai  un long ha ka liang jong kiba leh ïa kaba dei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u Amariah u rangbah lyngdoh u don halor jong phi ha ki kam baroh jong U Trai bad u Zebadaiah u khun jong u Ishmael, u nongsynshar jong ka iing Judah: kumjuh ruh ki Lebi kin long ki ophisar ha khmat jong phi . To leh shlur bad U Trai un long bad ka jingbha .

en: And Hazael said , Why weepeth my lord ? And he answered , Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel : their strong holds wilt thou set on fire , and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword , and wilt dash their children , and rip up their women with child .
kha: Balei kynrad phi ïam ?  u Hasael u kylli . U Elisha u jubab ,  Namar ba nga tip ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba men leh pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel .   Men sa wiang ding ïa ki kut jong ki , men sa pynïap ïa ki rangsamla bakynsai jong ki , men sa lynthaw ïa ki khun rit jong ki ha ban da ïap , bad men sa patar ïa ki kynthei jong ki kiba armet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hazael u la ong: Balei u kynrad jong nga u iam ? Bad u la jubab, Namar nga tip ia ka jingsniew kaba me leh ia ki khun Israel: ki jingbat ba skhem jong ki men thang ding, bad ki samla jong ki men pyniap da ka waitlam, bad men pyniap ia ki khun jong ki da u khun .

en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him , and said , Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the  Lord  , we have had enough to eat , and have left plenty : for the  Lord  hath blessed his people  ; and that which is left is this great store .
kha: bad u Asaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba hiarpateng na u Sadok , u ong ha u ,  Naduh ba ki briew ki sdang ban wanrah ïa ki jingai jong ki sha ka Templ , kaba la don , ka la biang ban bam bad kaba sah tam ka long kaba bun . Ngi don ïa kane baroh namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asariah u rangbah lyngdoh jong u Sadok u la jubab ia u bad u la ong: Naduh ba ki briew ki la sdang ban wanrah ia ki jingainguh sha ka iing U Trai , ngi la biang ban bam bad ngi la iehnoh shibun: namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ia ki briew jong u; bad kaba sah ka long kane ka dukan kaba khraw .

en: The diseased have ye not strengthened , neither have ye healed that which was sick , neither have ye bound up that which was broken , neither have ye brought again that which was driven away , neither have ye sought that which was lost  ; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them .
kha: Phim shym la sumar bha ïa kita kiba swai , pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , phim shym la sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba mynsaw , wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ne wad ïa kito kiba la jah noh . Pynban phi la lehbeiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongpang um shym la pynskhem ia kata kaba pang, lymne phim shym la teh ia kata kaba la tyrkhong, lymne phim shym la wanrah biang ia kata kaba la shah beh noh, lymne phim shym la wad ia kata kaba la jah ; hynrei da ka bor bad da ka jingleh bein phi la synshar ia ki .

en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God , and he shall go no more out : and I will write upon him the name of my God , and the name of the city of my God , which is new Jerusalem , which cometh down out of heaven from my God : and I will write upon him my new name .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa uta uba jop , u rijied ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong nga , bad un ïailong hangta . Ngan thoh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng U Blei jong nga bad ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah jong U Blei jong nga , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , ka ban wan hiar na bneng na U Blei jong nga . Ngan thoh ruh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng bathymmai jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba jop un pynlong ia u maw ha ka tempi U Blei jong nga: bad ngan thoh ha u ia ka kyrteng U Blei jong nga bad ia ka kyrteng jong ka shnong U Blei jong nga kaba thymmai kaba wan hiar na bneng na U Blei jong nga: bad ngan thoh ha u ia ka kyrteng thymmai jong nga .

en: Saying ,  I am Alpha and Omega , the first and the last : and , What thou seest , write in a book , and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia  ; unto Ephesus , and unto Smyrna , and unto Pergamos , and unto Thyatira , and unto Sardis , and unto Philadelphia , and unto Laodicea .
kha: Ka la ong ,  Thoh ïa kaei kaba me ïohi , bad phah ïa ka kitab sha ki balang ha kine ki hynñiew tylli ki nongbah : ka Ephesos , ka Smyrna , ka Pergamum , ka Thiatira , ka Sardis , ka Philadelphia , bad ka Laodikaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong, nga long u Alpha bad u Omega, uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh: bad, Kaei kaba me iohi, to thoh ha ka kot, bad phah ia ka sha ki hynriew tylli ki balang kiba don ha Asia; bad sha ka Smyrna, bad sha ka Pergamo, bad sha ka Thia, bad sha ka Sardis, bad sha ka Ladicesia .

en: The matter is not so : but a man of mount Ephraim , Sheba the son of Bichri by name , hath lifted up his hand against the king , even against David : deliver him only , and I will depart from the city . And the woman said unto Joab , Behold , his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall .
kha: Kata kam dei ka jingthmu jong ngi . U briew uba kyrteng u Sheba , u khun jong u Bikri , uba na ka ri lum Ephraim , u la sdang ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Dabid . Aiti ïa une u briew , bad ngan kynriah noh na ka nongbah .   Ngin bret ïa ka khlieh jong u sha phi nalor ka kynroh ,  ka ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mat kam long kumta: hynrei u briew uba shong ha ka kyrteng u la rah ia la ka kti pyrshah ia u syiem, wat pyrshah ia u Dabid: to pyllait noh tang ia u . Bad kata ka kynthei ka la ong ha u Joab: Ha khmih ka khlieh jong u kan sa shah bret ha me halor ka kynroh .

en: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him . Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him , If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews , before whom thou hast begun to fall , thou shalt not prevail against him , but shalt surely fall before him .
kha: U ong ha la ka tnga bad baroh ki paralok ïa kiei kiei baroh ba la jia ha u . Nangta ma ka bad kito ki paralok bastad jong u ki ong ha u ,  Phi la sdang ban duh bor ha u Mordekai . U dei u Jiw , bad phim lah ban jop ïa u . Da shisha un sa jop ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Haman u la iathuh ha u Seresh ia ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh kiba la jia ia u . Nangta u la ong ia ki riewstad jong u bad u Seresh jong u ha u, Lada u Mordecai u long na u symbai jong ki Jiw, ha khmat jong u uba me la sdang ban hap , men ym jop ia u , hynrei thikna ba men hap ha khmat jong u .

en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me , and slay me  ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .
kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Simeon bad ha u Lebi ,  Phi la pynjynjar ïa nga ; ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad kat kiba don ha kane ka ri , mynta kin sa shun ïa nga . Ngam dei uba bun paid ; lada ki ïa-tylli lang kawei pyrshah ïa nga , bad ki ïaleh ïa nga , ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga baroh ngin sa shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha u Simeon bad u Lebi, Phi la pynshitom ia nga ban pynlong ia nga ban sngap jar hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri, hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong nga: bad nga la nang duna ha ka jingbun briew, kin ia lum lang pyrshah ia nga; bad ngan sa shah pynjot noh, ma nga bad ka iing jong nga .

en: All things come alike to all : there is one event to the righteous , and to the wicked  ; to the good and to the clean , and to the unclean  ; to him that sacrificeth , and to him that sacrificeth not : as is the good , so is the sinner  ; and he that sweareth , as he that feareth an oath .
kha: Kam don kano kano ka jingpher . Kajuh ka kupar ka wan ha uba hok bad ha uba bymman , ha uba bha bad ha uba sniew , ha kito kiba riewblei bad ha kito ki bymriewblei , ha kito kiba ai ki jingkñia bad ha kito ki bym ai . U briew babha um da ïapher eh na u nongpop ; uta uba smai um ïapher eh na uta u bym smai .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiei kiei ki wan kumjuh ha baroh: ka don kawei ka jingjia ha kiba hok, bad ha kiba sniew ha kiba bha bad kiba khuid, bad ha kiba khlem khuid; bad ha uta u bym knia: kumba long uba bha; kumjuh ruh u nongpop; bad uta uba sngap jar .

en: But he sent ambassadors to him , saying , What have I to do with thee , thou king of Judah ? I come not against thee this day , but against the house wherewith I have war : for God commanded me to make haste : forbear thee from meddling with God , who is with me , that he destroy thee not .
kha: Kane ka thma kaba nga ïaleh kam don jingïadei ei ei bad phi , ko syiem ka Judah . Ngam shym la wan ban ïaleh ïa phi , hynrei ban ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong nga , bad U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban pynstet . U Blei u don ha ka liang jong nga , wat ïeng pyrshah ïa nga , ïoh un pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la phah ia ki nonglamler sha u, u da ong, Nga don jingiadei bad me, ko syiem Judah? Ngam wan pyrshah ia me ha kane ka sngi , hynrei pyrshah ia ka iing kaba nga don ka thma: namar U Blei u la hukum ia nga ban pynkloi: to khang ia me na kaba ialeh pyrshah bad U Blei uba don bad nga, ba un ym pynjot ia me .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite , and his seed : he shall not have a man to dwell among this people  ; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people , saith the  Lord   ; because he hath taught rebellion against the  Lord .
kha: ban phah sha ki koidi baroh ha Babilon ïa kane ka khubor shaphang u Shemaïah :  Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa u Shemaïah bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u baroh . Ngam shym la phah ïa u , hynrei u la kren ha phi kumba u la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad la pynlong ïa phi ban ngeit ïa ki jinglamler . Un ym don kino kino ki khun ki ksiew hapdeng jong phi . Un ym im ban ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba ngan leh na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , namar u la ong ïa ki ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong u Trai; Ha khmih, ngan pynshitom ia u Nehelamite bad u symbai jong u: un ym don briew ban shong hapdeng une u briew ; bad un ym iohi ia ka jingbha kaba ngan leh na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , ong u Trai ; namar u la hikai ia ka jingleh pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , when the king of Ai saw it , that they hasted and rose up early , and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle , he and all his people , at a time appointed , before the plain  ; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city .
kha: Haba u syiem jong ka Ai u ïohi ïa ki rangbah jong u Joshua , u pynstet ban leit ïaleh . Ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih sha ka phang ka Them Jordan ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha kajuh ka jaka kum mynshuwa , khlem da tip ba un shah tur ïaleh na shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem Ai u la iohi ia kata, ba ki la kyrkieh bad ki la mih noh kloi, bad ki briew jong ka shnong ki la leit shabar pyrshah ia ki Israel ban ialeh thma, ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh, ha ka por ba la buh, ha khmat ka madan ; hynrei um shym la sngewsih ba ki don ki nongthiah ha ka shnong jong u.

en: For this is the day of the Lord  God  of hosts , a day of vengeance , that he may avenge him of his adversaries : and the sword shall devour , and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood : for the Lord  God  of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates .
kha: Kane ka long ka sngi jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh : ha kane ka sngi un pynhiarkput ; ha kane ka sngi un pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u . Ka waitlam jong u kan bam ïa ki haduh ban da kdang , bad dih ïa ka snam jong ki haduh ban da sngewhun . Ha kane ka sngi u Badonbor Baroh u kñia ïa kiba la shah pynmong ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka dei ka sngi jong U Trai Blei jong ki paid, ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom bein, ba un pynshitom ia u na ki nongshun jong u: bad ka waitlam kan bam bad kan dih ia ka da ka snam jong ki: namar U Trai Blei jong ki paid u don ka jingknia ha ka ri Sepngi da ka wah Euphrates .

en: And it came to pass , as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth–horon , that the  Lord  cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .
kha: Katba ki Amor ki dang phet arsut na ka khim lum na ki shipai Israel , U  Trai  u pynhap halor jong ki ïa u phria uba heh baroh shi lynter lynti haduh Asekah . Kham bun ki la ïap na u phria ban na kaba ki shah pynïap ha ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba ki dang phet noh na khmat ki Israel, bad ki dang leit sha Bethoron, ba U Trai u la pynhap ia ki maw kiba khraw na bneng ha ki haduh Azekah: ki la kham bun kiba la iap da u maw hail ban ia kiba ki khun Israel ki la pyniap da ka waitlam .

en: Now , behold , in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the  Lord  an hundred thousand talents of gold , and a thousand thousand talents of silver  ; and of brass and iron without weight  ; for it is in abundance : timber also and stone have I prepared  ; and thou mayest add thereto .
kha: Na ka bynta ka Templ , da ki jingpyrshang jong nga , nga la lum palat ïa lai hajar sawspah ton ka ksiar bad palat ïa laiphew saw hajar ton ka rupa ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka . Nalor kata , la don bun bah ka rnong bad ka nar . Nga la pynkhreh ruh ïa ka dieng bad u maw , hynrei me dei ban pynïoh shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ha khmih, ha ka jingjynjar jong nga nga la pynkhreh na ka bynta ka iing U Trai shispah hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar ha

en: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Cushi , unto Baruch , saying , Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people , and come . So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand , and came unto them .
kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ïa u Jehudi ( u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u ksiew jong u Shelemaïah , bad u ksiew tun jong u Kushi ) ban ong ïa u Barukh ban wallam ïa ka kot kli na kaba u la pule ha ki paidbah . U Barukh u la wallam ha ki ïa ka kot kli .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata baroh ki rangbah ki la phah ia u Jehudi u khun u Sheemaiah, u khun u Sheemaiah, ha u Baruk, da kaba ong: To shim ha ka kti jong me ia ka roll ha kaba me la pule ha ki shkor jong ki briew bad to wan . Kumta u Baruk u khun u Neriah u la shim ia ka roll ha ka kti jong u, bad u la wan sha ki .

en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed  ; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made  ; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come even unto thy years : therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .
kha: Pha long ba la pynrem namar kito ki jingpynïap briew baroh bad ba la pyntngit da ki bleithaw ba pha la thaw , bad te ka sngi jong pha ka la wan , ka por ka la kut ! Dei na kata ka daw nga la pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ibeiñ ïa pha bad ki ri baroh ki ñiewbeiñ ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la kylla long uba sniew ha ka snam jong me ba me la pynsniew ia lade ha ki bleithaw jong me kiba me la pynlong bad me la pynlong ia ki sngi jong me ban jan shu wan shajan, bad me la wan haduh ki snem jong me: nga la pynlong ia me ban shah leh bein ha ki nongwei bad ka jingleh bein ha ki ri baroh .

en: Know for a certainty that the  Lord  your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you  ; but they shall be snares and traps unto you , and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until ye perish from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
kha: to tip skhem ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym beh shuh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Pynban , kin long ka jingmynsaw ïa phi kum ka shangkhawiah lane ka thliew bad kaba pang shikatdei eh kum ka jingsympat ha ka ingdong jong phi lane ki shiah ha ki khmat jong phi . Bad kane kan neh tad haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh napdeng jong phi uba dang lait im ha kane ka ri kaba bha ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tip da kaba thikna ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ym beh shuh ia kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi ; hynrei kin long ki jingeh bad ki jingma ia phi , bad ki jingsma ha ki liang jong phi , bad ki jingsma ha ki khmat jong phi , haduh ba phin da jah noh na kane ka ri kaba bha kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .

en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel , and it shall be forgiven them  ; for it is ignorance : and they shall bring their offering , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord  , and their sin offering before the  Lord  , for their ignorance :
kha: U lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa ka kynhun , bad yn sa map ïa ki , namar ka jingbakla ka long kaba khlem da mut khnang bad ba ki la wallam ruh ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei: namar ka long ka jingbymtip: bad kin wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong ki, ka jingknia ba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai bad ka jingknia pop jong ki ha khmat U Trai:

en: Then shalt thou kill the ram , and take of his blood , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons , and upon the thumb of their right hand , and upon the great toe of their right foot , and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about .
kha: Pynïap ïa u , shim khyndiat ka snam jong u , bad tah ïa ka ha ki shkor kamon jong u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ha ki  tikmie kamon jong ki , bad ha ki  jatkmie kamon jong ki . Synreit ïa ka snam kaba sah , sawdong kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to pyniap ia u langbrot bad shim ia ka snam jong u, bad to buh ia ka ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong u Aaron bad ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ka tduh jong ka kti kadiang jong ki bad ha ka kjat kadiang jong ki, bad sa theh ia ka snam ha ka tduh jong ka kjat kadiang jong ki sawdong .

en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel , and made all that were present in Israel to serve , even to serve the  Lord  their God . And all his days they departed not from following the  Lord  , the God of their fathers .
kha: U syiem Josaïah u pynjot ïa baroh ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba don ha ka ri kaba dei jong ki paid Israel , bad katba u dang im , u dawa ba ki briew kin shakri ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Josiah u la weng noh ia ki jingleh bymman baroh kiba iadei bad ki khun Israel , bad u la pynlong ia baroh kiba don ha Israel ban shakri , wat ban shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong ki . Bad baroh ki sngi jong u kim shym la leit noh na kaba bud ia U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And , behold , this day I am going the way of all the earth : and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls , that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the  Lord  your God spake concerning you  ; all are come to pass unto you , and not one thing hath failed thereof .
kha: Mynta , ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban ïap . Uwei pa uwei na phi u tip ha la ka dohnud bad ha la ka mynsiem ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kular ha phi . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka kular la pyndep , ym don kawei ruh ka ban sep-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha kane ka sngi nga iaid ha ka lynti jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei: bad phi tip ha ki dohnud jong phi baroh bad ha ki mynsiem jong phi baroh, ba ym don kawei ruh kaba la jah na kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kren shaphang jong phi baroh.

en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea : and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me , and will cause them to be discharged there , and thou shalt receive them : and thou shalt accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household .
kha: Ki rangbah jong nga kin pynpoi ïa ki dieng tylli na Lebanon shathie sha ka duriaw bad kin teh lang ïa ki ha ki bur ban pynkie ïa ki sharum jong ka rud duriaw sha ka jaka kaba me jied . Hangta ki rangbah jong nga kin law ïa ki jingteh , bad ki rangbah jong me kin shimti ïa ki . Na ka liang jong me , nga kwah ïa me ban pynbiang jingbam ïa ki rangbah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong nga kin pynhiar ia ki na Lebanon sha duriaw: bad ngan pynpoi ia ki da ka duriaw sha ka jaka ba me buh ia nga, bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban shah pyllait noh hangta, bad me pdiang ia ki: bad me pyndep ia ka jingkwah jong nga, ha kaba ai jingbam ia ka iing jong nga .

en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kane , u kren sa shisien ha u Shemaïah bad u ong ha u ,  Namar ba ki phla ïa la ki pop , ngan ym pynjot ïa ki . Hynrei haba u Shishak u tur ïaleh , kin ym lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai u la iohi ba ki la pynrit mynsiem ia lade, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Shemaiah, ka da ong: Ki la pynrit mynsiem ia lade namarkata ngan ym pynjot ia ki, hynrei ngan ai katto katne ka jingpyllait ; bad ka jingbitar jong nga kan ym tuid sha Jerusalem da ka kti u Shishak .

en: The Bible says : “The wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb , and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down , and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together  ; and a mere little boy will be leader over them .”—Isaiah 11 :6-9  ; Hosea 2 :18 .
kha: Ka Baibl ka ong “Te u suri un shong lem bad u khun ‘ langbrot , u labasa ruh un dem bad u khun blang ; u khun masi bad u sing samla bad u masi sngaid lang bad u khynnah rit un ïalam ïa ki .” —Isaïah 11 :6-9 ; Hosea 2 :18 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Baibl ka ong: U blang un shong ha ka jingshisha bad u khun langbrot shynrang, bad bad u khun masi hi un thiah noh, bad u khun masi bad u sing rit bad u mrad ba la ai bam bha baroh lang bad tang u khynnah rit un long u nongialam halor jong ki .

en: And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee , a land flowing with milk and honey , that thou shalt keep this service in this month .
kha: U  Trai  u la kular skhem ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ba un ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus . Ynda u la wallam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam man ka snem ha u bnai uba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha ka por ba U Trai un wanrah ia me sha ka ri jong ki nong Kanaan, bad ki Hittite, bad ki Amorit , bad ki Hivite bad ki Jibuite kiba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me ban ai ha me ia me ia ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ba me bat ia kane ka jingshakri ha une u bnai .

en: And when Gideon was come , behold , there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow , and said , Behold , I dreamed a dream , and , lo , a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian , and came unto a tent , and smote it that it fell , and overturned it , that the tent lay along .
kha: Haba u Gideon u la poi , u la ïohsngew ïa uwei u briew uba ïathuh ha la u paralok shaphang ka jingphohsniew . U ong ,  Nga phohsniew ba uwei u kpu barli u tyllun sha ka jaka sher dara jong ngi bad u tyngkhuh ïa ka dara . Ka dara ka la kyllon bad ka don lyngktar ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la wan, ha khmih, u la don uwei u briew uba la iathuh ia ka jingphohsniew ha u paralok jong u, bad u la ong, Ha khmih, ka cake u kpu barli ka la rung sha ka kynhun jong ki nong Midian, bad ka la wan sha kawei ka ïingjaiñ bad ka la pynkhih ïa ka ba ka la hap, bad ka la kylla long .

en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time , and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit , that thou be not inhabited  ; and I shall set glory in the land of the living  ;
kha: Ngan phah ïa pha sha trai jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad ki briew kiba shong ha ki por mynbarim . Ngan pynlong ïa pha ba phan shong ha kata ka pyrthei kaba shapoh ka khyndew hapdeng ki jingjot bymjukut , ban ïadon lang bad kiba ïap . Namarkata phan ym lah shuh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ngan pynhiar ia me bad ki kiba hiar shapoh ka thliew, bad ki briew kiba la rim, bad ngan buh ia me ha ki jaka ba rit jong ka khyndew, ha ki jaka ba la jot noh da ki briew kiba la leit shapoh ka thliew, ba me ym shong; bad ngan buh ia ka burom ha ka ri jong kiba im;

en: And David said in his heart , I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul : there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines  ; and Saul shall despair of me , to seek me any more in any coast of Israel : so shall I escape out of his hand .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha lade ,  Ha kawei na kine ka sngi , u Saul un sa pynïap ïa nga . Kaba bha tam eh ïa nga ban leh ka long ban phet noh sha ka ri ki Philistia . Te u Saul un sa sangeh ban wad ïa nga ha Israel , bad ngan sa lait na ka kti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha la ka dohnud: ym don ei ei kaba kham bha na ka bynta jong nga ban ia kaba nga phet noh kloi sha ka ri Philistia ; bad u Saul un duh jingkyrmen ia nga, ban wad shuh ia nga ha kano kano ka rud duriaw jong ki Israel: kumta ngan lait na ka kti jong u .

en: Therefore now ,  Lord  God of Israel , keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him , saying , There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel  ; so that thy children take heed to their way , that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me .
kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga kyrpad ba men bat ruh ïa la ka kular kaba me la pynlong bad u kpa jong nga mynba me ïathuh ha u ba yn don borabor uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u , u ban synshar kum u syiem ki Israel , tang lada ki kohnguh ïa me kumba me la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta, ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, to sumar bad u shakri jong me u Dabid u kpa jong nga uba me la kular ia u, da kaba ong: Wat pynduh ia me ia u briew ha khmat jong nga ban shong ha ka khet Israel ; khnang ba ki khun jong me kin sumar ia ka lynti jong ki, ba kin iaid ha khmat jong nga kumba me la iaid ha khmat jong nga .

en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .
kha: Te u la leit sha ka ïingsyiem , sha ka kamra u sekretari ka ïingbishar , ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang don ha ka jingïalang . U Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Delaïah u khun jong u Shemaïah , u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor , u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Shaphan , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Hananaïah , bad baroh kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ki la don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit hiar sha ka iing syiem, sha ka kamra thoh: bad, ha khmih, ki rangbah baroh ki la shong hangta, wat u Elishama u nongthoh, bad u Delaiah u khun u Shemaiah, bad u Elnathan u khun u Achbor, bad u Gemariah u khun u Hananiah bad ki rangbah baroh .

en: And he prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , I pray thee , O  Lord  , was not this my saying , when I was yet in my country ? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish : for I knew that thou art a gracious God , and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repentest thee of the evil .
kha: Kumta u la duwai ,  A Trai , hato ngam la ong shuwa ba ngan mih na ïing ba kane ka dei kaei kaba men leh ? Dei na kata ka daw ba nga la pyrshang tyngeh ban phet noh sha Spain ! Nga la tip ba me long U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei , uba ïaishah slem , uba sbun borabor , bad uba kloi borabor ban kylla ïa la ka jingmut ban ym pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la duwai ha U Trai , bad u la ong, ko Trai, hato kane kam dei ka jingkren jong nga, haba nga dang don ha ka ri jong nga ? Namarkata nga la phet noh shuwa sha u Tarshish: namar nga tip ba me long U Blei uba sngewrit bad uba isynei, uba slem ban bitar bad uba sngewrit shibun ia me na ka jingsniew .

en: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time , in making war against it to take it , thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them : for thou mayest eat of them , and thou shalt not cut them down ( for the tree of the field is man s life ) to employ them in the siege :
kha: Haba phi ïaleh ban knieh ïa kano kano ka shnong , wat pom ïa ki diengsoh jong ka , wat lada phi kerkut slem ïa ka . Bam ïa u soh , hynrei wat pynjot ïa ki diengsoh , naba kim dei ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me la pynjot ia ka shnong kaba jrong, ha kaba ialeh pyrshah ia ka ban shim ia ka: namar me lah ban bam ia ki: namar me lah ban bam ia ki: namar me dei ban ot ia ki: namar u dieng jong ka lyngkha u dei u briew) ban pyntrei ia ki ha ka jingkhang:

en: Behold , therefore I will gather all thy lovers , with whom thou hast taken pleasure , and all them that thou hast loved , with all them that thou hast hated  ; I will even gather them round about against thee , and will discover thy nakedness unto them , that they may see all thy nakedness .
kha: Namar kane ngan wallam lang ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha kiba mynshuwa — kito kiba pha la sngewtynnat bad kito kiba pha la isih . Ngan wallam ïa ki sawdong jong pha ha ka jylli , bad nangta ngan law ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad shah ïa ki ban ïohi ba pha lyngkhuit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , namarkata ngan lum lang ia ki nongieit jong me baroh, bad kiba me la ieit, bad ia kita baroh kiba me la shun; ngan lum lang ia ki sawdong pyrshah ia me, bad ngan sa lap ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me ha ki, ba kin iohi ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me baroh .

en: And I will be found of you , saith the  Lord  : and I will turn away your captivity , and I will gather you from all the nations , and from all the places whither I have driven you , saith the  Lord   ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive .
kha: Ho-oid , nga ong , phin shem ïa nga , bad ngan buh pat ïa phi ha ka ri jong phi hi . Ngan lumlang ïa phi na kawei pa kawei ka ri bad na kawei ka jaka sha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka ri na kaba nga la phah noh ïa phi sha ka jingshah ringmraw . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan sa shem ia phi , ong U Trai: bad ngan pynphai noh ia ka jinglong mraw jong phi: bad ngan lum noh ia phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad na ki jaka baroh ha kaba nga la beh noh ia phi , ong u Trai; bad ngan wanrah biang ia phi sha ka jaka ba nga la pynlong ia phi ban shah rah noh .

en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year , and one young bullock , and two rams : they shall be for a burnt offering unto the  Lord  , with their meat offering , and their drink offerings , even an offering made by fire , of sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Ryngkat bad kita ki kpu , baroh phin ïa-ai hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem , uwei u masi lyngraw , bad ar tylli ki  langsohmoh ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Yn ai ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh dih . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ai da u kpu hynriew ngut ki langbrot khlem jingduna ha ka snem kaba nyngkong, bad uwei u khun masi bad ar tylli ki langbrot: kin long na ka bynta ka jingknia thang sha U Trai, ryngkat bad ka jingknia bam jong ki, bad ki jingknia dih jong ki, wat ka jingknia ba la shna da ka ding, na ka jingsma ba thiang ha U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , that after the year was expired , at the time that kings go out to battle , Joab led forth the power of the army , and wasted the country of the children of Ammon , and came and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried at Jerusalem . And Joab smote Rabbah , and destroyed it .
kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem kaba ki syiem ki ju leit ïaleh thma , u Joab u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai bad hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ki Ammon ; u syiem Dabid , pat u sah ha Jerusalem . Ki kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah , ki tur ïaleh , bad pynjot ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba hadien ba la kut ka snem, ha ka por ba ki syiem ki leit sha ka thma, u Joab u la pynmih ia ka bor shipai, bad u la pynjot ia ka ri jong ki khun Ammon, bad u la wan bad u la pynjot ia u Rabbah . Hynrei u Dabid u la sah ha Jerusalem . Bad u Joab u la pynjot ia ka Rabbah .

en: Thy riches , and thy fairs , thy merchandise , thy mariners , and thy pilots , thy calkers , and the occupiers of thy merchandise , and all thy men of war , that are in thee , and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee , shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin .
kha: Ka spah jong ki mar khaïi jong pha baroh , ki maji jong pha baroh , ki misteri liengbah bad ki nongkhaïi jong pha baroh , uwei pa uwei u shipai halor ka liengbah — baroh , baroh ki la ngam jyllop ha ka duriaw mynba ka liengbah jong pha ka la shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka spah jong me, bad ki jingbam jong me, bad ki nongleit jingleit jong me, bad ki nongleit jingleit jong me, bad ki nongshong shnong jong me, bad ki nongshong shnong jong me baroh kiba don ha me, bad ha ka kynhun jong me baroh kaba don hapdeng jong me, kin hap hapdeng ki duriaw ha ka sngi jong ka jingjot jong me .

en: And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut da kaba shisha bad kaba sngur mynsiem , bad ki duwai ha me da kaba phai khmat sha kane ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , sha kane ka nongbah kaba me la jied , bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta to wan phai sha me da ka dohnud jong ki baroh, bad da ka mynsiem jong ki baroh, ha ka ri jong ki nongshun jong ki, kiba la ialam noh ia ki sha ka ri jong ki, kaba me ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki, ka shnong kaba me la jied, bad ka iing kaba nga la tei na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong me:

en: Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself !
kha: Hadien kata , haba u Dabid u la leit sha ïing ban khublei ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing , ka Mikhal ka wan mih ban ïakynduh ïa u .  U syiem ki Israel u la pynkhraw nam ïa lade ha kane ka sngi !  ka ong .  U la pynlyngkhuit ïa lade kum u bieit ha khmat ki shakri kynthei jong ki rangbah synshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la leit phai sha iing jong u . Bad u Michal ka khun u Saul u la mih ban iakynduh ia u Dabid bad u la ong , Katno u syiem Israel u la paw ha ka sngi ha ki khmat ki nongtrei jong u , kumba uwei na ki briew kiba lehnohei u la paw khlem akor ia lade !

en: If a soul commit a trespass , and sin through ignorance , in the holy things of the  Lord   ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the  Lord  a ram without blemish out of the flocks , with thy estimation by shekels of silver , after the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering :
kha: Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba kum klet ban wan ai ïa ka jingsiew ba long kyntang sha U  Trai  , un wallam ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat sha U  Trai  da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kumba la buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka mynsiem ka leh ia ka jingleh bymman, bad ka pop lyngba ka jingbymtip, ha kiei kiei kiba khuid jong U Trai te un wanrah na ka bynta ka jingleh bymman jong u Trai ia u langbrot khlem jingduna na ki kynhun langbrot, da ka jingkhein jong me da ki Shekel rupa, hadien ka Shekel jong ka jaka kyntang:

en: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place  ; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hands of them that seek their lives : and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
kha: Ha kane ka jaka ngan pynpulom ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban risa halor jong ki bad pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma . Ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ki sim bad ha ki mradkhlaw kum ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ka jingmut jong u Judah bad ka Jerusalem ha kane ka jaka bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban hap da ka waitlam ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki: bad da ki kti jong ki kiba wad ia ka jingim jong ki: bad ia ki met jong ki ngan ai doh ia ki sim bneng bad ia ki mrad khlaw .

en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart , to work all manner of work , of the engraver , and of the cunning workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , and in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of them that do any work , and of those that devise cunning work .
kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ka jingtbit ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh ba la ju trei da ki nong-ohdur , ki nongthawdur , bad ki nongsuh nongthain ïa ka linen kaba ni ; ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait jaiñ . Ki nang ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh , bad ki long ruh ki nongpruid dur kiba tbit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la dap da ka jingstad jong ka dohnud, ban trei ia ki kam baroh, na u nongtrei uba stad, bad na u nongtrei uba stad, ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka jain kaba bha, wat na ki kiba leh ia kano kano ka kam, bad na kito kiba thmu ia ka kam kaba sniew .

en: And Ben–hadad said unto him , The cities , which my father took from thy father , I will restore  ; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus , as my father made in Samaria . Then said Ahab , I will send thee away with this covenant . So he made a covenant with him , and sent him away .
kha: U Benhadad u ong ïa u ,  Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ki shnong ba u kpa jong nga u la shim na u kpa jong phi , bad phi lah ban tei ka jaka khaïi na ka bynta ïa lade ha Damaskos , kumba u kpa jong nga u leh ha Samaria .  U Ahab u jubab ,  Halor kine ki kyndon , te ngan pyllait ïa phi .  U ïateh kular bad u bad u pyllait noh ïa u ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benhadad u la ong ha u, "Ki shnong kiba u kpa jong nga u la shim na u kpa jong me, ngan pynphai biang ia me ha ka shnong Damekh, kumba u kpa jong nga u la leh ha Samaria . Nangta u la ong u Ahab . Kumta u la leh ia ka jutang bad u bad u la phah noh ia u .

en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies , who vexed them : and in the time of their trouble , when they cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours , who saved them out of the hand of their enemies .
kha: kiba ong ïa ki ba ki dei ban phai pat sha me . Ki la ñiewbeiñ ïa me na ka por sha ka por , ba kumta me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop bad synshar ïa ki . Ha ka jingeh jong ki , ki khot ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me jubab ïa ki na bneng . Ha ka jingisynei bakhraw me phah ki nongïalam ïa ki kiba pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki: bad ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar jong ki: bad ha ka por jong ki: bad ha ka por jong ki: bad kat kum ka jingsngewsih jong me kaba bun .

en: And if a man shall take his sister , his father s daughter , or his mother s daughter , and see her nakedness , and she see his nakedness  ; it is a wicked thing  ; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people : he hath uncovered his sister s nakedness  ; he shall bear his iniquity .
kha: Lada uno uno u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka hynmen ne ka para , kaba na ujuh ne na kajuh ka kmie , yn pynkheiñ burom ïa ki ha khmat u paidbah bad yn tait noh ïa ki na la ki jong ki briew . U la ïathiah shongkha bad la ka para bad u dei ban kit hi ïa la ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew un shim ia ka para jong u, ka khun jong u, ne ka khun jong u, bad ka iohi ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u, bad ka iohi ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u ; ka long kaba sniew ; bad kin shah ot noh ha khmat ki briew jong ki: u la pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka para jong u ; un kit ia ka jingbymhok jong u .

en: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts , men of valour , from Zorah , and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land , and to search it  ; and they said unto them , Go , search the land : who when they came to mount Ephraim , to the house of Micah , they lodged there .
kha: Kumta ki Dan ki jied san ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit na baroh ki longïing ha ka jait bad ki phah ïa ki na ki shnong Sorah bad Eshtaol ryngkat bad ki jingbthah ba kin leit syntiat ïa ka ri . Ynda ki poi ha ri lum Ephraim , ki sah ha ïing u Mikah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la phah na ki jaka jong ki, ki briew kiba don ha ka ri, na ka ri Sorah bad na Eshetol, ban leit jngoh ia ka ri, bad ban leit wad ia ka; bad ki la ong ha ki: Leit, wad ia ka ri: kiba haba ki la wan ban kiew ia ka ri, sha ka iing u Mihaah .

en: For they covered the face of the whole earth , so that the land was darkened  ; and they did eat every herb of the land , and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left : and there remained not any green thing in the trees , or in the herbs of the field , through all the land of Egypt .
kha: Ki la tap ïa ka khyndew baroh kat haduh ba ka ïong ngaiñ da ki puit suda . Ki la bam ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u phria u dang pynsah , kynthup ïa ki soh baroh ha ki dieng . Ym shym sah shuh kano kano kaba jyrngam ha u jingthung ne ha u dieng ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la tap ia ka khmat jong ka khyndew baroh kawei, haduh ba ka ri ka la dum bad ki la bam ia u jingthung baroh jong ka ri, bad ki soh jong ki dieng baroh kiba u hail u la iehnoh: bad ym shym la sah ei ei ha ki dieng ne ha ki jingthung jong ka lyngkha baroh kawei .

en: And it shall come to pass , that when any shall yet prophesy , then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him , Thou shalt not live  ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the  Lord  : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .
kha: Te lada uno uno u ïaiban ban ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u hi kin ong ïa u ba u dei ban shah pynïap , namar u la kam ba u kren ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  , hynrei u kren pynban ïa ki jinglamler . Haba u ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u kin dung pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba haba uno uno u dang iathuhlypa, te u kpa jong u bad ka kmie jong u kiba kha ia u kin ong ha u, Wat im shuh shuh namar me kren thok ha ka kyrteng U Trai: bad u kpa jong u bad ka kmie jong u kiba kha ia u kin pynkhih ia u haba u iathuhlypa .

en: And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
kha: U Boas u jubab ,  Nga la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kaba phi la leh ïa la ka kiaw kurim naduh ba u tnga jong phi u la ïap . Nga tip kumno phi la iehnoh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa la ka ri ruh , bad kumno phi la wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng ki briew kiba phim pat ju ithuh mynno mynno .
translated_en_to_kha: U Boaz u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka, "Ka la paw pura ia nga, ia kiei kiei baroh kiba me la leh ha ka kmie tymmen jong me naduh ka jingiap jong u tnga jong me: bad kumno me la iehnoh ia la u kpa bad ka kmie jong me bad ka ri jong ka jingkha jong me, bad me la wan sha ka jaitbynriew kaba me khlem tip haduh mynta .

en: And strangers , the terrible of the nations , have cut him off , and have left him : upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen , and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land  ; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow , and have left him .
kha: Ki nongwei barunar ki khet noh ïa u bad iehnoh ïa u . Ki tnat dieng ba la kdiah jong u kin hap ha man la u lumbah bad ka them ha ka ri . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba im ha ki jingkah syrngiew jong u kin phet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongwei kiba shyrkhei jong ki jaitbynriew ki la ot noh ia u: halor ki lum bad ha ki them baroh ki tnat jong u ki la hap , bad ki tnat jong u ki la tyrkhong da ki wah baroh jong ka ri; bad ki briew jong ka khyndew baroh ki la hiar noh na ka jingdum jong u .

en: And Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , and the silver , and the garment , and the wedge of gold , and his sons , and his daughters , and his oxen , and his asses , and his sheep , and his tent , and all that he had : and they brought them unto the valley of Achor .
kha: U Joshua , lem bad ki paid Israel , ki shim ïa u Akhan , ka rupa , ka barandi , ka lyngkhot ksiar , lem bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong u Akhan , ki jingri jong u , ki kada jong u , bad ki langbrot jong u , ka ïingjaiñ jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them Jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua bad ki Israel baroh ki la shim ia u Achan u khun u Serah bad ka rupa bad ka jain bad ka sniehdoh ksiar bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki khun kynthei jong u bad ki masi jong u bad ki kulai jong u bad ki langbrot jong u bad ki jingdon jong u baroh: bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha ka them Achor .

en: Moreover , my father , see , yea , see the skirt of thy robe in my hand : for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe , and killed thee not , know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand , and I have not sinned against thee  ; yet thou huntest my soul to take it .
kha: Ha khmih , ko pa jong nga , khmih ïa ka lyngkhot ka jaiñkup jong phi kaba nga bat ! Ngan jin da la pynïap ïa phi , hynrei pynban nga shu ot noh tang ïa kane . Kane ka dei ban pynthikna ïa phi ba ngam don jingmut ei ei ban ïaleh pyrshah ne pynmynsaw ïa phi . Phi la beh mrad ïa nga ban pynïap ïa nga , wat la ngam shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata, ko kpa jong nga, to peit ia ka lyngkhot lyngkhai jong me ha ka kti jong nga: namar ha kata nga ot noh ia ka lyngkhot lyngkhai jong me, bad ngam shym la pyniap ia me, to tip bad me iohi ba ym don ka jingsniew ne ka jingleh bymman ha ka kti jong nga, bad ngam shym la leh pop pyrshah ia me; hynrei me leit khwai ia ka mynsiem jong nga ban shim ia ka .

en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion , and shall flow together to the goodness of the  Lord  , for wheat , and for wine , and for oil , and for the young of the flock and of the herd : and their soul shall be as a watered garden  ; and they shall not sorrow any more at all .
kha: Kin wan bad rwai da ka jingkmen ha u lum Seïon bad kin kmen ha ki jingai sngewbha jong nga — ki jingai sngewbha da u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ki jingai sngewbha da ki langbrot bad ki masi . Kin long kum ka kper bad la ai um bha ; kin don baroh kat kaba ki donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kin wan bad rwai ha ka jingjrong jong ka Seion , bad kin tuid lang ha ka jingbha jong U Trai , na ka bynta u kew bad ka wain bad ka umphniang bad na ka bynta ki khun masi bad ki kynhun masi: bad ka mynsiem jong ki kan long kum ka kper ba la ai um; bad kin ym sngewsih shuh .

en: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave , all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth , which caused their terror in the land of the living  ; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit .
kha: Ka Elam ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki la leit hiar , khlem otsher sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad jahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka Elam bad ka jingbun briew jong ka baroh sawdong ka jingtep jong ka, baroh ki la shah pyniap, ki la hiar khlem da shah ot ha ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka khyndew , kiba la pynlong ia ka jingtieng jong ki ha ka ri jong ki bringing kiba im hynrei ki la kit ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki bad ki kiba leit shapoh ka thliew .

en: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people , and were drawn away from the city  ; and they began to smite of the people , and kill , as at other times , in the highways , of which one goeth up to the house of God , and the other to Gibeah in the field , about thirty men of Israel .
kha: Ki Benjamin ki wan mih shabar ban ïaleh bad la ring pah ïa ki kham sha jngai na kata ka nongbah . Kum mynshuwa , ki la sdang ban pom katto katne ngut ki Israel ha ka jaka lum , ha ki lynti bah sha Bethel bad ha ka lynti bah sha Gibeah . Ki pynïap kumba laiphew ngut ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la mih noh na ka shnong bad ki la sdang ban pyniap ia ki briew, bad ki la pyniap, kumba ju long ha kiwei pat ki por, ha ki surok bah, ha kaba uwei u leit sha ka iing U Blei, bad uwei pat sha Gibeah ha lyngkha , kumba laiphew ngut ki Israel .

en: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity , and that divine lies : they shall not be in the assembly of my people , neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel , neither shall they enter into the land of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
kha: Nga la jan ban pynshitom ïa phi ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad kiba thaw ki jingïathuhlypa kiba ïalam bakla . Phin ym don hangta haba ki briew jong nga ki ïalumlang ban ïashim ïa ki rai ; ïa ki kyrteng jong phi yn ym kynthup ha ka thup kyrteng jong ki traishnong ka Israel ; phin ym wan phai shuh da lei lei sha ka ri ka jong phi . Nangta phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kti jong nga kan long halor ki nongiathuhlypa kiba iohi ia ka jinglong ba kynja Blei: kin ym don ha ka jingiaseng jong ki briew jong nga, lymne kin ym shah thoh ha ka jingthoh jong ka iing Israel, lymne kin ym rung ha ka ri Israel; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai Blei .

en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou didst humble thyself before God , when thou heardest his words against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , and humbledst thyself before me , and didst rend thy clothes , and weep before me  ; I have even heard thee also , saith the  Lord .
kha: bad to kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , da kaba kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïam , haba me ïohsngew kumno nga la byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka dohnud jong me ka la jem, bad me la pynrit ia lade ha khmat U Blei, haba me la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong u pyrshah ia kane ka jaka, bad pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka, bad me la pynrit ia lade ha khmat jong nga, bad me la pynkhih ia ki jain jong me, bad me la iam ha khmat jong nga; nga la iohsngew wat ia me ruh, ong U Trai .

en: Then shall ye know that I am the  Lord  , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars , upon every high hill , in all the tops of the mountains , and under every green tree , and under every thick oak , the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .
kha: Ïa ki metïap yn pynsaphriang hapdeng ki bleithaw bad sawdong ki duwan , yn pynsaphriang halor uwei pa uwei u lum uba jrong , ha kliar uwei pa uwei u lumbah , ha trai uwei pa uwei u dieng jyrngam bad uwei pa uwei u dieng Sning uba heh , ha ki jaka baroh ba ki thang ïa ki jingkñia ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai, haba ki briew kiba la shah pyniap jong ki kin don hapdeng ki bleithaw jong ki sawdong ki lum jong ki, ha u lum ba jrong baroh, bad hapoh u dieng ba jyrngam baroh, bad hapoh u dieng oak ba jyrngam baroh .

en: But they rebelled against me , and would not hearken unto me : they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes , neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt : then I said , I will pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt .
kha: Hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad ki la kyntait ban shahshkor . Kim shym la bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong ki lane iehnoh ïa ki blei jong ki nong Ijipt . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la leh pyrshah ia nga , bad kim shym la sngap ia nga: kim shym la bret noh ia ki jinglehrain jong ki khmat jong ki: nangta nga la ong: Ngan theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki, ban pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ia ki hapdeng ka ri Ijipt .

en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat , and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel , and all their transgressions in all their sins , putting them upon the head of the goat , and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness :
kha: Un buh ïa la ki kti baroh ar ha ka khlieh jong uta u  langsohmoh , bad halor jong u un phla ïa ki jingbymman , ïa ki pop , bad ïa ki jingïaleh pyrshah baroh jong ki Israel , bad da kumta un pynkit ïa ki ha ka khlieh jong uta u  langsohmoh . Nangta dei ban ñiah noh ïa uta u  langsohmoh sha ka ri shyiap da u briew uba la jied kyrpang na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un buh ia ki kti jong u ha ka khlieh jong u blang ba im, bad un phla ia ki jingbymhok jong ki Israel baroh, bad ki jingpynkhein jong ki baroh ha ki pop jong ki baroh:

en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the  Lord  thy God in Horeb , when the  Lord  said unto me , Gather me the people together , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth , and that they may teach their children .
kha: Ïathuh pateng ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi shaphang kata ka sngi ba phi ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha u Lum Sinai , mynba u ong ha nga , ‘ Lumlang ïa u paidbah . Nga kwah ba kin ïohsngew aïu ngan ong , ba kumta kin tiengburom ïa nga katba ki dang im bad ba kin hikai ïa la ki khun ki kti ban leh kumjuh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Khamtam ha ka sngi ba me ieng ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ha Horb , haba U Trai u la ong ha nga , To iakynduh ia nga ia ki briew bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga , ba kin nang ban sheptieng ia nga baroh ki sngi ba kin im ha ka khyndew bad ba kin hikai ia ki khun jong ki .

en: Then he said unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here ? for they have filled the land with violence , and have returned to provoke me to anger : and , lo , they put the branch to their nose .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa katai ? Kine ki briew ka Judah kim pat hun tang kaba leh ïa ki kam ba-ijli kiba me la ïohi hangne bad ban pynphriang ïa ka ri da ka jingleh thombor . Em , ki dei ban wan bad leh ïa ki hangne hi ha ka Templ ban pynbitar shuh shuh ïa nga . Peit kumno ki beiñ ïa nga ha ka rukom kaba kham palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, Hato me la iohi ia kane, ko khun u briew? Hato ka long kaba jem ia ka iing Judah ba ki leh ia ki kam ba sngewsih kiba ki leh hangne ? namar ki la pyndap ia ka ri da ka jingleh donbor , bad ki la wan phai biang ban pynkhih ia nga ban bitar: bad , ha khmih , ki buh ia ka tnat ha ka shyntur jong ki .

en: Call together the archers against Babylon : all ye that bend the bow , camp against it round about  ; let none thereof escape : recompense her according to her work  ; according to all that she hath done , do unto her : for she hath been proud against the  Lord  , against the Holy One of Israel .
kha: To ong ïa ki nongsiatkhnam ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon . Phah ïa baroh kiba nang ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh bad ïa u khnam . Kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad wat ai ba yn don ba lait phet . Siew kylliang pat ïa kiei kiei baroh ba ka la leh , bad leh ïa ka kumba ka la leh ïa kiwei , namar ba ka la leh da ka jingsarong pyrshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Khot lang ia ki nongsiat khnam pyrshah ia ka Babilon: phi baroh kiba pynkhih ia ka bow , to ai ba kan lait im: to siew kylliang ia ka kat kum ka kam jong ka; kat kum ka kam baroh kaba ka la leh: namar ka la sngew sarong ia U Trai; namar ka la sngew sarong ia U Trai Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: Now therefore , if it seem good to the king , let there be search made in the king s treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem , and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter .
kha: Mynta , lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , ai ba yn ïit ha ki jingthoh syiem ha Babilon ban shem lada u Syros u la ai ne um shym la ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa kane ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad nangta sa pyntip ïa ngi kaei ka mon jong phi ha kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, lada ka long kaba bha ia u syiem, to ai ba un wad ha ka iing jong u syiem kaba don hangta ha Babilon, la ka long kumta, ba la buh ia ka hukum na u syiem Cyrus ban tei ia kane ka iing U Blei ha Jerusalem , bad to ai ba u syiem un phah ia ka jingsngewbha jong u ha ngi shaphang kane ka kam .

en: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel , saying , If ye do return unto the  Lord  with all your hearts , then put away the strange gods and Ashtoreth from among you , and prepare your hearts unto the  Lord  , and serve him only : and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines .
kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Lada phin phai sha U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , phi dei ban bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Astarte . Pynkyntang lut ïa lade sha U  Trai  bad mane tang ïa u , te un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la kren ha ka iing Israel baroh kawei, u da ong: Lada phi wan phai sha U Trai da ki dohnud jong phi baroh, te to weng noh ia ki blei nongwei bad u Ashtoret na pdeng jong phi, bad pynkhreh ia ki dohnud jong phi sha U Trai, bad shakri tang ia u: bad un pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz , which the kings of Judah had made , and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the  Lord  , did the king beat down , and brake them down from thence , and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron .
kha: Ïa ki duwan kiba ki syiem Judah ki la tei halor tnum ka ïingsyiem hajrong ka jaka sah u syiem Ahas , u syiem Josaïah u la pyntwa lut , ryngkat bad ki duwan ba la pynïeng da u syiem Manasseh ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka Templ ; u la pynlwet ïa ki duwan lyngkhot lyngkhai bad bret ïa ki sha ka Them Kidron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nonglehkai kiba don ha jrong jong ka kamra ba shalor jong u Ahash, kiba ki syiem Judah ki la shna, bad ki nonglehkai kiba u Manasseh u la shna ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka iing U Trai, u la pynkhih ia ki nangta, bad u la bret ia ka dewbilat jong ki shapoh ka wah Kidron .

en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it  ; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith , even the bread of affliction  ; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste : that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life .
kha: Haba phi bam ïa kane ka jingbam , wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Hynñiew sngi phin bam ïa u kpu khlem thiat , kumba phi la bam mynba phi la dei ban mihnoh kyrkieh na Ijipt . Bam ïa une u kpu — yn khot ïa u , u kpu ka jingshah shitom — ba katba phi dang im phin ïai kynmaw ïa kata ka sngi mynba phi mihnoh na Ijipt , kata ka jaka ka jingshah shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bam ia u kpu bym don thied bad u ; hynriew sngi phi dei ban bam ia u kpu bym don thied bad u; namar me wan mih na ka ri Ijipt ha ka por ba me wan mih na ka ri Ijipt baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong me .

en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .
kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba mane ïa ki Baal bad ïa ki Astarte , lem bad ïa ki blei jong ki Syria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki Moab , jong ki Ammon , bad jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sangeh ban mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai, bad ki la shakri ia u Baalim, bad u Ashtoret, bad ki blei jong ka Syria, bad ki blei jong u Sedon bad ki blei jong u Moab bad ki blei jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon bad ki blei jong ki Philistia bad ki la iehnoh ia U Trai bad kim shym la shakri ia u .

en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron , is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word ? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
kha: bad u ong ha u ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Namar ba me la phah ki nonglamktien ban kylli na u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron — i kumba ym don blei ha Israel ban kylli — men ym ïohkhiah ; men ïap !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Kumta u ong U Trai, Kumba me la phah ia ki nonglam khubor ban kylli na u Baalzebul u blei jong u Ekron , hato kam dei namar ba ym don Blei ha Israel ban kylli ia ka ktien jong u ? namarkata wat hiar na kata ka jingthiah ha kaba me la leit kiew sha jrong .

en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha kata ka duwan bad khyndiat ka umphniang pynsleh , bad synreit ha u Aaron bad ha ki jaiñkup jong u , bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ma ki bad ki jaiñkup jong ki kin long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ka snam kaba don halor ka almari bad ka umphniang pynsleh bad to theh ia ka ha u Aaron bad ha ki jain jong u bad ha ki jain jong u bad ha ki jain jong ki khun shynrang jong u bad u: bad un long uba la pynkyntang, bad ki jain jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: And when the people were come into the camp , the elders of Israel said , Wherefore hath the  Lord  smitten us to day before the Philistines ? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of Shiloh unto us , that , when it cometh among us , it may save us out of the hand of our enemies .
kha: Ynda ki shipai kiba lait im ki wan phai sha ka jaka shong dara , ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki ong ,  Balei keiñ U  Trai  u shah ba ki Philistia kin jop ïa ngi mynta ka sngi ? Ïa ngin ïaleit bad wanrah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai  na Shiloh , ba kumta un leit lem bad ngi bad pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew ki la wan shapoh ka shnong ki la ong ki rangbah Israel: Balei U Trai u la pyniap ia ngi ha ka sngi ha khmat ki Philistia ? To ngin ia shim ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai na Shiloh sha ngi, ba haba ka wan hapdeng jong ngi, kan pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti ki nongshun jong ngi .

en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .
kha: Khmih sha ki bneng ; peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei kan jot noh kum ki jaiñ ba la rim , bad ki briew jong ka baroh kin ïap kum ki skain . Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba nga wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan long kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia ki khmat jong phi sha bneng, bad peit shapoh ka khyndew: namar ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem, bad ka khyndew kan kylla tymmen kum ka jain , bad kita kiba shong ha ka kin iap kumjuh: hynrei ka jingpynim jong nga kan long junom: bad ka hok jong nga kan ym jah noh .

en: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel , and an hundred of a thousand , and a thousand out of ten thousand , to fetch victual for the people , that they may do , when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin , according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel .
kha: Uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha Israel kin wanrah jingbam ïa ka kynhun shipai , bad kiwei pat kin leit ban pynshitom ïa ka Gibeah namar kane ka kam khlemrain ba ki la leh ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngin shim shiphew ngut ki jait Israel baroh kawei, bad shispah hajar ngut ki Israel, bad shi hajar na ki shi hajar ngut ki Israel, ban leit sha ka ri Israel .

en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven , and mine understanding returned unto me , and I blessed the most High , and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever , whose dominion is an everlasting dominion , and his kingdom is from generation to generation :
kha: Haba ki hynñiew snem ki la leit ,  la ong u syiem ,  Nga la khmih shajrong sha sahit bneng , bad ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai . Nga la ïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh bad nga la ai ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom ïa uta uba im junom .  Un synshar junom , bad ka hima jong u kan neh ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaba kut jong ki sngi nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga sha bneng, bad ka jingsngewthuh jong nga ka la wan phai biang sha nga, bad nga la kyrkhu bad nga la burom ia uta uba im junom, uba ka jingsynshar jong u ka long ka jingsynshar bymjukut, bad ka hima jong u ka long naduh ki pateng:

en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the  Lord  , the Lord of all the earth , shall rest in the waters of Jordan , that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above  ; and they shall stand upon an heap .
kha: Haba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  jong ka pyrthei baroh kin ïuh ïa la ki kjat ha um , ka Jordan kan sangeh ban tuid , bad ka um kaba wan tuid na shaneng kan lang shi jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia tang shu jia ba ki khyndew jong ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk U Trai , U Trai jong ka khyndew baroh kawei, kin shong ha ki um Jordan , ba ki um Jordan kin sa jah noh na ki um kiba wan hiar na jrong; bad kin ieng halor ka kynhun .

en: Turn you , and take your journey , and go to the mount of the Amorites , and unto all the places nigh thereunto , in the plain , in the hills , and in the vale , and in the south , and by the sea side , to the land of the Canaanites , and unto Lebanon , unto the great river , the river Euphrates .
kha: Lied noh ïa la ka dara bad ïaid shaphrang . Leit sha ri lum Amor bad sha ki jaka kiba markhap bad ka — sha ka Them Jordan , sha ki ri lum bad ri them , sha ka jaka kaba shathie bad sha ka rud duriaw Mediterranian . Leit sha ka ri Kanaan bad nangta sha lyndet ki lum Lebanon haduh ka wahbah Ïuphratis .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai ia phi, bad shim ia ka jingleit jong phi, bad leit sha u lum jong ki Amorites, bad sha ki jaka baroh kiba don ha ka ri, ha ki lum, bad ha ki lum, bad ha ka ri Sepngi, bad ha rud duriaw, haduh ka ri jong ki nong Kanaan, bad haduh ka wah bah Euphrates .

en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee , and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites , to give it , I say , to his seed , and hast performed thy words  ; for thou art righteous :
kha: Me shem ba u ïaineh ha me , bad me pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad u . Me kular ban ai ha u ïa ka ri ki Kanaan , ka ri jong ki Hit bad ki Amor , ka ri ki Peris , ki Jebus bad ki Girgash , kan long ka ri ha kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin shong kin sah . Me bat ïa la ka kular , namar me long uba ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to shem ia ka dohnud jong u kaba iaineh ha khmat jong me, bad phi la leh ia ka jutang bad u ban ai ia ka ri jong ki nong Kana, ki Hittite, ki Amorites bad ki Perizzite bad ki Jergashite, ban ai ia ka, nga ong, ha u symbai jong u, bad me la leh ia ki ktien jong me; namar me long uba hok:

en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the  Lord  , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites , and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands ? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams , the same may be a priest of them that are no gods .
kha: Phi beh noh shabar ïa ki lyngdoh ki jong U  Trai  , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , bad phi beh noh ïa ki Lebi . Ha ka jaka jong ki phi la thung ïa ki lyngdoh ha kajuh ka rukom ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki leh . Uno uno uba wanrah lang bad u masi ne hynñiew tylli ki langbrot u lah ban ïoh pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh jong kito kiba shu khot ki blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim shym la beh noh ia ki lyngdoh jong U Trai, ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron bad ki Lebi bad phi la pynlong ia phi ki lyngdoh katkum ka rukom jong ki jaitbynriew jong kiwei pat ki ri ? kumta uno uno uba wan ban pynkyntang ia lade da u masi bad hynriew tylli ki langbrot kiba dang rit , ujuh u lah ban long u lyngdoh na ki ki bym long blei .

en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and the priests , and the Levites , and all the people , great and small : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the  Lord .
kha: bad ryngkat lang ki leit sha ka Templ , ba la synran da ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad da baroh kiwei ki briew , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk kumjuh . Ha khmat jong ki baroh , u syiem u pule jam ïa ka kitab baroh jong ka jutang , kaba la shem ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la leit sha ka iing U Trai, bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem, bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad ki briew baroh: bad u la pule ha ki shkor jong ki ia ki ktien baroh jong ka Kitab ka jutang kaba la shem ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And they rose early in the morning , and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa : and as they went forth , Jehoshaphat stood and said , Hear me , O Judah , and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; Believe in the  Lord  your God , so shall ye be established  ; believe his prophets , so shall ye prosper .
kha: Dang step eh , ha ka sngi kaba bud , u paidbah u mih ban leit sha ka ri khlaw hajan Tekoa . Katba ki dang sdang leit , u Jehoshaphat u kren ïa ki da kine ki ktien :  Ko ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem ! Buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phin long skhem . Ngeit ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa phi bad phin jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng dang step, bad ki la leit sha ka ri khlaw Tekoa: bad katba ki dang leit sha khlaw: bad katba ki dang leit sha khlaw: bad katba ki dang leit sha khlaw: bad u Jehoshaphat u la ieng bad u la ong: To sngap ia nga ko Judah bad phi ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem; To ngeit ha U Trai U Blei jong phi, kumta phin sa pynskhem;

en: Fear ye not me ? saith the  Lord  : will ye not tremble at my presence , which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree , that it cannot pass it : and though the waves thereof toss themselves , yet can they not prevail  ; though they roar , yet can they not pass over it ?
kha: Nga long U  Trai  ; balei phim sheptieng ïa nga ? Balei phim khynñiuh ha khmat jong nga ? Nga la buh ïa u shyiap kum u pud jong ka duriaw , u pud uba neh ba kam lah ban jam palat . Ka duriaw ka lah ban kynting , hynrei kam lah ban leit palat ïa u ; ki jingat phyllung ki lah ban kyrhuh , hynrei kim lah ban ksam lyngba .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyntieng ia nga ? ong U Trai: hato phin ym khih ha khmat jong nga, kiba la buh ia u dewbilat na ka bynta u pud u sam jong ka duriaw da ka hukum bymjukut: bad wat la ki um jong ka ki iaid lait noh ia ka: bad wat la ki um jong ka ki iaid lait noh ia ka: hynrei hato kim lah ban jop; wat la ki iaid lait noh ia ka ?

en: And it shall be , as with the people , so with the priest  ; as with the servant , so with his master  ; as with the maid , so with her mistress  ; as with the buyer , so with the seller  ; as with the lender , so with the borrower  ; as with the taker of usury , so with the giver of usury to him .
kha: Uwei pa uwei un ïakynduh ïa kajuh ka kupar — ki lyngdoh bad ki briew , ki mraw bad ki kynrad , kiba thied bad kiba die , kiba ai kylliang bad kiba shim kylliang , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long kumjuh bad u lyngdoh kum bad u shakri, kumjuh ruh bad u kynrad jong u.

en: There is one alone , and there is not a second  ; yea , he hath neither child nor brother : yet is there no end of all his labour  ; neither is his eye satisfied with riches  ; neither saith he , For whom do I labour , and bereave my soul of good ? This is also vanity , yea , it is a sore travail .
kha: Hangne don uwei uba shong basah marwei . Um don khun shynrang lymne u para , pynban u ïai trei , um ju sngewhun ïa ka spah kaba u don . Na ka bynta jongno ba u trei shitom haduh katta katta bad ba u khanglad ïa lade hi na kano kano ka jingpynsngewbha ? Kane ruh ka long ka bymmyntoi — bad ka lynti ba-isangsot ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don uwei marwei, bad ym don u khun ne u hynmen: hynrei ym don jingkut na ka jingtrei shitom baroh jong u; hynrei ka khmat jong u kam sngewhun ia ka spah ; bad ka ong ba u long uba sngewsih ia ka mynsiem jong nga kaba bha ? Kane ruh ka long ka jinglehnohei , hooid ka long ka jingtrei shitom .

en: And I have heard of thee , that thou canst make interpretations , and dissolve doubts : now if thou canst read the writing , and make known to me the interpretation thereof , thou shalt be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about thy neck , and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom .
kha: Mynta nga la ïohsngew ba me lah ban shem ïa ki jingmut barieh bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan . Lada me lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga aïu ka kit jingmut , yn pynkup ïa me ha ki jaiñkup syiem ba sawbthuh , yn pyndeng ha me ïa u kynjri ksiar jong ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong me , bad men long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew na me, ba me lah ban pynkylla, bad pynkylla ia ki jingartatien: mynta lada me lah ban pule ia ka jingthoh bad pyntip ha nga ia ka jingbatai jong ka, men sa phong da ka rong saw bad men sa phong da ka kynjri ksiar sawdong ka ryndang jong me, bad men long u nongsynshar ba lai ha ka hima .

en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .
kha: Hynrei kynmaw , lada ki ïashongkurim bad ki shynrang kiba na kawei pat ka jait , ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kan long noh ka jong kata ka jait , bad ka bynta kaba dei ka jong ngi kan nang duna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki long kiba shongkurim bad uno uno na kiwei pat ki jait Israel , te yn shim noh ia ka pateng jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad yn buh ha ka pateng jong ka jaitbynriew ha kaba ki ioh: kumta yn shim noh ia ka na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: And the nations were angry , and thy wrath is come , and the time of the dead , that they should be judged , and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets , and to the saints , and them that fear thy name , small and great  ; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth .
kha: Kiba mane blei thala ki la dap da ka jingbitar shla , namar ka por jong ka jingbitar jong me ka la poi , ka por ban bishar ïa kiba ïap . Ka por ka la poi ban ainong ïa ki shakri jong me , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh , kito baroh kiba tiengburom ïa me , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh . Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa kito kiba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la bitar, bad ka por jong me ka la wan, bad ka por jong kiba iap, ba kin shah bishar, bad ba me dei ban ai ia ka bainong ha ki shakri jong me ki nongiathuhlypa bad ha ki riewkhuid bad ia kita kiba sheptieng ia ka kyrteng jong me, kiba rit bad kiba khraw bad me dei ban pynjot ia ki kiba pynjot ia ka khyndew .

en: They shall cast their silver in the streets , and their gold shall be removed : their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the  Lord  : they shall not satisfy their souls , neither fill their bowels : because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity .
