kha: Kin bret noh ïa la ka ksiar bad ka rupa ha ki lynti bah kum kiba la kyntait , namar ka ksiar lymne ka rupa kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba U  Trai  un theh noh ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u . Kin ym lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynhun ïa ka jingangnud jong ki ne pyndap ïa ki snier jong ki . Ka ksiar bad ka rupa ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingleh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin bret ia ka rupa jong ki ha ki lynti, bad ka ksiar jong ki kan jah noh: ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki kin ym lah ban pynpoi ia ki ha ka sngi ka jingbitar U Trai: kin ym pynhun ia ka mynsiem jong ki , lymne kin ym pyndap ia ki kpoh jong ki: namar ka long ka jingthang ia ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols , nor with their detestable things , nor with any of their transgressions : but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces , wherein they have sinned , and will cleanse them : so shall they be my people , and I will be their God .
kha: Kin ym pyntngit shuh ïa lade da ki bleithaw kiba ijli lane pynjot ïa lade da ka pop . Ngan pyllait ïa ki na ki lynti jong ka jingleh pop bad ka jingshetkylla ïa nga . Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki , kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym pynjakhlia shuh ia lade da ki bleithaw jong ki, ne da ki jingleh bymman jong ki: hynrei ngan pyllait im ia ki na ki jaka shong jong ki baroh: hynrei ngan pynim ia ki na ki jaka shong jaka sah jong ki: bad ngan pynkhuid ia ki: kumta kin long ki briew jong nga: bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .
kha: Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa ruh kiba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la wallam sha Babilon na ka Templ ha Jerusalem , dei ban pynphai pat sha ka jaka jong ki ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh ia ki tiar ksiar bad rupa jong ka iing U Blei, kiba u Neuchadnezzar u la shim na ka tempi kaba don ha Jerusalem bad la wanrah sha Babilon, bad la wanrah biang sha ka tempi kaba don ha Jerusalem, uwei pa uwei ha ka jaka jong u, bad u la buh ia ki ha ka iing U Blei .

en: And God said to Solomon , Because this was in thine heart , and thou hast not asked riches , wealth , or honour , nor the life of thine enemies , neither yet hast asked long life  ; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself , that thou mayest judge my people , over whom I have made thee king :
kha: U Blei u jubab ïa u Solomon ,  Me la jied ïa kaba dei . Ha ka jaka ka jingpan ïa ka spah lane ka jingkynshew lane ka nam lane ka jingïap jong ki nongshun jong me lane wat ka jingjlan jong ka jingim jong me , me la pan ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip khnang ba me lah ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga , kiba halor jong ki nga la thung syiem ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Solomon , Namar kane ka la don ha ka dohnud jong me, bad me khlem pan ia ka spah, ka spah ne ka burom ne ka jingim jong ki nongshun jong me, bad me khlem pan ia ka jingim kaba jrong ; hynrei me la pan ia ka jingstad bad ka jingtip na ka bynta lade, ba me lah ban bishar ia ki briew jong nga, halor kiba nga la pynlong syiem ia me:

en: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth–shean and her towns , and Ibleam and her towns , and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns , and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns , and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns , even three countries .
kha: Hapoh ka ri Issakhar bad Asher , ki Manasseh ki ïohkynti ïa ka Beth Shan bad ka Ibleam , lem bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki , kumjuh ruh ïa ka Dor ( kata kaba harud duriaw ) , ka Endor , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Manasseh u la don ha Issakha bad ha Asher Bethshean bad ki shnong jong ka, bad ki shnong jong ka, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Dork bad ki shnong jong ka, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Endor bad ki shnong jong ka, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Taak bad ki shnong jong ka, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Megiddo bad ki shnong jong ka, wat lai tylli ki ri jong ka.

en: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , Send away the ark of the God of Israel , and let it go again to his own place , that it slay us not , and our people : for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city  ; the hand of God was very heavy there .
kha: Kumta sa shisien pat ki khot lang ïa ki syiem Philistia baroh bad ki ong ,  Pynphai noh ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel sha ka jaka jong ka , ba kumta kan ym pynïap ïa ngi bad ïa ki longïing jong ngi .  La don ka jingkulmar baroh kawei ka nongbah namar ba U Blei u la pynshitom jur ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la phah bad ki la lum lang ia ki kynrad jong ki Philistia baroh, bad ki la ong: Pynduh noh ia ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel, bad pyllait noh ia ka sha la ka jong ka jaka, ba kan ym pyniap ia ngi, bad ki briew jong ngi: namar ka la don ka jingpynjot kaba pyniap briew ha baroh kawei ka nongbah; ka kti U Blei ka la khia bha hangta .

en: That thou mayest love the  Lord  thy God , and that thou mayest obey his voice , and that thou mayest cleave unto him : for he is thy life , and the length of thy days : that thou mayest dwell in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .
kha: To ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kohnguh bad ïaineh ha u ; te ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad ba me lah ban kohnguh ia ka sur jong u, bad ba me lah ban bat ia u: namar u long ka jingim jong me, bad ka jingjrong jong ki sngi jong me: ba me lah ban shong ha ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me, ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak, bad ha u Jakob, ban ai ia ki .

en: Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .
kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki Israel bad Judah :  Iehnoh noh ïa ki lynti kynriang bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , ïa kiba la don ha ka Aiñ kaba nga la ai ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kaba nga la aiti pateng ha phi lyngba ki shakri jong nga bad ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la sakhi pyrshah ia ki Israel bad pyrshah ia u Judah da ki nongiathuhlypa baroh bad da ki nongpeitkai baroh, da kaba ong: To phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong phi, bad to sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad ki ain jong nga baroh kiba nga la hukum ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi, bad kiba nga la phah sha phi da ki shakri jong nga ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .
kha: U Solomon u pynkyntang ïa ka jaka pdeng jong ka phyllaw , ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u ai ki jingkñia hangta ba la thang tylli , ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ na ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba ka duwan rnong ba u la thaw ka rit than ïa kine ki jingainguh baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Solomon u la pynkyntang ia ka pdeng jong ka iing U Trai: namar hangta u la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ka shini jong ki jingknia iasuk , namar ka jingknia ba la shna da u Solomon kam lah ban pdiang ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia doh bad ka shini .

en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing , and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation , because they are burned up , so that none can pass through them  ; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle  ; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled  ; they are gone .
kha: Nga la ong ,  Ngan ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ki lumbah bad jaw ummat na ka bynta ki jaka pynbamphlang , namar ki la tyrkhong , bad ym don mano mano ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ki . Ïa ka jingsawa ki jingri ym shym ïohsngew shuh ; ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw ki la phet bad kim don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki lum ngan shim ia ka jingiam bad ka jingsawa, bad na ka bynta ki jaka shong jaka sah jong ka ri khlaw, namar ba la thang ia ki, haduh ba ym don ba lah ban iaid lyngba jong ki ; bad ki briew kim lah ban iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki masi ; baroh ar ki sim bneng bad ki mrad ki la phet noh .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .
kha: Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u khlem don kano kano ka daw , hynrei u Job u ïailong hi uba ïaineh kumba u ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , Hato me la pyrkhat ia u shakri jong nga u Job, ba ym don u briew uba janai bad uba hok, uba sheptieng ia U Blei bad uba sngewsih ia ka jingsniew ? bad wat la u dang bat skhem ia ka jinglong ba janai jong u, wat la me pynkhih ia nga pyrshah ia u, ban pynjot ia u khlem daw .

en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he commanded you , and have gone and served other gods , and bowed yourselves to them  ; then shall the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you .
kha: Lada phim sumar ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi ban sumar bad lada phi shakri bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , kumta te ha ka jingbitar jong u , un pynshitom ïa phi , bad shen ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kane ka ri babha kaba u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda phi la pynkhein ia ka jutang U Trai U Blei jong phi, kaba u la hukum ia phi, bad phi la leit shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei, bad phi la dem khrup ha ki ; te ka jingbitar U Trai kan sa bthei pyrshah ia phi, bad phin sa jah noh kloi na ka ri kaba bha kaba u la ai ha phi .

en: And it was so on the morrow , that Saul put the people in three companies  ; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch , and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day : and it came to pass , that they which remained were scattered , so that two of them were not left together .
kha: Ha kata ka miet u Saul u pynbynta ïa u paidïapom jong u ha ki lai kynhun , bad ynda mynstep ki tur sha ka jaka shong dara ki nongshun bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Ammon . Ha ka por shiteng sngi ki la lah pynïap ïa ki . Kiba lait im ki phet ïap , marwei marwei ha la ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u Saul u la buh ia ki briew ha ki lai tylli ki kynhun; bad ki la wan rung hapdeng ki shipai ha ka por mynstep, bad ki la pyniap ia ki Ammon haduh ka jingshit jong ka sngi: bad ka la jia ba kita kiba sah ki la jah rngai noh, haduh ba arngut na ki kim shym la sah lang .

en: And Jehoash said to the priests , All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the  Lord  , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at , and all the money that cometh into any man s heart to bring into the house of the  Lord  ,
kha: U Joash u phah khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad u hukum ïa ki ban kynshew ïa ki pisa ba siew ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingkñia ha ka Templ , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingsiew ba dei na ka bynta ki jingkñia ba ju leh bad ka pisa ba ai kum ki jingai sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoash u la ong ha ki lyngdoh , Baroh ka pisa jong kiei kiei kiba la pynkyntang sha ka iing U Trai , wat ka pisa jong uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba ka account , ka pisa ba uwei pa uwei u la buh ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .
kha: Haba u syiem Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kane , u kdew ïa u bad u hukum ,  Kem ïa uto u briew !  Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka long kumba ïap haduh ba um lah pynkhun shuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem Jeroboan u la iohsngew ia ka jingkren jong u briew jong U Blei uba la pyrta pyrshah ia ka jingknia ha Betel, ba u la pynkhih ia la ka kti na ka jingknia, u da ong: To bat ia u. Bad ka kti jong u kaba u la pynkhih pyrshah ia u, ka la tyrkhong, haduh ba um lah ban tan biang ia ka shapoh jong u .

en: And Jonathan , Saul s son , had a son that was lame of his feet . He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel , and his nurse took him up , and fled : and it came to pass , as she made haste to flee , that he fell , and became lame . And his name was Mephibosheth .
kha: Uwei pat u nonghiarpateng jong u Saul , u dei u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan , uba la dap san snem ka rta mynba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la shah pynïap . Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap jong ki ka la wan poi na ka nongbah Jesreel , ka nongsumar jong u ka la rah ïa u bad ka phet krad ; hynrei namar ka jingkyrkieh palat ka la pynhap ïa u , bad u la kylla long uba dkoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la don u khun shynrang uba la tyrkhong ha ki kjat jong u . U la dap san snem ka rta haba ka khubor ka la wan na u Saul bad u Jonathan na Jesel, bad ka nurse jong u ka la shim ia u: bad ka la jia, katba ka dang kyrkieh ban phet noh, ba u la hap bad u la kylla lyngngoh . Bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Mephish .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against the shepherds  ; and I will require my flock at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the flock  ; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more  ; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth , that they may not be meat for them .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba nga long u nongshun jong phi . Ngan shim noh ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba phin long ki nongsharai jong ki ; ngan ym shah shuh ba phin sumar bha tang ïa lade . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi bad ngan ym shah ba phin bam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei baroh u ong: Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia ki nongaplangbrot jong nga ha ka kti jong ki, bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban sangeh noh ban ai bam ia ka kynhun; bad ki nongaplangbrot kin ym ai bam shuh ia lade; namar ngan pyllait noh ia ka kynhun jong nga na ka shyntur jong ki, ba kin ym long doh na ka bynta jong ki .

en: As for me , this is my covenant with them , saith the  Lord   ; My spirit that is upon thee , and my words which I have put in thy mouth , shall not depart out of thy mouth , nor out of the mouth of thy seed , nor out of the mouth of thy seed s seed , saith the  Lord  , from henceforth and for ever .
kha: Bad ngan pynlong ka Jutang bad phi : Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ki jinghikai jong nga kin long bad phi junom , bad naduh mynta phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad hikai ïa ki khun jong phi bad ïa ki pateng jong phi ban kohnguh ïa nga ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia nga pat kane ka long ka jutang jong nga bad ki, ong U Trai; ka mynsiem jong nga kaba don ha me, bad ki ktien jong nga kiba nga la buh ha ka shyntur jong me, wat mih na ka shyntur jong u symbai jong me, lane na ka shyntur jong u symbai jong me, ong U Trai, naduh mynta bad junom .

en: And the priests waited on their offices : the Levites also with instruments of musick of the  Lord  , which David the king had made to praise the  Lord  , because his mercy endureth for ever , when David praised by their ministry  ; and the priests sounded trumpets before them , and all Israel stood .
kha: Ki lyngdoh ki ïeng ha ki jaka ba la pynbeit na ka bynta jong ki ; bad ha pyrshah jong ki , ki ïeng ki Lebi , ki da ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ryngkat bad ki jingput jingtem ba u syiem Dabid u la pynkhreh bad ki ïarwai ïa ka jingrwai ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh junom !  kumba u Dabid u la bthah ïa ki . Ki lyngdoh ki put ïa ki turoi , katba ki paidbah baroh ki ïa-ïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh ki la ap ia ki kam jong ki: ki Lebi ruh da ki tiar ialeh jong U Trai, kiba u syiem u la leh ban iaroh ia U Trai, namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom, haba u Dabid u la iaroh da ka jingshakri jong ki bad ki lyngdoh ki la sawa ha khmat jong ki; bad ki Israel baroh ki la ieng .

en: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah . Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  did choose out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .
kha: U Rehoboam u khun jong u Solomon u la don sawphew wei snem ka rta mynba u sdang ban long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba U  Trai  u la jied na ka ri Israel baroh kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie u Rehoboam ka dei ka Naamah ka nong Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehoboam u khun u Solomon u la synshar ha Judah . U Rehoboam u la don sawphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem , ka shnong kaba U Trai u la jied na ki jait Israel baroh . Bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long ka Naamah ka Ammon .

en: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it lighter unto us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Kane ka dei kaei ba phin ong : ‘ Ka  tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla kiba la san bad u ki la kren ha u, ki da ong: Kumta to kren ia une u briew uba kren ha me, da kaba ong: U kpa jong me u la pynlong ia ka ban kham jem ha ngi; kumta me ong ha ki: Ka kti barit jong nga kan kham jem ban ia ki tyrpeng jong nga .

en: Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well  ; let him do the kinsman s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee , then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee , as the  Lord  liveth : lie down until the morning .
kha: Sah hangne baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por mynstep ngin sa wad la un shim jingkitkhlieh ne em na ka bynta jong phi . Lada ka long kumta , ka la bha ; lada kam long kumta , te nga smai ha U  Trai  Uba im ba ngan shim ïa ka jingkitkhlieh . Mynta to thiah bad sah hangne haduh mynstep .
translated_en_to_kha: Tarry mynta ka miet , bad kan long ha ka por mynstep , ba lada un leh ia ka bynta jong u khun masi: hynrei lada un ym leh ia ka bynta jong u khun masi ha me: te ngan leh ia ka bynta jong u khun masi ha me: thiah haduh ka por mynstep .

en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day , and I will forsake them , and I will hide my face from them , and they shall be devoured , and many evils and troubles shall befall them  ; so that they will say in that day , Are not these evils come upon us , because our God is not among us ?
kha: Te ngan bitar lep ïa ki ; ngan kyntait bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Shibun ki jingjynjar kiba sngewshyrkhei kin wan ngat ha ki , ba kumta kin sa sngewthuh ba kita kiei kiei ki wan jia ha ki namar ba nga , U Blei jong ki , ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka jingbitar jong nga kan sa bthei ha ki ha kata ka sngi , bad ngan iehnoh ia ki , bad ngan buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na ki , bad kin sa shah rong noh , bad bun ki jingsniew bad ki jingeh kin sa jia ha ki ; haduh ba kin ong ha kata ka sngi , Hato kine ki jingsniew kim wan ha ngi , namar ba U Blei jong ngi um don hapdeng jong ngi ?

en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u ïeng harud ka duwan . U la ai ka hukum :  Tied tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Templ haduh ba ka shyngkub baroh kawei kan da khih . Pynpait ïa ki bad ai ba kin hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynïap ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . Yn ym don u ban ïohphet ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia U Trai ba u ieng halor ka jingkhang: bad u la ong, Pynkhih ia ka lynti jong ka jingkhang: bad ot ia ki ha ka khlieh: bad ngan pyniap ia kiba khatduh na ki da ka waitlam: uta uba phet noh na ki un ym shah pyllait im .

en: Therefore wait ye upon me , saith the  Lord  , until the day that I rise up to the prey : for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms , to pour upon them mine indignation , even all my fierce anger : for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .
kha: Shu ap ,  U  Trai  u ong .  Ap ïa ka sngi haba ngan ïeng ban pynrem ïa ki jaitbynriew . Nga la pynbeit ïa la ka jingmut ban lumlang ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima khnang ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar shla jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ap ia nga, ong U Trai, haduh ka sngi ba ngan kiew sha ka jingbam: namar ka jingkut jingmut jong nga ka long ban lum ia ki jaitbynriew , ba ngan lum lang ia ki hima , ban theh halor jong ki ia ka jingbitar jong nga baroh: namar ka khyndew baroh kan shah bam noh da ka ding jong ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land : for they have heard that thou  Lord  art among this people , that thou  Lord  art seen face to face , and that thy cloud standeth over them , and that thou goest before them , by day time in a pillar of a cloud , and in a pillar of fire by night .
kha: kin sa ïathuh ïa kata ha ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Kine ki briew ki la lah ïohsngew ba me , A  Trai  , me don lem bad ngi , bad ba me paw ha kaba ïohi shai haba u lyoh jong me u sangeh halor jong ngi bad ba me leit ha shuwa jong ngi ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi bad u rishot ding mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin iathuh ha ki nongshong shnong jong kane ka ri: namar ki la iohsngew ba me Trai me long hapdeng kine ki briew, ba me Trai me la iohi ia me khmat khmat, bad ba u lyoh jong me u ieng halor jong ki, bad ba me leit ha khmat jong ki, ha ka por mynstep jong u lyoh bad ha u lum ding ha ka por miet .

en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty . And the third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and besought him , and said unto him , O man of God , I pray thee , let my life , and the life of these fifty thy servants , be precious in thy sight .
kha: Sa shisien pat u syiem u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah . U la leit kiew ïa u lum , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat u Elijah , bad u la ïasaid ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , to isynei ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga . To pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah biang ia u rangbah shiphew snem jong u. Bad u rangbah shiphew snem jong u u la kiew shaneng, bad u la wan bad u la dem khrup ha khmat u Elijah bad u la ong ha u: Ko briew jong U Blei, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba ka jingim jong nga bad ka jingim jong kine ki sanphew ngut ki shakri jong me, kan long kaba kordor ha khmat jong me .

en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir  ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions  ;
kha: U Joshua bad ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem baroh kiba ha ka ri kaba sha sepngi jong ka Jordan , naduh Baalgad ha Them Lebanon haduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang shathie hajan Edom . U Joshua u pynïabynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki jait Israel bad u ai ïa ka ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti baneh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki syiem jong ka ri kiba u Joshua bad ki khun Israel ki la iaid sha kane ka liang ka Jordan shaphang sepngi, naduh Baalgad ha ka them Lebanon haduh u lum Halak , kiba leit sha u lum Halak , kiba leit sha u lum Halak .

en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him , Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection , according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the  Lord  , and of the congregation of Israel , for the tabernacle of witness ?
kha: kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada , u nongïalam jong ki , bad u dawa ,  Balei ba phim peit ïa kane ba ki Lebi ki lum na Judah bad Jerusalem ïa ka khajna kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pan na ki briew ban siew ïa ka ban kyrshan ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la khot ia u rangbah shipai bad u la ong ha u, Balei phim shym la dawa na ki Lebi ban wanrah na Judah bad na Jerusalem ia ka jinglum jingtip kat kum ka hukum jong u Moses u shakri U Trai bad na ka kynhun Israel na ka bynta ka iing ka sem jong ki Israel ?

en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence  ; and the images , that were on high above them , he cut down  ; and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .
kha: Hapoh ka jingbthah jong u ïa ki duwan ha kaba la mane ïa u Baal la pynpra , bad ïa ki duwan jingiwbih hajan jong ki la pyntwa . Ki pynlwet kum ki pui pui ïa ki dur ka Asherah bad ïa kiwei ki bleithaw baroh bad nangta ki bret ïa u pui pui ha ki jingtep jong ki briew kiba la ai jingkñia ïa lade ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynpra ia ki nongleh kam sniew ha khmat jong u; bad ki dur kiba la don halor jong ki, u la ot ia ki dur ba la ker bad ki dur ba la ker bad ki dur ba la khleh lang .

en: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest , they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God , which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim , and of all the remnant of Israel , and of all Judah and Benjamin  ; and they returned to Jerusalem .
kha: Ka pisa kaba ki Lebi kiba long ki nongap phira ki la lum ha ka Templ la aiti ha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh . ( La lum ïa ka na ki briew ka Ephraim bad Manasseh bad kaba sah jong ka Hima bashatei , bad na ki paid Judah , Benjamin , bad Jerusalem . )
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha u Hilkiah u rangbah lyngdoh, ki la pynpoi ia ka pisa kaba la wanrah sha ka iing U Blei, kaba ki Lebi kiba la buh ia ki jingkhang ki la lum na ka kti u Manasseh bad u Ephraham bad na ki Israel baroh kiba sah jong ki Israel bad na ki Judah bad u Benjamin baroh .

en: Then there shall be a place which the  Lord  your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there  ; thither shall ye bring all that I command you  ; your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , your tithes , and the heave offering of your hand , and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the  Lord  :
kha: U  Trai  un jied tang kawei ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa u , bad hangta phi dei ban wanrah sha u ïa kata baroh kaba nga la hukum : ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa kawei na ka shiphew bad ki jingainguh jong phi , bad ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kan don ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi un jied ban pynlong ia ka kyrteng jong u ban shong hangta; te phin wanrah ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga hukum ia phi; bad ki jingknia thang jong phi, bad ki jingknia ba la jied jong phi:

en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .
kha: Ki rangbah ki bud ïa ki hukum jong u Joshua . Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , ki la shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel , ki la bah ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara , bad ki buh ïa ki hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh kumba u Joshua u la hukum, bad ki la shim shiphew tylli ki maw na pdeng ka Jordan, kumba U Trai u la kren ha u Joshua kat kum ka jingdon jong ki jait Israel, bad u la rah ia ki bad ki sha ka jaka ba ki la sahkut hangta .

en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that Elijah the prophet came near , and said ,  Lord  God of Abraham , Isaac , and of Israel , let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel , and that I am thy servant , and that I have done all these things at thy word .
kha: Ha ka kynta jong ka jingainguh ha ka por nohphai sngi , u Elijah nongïathuhlypa u wan sha ka duwan bad u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , U Blei u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , pynshisha mynta ba me long U Blei ki Israel bad ba nga long u shakri jong me bad ba nga la leh ïa kane baroh kat kum ka hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba la ai ia ka jingknia janmiet, u Elijah u nongiathuhlypa u la wan hajan bad u la ong: Ko Trai U Blei jong u Abraham, u Isaak bad ki Israel .

en: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised , which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war : and they have laid their swords under their heads , but their iniquities shall be upon their bones , though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living .
kha: Ym shym la ai ha ki ka jingtep donburom kum ïa ki riewshlur ha ki por mynbarim , kiba da kieng atiar bha haba ki leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ïa ki waitlam jong ki la buh hapoh ki khlieh jong ki bad ïa ki stieh jong ki halor ki met jong ki . Kine ki riewshlur ki la long shisien kiba khlaiñbor bha ban pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym thiah bad kiba khlain bor kiba la hap na ki bym pat shah ot, kiba la leit sha dujok da ki tiar thma jong ki: bad ki la buh ia ki waitlam jong ki hapoh ki khlieh jong ki , hynrei ki jingbymhok jong ki kin long halor ki shyieng jong ki , wat la ki long ki jingtieng jong kiba khlain bor ha ka ri jong kiba im .

en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal , all his servants , and all his priests  ; let none be wanting : for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal  ; whosoever shall be wanting , he shall not live . But Jehu did it in subtilty , to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal .
kha: Khot lang ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal baroh , ïa ki nongmane jong u baroh , bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh . Uwei ruh um dei ban pep ; nga ai ka jingkñia ainguh kaba khraw ha u Baal , bad uno uno uba jah un shah pynïap .  ( Kane ka long ka buit sianti ha ka liang jong u Jehu da kaba u mut ban pynïap lut ïa ki nongmane ïa u Baal . )
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to khot ia nga baroh ki nongiathuhlypa jong u Baal, bad ki lyngdoh jong u baroh kim shah shuh: namar nga don ka jingknia kaba khraw ban leh ia u Baal; uno uno uba kwah, un ym im . Hynrei u Jehu u la leh ia kata ha ka jinglong rit paid, ha ka jingthmu ba un pynjot ia ki nongmane ia u Baal .

en: For in mine holy mountain , in the mountain of the height of Israel , saith the Lord  God  , there shall all the house of Israel , all of them in the land , serve me : there will I accept them , and there will I require your offerings , and the firstfruits of your oblations , with all your holy things .
kha: Hangta ha ka ri , halor u lumbah bakhuid jong nga , u lumbah bajrong jong ka Israel , ma phi ki Israel baroh phin mane ïa nga . Ngan sngewbha eh bad phi bad ngan khmih lynti ïa phi ban wallam ha nga ïa ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa ki jingainguh bakynsai tam jong phi , bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha bakhuid jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha u lum bakhuid jong nga, ha u lum jong ki Israel, ong U Trai Blei, baroh ki long ha ka ri: hangta ngan pdiang ia ki, bad hangta ngan dawa ia ki jingknia jong phi, bad ki soh ba nyngkong jong phi, ryngkat bad kiei kiei baroh kiba khuid jong phi .

en: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month , on the fifteenth day of the month , like unto the feast that is in Judah , and he offered upon the altar . So did he in Beth–el , sacrificing unto the calves that he had made : and he placed in Beth–el the priests of the high places which he had made .
kha: U Jeroboam u seng ruh ïa ka jingkhawai niam ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba phra , kum ka jingkhawai niam kaba ha Judah . Ha ka duwan kaba ha Bethel u la kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha kita ki khun masi ksiar kiba u la shna , bad u buh hangta ha Bethel ïa ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane kiba u la tei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeroboan u la buh ia ka jingkhawai ha ka sngi kaba phra, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, kum ka jingkhawai kaba don ha Judah, bad u la ainguh halor ka jingbam . Kumta u la leh ha Bethesel, da kaba knia ia ki khun masi kiba u la leh: bad u la buh ha Bethesel ia ki lyngdoh jong ki jaka ba jrong kiba u la leh .

en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab–shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem . And they went up and came to Jerusalem . And when they were come up , they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool , which is in the highway of the fuller s field .
kha: U patsha ka Assyria u phah ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba bun na Lakhish ban tur ïaleh ïa u Hesekaïah ha Jerusalem ; hapoh ka jingai hukum ki lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ba-halor tam . Haba ki wan poi ha Jerusalem , ki pyndap ïa ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki trei , hajan ka nur-um kaba wan tuid um na ka pung ba haneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Assyria u la phah ia u Tartan bad u Rabsakh na U Trai Hesekaiah bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem . Ki la leit sha Jerusalem . Bad haba ki la wan shaneng ki la wan bad ki la ieng hajan ka wah kaba shalor kaba don ha ka lynti kaba kham jylliew .

en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province  ; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done , nor his fathers  fathers  ; he shall scatter among them the prey , and spoil , and riches : yea , and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds , even for a time .
kha: Un hiarthma khlem ka jingmaham ïa ka probins    jong ka ri bariewspah bad un leh ïa kiei kiei kiba ym don na ki kpa tymmen jong u kiba la ju leh . Nangta un pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongbud jong u ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingdon jingem kiba u la kurup ha ka thma . Un pynlong ki jingthmu ban tur ïaleh ïa ki kut , hynrei ka por jong u kan kut noh shen .
translated_en_to_kha: Un rung suk wat ha ki jaka ba heh tam jong ka jylla; bad un leh ia kaba ki kpa jong u kim shym la leh, ne ki kpa jong u; un pynphriang hapdeng jong ki ia ki mrad ba bam doh bad ki spah: hooid , bad un iathuh lypa ia ki jingthmu jong u pyrshah ia ki jingbat kiba khlain .

en: They shall die of grievous deaths  ; they shall not be lamented  ; neither shall they be buried  ; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth : and they shall be consumed by the sword , and by famine  ; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
kha: Kin ïap na ki jingpang bashyrkhei , bad ym don mano mano ba ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki lane tep ïa ki . Ki met jong ki kin long kum ki kynton sboh halor ka khyndew . Kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane ïap na ka jingïapthngan , bad ki met jong ki kin long ki jingbam ïa ki sim bad ïa ki mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin iap na ka jingiap kaba sngewsih ; kim dei ban iam ; hynrei kin long kum ka dewbilat ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew : bad kin shah bam ha ka waitlam, bad da ka jingkyrduh ; bad ki met iap jong ki kin long ka doh na ka bynta ki sim bneng bad na ka bynta ki mrad khlaw .

en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself , and to make him a name , and to do for you great things and terrible , for thy land , before thy people , which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?
kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kaba kum ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki , ki briew jong me hi . Kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki la pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng satlak ka pyrthei . Me la beh noh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki blei jong ki katba ki briew jong me ki nang ïaid shaphrang , ki briew ïa kiba me la pyllaitluid na Ijipt ban long ki jong me hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei ka jaitbynriew ha ka khyndew kaba kum ki briew jong me, wat kum ki Israel, kiba U Blei u la leit ban siewspah na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew ha lade, bad ban pynlong ia u ia ka nam, bad ban leh ia kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba shyrkhei na ka bynta jong me, ha khmat ki briew jong me, kiba me la siewspah ha me na Ijipt, na ki jaitbynriew bad ki blei jong ki ?

en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath , and bringing in sheaves , and lading asses  ; as also wine , grapes , and figs , and all manner of burdens , which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day : and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals .
kha: Ha kata ka por , nga ïohi ba ki briew ha Judah ki khñiot umsoh na ki sohwaiñ ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Kiwei pat ki dang kyntiew halor ki kada jong ki ïa u kew , ka waiñ , sohwaiñ , soh Khajur , bad kiwei kiei kiei bad leit rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem ; nga la maham ïa ki ban ym die ei ei ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi nga la iohi ha Judah katto katne ki jingkhynñiuh wain ha ka sngi Sabha, bad nga la wanrah ia ki jingbam ba la shet, bad ki jingbam ba la shet; bad ki sohjew bad ki sohjew baroh ki jait jingkit ba ki wanrah sha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Sabha: bad nga la sakhi pyrshah ia ki ha ka sngi ba ki die ia ki jingbam .

en: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the  Lord  , and the praises of the  Lord  , according to all that the  Lord  hath bestowed on us , and the great goodness toward the house of Israel , which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies , and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses .
kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka jingieit baïaineh jong U  Trai  ; ngan ïaroh ïa u ïa baroh kaba u la leh na ka bynta jong ngi . U la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa ki paid Israel namar ka jingisynei bad ka jingieit baneh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kdew ia ki jingieit jong U Trai bad ki jingiaroh jong U Trai katba U Trai u la ai ha ngi baroh , bad ka jingbha kaba khraw ia ka iing Israel kaba u la ai ha ki katba kum ki jingsngewrit jong u , bad kat kum ka jingbun jong ki jingieit jong u .

en: And Gideon said unto him , Oh my Lord , if the  Lord  be with us , why then is all this befallen us ? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of , saying , Did not the  Lord  bring us up from Egypt ? but now the  Lord  hath forsaken us , and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites .
kha: U Gideon u ong ha u ,  Kynrad , lada long ban kylli , balei kane ka wan jia ha ngi lada U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad ngi ? Jia aïu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla kiba ki kpa jong ngi ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba U  Trai  u ju leh — kumno u la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt ? U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi bad u la ieh ïa ngi ha ka jingisynei jong ki Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la ong ha u, Ah Trai jong nga, te ba kane baroh ka la jia ia ngi? bad shano ki kambah jong u baroh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la iathuh ha ngi, ki da ong: Hato U Trai um shym la wanrah ia ngi na Ijipt ? hynrei mynta U Trai u la iehnoh ia ngi bad u la aiti ia ngi ha ki kti jong ki nong Ijipt .

en: Until the  Lord  have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you , and they also have possessed the land which the  Lord  your God giveth them : then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it , which Moses the  Lord s  servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .
kha: haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha ki . Hadien ba u la pynïoh ïa ka jingshongshngain ïa ki jait Israel baroh , te phi lah ban wan phai pat bad shongsah hangne ha ka ri jong phi ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba U Trai un da ai ia ki hynmen jong phi ia ka jingjahthait kumba u la ai ha phi, bad ki ruh kin ioh ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha ki: nangta phin leit phai noh sha ka ri jong phi, bad phin sngewbha ia ka, kaba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la ai ha kane ka liang jong u Jordan sha ka liang jong ka sngi .

en: And I will set a sign among them , and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations , to Tarshish , Pul , and Lud , that draw the bow , to Tubal , and Javan , to the isles afar off , that have not heard my fame , neither have seen my glory  ; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles .
kha: Hynrei ngan pynsah katto katne na ki bad phah ïa ki sha ki jaitbynriew bad sha ki ri kiba jngai ki bym pat shym la ïohsngew ïa ka nam jong nga lymne ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong nga : sha Spain , sha Libya bad sha Lydia , ryngkat bad ki nongrah ryntieh kiba tbit , bad sha Tubal bad sha Gris . Hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhrawbor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka dak hapdeng jong ki, bad ngan phah ia kito kiba lait na ki sha ki jaitbynriew, sha u Tarshish, u Pul bad u Lud, kiba ring ia ka bow, sha u Tubal bad u Javan, sha ki dulir kiba jngai, ki bym shym la iohsngew ia ka nam jong nga, bad ki la pynbna ia ka burom jong nga; bad kin pynbna ia ka burom jong nga hapdeng ki Jutang .

en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake , and said , Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , who hath sent his angel , and delivered his servants that trusted in him , and have changed the king s word , and yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god , except their own God .
kha: U syiem u la ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ! U la phah ïa u angel jong u bad pyllait im ïa kine ki rangbah kiba la shakri bad shaniah ha u . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad ki la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban ïa kaba dem ngon bad mane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang u jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Neuchadnezzar u la kren bad u la ong, La kyrkhu ia U Blei jong u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego, uba la phah ia u angel jong u, bad u la aiti ia ki shakri jong u kiba la shaniah ha u, bad ki la pynkylla ia ka ktien jong u syiem, bad ki la aiti ia la ka met, ba kin ym shakri ne mane ia uno uno u blei, lait noh tang ia la u jong u Blei .

en: And it came to pass , when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  were come up out of the midst of Jordan , and the soles of the priests  feet were lifted up unto the dry land , that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place , and flowed over all his banks , as they did before .
kha: bad haba ki lyngdoh ki la poi ha ka rudwah , ka wah ka la sdang ban tuid biang bad ka la pynshlei ïa ki rud jong ka baroh sa shisien pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk jong U Trai ki la mih na pdeng ka Jordan , bad ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh ki la kiew sha ka ri kaba rkhiang , ba ki um Jordan ki la wan phai biang sha ka jaka jong ki , bad ki la tuid sha ki rud jong u baroh kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .

en: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week : and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease , and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate , even until the consummation , and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate .
kha: Uta u nongsynshar un don ka jingïateh kular kaba skhem bad kiba bun ki briew haduh hynñiew snem , bad haba shiteng na kane ka por ka la leit , un pynkut ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh . Ïa ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli yn buh ha ka jaka bajrong tam jong ka Templ bad kan sah hangta tad haduh ba uta uba buh ïa ka hangta u ïashem ïa kaba kut kaba U Blei u la lah pynkhreh na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynskhem ia ka jutang bad kiba bun shi taiew: bad ha ka por pdeng jong ka taiew un pynlong ia ka jingknia bad ka jingknia ban sangeh noh , bad na ka bynta ka jingpynphriang palat ia ki jingpynjot un pynlong ia ka ban jah noh , wat haduh ka jingpynjot , bad kata ka long kaba la buh ban theh ha ka jingjot .

en: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .
kha: U weng noh na ka kam ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ki syiem Judah ki la pynkyntang ban ai jingkñia halor ki duwan ba-thala ha ki nongbah ka Judah bad ha ki jaka hajan Jerusalem ― ïa baroh ki lyngdoh kiba ai jingkñia sha u Baal , sha ka sngi , u bnai , ki metbneng , bad ki khlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki lyngdoh kiba don ki bleithaw, kiba ki syiem Judah ki la buh ban thang jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong ha ki nongbah Judah , bad ha ki jaka sawdong ka Jerusalem; ki ruh kiba thang jingiwbih sha Baal , sha ka sngi bad sha u bnai bad sha ki planet bad sha ki kynhun bneng baroh .

en: Therefore the princes said unto the king , We beseech thee , let this man be put to death : for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people , in speaking such words unto them : for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .
kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong ,  Ïa une u briew dei ban pynïap . Da kaba u kren kumne , u pynlong ïa ki shipai ha ka nongbah ban duh noh ïa ka jingshlur , bad u leh kumjuh ïa uwei pa uwei baroh ba dang sah ha ka nongbah . Um shym pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ki paidbah ; u kwah tang ban pynmong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki rangbah ki la ong ha u syiem: Ngi kyrpad ia me, to ai ba une u briew un shah pyniap: namar kumta u pyntlot ia ki kti jong ki shipai kiba sah ha kane ka shnong bad ki kti jong ki briew baroh: namar une u briew um wad ia ka jingbha jong une u briew .

en: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness : they walked not in my statutes , and they despised my judgments , which if a man do , he shall even live in them  ; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted : then I said , I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness , to consume them .
kha: Hynrei wat ha ka ri shyiap ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad ki la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , kiba wallam jingim ïa uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki . Ki la pyntngit khoit ïa ka Sabbaton . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha ka ri shyiap bad ban pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka iing Israel ka la leh pyrshah ia nga ha ka ri khlaw: kim shym la iaid ha ki ain jong nga, kiba lada u briew u leh kumta un im ha ki ; bad ki sngi saitjain jong nga ki la pynjakhlia shibun: nangta nga la ong, ngan theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki ha ka ri khlaw, ban bam ia ki .

en: And it came to pass , when they brought out those kings unto Joshua , that Joshua called for all the men of Israel , and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him , Come near , put your feet upon the necks of these kings . And they came near , and put their feet upon the necks of them .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki rangbah ka Israel baroh bad u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai kiba la leit ryngkat bad u ban wan bad buh ïa la ki kjat ha ki ryndang jong ki syiem . Ki la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki la wanrah ia kita ki syiem sha u Joshua, ba u Joshua u la khot ia ki rangbah Israel baroh, bad u la ong ha ki rangbah shipai kiba la leit ryngkat bad u, To wan hajan, to buh ia ki kjat jong phi ha ki ryndang jong kine ki syiem . Ki la wan hajan bad ki la buh ia ki kjat jong ki ha ki ryndang jong ki .

en: And Absalom answered Joab , Behold , I sent unto thee , saying , Come hither , that I may send thee to the king , to say , Wherefore am I come from Geshur ? it had been good for me to have been there still : now therefore let me see the king s face  ; and if there be any iniquity in me , let him kill me .
kha: U Absalom u jubab ,  Namar ba phim wan haba nga la phah khot ïa phi . Nga la kwah ïa phi ban leit sha u syiem bad ban kylli na ka bynta jong nga : ‘ Balei nga dei ban iehnoh ïa ka Geshur bad wan hangne ? Kan jin da la kham bha ïa nga ban sah hangta .’   U Absalom u bteng ,  nga kwah ïa phi ban pynbeit ïa nga ban ïohi ïa u syiem , bad lada nga la kit pop , te shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la jubab ia u Joab , Ha khmih nga la phah sha me, nga la ong, To wan hangne, ba ngan phah ia me sha u syiem, ban ong, Balei nga wan na Geshur ? ka la long kaba bha ia nga ban dang don hangta: mynta to ngan iohi ia ka khmat jong u syiem; bad lada don ka jingbymhok ha nga, to un pyniap ia nga .

en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to your tents , O Israel : and now , David , see to thine own house . So all Israel went to their tents .
kha: Haba kita ki briew ki ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki pyrta jam ,  Keiñ noh ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha la ïing ! Ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi na ka bynta ïa lade .  Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïaleh pyrshah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki Israel baroh ki la iohi ba u syiem un ym sngap ia ki, ki briew ki la jubab ia u syiem, ki da ong: Ngi don ka pateng ha u khun u Jesse: uwei pa uwei u briew ha ki ïingjaiñ jong phi, ko Israel: bad mynta, ko Dabid, to peit ia la ka jong ka ïing . Kumta baroh ki Israel ki la leit sha la ki ïingjaiñ .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel , the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea : and it shall stop the noses of the passengers : and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude : and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba kane baroh ka jia , ngan ai ïa u Gog ka jaka tep hangta ha Israel , ha ka them ki nongleit jingleit , shaphang mihngi ka Duriaw Baïap ; hangta yn tep ïa u Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ïa ka them yn khot ïa ka , ‘ Ka them ka kynhun shipai u Gog .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba ngan ai ha u Gog ia ka jaka tep ha Israel, ka them jong ki nongleit jingleit shaphang mihngi jong ka duriaw: bad kan pynsangeh ia ki shyntur jong ki nongleit jingleit: bad hangta kin tep ia u Gog bad ia u paidbah jong u baroh: bad kin khot ia ka ka ka them jong u Hamongog .

en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria , saying , The nations which thou hast removed , and placed in the cities of Samaria , know not the manner of the God of the land : therefore he hath sent lions among them , and , behold , they slay them , because they know not the manner of the God of the land .
kha: La ïathuh ïa u patsha ka Assyria ba ki briew kiba u la pynshongduh ha ki nongbah ka Samaria kim shym la tip ïa ki aiñ jong u blei jong kata ka ri , bad kumta u blei u la phah ïa ki sing , kiba la pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ki la kren ha u syiem Assyria, ki da ong: Ki jaitbynriew kiba me la weng noh bad kiba me la buh ha ki nongbah jong ka ri: namarkata u la phah ia ki sing hapdeng jong ki bad, ha khmih, ki pyniap ia ki, namar kim tip ia ka rukom U Blei jong ka ri .

en: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me : they walked not in my statutes , neither kept my judgments to do them , which if a man do , he shall even live in them  ; they polluted my sabbaths : then I said , I would pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness .
kha: Hynrei kata ka pateng bynriew ruh ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kim shym la bat ïa ki hukum jong nga , kiba wallam jingim ha uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki . Ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha ka ri shyiap bad ban pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ki khynnah ki la leh pyrshah ia nga: kim shym la iaid ha ki ain jong nga, lymne ki jingbishar jong nga ban leh ia ki, kiba lada u briew u leh kumta un im wat ha ki ; ki la pynjakhlia ia ki sngi saitjain jong nga: nangta nga la ong , ngan theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki, ban pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ia ki ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And testifiedst against them , that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law : yet they dealt proudly , and hearkened not unto thy commandments , but sinned against thy judgments , ( which if a man do , he shall live in them  ; ) and withdrew the shoulder , and hardened their neck , and would not hear .
kha: Me maham ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me , hynrei ha ka jingsarong ki kyntait ïa ki hukum jong me , wat la kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim . Kiba mutlop bad kiba ehrang , ki kyntait ban kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynshisha pyrshah ia ki, ba me lah ban wanrah biang ia ki sha ka hukum jong me: hynrei kim shym la sngap ia ki hukum jong me, hynrei ki la leh pop pyrshah ia ki jingbishar jong me, (kiba lada u briew u leh kumta, un im ha ki ; ) bad un weng noh ia ka tyrpeng jong ki, bad un ym iohsngew ia ki hukum jong me .

en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the  Lord  by the hand of the priests the Levites , whom David had distributed in the house of the  Lord  , to offer the burnt offerings of the  Lord  , as it is written in the law of Moses , with rejoicing and with singing , as it was ordained by David .
kha: U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ . Ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba la bynshet ha ki da u syiem Dabid bad ban thang ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ai sha U  Trai  kat kum ka Aiñ u Moses . Ki la peit ruh ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ïa ka jinglehkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u Jehoiada u la thung ia ki kam jong ka iing U Trai da ka kti jong ki lyngdoh kiba u Dabid u la sam ha ka iing U Trai , ban aiti ia ki jingknia thang jong U Trai kumba la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses , da ka jingkmen bad da ka jingrwai kumba la buh da u Dabid .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Son of man , mark well , and behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the  Lord  , and all the laws thereof  ; and mark well the entering in of the house , with every going forth of the sanctuary .
kha: Nga la dem pyllup ha ka khyndew , bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko khun u briew , shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh ba me ïohi bad ïohsngew . Ngan ïathuh ïa me ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ka Templ . Khmih bha ïa kiba kumno ki briew la shah ban leit shapoh bad mih shabar ka Templ bad ïa kiba kumno ki briew ym shah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga, Ko khun u briew, to buh dak bha, bad ha khmih da ki khmat jong me, bad to iohsngew da ki shkor jong me baroh kiba nga ong ha me shaphang ki jinglong baroh jong ka iing U Trai, bad ki ain baroh jong ka; bad to buh dak bha ia ka jingrung shapoh ka iing .

en: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him , Turn , and slay the priests of the  Lord   ; because their hand also is with David , and because they knew when he fled , and did not shew it to me . But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u ong ha ki nongap kiba ïeng hajan jong u ,  Pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  ! Ki la ïasylla bad u Dabid bad kim shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba u la phet , wat la ki la tip ïa ka baroh shi katta .  Hynrei ki nongap kim treh ban rah ïa la ka kti ban pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki nongleit jingleit kiba ieng sawdong jong u, To phai noh bad pyniap ia ki lyngdoh U Trai ; namar ba ka kti jong ki ruh ka don bad u Dabid , bad namar ba ki tip haba u la phet noh , bad kim shym la pyni ia ka ha nga . Hynrei ki shakri jong u syiem kin ym pynkhih ia ka kti jong ki ban hap ha ki lyngdoh U Trai .

en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him , Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high , and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon : then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet . And the thing pleased Haman  ; and he caused the gallows to be made .
kha: Kumta ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh ki ai jingmut ,  Balei ba phim shna da ka diengphasi kaba arphew ar mitar ka jingjrong ? La shai mynstep phi lah ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien ïa u Mordekai halor jong ka , bad nangta sa leit sha ka jingkhawai da kaba kmen .  U Haman u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long kaba dei , kumta u la phah thaw ïa ka diengphasi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Seresh ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh ha u, To ai ba un long u nonglehkai sanphew cubit, bad ban sdang ia ka jingkren ha u syiem ba u Mordecai u lah ban shah pynsangeh ha kata ka por: nangta to leit sha ka jingkhawai bad u syiem ha ka jingkhawai . Bad kata ka jingjia ka la pynlong ia u Haman bad u la pynlong ia ki jingkren bein .

en: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers : so shalt thou find in the book of the records , and know that this city is a rebellious city , and hurtful unto kings and provinces , and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time : for which cause was this city destroyed .
kha: ba phin hukum ban wad ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la buh . Lada phi leh kumta , phin shem ba kane ka nongbah ka la long borabor kaba ïaleh pyrshah bad ba naduh ki por mynhyndai , ka la ju ai jingshitom ïa ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar ki jylla . Ka long borabor kaba eh ban synshar ïa ki briew jong ka . Dei na kane ka daw ba ïa ka nongbah la pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka jingwad ka lah ban long ha ka kot jong ki kot ki sla jong ki kpa jong me: kumta men shem ha ka kot ki kot ki sla , bad to tip ba kane ka shnong ka long ka nongbah kaba leh pyrshah ia ki syiem bad ki jylla , bad ba ki la iaid lyngba hapoh kajuh ka por barim: namar kata ka daw la pynjot ia kane ka nongbah .

en: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together , and to stand for their life , to destroy , to slay , and to cause to perish , all the power of the people and province that would assault them , both little ones and women , and to take the spoil of them for a prey ,
kha: Kine ki shithi ki batai ba u syiem u shah ïa ki Jiw ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ban ïalumlang para ma ki ban ïada ïa lade . Lada ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ha kano kano ka probins ki tur ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Jiw , ïa ki khun jong ki ne ïa ki kynthei jong ki , ki Jiw ki lah ban ïaleh pyrshah bad pynjot ïa kiba wan ïaleh pyrshah ; ki lah ban pynïap ïa baroh na ki bad shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u syiem u la ai ia ki Jiw kiba don ha man la ka shnong ban ialum lang bad ban ieng na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki, ban pynjot , ban pyniap bad ban pynlong ia ka jingduh noh ia ka bor jong ki briew bad ka jylla baroh kawei kaba lah ban hiar thma ia ki, baroh arngut ki khynnah rit bad ki kynthei bad ban shim ia ka jinglute jong ki na ka bynta ka jinglute , .

en: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king s forest , that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house , and for the wall of the city , and for the house that I shall enter into . And the king granted me , according to the good hand of my God upon me .
kha: Nga kyrpad ruh ïa ka shithi sha u Asaph , u nongsumar ïa ki khlaw u syiem , da kaba bthah ïa u ban ai ïa nga ki dieng na ka bynta ki khyrdop ka kut kaba ïada ïa ka Templ , na ka bynta ki kynroh ka nongbah , bad na ka bynta ka ïing kaba ngan shong ngan sah . U patsha u la ai ïa nga ïa baroh kaba nga pan , namar U Blei u la long ryngkat bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shithi sha u Asaph u nongsumar khlaw jong u syiem, ba un ai dieng ia nga ban shna dieng na ka bynta ki khyrdop jong ka iing bad na ka bynta ka kynroh jong ka shnong bad na ka bynta ka iing kaba nga rung shapoh . Bad u syiem u la ai ia nga kat kum ka kti babha jong U Blei jong nga halor jong nga .

en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the  Lord  slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , being males  ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .
kha: Haba u Pharaoh u mutlop bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ngi ban leit , U  Trai  u la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt , uba na u briew bad na u mrad ruh . Dei namar kata ba ngi kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  ïa uwei pa uwei uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad , hynrei ngi pyllait pat ïa la ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Pharaoh um ju pyllait ia ngi, ba U Trai u la pyniap ia u khun nyngkong baroh ha ka ri Ijipt: namarkata nga knia ha U Trai ia baroh kiba plie ia ka matrix , ki shynrang baroh kiba dang kha khun nyngkong jong nga nga siewspah .

en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it somewhat lighter for us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Kane ka dei kaei ba phin ong ha ki : ‘ Ka  tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla kiba la shah pynsan bad u ki la kren ha u, ki da ong: Kumta me jubab ia ki briew kiba kren ha me, da kaba ong: U kpa jong me u la pynlong ia ka ban kham jem katto katne na ka bynta jong ngi; kumta me ong ha ki: Ka kti barit jong nga kan kham jem ban ia ki tyrpeng jong u kpa jong nga .

en: Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
kha: Ym dei namar ka hok jong phi ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki , hynrei ka long namar ka jingbymman jong kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la beh krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi ; ba un pynskhem ïa la ka kular ba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym na ka bynta ka hok jong me, ne na ka bynta ka jinglong hok jong me, to leit bat ia ka ri jong ki: hynrei na ka bynta ka jingsniew jong kine ki jaitbynriew U Trai U Blei jong me u beh noh ia ki na khmat jong me, bad ba un leh ia ka ktien kaba U Trai u la sngap jar ia ki kpa tymmen jong me, u Abraham, u Isaak bad u Jakob .

en: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .
kha: To phai bad to ud , ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , kum ka briew ka ban sa kha khun , naba mynta phin sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban im ha rudnong . Phi dei ban leit sha Babilon , hynrei hangta U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To long ha ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingtrei shitom ban kha khun, ko khun jong u Seion, kum ka kynthei kaba kha khun: namar mynta men leit noh na ka nongbah, bad me shong ha ka lyngkha, bad me leit sha Babilon; hangta me shah pyllait im; hangta u Trai un pyllait im ia me na ka kti ki nongshun jong me .

en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest , and before Joshua the son of Nun , and before the princes , saying , The  Lord  commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren . Therefore according to the commandment of the  Lord  he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father .
kha: Ki la leit sha u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad sha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun bad sha ki nongïalam , bad ki ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ai ïa ngi , kumjuh ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing shynrang jong ngi , shi bynta jong ka ri ban ïohkynti .  Kumta , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , la ai jaka ha ki lem bad ha ki ba-ha-ïing shynrang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan hajan u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad ha khmat u Joshua u khun u Nun bad ha khmat ki rangbah ki da ong: U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses ban ai pateng ia ngi hapdeng ki hynmen jong ngi . Kumta kat kum ka hukum U Trai u la ai pateng ia ki hapdeng ki hynmen jong ki .

en: Then Achish called David , and said unto him , Surely , as the  Lord  liveth , thou hast been upright , and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight : for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day : nevertheless the lords favour thee not .
kha: U Akhish u khot ïa u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Nga smai ha U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba phi long uba hok ïa nga ; bad nga hi nga sngewdei ba phin leit ryngkat bad nga sha ka thma ; naba ngam shym la shem kano kano ka jingbakla ha phi naduh ka sngi ba phi wan sha nga haduh kane ka sngi . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem kim pdiang ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Achish u la khot ia u Dabid bad u la ong ha u, Hooid, kumba U Trai u im, me la long uba hok, bad ka jingleit jong me bad ka jingwan jong me ha ka kynhun shipai ka long kaba bha ha nga: namar ngam shym la shem ia ka jingsniew ha me naduh ka sngi ba me wan sha nga haduh kane ka sngi: wat la katta ruh ki kynrad kim sngewbha ia me .

en: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel , who was shut up  ; and he said , Let us meet together in the house of God , within the temple , and let us shut the doors of the temple : for they will come to slay thee  ; yea , in the night will they come to slay thee .
kha: Hamar kane ka por , nga leit ban jngoh ïa u Shemaïah , u khun jong u Delaïah bad u ksiew jong u Mehetabel , u bym shym lah ban mih na ïing jong u . U ong ïa nga ,  Ma phi bad nga , ngi dei ban ïaleit bad rieh lang ha ka Jaka Kyntang jong ka Templ bad khang tala ïa ki jingkhang , namar kin wan ban pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata nga la wan sha ka iing u Shemiah u khun u Mehetabel, uba la shah set phatok bad u la ong: To ngin ia iakynduh lang ha iing U Blei, hapoh ka tempi: namar kin wan pyniap ia me ; yea, ha ka por miet kin wan pyniap ia me .

en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount , the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron , and said unto him , Up , make us gods , which shall go before us  ; for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u Moses um pat shym wan hiar na u lum hynrei u la sah slem hangta , ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u Aaron , bad ki la ong ha u ,  Ngim tip satia ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , uba la ïalam ïa ngi ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta to thaw ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la iohi ba u Moses u la slem ban wan hiar na u lum, ki briew ki la ialum lang ha u Aaron, bad ki la ong ha u, To leh ia ngi ki blei, ki ban leit shuwa jong ngi; namar ia une u Moses, u briew uba la wanrah ia ngi na ka ri Ijipt, ngim ju leh ia kaei kaba la jia ia u .

en: Go , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah , concerning the words of the book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is poured out upon us , because our fathers have not kept the word of the  Lord  , to do after all that is written in this book .
kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U  Trai  na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba dang sah ha Israel bad Judah . Wad bniah shaphang ki jinghikai na kane ka kitab . U  Trai  u bitar ïa ngi namar ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka ktien U  Trai  bad kim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba kane ka kitab ka ong ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit , kylli ia U Trai na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta kito kiba sah ha Israel bad ha Judah: namar ka long kaba khraw ia ka jingbitar U Trai kaba la theh halor jong ngi , namar ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la bat ia ka ktien U Trai , ban leh katba la thoh ha kane ka kot .

en: And when Asa heard these words , and the prophecy of Oded the prophet , he took courage , and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin , and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim , and renewed the altar of the  Lord  , that was before the porch of the  Lord .
kha: Haba u Asa u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïathuhlypa ba u Asaraïah u khun jong u Oded u la kren , u la ïoh mynsiem . U la pynkynriah noh ïa ki bleithaw baroh ha ka ri Judah bad Benjamin bad baroh ki bleithaw ha ki nongbah kiba u la kurup ha ka ri lum Ephraim . U tei pynbha ruh ïa ka duwan U  Trai  kaba ïeng ha phyllaw jong ka templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa u la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien bad ka jingiathuhlypa jong u Oded u nongiathuhlypa, u la shim ia ka jingshlur bad u la weng noh ia ki bleithaw kiba sngewsih na ka ri Judah bad ka ri Benjamin baroh kawei bad na ki nongbah kiba u la shim na u lum Ephraim bad u la pynthymmai ia ka jingknia U Trai kaba don ha khmat ka phyllaw jong U Trai .

en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .
kha: Ki nongrah-khubor ki la rah ïa kane ka jingpynbna sha kawei pa kawei ka probins jong ka hima . Ka don ki jingbthah ba tang ha kawei ka sngi , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , ïa baroh ki Jiw — samla bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei ban pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlem jingisynei bad ba ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki dei ban shim noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la phah ia ki shithi da ki post sha ki jylla baroh jong u syiem, ban pynjot, ban pyniap bad ban pynlong ia ki Jiw baroh, kiba dang rit bad kiba dang rit, ha kawei ka sngi, wat ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba arphew, uba long u bnai Adar, bad ban shim ia ka jinglute jong ki na ka bynta ka jinglute .

en: But after they had rest , they did evil again before thee : therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies , so that they had the dominion over them : yet when they returned , and cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies  ;
kha: Haba ka jingsuk ka la wan , ki leh pop biang , bad me shah biang ïa ki nongshun ban jop ïa ki . Pynban ki kylla-kaba-mut bad kyrpad ïa me ban pynim ïa ki , ha bneng me ïohsngew , bad na ka por sha ka por me pyllait ïa ki ha ka jingisynei bakhraw jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ba ki la shongthait, ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat jong me: namarkata me la iehnoh ia ki ha ka kti ki nongshun jong me: hynrei haba ki la wan phai bad ki la pyrta ha me: hynrei haba ki la wan phai sha me: me la iohsngew ia ki na bneng bad bunsien me la pyllait im ia ki kat kum ka jingsngewsih jong me;

en: And there came in two men , children of Belial , and sat before him : and the men of Belial witnessed against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , Naboth did blaspheme God and the king . Then they carried him forth out of the city , and stoned him with stones , that he died .
kha: Kita ki ar ngut ki riewrunar ki kynnoh pyrshah ïa u ha khmat u paidbah ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem . Bad kumta la sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ha ban da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki arngut ki briew ki la wan rung ha khmat jong u: bad ki briew kiba la shah pyniap ki la sakhi pyrshah ia u, wat pyrshah ia u Naboth, ha khmat ki briew, ki da ong: U Naboth u la kren bein ia U Blei bad ia u syiem . Nangta ki la rah ia u shabar na ka nongbah bad ki la pyniap ia u da ki maw .

en: This day will the  Lord  deliver thee into mine hand  ; and I will smite thee , and take thine head from thee  ; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air , and to the wild beasts of the earth  ; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel .
kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi U  Trai  un aiti ïa me hapoh ka bor jong nga ; ngan pynkyllon ïa me bad ngan khrai ïa ka khlieh jong me . Bad ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki shipai Philistia ha ki sim bad ha ki mrad ba kin bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka sngi U Trai un aiti ia me ha ka kti jong nga; bad ngan shim ia ka khlieh jong me na me; bad ngan ai ia ki met iap jong ki Philistia ha kane ka sngi ha ki sim jong ka Iyer bad ha ki mrad khlaw jong ka khyndew; ba ka khyndew baroh kan tip ba don U Blei ha Israel .

en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .
kha: U shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la thmu tang ban buh ïa u kew jingkñia bad ka jingiwbih , ki tiar ki tar ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , bad kiba shiphew na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba ai sha ki Lebi , ki nongtem nongput ka Templ , bad ki nongap phira ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong u ia ka kamra kaba heh, ha kaba ki la buh ia ki jingknia doh, ki jingbam ba la shet bad ki khiew bad ki jingbam ba la shet ha ki kper bad ka umphniang ba la hukum ban ai ha ki Lebi bad ki nongrwai;

en: And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Namar ba ki Syria ki ong ba nga long u blei jong ki lum bad ym jong ki jaka madan , ngan sa ai jingjop ïa phi halor ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong ki , bad ma phi bad ki briew jong phi kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: U briew jong U Blei u la wan bad u la kren ha u syiem Israel bad u la ong: Kumta u ong U Trai , Namar ki nong Syria ki la ong , U Trai u long U Blei jong ki lum , hynrei um dei u Blei jong ki them , namarkata ngan aiti ia une u paidbah uba bun ha ka kti jong me , bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .
kha: Hynrei u Asahel um shym sangeh ; kumta u Abner , da ka jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum , u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u . U Asahel u kyllon ïap ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wan poi ha ka jaka ha kaba u kyllon u la sangeh bad ïeng hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la kyntait ban phai noh: namar kata u Abner da ka tduh kaba khanglad ia u hapoh ka ryndang kaba phra, ba u khnam u la mih noh hadien jong u bad u la hap hangta; bad u la iap ha kajuh ka jaka: bad ka la jia ba kiba la poi sha ka jaka ba u Ashael u la hap bad u la iap ki la ieng .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , to him whom man despiseth , to him whom the nation abhorreth , to a servant of rulers , Kings shall see and arise , princes also shall worship , because of the  Lord  that is faithful , and the Holy One of Israel , and he shall choose thee .
kha: U Blei Bakhuid bad u nongpynim ki Israel u ong ïa uta uba shah ibeiñ , ïa uba la isih da ki jaitbynriew bad uba long u shakri jong ki nongsynshar :  Ki syiem kin ïohi ba la pyllait ïa me bad kin ïeng ban pynpaw ïa ka jingñiewburom jong ki ; ki khun syiem ruh kin ïohi ïa kata , bad kin dem khrup ban pyndonburom ïa me .  Kane kan jia namar U  Trai  u la jied ïa la u shakri ; U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel u bat ïa la ki kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai , U Nongsiewspah jong ki Israel bad U Bakhuid jong u, ha uta uba u briew u sngewsih, ha uta uba ka jaitbynriew ka sngewsih, ha u shakri jong ki nongsynshar, ki Syiem kin iohi bad ki mih ki rangbah ruh kin mane ia me, namar U Trai uba iaineh bad U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And the  Lord  shall return his blood upon his own head , who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he , and slew them with the sword , my father David not knowing thereof , to wit , Abner the son of Ner , captain of the host of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the host of Judah .
kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa u Joab na ka bynta kito ki jingpynïap , kiba u la leh khlem ka jingtip u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Joab u la pynïap ar ngut ki rangbah balui lui kiba kham bha ban ïa u — u Abner , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel , bad u Amasa , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynphai biang ia ka snam jong u ha la ka jong ka khlieh, kaba la hap halor arngut ki briew kiba kham hok bad kham bha ban ia u, bad u la pyniap ia ki da ka waitlam, u kpa jong nga u Dabid u bym tip ia kata, ban wad ia u Abner u khun u Ner, u khliehduh jong ki Israel, bad u Amasa u khun u Amasa, u khliehduh jong ka Judah .
