en: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets : and it came to pass , when the people heard the sound of the trumpet , and the people shouted with a great shout , that the wall fell down flat , so that the people went up into the city , every man straight before him , and they took the city .
kha: Kumta ki lyngdoh ki put ïa ki turoi . Uta u paidbah , u tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata , u la risa jam , bad kita ki kynroh ki la khyllem . Te ki shipai baroh ki leit beit beit sha u lum sha kata ka nongbah bad ki kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew ki la pyrta haba ki lyngdoh ki la pyrta da ki turoi: bad ka la jia , haba ki briew ki la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ka turoi , bad ki briew ki la pyrta da ka jingsawa kaba khraw , ba ka kynroh ka la hap noh shapoh nongbah , kumta ki briew ki la leit shapoh nongbah , uwei pa uwei u briew u la leit shapoh nongbah .

en: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom , that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace , to the house of the women , unto the custody of Hege the king s chamberlain , keeper of the women  ; and let their things for purification be given them :
kha: Phi lah ban thung ki rangbah synshar ha man ki probins    jong ka hima bad hukum ïa ki ban wallam ïa baroh kine ki samla kynthei ba-bhabriew sha ka ïing ki kynthei jong phi hangne ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima . Buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingkhmih jong u Hegai , u ïunukh uba peit halor ki kynthei jong phi , bad ban ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba u syiem un thung ia ki ophisar ha ki jylla baroh jong ka hima jong u, ba kin lum lang ia ki khun samla kiba itynnad baroh sha Shushan ka iing syiem, sha ka iing jong ki kynthei, ha ka jaka sumar jong u Hege u syiem, u nongsumar ia ki kynthei; bad ai ba kin ai ia ki ia ki tiar jong ki ban pynkhuid:

en: Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa la ki briew bad u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lumbah kin khynñiuh bad ïa ki met jong kito kiba la ïap yn ieh ha ki lynti kum ka synrum . Pynban wat la katta ruh ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  ym shym la pynkut , hynrei ka kti jong u kan ïai kner ban pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki briew jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia ki: bad ki lum ki la khih , bad ki met iap jong ki ki la tyrkhong hapdeng ki surok . Na ka bynta kine baroh ka jingbitar jong u kam shym la kylla , hynrei ka kti jong u ka dang iaid shabar .

en: Therefore as I live , saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , Surely Moab shall be as Sodom , and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah , even the breeding of nettles , and saltpits , and a perpetual desolation : the residue of my people shall spoil them , and the remnant of my people shall possess them .
kha: Kumba shisha nga long U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga smai ba ka Moab bad ka Ammon kin shah pynjot kum ka Sodom bad Gomorrah . Kin long ka jaka jong ki thliew mluh bad ki jingjot bymjukut , kaba la tap da ki ñiut . Kito na ki briew jong nga kiba lait im kin lute ïa ki bad shim ïa ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata katba nga dang im, ong U Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel, Hooid un long kum u Sodom, bad ki khun Ammon kum u Gomorrah, wat ka jingkha khun ki bniat bad ki umsoh bad ka jingpynjot bymjukut: ka jingsah jong ki briew jong nga kan pynjot ia ki, bad ki briew jong nga kin don ia ki .

en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them . And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley . So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .
kha: U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ammon bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u bad u jop ïa ki . Nangta u pynbor ïa ki Ammon ban siew ïa u ka khajna man ka snem haduh lai snem kumne : lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shihajar ton u kew , bad shihajar ton u barli .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ialeh ruh bad u syiem jong ki Ammon bad u la jop ia ki . Ki khun Ammon ki la ai ha u ha kajuh ka snem shispah talent ka rupa, bad shi hajar tylli ki jingthew kew bad shi hajar tylli ki barli . Kumta ki khun Ammon ki la siew ia u, ha ka snem kaba ar bad kaba lai .

en: And they burn unto the  Lord  every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense : the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table  ; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof , to burn every evening : for we keep the charge of the  Lord  our God  ; but ye have forsaken him .
kha: Man ka step bad man ka janmiet ki ai ha u ïa ki jingiwbih bad ki mrad jingkñia ba la thang tylli . Ki ai ïa ki jingainguh kpu ha ka miej kaba la pynkyntang khuid , bad man ka janmiet ki thang ïa ki sharak ha ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar . Ngi leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum , hynrei phi , phi la iehnoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki thang ia ki jingknia ba la thang bad ka jingiwbih ba thiang man ka step bad man ka janmiet: ka jingbam ba la shet ruh ki buh ha ka miej kaba khuid; bad ka sharak ksiar ryngkat bad ki sharak ksiar jong ka: ban thang man ka janmiet: namar ngi bat ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong U Trai U Blei jong ngi; hynrei phi la iehnoh ia u .

en: And a man s uncle shall take him up , and he that burneth him , to bring out the bones out of the house , and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house , Is there yet any with thee ? and he shall say , No . Then shall he say , Hold thy tongue : for we may not make mention of the name of the  Lord .
kha: U ba-ha-ïing jong u briew uba ïap , uta uba dei khmih ïa ka jingleit ontep , un sei shabar ïa ka metïap na ka ïing . Uba ha ïing un khot ïa uno uno ba dang sah hapoh ïing ,  Dang don mano mano bad phi hangto ?  Ka sur kan jubab ,  Em !  nangta u ba-ha-ïing un sa ong ,  Sngap jar ! Ngi dei ban sumar wat ban ym ong ei ei ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u briew u dei ban shim ia u, bad uta uba thang ia u, ban pynmih ia ki shyieng na ka iing, bad un ong ha uta uba don hajan ka iing, Hato don shuh bad me? bad un ong, Em . Nangta un ong, To bat ia ka shyntur jong me: namar ngim lah ban kdew ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And when they were departed from him , ( for they left him in great diseases , ) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest , and slew him on his bed , and he died : and they buried him in the city of David , but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings .
kha: U la mynsaw jur , bad haba ki nongshun ki la leit noh , ar ngut ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka jingthiah jong u ban pynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u khun jong u Jehoïada , u lyngdoh . La tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leit noh na u , (namar ki la iehnoh ia u ha ki jingpang kiba khraw), ki shakri jong u hi ki la thmu pyrshah ia u namar ka snam jong ki khun shynrang jong u Jehoiada u lyngdoh bad ki la pyniap ia u ha ka jingthiah jong u: bad ki la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid , hynrei kim shym la tep ia u ha ki jingtep jong ki syiem .

en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them , they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies , and precious jewels , which they stripped off for themselves , more than they could carry away : and they were three days in gathering of the spoil , it was so much .
kha: U Jehoshaphat bad ki shipai jong u ki leit bad lute , bad ki shem bun ki jingri , ki mar ki mata , ki jaiñ ki nep bad kiwei ki mar baremdor . Ki pynlut lai sngi ban lum ïa ka jinglute , hynrei la don bun palat haduh ba kim lah shuh ban rah lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Jehoshaphat bad ki briew jong u ki la wan ban shim noh ia ka jingjot jong ki, ki la shem hapdeng jong ki ha ka jingbun ki spah bad ki met iap bad ki mawkordor kiba kordor, kiba ki la weng noh na ka bynta lade, kham palat ia kaba ki lah ban rah: bad ki la long lai sngi ha kaba lum ia ka jingjot: bad ki la long haduh katta katta .

en: Then said the princes of the Philistines , What do these Hebrews here ? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines , Is not this David , the servant of Saul the king of Israel , which hath been with me these days , or these years , and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day ?
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia haba ki ïohi ïa ki , ki kylli ,  Kine ki Hebru ki wan leh aïu hangne ?  U Akhish u jubab ,  Une u dei u Dabid , uba ju long u shakri jong u Saul , u syiem Israel . La kham slem mynta u la don ryngkat bad nga . Naduh ba u la wan phet sha nga , haduh kane ka sngi , ngam shym lap ba u la leh bakla ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah jong ki Philistia ki la ong: Kiei kine ki Hebru hangne ? U Akhis u la ong ha ki rangbah jong ki Philistia , Hato une u Dabid u shakri u Saul u syiem Israel uba la don bad nga ha kine ki sngi ne kine ki snem bad ngam shym la lap ia ka jingbakla ha u naduh ba u la hap ha nga haduh kine ki sngi ?

en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon , she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem , with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
kha: Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingkylli kiba eh . Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki musla , ki mawkordor , bad shibun ka ksiar . Haba ka la ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli lut ïa baroh ki jingkylli kat kiba don ha ka jingmut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka mahadei ka Sheba ka la iohsngew ia ka nam u Solomon , ka la wan ban pynshisha ia u Solomon da ki jingkylli kiba eh ha Jerusalem , bad ki kulai kiba khlem akor shibun , bad ki ksiar kiba bun bad ki maw kiba kordor: bad haba ka la wan sha u Solomon , ka la iakynduh bad u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka dohnud jong ka .

en: The beast that thou sawest was , and is not  ; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit , and go into perdition : and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder , whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world , when they behold the beast that was , and is not , and yet is .
kha: Uta u mradkhlaw u la ju im shisien , hynrei um shym im shuh ; u la jan wan kiew na ka liewlong khlem trai bad un mih ban shah pynjot . Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab jong kiba im ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , kin ïasngew kyndit lut katba ki dang khmih ïa u mradkhlaw . U la ju im shisien ; mynta um shym im shuh , hynrei un wan mih biang .
translated_en_to_kha: U mrad uba me la iohi u la long, bad um long shuh bad un kiew na ka thliew bym don shapoh, bad kin leit sha ka jingjot: bad kita kiba shong ha ka khyndew kin lyngngoh , kiba la thoh kyrteng ha ka Kitab ka jingim naduh ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei , haba ki iohi ia uta u mrad uba la long , bad um long kumta .

en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the  Lord  of hosts of a people scattered and peeled , and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden under foot , whose land the rivers have spoiled , to the place of the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the mount Zion .
kha: Ka por ka wan haba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pdiang ïa ki jingainguh na kane ka ri ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , ki briew kiba jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha ka pyrthei baroh . Kin wan sha u Lum Seïon , ha kaba la mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por yn wanrah ia ka mynta sha U Trai jong ki paid, bad na ka jaitbynriew kaba shyrkhei naduh ba ki sdang; ka jaitbynriew ka la mih bad ka la iaid hapoh ka kjat jong ki, ha ka jaka jong ka kyrteng U Trai jong ki paid, ka Mount Seion .

en: And the elders of the Jews builded , and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo . And they builded , and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel , and according to the commandment of Cyrus , and Darius , and Artaxerxes king of Persia .
kha: Ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la pynïaid bha ïa ka jingtei ïa ka Templ , ba la ai jingpynshlur da ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah . Ki pyndep ïa ka Templ kumba la hukum da U Blei ki Israel bad da u Syros , u Darius bad u Artakserksis , ki patsha ka Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ki Jiw ki la tei bad ki la roi lypa da ka jingiathuhlypa jong u Haggai u nongiathuhlypa bad u Sekharaiah u khun jong u Iddo . Ki la tei bad pyndep ia ka kat kum ka hukum U Blei ki Israel bad kat kum ka hukum jong u Cyrus bad u Darius bad u Artaxerxes u syiem ka Persia .

en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be multiplied and increased in the land , in those days , saith the  Lord  , they shall say no more , The ark of the covenant of the  Lord  : neither shall it come to mind : neither shall they remember it  ; neither shall they visit it  ; neither shall that be done any more .
kha: Nangta haba phi la ïaroi bun ha kata ka ri , ki briew kin ym ïakren shuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang jong nga . Kin ym pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka lane kynmaw ïa ka ; kin ym donkam shuh ïa ka , lymne kin ym shna sa kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, haba phi la nang bun bad nang bun ha kata ka ri, ha kita ki sngi, ong U Trai, kin ym ong shuh: Ka synduk ka jutang U Trai: lymne kan ym wan ha ka jingmut: lymne kin ym kynmaw ia ka; lymne kin ym leit jngoh ia ka; lymne kin ym leh ei ei shuh .

en: After this I saw in the night visions , and behold a fourth beast , dreadful and terrible , and strong exceedingly  ; and it had great iron teeth : it devoured and brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with the feet of it : and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it  ; and it had ten horns .
kha: Katba nga dang ap khmih , u mradkhlaw uba saw u la mihpaw . U la long uba khrawbor , uba ingiew bad uba ishyrkhei . Da ki bniat nar bakhraw jong u , u khñiot pynlwet ïa ki ba u la ïoh , bad nangta u la kyrdem halor jong ki . Ym kum kita kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw , u la don shiphew tylli ki reng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane nga la iohi ha ki jingphohsniew miet, bad ha khmih u mrad uba saw, uba shyrkhei bad uba shyrkhei palat bad u don ki bniat nar kiba khraw: u la bam bad u la bthei ha ki bynta ba sah bad ki kjat jong u: bad u la long uba pher na ki mrad baroh kiba don ha khmat jong u ; bad u don shiphew tylli ki bniat nar .

en: And it came to pass the same year , in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the fourth year , and in the fifth month , that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet , which was of Gibeon , spake unto me in the house of the  Lord  , in the presence of the priests and of all the people , saying ,
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka snem , ha u bnai uba san jong ka snem kaba saw ba u Sedekaïah u long syiem , u Hananaïah u khun jong u Assur , u nongïathuhlypa na ka shnong Gibeon , u la kren ha nga ha ka Templ . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki lyngdoh bad ki paidbah u la ong ïa nga
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka snem, ha kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah, ha ka snem kaba saw, bad ha ka taiew kaba phra, ba u Hananiah u khun u Asur u nongiathuhlypa uba long na Gibeon, u la kren ha nga ha ka iing U Trai, ha khmat ki lyngdoh bad ki briew baroh, u da ong:

en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the  Lord  against Baasha , and against his house , even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the  Lord  , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam  ; and because he killed him .
kha: Kata ka khubor na U  Trai  pyrshah ïa u Baasha bad ïa ka longïing jong u la ai da u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa namar ki pop ba u Baasha u la leh pyrshah ïa u  Trai . U la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  ym tang namar ki kam bymman ba u la leh , kumba u syiem Jeroboam u la leh ha shuwa jong u , hynrei ruh namar ba u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Jeroboam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh da ka kti jong u nongiathuhlypa Jehu u khun u Hanani u la wan ka ktien U Trai pyrshah ia u Basah bad pyrshah ia ka iing jong u, wat na ka bynta ka jingsniew baroh kaba u la leh ha khmat U Trai, ha kaba u la pynkhih ia u ban bitar da ka kam jong ki kti jong u, ha kaba u long kum ka iing u Jeroboiah ; bad namar ba u la pyniap ia u .

en: And Asa cried unto the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , it is nothing with thee to help , whether with many , or with them that have no power : help us , O  Lord  our God  ; for we rest on thee , and in thy name we go against this multitude . O  Lord  , thou art our God  ; let not man prevail against thee .
kha: U Asa u duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u ,  A  Trai  , me lah ban ïarap ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba tlot da kaba suk kum kaba khlaiñ . Ïarap ïa ngi mynta , Ko  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , namar ba ngi shaniah ha me , bad ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la mih ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai kaba bun . A  Trai  , me long U Blei jong ngi ; ym don u ban kyrmen ban jop ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa u la pyrta ha U Trai U Blei jong u, bad u la ong, ko Trai, kam long ei ei bad me ban iarap, la ka long bad kiba bun ne bad ki ki bym don bor: iarap ia ngi: ko Trai jong ngi; namar ngi shongthait ha me, bad ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi leit pyrshah ia une u paidbah . Ko Trai, me long U Blei jong ngi; wat ai ba u briew un jop ia me .

en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon  ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .
kha: Kumta phah ïa ki rangbah jong me sha Lebanon ban pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar na ka bynta jong nga . Ki rangbah jong nga kin ïatreilang bad ki , bad ngan siew ïa ki rangbah jong me kat kaba me pynbeit . Kumba me tip bha , ki rangbah jong nga kim tip kumno ban pynngat ïa ki dieng kumba ki jong me ki tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta me hukum ba kin iaid lyngba ia ki diengsoh na Lebanon bad ki shakri jong nga kin don bad ki shakri jong me: bad ha me ngan ai bai lutksan na ka bynta ki shakri jong me katba me buh: namar me tip ba ym don hapdeng jong ngi uba lah ban tih dieng kum ki Sidonian .

en: The burden of the beasts of the south : into the land of trouble and anguish , from whence come the young and old lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses , and their treasures upon the bunches of camels , to a people that shall not profit them .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor jong U Blei shaphang ki mrad jong ka ri shyiap bashathie :  Ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki ïaid lyngba ka ri bashyrkhei , ha kaba ki sing ki don bad ha kaba ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki Ïakjakor kiba her . Ki pynkit halor ki kada bad ki ut jong ki da ki jingai sngewbha baremdor na ka bynta ka hima ka bym lah ban ai ïa ki kano kano ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong ki mrad ba rit: sha ka ri jong ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih, na kaba u sing uba dang rit bad uba la tymmen, u bsein uba her bad uba her ding , kin rah ia ka spah jong ki ha ki tyrpeng jong ki kada kiba dang rit bad ki spah jong ki ha ki tyrpeng jong ki kulai kiba dang rit .

en: And it came to pass , that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath , I commanded that the gates should be shut , and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath : and some of my servants set I at the gates , that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day .
kha: Kumta nga la ai hukum ban khang ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ha kaba sdang jong kawei pa kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , tang shu sdang ka por janmiet , bad ban ym plie biang haduh ba ka sngi Sabbaton ka la kut . Nga la pynap katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ha ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ban ym don jingwanrah ei ei shapoh ka nongbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ki khyrdop Jerusalem ki la sdang ban dum ha khmat ka sngi Sabha , nga la hukum ba ki khyrdop kin ym plie haduh ka sngi Sabha: bad katto katne na ki shakri jong nga ki la buh ia nga ha ki khyrdop , ba ym dei ban wanrah ia ka jingkit ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: But a prophet of the  Lord  was there , whose name was Oded : and he went out before the host that came to Samaria , and said unto them , Behold , because the  Lord  God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand , and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven .
kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Oded , u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  ; u shong ha ka nongbah Samaria . U ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel kaba wan phai bad ki koidi Judia hamar ba kin rung sha ka nongbah bad u ong :  U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la bitar ïa ki Judah , bad u la shah ïa phi ban jop ; hynrei mynta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglehbeiñ palat jong phi ba phi pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei u nongiathuhlypa jong U Trai u la don hangta, uba la tip kyrteng kum u Oddd: bad u la leit shabar ha khmat ki shipai kiba la wan sha Samaria, bad u la ong ha ki: Ha khmih , namar ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la bitar ia u Judah , u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong phi , bad phi la pyniap ia ki ha ka jingbitar kaba poi sha bneng .

en: And he sought Ahaziah : and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , ) and brought him to Jehu : and when they had slain him , they buried him : Because , said they , he is the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the  Lord  with all his heart . So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom .
kha: La pynlong ka jingleit wad bniah ïa u Ahasaïah , bad la shem ïa u ba u rieh ha Samaria . Ki la leit lam ïa u sha u Jehu bad pynïap ïa u . Hynrei ki la tep ïa ka met jong u naba ki burom ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat u kparad jong u , uba la leh kat kaba u lah ban shakri ïa U  Trai . Ym don uno uno u dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Ahasaïah uba dang sah uba lah ban synshar ïa ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wad ia u Ahasaiah : bad ki la kem ia u, (namar u la buhrieh ha Samaria), bad ki la wanrah ia u sha Jehu: bad haba ki la pyniap ia u: Namar, ki la ong, u long u khun u Jehoshaphat uba la wad ia U Trai da ka dohnud jong u baroh . Kumta ka iing u Ahasaiah kam don bor shuh ban bat ia ka hima .

en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said , It is the man of God , who was disobedient unto the word of the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  hath delivered him unto the lion , which hath torn him , and slain him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake unto him .
kha: Haba uta u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u ïohsngew ïa kata , u ong ,  Utai u dei u nongïathuhlypa uba la lyndet ïa ka hukum U  Trai . Bad kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa u sing uba la patar bad pynïap ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u nongiathuhlypa uba la wanrah biang ia u na ka lynti kaba u la iohsngew ia ka, u la ong: U long u briew jong U Blei uba khlem kohnguh ia ka ktien U Trai: namarkata U Trai u la aiti ia u ha u sing uba la pynmong ia u bad u la pyniap ia u kat kum ka ktien U Trai .

en: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren , our children as their children : and , lo , we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants , and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already : neither is it in our power to redeem them  ; for other men have our lands and vineyards .
kha: Ngi long na kajuh ka jaitbynriew kum ki para Jiw jong ngi . Hato ki khun ki kti jong ngi kim long kumjuh kum ki jong ki ? Hynrei ngi la hap ban pynlong mraw ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi . Ïa ki katto katne ki khun kynthei jong ngi , la lah die ïa ki kum ki mraw . Ngim donbor ei ei namar ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ la shim noh na ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ka doh jong ngi ka long kum ka doh jong ki hynmen jong ngi, ki khun jong ngi kum ki khun jong ki: bad, ha khmih , ngi wanrah ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ngi ban long ki shakri , bad katto katne na ki khun kynthei jong ngi ki la shah pynlong mraw mynta: bad kam don ha ka bor jong ngi ban siew kylliang ia ki; namar kiwei pat ki briew ki don ki jaka bad ki kper sohjew jong ngi .

en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large , unto a land flowing with milk and honey  ; unto the place of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites .
kha: bad kumta nga la wan ban pyllait ïa ki na ki nong Ijipt bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt sha kata ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh , kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ha kaba ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib bad ki Jebus ki shong mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga wan hiar ban pyllait ia ki na ka kti jong ki nong Ijipt, bad ban wanrah ia ki na kata ka ri kaba bha bad kaba heh, sha ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ; haduh ka jaka jong ki nong Kanaan, bad ki Hit , bad ki Amorit , bad ki Perizi bad ki Hebus .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them : because I have spoken unto them , but they have not heard  ; and I have called unto them , but they have not answered .
kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam halor jong phi ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ïa baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga la kular . Ngan leh ïa kane namar phim shym la shahshkor haba nga la kren ha phi , bad phim shym la jubab haba nga la khot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel; Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba nga la pynpaw pyrshah ia ki: namar nga la kren ha ki: hynrei kim shym la iohsngew ia ki; bad nga la khot ia ki: hynrei kim shym la jubab .

en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the  Lord  , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering , which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Nangta un tah snam khyndiat ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan ka jingiwbih thang kaba hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . U dei ban theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh thang kiba don ha khmat jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un buh katto katne ka snam ha ki bniat jong ka jingainguh kaba thiang ha khmat U Trai , kaba don ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng ; bad un theh ia ka snam baroh ha trai jong ka jaka thang kaba don ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .
kha: Lada me kohnguh tylli ïa nga , me im hapoh ki hukum jong nga , bad me ïoh ïa ka jingmynjur jong nga da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum , kumba u Dabid u shakri jong nga u la leh , ngan ïai don ryngkat bad me . Ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba kiba hiarpateng na me kin synshar hadien jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, lada me sngap ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga hukum ia me, bad phin leh ia kata ha khmat jong nga, ban sumar ia ki ain bad ki hukum jong nga, kumba u Dabid u shakri jong nga u la leh; ba ngan long bad me, bad ngan tei ia me ia ka iing kaba skhem, kumba nga la tei na ka bynta u Dabid, bad ngan ai ia ki Israel ha me .

en: And refused to obey , neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them  ; but hardened their necks , and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage : but thou art a God ready to pardon , gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and forsookest them not .
kha: Ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ; ki la klet ïa baroh kaba me la leh ; ki la klet noh ïa ki kambah kiba me la leh . Ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki la jied u nongïalam ban ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei me long U Blei uba map ; me long uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingieit , uba suki ban bitar . Ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw ; mem shym iehnoh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kyntait ban kohnguh, wat la phi pyrkhat ia ki jingphylla jong me kiba me la leh hapdeng jong ki; hynrei ha ka jingleh pyrshah jong ki u la thung ia u kapten ban leit phai sha ka jinglong mraw jong ki: hynrei me long U Blei uba kloi ban map, uba sngewrit bad uba isynei, uba slem ban bitar, bad uba sngewbha shibun, bad uba khlem sangeh ia ki .

en: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly , saying , Let me go , I pray thee , and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and no man shall know it : wherefore should he slay thee , that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered , and the remnant in Judah perish ?
kha: Te u Johanan u la ong ha kaba rieh ha u ,  Ai ba ngan leit ban pynïap ïa u Ishmael , bad yn ym don batip mano ba la leh ïa kata . Balei ba yn shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa phi ? Kata kan pynlong ïa ki Jiw baroh kiba ïalum sawdong jong phi ban shah pynsakma , bad kan wallam ïa ka jingjot ha baroh ki briew ïa kiba la pynsah ha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Johanan u khun u Krea u la kren rieh ha ka ri Mizpah, u da ong, To ngan leit noh, nga kyrpad ia me, bad ngan pyniap ia u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah, bad ym don mano mano ruh ban tip ia kata: namar kata u dei ban pyniap ia me, ba ki Jiw baroh kiba la lum lang ha me kin sa jah noh ?

en: And the  Lord  sent an angel , which cut off all the mighty men of valour , and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria . So he returned with shame of face to his own land . And when he was come into the house of his god , they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword .
kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u angel uba pynap ïa ki shipai bad ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria . Te u patsha u leit phai pat sha Assyria ha ka jinglehrain . Ha kawei ka sngi haba u dang don ha ka templ jong U Blei jong u , katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pynïap ïa u da la ki waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phah ia u angel uba la ot noh ia ki briew kiba khlain bor baroh, bad ki nongialam bad ki rangbah ha ka jaka sah jong u syiem Assyria . Kumta u la wan phai noh da ka jingsngewlehrain sha la ka jong ka ri . Bad haba u la wan rung shapoh ka iing jong u blei jong u , kito kiba la mih na ki bniat jong u hi ki la pyniap ia u hangta da ka waitlam .

en: And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .
kha: Nangta u ai sa kawei ka hukum :  Khie leit sha ki briew bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki langbrot hangne . Ki dei ban pynïap ïa ki bad bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .  Kumta ha kata ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki pynïap ïa ki hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong: Pynphriang ia lade hapdeng ki briew, bad ong ha ki, To wanrah ia nga hangne uwei pa uwei u masi jong u, bad uwei pa uwei u langbrot jong u, bad to pyniap ia ki hangne, bad to bam ia ki ; bad wat leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai da kaba bam ia ka snam . Bad ki briew baroh ki la wanrah ia u masi jong u bad u ha kata ka miet .

en: And it was so , when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all : for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . Thus did Job continually .
kha: Ha man ka step kaba bud jong ka jingkhawai , u Job u ju khie dang step bad u ai ïa ki jingkñia na ka bynta iwei pa iwei na ki khun jong u ban pynkhuid ïa ki . U ju leh ïa kane borabor namar u pyrkhat ba ïoh iwei na ki i leh pop da kaba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei khlem poi pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, haba ki sngi jong ka jingkhawai jong ki ki la iaid kylleng, ba u Job u la phah bad u la pynkyntang ia ki, bad u la ieng mynstep, bad u la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang kat kum ka jingbun jong ki baroh: namar u Job u la ong, Lehse ki khun jong nga ki la leh pop, bad ki la tim ia U Blei ha ki dohnud jong ki . Kumta u Job u la iai bteng .

en: And at that time shall Michael stand up , the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people : and there shall be a time of trouble , such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time : and at that time thy people shall be delivered , every one that shall be found written in the book .
kha: U angel uba kup ki jaiñ linen u la ong ,  Ha kata ka por , u Mikhael , u angel uba khraw , uba ïada ïa ki briew jong me , un mihpaw . Nangta kan don ka por ki jingjynjar , kaba kham sniew tam naduh ba ki jaitbynriew ki mih . Haba kata ka por ka wan , baroh ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong me kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha ka kitab ka jong U Blei yn pynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka por u Michael un ieng, u rangbah uba khraw uba ieng na ka bynta ki khun jong me: bad kan don ka por jong ka jingjynjar, kumba ym pat ju don ka jaitbynriew wat haduh kata ka por: bad ha kata ka por jong me yn sa pynpoi ia u briew jong me, uwei pa uwei uba la lap ha ka kot .

en: And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee , and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree : the flaming flame shall not be quenched , and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .
kha: Ong ïa ka khlaw bashaphang shathie ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : Ha khmih ! Nga pynmeh ïa ka ding , bad kan thang khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng ha phi , la uba jyrngam ne uba tyrkhong . Yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka . Kan pur na shathie haduh shatei , bad uwei uwei baroh un sngew ïa ka jingkhluit ki thylliej ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ka khlaw jong ka thain shatei lam mihngi , To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , ngan thang ia u dieng uba jyrngam ha me , bad u dieng uba rkhiang baroh: ka ding kaba rkhiang kan ym shah thang , bad ki khmat baroh na shaphang shathie haduh shaphang shathie .

en: Then the princes , the governors , and captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up  ; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up .
kha: Haba kine ki rangbah synshar baroh ki la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang bad ba ki la ïeng ha khmat jong ka durbriew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah, ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah, ki nongbishar, ki nongshong shnong, ki nongai jingmut , ki nongshong shnong bad ki nongsynshar baroh ki la ialum lang ha ka jingpynkyntang ia ka dur kaba u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem u la buh; bad ki la ieng ha khmat ka dur kaba u Neuchadnezzar u la buh .

en: Then was the iron , the clay , the brass , the silver , and the gold , broken to pieces together , and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors  ; and the wind carried them away , that no place was found for them : and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain , and filled the whole earth .
kha: Kumta hi ka nar , ka dewbyrtha , ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki la khyllem bad ki la long kum u pui pui ha ka jaka shoh kew ha ka por lyiur . Ka lyer ka la kit noh ïa u , khlem da pynsah dien ei ei . Hynrei u maw u la san ban long u lumbah uba tap ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka nar, ka dewbilat, ka nar, ka rupa bad ka ksiar, ka la tyrkhong lang, bad ka la kylla long kum ka sniehdoh jong ki jingthung ha ka por lyiur; bad ka Iyer ka la rah noh ia ki: bad u maw uba la tyrkhong ia ka dur u la kylla long u lum uba khraw, bad u la pyndap ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And it came to pass , when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field , in the wilderness wherein they chased them , and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword , until they were consumed , that all the Israelites returned unto Ai , and smote it with the edge of the sword .
kha: Ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u nongshun ha ka jaka bashrah ha kaba ki la beh ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Ai bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki Israel ki la pynkut noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong u Ai ha lyngkha, ha ka ri khlaw ha kaba ki la beh ia ki, bad haba ki la hap baroh ha ka tduh jong ka waitlam haduh ba kin da shah pynjot , ba ki Israel baroh ki la leit phai noh sha Ai, bad ki la pynkhih ia ka da ka tduh jong ka waitlam .

en: And Uriah said unto David , The ark , and Israel , and Judah , abide in tents  ; and my lord Joab , and the servants of my lord , are encamped in the open fields  ; shall I then go into mine house , to eat and to drink , and to lie with my wife ? as thou livest , and as thy soul liveth , I will not do this thing .
kha: U Uriah u jubab ,  Ki rangbah Israel bad Judah ki don jngai ha ka thma , bad ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don bad ki ; u Joab u rangbah nongai hukum ïa nga bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki ïasah ha madan . Kumno nga lah ban shu leit sha ïing , ban bam ban dih , bad ban thiah bad la ka tnga ? Ka long kaba kyntang ïa nga , nga smai ba ngan ym leh ïa kaba kum kata ka kam !
translated_en_to_kha: U Uri u la ong ha u Dabid, Ka synduk bad ki Israel bad ka Judah, ki sah ha ki ïingjaiñ ; bad u kynrad jong nga Joab, bad ki shakri jong u kynrad jong nga, ki la sah ha ki lyngkha ba plie ; te ngan leit shapoh iing jong nga, ban bam bad ban dih bad ban thiah bad ka tnga jong nga ? kumba me im bad katba ka mynsiem jong me ka dang im .

en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Did I not make thee to swear by the  Lord  , and protested unto thee , saying , Know for a certain , on the day thou goest out , and walkest abroad any whither , that thou shalt surely die ? and thou saidst unto me , The word that I have heard is good .
kha: u la phah khot ïa u bad u ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me ban smai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ban ym mihnoh na Jerusalem . Bad nga la maham ïa me ba lada me leh kumta , men ïap da shisha . Hato mem shym la mynjur ïa ka bad ong ba men kohnguh ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la phah bad u la khot ia u Shimei bad u la ong ha u, Hato ngam shym la pynlong ia me ban smai da U Trai, bad nga la pyrshah ia me, da kaba ong: Tip ia ka por ba me leit shabar ri? bad me la ong ha nga: Ka ktien kaba nga la iohsngew ka long kaba bha .

en: And it came to pass , as he talked with him , that the king said unto him , Art thou made of the king s counsel ? forbear  ; why shouldest thou be smitten ? Then the prophet forbare , and said , I know that God hath determined to destroy thee , because thou hast done this , and hast not hearkened unto my counsel .
kha: Naduh mynno ,  u Amasaïah u kynrup ktien ,  ba ngi la pynlong ïa me u nongai jingmut ïa u syiem ? Sangeh ban kren , ïoh ngan pynïap ïa me !  U nongïathuhlypa u la sngap , hynrei ym shuwa ba un ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba U Blei u la thmu ban pynjot ïa me namar ba me la leh ïa kane baroh bad ba mem shym sngap ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u dang iakren bad u, ba u syiem u la ong ha u, Hato me la leh ia ka jingai jingmut jong u syiem ? to sngap jar ba me dei ban shah shoh ? Nangta u nongiathuhlypa u la ong: Nga tip ba U Blei u la kut jingmut ban pynjot ia me, namar me la leh ia kane, bad me khlem sngap ia ka jingai jingmut jong nga .

en: Speak unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them , Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers in Israel , that will offer his oblation for all his vows , and for all his freewill offerings , which they will offer unto the  Lord  for a burnt offering  ;
kha: ban ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha ki Israel baroh ,  Haba uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba ha Israel u ai ïa ka jingainguh thang , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u baroh bad ha ki khun Israel baroh bad to ong ha ki , Kaei kaei kaba u long na ka iing Israel ne na ki nongwei ha Israel , kata kan ai ia ka jingbam jong u na ka bynta ki jingkular jong u baroh .

en: And Solomon said , Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy , according as he walked before thee in truth , and in righteousness , and in uprightness of heart with thee  ; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness , that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne , as it is this day .
kha: U Solomon u jubab ,  Me la ju ïai pynpaw ka jingieit bakhraw ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , u shakri jong me , bad u la long uba bha , uba ïaineh , bad uba hok ha ka jingïadei jong u bad me . Bad me la ïai bteng ban pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad baneh skhem da kaba ai ha u ïa u khun uba mynta u synshar ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la ong: Me la pyni ia u mraw jong me u Dabid u kpa jong nga ha khmat jong me ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok bad ha ka jinglong hok bad me; bad me la buh na ka bynta jong u ia kane ka jingbha kaba khraw, ba me la ai ia u khun shynrang ban shong ha ka khet jong u, kumba ka long ha kane ka sngi .

en: And it came to pass , as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life , that , behold , the woman , whose son he had restored to life , cried to the king for her house and for her land . And Gehazi said , My lord , O king , this is the woman , and this is her son , whom Elisha restored to life .
kha: Katba u Gehasi u dang ïathuh ïa u syiem kumno u Elisha u la pynim pat ïa u briew uba la ïap , kata ka briew ka la pynlong ïa ka jingkyrpad na u syiem . U Gehasi u ong ha u ,  Ko syiem kynrad , kane keiñ kata ka briew , bad une keiñ u khun jong ka ïa uba u Elisha u la pynim pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u dang iathuh ha u syiem kumno u la pynim ia ka met kaba iap, kata, ha khmih kata, ka kynthei, kaba u la pynim biang ia ka jingim jong ka, ka la pyrta ha u syiem na ka bynta ka iing jong ka bad na ka bynta ka ri jong ka . U Gehasi u la ong, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, kane ka long ka kynthei, bad une u long u khun jong ka, uba u Elisa u la pynim biang ia u.

en: After many days thou shalt be visited : in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword , and is gathered out of many people , against the mountains of Israel , which have been always waste : but it is brought forth out of the nations , and they shall dwell safely all of them .
kha: Hadien bun snem ngan hukum ïa u ba un hiarthma ïa ka ri ha kaba ïa ki briew la wallam biang napdeng shibun ki jaitbynriew bad kiba la im khlem jingsheptieng ïa ka thma . Un hiarthma ïa ki lumbah ka Israel kiba la sah kynjah bad sah shrah la slem bah , hynrei ha kaba mynta ki briew ki shong ha ka jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien bun sngi yn sa leit jngoh ia me: ha ki snem kiba hadien men wan phai biang na ka waitlam, bad la lum lang na ki briew kiba bun, pyrshah ia ki lum Israel kiba la ju jah rngai: hynrei la wanrah ia ka na ki jaitbynriew: bad kin shong suk ia ki baroh .

en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong : but I will make them suddenly run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ki khlaw barben kiba don shi lynter ka rud Jordan haduh ka jaka phlang bajyrngam , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan wan bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Babilonia ban phet krad kynsan na ka nongbah jong ki . Te u nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Mano ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban wan kob ïa nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , un wan shaneng kum u sing na ka jingkhluit jong ka Jordan sha ka jaka shong jong kiba khlain: hynrei ngan pynlong ia ki ban phet noh kynsan na ka: bad mano ba la jied ia ka ? namar mano ba long kum ma nga ? bad mano ba thung ia nga ha khmat jong nga ? bad mano ba long uta u nongaplangbrot uba ieng ha khmat jong nga ?

en: And the king arose in the night , and said unto his servants , I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us . They know that we be hungry  ; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field , saying , When they come out of the city , we shall catch them alive , and get into the city .
kha: Ka dang long mynmiet eh , hynrei u syiem u khie joit na jingthiah bad u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei ba ki Syria ki thmu . Ki tip ba ngi shahthngan hangne , kumta ki mih na la ka jaka shong dara ban leit rieh ha ki rudnong . Ki da pyrkhat ba ngin iehnoh ïa ka nongbah ban leit wad jingbam bad kumta kin sa kem ïa ngi bad kurup ïa kane ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ieng ha ka por miet bad u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, mynta ngan pyni ia phi ia kaei kaba ki Syria ki la leh ia ngi . Ki tip ba ngi la thngan namarkata ki la leit noh na ka jaka sah ban buhrieh ia lade ha lyngkha da kaba ong: Ynda ki la mih na ka nongbah , ngin kem ia ki da kaba im bad ngin rung shapoh ka nongbah .

en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother s eye .
kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Ko para , sngewbha shah ïa nga ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ pynban phim lah ban ïohi ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ? Phi kiba arsap ! Nyngkong to shim noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na ka khmat jong phi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong u para jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane kumno me lah ban ong ia u hynmen jong me, ko para, to ngan sei noh ia ka mot kaba don ha ka khmat jong me, haba me hi ngam iohi ia u beam uba don ha ka khmat jong me hi? Me, ko nongleh arsap, to bret noh nyngkong ia u beam na ka khmat jong me hi, bad nangta me sa iohi shai ba me sei noh ia ka mot kaba don ha ka khmat jong u hynmen jong me.

en: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation . So they made an end of dividing the country .
kha: U Eleasar u lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad ki nongïalam jong ki jait Israel ki la ai ïa kine ki bynta jong ka ri da kaba kynting sbai ban ïakren ïa U  Trai  ha Shiloh , ha ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom ki la pyndep ka jingpynbynta ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki pateng kiba u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u Joshua u khun u Nun bad ki khlieh jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki Israel ki la iasam ha Shiloh ha khmat U Trai . Kumta ki la pynkut noh ia ka jingphiah ia ka ri .

en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .
kha: kumta u la leit kiew sha u Lum Salmon bad la ki rangbah . Hangta u shim uwei u sdie , u pom kawei ka tnat na u dieng , bad u bah ïa ka ha la ka tyrpeng . U ong ïa la ki rangbah ban pynkloi bad ban leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la leit sha u lum, ma u bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u; bad u Abimelech u la shim ia ka wait ha ka kti jong u, bad u la shim ia ka, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka tyrpeng jong u, bad u la ong ha ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, Kaei kaba phi la iohi ia nga, to leh kloi, bad leh kumba nga la leh .

en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands , and that it brake in pieces the iron , the brass , the clay , the silver , and the gold  ; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter : and the dream is certain , and the interpretation thereof sure .
kha: Phi la ïohi kumno u maw u la lait na ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u bad kumno u la shoh ïa ka durbriew kaba la shna da ka nar , ka rnong , ka dewbyrtha , ka rupa bad ka ksiar . U Blei uba khraw u ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban sa jia ha ka lawei . Nga la ïathuh thik ïa kaei kaba phi la phohsniew bad nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jingmut bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat ba la ot ia u maw na u lum khlem kti, bad ba u la pynpra ia ka nar, ka nar, ka dewbilat, bad ka rupa .

en: So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him , Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ? or that there be three days  pestilence in thy land ? now advise , and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me .
kha: u Gad u la leit sha u , ban ïathuh ïa u ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano kata ka ban long ? Lai snem ka  nemsniew ha ka ri jong phi , lane lai bnai kaba phet ïap na ki nongshun jong phi , ne lai sngi ka jingïapthem ha ka ri jong phi ? Mynta to pyrkhat , bad ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jubab ba ngan leit rah sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Gad u la wan sha u Dabid bad u la ong ha u, Hato hynriew snem ka jingkyrduh kan wan sha me ha ka ri jong me? lane phin phet noh lai bnai shuwa ki nongshun jong me, katba ki dang beh ia me ? lane ba kan don ka jingpang kaba lai sngi ha ka ri jong me ? mynta to ai jingmut bad peit kaei ka jubab kaba ngan pynphai biang ia uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou hast humbled thyself before the  Lord  , when thou heardest what I spake against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , that they should become a desolation and a curse , and hast rent thy clothes , and wept before me  ; I also have heard thee , saith the  Lord .
kha: bad kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , kad ïa ki jaiñ jong phi bad ïam , haba phi ïohsngew kumno nga byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba ishyrkhei ban peit , ka jaka ha kaba ïa ka kyrteng jong ka , ki briew kin pyndonkam kum ka jingtim . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka dohnud jong me ka la jem , bad me la pynrit ia lade ha khmat U Trai , haba me la iohsngew ia kaei kaba nga kren pyrshah ia kane ka jaka bad pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka , ba kin kylla long ka jingpynjot bad ka jingtim , bad me la pynkhih ia ki jain jong me; bad nga ruh nga la iohsngew ia me ha khmat jong nga; nga la iohsngew ia me ha khmat U Trai .

en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man  ; he that sacrificeth a lamb , as if he cut off a dog s neck  ; he that offereth an oblation , as if he offered swine s blood  ; he that burneth incense , as if he blessed an idol . Yea , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delighteth in their abominations .
kha: Ki briew ki leh katba ki sngewbha . Baroh ka long kajuh ïa ki , la ki pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong kum ka jingkñia lane jingkñia da u briew ; la ki kñia da u khunlangbrot lane ki pyndkut ïa ka ryndang u ksew ; la ki wanrah ka jingainguh kew ne ki ainguh da ka snam sniang ; la ki thang jingiwbih ne ki duwai ha ka bleithaw . Ki shem sngewbha ha ki rukom ba-ijli ha ka jingmane .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pyniap ia u masi u long kumba u pyniap ia u briew uba la pyniap ia u kulai, kumba u ot ia ka ryndang jong u kulai; uta uba ai ia ka snam sniang; uta uba thang ia ka jingiwbih u long kumba u la kyrkhu ia u bleithaw . Hooid, ki la jied ia la ka jong ka lynti bad ka mynsiem jong ki ka sngewbha ia ki jinglehrain jong ki.

en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the people , both small and great : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the  Lord .
kha: bad baroh lang ki leit sha ka Templ , ba la synran da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew , kiba riewspah bad baduk kumjuh . Ha khmat jong ki baroh , u syiem u pule jam baroh kawei ïa ka Kitab ka Jutang kaba la shem ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la leit sha ka iing U Trai, bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem bad u, bad ki lyngdoh bad ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki briew baroh: bad u la pule ha ki shkor jong ki ia ki ktien baroh jong ka Kitab ka jutang kaba la shem ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And they answered Joshua , and said , Because it was certainly told thy servants , how that the  Lord  thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you , therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you , and have done this thing .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  Bah , ngi la leh ïa ka namar ngi la tip shisha ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa u Moses u shakri jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri baroh kawei , bad ban pynïap ïa ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Ngi la leh ïa ka namar ba ngi la sngewsheptieng ïa phi ; ngi don ha ka jingsyier ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia u Joshua bad ki la ong: Namar la iathuh shisha ia ki shakri jong me, kumno u Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia u Moses jong u ban ai ia phi ia ka ri baroh kawei bad ban pynjot ia ki nongshong shnong baroh na khmat jong phi .

en: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes : and it shall be , that the tribe which the  Lord  taketh shall come according to the families thereof  ; and the family which the  Lord  shall take shall come by households  ; and the household which the  Lord  shall take shall come man by man .
kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ha ka por mynstep yn ïalam ïa ki sha khmat , kawei ka jait hadien kawei pat . Ka jait kaba nga jied kan wan sha khmat , shi kur shi kur . Ka kur kaba nga jied kan wan sha khmat , kawei ka longïing hadien kawei pat . Ka longïing kaba nga la jied kan wan sha khmat uwei hadien uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep namarkata phin sa wan katkum ki jaitbynriew jong phi: bad kan long, ba ka jaitbynriew kaba U Trai u shim kan wan katkum ki longiing jong u ; bad ka longiing kaba U Trai un shim kan wan da ki iing; bad ka iing kaba U Trai un shim kan wan da u briew da u briew .

en: And it shall come to pass , when many evils and troubles are befallen them , that this song shall testify against them as a witness  ; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed : for I know their imagination which they go about , even now , before I have brought them into the land which I sware .
kha: bad shibun ki jingjynjar kiba ishyrkhei kin wan ngat ha ki . Hynrei ïa kane ka jingrwai yn dang ïai rwai , bad ka kan ïeng kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . Wat mynta hi , shuwa ba ngan ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , nga tip aïu ki pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, haba bun ki jingsniew bad ki jingeh ki la jia ha ki, ba kane ka jingrwai kan sa phla pyrshah ia ki kum ka sakhi ; namar yn ym klet noh ia ka na ka shyntur jong u symbai jong ki: namar nga tip ia ka jingmutdur jong ki kaba ki iaid kylleng kylleng, wat mynta ruh, shuwa ba ngan wanrah ia ki sha ka ri kaba nga sngap jar .

en: And , behold , the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .
kha: Ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi la pynbynta kam ba kin leh ha ka Templ . Ki nongtrei kiba don jingtbit ha ki jait kam baroh ki thrang ban ïarap ïa me , bad baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki don hapoh ka hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki jinghikai jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi, wat kin don ryngkat bad me na ka bynta ka jingshakri baroh jong ka iing U Blei: bad kin don ryngkat bad me na ka bynta ka jingtrei kam baroh: bad ki rangbah bad ki briew baroh kin long ha ka hukum jong me .

en: When the  Lord  thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it , and hath cast out many nations before thee , the Hittites , and the Girgashites , and the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , seven nations greater and mightier than thou  ;
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un wan ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , bad un beh noh nangta ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , un beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki jaitbynriew kiba kham bun paid bad kham khrawbor ban ïa phi . Kita ki dei ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Trai U Blei jong me un wanrah ia me sha ka ri kaba me leit ban ioh ia ka, bad u la beh noh ia ki jaitbynriew kiba kham heh bad kham khlain bor ban ia me;

en: And he brought me into the inner court of the  Lord s  house , and , behold , at the door of the temple of the  Lord  , between the porch and the altar , were about five and twenty men , with their backs toward the temple of the  Lord  , and their faces toward the east  ; and they worshipped the sun toward the east .
kha: Kumta u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh ka Templ . Hangta hajan ka jaka rung sha ka jaka kyntang , hapdeng ka duwan bad ka lynti rung , la don arphew san ngut ki rangbah . Ki phai dadien ïa ka jaka kyntang , bad ki pyndem ïa lade shaphang mihngi , ki da mane ïa ka sngi kaba dang mih .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga shapoh ka phyllaw ba shapoh jong ka iing U Trai, bad, ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing U Trai, hapdeng ka phyllaw bad ka almari, ki don kumba arphew ngut ki briew, bad ki tyrpeng jong ki sha ka iing U Trai, bad ki khmat jong ki shaphang mihngi; bad ki la mane ia ka sngi shaphang mihngi .

en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong : but I will suddenly make him run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ki khlaw barben artet ïa ka Jordan haduh ki jaka phlang bajyrngam , ngan wan bad ban pynlong ïa ki nong Edom ban phet krad kyndit na ka ri jong ki . Nangta u nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Uno uba lah ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban ïakob bad nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , un wan shaneng kum u sing na ka jingkhluit jong ka Jordan pyrshah ia ka jaka shong jong kiba khlain: hynrei nga pynlong kynsan ia u ban phet noh na ka: bad mano ba la jied ia ka ? namar mano ba long kum ma nga ? bad mano ba thung ia nga ha khmat jong nga ? bad mano ba long uta u nongaplangbrot uba ieng ha khmat jong nga ?

en: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required : the porters also by their courses at every gate : for so had David the man of God commanded .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki rukom ba la buh da u Dabid u kpa jong u , u buh ryntih ïa ka kam shakri kaba man ka sngi jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh ha ki jingrwai ïaroh bad haba pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki . U buh ryntih ruh ïa ki nongap jingkhang ka Templ da ki kynhun ha kawei pa kawei ka khyrdop , ban pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi kat kum ki hukum u Dabid , u briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thung kat kum ka jingbthah jong u kpa jong u u Dabid, ia ki jinghikai jong ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri jong ki, bad ki Lebi ha ki jingkitkhlieh jong ki, ban iaroh bad shakri ha khmat ki lyngdoh, kumba ka kamram man la ka sngi: ki nongap ruh da ki jinghikai jong ki ha man la ka khyrdop: namar kumta u Dabid u briew U Blei u la hukum .

en: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .
kha: Ki briew jong nga kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me ong ha ki . Nangta me dei ban leit bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel sha u Pharaoh bad ong ha u , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Mynta shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sngap ia ka sur jong me: bad me bad ki rangbah Israel, ha u syiem Ijipt, bad phin ong ha u: U Trai U Blei jong ki Hebru u la iakynduh bad ngi: bad mynta to ngin leit noh ia me, ngi leit noh ia me, lai sngi sha ka ri khlaw, ba ngin knia ia U Trai jong ngi .

en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden ? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth : thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword . This is Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
kha: U dieng u dei u syiem ka Ijipt bad ki briew jong u baroh . Wat ki dieng ha Eden kim lah ban jrong ne ban ikhain kum ma u . Hynrei mynta , kum ki dieng ha Eden , un hiar shapoh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad ïasoh lem bad ki bymriewblei bad kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma , nga la kren ,  ong U Trai Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiba me long kumta ha ka burom bad ha ka jingkhraw hapdeng ki dieng Eden ? hynrei yn pynhiar ia me bad ki dieng Eden sha ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka khyndew: men thiah hapdeng ki bym pat shah ot bad ki kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam . Kane ka long u Pharaoh bad ka kynhun jong u baroh kawei .

en: But thou must eat them before the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates : and thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto .
kha: Ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , lem bad ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , phi dei ban bam ïa kine ki jingainguh tang ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ha kawei ka jaka mane Blei kaba u la jied . Bad hangta phi dei ban sngewkmen na ka bynta kaei kaei baroh kaba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban bam ia ki ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me un jied, ma me bad ka khun jong me bad ka khun jong me bad ka khun jong me bad u Lebi uba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong me: bad me dei ban kmen ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me buh ha ki kti jong me .

en: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :
kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , bad lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka long kaba dei ha phi , sngewbha pynmih ka jingpynbna ban khang ïa ki hukum u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki — kito ki hukum kiba u khun jong u Hammedatha uba hiarpateng na u Agag u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw baroh ha ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Lada ka long kaba sngewbha ia u syiem bad lada nga la shem ia ka jinglong kaba dei ha khmat u syiem bad nga sngewbha ha khmat jong u, to ai ba kan thoh ia ki shithi ba la thmu da u Haman u khun u Hamdaatha u Agagite, kiba u la thoh ban pynjot ia ki Jiw kiba don ha ki jylla syiem baroh:

en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Khie leit sha la ka jong ka ri ha Anathoth . Me dei hok ban ïap , hynrei ngan ym phah pynïap ïa me mynta , namar ba me la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  mynba me dang don bad u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , bad me la ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh u la ong u syiem, To leit sha ki lyngkha jong me hi; namar ba me la shah pynshitom ha baroh ha kaba u kpa jong nga u la shah pynshitom .

en: And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .
kha: U Hegai u la itynnat ïa ka Esther , bad ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u . Um shym pynslem ha kaba ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew bad ki jingbam bakyrpang . U ai ïa ka , ka jaka babha tam ha ka ïing ki kynthei bad buh hynñiew ngut ki samla kynthei ba la jied kyrpang na ka ïingsyiem ban shakri ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khun masi ka la sngewbha ia u, bad ka la ioh ia ka jingsngewbha jong u; bad u la ai kloi ia ki tiar jong ka, bad hynriew ngut ki nongtrei kiba la iakynduh ban ai ia ka, na ka iing syiem: bad u la kham sngewtynnad ia ka bad ki nongtrei jong ka ha ka jaka kaba bha tam jong ki kynthei .

en: And none considereth in his heart , neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say , I have burned part of it in the fire  ; yea , also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof  ; I have roasted flesh , and eaten it : and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination ? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree ?
kha: U nongshna ïa ki bleithaw um don ka jingpuson ne ka jingshemphang ban ong ,  Khyndiat na ka dieng nga thang duh . Nga shet khyndiat u kpu halor ki rnga bad nga syang doh bad nga la bam ïa ka . Bad kaba sah na ka dieng nga shna bleithaw . Hangne nga don ban nguh dem ïa u dieng tylli !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ba pyrkhat ha ka dohnud jong u, lymne ka jingtip ne ka jingsngewthuh ban ong, nga la thang ia ka ha ka ding ; yea, ruh nga la shet ia u kpu ha ki dewiong jong u ; nga la shet ia ka doh . bad ngan pynlong ia ka jingbam ba sah jong u? nga hap ha ka tnat jong u dieng ?

en: Because that they have forsaken me , and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , Chemosh the god of the Moabites , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon , and have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in mine eyes , and to keep my statutes and my judgments , as did David his father .
kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar u Solomon u la kyntait ïa nga bad u la mane ïa ki blei nongwei : ka Astarte , ka blei ki Sidon ; u Khemosh , u blei ki Moab ; bad u Molekh , u blei ki Ammon . U Solomon u la lyndet ïa nga ; u la leh palat , bad um shym la sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ki la iehnoh ia nga, bad ki la mane ia u blei jong ki Sidoni, u Khemosh u blei jong ki nong Moab, bad u Milcom u blei jong ki khun Ammon, bad kim shym la iaid ha ki lynti jong nga, ban leh ia kaba dei ha ki khmat jong nga, bad ban bat ia ki ain jong nga bad ki jingbishar jong nga, kumba u kpa jong u u Dabid .

en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering  ; and my servant Job shall pray for you : for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .
kha: Mynta shim hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang bad leit sha u Job bad ai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ïa lade . U Job un duwai na ka bynta jong me , bad ngan jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad ngan ym pynjahburom ïa me kumba ka dei hok ïa me . Mem shym la kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga kumba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to shim ha phi mynta hynriew tylli ki masi bad hynriew tylli ki langbrot jong nga, bad to leit sha u Job jong nga, bad to ai ia lade ia ka jingainguh thang ; bad u Job jong nga un duwai na ka bynta jong phi: namar ia u ngan pdiang: ioh ia phi hadien ka jinglong bieit jong phi, namar ba phim shym la kren ia kata kaba dei, kum u Job jong nga .

en: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col–hozeh , the ruler of part of Mizpah  ; he built it , and covered it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king s garden , and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David .
kha: U Shallum , u khun jong u Kolhoseh , u nongsynshar ïa ka Mispah distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Umpohliew . U siang ïa ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khyrdop , u pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop . Ha ka Pungsum Shelah , u tei ïa ka khyrdop markhap ïa ka kper syiem , haduh ki mawjam kiba hiar sha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop jong ka pung ka la pynbha ia u Shallun u khun jong u Koldesh, u nongsynshar jong ka bynta jong ka Mizpah; u la tei ia ka, bad u la buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka, ki jingkhang jong ka, bad ki bar jong ka, bad ka kynroh jong ka pung Siloh da ka kper syiem, bad haduh ki jingkieng kiba hiar na ka shnong u Dabid .

en: Wherefore , when I came , was there no man ? when I called , was there none to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it cannot redeem ? or have I no power to deliver ? behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea , I make the rivers a wilderness : their fish stinketh , because there is no water , and dieth for thirst .
kha: Balei ba ki briew jong nga kim jubab haba nga la leit sha ki ban pynim ïa ki ? Balei ba kim phai ktien haba nga la khot ïa ki ? Hato nga tlot eh ban pynim ïa ki ? Nga lah ban pynrngad noh ïa ka duriaw da kaba shu hukum bad pynkylla ïa ki wah sha ka ri shyiap , ba ki dohkha kiba don ha ki kin ïap na ka jingduna um .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba nga wan, hato ym don briew? haba nga khot, hato ym don ba jubab? Hato ka kti jong nga ka la lyngkot satia, ba kam lah ban siewspah ? lane ngam don bor ban pynim ? ha khmih, ha ka jingshah pynrem jong nga nga pynlong ia ki wah ki ri khlaw: ki dohkha jong ki ki ki tyrkhong, namar ym don um, bad ki iap na ka jingthngan .

en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the  Lord  , and said , O altar , altar , thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , a child shall be born unto the house of David , Josiah by name  ; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee , and men s bones shall be burnt upon thee .
kha: Ha kaba bud ïa ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u nongïathuhlypa u kren pynrem ïa ka duwan :  Ko duwan , duwan ! Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ U khunlung ïa uba yn khot kyrteng u Josaïah , yn sa kha ha ka longïing jong u Dabid . Un sa pynïap ha pha ïa ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei thala , bad un thang ïa ki shyieng briew halor jong pha .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrta pyrshah ia ka altar ha ka ktien U Trai, bad u la ong, Ko altar, kumta u Trai u la ong: Ha khmih, u khun un kha ia ka iing u Dabid, u Josiah da ka kyrteng; bad halor jong me un aiti ia ki lyngdoh jong ki jaka ba jrong kiba thang jingiwbih halor jong me, bad ki shyieng jong ki briew kin shah thang halor jong me .

en: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem , Let the house be builded , the place where they offered sacrifices , and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid  ; the height thereof threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof threescore cubits  ;
kha: Ha ka snem banyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u patsha Syros , u la hukum ba ïa ka Templ ha Jerusalem yn tei pat ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh yn thang . Ka Templ ka dei ban long arphew hynñiew mitar ka jingjrong bad arphew hynñiew mitar ka pyngkiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong u Cyrus u syiem u la leh ia ka hukum shaphang ka iing U Blei ha Jerusalem , Ai ba yn tei ia ka iing , bad ai ba ki nongrim jong ka kin long kiba skhem bha; ka jingjrong jong ka kan long kaba sanphew cubit; bad ka jingjrong jong ka kan long kaba sanphew cubit;

en: And the king stood by a pillar , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul , to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book . And all the people stood to the covenant .
kha: U ïeng ha ka jaka ïeng jong ki syiem , bad pynlong ka jutang bad U  Trai  ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki Aiñ bad ki hukum jong u , da ka dohnud bad mynsiem jong u baroh bad ban leh ïa ki jingdawa kiba ïadei bad ka jutang kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab . Bad baroh ki briew ki kular ban bat ïa ka jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ieng hajan u mawlyngnai bad u la leh ia ka jutang ha khmat U Trai, ban iaid hadien U Trai, bad ban bat ia ki hukum jong u bad ki jingphla jong u bad ki ain jong u da ka dohnud jong ki baroh bad ka mynsiem jong ki baroh . Bad ki briew baroh ki ieng ha ka jutang .

en: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ? then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Such as are for death , to death  ; and such as are for the sword , to the sword  ; and such as are for the famine , to the famine  ; and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity .
kha: Haba ki kylli ïa me shano ki dei ban leit , ïathuh ïa ki ba nga la lah ong :  Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap da ka jingpang — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban ïap ha ka thma — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap na ka jingïapthngan — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban shah ring noh kum ki koidi — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia lada ki ong ha me, Hato ngin leit noh ? te men iathuh ia ki, Kumta u Trai u la ong: Kumta ki long na ka bynta ka jingiap, ha ka jingiap; bad kiba long na ka bynta ka waitlam, ha ka waitlam; bad kiba long na ka bynta ka jinglong mraw, ha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: And they rejected his statutes , and his covenant that he made with their fathers , and his testimonies which he testified against them  ; and they followed vanity , and became vain , and went after the heathen that were round about them , concerning whom the  Lord  had charged them , that they should not do like them .
kha: Ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kim shym sumar ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kim suidñiew ïa ki jingmaham jong u . Ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw bym shongdor bad ïa lade ki long ki bymdondor , bad ki bud ïa ki rukom jong ki hima ba don sawdong , khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ban pyrthuh bud ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kyntait ia ki ain jong u bad ka jutang jong u kaba u la leh bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki, bad ki jingphla jong u kiba u la sakhi pyrshah ia ki; bad ki la kylla long kiba lehnohei, bad ki la leit bud ia ki nongwei kiba la don sawdong jong ki, shaphang kiba U Trai u la kynnoh ia ki, ba kim dei ban leh kum ma ki.

en: Again , When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness , and commit iniquity , and I lay a stumblingblock before him , he shall die : because thou hast not given him warning , he shall die in his sin , and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
kha: Lada u briew uba da bha shisha u sdang leh ïa ka kam sniew bad nga buh ïa u ha kaba shong syier , un sa ïap , lada mem shym maham ïa u . Un sa ïap namar ki pop jong u — ngan ym kynmaw ïa ki kam babha ba u la leh — bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me namar ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , Haba u briew uba hok u phai noh na ka hok jong u bad u leh ia ka jingbymhok jong u, bad nga buh ia ka jingkhang ha khmat jong u: namar ba ngam shym la maham ia u , un iap ha ka pop jong u , bad ka hok jong u kaba u la leh kan ym kynmaw shuh shuh ia ka met jong u .

en: Let thine ear now be attentive , and thine eyes open , that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant , which I pray before thee now , day and night , for the children of Israel thy servants , and confess the sins of the children of Israel , which we have sinned against thee : both I and my father s house have sinned .
kha: Khmih ïa nga , ko  Trai  , bad to sngew ïa ka jingduwai jong nga , katba nga duwai mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki shakri jong me , ki briew ka Israel . Nga phla ba ma ngi , ki briew ka Israel , ngi la leh pop . Ki kpa tymmen jong nga bad ma nga , ngi la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka shkor jong me mynta kan sngap jar, bad ki khmat jong me kin plie, ba me lah ban iohsngew ia ka jingduwai jong u shakri jong me, kaba nga duwai ha khmat jong me mynta, sngi bad sngi, na ka bynta ki khun Israel jong me, bad phin phla ia ki pop jong ki khun Israel kiba ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia me: ma nga bad u kpa jong nga ngi ngi la leh pop .
