en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them , saying , If ye be mine , and if ye will hearken unto my voice , take ye the heads of the men your master s sons , and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time . Now the king s sons , being seventy persons , were with the great men of the city , which brought them up .
kha: U Jehu u pynbud sa kawei pat ka shithi sha ki :  Lada phi don ha ka liang jong nga bad bud ïa ki hukum jong nga , wanrah sha nga ïa ki khlieh jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab ha Jesreel kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi .  Ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab ki don hapoh ka jingsumar jong ki riewpawkhmat jong ka Samaria , kiba la pynheh pynsan ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la thoh shithi ha ka sien kaba ar ha ki, u da ong: Lada phi long ki jong nga, bad lada phin sngap ia ka sur jong nga, to shim ia ki khlieh jong ki khun shynrang jong phi, bad to wan sha nga sha Jesel da kaba leit sha Jesel lashai ka sngi . Mynta ki khun shynrang kiba long hynriewphew ngut ki la don ryngkat bad ki rangbah jong ka nongbah kiba la pynsan ia ki .

en: But the children of the murderers he slew not : according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses , wherein the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers  ; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .
kha: Pynban , um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki hynrei u kohnguh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha ka Aiñ u Moses :  Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ki khun kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba u hi u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun ki bym shym la pyniap: kat kum kata kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab u Moses , ha kaba U Trai u la hukum , da kaba ong: Ki kpa kin ym shah pyniap na ka bynta ki khun , lymne ki khun kin ym shah pyniap na ka bynta ki kpa; hynrei uwei pa uwei un shah pyniap na ka bynta la ka jong ka pop .

en: And he took a yoke of oxen , and hewed them in pieces , and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers , saying , Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done unto his oxen . And the fear of the  Lord  fell on the people , and they came out with one consent .
kha: U shim shi jur ki masi lur , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki bad u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit rah ïa kita ki lyngkhot kylleng ka ri Israel ryngkat bad kane ka jingmaham :  Kat u bym bud ïa u Saul bad u Samuel sha ka thma , kumne yn leh ïa ki masi lur jong u .  Te ki paid Israel ki sheptieng her ïa kaei ba un leh U  Trai  , bad baroh khlem lait uwei ruh , ki ïawan mih ryntih lang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka lyngkhot masi jong u masi bad u la ot ia ki ha ki jaka baroh jong ki Israel da ki kti jong ki nonglam khubor , da kaba ong: Uno uno u bym wan shakhmat hadien u Saul bad hadien u Samuel . Bad ka jingtieng U Trai ka la hap ha ki briew , bad ki la mih da kawei ka jingmynjur .

en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem , and reigned : for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .
kha: U Rehoboam u synshar ha Jerusalem bad u nang khraw ha ka bor kum u syiem . U don sawphew wei snem mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah kaba U  Trai  u la jied na ki jaka baroh jong ka Israel kum ka jaka hangno ba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie jong u Rehoboam ka dei ka Naamah , na ka ri ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem Rehoboam u la pynskhem ia lade ha Jerusalem , bad u la synshar: namar u Rehoboam u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem , ka shnong kaba U Trai u la jied na ki jait Israel baroh . Bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long ka Naamah ka Ammon .

en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .
kha: Kin wallam pat ïa baroh ki para kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa nga . Kin wallam ïa ki sha u lum bakyntang jong nga ha Jerusalem ha ki kulai , ki khashor bad ha ki ut , bad ha ki kali ïapom bad ki kali kit jingkit , kumba ki Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingainguh bam sha ka Templ ha ki khiew lehniam kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin wanrah ia ki hynmen jong phi baroh na ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ki kulai bad ha ki kali bad ha ki jaka ri jingri bad ha ki kulai bad ha ki mrad ba im ha u lum bakhuid jong nga ha Jerusalem , ong U Trai .

en: Now when the turn of Esther , the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai , who had taken her for his daughter , was come to go in unto the king , she required nothing but what Hegai the king s chamberlain , the keeper of the women , appointed . And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her .
kha: Ka por ka la dei na ka bynta ka Esther ban leit sha u syiem . Ka Esther — ka khun u Abihail bad ka bakha jong u Mordekai , uba la ri ïa ka kum la ka khun ; ka Esther — ïa kaba la ïaroh da baroh kiba ïohi ïa ka . Haba ka por jong ka , ka la poi , ka la riam thik kumba u Hegai , uta u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki kynthei , u la ai jingmut ïa ka ban riam .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ka por jong ka Esther, ka khun jong u Abisai, kaba la shim ia ka na ka bynta ka khun jong u, kam donkam ei ei hynrei tang ia kaei kaba u Hegai u la buh ia ki kynthei . Bad ka Esther ka la ioh ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong kito baroh kiba peit ia ka .

en: Therefore , ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , to the desolate wastes , and to the cities that are forsaken , which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about  ;
kha: Kumta mynta to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi ki lumbah bad ki lumrit , ha phi ki wahduid bad ki jaka them , bad ha phi ki jaka kiba sah ha ki jingjot jingpra , bad ha phi ki nongbah ba la iehnoh kynjah kiba la shah lute bad shah rkhiebeiñ da baroh ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , phi ki lum Israel , to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai Blei; Kumta u Trai Blei u ong ia ki lum, bad ia ki lum, bad ia ki them, sha ki jaboh jabaiñ bad ki nongbah kiba la shah iehnoh bein, kiba la kylla long ka jingbam bad ka jingpynjah burom ia ki nongwei kiba la shah rong sawdong;

en: And he said , Go forth , and stand upon the mount before the  Lord . And , behold , the  Lord  passed by , and a great and strong wind rent the mountains , and brake in pieces the rocks before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  was not in the wind : and after the wind an earthquake  ; but the  Lord  was not in the earthquake :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Mih shabar bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga halor u lum .  Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la ïaid nangta bad u la phah ïa ka lyer bajur kaba la kad arliang ïa ki lum bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki mawsiang — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha ka lyer . Ka lyer ka sangeh ban beh , bad nangta la khie u jumai — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha u jumai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To leit sha khmat bad ieng halor u lum ha khmat U Trai . Bad, ha khmih, U Trai u la iaid lyngba, bad ka Iyer kaba khraw bad kaba khlain ka la pynpra ia ki lum, bad ka la pynpra ia ki maw ha khmat U Trai ; hynrei U Trai um shym la don ha ka Iyer: bad hadien ka Iyer ka la wan ha ka jingkhynñiuh jumai;

en: And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering , that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains , Go in , and slay them  ; let none come forth . And they smote them with the edge of the sword  ; and the guard and the captains cast them out , and went to the city of the house of Baal .
kha: Tang mar shu dep ai ïa ki jingkñia , u Jehu u ong ha kita ki nongap bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie rung bad pynïap ïa ki baroh , wat shah ïano ïano ban lait im !  Ki la leit rung shapoh bad ki waitlam , ki la pynïap ïa ki baroh , bad ki la paring shabar ïa ki met . Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka kyntang kaba shapoh jong ka templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia tang shu dep ban ai ia ka jingainguh thang, ba u Jehu u la ong ha u nongap bad ha ki rangbah: To leit shapoh bad to pyniap ia ki ; wat ai ba kin wan mih shuh shuh . Ki la shoh ia ki da ka tduh jong ka waitlam ; bad ki rangbah ki la bret noh ia ki shabar bad ki la leit sha ka shnong jong ka iing u Baal .

en: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee , which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the  Lord  that healeth thee .
kha: U la ong ,  Lada phi kohnguh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud da kaba leh ïa kata kaba nga ñiew ba ka long kaba dei , bad da kaba sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi da kano kano ka jingpang kaba nga la pynngat ha ki nong Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkhiah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Lada me sngap jar ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me, bad phin leh ia kaba dei ha ka khmat jong u, bad phin sngap ia ki hukum jong u baroh, bad ngan buh ia kine ki jingpang ha me, kiba nga la wanrah ha ki nong Ijipt: namar nga long U Trai uba pynkoit ia me .

en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah , and said , We have ten parts in the king , and we have also more right in David than ye : why then did ye despise us , that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king ? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel .
kha: Ki Israel ki jubab ,  Ngi don shiphew shah ki jingkam halor u syiem kumba phi , phi don , wat la u dei uwei na phi . Balei phi khmih beiñ ïa ngi ? Wat klet ba ngi dei kiba nyngkong ban ïakren shaphang ka jingwallam pat ïa u syiem !  Hynrei ki rangbah ka Judah ki kham pyneh ha kaba pynpaw ïa ki jingkam jong ki ban ïa ki rangbah ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la jubab ia ki briew jong ka Judah bad ki la ong: Ngi don shi bynta ha u syiem bad ngi ruh ngi kham don hok ha u Dabid ban ia phi: te phi la leh bein ia ngi , ba ka jingai jingmut jong ngi kam dei ban long nyngkong eh ban wanrah biang ia u syiem jong ngi ? Bad ki ktien jong ki briew jong ka Judah ki kham jur ban ia ki ktien jong ki Israel .

en: And thou , Solomon my son , know thou the God of thy father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind : for the  Lord  searcheth all hearts , and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts : if thou seek him , he will be found of thee  ; but if thou forsake him , he will cast thee off for ever .
kha: Bad ha u Solomon u ong ,  Ko khun jong nga , nga kyntu ïa me ban ithuh ïa U Blei u kpa jong me , bad ban shakri ïa u da ka dohnud kaba skhem bad da ka jingmut kaba pyndem . U tip ïa baroh ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingkwah jong ngi . Lada me leit sha u , un pdiang ïa me , hynrei lada me phai lyndet na u , u ruh un iehnoh ïa me junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, ko khun jong nga, to tip ia U Blei jong u kpa jong me, bad to shakri ia u da ka dohnud kaba janai bad da ka jingmut kaba mon sngewbha: namar U Trai u wad ia ki dohnud baroh, bad u sngewthuh ia ki jingmutdur baroh: lada me wad ia u, un sa lap ia me; hynrei lada me iehnoh ia u, un bret noh ia me junom .

en: And she vowed a vow , and said , O  Lord  of hosts , if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid , and remember me , and not forget thine handmaid , but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child , then I will give him unto the  Lord  all the days of his life , and there shall no razor come upon his head .
kha: Ka Hannah ka pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , to khmih ïa nga ka shakri jong me ! To peit ïa ka jingkordit jong nga bad kynmaw ïa nga ! To wat klet ïa nga ! Lada men ai khun shynrang ïa nga , nga kular ba ngan aiti ïa u sha me baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u , bad da lei lei yn ym khap ïa u shñiuh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la kular ia ka jingkular, bad ka la ong, ko Trai jong ki paid, lada me peit shisha ia ka jingjynjar jong ka kti jong me, bad wat klet ia nga, bad wat klet ia ka kti jong me, hynrei ngan ai ha ka kti jong me ia u khun shynrang, te ngan ai ia u ha U Trai ha ka por jong ka jingim jong u baroh kawei, bad ym don u razor uba wan ha ka khlieh jong u.

en: And Moses gave unto them , even to the children of Gad , and to the children of Reuben , and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph , the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , the land , with the cities thereof in the coasts , even the cities of the country round about .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ha ki jait Gad bad Reuben , bad ha ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ïa ka hima jong u Syiem Sihon jong ki Amor bad ïa ka hima u syiem Og jong ka Bashan , kynthup ïa ki shnong bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai ha ki, wat ha ki khun Gad bad ha ki khun u Reuben, bad ha ka shnong Manasseh u khun u Joseph, ka hima u Sihon u syiem ki Amorit bad ka hima u Og u syiem u Basan, ka ri, bad ki shnong jong ka ha ki jaka ba la buh kylleng kylleng .

en: Yet , behold , therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth , both sons and daughters : behold , they shall come forth unto you , and ye shall see their way and their doings : and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem , even concerning all that I have brought upon it .
kha: Lada don uba lait im bad uba pyllait im ïa ki khun jong u , to khmih sha ki haba ki wan sha phi . Peit haduh katno ki long kiba sniew , bad to sngewthikna ba ka jingpynshitom kaba nga wallam ha ka Jerusalem ka long kaba dei hok ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei, ha kata ka por, yn iehnoh ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei: ha khmih, kin wan shabar sha phi, bad phin sa iohi ia ka lynti bad ki jingleh jong ki: bad phin sa shah pyntngen shaphang ka jingsniew kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem, wat shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la wanrah ha ka .

en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?
kha: Hadien shi taïew u khunlung u la ïap bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u ïa ka khubor . Ki ong ,  Mynba i khunlung i dang im , u Dabid um ju jubab ïa ngi haba ngi kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïathuh ïa u ba i khun jong u i la ïap ? U lah ban pynmynsaw ïa lade !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba hynriew, ba u khynnah u la iap . Ki shakri u Dabid ki la tieng ban iathuh ia u ba uta u khynnah u la iap: namar ki la ong: Ha khmih katba u khynnah u dang im , ngi kren ia u bad un ym sngap ia ka sur jong ngi: kumno un sngap ia ka sur jong ngi: te u la sngewsih ia u ba uta u khynnah u la iap ?

en: And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed  ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , O  Lord  my God , be on me , and on my father s house  ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .
kha: U Dabid u la duwai ,  A Blei , nga long ma nga uta uba la leh bakla . Nga dei uta uba la hukum ban kheiñ briew . Kine ki paidbah bapli ki la leh aïu ? A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga , bad pyllait ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha U Blei, Hato ngam dei uba la hukum ia ki briew ban shah khein? wat nga ruh nga long uba la leh pop bad uba la leh sniew shisha; hynrei ia kine ki langbrot ki la leh aiu ? to ai ba ka kti jong me, ko Trai jong nga, kan long halor jong nga, bad halor ka iing jong u kpa jong nga; hynrei ym ha ki briew jong me, ba kin shah pynshitom bein .

en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .
kha: Ki ong ,  Ko Ussaïah ! Phim don hok ban thang jingiwbih ha U  Trai . Dei tang ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa kane . Khie mihnoh na kane ka jaka kyntang . Phi la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei , bad phin ym ïoh shuh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ialeh pyrshah ia u Usiah u syiem bad ki la ong ha u, Kam dei ia me, ko Usiah, ban thang jingiwbih ha U Trai, hynrei ha ki lyngdoh ki khun shynrang Aaron kiba la pynkyntang ban thang jingiwbih: leit noh na ka jaka kyntang; namar me la leh bein; bad kan ym long na ka bynta ka burom jong me na U Trai U Blei .

en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and delivered them into the hand of his servants : and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad , the son of Tabrimon , the son of Hezion , king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,
kha: Kumta u syiem Asa u shim lut ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kiba dang sah ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ban rah ha la ki rangbah synshar sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , u khun jong u Tabrimmon bad u ksiew jong u Hesion , lem bad kane ka khubor :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Asa u la shim ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kaba la sah ha ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing U Trai bad ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing u syiem: bad u syiem Asa u la phah ia ki ha u Benhadad u khun u Tabrimon u khun u Heson u syiem Syria uba shong ha Damaskos da kaba ong:

en: And as the king passed by , he cried unto the king : and he said , Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle  ; and , behold , a man turned aside , and brought a man unto me , and said , Keep this man : if by any means he be missing , then shall thy life be for his life , or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver .
kha: Katba u syiem u dang ïaid , u nongïathuhlypa u khot ïa u bad ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , katba nga dang ïaleh thma , u shipai u wallam sha nga ïa u nongshun ba shah kem bad u ong , ‘ Ap bha ïa une u briew ; lada u lait phet , phin hap ban siew da la ka jong ka jingim lane phin hap siew kuna lai hajar ki sbai rupa .’
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la iaid lyngba, u la pyrta ha u syiem: bad u la ong, U shakri jong me u la leit shabar bad, ha khmih, u briew u la wanrah ia u briew ha nga, bad u la ong: To sumar ia une u briew: lada da kano kano ka lad u la jah noh, te ka jingim jong me kan long na ka bynta ka jingim jong u, lym kumta me siew ia ka talent rupa .

en: And the golden mice , according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords , both of fenced cities , and of country villages , even unto the great stone of Abel , whereon they set down the ark of the  Lord  : which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua , the Beth–shemite .
kha: Ki phah ruh ïa ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka nongbah ba la synshar da ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia , ki shnong ba la ker kynroh bad ki bym shym la ker kynroh . Uta u mawbah ha ka lyngkha u Joshua uba ha Beth Shemesh , ha uba ki buh ïa ka synduk ka Jutang , u dang don hangta kum u sakhi haduh kane ka sngi ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki khnai ksiar baroh ki long ki jong ki phlim Philistia, baroh ar ki shnong ba la ker sawdong bad ki shnong nongkyndong, wat haduh u maw bah jong u Abel, ha kaba ki la buh ia ka synduk U Trai: uba u maw u sah haduh kine ki sngi ha ka lyngkha u Joshua, u Betheshem .

en: The  Lord  shewed me , and , behold , two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the  Lord  , after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , and the princes of Judah , with the carpenters and smiths , from Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .
kha: U  Trai  u pyn-i ha nga ar shang ki soh Dumbur ba la buh ha khmat ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hadien ba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin , u syiem ka Judah , u khun jong u Jehoïakim , kum u koidi na Jerusalem , lem bad ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki nongtrei dieng , bad ki nongtrei batbit . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pyni ia nga, bad, ha khmih, ar tylli ki lyngkhot lyngkhai jong ki sohjew ki la buh ha khmat ka tempi U Trai, hadien ba u Neuchastrozzar u la rah noh ia u khun jong u Jehoiakim u syiem Judah bad ki rangbah Judah, ryngkat bad ki nongshna nar bad ki khnai, na Jerusalem bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha Babilon .

en: For behold this selfsame thing , that ye sorrowed after a godly sort , what carefulness it wrought in you , yea , what clearing of yourselves , yea , what indignation , yea , what fear , yea , what vehement desire , yea , what zeal , yea , what revenge ! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter .
kha: Phi ïohi aïu U Blei u la leh lyngba kane ka jingsngewsih jong phi : Katno ka la pynlong smat ïa phi . Katno phi kwah ban pynshisha ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong phi ! Kaba haduh katno ka jingsngew bitar , ka jingpeit pyrman halor kaba la jia , bad phi la sngew ka jingsngew , ka jingaiti , ka jinglong ba la kloi ban pynshitom ïa ka jingleh bakla ! Phi la pynpaw ïa lade kiba khlem bakla ha kane ka kam baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha khmih ia kane ka jingjia kaba kum kata, kaba phi la sngewsih hadien ka jinglong ba kynja Blei, kaei kaba phi la pynkhuid ia lade, hooid, kaei ka jingbitar, hooid, kaei ka jingkwah kaba jur, hooid, kaei ka jingkwah brai, hooid, kaei kaba phi la mynjur ia lade ban long kiba shai ha kane ka kam .

en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king s most noble princes , that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour , and bring him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
kha: Nangta shim ïa uwei na ki riewdonburom uba don ka kyrdan ba-halor eh ban pynriam ïa uta u briew da kine ki jingriam bad un ïalam ïa u , ba la pynshong halor u kulai lyngba ka jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah . Ai ba uta u riewdonburom un pyrta katba ki nang ïaid : ‘ Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kane ka jain bad u kulai un shah pynpoi ha ka kti jong uwei na ki syiem kiba donburom tam, ba kin pynbeit ia uta u briew uba u syiem u sngewbha ban burom, bad kin wanrah ia u da kaba shong kulai lyngba ka lynti jong ka nongbah , bad kin pynbna ha khmat jong u , Kumta yn leh ia uta u briew uba u syiem u sngewbha ban burom .

en: And he took it , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof  ; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof  ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .
kha: U la kurup ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa baroh ki shnong kiba markhap . Ki pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei hangta . U Joshua u la leh ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa ka Hebron bad ïa ka Libnah bad u syiem jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka, bad u syiem jong ka baroh, bad ki shnong jong ka baroh, bad ki la pynjot lut ia ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta baroh: kumba u la leh ia u Hebron , kumta u la leh ia u Debir bad ia u syiem jong ka baroh kawei kumba u la leh ia ka Libna bad ia u syiem jong ka .

en: For every one of the house of Israel , or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel , which separateth himself from me , and setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me  ; I the  Lord  will answer him by myself :
kha: Man ba uwei na ki Israel lane uwei na ki nongwei uba shong hapdeng ka kynhun ki Israel u phai noh na nga bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad nangta u leit ban kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ai ha u ïa ka jubab jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei na ka iing Israel ne na ki nongwei uba sah ha Israel, uba pyniakhlad ia lade na nga, bad u buh ia ki bleithaw jong u ha ka dohnud jong u, bad u buh ia ka jingkhih jong ka jingbymhok jong u ha khmat jong u, bad u wan sha u nongiathuhlypa ban kylli ia u shaphang jong nga; nga U Trai ngan jubab ia u da lade:

en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments , ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the  Lord  , and so wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren : this do , and ye shall not trespass .
kha: Haba ki para nongshong shnong na kino kino ki nongbah ki wallam ha khmat jong phi ïa ka kam pynïap briew ne kano kano ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ ne ka hukum , phi dei ban bthah bha ïa ki kumno ba ki dei ban leh donakor ïa lade ha ka por jong ka jingbishar , khnang ba kin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Lada phim leh kumta , ma phi bad ki para nongshong shnong jong phi , kin sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U  Trai . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa la ka kamram , phin long kiba la ksan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaba don ha phi na ki para jong phi kiba shong ha ki shnong jong ki, hapdeng ka snam bad ka snam, hapdeng ka ain bad ki hukum bad ki jingbishar, phi dei ban maham wat ia ki ba kim ju leh pyrshah ia U Trai, bad kumta ka jingbitar ka wan ha phi, bad ha ki para jong phi: kane ka long .

en: And one of his servants answered and said , Let some take , I pray thee , five of the horses that remain , which are left in the city , ( behold , they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it : behold , I say , they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed : ) and let us send and see .
kha: Uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u , u ong ,  Ki briew ha kane ka nongbah ki long ki bym don jingkyrmen shuh , la kum kito kiba la ïap . Kumta , to ngin ïaphah katto katne ngut ki rangbah bad san tylli ki kulai kiba dang sah khnang ba ngin tip ka la jia aïu .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki shakri jong u u la jubab bad u la ong, To ai ba kin shim, nga kyrpad ia me, san ngut ki kulai kiba sah ha ka shnong, (ha khmih, ki long kum ki paid Israel baroh kiba sah ha ka: ha khmih, nga ong, ki long kum ki paid Israel baroh kiba la shah pynjot: ) bad to ngin phah bad peit .

en: And he was driven from the sons of men  ; and his heart was made like the beasts , and his dwelling was with the wild asses : they fed him with grass like oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven  ; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men , and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will .
kha: La beh noh ïa u na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , bad ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u ka la long kum u mrad . U la shong la sah bad ki kada khlaw , u la bam phlang kum u masi dab bad u la thiah ha ka jaka bym don jingkah khlem kano kano ka ban ïada ïa u na ka umjer . Ha kaba khatduh u la pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew bad u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la beh noh ia u na ki khun shynrang ; bad ka dohnud jong u ka la long kum ki mrad khlaw: ki la ai bam ia u da u phlang kum u masi, bad ka met jong u ka la sngem da ka dewbilat jong ka bneng ; haduh ba u la tip ba U Blei uba ha khlieh duh u la synshar ha ka hima ki briew, bad ba u la thung ia u halor jong u mano mano ba u mon .

en: All the presidents of the kingdom , the governors , and the princes , the counsellors , and the captains , have consulted together to establish a royal statute , and to make a firm decree , that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days , save of thee , O king , he shall be cast into the den of lions .
kha: Baroh ma ngi kiba pynïaid ïa ka hima jong phi — ki nongpynïaidkam , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah pynïaidkam — ki la ïamynjur ba u Syiem Kynrad u dei ban pynmih ka hukum ban pyntreikam pyrkhing ïa ka . To ai ki hukum ba haduh laiphew sngi yn ym shah ïano ïano ban kyrpad ei ei na uno uno u blei lane na uno uno u briew lait noh tang na u Syiem Kynrad . Ïa uno uno uba pynkheiñ ïa kane ka hukum dei ban bret shapoh ka thliew kaba la dap da ki sing .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongsynshar jong ka hima, ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem, ki nongai jingmut bad ki rangbah ki la iamir jingmut lang ban pynskhem ia ka ain syiem bad ban thaw ia ka hukum kaba skhem , ba uno uno u briew un pan ia ka jingkyrpad jong uno uno u Blei ne u briew haduh laiphew sngi , lait noh tang ma me, ko syiem , un shah bret ha ka thliew jong ki sing .

en: When thou art departed from me to day , then thou shalt find two men by Rachel s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah  ; and they will say unto thee , The asses which thou wentest to seek are found : and , lo , thy father hath left the care of the asses , and sorroweth for you , saying , What shall I do for my son ?
kha: ynda me mih nangne mynta ka sngi , men ïakynduh ar ngut ki rangbah hajan ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel ha Selsah kaba ha ka ri Benjamin . Kin ïathuh ha me ba la lap ïa kita ki kada kiba me leit wad , bad i pa jong me im shym khuslai shuh shaphang jong ki , hynrei i khuslai shaphang jong me , i da ïai kylli , ‘ Ngan leh kumno keiñ shaphang la u khun ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda me la leit noh na nga haduh ka sngi, te men shem arngut ki briew ha u pud u sam jong u Benjamin ha Selsah bad kin ong ha me: Ki kada kiba me leit wad ki long: bad, ha khmih, u kpa jong me u la iehnoh ia ki kada bad u la sngewsih na ka bynta jong phi, da kaba ong: Ngan leh aiu ia u khun jong nga ?

en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish–bosheth , and said , Am I a dog s head , which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father , to his brethren , and to his friends , and have not delivered thee into the hand of David , that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman ?
kha: Kane ka la pynbitar lep ïa u Abner ,  Me tharai ba ngan shetkylla ïa u Saul ? Me tharai shisha ba nga shakri ïa ki Judah ?  u ong .  Naduh mynnyngkong , nga la ïaineh skhem na ka bynta u Saul u kpa jong me , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki paralok jong u , bad nga da ïa me na kaba shahjop ha u Dabid ; pynban ha kane ka sngi me wad dong ïa nga shaphang ka kynthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abner u la bitar shibun eh ia ki ktien u Ishiioshet bad u la ong, Hato nga long u khlieh kulai uba pyrshah ia u Judah uba pyni ia ka jingsngewbha mynta ka sngi ha ka iing u kpa jong me, ha ki hynmen jong u bad ha ki paralok jong u, bad phim shym la aiti ia me ha ka kti u Dabid, ba me la pynpaw ia nga ha ka sngi bad ka jingbakla ha kane ka kynthei ?

en: Go ye , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .
kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U  Trai  na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh jong ka Judah shaphang ka jinghikai jong kane ka Kitab . U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ngi namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la leh ïa kaei ba kane ka Kitab ka ong ba dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit kylli ia U Trai na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh: namar ka long kaba khraw ia ka jingbitar U Trai kaba la pynkhih pyrshah ia ngi , namar ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la sngap ia ki ktien jong kane ka kot , ban leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh shaphang jong ngi .

en: And when David heard that Nabal was dead , he said , Blessed be the  Lord  , that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal , and hath kept his servant from evil : for the  Lord  hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head . And David sent and communed with Abigail , to take her to him to wife .
kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ba u Nabal u la ïap , u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! U la pynhiarkput ïa u Nabal namar ba u la ñiewbeiñ ïa nga , bad ba u la khang ïa nga u shakri jong u na kaba leh bakla . U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Nabal namar ka jingbymman jong u .  Nangta u Dabid u phah ka jingtyrwa sha ka Abigail ban ïakyntiew kurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Dabid u la iohsngew ba u Nabal u la iap, u la ong, La kyrkhu ia U Trai, uba la kyrpad ia ka daw jong ka jingshah lehbein jong nga na ka kti u Nabal , bad u la pynsah ia u shakri jong u na ka jingsniew: namar U Trai u la pynphai biang ia ka jingsniew jong u Nabal ha la ka jong ka khlieh . U Dabid u la phah bad u la iakynduh bad ka Abigail, ban shim ia ka ha u ha ka tnga jong u Dabid bad u Dabid bad u Dabid bad u Dabid bad u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid u Dabid

en: And thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates , and the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are among you , in the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to place his name there .
kha: Lehkmen ha khmat U  Trai  ryngkat bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi . Leh ïa kane ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kmen ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me, ma me, bad u khun jong me, bad u nongshakri jong me, bad u Lebi uba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong me, bad u nongwei bad u khlem kpa, bad u riewkynthei, kiba don hapdeng jong phi, ha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong u hangta .

en: And say unto the people of the land , Thus saith the Lord  God  of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and of the land of Israel  ; They shall eat their bread with carefulness , and drink their water with astonishment , that her land may be desolate from all that is therein , because of the violence of all them that dwell therein .
kha: To ïathuh ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ba kane ka dei ka khubor jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem kiba dang shong dang sah ha ka ri jong ki : Kin kyiuh haba ki bam bad kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng haba ki dih . Ïa ka ri jong ki yn sloit lyngkhuit , namar uwei uwei baroh uba shong hangta u long uba thurmur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki briew jong ka ri , Kumta ong U Trai U Blei jong ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem bad jong ka ri Israel; Kin bam ia u kpu jong ki da kaba sumar bha, bad kin dih ia ka um jong ki da ka jinglyngngoh, ba ka ri jong ka kan long kaba la jot na kiei kiei baroh kiba don hangta .

en: And when he was departed thence , he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him : and he saluted him , and said to him , Is thine heart right , as my heart is with thy heart ? And Jehonadab answered , It is . If it be , give me thine hand . And he gave him his hand  ; and he took him up to him into the chariot .
kha: U Jehu u bteng biang ïa ka jingleit , bad ha lynti la ïakynduh ïa u da u Jonadab u khun jong ka Rekhab . U Jehu u la khublei ïa u bad u la ong ,  Ma phi bad ma nga , ngi ïa-pyrkhat kumjuh , hato phin kyrshan ïa nga ?   Ho-oid ,  u Jonadab u jubab . U Jehu u ong ,  Ai ka kti ngin ïakhublei .  Ki ïabat kti bad u Jehu u ïarap ïa u ban kiew ha ka kali ïapom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la leit noh nangta, u la pynshai ia u Jehonadab u khun u Rehab uba wan iakynduh ia u: bad u la khublei ia u: bad u la ong ia u: Hato ka dohnud jong me ka long kaba dei, kumba ka dohnud jong nga ka long bad ka dohnud jong me ? Bad u Jehonadab u la jubab: Hooid, to ai ia nga ia ka kti jong me . Bad u la ai ia ka kti jong u; bad u la shim ia u sha u sha ka kali .

en: And they shall come from the cities of Judah , and from the places about Jerusalem , and from the land of Benjamin , and from the plain , and from the mountains , and from the south , bringing burnt offerings , and sacrifices , and meat offerings , and incense , and bringing sacrifices of praise , unto the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ki briew kin wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah bad na ki shnongrit sawdong jong ka Jerusalem ; kin wan na ka thain Benjamin , na ki kjat lum , na ki lumbah , bad na ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah . Kin wallam sha ka Templ jong nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa ki jingkñia , ki jingainguh bam bad ka jingiwbih , kumjuh ruh ka jingainguh sngewnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wan na ki shnong Judah bad na ki jaka ba marjan bad ka ri Benjamin bad na ki lum bad na ki lum bad na ki lum ba shathie .

en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God  ; every precious stone was thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold : the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .
kha: Me la shong ha Eden , ka kper jong U Blei , bad me deng ïa ki mawlynnai ba bun jait : ki Rubi bad ki Diamond ; u Topas , u Beryl , u Karnelian bad u Jasper ; ki Sapphir , ki Emerald , bad ki Garnet . Me don ki jingdeng da ka ksiar . Ïa ki la shna na ka bynta jong me ha ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la don ha Eden ka kper U Blei baroh kawei ka long ka jingtap jong me, u maw sardius, u topz, bad u mawkordor, u beryl, u onyx, bad u Jasper, u sohjew, u sohjew bad u sohjew: ka jingtrei jong ki maw bad ki pipe jong me ka la pynkhreh ha me ha ka sngi ba me la thaw .

en: Therefore speak unto them , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to the prophet  ; I the  Lord  will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols  ;
kha: Mynta to kren ha ki bad to ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki : Uwei pa uwei u Israel uba la ai ïa la ka dohnud ha ki bleithaw bad shah ïa ki ban ïalam ïa u sha ka pop bad nangta uba wan ban kylli na u nongïathuhlypa , un ïoh ka jubab na nga — ka jubab kaba ki bleithaw jong u ki dei hok ban ïoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kren ha ki , bad ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei u ong ia u briew jong ka iing Israel uba buh ia ki bleithaw jong u ha ka dohnud jong u , bad u buh ia ka jingkhih jong ka jingbymhok jong u ha khmat jong u , bad u wan sha u nongiathuhlypa; nga u Trai ngan jubab ia u uba wan kat kum ka jingbun ki bleithaw jong u;

en: And , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Speak unto every feathered fowl , and to every beast of the field , Assemble yourselves , and come  ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel , that ye may eat flesh , and drink blood .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to khot ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh kiba ha khlaw , ban ïawan na baroh sawdong ban ïabam ïa ka jingkñia kaba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki . Kan long ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ki lumbah Israel , ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh bad dih ïa ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ko khun u briew, kumta u Trai U Blei u kren ha uwei pa uwei u sim uba don sniehdoh, bad ha uwei pa uwei u mrad khlaw , To lum lang ia lade ha man la ki liang ha ka jingknia jong nga ba nga knia na ka bynta jong phi, wat ia ka jingknia kaba khraw na ka bynta jong phi, ba phin bam ia ka doh bad dih ia ka snam .

en: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields , even they and their men , heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land , and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land , of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon  ;
kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ka Judah bad ki shipai kim shym la pyndem . Ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la lah pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat ka ri bad ba la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa kito baroh ki bym shym la ïalam noh sha Babilonia — ki briew kiba duk tam ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki rangbah shipai baroh kiba don ha ki lyngkha, wat ma ki bad ki briew jong ki, ki la iohsngew ba u syiem Babilon u la leh ia u Godoiah u khun u Ahikam ha ka ri, bad ki la aiti ha u ia ki shynrang bad ki kynthei bad ki khun bad ki baduk jong ka ri, na kita ki bym shym la shah rah sha Babilon;

en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them , and shewed them all the house of his precious things , the silver , and the gold , and the spices , and the precious ointment , and all the house of his armour , and all that was found in his treasures : there was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah shewed them not .
kha: U Hesekaïah u pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nonglamktien bad u pyn-i ha ki ïa ka spah ka phew jong u — ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong u , ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih jong u , bad baroh ki tiar thma ki jong u . Ym don shuh kano kano kaba don ha ki jaka buh tiar jong u lane hangno hangno ha ka hima jong u kaba um shym la pyn-i ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la sngap ia ki, bad u la pyni ia ki ia ka iing jong u baroh, ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ki jingiwbih ba kordor bad ka iing jong u baroh: ym don ei ei ha ka iing jong u, ne ha ka jingsynshar jong u baroh .

en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem , and brought them into the temple of Babylon , those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar , whom he had made governor  ;
kha: U la pynphai pat ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa jong ka Templ kiba u Nebukhadnessar u la rah na ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad buh ha ka templ ha Babilon . U Syros u la aiti ïa kine ki khiew ki pliang ha u briew uba kyrteng u Sheshbassar , ïa uba u la thung kum u lat ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tiar ksiar bad rupa jong ka iing U Blei, kiba u Neuchadnezzar u la shim na ka tempi kaba don ha Jerusalem bad u la wanrah ia ki sha ka tempi jong ka Babilon .

en: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord , and hast said , By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains , to the sides of Lebanon  ; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof , and the choice fir trees thereof : and I will enter into the height of his border , and the forest of his Carmel .
kha: Me la phah ïa ki shakri jong me ban kob sarong ïa nga ba da baroh ki kali ïapom jong me men jop ïa ki lum bajrong tam ka Lebanon . Me kob sarong ba hangta me pom lut ïa ki dieng Kedar bajrong tam bad ïa ki dieng Kseh bakynsai tam , bad me la poi sha ki bynta barben tam jong ki khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki shakri jong me me me la kren bein ia U Trai, bad me la ong, Da ka jingbun ki kali jong nga nga wan sha jrong jong ki lum, sha ki liang jong ka Lebanon ; bad ngan ot ia ki dieng kiba jrong jong ka, bad ki dieng kiba jrong jong ka: bad ngan rung sha ka jingjrong jong u pud jong u, bad ka khlaw jong u Karmel .

en: And he put forth the form of an hand , and took me by a lock of mine head  ; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven , and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem , to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north  ; where was the seat of the image of jealousy , which provoketh to jealousy .
kha: U la kner kaei kaei kaba i kum ka kti bad u shim trait ïa nga na u  ñiuhkhlieh . Te ha kane ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah artet ïa nga ha ka lyer bad u ïalam ïa nga sha Jerusalem . U la rah ïa nga sha ka jaka rung kaba kham hapoh jong ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Templ , ha kaba la don ka dur bleithaw kaba long ka jingpynbitar ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ka dur jong ka kti, bad u la shim ia nga da ka jingkhang jong ka khlieh jong nga bad ka mynsiem u la rah ia nga hapdeng ka khyndew bad ka bneng, bad u la wanrah ia nga ha ki jingphohsniew U Blei sha Jerusalem, sha ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop ba shapoh kaba peit shaphang shathie; ha kaba ka jaka shong jong ka jingsngewsih jong nga ka la pynmih ia nga sha ka jingsngewsih .

en: Then the five men departed , and came to Laish , and saw the people that were therein , how they dwelt careless , after the manner of the Zidonians , quiet and secure  ; and there was no magistrate in the land , that might put them to shame in any thing  ; and they were far from the Zidonians , and had no business with any man .
kha: Kumta kita ki rangbah san ngut ki mihnoh bad ki leit sha ka shnong Laish . Ki ïohi kumno ki briew hangta ki ïashong shngain , kumba long ki nong Sidon . Ki long kiba ïashongsuk bad ki briew kiba jar jar , kim don jingïania badno badno ; ki don lut kat kaba ki donkam . Ki shong kham jngai na ki nong Sidon bad kim pynïadei bad kiwei ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki san ngut ki briew ki la leit noh sha Laish, bad ki la iohi ia ki briew kiba don hangta, kumno ki shong khlem da pyrkhat, kat kum ka rukom jong ki Sidonian, ki sngap jar bad ki la shngain .

en: And they shall spread them before the sun , and the moon , and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served , and after whom they have walked , and whom they have sought , and whom they have worshipped : they shall not be gathered , nor be buried  ; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth .
kha: Ha ka jaka ban lumlang bad ban tep , ki shyieng jong ki kin long kum ka sboh kaba don ha madan . Yn pynphriang ïa ki shabar ha khmat ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur , kiba kine ki briew ki ieit bad shakri , bad kiba ki la ïakylli bad mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynphriang ia ki ha khmat ka sngi, bad u bnai, bad ki shipai bneng baroh kiba ki la ieit, bad kiba ki la shakri, bad hadien jong kiba ki la iaid, bad kiba ki la wad: kin ym shah lum lang, lymne shah tep; kin ym long kum ki sboh ha ka khmat ka khyndew .

en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits , and the wizards , and the images , and the idols , and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem , did Josiah put away , that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the  Lord .
kha: Khnang ban pyntreikam ïa ki aiñ ba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la shem ha ka Templ , u syiem Josaïah u la weng noh na Jerusalem bad ki bynta ka Judah ïa baroh ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongbatai kupar , bad ïa baroh ki blei ïing , ki bleithaw , bad ki tiar mane blei thala .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki nongtrei kiba don ki mynsiem kiba la tip bha, bad ki nongleh jadu, bad ki dur bleithaw bad ki jingleh bymman baroh kiba la shah rong noh ha ka ri Judah bad ha Jerusalem , u Josiah u la weng noh ia ki ktien jong ka hukum kiba la thoh ha ka kot ba u Hilkiah u lyngdoh u la lap ha ka iing U Trai .

en: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword : though their terror was caused in the land of the living , yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit : he is put in the midst of them that be slain .
kha: Ka Elam ka don hapdeng kito kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ki don ha baroh sawdong jong ka . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad ki jahburom , ki ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar ryngkat bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka jingthiah hapdeng ki jingiap jong ka baroh: ki jingtep jong ka ki long sawdong jong u: baroh ki long ki bym pat shah ot: wat la ka jingtieng jong ki ka la mih ha ka ri jong kiba im: hynrei ki la kit ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki bad ki kiba leit shapoh ka thliew: la buh ia u hapdeng jong ki kiba la shah pyniap .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , The people are yet too many  ; bring them down unto the water , and I will try them for thee there : and it shall be , that of whom I say unto thee , This shall go with thee , the same shall go with thee  ; and of whomsoever I say unto thee , This shall not go with thee , the same shall not go .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon ,  Me dang don bun bah ki rangbah . Ïalam ïa ki sha um , bad hangta ngan pynkhlad ïa ki na ka bynta jong me . Lada nga ong ha me ba u briew un leit bad me , un leit . Lada nga ong ha me ba u briew un ym leit bad me , un ym leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Gideon , Ki briew ki dang bun palat ban wanrah ia ki shapoh um, bad ngan pyrshang ia ki na ka bynta jong me hangta: bad kan long, uta uba nga ong ha me, uta un leit bad me; bad na uba nga ong ha me, une un ym leit bad me, uta un ym leit bad me .

en: And the high places that were before Jerusalem , which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption , which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians , and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites , and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon , did the king defile .
kha: U Josaïah u la ñiewsang ïa ki duwan ba u syiem Solomon u la tei shaphang mihngi ka Jerusalem , shaphang shathie jong u Lum ki Olib , na ka bynta ban mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli ― ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , u Khemosh u blei ki Moab bad u Molekh u blei ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jaka ba jrong kiba don ha khmat ka Jerusalem, kiba don ha ka liang kadiang jong ka jingbamsap, kaba u syiem Israel u la tei na ka bynta u Ashtoret ia ka jinglehrain jong ki Sidonian bad na ka bynta u Khmih ia ka jinglehrain jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki nongshong shnong jong ki

en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood , which they had made for the purpose  ; and beside him stood Mattithiah , and Shema , and Anaiah , and Urijah , and Hilkiah , and Maaseiah , on his right hand  ; and on his left hand , Pedaiah , and Mishael , and Malchijah , and Hashum , and Hashbadana , Zechariah , and Meshullam .
kha: U Esra u ïeng ha ka jaka ba kham kynjang ba la shna da ka dieng ïa kaba la shna khnang na ka bynta kata ka por . Kine ki briew ki ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong u : U Mattithaïah , u Shema , u Anaïah , u Uriah , u Hilkaïah , bad u Maaseïah ; bad kine pat ki ïeng ha ka liang kadiang jong u : u Pedaïah , u Mishael , u Malkhijah , u Hashum , u Hashbaddanah , u Sekharaïah bad u Meshullam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esra u nongthoh u la ieng halor ka lyngkhot dieng kaba ki la shna na ka bynta ka jingthmu bad hajan jong u u la ieng u Matiah, bad u Anaiah, bad u Hilkiah, bad u Maaseiah, ha ka liang kadiang jong u; bad ha ka liang kadiang jong u, u Pediah, bad u Mishael, bad u Malakaiah, bad u Hashbadana, u Sekharaiah, bad u Meshalaiah .

en: And the king said , Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this ? And the woman answered and said , As thy soul liveth , my lord the king , none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken : for thy servant Joab , he bade me , and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid :
kha: Hato dei u Joab uba la ai buit ïa pha ha kane baroh ?  u la kylli ïa ka . Ka jubab ,  Nga smai da kata baroh kaba kyntang , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba ym don kano kano ka lad ban kiar na kaba jubab ïa ka jingkylli jong phi . Ka dei kaba shisha ba u Joab , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi uba la bthah ïa nga ïa kaei ngan leh bad ïa kaei ngan kren .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong: Hato ka kti jong u Joab bad me ha kine baroh ? Bad kata ka kynthei ka la jubab bad ka la ong: Kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ko kynrad jong nga, ym don ba lah ban phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang na ka bynta ba u kynrad jong nga u la kren: na ka bynta u shakri jong me u Joab, u la ong ia nga: bad u la buh ia kine ki ktien baroh ha ka shyntur jong u:

en: And let it come to pass , that the damsel to whom I shall say , Let down thy pitcher , I pray thee , that I may drink  ; and she shall say , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac  ; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master .
kha: Ngan ong ha kawei na ki , ‘ Sngewbha pynhiar ïa u khiew um jong phi bad to ai ba ngan ïoh dih um .’ Lada ka ong , ‘ Dih , bad ngan sa wanrah um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ,’ to ai ba kan dei ma ka kaba me la jied na ka bynta u shakri jong me u Isaak . Lada kane kan jia , ngan tip ba me la batskhem ïa la ka kular ha u kynrad jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kan jia, ba ka dam jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, ba ngan dih ; bad kan ong: To dih, bad ngan ai ia ki kulai jong me ruh: to ai ba kata ruh ka long ma me kaba me la buh na ka bynta u shakri jong me u Isaak ; bad da kata ngan tip ba me la pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia u kynrad jong nga.

en: For thus hath the  Lord  spoken unto me , Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey , when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him , he will not be afraid of their voice , nor abase himself for the noise of them : so shall the  Lord  of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion , and for the hill thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kam pher kumno ki nongaplangbrot ki kynhied bad ki pyrta , kim lah ban pyntieng ïa u sing ba un phet na ka jingri ba u la pynïap ; ha kajuh ka rukom , ym don kano kano kaba lah ban khang ïa nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh na kaba ïada ïa u Lum Seïon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai u la kren ha nga, Kumba u sing bad u sing rit u la rkhie bein ia u mrad jong u, haba la khot ia u da ki nongap langbrot kiba bun pyrshah ia u, un ym tieng ia ka sur jong ki, lymne un ym pyntieng ia lade na ka bynta ka jingsawa jong ki: kumta U Trai jong ki paid un wan hiar ban ialeh na ka bynta u lum jong ka .

en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beer–sheba , and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man s left hand at the gate of the city .
kha: U wallam sha Jerusalem ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ju don ha ki nongbah ka Judah , bad ha kylleng jong ka ri u la ñiewsang ïa ki duwan ha kiba ki ju ai jingkñia . U la pyntwa ruh ïa ki duwan ba la pynkyntang sha ki ksuid-durblang hajan ka khyrdop ba la tei da u Joshua , u lat ka nongbah , kiba don sha kadiang jong ka khyrdop bah kaba ki ju rung sha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ki lyngdoh baroh na ki shnong Judah, bad u la pynjakhlia ia ki jaka ba jrong ha kaba ki lyngdoh ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih, naduh Gba haduh Beersheba, bad u la pynpra ia ki jaka ba jrong jong ki khyrdop kiba don ha ka jingkhang jong u Lat jong ka shnong u Joshua .

en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .
kha: Ha kata ka por un ïeng halor u lum Olib , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem . Te ïa u lum Olib yn sa kad arliang na mihngi sha sepngi da ka them kaba khraw . Shiteng jong u lumbah un kynriah shaphang shatei bad shiteng jong u shaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kjat jong u kin ieng ha kata ka sngi ha u lum Olives uba don ha khmat ka Jerusalem shaphang mihngi, bad u lum Olives un iaid hapdeng jong u shaphang mihngi bad shaphang sepngi, bad kan don ka them kaba heh bha; bad shiteng na u lum kan leit shaphang shathie .

en: That they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field , and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven , and seven times shall pass over thee , till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .
kha: Yn beh noh ïa phi na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad phin shong phin sah bad ki mradkhlaw . Hynñiew snem phin bam phlang kum u masi dab , bad thiah ha bym don jingkah ei ei , ha kaba ka umjer kan hap halor jong phi . Te phin pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u bat synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew , bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin beh noh ia me na ki briew, bad ka jaka shong jong me kan long bad ki mrad khlaw, bad kin pynlong ia me ban bam ia u phlang kum u masi, bad kin pynsngem ia me da ka dewbilat jong ka bneng, bad hynriew sien kin iaid halor jong me, haduh ba me tip ba ka long kaba ha khlieh duh ha ka hima ki briew, bad me ai ia ka ha uno uno uba u mon .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will make thee a terror to thyself , and to all thy friends : and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies , and thine eyes shall behold it : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall carry them captive into Babylon , and shall slay them with the sword .
kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ngan pynlong ïa me ka jingshyrkhei ïa me hi bad ïa ki paralok jong me , bad men ïohi ïa ki baroh ba ki shah pynïap da ki waitlam jong ki nongshun jong ki . Ngan buh ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia ; un shim katto katne ngut kum ki koidi sha ka ri jong u bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia me ka jingtieng ia lade bad ia ki paralok jong me baroh: bad kin hap da ka waitlam jong ki nongshun jong me: bad ki khmat jong me kin iohi ia ka: bad ngan aiti ia ki baroh ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon .

en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God , where is the garrison of the Philistines : and it shall come to pass , when thou art come thither to the city , that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery , and a tabret , and a pipe , and a harp , before them  ; and they shall prophesy :
kha: Nangta men leit kiew sha u Lum jong U Blei ha Gibeah , ha kaba don ka jaka sher dara jong ki Philistia . Ha ka jaka rung shapoh shnong , men ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba dang wan hiar na ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum , ki da tem da put ïa ki duitara , ki ksing , ki sharati , bad ki kanjari . Kin sa ïashad bad ïarisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata me wan sha u lum U Blei, ha kaba ka don ka kynhun jong ki Philistia: bad kan sa jia, haba me wan sha kata ka shnong, ba me iakynduh ia ka kynhun ki nongiathuhlypa kiba wan hiar na ka jaka ba jrong da ka jingrwai bad ka umsoh bad ka pipe, bad ka harp, ha khmat jong ki; bad kin iathuhlypa:

en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men  ; and Eliab s anger was kindled against David , and he said , Why camest thou down hither ? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know thy pride , and the naughtiness of thine heart  ; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle .
kha: U Eliab , u hynmen rangbah u Dabid , u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ïakren bad kita ki rangbah . U la bitar ïa u Dabid bad u ong ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba sumar ïa kito ki langbrot ki jong me kiba don ha ka ri khlaw ? Ma me , me uba sngewstad ! Me wan tang ban peit kai ïa ka jingïaleh thma !
translated_en_to_kha: U Eliab u hynmen rangbah jong u u la iohsngew haba u la kren ha ki briew ; bad ka jingbitar jong u Eliab ka la bthei pyrshah ia u Dabid, bad u la ong: Balei me wan hiar hangne ? bad bad kiba me la iehnoh ia kita ki langbrot kiba rit ha ka ri khlaw ? Nga tip ia ka jingsarong jong me, bad ka jingsniew jong ka dohnud jong me, namar me wan hiar ba me lah ban iohi ia ka thma .

en: Then it shall be , if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation , that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord  , with his meat offering , and his drink offering , according to the manner , and one kid of the goats for a sin offering .
kha: Lada kata ka jingbakla ka long namar ba ki paidbah kim tip , ki dei ban wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh dih . Nalor kita , ki dei ban wanrah ïa u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kan long, lada dei ban leh khlem da tip ia ka jingiaseng, ba ka jingiaseng baroh kan aiti ia uwei u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingknia thang , namar ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai , ryngkat bad ka jingknia doh jong u bad ka jingknia dih jong u kat kum ka rukom .

en: Now when every maid s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus , after that she had been twelve months , according to the manner of the women , ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished , to wit , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet odours , and with other things for the purifying of the women  ; )
kha: Ka jingai jingsumar man ka por na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki kynthei ka neh shisnem — ki jingkhem met da ka umphniang mirr na ka bynta hynriew bnai bad da ka umphniang balsam sa hynriew bnai . Hadien kata , ïa kawei pa kawei ka samla yn ïalam kawei hadien kawei sha u syiem Serksis .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba kawei pa kawei ka por ka la wan rung sha u syiem Ahasauerus, hadien kata ka la dap shiphew bnai, kat kum ka rukom jong ki kynthei, (namar kumta la pyndep ia ki sngi jong ki jingpynkhuid jong ki, haduh hynriew bnai da ka umphniang myrr, bad hynriew bnai da ki jingsma ba thiang, bad da kiwei kiwei ki jingpynkhuid ia ki kynthei ; )

en: And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ? that thou shalt answer , For the tidings  ; because it cometh : and every heart shall melt , and all hands shall be feeble , and every spirit shall faint , and all knees shall be weak as water : behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Haba ki kylli ïa me balei ba me ud , ïathuh ïa ki ba ka long na ka daw ka khubor kaba la ïohpdiang . Haba ka wan , ki dohnud jong ki kin dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki kti jong kin noh kyrwep , ka jingshlur jong ki kan duh , bad ki khohsiew jong ki kin kyiuh . Ka por ka la poi ; ka long hangne .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba ki ong ha me, Balei me sngap jar? ba me jubab, Na ka bynta ki khubor namar ba ka wan: bad kawei pa kawei ka dohnud kan rkhiang, bad ki kti baroh kin sa tlot, bad kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem kan sa tlot kum ka um: ha khmih, ka wan, bad yn sa wanrah ia ka, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ye have not hearkened unto me , in proclaiming liberty , every one to his brother , and every man to his neighbour : behold , I proclaim a liberty for you , saith the  Lord  , to the sword , to the pestilence , and to the famine  ; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
kha: Te mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga : phim shym la ai ka jinglaitluid ïa la ki para Israel . Kumta te , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jinglaitluid : ka jinglaitluid ban ïap da ka thma , ka jingpang , bad ka jingïapthngan . Ngan pynlong ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ban sngewshyrkhei ïa kaei kaba nga leh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai u ong: Phim shym la sngap ia nga, ha kaba pynbna ia ka jinglaitluid, uwei pa uwei ha u para jong u: ha khmih , nga pynbna ia ka jinglaitluid na ka bynta jong phi, ong U Trai, ha ka waitlam, ha ka jingkyrduh; bad ha ka jingkyrduh; bad ngan pynlong ia phi ban shah weng noh ha ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew .

en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth , and , behold , he eateth  ; but he awaketh , and his soul is empty : or as when a thirsty man dreameth , and , behold , he drinketh  ; but he awaketh , and , behold , he is faint , and his soul hath appetite : so shall the multitude of all the nations be , that fight against mount Zion .
kha: Baroh ki hima kiba ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin long kum u briew uba ïap-tyrsaw uba phohsniew ba u bam jingbam bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah hapdeng ka jingthngan , lane kum u briew u ban sa ïap na ka jingsliang uba phohsniew ba u dih um bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah ryngkat bad u pdot ba-tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan long wat kum haba u briew uba thngan u phohsniew, bad, ha khmih, u bam hynrei u kyndit, bad ka mynsiem jong u ka long kaba thylli: lane kumba u briew uba sliang u phohsniew, bad, ha khmih, u dih ; hynrei u kyndit, bad, ha khmih, u la lyngngoh, bad ka mynsiem jong u ka la lyngngoh: kumta ka jingbun ki jaitbynriew baroh ka long:

en: And Samuel said to Saul , Why hast thou disquieted me , to bring me up ? And Saul answered , I am sore distressed  ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God is departed from me , and answereth me no more , neither by prophets , nor by dreams : therefore I have called thee , that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do .
kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Balei me la pynthut ïa nga ? Balei me pynlong ïa nga ban wan pat ?  U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la poi ha ka khim khait ! Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma ïa nga , bad U Blei u la iehnoh ïa nga . Um shym jubab shuh ïa nga , la da ki nongïathuhlypa , lane da ki jingphohsniew . Bad kumta nga la khot ïa phi ba phin ïathuh ïa nga aïu nga dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha u Saul, Balei me la pynsngewsih ia nga, ban wanrah ia nga ? U Saul u la jubab, nga la sngewsih shibun namar ki Philistia ki ialeh pyrshah ia nga, bad U Blei u la leit noh na nga, bad um jubab shuh ia nga, lymne da ki nongiathuhlypa, lymne da ki jingphohsniew: namarkata nga la khot ia me, ba me lah ban pyntip ha nga ia kaei kaba ngan leh .

en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed , and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: Nangta un weng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka baroh , kumba ju weng ïa ka khleiñ na ki langbrot ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad un thang ïa ka ha ka duwan lem bad ki jingainguh bam ba ai sha U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un weng noh ia ka shini baroh jong u, kumba la weng noh ia ka shini jong u langbrot na ka jingknia jingsuk ; bad u lyngdoh un thang ia ki ha ka almari kat kum ki jingknia ba la thang sha U Trai: bad u lyngdoh un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka pop jong u kaba u la leh , bad yn map ia u .

en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel , If it seem good unto you , and that it be of the  Lord  our God , let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , that are left in all the land of Israel , and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs , that they may gather themselves unto us :
kha: Nangta u pynbna sha baroh ki paid Israel ,  Lada phi ai ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi bad lada ka dei ka mon U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to ai ba ngin ïaphah nonglamktien sha kiwei pat ki para ri jong ngi bad sha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ha ki shnong jong ki , bad ïathuh ïa ki ban ïalumlang hangne bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei , bad ba ka long na U Trai U Blei jong ngi , to ngin phah shabar sha ki para jong ngi ha man la ki jaka ba sah ha ka ri Israel baroh kawei bad bad ki ruh ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba don ha ki shnong bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ki:

en: Behold , I build an house to the name of the  Lord  my God , to dedicate it to him , and to burn before him sweet incense , and for the continual shewbread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts of the  Lord  our God . This is an ordinance for ever to Israel .
kha: Nga tei ka Templ ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga . Kan long ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngin mane ïa u da kaba thang ki jingiwbih da ki musla iwbih , bad ha kaba ngin ïai ai ki jingainguh ha u da u kpu kyntang , bad ha kaba ngin ai ki jingainguh thang man ka step bad janmiet , kumjuh ruh ha ki sngi Sabbaton , ki Jingrakhe Bnai Thymmai , bad kiwei pat ki sngi khuid ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U la hukum ïa ki Israel ban leh ïa kane junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong nga, ban aiti ia ka ha u, bad ban thang ha khmat jong u ia ka jingiwbih kaba thiang, bad na ka bynta ki jingbam ba la thang man ka por mynstep bad janmiet, ha ki sngi saitjain, bad ha ki sngi saitjain ba thymmai jong U Trai jong ngi . Kane ka long ka jingpynbeit ia ki Israel .

en: Then came there unto him all his brethren , and all his sisters , and all they that had been of his acquaintance before , and did eat bread with him in his house : and they bemoaned him , and comforted him over all the evil that the  Lord  had brought upon him : every man also gave him a piece of money , and every one an earring of gold .
kha: Baroh ki hynmen ki para jong u Job , kynthei bad shynrang , bad ki paralok barim jong u , ki la wan jngoh ïa u bad ïabam sngewbha bad u ha ka ïing jong u . Ki la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong ki bad ki pyngtngen ïa u namar ki jingjynjar baroh ba U  Trai  u la wallam halor jong u . Uwei pa uwei na ki u la ai katto katne ka pisa bad ka sati ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wan shata ha u baroh ki hynmen jong u, bad ki para jong u baroh, bad kiba la ithuh ia u mynshuwa, bad ki la bam ia u ha iing jong u: bad ki la sngewsih ia u, bad ki la pyntngen ia u halor ka jingsniew baroh kaba U Trai u la wanrah halor jong u: uwei pa uwei ruh u la ai ia u ia ka shkor ksiar .

en: There is a man in thy kingdom , in whom is the spirit of the holy gods  ; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom , like the wisdom of the gods , was found in him  ; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father , the king , I say , thy father , made master of the magicians , astrologers , Chaldeans , and soothsayers  ;
kha: U don u briew ha ka hima jong phi uba don ïa u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid hapoh jong u . Mynba u kpa jong phi u long syiem , une u briew u la pyn-i ka jingmut kaba bha , ka jingtip , bad ka jingstad kum ka jingstad jong ki blei . Bad u syiem Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong phi , u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh duh jong ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Don u briew ha ka hima jong me, ha uba ka mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid bad ha ki sngi jong u kpa jong me, kum ka jingstad jong ki blei, la shem ha u; ha uba u syiem Neuchadnezzar u kpa jong me, u syiem jong me, nga ong, u kpa jong me, u la long u trai jong ki nongleh jadu, ki nongleh jadu, ki nongleh jadu, bad ki nongleh jadu;

en: O Lord , righteousness belongeth unto thee , but unto us confusion of faces , as at this day  ; to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and unto all Israel , that are near , and that are far off , through all the countries whither thou hast driven them , because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee .
kha: Ma me ko Trai , me leh borabor ïa kaba dei , hynrei borabor ngi la wallam ka jingjahburom ha lade hi . Kane ka long kaba shisha ïa baroh na ngi kiba shong basah ha Judia bad ha Jerusalem bad jong baroh ki khun Israel ïa kiba me la pynsakma ha ki ri kiba jan bad kiba jngai namar ki la long ki bymïaineh ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , ka hok ka long ka jong me, hynrei ha ngi ka jingsngewsih ia ki khmat, kumba ha kane ka sngi ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem baroh, kiba hajan bad kiba jngai, lyngba ki ri baroh kiba me la beh noh ia ki, namar ka jingleh bymman jong ki ba ki la iaid lait pyrshah ia me .

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , the place of my throne , and the place of the soles of my feet , where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever , and my holy name , shall the house of Israel no more defile , neither they , nor their kings , by their whoredom , nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places .
kha: Ko khun u briew , hangne ka dei ka khet jong nga . Ngan shong hangne hapdeng ki paid Israel bad synshar halor jong ki junom . Ki paid Israel lymne ki syiem jong ki , kin ym pynjahburom shuh ïa kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da kaba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei lane da kaba tep ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem jong ki ha kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, ka jaka jong ka khet jong nga, bad ka jaka jong ki kjat jong nga, ha kaba ngan shong hapdeng ki khun Israel junom, bad ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga, kan ym pynjakhlia shuh ia ka iing Israel jong nga, lymne ia ki, lymne ki syiem jong ki, da ka jingkha khun jong ki, lymne da ki met jong ki syiem jong ki ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ki .

en: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth , shall he live ? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned : in his trespass that he hath trespassed , and in his sin that he hath sinned , in them shall he die .
kha: Hynrei lad u briew uba hok u sangeh ban lehbha bad sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew baroh , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki briew kiba sniew ki leh , hato un ïai im ? Em , yn ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha kaba u la leh . Un ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u bad ki pop jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u hok u phai noh na ka hok jong u, bad u leh kat kum ki jingleh bymman baroh kiba u briew uba sniew u leh ? Ka hok jong u baroh kaba u la leh kan ym shah kdew: ha ka jingleh bymman jong u ba u la leh pop, bad ha ka pop jong u ba u la leh pop, ha ki un iap .

en: And I will come near to you to judgment  ; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , and against the adulterers , and against false swearers , and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan sa paw hapdeng jong phi ban bishar , bad ngan phla shisyndon pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh myntor , pyrshah ïa kiba klim , pyrshah ïa kito kiba sakhi lamler , kito kiba shukor ïa ki nongtrei ïa ki bainong jong ki , bad kito kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , bad ki nongwei — pyrshah ïa kito baroh ki bym ñiewkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan wan hajan jong phi ban bishar ; bad ngan long u nongsakhi uba stet pyrshah ia ki nongleh jadu, bad pyrshah ia ki nongleh kam sniew, bad pyrshah ia kito kiba pynshitom bein ia u nongtrei kam sniew ha ka bainong jong u, u nongleh kam sniew bad u bym don kpa, bad kiba pynphai noh ia u nongwei na ka liang kadiang jong u, bad wat tieng ia nga, ong U Trai jong ki paidbah .

en: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives , because I am broken with their whorish heart , which hath departed from me , and with their eyes , which go a whoring after their idols : and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations .
kha: Hangta kin sa kynmaw ïa nga bad tip ba nga la pynshitom ïa ki bad pynlehrain ïa ki , namar ki dohnud bymngeit jong ki , ki la kylla dien na nga bad ki la jied ïa ki bleithaw ban ïa nga . Bad kin sa isih hi ïa lade namar ki kam ba-bymman bad bajahburom ba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba lait na phi kin kynmaw ia nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ha kaba kin shah rah mraw, namar nga la shah pynpra noh da ka dohnud kaba sniew jong ki, kaba la leit noh na nga, bad da ki khmat jong ki kiba leit sha ki bleithaw jong ki: bad kin sa ialeh ia lade na ka bynta ki jingsniew kiba ki la leh ha ki jingleh bymman jong ki baroh .

en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , nor thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thine ox , nor thine ass , nor any of thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates  ; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou .
kha: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ka sngi shongthait ba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta jong nga . Ha kata ka sngi phim bit ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam — ma phi , lane ki khun jong phi , lane ki mraw jong phi , lane ki jingri jong phi , lane ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi . Ki mraw jong phi ki dei ban shongthait kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka sngi kaba hynriew ka long ka Sabha jong U Trai U Blei jong me: ha ka wat leh ei ei, ma me, ne u khun jong me, ne u shakri jong me, ne u shakri jong me, ne u masi jong me, ne u masi jong me, ne u nongwei jong me uba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong me; ba u shakri jong me bad ka shakri jong me kin shongthait kumjuh .

en: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord , and hast said , With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains , to the sides of Lebanon , and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof , and the choice fir trees thereof : and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders , and into the forest of his Carmel .
kha: Me phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban kob sarong ïa nga ba da ki kali ïapom baroh ki jong me , me la jop thiaw ïa ki lum bajrong tam u Lebanon . Me kob sarong ba hangta me pom ïa ki dieng Kedar bajrong tam bad ïa ki dieng Kseh-Sypress bakynsai tam bad me ïohrung shaduh ki bynta bashapoh tam jong ki khlaw .
