translated_en_to_kha: Da ki nonglam khubor jong me me la kren bein ia U Trai, bad me la ong, Da ka jingbun ki kali jong nga nga la wan sha jrong jong ki lum, sha ki liang jong ka Lebanon, bad ngan ot ia ki dieng cedar kiba jrong jong ka, bad ki dieng ba la jied jong ka: bad ngan rung sha ki jaka sah jong u, bad sha ka khlaw jong u Karmel .

en: So that the fishes of the sea , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the field , and all creeping things that creep upon the earth , and all the men that are upon the face of the earth , shall shake at my presence , and the mountains shall be thrown down , and the steep places shall fall , and every wall shall fall to the ground .
kha: Man la ka dohkha bad ka sim , man la ka mrad , barit bad baheh , bad man la u briew halor ka sla pyrthei kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ïa nga . Ki lumbah kin khyllem , ki riat kin twa , bad kawei pa kawei ka kynroh kan kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki dohkha duriaw bad ki sim bneng bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki jingthaw baroh kiba iaid halor ka khyndew bad ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka khyndew kin khih ha khmat jong nga bad ki lum kin hap noh , bad ki jaka ba jrong kin hap ha khyndew .

en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers . And the king spake , and said to the wise men of Babylon , Whosoever shall read this writing , and shew me the interpretation thereof , shall be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about his neck , and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom .
kha: U la pyrta ïano ïano ban wallam shapoh ïa ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti . Haba ki la ïawan shapoh , u syiem u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa uno uno uba lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka yn pynphong ha ki jaiñkup syiem kiba sawbthuh , un deng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u , bad un long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la pyrta jam ban wanrah ia ki nongleh jadu, ki Khlieh bad ki nongleh jadu . Bad u syiem u la kren bad u la ong ha ki riewstad jong ka Babilon , Uno uno u briew uba pule ia kane ka jingthoh bad uba pyni ia nga ia ka jingbatai jong ka , un phong da ka kynjri ksiar sawdong ka ryndang jong u , bad un long u nongsynshar ksiar uba lai ha ka hima .

en: And she looked , and , behold , the king stood at his pillar at the entering in , and the princes and the trumpets by the king : and all the people of the land rejoiced , and sounded with trumpets , also the singers with instruments of musick , and such as taught to sing praise . Then Athaliah rent her clothes , and said , Treason , Treason .
kha: Hangta ka la ïohi ïa u syiem thymmai ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ , ba u ïeng ha syndah u rishot ba la buh khnang na ka bynta ki syiem bad ba la ker sawdong ïa u da ki rangbah shipai bad ki nongput turoi . Ki paidbah baroh ki ïarisa da ka jingkmen bad ki put ïa ki turoi , bad ki nongput nongtem ka Templ ki ïalam ïa ka jinglehkmen da ki jingput jingtem jong ki . Ka la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad ka lynñiar ,  Ka Jingshetkylla ! Ka Jingshetkylla !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la peit, bad, ha khmih, u syiem u la ieng ha u maw jong u ha ka por ba rung shapoh, bad ki rangbah bad ki turoi da u syiem: bad ki briew baroh ki la ia risa bad ki la sawa da ki turoi, bad ki nongrwai da ki tiar ialehkai, bad kiba la hikai ban rwai iaroh . Nangta ka Athaliah ka la pynkhih ia ki jain jong ka, bad ka la ong, Ka Jingktah, ka Jingktah.

en: Then Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , was astonished for one hour , and his thoughts troubled him . The king spake , and said , Belteshazzar , let not the dream , or the interpretation thereof , trouble thee . Belteshazzar answered and said , My lord , the dream be to them that hate thee , and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies .
kha: Ha kane , u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar , u la sngewsheptieng katta katta ba um lah ban ong ei ei . U syiem u la ong ha u ,  Ko Belteshassar , wat ai ba ka jingphohsniew bad ka khubor jong ka kin pynsheptieng ïa me .  U Belteshassar u la phai ktien ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kwah ba ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingbatai ïa ka kan dei ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad ym ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel uba la tip kyrteng kum u Beltsasar u la lyngngoh shi kynta, bad ki jingpyrkhat jong u ki la pynkhuslai ia u. U syiem u la kren bad u la ong, Wat ai ba ka jingphohsniew ne ka jingbatai jong ka kan pynkhuslai ia me. U Beltsasar u la jubab bad u la ong, ko kynrad jong nga, ka jingphohsniew jong nga kan long ha kita kiba shun ia me, bad ka jingbatai jong ka ha ki nongshun jong me .

en: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king s office by the hand of the Levites , and when they saw that there was much money , the king s scribe and the high priest s officer came and emptied the chest , and took it , and carried it to his place again . Thus they did day by day , and gathered money in abundance .
kha: Man ka sngi ki Lebi ki leit rah ïa kata ka synduk sha u nongpynïaidkam u syiem , uba dei peit ïa ka . Ha man ba ka dap , u sekretari syiem bad u nongmihkhmat ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki sei shabar ïa ka pisa bad ki leit buh biang ïa ka synduk ha ka jaka jong ka . Bad kumta ki la ïohlum shibun ka pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ba ha ka por ba la wanrah ia ka synduk ha ka kam syiem da ki Lebi, bad haba ki la iohi ba ka don ka pisa kaba bun, u nongthoh syiem bad u rangbah lyngdoh u la wan bad u la thylli ia ka synduk bad u la rah biang ia ka sha ka jaka jong u . Kumta ki la leh ia kata man ka sngi .

en: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada , whereof were made vessels for the house of the  Lord  , even vessels to minister , and to offer withal , and spoons , and vessels of gold and silver . And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the  Lord  continually all the days of Jehoiada .
kha: Ynda ki la pyndep ïa ka jingpynbha , ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba tam la ai sha u syiem bad sha u Jehoïada , kiba la pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba phah shna ïa ki pliang bad kiwei ki pat ki khiew ki pliang na ka bynta ka Templ . Katba u Jehoïada u dang im , ïa ki jingkñia la ai tista ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ki la dep ia ka, ki la wanrah ia ka pisa kaba sah ha khmat u syiem bad u Jehoiada, na ki la shna ia ki tiar na ka bynta ka iing U Trai, wat ki tiar ban shakri bad ban ai ia ka met bad ki spun bad ki tiar ksiar bad rupa . Ki la ai ia ki jingknia thang ha ka iing U Trai man ka por ha ki sngi jong u Jehoiada .

en: And , behold , the whole family is risen against thine handmaid , and they said , Deliver him that smote his brother , that we may kill him , for the life of his brother whom he slew  ; and we will destroy the heir also : and so they shall quench my coal which is left , and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth .
kha: Bad mynta , ko kynrad , baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga ki la phai pyrshah ïa nga bad ki dawa ba ngan ai ha ki ïa u khun shynrang jong nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pynïap ïa u namar ba u la pynïap ïa uba shi para bad u . Lada ki leh ïa kane , ngan shah iehnoh khlem u khun . Kin pynjot ïa ka jingkyrmen bakhatduh jong nga bad kin iehnoh ïa u tnga jong nga khlem u khun jong u ban ri pynim ïa ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka longiing baroh kawei ka la kiew pyrshah ia ka kti jong me, bad ki la ong, To ai ia u uba la shoh ia u hynmen jong u, ba ngin pyniap ia u, namar ka jingim jong u hynmen jong u uba u la pyniap; bad kumta kin pynjot ia u dewiong jong nga uba sah ha ka khyndew .

en: And I heard the man clothed in linen , which was upon the waters of the river , when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven , and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time , times , and an half  ; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people , all these things shall be finished .
kha: U angel u la rah ïa la ki kti sha bneng bad u la pynlong ka jingkular kyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei Bymjukut . Nga la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ,  Kan long lai snem shiteng . Haba ka jingpynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew jong U Blei ka kut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin hap ban jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia uta u briew uba la phong da ka jain lin kaba don halor ki um jong ka wah, haba u la bat ia ka kti kadiang bad ka kti kadiang jong u sha bneng, bad u la sngap jar da uta uba im junom ba kan long shipor, bad shiteng; bad ynda u la pyndep ia ka bor jong ki briew kiba khuid .

en: For when I had brought them into the land , for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them , then they saw every high hill , and all the thick trees , and they offered there their sacrifices , and there they presented the provocation of their offering : there also they made their sweet savour , and poured out there their drink offerings .
kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki . Haba ki la ïohi ïa ki lum bajrong bad ïa ki dieng bajyrngam , ki la ai jingkñia ha ki baroh . Ki la pynbitar ïa nga da ki jingkñia kiba ki la thang bad da ka waiñ kaba ki la wallam kum ki jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba nga la wanrah ia ki sha ka ri, na ka bynta kaba nga la rah ia ka kti jong nga ban ai ia ka ha ki, nangta ki la iohi ia u lum baroh uba jrong, bad ki dieng kiba jylliew baroh, bad ki la tyrwa hangta ia ki jingknia jong ki: hangta ruh ki la pynlong ia ki jingknia ba thiang jong ki .

en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary , and all the vessels of the sanctuary , as the camp is to set forward  ; after that , the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it : but they shall not touch any holy thing , lest they die . These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: ban buh jingthoh ïa ki Lebi katno ngut ki don shi kur shi kur bad shi ïing shi ïing , da kaba thoh kyrteng ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang uba la dap shi bnai ne kham heh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pynkut noh ia ka jaka kyntang bad ki tiar kyntang baroh, kumba ka camp ka dei ban leit sha khmat shuh shuh: hynrei ki khun shynrang jong u Kohath kin wan ban kit ia ka: hynrei kin ym ktah ia kaei kaei kaba khuid , ioh ba kin iap . Kine kiei kiei ki long ki jingkit jong ki khun shynrang jong u Kohath ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And it shall come to pass , that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , that nation will I punish , saith the  Lord  , with the sword , and with the famine , and with the pestilence , until I have consumed them by his hand .
kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima kam pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u , te ngan pynshitom ïa kata ka jaitbynriew da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad da ka jingpang tad haduh ba ngan da shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban pynjot khoit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba ka jaitbynriew bad ka hima ki bym shakri ia u juh u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon , bad kata kan ym buh ia ka ryndang jong u syiem Babilon , kata ka jaitbynriew ngan pynshitom , ko Trai , da ka waitlam bad da ka jingpang khlam , haduh ba ngan da bam ia ki da ka kti jong u .

en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let my lord the king hear the words of his servant . If the  Lord  have stirred thee up against me , let him accept an offering : but if they be the children of men , cursed be they before the  Lord   ; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the  Lord  , saying , Go , serve other gods .
kha: Ko syiem kynrad , sngap ïa kaei ba ngan ong . Lada dei U  Trai  uba la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa nga , ka jingainguh ïa u , to kan pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u ; hynrei lada ki briew ki la leh ïa ka , to ka jingtim U  Trai  kan hap ha ki . Naba ki la beh noh ïa nga na ka ri U  Trai  sha ka ri ha kaba nga lah ban mane tang ïa ki blei nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba u kynrad jong nga un iohsngew ia ki ktien jong u shakri jong u . Lada U Trai u la pynkhih ia me pyrshah ia nga: hynrei lada ki long ki khun shynrang , la tim ia ki ha khmat U Trai; namar ki la beh noh ia nga ha kane ka sngi na kaba sah ha ka pateng U Trai, da kaba ong: Leit, to shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei .

en: Men shall buy fields for money , and subscribe evidences , and seal them , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , and in the cities of the mountains , and in the cities of the valley , and in the cities of the south : for I will cause their captivity to return , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki briew kin thied ïa ki , bad ïa ki dulir thied jaka yn soi , shon muhor bad yn sakhi . Kane kan jia ha ka ri Benjamin , ha ki shnong sawdong ka Jerusalem , ha ki shnong ka Judah , bad ha ki shnong ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ngan pynïoh pat ha ki briew ïa ka ri jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kin thied ia ki lyngkha na ka bynta ka pisa, bad kin ai sakhi ia ki, bad kin shim sakhi ha ka ri Benjamin, bad ha ki jaka kiba don sawdong ka Jerusalem bad ha ki nongbah jong ki lum bad ha ki nongbah jong ki lum bad ha ki nongbah jong ka them: namar ngan pynlong ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki ban wan phai biang, ong U Trai .

en: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah , even the king s daughters , and all the people that remained in Mizpah , whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive , and departed to go over to the Ammonites .
kha: Nangta u la pynlong koidi ïa ki khun kynthei u syiem bad ïa ki briew baroh ha Mispah kiba dang sah ïa kiba u Nebusaradan u rangbah shipai u la iehnoh ha ka jingpeit u Gedalaïah . U Ishmael u la shim ïa ki kum ki koidi bad u la leit ha ka phang jong ka ri ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ishmael u la rah noh ia ki briew kiba sah ha Mizpah, wat ki khun kynthei jong u syiem, bad ki briew baroh kiba sah ha Mizpah, kiba u Nebuzaradan u rangbah shipai u la aiti ha u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam: bad u Ishmael u khun u Nethaniah u la rah noh ia ki sha ka ri Ammon .

en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them , saying , Return ye now every man from his evil way , and amend your doings , and go not after other gods to serve them , and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers : but ye have not inclined your ear , nor hearkened unto me .
kha: Nga la ïai phah sha phi ïa baroh ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la ong ïa phi ban iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymman jong phi bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Ki la maham ïa phi ban ym mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaishong ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane sngap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phah ruh ha phi baroh ia ki shakri jong nga, da kaba khie dang step bad phah ia ki, da kaba ong: To leit phai noh mynta uwei pa uwei na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u, bad pynbeit ia ki kam jong phi, bad wat leit bud ia kiwei pat ki blei ban shakri ia ki, bad phin shong ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi: hynrei phim shym la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong phi, lymne phim shym la sngap ia nga .

en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel , unto Abner the son of Ner , and unto Amasa the son of Jether , whom he slew , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins , and in his shoes that were on his feet .
kha: Ka dang don shuh sa kawei pat . Me kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la leh ïa nga da kaba pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki shipai Israel — u Abner , u khun jong u Ner bad u Amasa , u khun jong u Jether . Me kynmaw kumno u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka por suk pyrthei kum ka jingpynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynïap kaba ki la leh ha ka por thma . U la pynïap ïa ki rangbah balui lui , bad mynta nga bah ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kaei kaba u la leh , bad nga la shah jynjar na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me tip ruh ia kaei kaba u Joab u khun jong u Seruiah u la leh ia nga, bad kaei kaba u la leh ia ki arngut ki rangbah shipai Israel, ha u Abner u khun u Ner, bad ha u Amasa u khun u Jether, uba u la pyniap, bad u la theh ia ka snam thma ha ka jingsuk, bad u la buh ia ka snam thma ha ka tyrpeng jong u kaba la don ha ki tyrpeng jong u, bad ha ki juti jong u kiba don ha ki kjat jong u .

en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the  Lord  was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u pynkyntang ruh ïa ka bynta kaba hapdeng ka phyllaw , kata ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u kñia hangta ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad na ka bynta ka jingainguh jingïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba kata ka duwan rnong ka rit than eh na ka bynta baroh kine ki jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi u syiem u la pynkhuid ia ka pdeng jong ka iing U Trai: namar hangta u la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia doh: namar ka jingknia ba la shet ha khmat U Trai ka long kaba duna palat ban pdiang ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia doh .

en: Then thou shalt say before the  Lord  thy God , I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house , and also have given them unto the Levite , and unto the stranger , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me : I have not transgressed thy commandments , neither have I forgotten them :
kha: phin ong ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ‘ Ngam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ha ïing na kata kaba nga la lum kyrpang ; nga la ai ïa ka ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , kumba me la hukum ïa nga . Ngam shym la leh palat lane leh klet ïa ki hukum jong me kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta me dei ban ong ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me, nga la weng noh ia kiei kiei kiba la pynkyntang na ka iing jong nga, bad nga ruh nga la ai ia ki ha u Lebi, bad ha u nongwei, ha u khunlung bad ha ka riewkynthei, kat kum ki hukum jong me baroh kiba me la hukum ia nga: ngam shym la pynkhein ia ki hukum jong me: bad ngam shym la klet ia ki:

en: So Hanameel mine uncle s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the  Lord  , and said unto me , Buy my field , I pray thee , that is in Anathoth , which is in the country of Benjamin : for the right of inheritance is thine , and the redemption is thine  ; buy it for thyself . Then I knew that this was the word of the  Lord .
kha: Te kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Hanamel u la wan sha nga hangta ha ka phyllaw bad u la ong ïa nga ba ngan thied ïa ka lyngkha . Kumta nga sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la kren shisha ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Hanameel u khun jong nga u la wan sha nga ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok kat kum ka ktien U Trai , bad u la ong ha nga: To thied ia ka lyngkha jong nga, kaba don ha ka ri u Benjamin: namar ka hok jong ka pateng ka long ka jong me . Nangta nga la tip ba kane ka long ka ktien U Trai .

en: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons that were slain , and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber . So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest , ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , ) hid him from Athaliah , so that she slew him not .
kha: U Ahasaïah u don kawei ka para ar kmie , ka Jehosheba , kaba shongkurim ïa u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Jehoïada . Ka la pyllait im jar jar ïa u Joash , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahasaïah , ka la shim ïa u na kiwei pat ki khun syiem kiba la dei ban shah pynïap bad ka la buhrieh ïa u bad ka nongri khun ha ka kamra thiah ha ka Templ . Da kaba buhrieh ïa u , ka la pyllait im ïa u na ka jingshah pynïap ha ki kti jong ka Athalaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehoshabeth u khun jong u syiem u la shim ia u khun u Ahasaiah, bad u la tuh ia u na ki khun syiem kiba la shah pyniap, bad u la buh ia u bad ka nongsumar jong u ha ka kamra thiah . Kumta u Jehoshabeth, ka khun jong u syiem Jehoram, ka tnga jong u syiem Jehoshabet, (namar ka long ka para jong u Ahasaiah,) u la buhrieh ia u na Athaiah .

en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat , and Jehoram , and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own hallowed things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and in the king s house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria : and he went away from Jerusalem .
kha: U Joash u syiem ka Judah u shim lut ïa baroh ki jingai ba kiba ha shuwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Ahasaïah ki la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , u kynthup lang ïa ki jingai jong u bad ka ksiar baroh kaba ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ïa kita baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Hasael , uba ïalam noh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehosh u syiem Judah u la shim ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la pynkyntang ia u Jehosh, bad u Ahasaiah, ki kpa tymmen jong u, ki syiem Judah, ki la aiti lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la pynkyntang, bad ka ksiar baroh kaba la lap ha ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing U Trai, bad ha ka iing syiem jong u, bad u la phah ia ka sha u Hazael u syiem Syria: bad u la leit noh na Jerusalem .

en: Now while he was not yet gone back , he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah , and dwell with him among the people : or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go . So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .
kha: Haba ngam shym la jubab , u Nebusaradan u la ong ,  Khie leit phai pat sha u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , ïa uba u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong ïa u , u lat jong ki shnong ka Judah . Phi lah ban sah bad u bad im hapdeng ki briew , lane phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi pyrkhat ba phi dei ban leit .  Kumta u la ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha bad katto katne ka jingbam ban rah bad nga , bad u la shah ïa nga ba ngan leit noh ha la ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba u dang leit phai noh, u la ong, To leit phai biang ruh sha u Ahikam u khun u Ahaphan, ia uba u syiem Babilon u la pynlong ia u nongsynshar halor ki nongbah Judah, bad u la shong bad u hapdeng ki briew: lane leit shano shano ruh ba phi sngewtynnad ban leit . Kumta u kapten jong ki nongap u la ai ia u ia ki jingbam bad ka bainong , bad u la pyllait noh ia u .

en: Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .
kha: A Blei , U Blei jong ngi , katno me long uba khraw ! Katno me long uba shyrkhei bad uba donbor ! Me batskhem ïa ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . Naduh ka por ba ki syiem Assyria ki banbeiñ ïa ngi , wat haduh kane ka por , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki lyngdoh jong ngi bad ki nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad baroh ki briew jong ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw haduh katno ngi la shahshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ko Blei jong ngi, uba khraw, uba donbor bad uba shyrkhei, uba bat ia ka jutang bad ka jingisynei, wat ai ba ka jingeh baroh kan long kaba rit ha khmat jong me, kaba la wan ha ngi, ha ki syiem jong ngi, bad ha ki rangbah jong ngi, bad ha ki nongiathuhlypa jong ngi, bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi baroh, naduh ka por jong ki syiem jong ngi haduh kine ki sngi .

en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
kha: Ïa ka jaka ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ïa ki longïing kiba sah na ka jait Manasseh : u Abieser , u Helek , u Asriel , u Shekhem , u Hepher , bad u Shemida . Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki longïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ruh shibun na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Manasseh da ki longiing jong ki, bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Helek, bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Shehel bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Hepher bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Hepher: kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Manasseh u khun shynrang jong u Joseph da ki longiing jong ki .

en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height , neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs , neither their trees stand up in their height , all that drink water : for they are all delivered unto death , to the nether parts of the earth , in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down to the pit .
kha: Bad kumta naduh mynta hi , yn ym don shuh u dieng , kam pher katno la ai um bha ïa u , un jrong pat sa shisien ne u ban kynjoh ïa la ka kliar lyngba ki lyoh bad u ban kot kat kato ka rynïeng . Ïa ki baroh la buh ban ïap kum ïa baroh ki briew ba dei ban ïap , la buh ba kin ïasoh bad kito kiba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba ym don uwei ruh na ki dieng harud ki um uba pynkiew ia lade na ka bynta ka jingjrong jong ki, bad ki dieng jong ki kim ieng ha ka jingjrong jong ki: namar baroh ki la shah pyniap haduh ka jingiap, ha pdeng ki khun ki ksiew jong ki briew, bad ki kiba leit shapoh ka thliew .

en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together , and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of their fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin : and he numbered them from twenty years old and above , and found them three hundred thousand choice men , able to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .
kha: U Syiem Amasaïah u pynbeit ïa baroh ki rangbah jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin ha ki kynhun shipai , kat kum ki kur jong ki , bad u la buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka jingai hukum ïa ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut . Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba arphew snem ne kham ïaw , baroh ki long lai lakh ngut . Ki long ki shipai ba la jied , kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma , kiba tbit ban pyndonkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Amasaiah u la lum lang ia ki shipai kiba la shah jied da ki hajar ngut, bad ki shipai kiba la shah jied da ki hajar ngut, kat kum ki iing jong ki kpa jong ki baroh kawei: bad u la khein ia ki naduh arphew snem shaneng, bad u la shem ia ki lai spah hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied, kiba lah ban leit sha ka thma, kiba lah ban bat ia ka khnam bad ka jingda .

en: And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand . If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come  ; and I will look well unto thee : but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear : behold , all the land is before thee : whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go .
kha: Mynta , ngan law noh ïa ki kynjri na ki ryndang-kti jong phi bad pyllait noh ïa phi . Lada phi kwah ban leit sha Babilonia ryngkat bad nga , phi lah ban leh kumta , bad ngan sumar ïa phi . Hynrei lada phim kwah ban leit , phi lah ban ym leit . Phi don ïa ka ri baroh kawei ban jied , phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, nga pyllait noh ia me ha kane ka sngi na ki kynjri kiba la don ha ka kti jong me. Lada ka long kaba bha ia me ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha Babilon, to wan bad ngan peit bha ia me: hynrei lada ka long kaba sniew ia me ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha Babilon, to leit noh: ha khmih, ka ri baroh kawei ka long ha khmat jong me: ha kaba ka long kaba bha bad kaba suk ia me ban leit sha Babilon .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying  ; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths , and fulfilled with your hand , saying , We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed , to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her : ye will surely accomplish your vows , and surely perform your vows .
kha: Nga la ong ïa ki briew baroh , khamtam ïa ki kynthei , ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha ki paid Judah kiba sah ha Ijipt :  Ma phi bad ki tnga jong phi , phi la pynlong ki jingkular bakyntang ha ka Syiem jong ka Bneng . Phi la kular ba phin ai ki jingkñia ha ka bad ban theh ka jingainguh waiñ ha ka , bad phi la bat ïa la ki jingkular . Ka long kaba bha keiñ ! To bat ïa la ki jingkular ! Pyndep ïa la ki jingsmai !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel, u ong: Phi bad ki tnga jong phi baroh arngut phi la kren da ka shyntur jong phi, bad phi la pyndep da ka kti jong phi, da kaba ong: Ngin sa pyndep shisha ia ki jingkular jong ngi kiba ngi la kular, ban thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ka mahadei bneng, bad ban theh ia ki jingknia dih sha ka: phin sa pyndep shisha ia ki jingkular jong phi .

en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .
kha: Ngin leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba ngi la ong ban leh . Ngin ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka blei jong ngi , ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ sha ka , kumba ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u syiem jong ngi bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi manbha , bad ngim ju don jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngin leh shisha ia kaei kaei kaba mih na ka shyntur jong ngi hi, ban thang ia ka mahadei bneng, bad ban theh ia ki jingknia dih sha ka, kumba ngi la leh, ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, ki syiem jong ngi bad ki syiem jong ngi, ha ki shnong Judah bad ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem: namar ha kata ka por ngi la ioh ia ki jingbam ba bun bad ngi la ioh ia ka jingsniew .

en: And when the man rose up to depart , he , and his concubine , and his servant , his father in law , the damsel s father , said unto him , Behold , now the day draweth toward evening , I pray you tarry all night : behold , the day groweth to an end , lodge here , that thine heart may be merry  ; and to morrow get you early on your way , that thou mayest go home .
kha: Haba uta u briew , ka tnga kliar jong u , bad u shakri jong u sa shisien ki khreh ban leit noh , u kpa u ong ,  Khmih , ka sngi ka la jan sep ; kan bha ba phin sah sa shi miet . Kan sa dum shen ; sah hangne bad pynsngewbha ïa lade . Lashai phi lah ban khie dang step ban leit ha ka jingleit sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba uta u briew u la ieng ban leit noh, ma u bad u shakri jong u, u kpa tymmen jong u, u kpa tymmen jong u, u la ong ha u, Ha khmih mynta ka sngi ka la jan jan jan janmiet, nga kyrpad ia phi ban sah baroh shi miet: ha khmih ka sngi ka la kut noh, to sah hangne, ba ka dohnud jong me kan sngewbha; bad ban leit phai noh sha la iing .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood  ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad ban rah ïa u halor ki wah , ki nur-um , bad ki pukri um baroh ha ka ri Ijipt . Ka um kan kylla snam , bad ha ka ri baroh kawei kan don ka snam , wat ha ki khiew dieng bad ki khiew maw ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses, To ong ha u Aaron, bad to pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ki um Ijipt, halor ki wah jong ki, halor ki wah jong ki, bad halor ki pung um jong ki baroh, ba kin kylla snam; bad ba kan don ka snam ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei, ha ki khiew dieng bad ha ki khiew maw .

en: But Elisha sat in his house , and the elders sat with him  ; and the king sent a man from before him : but ere the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head ? look , when the messenger cometh , shut the door , and hold him fast at the door : is not the sound of his master s feet behind him ?
kha: Bad u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban wallam ïa u Elisha . Ha kajuh ka por , u Elisha u don ha ïing lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san kiba dang wan jngoh ïa u . Shuwa ba u nonglamktien jong u syiem un poi , u Elisha u ong ha kita ki tymmen ki san ,  Uto u nongpynïap u la phah briew ban pynïap ïa nga ! Mynta , ynda uta u briew u poi hangne , khang ïa ka jingkhang bad wat shah ba un rung hapoh . U syiem da lade un wan nadien jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Elisha u la shong ha iing jong u, bad ki rangbah ki la shong bad u ; bad u syiem u la phah ia u briew na khmat jong u: hynrei shuwa ba u nonglam khubor u la wan sha u: Peit kumno une u khun jong u nongpyniap briew u la phah ban shim noh ia ka khlieh jong nga ?

en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door , to bring forth out of the temple of the  Lord  all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven : and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron , and carried the ashes of them unto Beth–el .
kha: Nangta u Josaïah u hukum ïa u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ïa ki lyngdoh ba ïarap ïa u , bad ïa ki nongap kiba treikam ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ ban wanrah shabar ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , ïa ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ki khlur . U syiem u la thang ïa kine ki tiar baroh shabar ka nongbah hajan ka Them Kidron , bad nangta ïa u dpei la rah sha Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum ia u Hilkiah u rangbah lyngdoh bad ki lyngdoh jong ka kynhun kaba ar, bad ki nongap jong ka jingkhang, ban pynmih na ka tempi U Trai ia ki tiar baroh kiba la shna na ka bynta u Baal bad na ka bynta u khlaw baroh: bad u la thang ia ki shabar jong ka Jerusalem ha ki lyngkha Kidron bad u la rah ia ka dewbilat jong ki haduh Bethesel .

en: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , from Mizpah , after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , even mighty men of war , and the women , and the children , and the eunuchs , whom he had brought again from Gibeon :
kha: Nangta u Johanan lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki shipai u la shimti ïa ki briew kiba u Ishmael u la ïalam noh kum ki koidi na Mispah hadien ba u la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah — ki shipai , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki ïunukh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shim ia u Johanan u khun jong u Krea, bad ki rangbah shipai baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, baroh kiba sah na u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah, na Mispah, hadien ba u la pyniap ia u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam, wat ia ki shipai kiba khlain bor, bad ki kynthei bad ki khun ki kti kiba u la wanrah biang na Gibeon:

en: Therefore , thou son of man , say unto the children of thy people , The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression : as for the wickedness of the wicked , he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness  ; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth .
kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , ïathuh ha ki Israel ba haba u briew babha u leh pop , ka jingleh babha ba u leh kam lah ban pynim ïa u . Lada u briew basniew , u sangeh kaba leh bymman , yn ym pynshitom ïa u , bad lada u briew babha u sdang ban leh pop , ïa ka jingim jong u yn ym pynsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko khun u briew, to ong ha ki khun jong me, Ka hok jong u hok kan ym pyllait ia u ha ka sngi jong ka jingleh bymman jong u: katba ia ka jingsniew jong u bymman , un ym hap da kata ha ka sngi ba u phai noh na ka jingsniew jong u; lymne u hok un ym lah ban im na ka bynta ka hok jong u ha ka sngi ba u leh pop .

en: And that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams , shall be put to death  ; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you out of the house of bondage , to thrust thee out of the way which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to walk in . So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee .
kha: Hynrei pynïap ïa uno uno u nongïathuhlypa lane uno uno u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew uba ong ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw . Kum uta u briew u long uba bymman bad u pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na kata ka rukom im ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi . Ïa une dei ban pynïap , khnang ba phin lah ban pyllait ïa lade na kane ka jingbymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u nongiathuhlypa ; ne uta u nongphohsniew jong phi un shah pyniap namar u la kren ban pynphai noh ia phi na U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la pynmih ia phi na ka ri Ijipt bad u la pyllait im ia phi na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw, ban beh noh ia me na ka lynti kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me ban iaid shapoh . Kumta to weng noh ia ka jingsniew na pdeng jong me .

en: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the image which I have made  ; well : but if ye worship not , ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace  ; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands ?
kha: Te mynta , tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong ki turoi , ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , ki duitara , bad baroh kiwei pat ki tiar put tiar tem , to dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew . Lada phim leh kumta , yn bret kloi lan ïa phi ha ka lawar ding baklang . Hato phi pyrkhat ba don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada phi long kiba la pynkhreh ia kata ha kano ka por ba phi iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka kornet, ka flute, ka harp, ka sniehdoh, ka jingsawa bad ka jingsma baroh, phi hap bad mane ia ka dur kaba nga la shna bha: hynrei lada phim mane bha: hynrei lada phim mane ia kata kajuh ka kynta hapdeng ka ding kaba thang bad mano ba uta u Blei un pyllait ia phi na ki kti jong nga ?

en: Then they came near , and spake before the king concerning the king s decree  ; Hast thou not signed a decree , that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days , save of thee , O king , shall be cast into the den of lions ? The king answered and said , The thing is true , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
kha: baroh na ki , ki la ïaleit lang sha u syiem ban mudui ïa u Daniel . Ki la ong ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi la soi ïa ka hukum ba na ka bynta ki laiphew sngi kiba bud ïa uno uno uba kyrpad ïa kano kano na uno uno u blei lane na uno uno u briew lait tang na phi , yn bret ïa u hapoh ka thliew ba-dap da ki sing .  U syiem u la jubab ,  Ho-oid , ka hukum kaba pyrkhing , ka aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan hajan bad ki la kren ha khmat u syiem shaphang ka hukum jong u syiem, ba uwei pa uwei u briew uba pan ia ka jingkyrpad jong uno uno u Blei ne u briew hapoh laiphew sngi, lait noh tang ma me ko syiem, un shah bret ha ka thliew jong ki sing ? U syiem u la jubab bad u la ong: Kaei kaei kaei ka long kaba shisha kat kum ka ain jong ki Media bad ki Persia ki bym kylla .

en: And I saw thrones , and they sat upon them , and judgment was given unto them : and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus , and for the word of God , and which had not worshipped the beast , neither his image , neither had received his mark upon their foreheads , or in their hands  ; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ki khet bad ha kito kiba shong ha ki la ai ïa ka bor ban bishar . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka jingshisha ïa kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw bad ïa ka ktien U Blei . Kim shym la mane ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka dur jong u , lymne ba ki la pdiang ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw ha ki shyllangmat jong ki lane ha ki kti jong ki . Ki la im pat bad ki la synshar kum ki syiem bad U Khrist shihajar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia ki khet, bad ki la shong halor jong ki, bad la ai ia ka jingbishar ha ki: bad nga la iohi ia ki mynsiem jong ki kiba la shah pynkhlieh khlieh na ka bynta ka jingsakhi U Jisu bad na ka bynta ka ktien U Blei , bad ki bym shym la mane ia uta u mrad , lymne ia ka dur jong u, lymne ha ki kti jong ki; bad ki la im bad ki la synshar bad ki la synshar bad U Khrist ha ka hajar snem .

en: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together  ; for the king s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement : but she shall not retain the power of the arm  ; neither shall he stand , nor his arm : but she shall be given up , and they that brought her , and he that begat her , and he that strengthened her in these times .
kha: Hadien bun tylli ki snem u syiem ka Ijipt un pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u syiem ka Syria bad un ai shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u . Hynrei ka jingïateh lok kan ym neh ; bad ïa ka , ïa u tnga jong ka , ïa i khun jong ka bad ïa ki shakri kiba la ïaleit bad ka yn pynïap baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaba kut jong ki snem kin iasoh lang na ka bynta u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi ban iateh: hynrei kan ym bat ia ka bor jong ka kti; hynrei kan ym ieng: hynrei kan shah pyllait noh ia ka; bad kita kiba la wanrah ia ka, bad uta uba la pynskhem ia ka ha kine ki por .

en: Either three years  famine  ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee  ; or else three days the sword of the  Lord  , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the  Lord  destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .
kha: Lai snem ka jingkyrduh bam ? Lane , lai bnai kaba phet krad na ki nongshun jong me ? Lane lai sngi ha kaba U  Trai  u tur ïaleh ïa me da ka waitlam bad phah ka jingïapthem halor ka ri jong me , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u angel jong u ban wallam ka jingïap ha kylleng ka Israel ? Kaei ka jubab ba ngan ai ha U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: La ka long kaba lai snem ne lai bnai ban shah pynjot ha khmat ki nongshun jong me, katba ka waitlam jong ki nongshun jong me ka la jop ia me lane lym kumta lai sngi ka waitlam jong U Trai, wat ka jingpang khlam, ha ka ri baroh kawei . Mynta to ai jingmut ia lade ia kaei ka ktien kaba ngan wanrah biang sha uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: And they said unto him , There came a man up to meet us , and said unto us , Go , turn again unto the king that sent you , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel , that thou sendest to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron ? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
kha: Ki jubab ,  La wan shem ïa ngi da uwei u briew uba ong ïa ngi ban wan phai noh bad ïathuh ha phi ba U  Trai  u ong ïa phi , ‘ Balei me phah ki nonglamktien ban kylli na u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron ? Hato ka dei namar ba me pyrkhat ba ym don blei ha Israel ? Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jong me ; men ïap !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Uwei u briew u la wan ban iakynduh ia ngi, bad u la ong ha ngi, To leit phai biang sha u syiem uba la phah ia phi, bad to ong ha u, Hato kam dei namar ba ym don Blei ha Israel, ba me phah ban kylli na u Baalzebul u blei jong u Ekron ? namarkata wat wan hiar na kata ka jingthiah ha kaba me la leit kiew, hynrei thikna ba me iap .

en: And the men which were expressed by name rose up , and took the captives , and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them , and arrayed them , and shod them , and gave them to eat and to drink , and anointed them , and carried all the feeble of them upon asses , and brought them to Jericho , the city of palm trees , to their brethren : then they returned to Samaria .
kha: bad ïa ki saw ngut ki rangbah la thung ban pynbiang ïa ki koidi da ki jaiñ na ki mar ba la lute . Ki ai ha ki ïa ki jaiñ bad ki juti ban phong , ki ai ïa ki ka bam ka dih kaba biang , bad ki tah da ka umphniang Olib ïa ki jingmong jong ki . Ïa kito kiba tlot palat ban ïaid ki pynshong ha ki kada , bad ïa baroh ki koidi la ïalam biang sha ka ri Judia ha Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai . Nangta ki Israel ki wan phai sha la ïing sha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la pynpaw da ka kyrteng ki la kiew, bad ki la phong da ka jain lyngkhuid baroh hapdeng jong ki, bad ki la pynkhuid ia ki, bad ki la ai bam bad dih ia ki, bad ki la pynsleh ia ki, bad ki la rah ia ki ha Jerikos baroh kiba tlot jong ki ha ki kada, bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha Jerikos, ka shnong jong ki dieng sohjew, sha ki hynmen jong ki: nangta ki la leit phai noh sha ka ri jong ki.

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The labour of Egypt , and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans , men of stature , shall come over unto thee , and they shall be thine : they shall come after thee  ; in chains they shall come over , and they shall fall down unto thee , they shall make supplication unto thee , saying , Surely God is in thee  ; and there is none else , there is no God .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ki Israel ,  Ka spah ki Ijipt bad ki Sudan kan long ka jong phi , bad ki rangbah bajrong jong ka Seba kin long ki mraw jong phi ; kin bud ïa phi ha ki kynjri . Kin dem ngon ha phi bad kin phla , ‘ U Blei u don ryngkat bad phi — tang ma u , u long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Ka jingtrei shitom jong ka ri Ijipt bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri Ethiopia bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri Asia kin wan sha me: kin wan hadien jong me da ki kynjri kin wan sha me: bad kin hap ha me: bad kin hap ha me: Hooid U Blei u don ha me; bad ym don shuh U Blei .

en: All the king s servants , and the people of the king s provinces , do know , that whosoever , whether man or woman , shall come unto the king into the inner court , who is not called , there is one law of his to put him to death , except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre , that he may live : but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days .
kha: Lada mano mano , u briew ne ka briew , u ban leit sha ka jaka ba kham shapoh ka phyllaw u syiem bad leit ïakynduh ïa u khlem shah khot , un ïap . Kata ka dei ka aiñ ; naduh ki nongai jingmut u syiem haduh ki riewpaidbah jong ki jylla , ki tip ïa kata . Ka don tang kawei ka lynti ban lait na kane ka aiñ : lada u syiem u pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ïano ïano , tang kata ka ban pyllait im ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka la long mynta shi bnai ba u syiem u la phah khot ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki shakri syiem bad ki briew jong ki jylla jong u syiem ki tip ba uno uno u briew u dei ban wan sha u syiem sha ka iing syiem kaba shapoh , u bym shah khot , ka don kawei ka ain jong u ban pyniap ia u , lait noh tang kito kiba u syiem un bat ia u khlieh ksiar , ba un im: hynrei ngam shym la khot ban wan sha u syiem ha kine ki laiphew sngi .

en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood  ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
kha: Nga la leh katba nga lah ban pynbiang ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka Templ — Ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ki dieng , ki mawkordor , bad ki mawlynnai , ki maw na ka bynta ki jingthaw dur , bad shibun u maw marbl .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga la pynkhreh da ka bor jong nga baroh na ka bynta ka iing U Blei jong nga ia kiei kiei kiba la shna da ka ksiar, bad ka rupa na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba la shna da ka nar, bad ki nar na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba la shna da ki dieng;

en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven , and saying , Hew the tree down , and destroy it  ; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts of the field , till seven times pass over him  ;
kha: Katba u Syiem Kynrad u dang peit , u angel u la wan hiar na bneng bad u la ong , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad pynjot ïa u , hynrei iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . Teh da u syrwiang nar bad rnong sawdong jong ka , bad iehnoh hangta ha ka pyntha lem bad u phlang . Ai ba ka umjer kan hap halor jong une u briew , bad shah ïa u ban im hangta bad ki mrad na ka bynta hynñiew snem .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u syiem u la iohi ia u nongap bad uwei uba khuid uba wan hiar na bneng, bad u la ong, Pynduh ia u dieng, bad pynjot ia u, wat ia u tynrai jong u ha ka khyndew, wat da ka nar bad ka nar, ha u phlang uba jem jong ka lyngkha; bad ai ba un sngem da ka dewbilat jong ka bneng, bad ai ba ka bynta jong u kan long kaba sngem bad ki mrad jong ka lyngkha, haduh hynriew sien ka la leit noh ha u ;

en: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him  ; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him , Make this fellow return , that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him , and let him not go down with us to battle , lest in the battle he be an adversary to us : for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master ? should it not be with the heads of these men ?
kha: Hynrei ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia ki bitar ïa u Akhish , bad ki ong ha u ,  Phah un leit noh sha ka jaka kaba phi la ai ïa u . Wat shah ba un leit bad ngi sha ka thma , ïoh u phai pyrshah ïa ngi katba ngi dang ïaleh . Naba na-ei un ïoh ka lad kaba kham bha ban pynsngewbha biang ïa la u kynrad ? Hato ym dei da ka jingïap ki briew jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ki Philistia ki la bitar ia u ; bad ki rangbah jong ki Philistia ki la ong ha u, To pynlong ia une u paralok ban leit phai biang sha ka jaka jong u kaba me la buh ia u, bad wat ai ba un leit hiar bad ngi ban ialeh thma: namar da kaba u dei ban pynbeit ia lade bad ki khlieh jong kine ki briew ?

en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki Israel ban ïalumlang ha Jerusalem . Kumta baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïaid ïa ka kam jong ka Hima , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , ki nongpeit ïa ki jingdon jingem bad ki jingri kiba dei jong u syiem bad ki khun shynrang jong u — Shisha ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki shipai kiba lamkhmat , bad ki rangbah badonkam — ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la lum lang ia ki rangbah Israel baroh, ki rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew, bad ki rangbah shipai kiba shakri ia u syiem da kaba iaid beit, bad ki rangbah shipai kiba la shah ktah ha ki hajar ngut, bad ki rangbah kiba la shah ktah ha ki spah ngut, bad ki nongshong shnong jong u, bad ki rangbah shipai jong u, bad ki rangbah shipai jong u, bad ki rangbah shipai kiba don ha Jerusalem .

en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan , and his father was a man of Tyre , skilful to work in gold , and in silver , in brass , in iron , in stone , and in timber , in purple , in blue , and in fine linen , and in crimson  ; also to grave any manner of graving , and to find out every device which shall be put to him , with thy cunning men , and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father .
kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka dkhot na ka jait Dan , bad u kpa jong u , u dei u traishnong jong ka Tyros . U tip kumno ban thaw ïa kiei kiei na ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , u maw bad ka dieng . U lah ruh ban trei bad ki jaiñ kiba jngum , sawbthuh , bad kiba rong saw , bad ka linen . U lah ban trei ïa bun jait ki jingohdur bad u lah ban bud ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñ dur kumba la ai jingmut ïa u . Shah ïa u ban trei bad ki nongtrei jong phi kiba tbit bad kito kiba la trei na ka bynta u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun jong ka kynthei na ki khun kynthei u Dan, bad u kpa jong u u long u briew uba tbit ban trei ksiar, bad ha ka rupa, ha ka nar, ha u maw, bad ha u dieng, ha ka rong saw, ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw ruh ban tep ia kano kano ka rukom kaba la buh ha u, bad ban wad ia kawei pa kawei ka tiar kaba la buh ha u, bad bad ki briew kiba stad jong u kynrad jong nga u kpa jong me.

en: The voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride , the voice of them that shall say , Praise the  Lord  of hosts : for the  Lord  is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever : and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the  Lord . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land , as at the first , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei ha kine ki jaka phin ïohsngew biang ïa ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingïabam khawai shongkurim . Phin ïohsngew ba ki briew ki ïarwai katba ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang sha ka Templ jong nga ; kin ïa-ong ,   ‘ To ainguh ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , namar u long uba bha bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .’ Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka ri kaba roi kyrhai kumba mynshuwa . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong ka jingkmen bad ka sur jong ka jingkmen, ka sur jong u nongleit kurim bad ka sur jong ka nongleit kurim, ka sur jong kita ki ban ong: Iaroh ia U Trai jong ki paid: namar U Trai u long uba bha; namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom: bad na kita ki ban wanrah ia ka jingknia iaroh sha ka iing U Trai . Namar ngan pynlong ia ka jinglong mraw jong ka ri kumba ha kaba nyngkong eh .

en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .
kha: Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , baroh ki paid Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot maw , ki pyndkut ïa ki dur ka blei Asherah , bad ki pynjot ïa ki duwan bad ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki leh ïa kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri jong ki Benjamin , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phai sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba la dep ia kine baroh, ki Israel baroh kiba la don hangta ki la leit sha ki nongbah Judah, bad ki la pynpra ia ki dur , bad ki la pynhap ia ki jaka ba jrong bad ki jaka bam na Judah bad ki nongleh kam sniew baroh . Nangta ki khun Israel baroh ki la leit phai noh sha la ki jong ki nongbah .

en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done , shew them the form of the house , and the fashion thereof , and the goings out thereof , and the comings in thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the laws thereof : and write it in their sight , that they may keep the whole form thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and do them .
kha: Te lada ki sngewlehrain ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , sa batai ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Templ ha ki : Ïa ka jingpynwandur jong ka , ïa ki khyrdop jingrung bad jingmih jong ka , ïa ka dur jong ka , ïa ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ïa baroh ki aiñ . To thoh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta jong ki khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi kumno ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh ryntih bad ba lah ban pyndep ïa baroh ki aiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki sngewlehrain ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh, to pyni ia ki ia ka dur jong ka iing, bad ki jingmih jong ka, bad ki jingwan jong ka baroh, bad ki jinglong jong ka baroh, bad ki jinglong jong ka baroh: bad ki jinglong jong ka baroh: bad ki thoh ia ka ha khmat jong ki: ba kin bat ia ka dur jong ka baroh kawei bad ki jinglong jong ka baroh .

en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem  ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta ha u bnai ba ar jong ka snem hadien ba ki la wan pat sha ka jaka jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem , ki sdang ban ïatrei . U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad kiwei pat ki para rangbah ka ri , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ha ka jingshisha , baroh kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha ka jingtrei . Ïa baroh ki Lebi kiba la dap arphew snem ka rta lane tam , la buh ban khmih ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingwan jong ki sha ka iing U Blei ha Jerusalem, ha ka taiew kaba ar, u Serubabel u khun u Josadak bad ki hynmen jong ki kiba sah ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad baroh kiba la mih na ka jingshah set phatok sha Jerusalem; bad ki la thung ia ki Lebi naduh arphew snem shaneng, ban pyniaid shakhmat ia ka kam jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And I will take the remnant of Judah , that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , and they shall all be consumed , and fall in the land of Egypt  ; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine : they shall die , from the least even unto the greatest , by the sword and by the famine : and they shall be an execration , and an astonishment , and a curse , and a reproach .
kha: Bad ïa ki briew ka Judah kiba sah bad kiba la kut jingmut ban leit bad shong ha Ijipt , ngan khmih ïa kane ba baroh na ki kin jot noh . Baroh na ki , kiba rit bad ki bakhraw , kin ïap ha Ijipt , na ka thma ne na ka jingïapthngan . Kin long ka jingïohi ba-itriem ; ki briew kin ñiewbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shim ia kiba sah jong u Judah, kiba la buh ia ki khmat jong ki ban leit sha ka ri Ijipt ban sahkut hangta, bad kin hap ha ka ri Ijipt baroh: kin sa shah pynjot wat ha ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh: kin sa iap, naduh kaba rit eh, da ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh: bad kin long ka jingkyrduh, bad ka jingtim, bad ka jingtim .

en: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven  ; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee , and thou , and thy lords , thy wives , and thy concubines , have drunk wine in them  ; and thou hast praised the gods of silver , and gold , of brass , iron , wood , and stone , which see not , nor hear , nor know : and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways , hast thou not glorified :
kha: Phi la leh pyrshah ïa U Trai jong ka bneng bad phi la wallam shapoh ïa ki khuri bad ïa ki pliang kiba la shim na ka Templ jong u . Ma phi , ki rangbah donburom jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki tnga kliar jong phi ki la dih waiñ na ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa ki blei kiba la shna da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ka dieng , bad u maw — ki blei ki bym lah ban ïohi lane ïohsngew bad ba kim lah ban tip ei ei . Hynrei phim shym la pyndonburom ïa U Blei uba rai la phin im ne phin ïap bad uba synshar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la pynkiew ia lade pyrshah ia U Trai jong ka bneng bad ki la wanrah ia ki tiar jong ka iing jong u ha khmat jong me, bad me bad ki kynthei jong me, me la dih wain ha ki; bad me la iaroh ia ki blei rupa, bad ksiar, nar, nar, dieng bad maw, ki bym iohi, ne iohsngew: bad ia U Blei ha uba ka jingsawa jong me ka long: bad ha uba ka kti jong me ka long: bad ha uba ka kti jong me ka long:

en: Then were the king s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month , and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king s lieutenants , and to the governors that were over every province , and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language  ; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written , and sealed with the king s ring .
kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la khot ïa ki sekretari jong u syiem bad u la pule ha ki ba kin bud ïa ka jingpynbna bad ong ïa ki ban pynkylla ktien sha baroh ki jait ktien bad rukom thoh ba la pyndonkam ha ka hima bad ban phah sha baroh ki nongsynshar , ki lat bad rangbah synshar . La pynmih ha ka kyrteng jong u syiem Serksis bad shon muhor da ka sati jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la khot ia ki nongthoh syiem ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ba nyngkong , bad la thoh katkum ka jingthoh jong u syiem ha ka ktien jong u syiem .

en: And all Israel , and their elders , and officers , and their judges , stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , as well the stranger , as he that was born among them  ; half of them over against mount Gerizim , and half of them over against mount Ebal  ; as Moses the servant of the  Lord  had commanded before , that they should bless the people of Israel .
kha: Ki Israel lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki nongbishar ryngkat lem bad ki nongwei kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki la ïeng ha baroh arliang jong ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , da kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba bah ïa ka . Shiteng na u paidbah ki ïeng ha kaba ka lyngkdong jong ki ka phai sha u Lum Gerisim bad shiteng kiwei pat , ki lyngkdong jong ki , ki phai sha u Lum Ebal . U Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ynda poi ka por ïa ki ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel baroh bad ki rangbah jong ki bad ki nongbishar jong ki ki la ieng ha kane ka liang bad ha kata ka liang ha khmat ki lyngdoh ki Lebi kiba kit ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai , bad kumjuh ruh ia u nongwei uba la kha hapdeng jong ki;

en: And king Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest , saying , Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering , and the evening meat offering , and the king s burnt sacrifice , and his meat offering , with the burnt offering of all the people of the land , and their meat offering , and their drink offerings  ; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering , and all the blood of the sacrifice : and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by .
kha: Nangta u hukum ïa u Uriah :  Pyndonkam ïa kane ka duwan baheh jong nga na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang mynstep bad ïa ki jingainguh bam janmiet , na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang bad jingainguh bam jong u syiem bad ki briew , bad na ka bynta ki jingainguh waiñ jong ki briew . Theh halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki mrad baroh ïa kiba la kñia . Hynrei ieh ïa ka duwan rnong na ka bynta jong nga ban pyndonkam ïa kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ahasa u la hukum ia u nongknia uba heh, u la ong: Ha ka jingknia thang kaba khraw, bad ka jingknia bam janmiet, bad ka jingknia bam jong u, bad ka jingknia bam jong u baroh ki briew jong ka ri, bad ka jingknia bam jong ki baroh kawei bad ka jingknia bam jong ki baroh kawei bad ka jingknia bam jong ki baroh kawei bad ka snam jong ka jingknia ba la khleh lang bad ka snam jong ka jingknia bam ka long na ka bynta jong u .

en: And afterward , saith the  Lord  , I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah , and his servants , and the people , and such as are left in this city from the pestilence , from the sword , and from the famine , into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of those that seek their life : and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword  ; he shall not spare them , neither have pity , nor have mercy .
kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , ki rangbah synshar jong phi bad ki briew kiba lait im na ka thma , ka khlam bad ka  nemsniew — ngan ai ïa baroh na phi ban shahjop ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad da ki nongshun jong phi , kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa phi . U Nebukhadnessar un phah pynïap ïa phi . Un ym pynsah ïano ïano na phi lane un ym isynei lane sngewlem ïano ïano na phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kata, U Trai, ngan pyllait noh ia u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah, bad ki shakri jong u, bad ia kiba sah ha kane ka shnong, na ka waitlam bad na ka jingkyrduh, ha ka kti jong u Neuchrosar syiem Babilon bad ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki: bad un ym pyllait ia ki da ka tduh jong ka waitlam; bad un ym pyllait ia ki da ka jingsngewrit .

en: Then were the king s scribes called at that time in the third month , that is , the month Sivan , on the three and twentieth day thereof  ; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews , and to the lieutenants , and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia , an hundred twenty and seven provinces , unto every province according to the writing thereof , and unto every people after their language , and to the Jews according to their writing , and according to their language .
kha: Kane ka long ha ka sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba lai , u bnai Siban . U Mordekai u khot ïa ki sekretari jong u syiem bad u pule ba kin thoh ïa ki shithi sha ki Jiw bad ïa ki lat , ki nongsynshar , bad ki rangbah synshar jong baroh ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki probins    naduh India haduh Sudan . Ïa ki shithi la thoh sha baroh ki probins ha ki ktien bad ki rukom thoh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la khot ia ki nongthoh syiem ha kata ka por ha ka taiew kaba lai, kata, ha ka sngi kaba arphew snem jong ka; bad la thoh kat kum ka jingthoh jong ki Jiw bad ki nongshong shnong bad ki nongsynshar jong ki ri kiba don na India haduh Ethiopia, shispah arphew hynriew tylli ki ri, ha kawei pa kawei ka ri katkum ka jingthoh jong ki, bad ha ki Jiw katkum ka jingthoh jong ki .

en: I have more understanding than all my teachers : for thy testimonies are my meditation .  I understand more than the ancients , because I keep thy precepts .  I have refrained my feet from every evil way , that I might keep thy word .  I have not departed from thy judgments : for thou hast taught me .  How sweet are thy words unto my taste ! yea , sweeter than honey to my mouth !    Through thy precepts I get understanding : therefore I hate every false way .  Thy word is a lamp unto my feet , and a light unto my path .    I have sworn , and I will perform it , that I will keep thy righteous judgments .  I am afflicted very much : quicken me , O  Lord  , according unto thy word .  Accept , I beseech thee , the freewill offerings of my mouth , O  Lord  , and teach me thy judgments .  My soul is continually in my hand : yet do I not forget thy law .  The wicked have laid a snare for me : yet I erred not from thy precepts .  Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever : for they are the rejoicing of my heart .  I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway , even unto the end .    I hate vain thoughts : but thy law do I love .  Thou art my hiding place and my shield : I hope in thy word .  Depart from me , ye evildoers : for I will keep the commandments of my God .  Uphold me according unto thy word , that I may live : and let me not be ashamed of my hope .  Hold thou me up , and I shall be safe : and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually .  Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes : for their deceit is falsehood .  Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross : therefore I love thy testimonies .    My flesh trembleth for fear of thee  ; and I am afraid of thy judgments .  I have done judgment and justice : leave me not to mine oppressors .  Be surety for thy servant for good : let not the proud oppress me .  Mine eyes fail for thy salvation , and for the word of thy righteousness .  Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy , and teach me thy statutes .  I am thy servant  ; give me understanding , that I may know thy testimonies .  It is time for thee ,  Lord  , to work : for they have made void thy law .  Therefore I love thy commandments above gold  ; yea , above fine gold .  Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right  ; and I hate every false way .  Thy testimonies are wonderful : therefore doth my soul keep them .  The entrance of thy words giveth light  ; it giveth understanding unto the simple .  I opened my mouth , and panted : for I longed for thy commandments .  Look thou upon me , and be merciful unto me , as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name .    Order my steps in thy word : and let not any iniquity have dominion over me .  Deliver me from the oppression of man : so will I keep thy precepts .  Make thy face to shine upon thy servant  ; and teach me thy statutes .  Rivers of waters run down mine eyes , because they keep not thy law .  Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , and upright are thy judgments .  Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful .      My zeal hath consumed me , because mine enemies have forgotten thy words .    Thy word is very pure : therefore thy servant loveth it .    I am small and despised : yet do not I forget thy precepts .  Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness , and thy law is the truth .  Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me : yet thy commandments are my delights .    The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting : give me understanding , and I shall live .  I cried with my whole heart  ; hear me , O  Lord  : I will keep thy statutes .  I cried unto thee  ; save me , and I shall keep thy testimonies .    I prevented the dawning of the morning , and cried : I hoped in thy word .  Mine eyes prevent the night watches , that I might meditate in thy word .  Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness : O  Lord  , quicken me according to thy judgment .  They draw nigh that follow after mischief : they are far from thy law .  Thou art near , O  Lord   ; and all thy commandments are truth .  Concerning thy testimonies , I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever .  Consider mine affliction , and deliver me : for I do not forget thy law .  Plead my cause , and deliver me : quicken me according to thy word .  Salvation is far from the wicked : for they seek not thy statutes .  Great are thy tender mercies , O  Lord  : quicken me according to thy judgments .    Many are my persecutors and mine enemies  ; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies .  I beheld the transgressors , and was grieved  ; because they kept not thy word .  Consider how I love thy precepts : quicken me , O  Lord  , according to thy lovingkindness .  Thy word is true from the beginning : and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever .    Princes have persecuted me without a cause : but my heart standeth in awe of thy word .  I rejoice at thy word , as one that findeth great spoil .  I hate and abhor lying : but thy law do I love .  Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments .  Great peace have they which love thy law : and nothing shall offend them .    Lord  , I have hoped for thy salvation , and done thy commandments .  My soul hath kept thy testimonies  ; and I love them exceedingly .  I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies : for all my ways are before thee .  Let my cry come near before thee , O  Lord  : give me understanding according to thy word .  Let my supplication come before thee : deliver me according to thy word .  My lips shall utter praise , when thou hast taught me thy statutes .  My tongue shall speak of thy word : for all thy commandments are righteousness .  Let thine hand help me  ; for I have chosen thy precepts .  I have longed for thy salvation , O  Lord   ; and thy law is my delight .  Let my soul live , and it shall praise thee  ; and let thy judgments help me .  I have gone astray like a lost sheep  ; seek thy servant  ; for I do not forget thy commandments .
kha: Nga shemphang kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai jong nga baroh , namar nga puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .  Nga don ka jingstad kaba kham khraw ban ïa ki riewtymmen , namar nga kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .  Nga kiar na ka jingleh sniew baroh , namar nga kwah ban kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .
